Use the union bound over $i$; multiple far coordinates cause no issue. Every other coordinate was summed on its whole original domain after (C8). Finite-N absolute convergence and the displayed dominating series justify all summations. No partial-far exterior with uncontrolled $R$ powers appears: the hypothesis used is the shared all-CROSS endpoint gap, valid for arbitrary real spectator spectra. This is the stronger input missing from the local operator-tail argument. ### The finite charges outside the local scaled box The remaining set $0<|\ell_i|\leq M_i$ is finite after $\mathbf n$ is fixed. Suppose at least one coordinate $i$ has $|\ell_i|/|n_i|>a$. Reflect charge signs if necessary; the source is separately even, so absolute estimates are unchanged and assume $\ell_i>0$. On the original real domain outside $K_b$, the shared global spectral gap gives rate $\Phi_D-\gamma_b$. The Gaussian and Fourier factors there have modulus one. No contour estimate is needed for this finite-charge portion. Inside $K_b$, shift only coordinate $i$ upward by $$ t_i=\frac{b}{|n_i|}.\tag{C15} $$ All actual side currents of this small rectangle are retained. The packet and its real-action Taylor bound give, uniformly for $x$ in $K_b$ and $0\leq v\leq t_i$, $$ \operatorname{Re}A_N(x+iv e_i) \leq A_N(0)-c|x|^2+Cv^2.\tag{C16} $$ Reality makes the first Taylor term purely imaginary. The Gaussian-plus-Fourier contribution in this coordinate is $$ -2\pi n_ix_iv-2\pi\ell_iv \leq-2\pi|n_i|(a-b)v\leq0.\tag{C17} $$ On the horizontal translate, $v=t_i$, this costs at least $2\pi b(a-b)$, while the source error is at most $Cb^2/n_0^2$. On either vertical side $|x_i|=b$, (C16) gives at least $cb^2$ loss, and (C17) is nonpositive. Enlarge $n_0$ so $C/n_0^2$ is small. Then the horizontal and both sides have a fixed strict gap $\gamma_{\mathrm{bad}}>0$ below $\Phi_D$, independently of slope ratios. The packet's amplitudes contribute only polynomial factors. Together with the exterior $K_b$ bound, every such bounded bad charge is exponentially small. There are finitely many of them, so their whole sum obeys the same strict rate with a fixed-n prefactor. No infinite sharp-cube series has been split. ### Finite local charges and the actual unit contribution It remains to consider the finite set with all $|\ell_i|/|n_i|\leq a$. On the real domain outside the larger $K_B$, the shared global spectral gap gives a fixed loss $\gamma_B$. Inside $K_B$ apply the [localized original contour theorem](general_localized_unit_charge_filling_period.md) to the packet (PH1), using the preceding local argument with its cube parameter set to $B$. It retains the exact side currents, the finite action, the Gaussian determinant branch and all sine/charge/parity factors. For positive charges the finite critical values satisfy $$ \operatorname{Re}S_{N,\mathbf1}-\operatorname{Re}S_{N,\boldsymbol\ell} \geq\sum_i\frac{C_i}{2n_i^2}(\ell_i^2-1).\tag{C18} $$ All sign-unit choices contribute exactly equally. Every other charge in this finite local box has a positive fixed-n gap. The all-unit local contribution is precisely the first-charge formula above, with its $O_{\mathbf n}(N^{-1})$ relative error and nonzero limiting amplitude. The half twists are included once through $n_i=\epsilon_i-2p_i$. The limiting unit loss from $\Phi_D$ is $O_D(\sum_i|n_i|^{-2})$. Enlarge the diagram-dependent $n_0$ until this loss is less than one quarter of the minimum of $\gamma_\infty$, $\gamma_{\mathrm{bad}}$, $\gamma_b$ and $\gamma_B$. Also require $a n_0\geq1$ so the unit charge lies in the local box. Since $S_{N,\mathbf1}$ tends to its limiting value, all complementary bounds above are then exponentially smaller than $e^{N\operatorname{Re}S_{N,\mathbf1}}$ for large N. The smallest nonunit gap in (C18) may depend on the fixed vector $\mathbf n$, but remains positive. Combining the finite local sector, bounded bad charges and the absolutely bounded infinite union proves the first-charge asymptotic. The exact critical volume identity identifies $$ \lim_{N\to\infty}\frac{2\pi}{N}\log|I_{\mathrm{cross}}| =\operatorname{Vol}(\text{the actual smooth filled exterior}).\tag{C19} $$ There is no uniform joint growing-twist/level error assertion: the twists are fixed first, while the threshold applies to arbitrary independent signs and magnitudes. ## 9. Restoring the full invariant under balance At every crossing circle put \(X_e=Q_{b_e}(0)+Q_{c_e}(0)\). The fan proof established \(X_e>\log b_e\) when \(b_e>0\) and \(X_e>\log c_e\) when \(c_e>0\). It also gives \(Q_t(0)>\frac12\log t\) for each positive middle. These are inequalities at the one actual complete marked packing. ### Every sector containing a one-sided crossing circle has a global spectral gap The [exact path partition](actual_cross_cofactor_factorization.md) is disjoint at both parities. For $N=2m$, LEFT has $j\leq m-1$, CROSS has $i\leq m-1$ and $j\geq m$, and RIGHT has $i\geq m$. For $N=2m+1$, LEFT has $j\leq m-1$, CROSS has $i\leq m\leq j$, and RIGHT has $i\geq m+1$. The odd central zero-step path belongs to CROSS exactly once. At a fixed crossing circle, the [global weighted LEFT theorem](actual_global_left_weighted_spectral_envelope.md) bounds the actual absolute value, at arbitrary face phases and every real spectral value, by the rate $$ L_e=\max\left\{\log c,Q_b(0)+\frac12\log c\right\},\qquad c>0.\tag{B3} $$ If $c=0$, the finite LEFT polynomial vanishes identically because its $c$ exponent is at least $\lfloor N/2\rfloor>0$. Similarly, the RIGHT rate is $$ R_e=\max\left\{\log b,Q_c(0)+\frac12\log b\right\},\qquad b>0,\tag{B4} $$ and the RIGHT polynomial vanishes exactly when $b=0$. The strict balance inequality and \(Q_t(0)>\tfrac12\log t\) give $L_e<X_e$ and $R_e<X_e$ whenever the corresponding sector survives. This also resolves the protected monomial exception: if one triangle has $t=0$ and $xy=0$, the sector overloading that zero middle is absent, while the opposite surviving sector uses the strict triangle inequality for its positive middle. If both middles vanish, both one-sided sectors vanish exactly. The [global CROSS coefficient comparison](actual_cross_cofactor_factorization.md), Section 8, bounds its value on the same face torus by rate $X_e$, with only a polynomial or logarithmic prefactor. Thus the whole local full numerator is bounded by rate $X_e$, and any chosen LEFT or RIGHT factor supplies a fixed strict loss. Since $D$ is fixed, the minimum of its finitely many surviving one-sided gaps is positive. If none survives, the remainder is identically zero and the subsequent conclusion is immediate. Take any original path sector with at least one one-sided crossing circle and CROSS, LEFT or RIGHT assigned elsewhere. The value bounds are uniform over the original common face Cauchy torus. The same marked target extraction therefore gives, for some $\gamma>0$ and all sufficiently large $N$, $$ |Z_{\mathrm{sector}}(\sigma_1,\ldots,\sigma_R)| \leq e^{N(\Phi_D-\gamma)},\tag{B5} $$ uniformly on the entire real spectral cube $[-2,2]^R$, at both parities. Here $\sum_eX_e$ minus the original ordinary log-radius targets is exactly $\Phi_D=\operatorname{Vol}(Y_D)/(2\pi)$, by the calibrated complete source. The protected variables stay zero throughout. No infimum of a sum of local maxima or independent-radius capacity equality is used. There are only $3^R-1$ such sectors. Their sum is exactly the full shared numerator minus its all-CROSS part. Thus (B5) also holds for that remainder, after reducing $\gamma$. It is a polynomial of spectral degree at most $d$ in each variable. Multivariate cosine Bernstein extends (B5) to a sufficiently thin fixed complex $\delta$ strip, at cost $\exp[2\pi d\sum_i|\operatorname{Im}\delta_i|]$. Reducing the strip height and $\gamma$ gives the same strict gap there. ### Entire original Fourier remainder and the full invariant Apply the [whole-domain three-integration-by-parts lemma](actual_global_diagonal_spectral_sector_gap.md), Section 4, to the remainder polynomial. The original sine factors vanish at both endpoints, first derivatives match, and the second-derivative endpoint current is retained. Source derivatives use the fixed strip; Gaussian derivatives are taken only on the real cube. Summing all nonzero original charges with their actual weights and parity gives $$ |I_{\mathrm{full}}-I_{\mathrm{cross}}| \leq C_D\prod_i(1+|n_i|)^3e^{N(\Phi_D-\gamma')},\tag{B6} $$ for a fixed $\gamma'>0$. No infinite sharp-cube charge series is split. All framing and component scalars remain the original ones. The [entire all-CROSS period theorem](general_all_cross_long_filling_volume.md) supplies a nonzero relative filling asymptotic for every fixed independently signed sufficiently long integer vector $n_i=\epsilon_i-2p_i$. Its unit critical rate tends to $\Phi_D$ as $\min_i|n_i|$ tends to infinity, with loss $O_D(\sum_i n_i^{-2})$. Choose a diagram-dependent threshold so this loss is less than $\gamma'/2$ and all existing geometric and analytic filling thresholds hold. Then (B6) is exponentially smaller than the complete all-CROSS asymptotic. Thus $$ \frac{I_{\mathrm{full}}}{I_{\mathrm{cross}}} =1+O_{\mathbf n}(e^{-c_{\mathbf n}N}),\tag{B7} $$ and $$ \lim_{N\to\infty}\frac{2\pi}{N}\log|I_{\mathrm{full}}| =\operatorname{Vol}(\text{the actual smooth filled exterior}).\tag{B8} $$ The same conclusion holds after multiplying by the separately recorded original normalization characters and nonzero polynomial-level factors. For the prescribed parity yielding a knot, this is the corresponding full original knot invariant, not a chosen spectral contribution. It does not assert that a given $2k$-plat has minimal bridge number $k$. The quantifiers are: for this fixed decorated diagram satisfying the balance inequalities, there exists $T(D)$ such that every independently signed fixed filling vector with all $|p_i|\geq T(D)$, in the prescribed parity convention, has (B7)–(B8) as $N\to\infty$. No bound on ratios $|p_i|/|p_j|$ is needed. There is no joint growing-twist/level estimate or uniform threshold over different diagrams or widths. ## 10. The original primitive geometric action ### Primitive geometry on the refined Morse diagram The geometric verification also uses the actual Morse presentation, not a hidden flat-plat replacement. From the stationary radii, solve the marked line-circle equations with matching inversive distances \(\cos(2\pi\delta_e)\). Their Jacobian is invertible by the same finite-face Hessian and elementary triangle motion argument. This gives one common nearby pattern with the original two marked lines. For each white face let \(\mathcal R_f^\pm\) be its two holomorphic reflection matrices, with \(\mathcal R_f^-\mathcal R_f^+=I\). At an actual Morse slice with regions \(F_0,\ldots,F_k\), set \[ H_j=\mathcal R_{F_j}^+\mathcal R_{F_{j-1}}^-,\qquad H_j\cdots H_1=\mathcal R_{F_j}^+\mathcal R_{F_0}^-. \tag{U13} \] Shared wire ends have the same regions and therefore the same based head. At cups/caps the first and last regions agree, giving the full inverse-pair relation. The prescribed shaded collar sends both ordered input puncture generators to their output generators, while preserving their product \(P=BA\). The source-selected eigenvalue is \(J=-e^{-2\pi i\delta}\), and the primitive collar ratio is \[ R_0=E_bE_c/D,\qquad U=-\log R_0-\epsilon\log(-J),\qquad V=2\log(-J)=-4\pi i\delta. \tag{U14} \] The matrix collar is the regular full divided difference \[ C=I+\frac{R_0-1}{J-J^{-1}}(P-J^{-1}I). \tag{U15} \] Its value at the parabolic complete point is retained, not replaced by the scalar eigenratio one. The auxiliary meridian follows \(C^{-1}\), and the original signed half twist is the full Hurwitz word with \(P^{-1}-I\). The ordered contacts, not just traces, fix these choices. The common marked-line limit supplies every zero face case. These are the local identities in [actual_deformed_circle_primitive_collar.md](actual_deformed_circle_primitive_collar.md). Equations (U13)--(U15) verify all shared wires, cups/caps, drilled threading and half-twist relations in the actual Morse van Kampen presentation, exactly as in [actual_complete_core_geometric_deformation.md](actual_complete_core_geometric_deformation.md), Section 2. Matching graph cycles introduce no extra free conjugating frame because the reflections were chosen on one global pattern. At zero this is the complete representation of the refined link, from its own cut certificate. Marked positive-gluing rigidity identifies the nearby family as that same geometric germ. For the ordinary-face stationary action \[ A_\epsilon(\boldsymbol\delta)= \operatorname{crit}_{\text{finite faces}} \left\{\sum_e(Q_{b_e}+Q_{c_e})- \sum_{f\ne u,v}\log L_f+\pi i\sum_e\epsilon_e\delta_e^2\right\}, \tag{U16} \] the primitive identities give \(\partial_eA_\epsilon=U_e\). The complete anchor is the actual augmented volume computed above. The same marked regulator calculation therefore gives \[ 2\pi\operatorname{Re}A_\epsilon =\operatorname{Vol}(\rho) -\tfrac12\sum_e\operatorname{Im}U_e\operatorname{Re}V_e. \tag{U17} \] At the first-charge critical point of the original period (S18), \[ U_e+p_eV_e=-2\pi i. \tag{U18} \] For independently sufficiently long fixed fillings this is the primitive smooth-filling branch of the actual refined exterior. The boundary term in (U17) cancels the original Gaussian/linear filling terms exactly. Hence the exponential rate is the volume of that actual filled complement. There is no comparison-diagram substitution and no inference from a formal critical value alone. ## 11. Completing the actual filled metric ### The precise metric completion theorem used after filling The authoritative general statement is [general_source_regulator_hyperbolic_equality.md](general_source_regulator_hyperbolic_equality.md), Sections 1--5. Let \(Y\) be the actual complete finite-volume augmented exterior, with its actual primitive peripheral bases. There is one neighborhood of its complete framed representation such that every representation in that neighborhood with parabolic unfilled peripheral groups and actual small logarithms satisfying \[ U_e+p_eV_e=-2\pi i. \tag{M3} \] is the holonomy of a smooth complete hyperbolic metric on the specified filled exterior. The neighborhood is chosen before the slopes. Here are the construction and the period check. On a compact truncated core choose a finite lifted partition of unity \(\eta_{j,\gamma}\). In the future hyperboloid form \[ Y_\rho(x)=\sum_{j,\gamma}\eta_{j,\gamma}(x) \rho(\gamma)\rho_0(\gamma)^{-1}x, \qquad E_\rho(x)=\frac{Y_\rho(x)}{\sqrt{-\langle Y_\rho(x),Y_\rho(x)\rangle}}. \tag{M4} \] The sum is future timelike and equivariant. On a compact fundamental part it is \(C^1\)-close to the identity, hence an oriented local diffeomorphism for nearby representations. In a cusp frame sending the selected flag to infinity, write the peripheral affine action as \(A_\rho(\lambda)z=a_\lambda z+b_\lambda\) on the original translation lattice \(\Lambda\). A smooth periodic partition of unity gives \[ d_\rho(w)=\sum_{\lambda\in\Lambda}\eta(w-\lambda) A_\rho(\lambda)(w-\lambda), \qquad F_\rho(w,t)=(d_\rho(w),e^{t+\chi_\rho(w)}), \tag{M5} \] where \(\chi_\rho\) is the real-linear extension of \(\log|a_\lambda|\). The first map is a positive local diffeomorphism and is exactly affine-equivariant; the second is an equivariant positive local diffeomorphism for the entire cusp tail. It is \(C^1\)-close to the old development on a compact collar. Geodesic interpolation with (M4) gives a global developing local diffeomorphism on the original manifold with its ideal ends removed. At a filled cusp, commuting nontrivial affine multipliers have a common finite fixed point \(q=b/(1-a)\). Near the complete representation the original generator translations stay nonzero, so \(|q|\to\infty\). The developed fundamental parallelogram and fixed generator paths of \(d_\rho\) remain bounded. Hence they miss \(q\), and equivariance makes the entire development miss it. On the simply connected link cover set \(f=\log(d_\rho-q)\). Its invariant differential gives a complete nonsingular flat metric \(|df|^2\) on the compact torus. The lifted local isometry is therefore a global Euclidean development, and its periods form an injective rank-two lattice. If a fixed generator path has image length at most \(L\) inside \(|d|\le R\), its logarithmic increment is at most \(L/(|q|-R)\), tending to zero. Its exponential is the corresponding peripheral multiplier. Both this increment and the prescribed small multiplier log tend to zero, so their difference, an integral multiple of \(2\pi i\), is exactly zero in one fixed neighborhood. The periods are thus the actual \(U,V\), before multiplication by any large slope coefficient. This excludes a hidden winding in (M3). Translate \(q\) to zero. The tail contains an entire equivariant epigraph \(y>A|d|\). Put \[ R=\operatorname{arsinh}(|d|/y),\qquad \theta=\operatorname{Im}f,\qquad X=\operatorname{Re}f+\tfrac12\log(1+y^2/|d|^2). \] Direct substitution gives the hyperbolic tube metric \[ ds^2=dR^2+\cosh^2R\,dX^2+\sinh^2R\,d\theta^2. \tag{M6} \] The tail contains a full punctured tube. Equation (M3) gives angular period \(-2\pi\) and zero longitudinal period on the primitive meridian. A complementary primitive curve has nonzero real log period, because the log lattice has real rank two. Adding \(R=0\) therefore gives a smooth solid torus, with exactly the original filling slope. Its affine meridian fixes both \(q\) and infinity and has multiplier one, so the representation also descends to the filled group. At an unfilled cusp both multipliers are one. Formula (M5) then gives a translation-equivariant complete Euclidean link and a full horoball quotient. In our construction the main meridian is noncentral parabolic throughout; its commuting longitude has multiplier one as well. Thus the main cusp remains complete and unfilled. The remainder of the manifold is compact, so the completed metric is finite-volume and complete. Its universal developing local isometry covers \(\mathbb H^3\), giving discrete faithful holonomy. The selected first-charge source solution lies in this fixed framed neighborhood once all fixed powers are sufficiently long. The common circle pattern, full collar matrices and selected flags converge to their original complete values; this is stronger than convergence of peripheral traces. Consequently (M3)--(M6) identify the actual smooth filled \(S^3\) knot complement. The regulator identity then calibrates the source action to that metric's volume. It does not replace the completion argument. ## 12. Exact reproduction and limits The script [audit_actual_balanced_terminal_fans.py](../experiments/audit_actual_balanced_terminal_fans.py) reproduces the polynomial recurrence, rational balance margin, oriented stellar matching and even coset, and literal quarter-turn/stack endpoint pairings. It uses integer and rational arithmetic. It does not test or replace the analytic asymptotic, full source identity or hyperbolic metric proof. The old and new powers are all independently sufficiently long and fixed before the level. There is no claim for the undecorated core, short core powers, a growing family, or a uniform threshold over different diagrams. No restriction to arborescent cores or prescribed minimum bridge number is used. The actual refined complement is the volume target. The cyclic matching-source channels remain in the shared coefficient. Their bound uses the true common-radius balance, not a scalar kernel product on a graph with cycles. No moving-main profile, shifted microscopic expansion or annihilator-factor statement is supplied.

title: Actual auxiliary-color packets through the complete-circle quarter transition
text: # Actual auxiliary-color packets through the complete-circle quarter transition 29 October 2026. This extends the complete-circle boundary packet to the ACTUAL inner auxiliary color j=N-h, rather than declaring its pair-Casimir argument to be a peripheral parameter. It proves an exact finite analytic inner packet on a fixed complex color disk, with a nonzero joint spectral/color asymptotic, and a full physical inner-color complement gap. Every original first Casimir normal and Cartan phase remains present. The final outer-circle color functional is a separate operation. The estimates below supply its inner inputs; they do not by themselves assert the hypotheses of the general long-filling theorem for the whole stack or identify a deformed representation. ## 1. The actual mixed circle, including its nonzero second band Use N,d,q,Q,kappa,M,F_r,s_r and the original continuants f_v from [the exact mixed two-band source](actual_pretzel_cusp_color_two_band_bound.md). For every physical 0<=h<=M, the FULL all-port identity is z_(N,h)=mathscrR(R^(-1)L_(N-h))=c_(N,h)+R P_(N,h), c_(N,h)=kappa^(-1) sum_(v=h)^M N^2 s_(2v) f_v/[s_v^2 s_(v-h)s_(v+h)]. (1) Here L_j is the literal ordinary mixed-color auxiliary trace and mathscrR is the genuine unscaled physical turn. For j<=N/2 the whole box is the pure alias (-1)^N R P_(N,j), including the even middle color. Thus all physical colors are accounted for. The reflected box is z_(N,h)^sharp. The sharp operation means coefficient conjugation, including kappa and the fixed root. Its complex-color continuation will be defined by Schwarz reflection of the specified analytic packet, not by conjugating its parameter inside an allegedly holomorphic expression. For the physical low core, interchanging its two finite sums gives c_(N,h)(c)=N^2 sum_(r=0)^M b_(N,r)(h) B_r(c), b_(N,r)=kappa^(-1) q^(h^2)(-1)^r q^(2r^2+r) A_(h,r)/F_r^3, A_(h,r)=sum_(v=max(h,r))^M Q^(-vr)F_(2v)/[F_v F_(v-h)F_(v+h)F_(v-r)], B_r(c)=product_(a<r)(c_a-c). (2) These are exact root identities with their original marked phases. No upper band, source normal or normalization is suppressed. ## 2. A source-selected complex-color channel THROUGH the quarter point Put tau=r/N, chi=pi h/N, H=exp(2i chi), Y=exp(2pi i tau), epsilon=1/N. On a fixed compact r-window about N/4, define A_(h,r) for COMPLEX h=N chi/pi by replacing F_(v-h),F_(v+h) in its finite sum v=r,...,M by the canonical marked Fhat_N. All these arguments remain in regular nonzero factorial strips after choosing a fixed small complex chi disk. The continuation is even in chi and equals the physical coefficient whenever h is an integer below the window. Normalize U_(h,r)=A_(h,r)/D_(h,r), where D_(h,r)=Q^(-r^2)F_(2r)/[F_r Fhat_N(r-h)Fhat_N(r+h)]. The [literal mixed Ward and high source](actual_pretzel_mixed_inner_source_wkb.md) prove, for THIS finite factorial continuation, U_r=p_N(tau,chi) U_(r+1)+q_N(tau,chi) U_(r+2), (3) p_N=-Q^(-2)Y^(-1)(2cos(2chi)Q^3Y^2+Q+1) /[(1-QY/H)(1-QYH)], q_N=-Q^(-4)Y^(-2)(1-Q^2Y)(1-Q^3Y^2)(1+Q^2Y) /[(1-QY/H)(1-QYH)(1-Q^2Y/H)(1-Q^2YH)]. The original source is U_M=1; its q_(M-1)=0 wall is exact at both parities and remains independent of complex chi. In particular the actual source, rather than an arbitrary solution of (3), is holomorphic and nonzero at a strict high-index anchor. Let mu_s,mu_f be the roots of the principal companion, continued from mu_s=-Y^(-1), mu_f=Y^(-1)cot(pi tau)^2 at chi=0. They are distinct and nonzero near tau=1/4 on a fixed complex neighborhood and small chi disk. Their relative multiplier in HIGH-to-LOW transport at chi=0 is -cot(pi tau)^2. Apply the supplied-eigenframe analytic diagonalizer from [the boundary-packet proof](actual_complete_circle_boundary_packet.md#2-the-exact-direction-of-transport-and-a-source-barrier), now holomorphically in chi. First fix its neighborhood and positive exponential remainder barrier sigma. Then choose a small fixed delta, anchor u_b=pi/4+2delta+O(1/N), and target |u-pi/4|<=delta/4. At chi=0 the relative fast action from anchor to ANY target is at most -gamma_0<0, while its entire intermediate action width is O(delta^2)<sigma/4. Continuity on the fixed complex chi disk preserves a strictly negative target action and width<sigma/2. Shrink chi AFTER delta; merely distinct roots do not imply this. The established high-index continued fraction supplies the exact anchor vector. Relative to its nonzero selected scalar, its slow coefficient is1+O(1/N), its fast coefficient O(1/N), uniformly for complex chi. Multiplying the exponentially diagonalized recurrence in its diagonal interaction frame bounds EVERY conversion error by exp[-N(sigma-width)]. The initially present fast source component is exponentially damped on the target. No source component or compensating current is deleted. This proves selection through the modulus crossing, uniformly on that fixed complex parameter disk. Optimal analytic Euler--Maclaurin of the slow diagonal product, anchored to the SAME exact high source coefficient, now gives a holomorphic zero-free Uhat_N(tau,chi) on a tube containing the whole anchor-to-target interval. On the target physical r-grid, U_(h,r)=Uhat_N(r/N,chi)[1+O(exp(-gamma N))]. (4) All statements are uniform in complex chi. The first transport coefficients are exactly the old rational expressions S(tau,chi)=integral_tau^(1/2) Log mu_s(t,chi)dt, C(tau,chi)=sqrt(mu_s(tau,chi)) exp[integral_tau^(1/2)nu/mu_s dt], nu=[p_1+q_1/mu_s-q_0(partial_tau mu_s)/mu_s^2] /[1+q_0/mu_s^2]. (5) The roots are continued from the original high interval to the target; the denominator is1-mu_f/mu_s and does NOT vanish at the quarter point. The normal-form diagonal and its first correction are holomorphic. Their explicit first-order scalar transport gives Uhat_N=C(tau,chi) exp[N S(tau,chi)] [1+O(1/N)]. (6) The constant is fixed by the old high source on the overlapping anchor tube, not by an unknown closed circle value. Formula (5) agrees there with the proved selected transport; the same analytic nonresonant transport equation continues it uniquely across the quarter point. This separates the algebraic leading error in (6) from the exponential original-grid error in (4). ## 3. Exact finite analytic inner packet and its joint asymptotic Choose a fixed index window I_N about the quarter point whose closure lies STRICTLY INSIDE the controlled target neighborhood in section2; for example use |u-pi/4|<=delta/8. Its endpoints may move by O(1/N) to the physical grid. It is nonempty for all sufficiently large N. Take the finite polynomial Z_N^win(c,chi)=N^2 sum_(r in I_N) kappa^(-1) q^(h^2)(-1)^r q^(2r^2+r) Ahat_(h,r) B_r(c)/F_r^3, (7) where Ahat is the EXACT finite factorial completion in section2. It is even holomorphic in chi on a fixed complex disk, with all Casimir derivatives literal. The reflected packet is Z_N^(win,sharp)(c,chi)=conjugate(Z_N^win(conjugate(c),conjugate(chi))). Both are holomorphic, with their separate typed source phases. Let J_sin(tau)=integral_0^tau Log(2sin(pi t))dt and define B(tau,chi)=S(tau,chi)-S(tau,0)+2J_sin(tau) -J_sin(tau-chi/pi)-J_sin(tau+chi/pi), D(tau,chi)=[C(tau,chi)/C(tau,0)] sin(pi tau) /sqrt(sin(pi tau-chi)sin(pi tau+chi)). (8) The marked factorial reflection shows these are precisely the exponential correction and amplitude ratio of q^(h^2)D_(h,r)/D_(0,r). In particular B(tau,0)=0,D(tau,0)=1, and D is nonzero. Put Psi(u,eta,chi)=[-Lambda(2u)+6Lambda(u)]/pi +(1/(2pi))integral_0^(2u)Log(2cosh eta+2cos v)dv +B(u/pi,chi). (9) The whole phase is even in eta and chi. At (eta,chi)=(0,0), its selected index is u=pi/4 and Psi_uu=-8/pi. The implicit function theorem gives a unique holomorphic u_*(eta,chi) nearby. Let j(eta,chi)=Psi(u_*,eta,chi), and a(eta,chi)=[sqrt(sin(2u_*))/sin(u_*)^(5/2)] exp(iu_*/2)D(u_*/pi,chi) /[4sqrt(pi)sqrt(-Psi_uu(u_*,eta,chi))]. (10) These are the SAME source-calibrated functions as the old mixed high-index theorem on its overlap eta>0; now both parameters range on fixed complex disks about zero. The exact finite packet satisfies Z_N^win(-2cosh eta,chi) =exp(-i pi d/4) a(eta,chi) exp[Nj(eta,chi)] [1+O(1/N)], (11) uniformly on smaller fixed complex disks. Its amplitude is nonzero. Proof: (4) supplies an exponentially accurate original-grid interpolant. Canonical factorials and the half-shift Newton factor are regular on this window and have the same optimal EM residual bound. The exact half-grid cotangent rectangle retains every vertical endpoint and horizontal nonzero-mode current. Its complete real phase has a fixed endpoint gap; the top/bottom cotangent errors have exp(-2Nd) while the phase increases O(d^2). Choose contour height first, then shrink the fixed eta,chi disks. All residuals are below the selected saddle by a fixed exponential rate. The two constant cotangent pieces give the same saddle integral with density N/pi. Analytic Gaussian expansion gives (10)--(11), including both original parity phases. This is the earlier exact cotangent proof with the newly justified source across the quarter point, not continuation of a merely pointwise leading formula. The rational principal quadratic gives, by differentiating in chi^2, j(eta,chi)=j(eta,0) -(1+exp(2iu_*(eta,0)))chi^2/(2pi i)+O(chi^4). Consequently at the complete spectral point, j(eta,chi)=j_0+eta^2/(4pi) +(-1+i)chi^2/(2pi)+O((|eta|+|chi|)^4), (12) with j_0=v8/pi. Reflection reverses the imaginary color coefficient, with its own explicit opposite complete-source phase. The real physical-color curvature is strictly negative. All fixed Casimir normals follow from the uniform holomorphic c-disk in (11); this does not assert moving-q normal derivatives of an unspecified off-root turn family. These estimates apply to the EXACT packet, not only its leading expression. Writing theta=s+it, chi=x+iy, and using eta=i theta, one may shrink the fixed disks so that |Z_N^win(-2cos theta,chi)| <=poly(N) exp N[j_0-a(s^2+x^2)+C(t^2+y^2)] (12a) for some a,C>0. The same holds for the typed reflected packet. The cross terms from the imaginary quadratic coefficient are absorbed by a fixed completion of squares; the quartic remainder is absorbed after shrinking. The uniform relative error in (11) changes only the prefactor. There is also a fixed angular gap away from theta=0. On the whole physical r-window the exact coefficient bound is |b_(N,r)(chi)|<=poly(N) [s_(2r)/s_r^6] exp(CN|chi|^2). It follows from (4)--(8) and their even analytic action perturbation. The old Newton arc-convolution has a strict angular gap uniformly on this compact r-window about pi/4. Therefore, on the remainder of the physical theta circle outside any fixed small central arc, the packet is bounded by poly(N)exp[N(j_0-g+C|chi|^2)]. The gap persists on a small fixed complex theta strip and chi disk. Cauchy on radius1/N then controls every fixed derivative with only an additional polynomial factor. These are bounds for the explicit finite polynomial (7), suitable before the outer-color transform. ## 4. Actual-source replacement on a full fixed cusp corridor Use the faithful original Hermite norm ||f||_H=max_double(|f(c)|+N^(-2)|f'(c)|), also including the odd simple value. It is submultiplicative; ||R||_H,||R^(-1)||_H<=9/8, and |phi(f)|<=3N^3||f||_H. For some fixed delta_0,gamma>0, uniformly for the ACTUAL integers 0<=h<=delta_0 N, ||z_(N,h)-Z_N^win(.,pi h/N)||_H <=poly(N)exp[N(j_0-gamma)]. (13) The proof includes two different retained source errors. First, the removed r-indices have the original all-index envelope J_1(u)+E(u)+C chi^2. Its unique maximum at chi=0 is pi/4, so the complement of I_N has a fixed gap. To obtain a uniform segment bound without a root singularity, enclose[-2,2] by a fixed small Bernstein ellipse: its uniform log-integral profile approaches the unit-radius profile, hence preserves that gap. The factorial and mixed-Ward bounds are polynomial times this exponential. A degree<=M complex Markov bound preserves it for the first normals. Second, the entire original upper band obeys ||RP_(N,h)||_H<=56^h. Shrink delta_0 until delta_0 log56<j_0-gamma. The finite errors in (13) are not zero; they are bounded before any exterior closure. This is why the actual even packet can replace the non-even full mixed source only with its explicit residual. For any fixed number n of stack pieces and fixed crossing power m, telescoping products in this faithful norm proves the same type of exponential replacement bound for the entire original stack, after an additional fixed shrink of delta_0. It is uniform for every physical outer color because max_(1<=j<=N)||L_j||_H=poly(N), ||R^m||_H<= (9/8)^|m|. (14) Indeed |U_(j-1)(c/2)|<=j on[-2,2] and Markov costs at most N^2/2 per derivative. No positive quotient of the radical or source-operator commutation beyond the actual full pair algebra is used. ## 5. A width-free gap for the ENTIRE physical inner-color complement For every fixed delta>0 with a nonempty physical complement there is gamma_delta>0 such that limsup_N N^(-1)log max_(0<=h<N)||z_(N,h)||_H<=j_0, limsup_N N^(-1)log max_(delta N<=h<N)||z_(N,h)||_H <=j_0-gamma_delta. (15) Here h=N-j labels EVERY actual auxiliary color, not just the low half. For j<=N/2, the entire box is a pure alias, bounded by the proved uniform rate B_alias=(1/2)log(4+sqrt15)<j_0. For j>N/2, keep both the low core and that alias. The uniform core upper rate j_0 follows from the global mixed-source spectral envelope. Its STRICT complement gap can be made uniform as the enclosing ellipse shrinks to the unit circle. Specifically choose ONCE 1/4<beta<1/2 and a closed contracting interval I subset(pi beta,pi/2). Every actual source propagating from the original terminal wall to r<=beta N crosses I. The exact spectral ellipse gives a uniform strict factor there for ALL delta N<=h<=M, including the repeated-root endpoint color. Frozen finite blocks turn it into a fixed exponential contraction, without choosing a root or assuming an eigenbasis. This factor is independent of the spectral radius R of the outer Newton estimate. For r>beta N, the complete profile J_R+E has a fixed gap from j_0 uniformly for R sufficiently close to1, since its maximizer converges to pi/4. Choose that R so small that j(log R)-j_0 is less than one quarter of the fixed contraction/gap budget. The maximum principle on the segment and complex Markov give the stated Hermite gap. Thus a vanishing gap in the limit R->1 has NOT been assumed away. The old uniform subexponential frozen- block cost is absorbed by half the fixed gap. This proves (15), including every color endpoint and its first normal. It follows immediately that for every fixed stack width n>=1, any fixed signed R power, and ANY physical outer color, the full original mixed scalar has a fixed exponential gap below n j_0 whenever at least one INNER deficit is at least delta N. The source cost in (14) is polynomial and one factor in (15) loses a fixed rate; the other fixed n-1 factors cost at most j_0+o(1). No minimum-width restriction is required: unlike the pretzel marked-period problem, the stack reference height is n j_0 with no outer Legendre loss. The separate complement in the OUTER auxiliary color remains the task of its exact Fourier-Hermite source transform. ## 6. The complete local input for the original outer-color source Fix n>=1 and m in Z. For physical inner deficits in the corridor, let F_phys(theta)=R(-2cos theta)^m product_i z_(N,h_i)^(typed i)(-2cos theta), where each type is z or its literal sharp. Its definition here means the original full-Hermite polynomial. On a fixed small central complex theta window take the EXACT finite analytic function F_win(theta,chi)=kappa^(m/2) exp[iNm theta^2/(4pi)] product_i Z_N^(win,typed i)(-2cos theta,chi_i), (16) with kappa^(m/2)=exp[i pi m d^2/(4N)], without a principal-root reset. This is separately even in theta and every chi_i. The replacement of R by its displayed Gaussian retains BOTH the value and first normal at every physical node in this window. Indeed, for theta_j=(2j-d)pi/N, the exact nodal phase is R(c_j)=kappa^(1/2)exp[iNtheta_j^2/(4pi)]. At every double node, the full original source derivative is R'(c_j)/R(c_j)=-(d-2j)/[2(q^(2j+1)-q^(-2j-1))], partial_theta log R(c_j)=iNtheta_j/(2pi). (17) The second identity follows using q^(2j+1)-q^(-2j-1)=-2i sin theta_j and dc/dtheta=2sin theta. At the odd simple node only its value is prescribed, as required. Thus (16) is not an arbitrary spectral extension of the physical crossing; it matches exactly the jets used in the original closure. Equations (12a),(13) and submultiplicativity now give, after a fixed shrink of the inner corridor, a gamma>0 with the following actual source estimates, uniformly on its physical grid: * On the central nodes, F_phys-F_win and their first theta derivatives are bounded by poly(N)exp[N(nj_0-gamma)]. * Outside any fixed smaller central theta window, F_phys and its first theta derivative obey the same exponential-gap bound. For the second assertion use the uniform angular gap of the finite packet on the compact r-window, the H-residual(13), and the fact that the original R^m has unit nodal values and at most a polynomial first-normal cost. Derivatives of the fixed n-factor product cost only another polynomial. Thus the original physical spectral complement, not just the interpolant, is estimated. On smaller fixed complex theta/color disks, the exact function (16) has a nonzero analytic asymptotic with phase n j_0 -[n-im]theta^2/(4pi) +sum_i[-1+i sigma_i]chi_i^2/(2pi)+O_4, sigma_i=+1 for z, -1 for z^sharp. (18) The unit kappa and complete source phases remain in its specified external factor. In particular, for theta=s+it and chi=x+iy, |F_win(s+it,x+iy)| <=poly(N)exp N[nj_0-a(s^2+||x||^2) +C(t^2+||y||^2)] (19) for some a,C>0 depending on n,m. The real quadratic coefficients at t=y=0 are n/(4pi) and1/(2pi); imaginary cross terms are absorbed by completing squares. Shrinking the fixed disks absorbs the quartic remainder. All fixed derivatives have polynomial additional cost on still smaller disks. These give the exact local holomorphic input, original-grid residual and spectral complement required BEFORE the outer-color Fourier-Hermite transform; no contour endpoint or alias is set to zero here. Audit: [actual mixed-circle operators, canonical complex quarter source and original crossing normals](../experiments/audit_actual_belt_stack_auxiliary_color_inner_packet.py). the finite checks cover seven full physical mixed-circle finite-field families and seven entire low-color alias families; two canonical complex-Fhat source families across the quarter point; nine high-precision literal crossing/first-normal families; and six all-parity selected complex-source calibrations at N=32,33,64,65,128,129. The last checks compare the ACTUAL terminating finite U sum with its endpoint-normalized C exp(NS), not just a formal root. These finite calibrations supplement the analytic proof of its uniform domains, exponential interpolation residuals and source gaps. The physical outer-color transform and geometric holonomy remain separate from the inner packet theorem.

title: A regular actual mixed-circle port chart at the belt boundary
text: # A regular actual mixed-circle port chart at the belt boundary 29 October 2026. The old diagonal pair chart for the actual mixed circle is singular at w=-1, precisely where the new belt packet is concentrated. This note resolves that local chart with bounded meridian matrices and preserves the FULL threaded-circle equations. It does not select a bare-crossing state/observable convention, nor identify the complete global stack representation from vertex flags. The later [typed global composition](actual_belt_stack_typed_character_composition.md) now completes the outer closed-leg/peripheral checks kept separate in this local note, and the [full filling assembly](actual_long_filled_octahedral_belt_stack_volume.md) records the resulting any-subset volume equality. The local calculations below remain the independent input to that global proof. The local all-port convention is the one in [the original literal port lift](actual_pretzel_port_lift_and_geometric_anchor.md): incoming rotated pair (g(z),h(z)), outgoing (g(Uz),h(Uz)), with h(z)g(z)=diag(w,w^(-1)), U=(wY-1)/(w-Y). (1) Here Y is the SOURCE-selected inner critical parameter. In the new [physical-color packet](actual_belt_stack_auxiliary_color_inner_packet.md) it is holomorphic near w=-1,Y=i,H=1. It is not the physical meridian. ## 1. A bounded irreducible pair Put c=w+w^(-1) and use a=-[[1,1],[0,1]], b=-[[1,0],[c-2,1]], A=ba=[[1,1],[c-2,c-1]]. (2) Both main meridians have trace -2 and determinant one. Their product has trace c. At c=-2 it is a NONCENTRAL trace-minus-two parabolic. The fixed flags of a,b are infinity and zero, so the pair stays irreducible for c near -2. This avoids diagonalizing the parabolic product and then calling a diverging diagonal frame bounded. For w!=+1,-1 this pair is simultaneously conjugate to the original g,h pair: their product eigenvalues and the two parabolic traces agree, and their distinct flags determine the conjugacy on the irreducible chart. The following formulas also give an explicit regular continuation of its rotated action. Choose sqrt(U) through 1 near w=-1,Y=i, and set beta=w(Y-1)/[(w-1)(w-Y)sqrt(U)], alpha=[sqrt(U)+1/sqrt(U)-beta*c]/2, K=alpha I+beta A. (3) All displayed denominators are nonzero in a fixed neighborhood. For w!=+1,-1 this equals beta=[sqrt(U)-1/sqrt(U)]/[w-w^(-1)]. (4) Indeed U-1=(w+1)(Y-1)/(w-Y). Thus K has determinant one and eigenvalues sqrt(U),1/sqrt(U) on the A-eigenflags w,w^(-1). It is exactly the conjugate of diag(sqrt(U),1/sqrt(U)), which sends g(z) to g(Uz) in the old chart. Consequently the ACTUAL rotated mixed-circle map is (a,b) -> (K a K^(-1), K b K^(-1)). (5) This is a local all-port statement, not an inference solely from a trace identity. Under w->w^(-1) one has U->U^(-1), and (4) and alpha are unchanged. The regular K therefore descends holomorphically to c near -2 when the selected Y is even in eta for w=-exp(eta). This is exactly the evenness supplied by the physical-color packet. ## 2. Original unrotated ports and the auxiliary meridian The literal bends, including their inverses, give the unrotated ports (a_orig,b_orig)=(K b K^(-1), b^(-1)), (r_orig,s_orig)=(K a^(-1)K^(-1), a). (6) Their common disk product is P=b_orig a_orig =b^(-1)K b K^(-1) =a K a^(-1)K^(-1). (7) The last equality uses [K,A]=0, with A=ba. Direct multiplication gives the REGULAR trace formula D=Tr P =2+(w-1)^2(Y-1)^2/[(w-Y)(wY-1)]. (8) For w!=-1 this is exactly the old formula ((w-1)/(w+1))^2(U+U^(-1))+8w/(w+1)^2; its apparent pole is removable on the SOURCE relation(1). Put Delta=1-YD+Y^2, choose sqrt(Delta) through 1+i, and define J=(I-YP)/sqrt(Delta), C=(YI-P)/sqrt(Delta). (9) They commute with P, have determinant one, and JC=-P. The original threaded half-twist equations remain EXACTLY r_orig=C^(-1)b_orig C, s_orig=C^(-1)b_orig a_orig b_orig^(-1) C. (10) One can verify them without roots by using I-YP and YI-P; their common scalar cancels from conjugation. Equivalently Ja_orig=aJ, together with(7) and JC=-P, proves(10). They are rational identities on the old nonsingular chart and both sides are regular here, so their continuation includes w=-1. No group relation is replaced by only its trace. On the full stationary mixed source, the previously proved identities give D=-(L+L^(-1)), L=(H-X)/(1-HX), and the marked auxiliary meridian C has eigenvalue H^(-1/2) on the P-eigenflag with eigenvalue -L^(-1). This is the same ACTUAL circle and preferred disk-word marking as [the typed longitude theorem](actual_mixed_crossing_circle_preferred_longitude.md). The eigenflag may move through the parabolic limit; the matrices in (2)--(10) remain bounded. Nothing here asserts a moving-q continuation. ## 3. Exact complete matrices and the six octahedral flags At w=-1,Y=i,H=1, A=[[1,1],[-4,-3]], K=I-(i/2)(A+I), P=[[-1+2i,-1],[-4,-1-2i]], C=I-(P+I)/(1+i). (11) The outer flag of A is -1/2; the inner flag of P and C is -i/2. The four actual rotated port flags are a:infinity, b:0, KaK^(-1):-(1+i)/2, KbK^(-1):-(1+i)/4. The HOLomorphic Möbius map M(zeta)=(zeta+1/2)/(zeta+i/2) (12) sends, in that order, the outer/inner flags to 0/infinity and the four port flags to 1,-i,i,-1. These are the six ideal vertices of a regular octahedron. In this exact frame one obtains M A M^(-1)=[[-1,0],[2-2i,-1]], M P M^(-1)=[[-1,-2+2i],[0,-1]], M C M^(-1)=[[1,-2i],[0,1]], M J M^(-1)=[[1,2],[0,1]]. (13) In particular the actual inner meridian translates by -2i, while the preferred disk product translates by 2-2i (its central sign has no projective effect). Their ratio is 1+i. This is a literal matrix/peripheral calculation, not a ratio guessed from a Hessian. The source prediction agrees: at eta=chi=0 its physical color action has j_chi_chi=(-1+i)/pi; with U_geom=-2i chi and the marked longitude log V_geom=-2 partial_(Log H)(2pi i j), the same ratio is 1+i. ## 4. The separate global geometric lift The old local source-to-character construction now extends regularly through the ACTUAL belt saddle and retains every port and auxiliary meridian. Its six complete ideal flags and the inner peripheral word are also explicit. These remove a genuine singular-chart problem. They do NOT alone identify the full global stack holonomy with its two-octahedron face quotient. The global argument additionally transports the actual bare R interfaces and bends in their literal orientation, composes the typed maps, imposes the outer auxiliary closure, and matches its primitive meridian/longitude. A bare R eigenphase can give the inverse of a state-versus-observable Hurwitz graph; it cannot select that convention by analogy. Matching six ideal flags is also weaker than checking all the face maps. The [separate typed composition proof](actual_belt_stack_typed_character_composition.md) now supplies that finite marked map, including the original nested head snakes, incident mixed coupons and untouched auxiliary pivot. That proof, the [uniform filling-existence theorem](finite_geometric_certificate_uniform_filling_existence.md) and general completion/calibration theorem identify the selected long-filling action with the actual filled hyperbolic volume. Neither the local regularization nor the quantum color packet substitutes for that independent marked-map proof. Section6 below checks the complete CUT-PIECE face anchor as well. The global outer collar and closed-leg peripheral dictionary are proved in the linked typed-composition note. ## 5. The opposite retained half twist, with its actual circle meridian There is an additional exact all-port statement using the SAME K and P. The positive unrotated half-Hurwitz rule with an auxiliary centralizer Q is r_orig=Q^(-1) a_orig^(-1)b_orig a_orig Q, s_orig=Q^(-1) a_orig Q. It is solved by Q=J^(-1). Indeed Ja_orig=aJ gives the second equation; the first then reduces to a^(-1)P=K a^(-1)K^(-1), which follows from(7). Thus the opposite retained half twist has circle meridian J^(-1), rather than silently using C unchanged. At completeness this meridian translates by -2 in the frame(12), whereas C translates by -2i. The SAME preferred disk product P translates by 2-2i. Its two primitive cusp ratios are consequently (2-2i)/(-2i)=1+i, (2-2i)/(-2)=-1+i. (14) These are the actual two half-twist meridians. On the full mixed branch the positive-circle color condition is imposed on J^(-1), not on C. Matching that flag condition to the typed reflected source is still required; one must not reuse the negative-half mixed parameter H without this check. This addition proves both complete typed matrices, not an unproved global sharp/reflection adapter. ## 6. Every complete white and inner shaded face map Use the normalized frame(12), now with the PRECISE labels X0=0, X1=infinity, Y+=1, Y-=-1, Z+=-i, Z-=i. The white faces of the existing literal two-octahedron cut table are W0=(0,1,i), W1=(0,-1,-i), W2=(infinity,1,-i), W3=(infinity,-1,i). Their reflections are the following antiholomorphic maps, with c0=(1+i)/2: r0(z)=c0+(1/2)/(conjugate(z)-conjugate(c0)), r1(z)=-c0+(1/2)/(conjugate(z)+conjugate(c0)), r2(z)=i conjugate(z)+1-i, r3(z)=i conjugate(z)-1+i. (15) Direct Gaussian-rational matrix multiplication gives the FULL PSL isometries (hats denote conjugation by M): a_hat=r2 r0, b_hat=r1 r2, a'_hat=r3 r0, b'_hat=r1 r3, A_hat=r1 r0. (16) Thus all white-face holonomies are matched, not only the fixed flags of the meridians. Develop the second octahedron as r0(P_+), using W0 as the face-tree pairing. The inner shaded faces are C_face=(infinity,1,i), D_face=(infinity,-1,-i). The literal threaded-port equations give the two shaded pairing maps gamma_+=J a', gamma_-=b'J^(-1)=J^(-1)a. In the M frame they are EXACTLY gamma_+=[[3i,1-i],[1+i,-i]], gamma_-=[[i,1-i],[-1-i,i]]. (17) They have the following complete three-vertex actions: gamma_+ r0(infinity,-1,-i)=(infinity,1,i), gamma_- r0(infinity,1,i)=(infinity,-1,-i). (18) These are r0(D_face)->C_face and r0(C_face)->D_face, precisely the TWO cross-copy shaded gluings of the actual retained half twist. They check the third vertex as well as the circle flag and one port. A holomorphic Mobius map is uniquely determined by three distinct ideal points; therefore these are the entire face isometries in the existing positive regular-octahedron certificate. Its matched canonical horospheres and edge/cusp completion are consequently the same ones. Equations(16)--(18), together with the reversible original disk cut, identify the COMPLETE local source representation with the actual geometric cut-piece holonomy. The reflected half twist uses the same unmarked cut quotient with its actual changed inner meridian J^(-1)=-C P^(-1); the preferred disk word P is retained. Bare outer R collars must still be read with their literal bends and primitive peripheral words. No global deformed-stack claim is deduced solely from this complete-point calculation. The [focused symbolic audit](../experiments/audit_actual_belt_stack_regular_parabolic_port_chart.py) checks EXACT rational-function/Gaussian-rational identities: the regular centralizer and reciprocal descent, both signed threaded port equations, complete matrices and flags, all five white identities, and BOTH three-vertex shaded maps. It does not replace the separate global outer collar/peripheral proof. ## 7. The oriented outer-pants boundary word There is a concrete boundary-path check that is useful for that last peripheral proof. The incoming pants has shaded triangle (X0,Y+,Z+)=(0,1,-i). The holomorphic map T(zeta)=((1+i)/2)(zeta-1)/zeta sends its three punctures to infinity, zero, one. Conjugating the EXACT white-face meridians in(16) gives a_T=[[-1,0],[-2,-1]], b_T=[[-3,2],[-2,1]], A_T=[[-1,-2],[0,-1]]. (19) Use the upper-half-plane orientation for its doubled ideal triangle. At punctures zero and one, the upper-half-plane cusp coordinates -1/zeta and -1/(zeta-1) make a_T and b_T each translation by -2. At infinity, A_T^(-1) is translation by -2 as well. They are therefore the consistently oriented boundary loops of a compact truncation of the pants: its oriented top horocycle goes to the left. Their based boundary relation is EXACTLY (A^(-1)) b a=I. (20) Thus the oriented OUTER boundary word of these actual puncture paths is A^(-1), not A. Reversing the pants orientation reverses all three paths together. This is an oriented face/path certificate, independent of any computed source Hessian. To call(20) the preferred POSITIVE auxiliary longitude, the actual closed auxiliary orientation and its original ordinary cup/pivot are transported to this pants boundary in the linked typed-composition proof. That operation also determines which A-eigenflag has the positive auxiliary meridian eigenvalue. Neither choice is inferred just from(19). The geometric boundary calculation supplies its explicit path, while preserving that distinction. The local signed boundary charts and oriented pants word are inputs to the separate global filled-volume assembly, not a replacement for it.

title: Typed belt-stack character composition and marked peripherals
text: # Typed belt-stack character composition and marked peripherals 29 October 2026. The actual mixed inner packet has a regular character lift through the complete pair-Casimir value -2. This note proves the signed crossing/box composition, including the sharp box's meridian flag, and the exact ordinary-cup outer dictionary. It constructs the marked deformed representation of the actual signed belt stack. Every incident mixed crossing is transported through the SAME original Hopf-duality adapters. The outer dictionary is NOT inferred from a Hessian or from relabeling indices while leaving coupons fixed. ## 1. Regular pair frame at the actual complete source Use the [regular local port chart](actual_belt_stack_regular_parabolic_port_chart.md). Set c=w+w^(-1), w=-exp eta, and a=-[[1,1],[0,1]], b=-[[1,0],[c-2,1]], A=ba=[[1,1],[c-2,c-1]]. (1) These main meridians have trace -2. The central signs do not affect their PSL classes; both signs in their product cancel. They form an irreducible pair near c=-2, including that point. For the source-selected local z=mathscrR(R^(-1)L_(N-h)) branch, let X,Y,H,L,U be the literal stationary functions of [the mixed local source lift](actual_pretzel_mixed_regular_character_lift.md), continued through the quarter point using the newly proved actual auxiliary-color packet. They satisfy U=(wY-1)/(w-Y), L=(H-X)/(1-HX), (1+YL)/(1+Y/L)=L^2/H. (2) The regular centralizer K_z of A constructed in the linked chart has determinant1, eigenratio U on the ordered A-eigenvalues (w,w^(-1)), and gives the rotated map (a,b) -> (K_z a K_z^(-1),K_z b K_z^(-1)). (3) Put P=aK_z a^(-1)K_z^(-1)=b^(-1)K_z bK_z^(-1). Then Tr P=-L-L^(-1). With Delta=(1+YL)(1+Y/L), J=(I-YP)/sqrt(Delta), C=(YI-P)/sqrt(Delta), JC=-P. (4) The branch of sqrt is its regular complete branch. The ACTUAL unrotated ports are incoming (K_z bK_z^(-1),b^(-1)) and outgoing (K_z a^(-1)K_z^(-1),a). Formula(4) gives exactly the threaded negative half-twist group relations. On the P-eigenflag with eigenvalue lambda=-L^(-1), C has the source-prescribed positive auxiliary meridian eigenvalue M=H^(-1/2). This is the local literal port/flag theorem, not a trace-only assertion. ## 2. The bare crossing in THIS bent frame It is essential not to apply the ordinary downward positive-Hurwitz rule to the bent (a,b) coordinates without transporting the ports. The FULL physical turn identity is mathscrR(R^(-1))=R, including kappa and every Casimir normal, by [the exact four-port turn calculation](actual_pair_casimir_commutant_and_rotated_trace.md#3-literal-turn-rotation-agrees-with-the-charge-block-formula). Here is its group-side port calculation. For a general turned box with input(a,b), output(a',b'), unrotation gives incoming (b',b^(-1)) and outgoing((a')^(-1),a). The unrotated bare R^(-1) uses the negative Hurwitz rule (u,v)->(v,vuv^(-1)). It follows immediately that a'=b, b'=bab^(-1). (5) Thus the actual source R in the bent frame is negative Hurwitz. No branch is selected by an eigenphase comparison. Define J_R=[A-(c-1)I]/sqrt(2-c), K_R=J_R^(-1). (6) Direct multiplication gives det J_R=1, J_R b=a J_R and J_R^2=-A^(-1). Consequently (5) is simultaneous conjugation by K_R. Its eigenratio on the ordered A-eigenvalues is -w; that of R^(-1) is -w^(-1). Both matrices are regular at c=-2. This agrees with the source's actual nodal Gaussian, but the group rule was proved FIRST from the literal turn. ## 3. The sharp box has its own actual positive-half meridian Write f^#(eta,chi)=conjugate(f(conjugate(eta),conjugate(chi))) for holomorphic Schwarz reflection. The source action of the literal sharp box obeys G_+=-G_-^#. Since the color logarithm z=Log H=2i chi has z^#=-z, while eta^#=eta, the chain rule gives partial_eta G_+=-(partial_eta G_-)^#, partial_z G_+=(partial_z G_-)^#. The effective stationary variables are therefore U_+=1/U_-^#, Y_+=1/Y_-^#, L_+=L_-^#, K_+=(K_z^#)^(-1). (7) The reciprocal of Y is essential: its stationary index is the Schwarz-reflected u, and Y=exp(2iu). At completeness both effective Y values are i. Merely conjugating K or declaring a different peripheral color would give the wrong source action. Form P_+=aK_+a^(-1)K_+^(-1), Delta_+ and J_+=(I-Y_+P_+)/sqrt(Delta_+) exactly as above. Trace invariance under K inversion, together with the old trace relation, gives Tr P_+=-L_+-L_+^(-1). For the literal POSITIVE unrotated half twist the actual meridian is C_+=J_+^(-1). (8) Indeed J_+ a_orig=a J_+ gives C_+^(-1)a_orig C_+=a, which is the second output of the positive-Hurwitz threaded box; the common product relation gives its first output. This checks the full port equations, not only their traces. On the P_+-eigenflag lambda_+=-L_+^(-1), eigen(C_+)^2=(1+Y_+L_+)/(1+Y_+/L_+)=H^(-1). (9) To verify the last equality, Schwarz-reflect(2): (1+Y_-^#L_+)/(1+Y_-^#/L_+)=L_+^2 H, then substitute Y_+=1/Y_-^#. Its regular square-root branch is precisely H^(-1/2). Thus the sharp box retains the SAME physical meridian color and has preferred lambda_+=-L_+^(-1), with all original ordinary-pivot spin signs. At completeness C_+ is J^(-1), while C_- is C; they are not assumed to be plain conjugate matrices. ## 4. Composition of every signed source piece The original stack pieces have full sources f_-=Rz and f_+=z^sharp R^(-1). Their literal mirror/reversed identification was proved in the stack cut certificate. The port maps above give simultaneous conjugation by K_(piece,-)=K_R K_z, K_(piece,+)=K_(box,+) K_R^(-1), (10) where K_(box,+) is the sharp BOX centralizer K_+ in(7). All matrices are specified functions of the SAME A, so they commute as actual centralizers; no arbitrary strand gauge is inserted between pieces. Their source-selected gains are gain(f_-)=(-w)U_-, gain(f_+)=U_+(-w)^(-1). After p plus,q minus pieces and an actual outer R^a, put n=p+q,m=q-p+a. The complete port map is conjugation by K_tot=K_R^m product_(plus)K_+ product_(minus)K_z, gain(K_tot)=(-w)^m product_i U_i. (11) These are full regular matrix identities through w=-1. To see their noncentral complete limit, let N_0=A+I, N_0^2=0. The actual selected local values are K_z=K_+=I-iN_0/2, K_R=I-N_0/2. Hence K_tot=I-(m+in)N_0/2. (12) In particular this complete outer meridian candidate never collapses to I when n>0. The matrix data retain the local regular octahedron flags, not only a cusp Hessian. ## 5. The literal outer-cut dictionary, with all coupons transported The actual outer dictionary is (a,b)=(beta_phys^(-1),alpha_phys^(-1)), C_0=K_tot, preferred P_0=beta_phys alpha_phys=A^(-1). (13) Here is its source/collar check. Keep the unrestricted original marked closure, pivot and single1/N on their original side. The physical cup and ordinary cap matrices are p_(a,b)=N x^(-b) delta_(a+b,d), ell_(a,b)=x^a/N delta_(a+b,d). Their literal snakes satisfy sum_b p_(a,b)ell_(b,c)=delta_(a,c), sum_b ell_(a,b)p_(b,c)=delta_(a,c). (13a) The one nonzero term has matching complement indices and all N/x factors cancel EXACTLY. Insert TWO noncrossing nested head snakes in the thin main-wire collar between the stack and outer loop; their arcs are disjoint from the auxiliary cut and closing pivot. For W=V tensor V the contravariant dual is ordered (second*,first*): the nested evaluation pairs first with fourth and second with third. Each actual cup takes its meridian path to the inverse. The explicit table on the outer side is therefore standard main port1 alpha_phys <-> bent port2 b^(-1), standard main port2 beta_phys <-> bent port1 a^(-1), auxiliary C_0 and its original closing pivot stay UNCHANGED. Every mixed crossing incident to these ports is transported through the SAME snakes by original Hopf duality. Equivalently (S tensor id)(R_universal)=R_universal^(-1) and (id tensor S^(-1))(R_universal)=R_universal^(-1) move that strand through its evaluation. This includes the full q^(H tensor H/2), with S(H)=-H, and both finite nilpotent factors. Their literal endpoint zeros give no cyclic wrap term. The ordinary auxiliary object is not dualized or cut again. This is an all-port identity for an arbitrary exterior; the original co-source remains outside the move. For clarity, let U be the FULL unflipped universal-R matrix between the complete physical head and any ordinary color j. If the N-head is FIRST, the actual left/right bend identities are U=(p^T tensor I)(U^(-1))^(t_1)(ell^T tensor I), U^(-1)=(p tensor I)U^(t_1)(ell tensor I). If it is SECOND they are U=(I tensor p)(U^(-1))^(t_2)(I tensor ell), U^(-1)=(I tensor p^T)U^(t_2)(I tensor ell^T). The superscript t_i means the partial transpose on that physical head. Both original half-Cartan factors and finite nilpotent factors are in U. The indicated transpose of p is fixed by which actual side of the cup is bent; exchanging p with p^T arbitrarily is false. Then J_W=(p tensor p)P_ord, E_W=P_ord(ell tensor ell), J_W E_W=E_W J_W=I_(V tensor V). (13b) Indeed its full index sum is sum_(s,t)p_(a,t)p_(b,s)ell_(t,c)ell_(s,d)=delta_(a,c)delta_(b,d). No R, curl or framing shear implements P_ord. Transporting the coupons through these literal nested adapters is precisely the bent port convention used in sections1--3, including(5). The consequence is elementary and exact: conjugating the standard [2,1,1,2] loop map by this dictionary gives main map Ad(C_0^(-1)) and closing relation [C_0,A]=1. Its preferred disk word is A^(-1), with no additional C_0 power: substitute A_orig=b^(-1), B_orig=a^(-1) in the original disk word B_orig A_orig. Main inversion/reversal commutes with common conjugation, so the same Ad(C_0^(-1)) is obtained when returning to (a,b). No argument from equality of L_j polynomials is used to choose this orientation. Outer closure gives Ad(C_0^(-1)K_tot)(a,b)=(a,b). Since a,b remain irreducible, their common centralizer is scalar in SL and trivial in PSL. Hence C_0=K_tot in PSL, with its SL sign fixed by the trace+2 complete branch. Reversing BOTH peripheral generators and swapping their common eigenflag is a harmless alternative with the same positive (M,lambda) data; inverting only one is not. ## 6. Actual global peripheral and source differential Let z_i=Log H_i, eta=Log(-w), and let G_i be the source-normalized typed local actions. The actual outer Fourier phase has G_total(eta,z)=sum_i G_i(eta,z_i)+m eta^2/2+z_0 eta +known real constants. (14) The real constants retain the kappa/source-spin line and do not change the marked volume. Its eta stationarity is gain(K_tot)=exp(-z_0)=H_0^(-1). By(13), C_0=K_tot has the positive M_0=H_0^(-1/2) flag on the A-eigenvalue w branch; preferred P_0=A^(-1) has eigenvalue w^(-1)=-exp(-eta). Therefore ALL actual cusp coordinates satisfy u_i=-z_i/2, lambda_i=-exp(-partial_(z_i)G), v_i=pi i-partial_(z_i)G, d[G-pi i sum_i z_i]=2 sum_i v_i du_i. (15) For inner cusps this was proved locally above; for the outer cusp it uses the actual preferred word in(13). Hence the source action has the marked boundary differential, including the spin term. Its complete imaginary anchor is2n v8. The next section verifies the complete actual geometric anchor needed to calibrate its absolute regulator. As a consistency check, (12),(13) give the actual outer cusp ratio 2i/[n-im] and the two inner ratios sigma+i. These are TWICE the analytic curvature parameter phi''/(2pi i) when x=h/N; the geometric logs are u=-pi i x and v=-phi_x. The factor is fixed by(15), not by relabeling a source Hessian as a cusp modulus. ## 7. The full complete geometric anchor and every surviving main cusp The [regular cut-piece certificate](actual_belt_stack_regular_parabolic_port_chart.md#6-every-complete-white-and-inner-shaded-face-map) verifies EVERY white and both inner shaded face maps, not just six vertex flags. In its bounded frame the vertices are (0,infinity,1,-1,-i,i). Exact white reflection products give a,b,a',b',A, and the actual two J a',b'J^(-1) shaded maps send ALL three vertices of each original inner face correctly. They are therefore the complete face isometries of the actual cut two-octahedron quotient. The opposite half uses the same unmarked cut geometry with its actual meridian J^(-1), not a silent circle framing change. The [literal stack collar certificate](actual_balanced_octahedral_belt_stack_volume.md#3a-any-fixed-integer-outer-crossing-power) glues those pieces with their actual signs and the actual outer R^a. Section2 has calibrated that crossing in precisely the same transported bent frame. The local main-port matrices thus agree across every seam with the regular-cell developing holonomy. At the final outer loop, the original relation in section5 uniquely forces its meridian to be K_tot in PSL for BOTH the source lift and geometric developing map. Its trace+2 branch fixes the SL choice. Thus this last generator is matched too, not merely its trace or cusp derivative. The independent oriented pants-path calculation in the local note section7 gives(A^(-1))ba=I and checks the preferred outer boundary orientation directly. The ENTIRE complete representation is consequently the positively oriented geometric holonomy of the ACTUAL stack exterior, of volume 2n v8. This holds for every fixed sign word and integer a. The possible simultaneous reversal of a peripheral pair changes neither the primitive slope nor its selected eigenvalues. All generator matrices and selected flags vary continuously in bounded charts for the small complex source colors. The apparent w=-1 diagonal- frame singularity is absent in the regular matrices(1)--(4). Every surviving MAIN component has a noncentral parabolic meridian, being a conjugate of a or b. A peripheral longitude commuting with that meridian has squared multiplier1, so its small geometric similarity log is ZERO near the complete point. Hence BOTH logs at every UNFILLED main cusp stay zero. This includes odd a, where the two main components merge. No additional main cusp Hessian or independently imposed main longitude is needed for completion or for the regulator boundary term. ## 8. Absolute regulator and every independently long integral filling After eliminating eta by its actual source stationarity, write G_(z_i)=ell_i for ALL n+1 auxiliary cusps, including ell_0=eta. The marked norm from(15) is D_src=Im G-sum_i Re z_i Im ell_i. (16) Indeed retain Gbar=G-pi i sum_i z_i BEFORE forming the boundary norm: D_src=Im Gbar-2 sum_i Re u_i Im v_i. The central terms cancel only in this paired expression. They are not discarded from the action or physical ordinary-circle character. For the actual developed fundamental chain of this SAME marked exterior, the Bloch boundary is delta beta=-2 sum_i M_i wedge lambda_i. Its Bloch--Wigner differential is therefore dD(beta)=2 sum_i[Re v_i dIm u_i-Re u_i dIm v_i] =dD_src. The main cusp terms vanish by section7. Both functions have the same absolute complete anchor2n v8, so they agree on this connected source germ. This is the established [marked fundamental-chain comparison](actual_pretzel_marked_regulator_and_filling_action.md#3-the-geometric-regulator-has-the-same-derivative-and-absolute-anchor) applied to the explicit global lift. Neither a cusp-Hessian match nor an unproved equality of dilogarithm lists replaces it. The [actual outer squared-kernel theorem](actual_outer_color_squared_kernel.md) and the inner packet/gap theorem supply the WHOLE original mixed-color packet and its ENTIRE complementary physical-color cube estimate for these stacks. The [general original-source filling transfer](general_original_source_long_filling_transfer.md) then gives a NONZERO full asymptotic for independently sufficiently long FIXED signed integral fillings at ANY chosen subset I of the n+1 auxiliary circles. Keep every other auxiliary color literally h_j=0, hence its original L_N component; do NOT set p_j=0, which would meridionally fill and remove that circle. The exact packet, nonzero amplitude, negative real Hessian and entire physical-color complement gap restrict to the I coordinates. Apply only the original color-filling functionals indexed by I. The equations are z_i+2p_i ell_i=2pi i m_i, m_i=+1 or -1, i in I, z_j=0, j not in I. (17) Separate exact source evenness gives ell_j=0 at every unfilled auxiliary coordinate, even while filled coordinates vary. Its peripheral group remains noncentral parabolic near the complete point, with BOTH small logs zero. These unfilled auxiliary cusps join the main cusps in section7. No new estimate or geometric existence premise is required. The ACTUAL small geometric similarity logs are U_i=-z_i,V_i=-2ell_i. Thus (17) is precisely U_i+p_i V_i=-2pi i m_i. It is the primitive2pi branch, not merely an exponentiated PSL relation. The preferred SL longitude minus sign has already been retained in(15)--(16). These equations kill the literal disk slopes mu_i+p_i lambda_i. The original complete-color twist expansion inserts R^(-2p_i), including every confluent normal and dimension endpoint; hence the slope sign is the original disk sign. At the OUTER circle it can also be checked directly: K_R^2=-A, so R^(-2p) gives Ad(A^(-p)), exactly the loop action Ad(C_0^(-1)) when C_0 P_0^p=1 and P_0=A^(-1). For each inner circle the same sign was proved in the literal mixed-circle longitude certificate, and the actual quarter-turn transports its disk with the tangle. Every selected filled coordinate is nonzero. Separate source evenness makes ell_i divisible by z_i, even when all other colors vary, so z_i=0 would contradict(17). The small logs exclude an extra period. The matrices share their selected flags; their filling products are scalar in SL and identity in PSL. The [general marked completion theorem](general_source_regulator_hyperbolic_equality.md) therefore extends this nearby ACTUAL representation to a positive smooth complete hyperbolic metric on the indicated filled topology. It is the filled geometric holonomy. The two directions of the fundamental-class/Gromov-volume comparison identify the regulator with the actual filled hyperbolic volume, rather than only bounding it above. The source filling phase keeps the literal quadratic chirps on I. In the present eigenlog variables it is, up to the recorded real constants, G_fill=G+sum_(i in I) (z_i-2pi i m_i)^2/(4p_i). On(17) its added imaginary part is sum_i 2p_i Re ell_i Im ell_i=-sum_i Re z_i Im ell_i. Hence Im G_fill=D_src EXACTLY. This verifies the source-to-volume comparison after filling while retaining all spin and charge data. We obtain: for every fixed n>=1, every sign word of length n, every fixed integer outer crossing power a, and ANY subset I of its n+1 auxiliary circles, independently sufficiently long fixed signed integral fillings on I obey lim_N (2pi/N)log|K_N(filled stack)| =Vol(S^3 minus resulting partially filled link). (18) The empty subset is the already proved COMPLETE stack theorem, with no slope threshold or filling functional. For a nonempty subset its threshold may depend on I; for a fixed stack take the maximum over its finitely many subsets if desired. All N parities and composite levels are included. The original single-cut normalization is retained, with no separately modified dimension at every component. Full twists preserve the main permutation: when ALL auxiliary circles are filled, the result is a KNOT for odd a and has TWO components for even a. For a proper subset the unfilled auxiliary circles remain components: the total is n+2-|I| for odd a and n+3-|I| for even a. The threshold depends on this fixed marked source and its fixed analytic neighborhoods; no numerical threshold or slope comparability condition is asserted. This is a cyclic-belt family, not an arbitrary branched-source or arbitrary fixed-bridge volume theorem. title: The complete beta source has an exponentially large first normal jet
text: # The complete beta source has an exponentially large first normal jet 28 October 2026. This is an obstruction to a uniform normal-neighborhood estimate AFTER integrating the original beta fiber. It is not an excess-volume contribution to a knot period, and it does not contradict a local exp(o(N)) bound in a shrinking collar where all the unintegrated full-Psi arguments approach one. ## 1. Exact source and exact first derivative Use precisely the original finite source in [the trivalent source theorem](actual_trivalent_quantum_beta_source.md#1-the-source-and-its-exact-finite-polynomial): Q=exp(2*pi*i/N), d=N-1, F_k=product_(j=1)^k(1-Q^j), B_N(u,v)=sum_(a=0)^d product_(j=0)^(a-1)(u-Q^j v). In the actual full-Psi fiber the arguments are u=Q^2 U, v=Q V, and its source normalization is Q^(-d)/N. These exact tags and that normalization are unchanged here. No residue-only beta replacement is made. Every nonempty Newton product contains u-v, so, identically in v, B_N(v,v)=1, partial_u B_N(v,v)=J_N(v):=sum_(k=0)^(N-2) F_k v^k, partial_v B_N(v,v)=-J_N(v). (1) The second equality follows by differentiating the first factor of each nonempty product; differentiating any other factor leaves u-v=0. Consequently this is a derivative of the COMPLETE original source, including the current responsible for B_N(v,v)=1. This is not the derivative of its homogeneous balanced-residue term alone. ## 2. A fixed regular point with an exponential derivative Set c_*=exp(-i*pi/3), I(s)=integral_0^s log(2 sin(pi*t)) dt, gamma=I(5/6)=-I(1/6)=v_3/(2*pi)>0. Here v_3 is the volume of the regular ideal tetrahedron; equivalently gamma=Im Li_2(exp(i*pi/3))/(2*pi)=0.161532973609725257.... For EVERY sequence of integer levels N tending to infinity, including both parities and every residue class modulo six, J_N(c_*)=i N exp[N gamma-25*pi*i*N/72] (1+o(1)). (2) More generally, uniformly for theta in a fixed bounded real interval, J_N(c_* exp(i*theta/N))/J_N(c_*) =exp(5*i*theta/6)+o(1). (3) Here and below c_* is a value of the actual tagged beta argument v. If one instead parametrizes its untagged argument V, choose V=Q^(-1)c_*. An O(1/N) root tag changes the nonzero prefactor through (3), not gamma. If a particular full-Psi chart also excludes c^N=1, use instead c_N=c_* exp(i*theta_0/N), for example theta_0=pi/7. Its N-th powers range over a fixed finite set bounded away from one, and (3) gives the same exponent with nonzero prefactor exp(5*i*theta_0/6). Thus the obstruction is not an artifact of the levels for which c_*^N=1. ### Proof For 0<=k<N there is an exact, continuously accumulated factorial phase: F_k=|F_k| exp[i*pi*k(k+1)/(2N)-i*pi*k/2]. (4) On every compact subinterval of 0<s=k/N<1, Stirling and elementary Euler--Maclaurin give the uniform estimate |F_k|=sqrt(2 N sin(pi*s)) exp[N I(s)](1+O(1/N)). (5) For clarity, subtract log(2*pi*t) from log(2 sin(pi*t)); the difference is smooth through t=0. Stirling for k! and the endpoint half-sum for that difference give exactly the prefactor sqrt(2 N sin(pi*s)). A global, endpoint-uniform version sufficient for discarding tails is log |F_k|=N I(k/N)+O(log N), 0<=k<=N-1. (6) One direct proof of (6) subtracts log t+log(1-t). The remaining function is smooth on [0,1], while the two singular sums are exactly log(k!)+log((N-1)!/(N-1-k)!)-2k log N. Uniform Stirling bounds, also at k=0 and k=N-1, give the stated error. The function I has its unique absolute maximum on [0,1] at s_*=5/6. Indeed I'=log(2 sin(pi*s)), its only interior zeros are 1/6 and 5/6, and I(0)=I(1)=0<I(5/6). Combining (4)--(5) gives the summand F_k c_*^k = sqrt(2 N sin(pi*s)) exp[N psi(s)] exp(i*pi*s/2)(1+O(1/N)), psi(s)=I(s)+i*(pi*s^2/2-5*pi*s/6). At s_* we have psi'(s_*)=0, psi(s_*)=gamma-25*pi*i/72, psi''(s_*)=-pi*(sqrt(3)-i). Equation (6) makes the sum outside any fixed neighborhood of s_* exponentially smaller. Within that neighborhood, I(s)<=gamma-c(s-s_*)^2. Set xi=(k-Ns_*)/sqrt N and use (5). The shifted lattice Gaussian Riemann sums converge by this bound, with arbitrary fractional part of Ns_*. Its integral is sqrt(2*pi/(-psi''(s_*)))=exp(i*pi/12). The remaining amplitude is sqrt N exp(5*pi*i/12); the lattice density is sqrt N. Their product with the Gaussian integral is iN, proving (2). Inserting exp(i*theta*k/N) proves (3) by exactly the same dominated Gaussian argument, uniformly on compact theta intervals. No external quantum-dilogarithm asymptotics or knot invariant identification enters. ## 3. Consequences for normal neighborhoods Already the order-one normal jet at the fixed regular point c_* has exponential rate gamma. Thus a claim that EVERY order r=o(N) normal jet costs exp(o(N)) relative to B_N(c,c)=1 is false, even for r=1. In fact the sharp uniform first-jet exponent on the entire unit circle is lim_(N->infinity) (1/N) log sup_(|c|=1)|J_N(c)|=gamma. (7) The upper bound follows from (6) and the sum of |F_k|; (2) gives the matching lower bound. Also, for ANY positive radius rho_N with log rho_N=o(N), Cauchy's derivative estimate gives sup_(|delta|<=rho_N)|B_N(c_*+delta,c_*)| >=rho_N |J_N(c_*)| =exp[N gamma+o(N)]. (8) This concerns a complex normal disk. It does not claim the same growth on every specified real contour or at every point of that disk. ## 4. The actual three-star block cannot uniformly hide this slope The exact actual figure-eight block in [the six-circuit computation](actual_six_circuit_beta_collision.md) has, after an invertible monomial coordinate change, the form W_N(U,V;a,b,c)=B_N(U,a) B_N(V,b) B_N(c,c U V). (9) The collision is U=V=1; c remains an independent nonzero parameter. All the other original atoms, cap factors, and remaining integrations are retained outside (9). Choose a,b with P_N=B_N(1,a)B_N(1,b)!=0. This excludes only the explicit finite local zero sets, and does not divide by an unknown knot period. Then W_N(1,1)=P_N, (partial_U W_N/P_N)(1,1) =A_N-c J_N(c), A_N=partial_u B_N(1,a)/B_N(1,a). (10) In particular no estimate on A_N is required for a UNIFORM obstruction. Take c_+=c_* and c_-=c_* exp(6*pi*i/(5N)). By (3), c_- J_N(c_-)=-c_+ J_N(c_+)(1+o(1)). The triangle inequality therefore implies max_(c=c_+,c_-)|A_N-c J_N(c)| >=N exp(N gamma)(1+o(1)). (11) Both marks may be multiplied by exp(i*pi/(7N)) if c^N=1 is excluded by an auxiliary chart. Their two N-th-power sets then stay uniformly away from one, while their asymptotic slope ratio is still -1. Thus the complete three-star block has an exponentially large relative first normal slope somewhere within O(1/N) of the SAME fixed regular c_*, regardless of the first star's derivative. For reference, an exact alternative uniform statement follows by Fourier orthogonality: (1/(2*pi)) integral_0^(2*pi)|A_N-e^(it)J_N(e^(it))|^2 dt =|A_N|^2+sum_(k=0)^(N-2)|F_k|^2. (12) The same real Laplace argument applied to (5), now without any complex phase, gives the positive energy asymptotic sum_(k=0)^(N-2)|F_k|^2 =3^(-1/4) N^(3/2) exp(2 N gamma)(1+o(1)). (13) Indeed 2I''(5/6)=-2*pi*sqrt(3), and the squared prefactor at the maximum is N. This is an exact Plancherel obstruction to a uniform tame normal-jet assertion, in addition to the explicit phase-coherent point (2). These are statements about an actual integrated subnetwork. They do not assert its exterior original-source pairing is nonzero. ## 5. What this does and does not rule out The exact collision identity B_N(c,c)=1 cannot be thickened to a uniform exp(o(N)) estimate for the COMPLETE fiber-integrated beta source on polynomial normal neighborhoods. A proof that removes a collision by first integrating that whole fiber and then using tame normal jets would lose a real exponential saddle. Conversely, a normal disk centered at this diagonal point on which the complete source is bounded by exp(o(N)) must have radius at most exp(-N gamma+o(N)), by the same Cauchy estimate. This does NOT obstruct the unintegrated, fixed finite shape-one collar patch. The derivative saddle above has Newton order k/N=5/6, away from the local all-six-shapes collar; global fiber integration can reach it.
