Thus the conductance products from the two bounds (7) and the middle Green product telescope EXACTLY to product_(r=0)^(t-1) a_r=s_t^2, s_t=product_(r=1)^t 2sin(r theta). (12) The root matrix is symmetric, so the same estimate holds for u>v. Its exact characteristic polynomial has real roots below two: chi_t(z)=product_(r=0)^t[z-2cos((2r+1)theta)]. For Re z>=2, each factor has magnitude at least its value at two. The already proved exact product inequality is |chi_t(z)|>=chi_t(2)>=4s_t^2/N^2. (13) Equations (7),(8),(12),(13) therefore bound EVERY entry by (N^2/4) exp[2C N f(|z-lambda_0|)+2C(log N)^2]. (14) Empty prefixes have determinant one and cause no exception. For t=0 the scalar bound follows directly from 2-lambda_0>=4/N^2. Finally |z-lambda_0|<=r+delta with delta=2-lambda_0 comparable to N^-2. The elementary inequality f(a+b)<=f(a)+f(b) gives N f(r+delta)<=N f(r)+C log N. The function f is increasing: its derivative has the sign of log x-2+4/x for x=2+1/r>=2, whose minimum is log 4-1>0. Multiplying the entrywise bound by the dimension at most N proves (2). In particular the proof includes t=N-1 and long prefixes; no compact restriction on physical degree is needed. ### The angular slit-cone extension The same numerator estimate applies at any complex z. Only the full characteristic lower bound changes outside Re z>=2. Write x_h=2-2cos((2h+1)theta)>0, |chi_t(2+rho exp(i phi))/chi_t(2)| =product_(h=0)^t |1+rho exp(i phi)/x_h|. (14a) For |phi|<=pi-gamma_0 and every y>=0 one has |1+y exp(i phi)|>=sin(gamma_0). Split the factors in (14a) at x_h=2rho. To count them, put v_h=min(h+1/2,N-h-1/2). The complete list 0<=h<N satisfies 16 v_h^2/N^2<=x_h<=4pi^2 v_h^2/N^2. There are O(N sqrt(rho)+1) factors with x_h<=2rho, so their total logarithmic loss is at most C_(gamma_0)(N sqrt(rho)+1). For the other factors, y=rho/x_h<1/2 and log|1+y exp(i phi)|>=log(1-y)>=-2y. The two displayed comparisons, followed by the convergent tail sum of v_h^-2, give sum_(x_h>2rho) rho/x_h<=C(N sqrt(rho)+1). Bounding the entire list also bounds every degree sublist. Hence |chi_t(z)/chi_t(2)| >=exp[-C_(gamma_0)(N sqrt(rho)+1)] (14b) on (4a). The additional loss is absorbed in N f(r)+O(log N). This proves (2),(3),(4) on the full cone (4a). The cone has a useful literal overlap with the earlier strict-prefix action domains. For any fixed strict pair of prefix angles beta_1, beta_2<pi, choose gamma_0 smaller than both (pi-beta_i)/2. Points z=2-rho exp(+/-i gamma_0) then lie in BOTH selected-prefix halfplanes. Thus the estimate reaches potential joining points for those actual integrand charts. No contour deformation or saddle contribution follows from this overlap alone. ## 4. Actual generic normals remain controlled For each fixed j>=1 the displayed original generic matrix satisfies ||partial_h^j J_t(q exp(h)) evaluated_(h=0)||op<=C_j N^j. This follows directly from its fixed bandwidth and finite products of monomials with exponents O(N). Differentiating the inverse identity retains the exact moving matrix: partial_h R=R(partial_h J)R and partial_z R=-R^2. Each mixed derivative is a finite sum of products with at most j+k+1 resolvent factors and total h-derivative order j on the intervening J factors. Bound them by (2) to obtain (3). This argument includes every moving eigenvalue and Jordan-current term, and differentiates no root-only reflection. ## 5. The root scalar integrand also has vanishing closing rate The actual polynomial p_a(q,z), 0<=a<=floor(d/2), has only simple roots strictly above two. Its normalization makes p_a(q,x)>0 for real x<2. Therefore the factorization into its actual roots gives the exact estimate |p_a(q,z)|<=p_a(q,2-r), |z-2|<=r. (15) This remains true on the part of the disk crossing the scalar's LIMITING cut: the finite source is a polynomial there and (15) does not select or continue a logarithm through its zeros. For a/N->alpha in (0,1/2], the proved slit action gives N^-1 log p_a(q,2-r)->Psi_alpha(2-r) at every fixed r>0. Its explicit real formula has Psi_alpha(2-r)->0 as r decreases to zero. Indeed its maximizing t_* satisfies sin^2(pi t_*)=A r/(r+4A), A=sin^2(pi alpha), so t_*=O(sqrt(r)); the sine-log integrals in that formula tend to zero, including their integrable endpoint logarithms. Thus (2),(15) prove lim_(r down 0) limsup_(N->infinity) N^-1 log sup_(Re z>=2,|z-2|<=r) ||p_a(q,z)(zI-J_t(q))^-1||op <=0, (16) uniformly over every physical degree t. The actual face factor is one at the root. The same conclusion holds with any fixed generic or spectral derivative placed on the RESOLVENT factor alone, by (3). Consequently a closing arc of bounded length contained in this half-disk has the upper rate (16). This is a genuine estimate on the entire closing region, rather than an inference from a tiny endpoint disk. This root-factor argument does not itself estimate generic derivatives of the scalar polynomial on that whole region; Section 6 uses the separate scalar theorem for them. Neither argument estimates the rest of an enclosing contour, its deformation or intersection numbers, or the coherent surrounding state. A contributing geometric saddle and noncancellation remain separate requirements. All conclusions in this section also hold on the slit cone (4a), with its fixed gamma_0-dependent constants. The scalar estimate (15) already holds on the whole disk, and (14b) supplies the only extra resolvent cost. ## 6. Assembly for the full original integrand and its generic normals The independently proved [canceled-Sears closing theorem](actual_matching_edge_polynomial_closing_region_bound.md) supplies the scalar factor on the WHOLE complex disk, including its genuine generic-q normals and the actual face scalar. Combine it with (2),(3),(4a). For I_(N,a,t)(h,z)=D_a(q exp(h))^-1 p_a(q exp(h),z)(zI-J_t(q exp(h)))^-1, every fixed j,k>=0 satisfies sup_(z in K_(r,gamma_0)) ||partial_h^j partial_z^k I_(N,a,t)(0,z)||op <=C_(j,k,gamma_0) r^-k N^(4j+3k+3) exp[C_(j,k,gamma_0) N f(r) +C_(j,k,gamma_0)(log N)^2]. (17) This holds uniformly in ALL 0<=a<=floor((N-1)/2), ALL 0<=t<=N-1, both level parities and 0<r<=r0, for a sufficiently small fixed r0. The angular exclusion gamma_0 remains fixed and positive. No limit a/N->alpha is required in (17). Here are the finite costs in the pure Leibniz argument. Put i of the j generic derivatives and l of the k spectral derivatives on the scalar factor. Its companion bound costs at most N^(3i) r^-l exp[C N f(r)+C log N], since p_a(q,2)<=1. The remaining resolvent derivatives cost, by (3), C N^(j-i) H_N(r)^(j-i+k-l+1). The resulting power of N is 4j-i+3k-3l+3<=4j+3k+3, and r^-l<=r^-k. Summing the finitely many Leibniz terms proves (17). The inverse face scalar and all its q jets are already part of the scalar companion theorem; none is discarded. In particular, let r_N decrease to zero at ANY rate and let an arc Gamma_N lie in K_(r_N,gamma_0), with length at most a fixed power of N. Hold that arc fixed while taking generic-q derivatives. For every fixed j, the integral over Gamma_N of partial_h^j I(0,z) has norm at most exp[o(N)]. This uses k=0 in (17), so there is no r_N^-k loss. It includes the actual finite source normals needed by the exceptional operator period, not just its root value. This cap estimate does not prove a deformation of the remainder of the original contour, its saddle intersection number or a nonzero geometric contribution. In particular it leaves the surrounding complement and its coherent contraction explicit: multiplying this block by an uncontrolled environment is not a completed volume bound. Audit: [dyadic path comparison, all-prefix determinants and original Green entries](../experiments/audit_actual_casimir_closing_region_bound.py). The finite spectral-count samples are diagnostics. The uniform estimates come from the proof. Section 6 uses the two bounds and the displayed Leibniz count, retaining the actual face factor, conservative power of N, arbitrary shrinking radii when k=0, fixed angular exclusion and the stated surrounding-environment limitation.

title: The full original Casimir resolvent is polynomial at the spectral endpoint
status: Full physical endpoint resolvent and genuine jets
text: # The full original Casimir resolvent is polynomial at the spectral endpoint 30 October 2026. The original physical Casimir has a uniformly polynomial resolvent at z=2, including all degrees, both level parities and its Jordan blocks. Fixed genuine generic-q and spectral derivatives have polynomial cost on an explicit shrinking neighborhood. This addresses a finite endpoint of the exact operator contour; it does not prove dominance of a geometric saddle or control an entire contour segment merely from its endpoint. ## 1. Uniform statement Put q=exp(pi i/N), d=N-1, N>=3, and use the ACTUAL generic physical matrix J_t(zeta) from the [original jet theorem](actual_q_hahn_physical_generic_jet_bound.md). For every 0<=t<=d there is an absolute constant C such that ||(2I-J_t(q))^-1||op<=C N^17. (1) The exponent is a conservative uniform bound, not an optimal rate. The same bound holds for every high-degree block, by the exact generic high-degree adapter, and for their full orthogonal direct sum. For sufficiently small absolute c>0, on the bidisk zeta=q exp(h), |h|<=cN^-19, |z-2|<=cN^-18, the resolvent exists and has norm at most 2C N^17. Consequently its mixed Taylor coefficients satisfy ||[h^r(z-2)^s](zI-J_t(q exp(h)))^-1||op <=C_(r,s) N^(17+19r+18s). (2) These are the original matrix normals, with distinct generic upper and lower entries. No semisimple projection or root-only reflection is differentiated in (2). ## 2. The exact ground-state congruence Write theta=pi/N, lambda_0=q+q^-1, delta=2-lambda_0=4sin^2(theta/2). The original normalized channel-zero vector is f_r=(-q^-1)^r. The root offdiagonal and its positive magnitude are A_r=-a_r q^(2r+1-t), a_r=4sin((t-r)theta)sin((r+1)theta)>0, 0<=r<t. The exact row identity proved in the [off-spectrum prefix theorem](actual_casimir_off_spectrum_prefix_action.md) is D_r=lambda_0+q^-1 A_r+q A_(r-1), with A_(-1)=0. For a leading m-by-m prefix, m<=t, let F=diag(f_0,...,f_(m-1)) and let L_m be the REAL weighted Dirichlet matrix with diagonal a_(r-1)+a_r and offdiagonals -a_r, retaining the right boundary conductance a_(m-1). Then exactly F(J_[m]-lambda_0 I)F=-q^-t L_m, F(J_[m]-2I)F=-q^-t(L_m+delta V_m), V_m=diag(q^(t-2r)). (3) This is a unitary congruence, not a unitary similarity. Its left and right factors nevertheless preserve singular values and determinant magnitudes. Thus it can be used for inverse norms without claiming that J is Hermitian. The positive matrix L_m has the elementary exact formulas det L_m=product_(r=0)^(m-1) a_r, tr L_m^-1=sum_(r=0)^(m-1)(r+1)/a_r. (4) Indeed L_m=B^T diag(a_r)B, where (Bv)_r=v_r-v_(r+1) and v_m=0. The inverse of B has ones above its diagonal; (4) follows directly. ## 3. Both halves are controlled, even when t approaches N-1 Suppose 1<=m<=floor(t/2)+1 and m<=t. Every argument (t-2r)theta in V_m lies in [0,t theta], and t theta<=pi-theta. Rotation by exp(-it theta/2) therefore gives Re[exp(-it theta/2)(L_m+delta V_m)] >=cos(t theta/2)(L_m+delta I). Since cos(t theta/2)>=sin(theta/2)>=1/N and delta>=4/N^2, ||(J_[m]-2I)^-1||op<=N^3/4. (5) This remains uniform at the folded physical endpoint t=N-1. For these same half-prefixes one has a_r>=4(r+1)^2/N^2. (6) For r=0 use sin(t theta)>=sin theta>=2/N. For r>=1, r<=t/2 and t<=N-1 put t-r in [r,N-r-1]. Both sine factors in a_r are at least 2r/N, giving a_r>=16r^2/N^2 and hence (6). Equations (4),(6) show delta tr L_m^-1<= (pi^2/4)(1+log N). Expansion in the diagonal perturbation gives an especially simple determinant bound: all principal minors of L_m are positive, and every diagonal entry of V_m has modulus one. Therefore |det(L_m+delta V_m)|<=det(L_m+delta I) <=det L_m exp(delta tr L_m^-1) <=C N^3 product_(r=0)^(m-1) a_r. (7) This is an upper bound for the ACTUAL determinant; no estimate on individual nonorthogonal spectral projectors was used. The trailing half at the root is the reflected conjugate of a leading half, so (5),(7) apply to it too. Only these root norm statements use reflection. ## 4. The exact full determinant prevents a small Schur denominator The actual characteristic polynomial gives chi_t(2)=det(2I-J_t(q)) =product_(r=0)^t [2sin((r+1/2)theta)]^2>0. (8) Let s_t=product_(r=1)^t 2sin(r theta). Then product_(r=0)^(t-1)a_r=s_t^2, chi_t(2)/s_t^2>=4/N^2. (9) Here is an elementary uniform proof of the second inequality. The positive sequence H_t=product_(r=0)^t 2sin((r+1/2)theta)/s_t has successive ratios sin((t+1/2)theta)/sin(t theta). They are first at least one and then at most one, so its minimum occurs at an endpoint. The cyclotomic products give H_(N-1)=2/N, while H_0=2sin(theta/2)>=2/N. Squaring proves (9). For t>=1 split J_t-2I between its two middle rows. Its diagonal blocks B,C have sizes floor((t+1)/2), ceil((t+1)/2), so (5),(7) apply. Let A be their single connecting root offdiagonal and a=|A|<=4. In (7) the connecting conductance occurs in BOTH Dirichlet halves. Consequently |det B det C|<=C N^6 a s_t^2. The two-by-two bridge correction has determinant Delta=1-A^2(B^-1)_(last,last)(C^-1)_(first,first) =det(J_t-2I)/(det B det C). Using (8),(9) and a<=4 yields |Delta|>=c N^-8. (10) Every entry of its adjugate is bounded by C N^3 by (5). Its inverse therefore has norm at most C N^11. The rank-two resolvent formula, with two diagonal-block inverse factors of norm at most C N^3, gives C N^(3+3+11)=C N^17 for the whole inverse. This proves (1). The case t=0 is the scalar inverse delta^-1<=N^2/4. This argument controls the actual full Jordan resolvent; it does not bound it by a sum of exponentially large individual projector norms. ## 5. The original generic normals and the contour qualification Every exponent in the displayed original generic matrix entries is O(N), and the bandwidth is fixed. On |h|<=c/N the matrix perturbation has operator norm at most C N|h|, uniformly in physical t. Combining this with (1), the two perturbations h and z-2 on the stated bidisk have relative inverse norm less than 1/2 for sufficiently small c. The Neumann resolvent formula proves the uniform bidisk bound; two-variable Cauchy gives (2). This argument starts from the genuine generic matrix and so retains all moving-node and moving-projector contributions automatically. The endpoint matters because the largest root Casimir node tends to 2, while the source-polynomial zeros approach 2 from above. A fixed contour enclosing all nodes cannot remain a fixed compact of the scalar limiting slit plane. Equations (1),(2) provide uniform finite control at 2 and on the displayed shrinking neighborhood. They do not alone estimate the path connecting that neighborhood to a fixed contour, establish a steepest-descent deformation, or show that the geometric contribution is nonzero. Focused audit: [actual ground-state congruence, halves and full endpoint resolvent](../experiments/audit_actual_casimir_endpoint_resolvent_bound.py). The matrix relation is a unitary congruence, not a similarity. The proof includes the duplicated bridge conductance and full Schur denominator. Numerical full norms are diagnostics; the uniform exponent comes from the analytical estimate. No contour deformation or geometric contribution follows.

title: The actual Casimir prefix has a selected off-spectrum action
text: # The actual Casimir prefix has a selected off-spectrum action 30 October 2026. This is a theorem for the original physical Casimir matrix, with an arbitrary spectral variable. It supplies a forward/backward Green-kernel ingredient for the exact exceptional-block contour. It does not continue a finite color or a magnetic index, evaluate the full polynomial operator by its symbol, or prove that a geometric saddle contributes to the source contour. ## 1. Statement and the strict half-prefix condition Use the original root matrix J_t of the [physical generic-jet theorem](actual_q_hahn_physical_generic_jet_bound.md), with q=exp(pi i/N), Q=q^2, 0<=t<=N-1. Let J_[m] be its first m rows and columns. Suppose t/N -> tau, m/N -> nu, 0<nu<tau/2, 0<tau<1. All convergence below is uniform when the two real parameters stay in compact subsets of this strict domain. Put beta=pi(1-tau+2nu) in (0,pi), H_beta={z: Re[exp(-i beta/2)(2-z)]>0}. On every compact subset of H_beta, the actual matrices J_[m]-zI are invertible for all sufficiently large N, with a uniformly bounded inverse. In particular this includes every fixed compact set of real spectral parameters z<2. The bound does not hold here at a central prefix nu=tau/2; that endpoint is deliberately excluded. There is a canonical analytic logarithm of the determinant, selected from negative real infinity, for which N^-1 Log det(J_[m]-zI) -> S_(tau,nu)(z), (1) locally uniformly on H_beta, with every fixed z derivative. Write A(x)=-4 exp(i pi(2x-tau)) sin(pi(tau-x))sin(pi x), w=2-z. The limiting action is the explicit single integral S_(tau,nu)(z)=integral_0^nu Log[(w+2A(x)+sqrt(w(w+4A(x))))/2] dx. (2) The square root and logarithm in (2) are selected at large positive w and continued in H_beta. They are not pointwise principal choices of a determinant or discriminant. Formula (1) is a leading action, not a relative-amplitude expansion. ## 2. An exact Dirichlet decomposition of the original matrix The actual root entries, with U=Q^r and T=Q^t, are D_r=U/T [2(q^-1+qT)-(q+q^-1)U], A_r=(U-T)(1-q^2 U)/T. Put A_(-1)=0. Direct algebra gives BOTH identities D_r=q+q^-1+q^-1 A_r+q A_(r-1), (3) R_r:=D_r-2-A_r-A_(r-1) =-U(q-1)^2(Tq^2-Uq^2-Uq-U+1)/(Tq^2). (4) Hence |R_r|<=C/N^2, uniformly over all physical r,t. The unitary diagonal sign matrix changes the offdiagonals of J_[m] to -A_r. After this conjugation, (4) says exactly J_[m]-2I=L_A+diag(R_r), (5) where L_A has diagonal A_(r-1)+A_r and adjacent entries -A_r. For v_m=0 its sesquilinear form is <v,L_A v>=sum_(r=0)^(m-1) A_r |v_r-v_(r+1)|^2. (6) The term r=m-1 is the retained Dirichlet boundary term. At the other endpoint A_(-1)=0 exactly; no omitted boundary term is being estimated. The original coefficients also have the exact polar form A_r=-4 exp(i(2r+1-t)pi/N) sin((t-r)pi/N)sin((r+1)pi/N). For 0<=r<m, both sine factors are positive and their marked arguments obey 0<Arg A_r<=beta_N:=pi+(2m-1-t)pi/N<pi. (7) In the strict scaling range beta_N tends to beta<pi. If w=2-z, rotation of wI+L_A by exp(-i beta_N/2) gives Re <v,exp(-i beta_N/2)(wI+L_A)v> >=Re[exp(-i beta_N/2)w] ||v||^2. (8) The perturbation (4) costs at most C/N^2 in (8). Every compact of H_beta has a positive margin in its right side; (5)--(8) therefore give the claimed uniform inverse bound for the original prefix. The sign conjugation is unitary and does not alter determinants. ## 3. Determining the actual logarithm, without an assumed WKB solution For a finite N, restrict first to Re[exp(-i beta_N/2)(2-z)]>2C/N^2. There the rotated matrix in (8) is strictly accretive. Its principal matrix logarithm defines Log det(J_[m]-zI) :=i m beta_N/2 +tr Log[exp(-i beta_N/2)(J_[m]-zI)]. (9) This agrees with m Log(-z)+O(m/|z|) as z tends to negative real infinity. These halfplanes exhaust every compact subset of H_beta. The logarithm in (9), rather than the principal logarithm of the scalar determinant, retains the actual accumulated phase. The inverse bound gives |N^-1 partial_z Log det(J_[m]-zI)|<=C_K m/N. At one sufficiently negative fixed real z, the uniformly bounded entries and fixed bandwidth give a bounded normalized logarithm by its convergent trace series. The derivative bound then gives local boundedness throughout H_beta. These analytic functions form a locally bounded normal family there. It remains to determine its limit on a nonempty open set. For each fixed integer k, multiplication of the tridiagonal matrices gives a finite sum over nearest-neighbor closed paths. Paths within k rows of an endpoint contribute O(k/N) after normalized trace, since their entries are uniformly bounded. On all other paths, the slowly varying entries may be replaced by their common local limits with error O_k(1/N). Thus N^-1 tr(J_[m]^k) -> integral_0^nu (1/pi) integral_0^pi [2+2A(x)+2A(x)cos(phi)]^k dphi dx. (10) The coefficient of the zero Laurent power in the local tridiagonal symbol is precisely the inner integral in (10); this proves the path count directly. For |z| sufficiently large, the uniformly convergent logarithmic trace series and (10) show that (1) has limit integral_0^nu (1/pi) integral_0^pi Log[w+4A(x)cos^2(phi/2)] dphi dx. (11) For every x in [0,nu], A(x) is zero or lies in the cone of (7). The argument of the logarithm in (11), after rotation, has strictly positive real part for z in H_beta. Consequently (11) is analytic on H_beta with the branch selected by negative infinity. The identity theorem and the normal-family bound make every subsequential limit equal to (11), proving convergence of the full sequence. Cauchy's formula proves convergence of all fixed spectral derivatives. Finally integrate the elementary logarithmic symbol. For large positive w, expansion in A/w (or differentiation in w followed by its value at infinity) gives (1/pi) integral_0^pi Log[w+4A cos^2(phi/2)] dphi =Log[(w+2A+sqrt(w(w+4A)))/2]. (12) Both sides continue analytically on H_beta. Indeed w and w+4A lie in the same rotated right halfplane; the selected product square root is nonzero there. The selected numerator in (12) is nonzero as well: a zero would force A=0 after squaring, whereas then it equals 2w. Equation (12) proves (2) with its source-selected branch. ## 4. What this gives to the exceptional-block problem The forward resolvent numerator is exactly det(zI-J_[m]); it differs from the determinant in (1) by (-1)^m, whose marked logarithm must be retained. The actual trailing prefix is the reflected conjugate root matrix, so it has the conjugate statement with its own corresponding halfplane and branch. Thus suitable strict forward/backward portions of the original Green kernel have a selected off-spectrum leading action, including all real geometric target traces below 2. This does not yet control prefixes reaching or crossing their midpoint, complex magnetic continuation, a relative nonzero amplitude, or the resolvent contour's intersection with a geometric steepest-descent cycle. No large-degree polynomial has been replaced by scalar symbol evaluation in this theorem. The moving generic-q normal also remains the one in the exact contour formula; (1) concerns spectral derivatives of the root prefix, not generic-q derivatives of the whole source. Focused audit: [original prefix, exact row residual and selected action](../experiments/audit_actual_casimir_off_spectrum_prefix_action.py). The theorem requires a strict half-prefix and concerns root spectral derivatives and the leading action. It includes no relative amplitude or source-cycle contribution. Finite logarithm and trace-moment samples check the formulas, not the limiting theorem.

title: Exact central black, ordinary-white and marked contractions
text: # Exact central black, ordinary-white and marked contractions 29 October 2026. At the ODD simple Steinberg triple the actual ordinary white covector is a genuine pivotal dual of the black tensor, with an explicit scalar. It is nonzero, yet its closed magnetic pairing with black is ZERO. The original marked closure instead gives an explicit positive scalar after all magnetic indices are contracted. This is a coherent source calculation, not a norm-square replacement of the vertex. It explains why the [full-black CD norm obstruction](actual_trivalent_full_cd_normalization_and_magnetic_growth.md) does not determine the growth of a sewn scalar. Only this odd central sector and the specified actual two-vertex contraction are evaluated. No paired/even analogue, arbitrary graph recoupling estimate or global volume statement is inferred. ## 1. Original duality fixes the ordinary white tensor Use N=2m+1, d=2m and the exact central W,pi,Theta,A_N of [the actual odd source](actual_trivalent_steinberg_central_anchor.md). Thus pi=W^dagger P, pi W=I, and the unscaled black tensor is U=pi^tensor3 J_source=s Theta, s=N^2 q^(-m^2) A_N, Theta=(W tensor I)p. (1) The original physical cup/cap matrices are p_(a,b)=N x^(-b)delta_(a+b,d), ell_(a,b)=x^a/N delta_(a+b,d), p ell=ell p=I. For a map T:V->V tensor V its genuine right dual, after identifying the dual objects by these SAME maps, is D(T)=p^T T^T(ell^T tensor ell^T)P_ord. (2) P_ord reverses abstract dual tensor order; it is not an inserted R. For an invariant column v in V^tensor3 the right-dual covector is D(v)=v^T(ell^T)^tensor3 Rev_3. (3) These are bilinear pivotal duals. Complex conjugation is not part of D. Both formulas follow by the ordinary evaluation index sums, with every N factor retained. The actual simple-channel Hom space is one-dimensional, so D(W) is a scalar multiple of pi. Evaluate row0,column(m,0) in(2), using W_d(d,m)=q^(m^2). It gives EXACTLY D(W)=gamma pi, gamma=q^(3m^2)/N. (4) In particular gamma is nonzero. Dualizing pi W=I and using the same one-dimensional Hom space gives D(pi)=gamma^(-1)W. The nested matching (16),(23),(45) is preserved by reversal, and its right dual is precisely the original three ordinary caps ell^S. Therefore, with Lambda=ell^S W^tensor3, D(U)=gamma^(-3)Lambda, Lambda=gamma^3 s D(Theta). (5) Both U and Lambda are nonzero at every odd N, since A_N is the proved nonzero quartic scalar. The original ordinary white packet V in the unscaled W coordinates satisfies conjugate(V)=N^6 Lambda. This proves its precise dual relation; it does not assume V=U or V=Vm. ## 2. The ordinary closed pairing is zero, despite nonzero vertices Write Theta_c and lambda_c for the third magnetic slices of Theta and D(Theta). Let T_(s,t)=sum_(a,b) Theta_(a,b,s)D(Theta)_(a,b,t). Integer H=0 support makes T diagonal. The ordinary E equations for the invariant column and covector imply, for 1<=r<=d, k_r lambda_r E_12=-e_r lambda_(r-1), k_(r-1) E_12 Theta_(r-1)=-e_r Theta_r. Here k_r=xQ^(-r) and every e_r is nonzero. Pairing these identities gives T_rr/T_(r-1,r-1)=k_(r-1)/k_r whenever interpreted as the cleared equality. Hence K T is scalar, with NO division by T_rr. Its scalar can also be computed finitely. The top-edge Clebsch identity is W_(d-a)(d,m-a)=q^(m^2)h_a, 0<=a<=m. (6) To prove it, start at W_d(d,m)=q^(m^2), apply the actual E relation at first physical color d, and use factorial reflection. The resulting factor is Q^(ma)F_m F_(d-a)/(F_(m-a)F_d); its root phase converts it exactly to h_a. There is no new scalar connection constant. Equations(2),(4),(6) give T_dd=gamma x^(-d)q^(-m^2) sum_a x^a beta(m,a)^2 =gamma x. The last sum is the finite Vandermonde sum N/F_m^2. Since k_d=x^-1, K T=gamma I, D(Theta)Theta=Tr T=gamma Tr(K^-1)=0. (7) Consequently Lambda U=0 exactly. This is the ordinary q-dimension zero in its actual magnetic contraction, not a claim that either vertex vanishes. Replacing it by a positive Euclidean contraction would destroy this cancellation. The open tangle obtained by cutting that third edge is K T in these left/right duality conventions. The K factor is the recorded pivotal clock from the same snakes; (7) also verifies directly that the open map is a Hopf endomorphism. Its normalized marked closure is gamma, since the original marked unknot has value one. ## 3. Transfer the physical mark through the actual simple projector Let E_St=W pi be the FULL isolated -2 Casimir projector. The actual central circle is L_St=N E_St. Its appropriately oriented ordinary partial traces are sum_b K_b (E_St)_(a b;c b)=delta_(a,c), sum_a K_a^(-1)(E_St)_(a b;a e)=delta_(b,e). (8) Here is a root-safe proof, rather than a guessed positive resolution. Lift only this projector to the ordinary generic highest-weight-d pair. Its central summand is again the highest-weight-d module. The Casimir projector is regular at the odd root: its eigenvalue -2 collides with no other pair eigenvalue, so every projector denominator is a unit there. Its typed partial trace is a Hopf endomorphism of V_N, hence scalar. Taking the generic full pivotal trace gives scalar [N]_q=[N]_q, so the scalar is one away from the root and remains one by regular specialization. This proves(8) with the original root duality. The same argument shows equality of the root scalar obtained by cutting a physical V_N component or its embedded central V_N edge: the generic quantum dimensions are IDENTICAL, and all relevant coupons have a regular lift. No arbitrary modified-trace axiom is assumed. At odd root the usual generic pivotal maps specialize to the recorded ones, since K^N=I on V_N and K^(1-N)=K. Root marked closure of an open scalar t I is exactly t, by the direct identity m p=1 with m_(a,b)=x^b/N^2. This is the actual unrestricted marked source, not a replacement by an ordinary cap. This generic lift proves a FIXED-ROOT identity only. It does not identify the original moving-q normal germ of the complete circle with a value-only projector or authorize differentiation of it. Other Casimir channels and their original normals remain separate. ## 4. Exact marked two-vertex central scalar Use the actual two-vertex, three-edge source of the branching note, with one original marked cap and all three edge circles projected to their odd simple Steinberg summand. Contract EVERY magnetic index before estimating. The open effective scalar of U and Lambda is, from(1),(5),(7), gamma^4 s^2=q^(10m^2)A_N^2=|A_N|^2. (9) Indeed A_N=q^[m(2-m)]S_N with S_N positive, and the remaining phase is q^[8m^2+4m]=q^(4mN)=1. Each of the three actual central circles contributes N, while(8) transports the original marked cut without an extra dimension. Thus the original raw marked central contribution is EXACTLY Z_St=N^3 |A_N|^2 =(1/16)exp(2Nj0)[1+O(1/N)]. (10) For edge twists R^(e_i)L_St multiply(10) by the literal full-Cartan unit phase omega_m^(e_1+e_2+e_3). Any recorded external line chi_N stays outside. Equation(10) is not the full graph source with the other joint channels removed by fiat: it is the explicitly specified central sector of an original source decomposition. This is a concrete coherent contraction that removes the extra magnetic growth of the black CD norm. It does not make the original marked WHITE tensor equal to the black tensor, or furnish a sharp norm bound for arbitrary six-port sewing. The paired/even analogue still needs its own normal-current calculation. A complete graph also retains all other channels, phases and possible cancellations. The [focused exact audit](../experiments/audit_actual_central_black_white_marked_contraction.py) passes seven odd levels N=3,...,15: literal right-dual Clebsch maps, nonzero ordinary white rows and zero closed pairing, both typed physical partial traces, the complete magnetic cut operator, and the unrestricted original marked contraction. Nine direct physical signed full-Cartan matrix contractions independently reproduce(10). Four labeled high-precision checks calibrate its scalar prefactor. The duality and regular-projector arguments above prove the general identities; the finite range is supplementary.

title: What simplifies at the geometric endpoint, and a magnetic gauge obstruction
text: # What simplifies at the geometric endpoint, and a magnetic gauge obstruction 30 October 2026. At every ODD level, fixing all complete-circle channels to the genuine simple endpoint makes each retained half twist an explicit scalar. The local q-Hahn critical equation also has no saddle collision on its physical endpoint domain. Nevertheless the actual central black spin tensor cannot be made entrywise positive by separate nonzero gauges on its three magnetic legs, already at N=3. The obstruction is an exact gauge-invariant six-entry ratio. It does not rule out a larger coherent resummation or a positive final scalar. It identifies why selecting endpoint channels and adjusting separate leg phases is not itself a general positive-source proof. ## 1. All retained half twists become known endpoint scalars Let N=2m+1, d=2m, q=exp(pi i/N), x=q^d and kappa=q^(d^2/2). The complete-circle node c_m=-2 is SIMPLE. Its physical summand is the actual intertwiner W:V_N->V_N tensor V_N of the [central Clebsch theorem](actual_trivalent_steinberg_central_anchor.md), with genuine dual pi=W^dagger P and pi W=I. Its projector is E_St=W pi, and L_(N,m)=N E_St, E_St^2=E_St, R E_St=omega_m E_St, omega_m=kappa (-1)^m q^[m(m+1)], |omega_m|=1. (1) Therefore for any original fixed ordered plat or source-certified matching circuit, its simultaneous endpoint contribution satisfies Z_endpoint(epsilon)=omega_m^(sum_i epsilon_i) Z_endpoint(0), (2) before the independently specified exterior framing line is restored. All cups, caps, the original unrestricted marked cut and wire ordering are unchanged. Equation (2) is just an all-input scalar identity on each actual endpoint image; it does not use positivity or replace a structural crossing elsewhere in the diagram. At even N the last folded node is DOUBLE and L_N is nilpotent there. Equation (1) must not be copied to that level as a projector identity. Its actual first-normal source is required, as in the existing even central black/white calculations. ## 2. The endpoint local saddle roots do not collide For the raw physical q-Hahn phase in the [augmented-plat compiler](actual_augmented_plat_phase_compiler.md), put T=exp(2pi i tau), U=exp(2pi i upsilon), and let Z be the exponentiated internal summation variable. At the continuum endpoint xi=j/N->1/2, its Jc=exp(2pi i xi) equals -1. The exact candidate quadratic from that LEADING phase simplifies to [U(T+1)-4T]Z^2+2U(T-1)Z+U(T+1)=0. (3) Its discriminant is Delta=16TU(T+1-U). (4) On the entire real physical domain 1/2<=tau<=1, 0<=upsilon<=tau, one has |T+1-U|>=1, hence |Delta|>=16. Indeed, with phi=2pi tau and psi=2pi upsilon, |1+exp(i phi)-exp(i psi)|^2-1 =4cos(phi/2)[cos(phi/2)-cos(psi-phi/2)]>=0. (5) Here cos(phi/2)<=0, while |psi-phi/2|<=phi/2<=pi makes the second factor nonpositive. The quadratic coefficient also has modulus at least 4-|T+1|>=2. Thus both roots remain simple; no division by a vanishing quadratic coefficient or hidden branch collision occurs on this domain. At tau=1/2 a root can be zero, so a logarithmic chart there still needs its boundary treatment. This removes one possible local obstruction. It does NOT select which root the actual finite q-Hahn sum carries. For an interior endpoint state with 1/2<tau<1, its internal Fourier derivative still has argument pi(tau-1/2), strictly between zero and pi/2. Hence the raw summation does not have a real interior saddle. A complex source deformation or an exact resummation is still needed. ## 3. An exact N=3 obstruction to positive magnetic leg gauges Use the ACTUAL endpoint invariant Theta=(W tensor I)p, Theta_(a,b,c)=N x^-c W_(d-c)(a,b), a+b+c=3m, (6) with the original cup p. The central black vertex is a known NONZERO scalar times Theta, as proved by its finite quartic transform. No scalar is inferred here from an unknown graph evaluation. At N=3, m=1, q=(1+i sqrt(3))/2 and x=q^2. The actual highest vector is W_0=|0,1>+q|1,0>; its descendants are W_r=F_pair W_(r-1)/(1-Q^r), F_pair=F tensor I+K^-1 tensor F, F|a>=(1-Q^(a+1))|a+1>, K|a>=x Q^-a |a>. These finite equations and (6) give the six NONZERO entries | Magnetic triple | Actual Theta entry | |---|---:| | (2,1,0) | 3q | | (1,2,0) | 3 | | (0,2,1) | -3 | | (0,1,2) | 3q^2 | | (1,0,2) | -3 | | (2,0,1) | 3 | Consequently Theta_210 Theta_021 Theta_102 / (Theta_120 Theta_012 Theta_201) =q^-1=(1-i sqrt(3))/2, (7) which is not real. Under ANY separate nonzero leg gauges Theta_abc -> A_a B_b C_c Theta_abc, the numerator and denominator of (7) contain exactly the same multiset of labels on EACH leg. Every gauge factor therefore cancels. A common vertex scalar cancels too. If every nonzero coefficient could be made positive real, (7) would be positive real, a contradiction. This obstruction allows arbitrary nonzero complex diagonal gauges, not just unit phases. Reversing or conjugating the displayed ratio does not make it real. Thus the actual central BLACK tensor already prevents the proposed independent-leg positive normalization. The known endpoint half-twist scalars in (2) do not change this ratio. No information about the marked white tensor was suppressed to obtain the obstruction. ## 4. What this does and does not rule out The actual ordinary white and marked white packets are distinct from the black tensor and must stay in the complete source. The source- certified two-vertex contractions have already been resummed to positive expressions at both parities; those proofs sum additional indices and retain the original mark. They are fully consistent with (7), which concerns entrywise magnetic positivity before such sums. For an arbitrary fixed matching graph or plat, the next step is a COHERENT resummation of its original contracted endpoint tensors, or a controlled complex saddle with that source. A full non-diagonal basis change could also be investigated, but its actual inverse, exponential norm and transported marked source would need estimates. Neither the local no-collision statement (4) nor endpoint half-twist scalarity (2) supplies that global comparison. In particular (7) does not disprove an arbitrary-plat volume limit, positivity of a resummed scalar, or a possible geometric period. It excludes one precise proposed shortcut while retaining the actual root phases and source normalization. The displayed counterexample concerns N=3: it rules out an all-level independent-leg normalization, but by itself does not classify the larger levels or exclude an asymptotic normalization with a controlled phase error. Audit: [original endpoint projectors, six-entry ratio and discriminant](../experiments/audit_actual_central_endpoint_magnetic_phase_obstruction.py).

title: The actual endpoint q-connection, clock feedback and its source extension
text: # The actual endpoint q-connection, clock feedback and its source extension 28 October 2026. The charged polynomial has a flat rank-one q-connection whose numerator and denominator degrees are bounded by the diagram valencies, independently of N. Macroscopic lengths Q^L are retained. Its correct source Ward identity uses a specified endpoint-DELETED polynomial. It is not a polynomial annihilator of the top-degree state obtained by simply multiplying the cleared equation by that state. The original clock feedback has an exact compatible mixed transport. These identities retain all macro defects and peripheral factors, but they do NOT imply a nonzero selected geometric component. We locate precisely the information lost by localizing the actual nilpotent source. ## 1. Exact bounded-degree endpoint connection Use the original charged source, before or after its exact closure contractions, with d=N-1 and Q primitive of order N. Write its fixed-clock polynomial, including every extracted nonzero scalar, as P_h=gamma_h product_i X_i^(mu_i) product_e B_(L_e)(X_(u_e),X_(v_e);a_e), B_L(U,V;a)=product_(r=0)^(L-1)(U-Q^r aV). (1) Nonloop blocks have u_e!=v_e, 1<=L_e<=d. Actual self-loops have been evaluated as their exact scalar times X_i^L; a zero scalar means the actual sector is zero and is not localized. All gamma_h, original clock factors W_h, chi_N, pivots and Cartan/framing phases remain. The original functional is lambda(P)=[product_i X_i^d]P. Let tau_i shift X_i to QX_i. The literal block ratios are B_L(Q U,V;a)/B_L(U,V;a) =Q^L (U-Q^(-1)aV)/(U-Q^(L-1)aV), B_L(U,Q V;a)/B_L(U,V;a) =(U-Q^L aV)/(U-aV). (2) Define D_i=product_(u_e=i)(X_i-Q^(L_e-1)a_e X_(v_e)) *product_(v_e=i)(X_(u_e)-a_e X_i), N_i=Q^(mu_i+sum_(u_e=i)L_e) product_(u_e=i)(X_i-Q^(-1)a_e X_(v_e)) *product_(v_e=i)(X_(u_e)-Q^(L_e)a_e X_i). (3) Then EXACTLY in the ordinary polynomial ring, D_i tau_i P_h=N_i P_h. (4) Each degree is the number of incident nonloop BLOCKS, not the sum of their lengths. It is bounded for a fixed diagram. The Q^L coefficients are not replaced by one when L is proportional to N. Self-loops contribute the displayed Q^mu, rather than being counted twice in (2). On the regular locus these ratios define a flat rank-one connection: R_i=N_i/D_i=tau_i P_h/P_h, (tau_j R_i)R_j=(tau_i R_j)R_i, product_(r=0)^(N-1) tau_i^r R_i=1. (5) These are actual identities with a specified global section P_h. Flatness by itself is not new knot holonomy or a source nonvanishing theorem. In particular (5) has no extra condition on Fermat centers. ## 2. The NONTRIVIAL original source current Every factor of D_i in (3) is the last factor of an outgoing block or the first factor of an incoming block. Therefore D_i divides the ordinary polynomial P_h, with multiplicities as specified by its factorization. Put P_(h,i)^del=P_h/D_i. (6) This is an endpoint-deletion operation on the proved polynomial, not an inverse in the nilpotent algebra. Equation (4) is equivalently tau_i P_h=N_i P_(h,i)^del. Since lambda(tau_i P)=Q^d lambda(P), the exact source current is lambda((N_i-Q^d D_i)P_(h,i)^del)=0. (7) For a Laurent-polynomial insertion F its retained version is lambda(F N_i P_(h,i)^del) =Q^d lambda((tau_i^(-1)F) P_h). (8) The coefficient here is the specified Laurent-residue source whenever F has negative exponents. No claim that arbitrary such insertions are original finite-head coupons is needed. At F=1 equation (7) preserves the original charge and is already nontrivial. In contrast, lambda((N_i-Q^dD_i)P_h)=0 is normally VACUOUS: the inserted homogeneous numerator has positive degree and P_h is already at the total top degree. Confusing it with (7) loses the actual endpoint source extension. Equation (7) survives multiplication by the full W_h and summation over the actual clocks, with its h-dependent coefficients and endpoint-deleted state retained. ## 3. Exact mixed clock transport with the actual underhistory Use the independent coefficient C_h(R)=[Y^h]F_N^0(R,Y) and actual matrix T of [the feedback theorem](actual_clock_feedback_normal_form.md). For a crossing j at position r in its overbridge, increasing h_j by one decreases n_(r-1) by one and increases n_r by one. At independent primitive parameters the finite binomial recurrence gives C_(h+e_j)(R)=b_j(h,R) C_h(R), b_j=(t_r/t_(r-1)) *(1-Q^(n_(r-1)))/(1-z_(r-1)Q^(n_(r-1)-1)) *(1-z_rQ^(n_r))/(1-Q^(n_r+1)). (9) Use its cleared form if a displayed numerator or denominator vanishes. Inside the monotone simplex the factorial denominators are units; the original boundary support remains part of the statement. No cyclic continuation across h=0,d is inferred from a zero-over-zero recurrence. For S_h(R)=C_h(R Q^(T h)) define the primitive parameter shift Sigma_j R_i=R_i Q^(T_(ij)). The ACTUAL transport is S_(h+e_j)(R) =b_j(h,R Q^(T(h+e_j))) S_h(Sigma_j R). (10) It is not multiplication of S_h at the old parameters by (9). Equation (10) changes the other event endpoints, bridge parameters and closure source exactly by the actual underclock column T_(.,j). It follows by substituting RQ^(T(h+e_j)) in (9). Thus the joint anchor/clock connection is the exact pullback of the independent one, with all causal histories and negative self-clock shifts retained. Its compatibility is an identity of the actual functions, not an assumption that the a_j are independent physical clocks. For a regular leading coefficient action S_0, this produces the feedback term T^T partial_(log R)S_0 in clock stationarity, as derived in the feedback note. The anchor equations obtained from (3) likewise retain the macro endpoint Q^L. Those are necessary equations for a regular stationary contribution; they do not determine its intersection with the original relative source. There is also a source-level affine mark which its exponentiated classical equation alone cannot read. On a regular branch with log P_h=N S+o(N), equation (2) has leading ratio exp(2*pi*i X_i partial_(X_i)S). The original coefficient contour has the stationary equation X_i partial_(X_i)S=1, since d/N tends to one. But Q^d tends to one, so the bounded-degree leading q-equation retains only exp(2*pi*i X_i partial_(X_i)S)=1. Its integer lift has to be fixed by the original charge window and source, not by this equation alone. The exact homogeneous alias theorem fixes that window on the WHOLE finite coefficient; it does not authorize replacing every classical integer branch by its required lift before the period is compared. ## 4. Why localization does not select the nilpotent source The actual source algebra at its jet fiber is A_0=K[X_1,...,X_k]/(X_1^N,...,X_k^N). Every positive-degree linear form, and hence every nonconstant D_i, is nilpotent in A_0. Localizing A_0 by such a D_i gives the ZERO ring. This follows directly from D_i^M=0: after adjoining its inverse one gets 1=0. Therefore the rational connection R_i cannot simply be restricted as an invertible connection to the original jet source. The endpoint-deleted polynomial (6) is still a legitimate specified lift in the ordinary ring. It is not determined by division of the class of P_h in A_0, where D_i is a zero divisor. Keeping (6) is the minimal extension needed by the actual cleared current (7). There is an additional exact loss of data if the source is taken first. The homogeneous degree-kd class is [P_h]=lambda(P_h) Omega, Omega=product_i X_i^d. On this line tau_i acts as the constant Q^d, independent of L_e, a_e and their macro limits. Also N_i[P_h]=D_i[P_h]=0 whenever their degree is positive. Thus the geometric endpoint information in (3) lives BEFORE the socle projection, in its stated factorized source extension, not in a nontrivial localized connection on that one line. Generic nonzero Fermat fibers avoid this localization problem and have the exact same original period. But invertibility of P_h or of its endpoints there does not imply that its specified Fourier/residue coefficient is nonzero. The next actual example retains macro defects. ## 5. Actual hyperbolic-source sector with macro defects and zero period Use the original figure-eight braid [1,-2,1,-2] and its actual clocks h=(d,0,0,0). After the exact three closure contractions, write its four remaining anchors as X_0,X_4,X_5,X_6. Up to the retained NONZERO scalar, its actual polynomial consists of the four full blocks B_d(X_5,X_0;Q), B_d(X_6,X_0;q^(N+3)), B_d(X_5,X_4;q^(N+1)), B_d(X_0,X_6;q^(N-1)). (11) Its incidence defects S_i-2d are +d at X_0, -d at X_4 and zero at X_5,X_6. Thus this test does NOT assume small or vanishing defects. Its original selected coefficient is zero for EVERY N. The first full block contracts X_5=X_0. The third then contracts X_0=xX_4, since q^(N+1)Q^(-1)=x. The other two become B_d(X_6,X_4;Q) and a nonzero scalar times B_d(X_4,X_6;1). Contracting the first gives X_6=X_4; the remaining block contains X_4-X_4 and is zero. Every contraction is the actual arbitrary-exterior source identity, with its scalar retained. No bare geometric quotient or unknown knot period is used. This is also a special case of the separately proved first-cut clock support in [the alternating-source theorem](actual_alternating_balanced_source.md); the contraction above is included as a diagnostic of the connection, not as a new knot-specific selection mechanism. Nevertheless the polynomial in (11) is nonzero in the ordinary ring. Choose generic independent nonzero Fermat centers so that C_u!=a_e^N C_v for every edge. Then ALL its factors, endpoint denominators and P_h itself are units on that semisimple fiber. Its flat rank-one connection (5), actual T feedback and original source currents remain exact, while its selected period is still zero by center independence of the original homogeneous source. This is not a counterexample to a geometric-sector theorem: the full knot sum has other clocks, and no geometric contribution is claimed for (11). It proves that a nonzero actual section, a regular flat bounded-degree connection, source Ward equations and retained macro defects do not ALONE force nonzero source projection. ## 6. Critical-path conclusion The endpoint connection and mixed clock transport are exact tools for the original state, with bounded endpoint complexity and full macro coefficients. They do not yet prove anything stronger about geometric selection than the previously known regular critical correspondence. In particular there is no new broad-class volume lower bound here. A successful further argument must preserve the endpoint extension (6)-(8), the clock windows and T transport (10), and compute a nonzero projection of their WHOLE original relative class to the marked geometric branch. Specializing or localizing the socle first destroys precisely the data which that comparison needs. The example (11) prevents replacing the missing computation by rank-one flatness. [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_charged_connection.py) checks the actual endpoint identities and source currents, original primitive clock recurrences and feedback, and the all-N macro-defect source annihilation (11). No literature proof is used as a premise.

title: The actual charged source has the same residue on Fermat and nilpotent fibers
text: # The actual charged source has the same residue on Fermat and nilpotent fibers 28 October 2026. The whole-source coefficient proved in [the charged bridge-flow theorem](actual_global_charged_bridge_flow.md) has a canonical finite-flat algebraic realization. At each fixed level, its cyclotomic-grid residue and its nilpotent jet evaluation are exactly the SAME functional, with no unknown scalar or chosen asymptotic branch. The pairing remains nondegenerate when all Fermat centers vanish. This makes a part of the proposed algebraic-period/jet viewpoint literal. It does not identify residues at different levels, select the geometric regulator, or prove a volume limit. The algebra and the state class both depend on N. ## 1. A fixed-level finite-flat Frobenius algebra Fix N>=2, d=N-1, the actual primitive Q and the coefficient field K containing Q, the original half-root and source scalars. For k anchors put R=K[C_1,...,C_k], A_N=R[X_1,...,X_k]/(X_i^N-C_i, all i). (1) Its basis over R is X^a with 0<=a_i<=d. Reduction by the monic relations is unique, so A_N is free of rank N^k; in particular it is flat even when some or all C_i vanish. Define lambda_C(P)=[X_1^d ... X_k^d] (P reduced in (1)). (2) For two basis monomials the EXACT multiplication pairing is lambda_C(X^a X^b)=product_i delta_(a_i+b_i,d). (3) Indeed a_i+b_i<=2d. If reduction by X_i^N occurs, its remaining exponent is at most d-1, so it cannot contribute to (2). Thus the Gram matrix is an anti-diagonal permutation matrix, INDEPENDENT of every C_i, with determinant a unit. This proves A_N -> Hom_R(A_N,R), f -> (g -> lambda_C(fg)) (4) is an isomorphism of A_N-modules on every fiber. This is a specified Frobenius functional, not an unspecified nonzero linear form. Generators of this dual module form a torsor under A_N^units; the original source fixes the generator (2). ## 2. The selected Fermat residue extends to the actual nilpotent jet When every C_i is nonzero, the roots are simple. The Jacobian of f_i=X_i^N-C_i is N^k product_i X_i^d. Direct evaluation gives lambda_C(P) =Res_(all f_i=0) P(X) dX_1...dX_k/(f_1...f_k) =1/N^k sum_(X_i^N=C_i) P(X)/product_i X_i^d. (5) The residue means the sum of normalized local product-circle integrals. It agrees with (2) on every basis monomial, hence on all polynomials modulo (1). The coefficient and the Jacobian fix its sign and normalization. At C=0 the algebra is A_N(0)=K[X_1,...,X_k]/(X_1^N,...,X_k^N). (6) Its socle, the elements annihilated by all X_i, is exactly the one-dimensional line generated by Omega=product_i X_i^d. The same lambda is its top-coefficient functional, lambda_0(Omega)=1, or equivalently the local residue P dX/product_i X_i^N at zero. Formula (3) proves that the source pairing has NOT degenerated, although the fiber has become a nonreduced jet algebra. For a homogeneous polynomial P of total degree kd there is the stronger exact identity lambda_C(P)=[X^d]P=lambda_0(P), for EVERY C. (7) Any use of one monic relation reduces total X-degree by N; such a term cannot reach the top monomial of total degree kd. This is the algebraic version of the whole-source alias argument, and includes polynomials with large degrees in individual anchors. The original invariant therefore has the identical descriptions K_N=chi_N/N sum_(h over-monotone) W_h lambda_C(P_h) =chi_N/N sum_(h over-monotone) W_h lambda_0(P_h). (8) All clock weights, closure adapters and pivots are those already proved in the charged-flow theorem. No raw full-Psi continuation is substituted for this polynomial. Equation (8) is an equality of algebraic periods at each level, rather than an inference from a limit or an arbitrary choice of a quantum source. ## 3. A general cyclotomic annihilation rule for the actual source Let i!=j and alpha,beta be nonzero. In the nilpotent fiber, product_(r=0)^(N-1)(alpha X_i-Q^r beta X_j) =alpha^N X_i^N-beta^N X_j^N=0. (9) Consequently, if the actual event polynomial P_h contains a complete Q-orbit of linear factors on a pair of anchors, its entire selected coefficient is ZERO. This is an exact rule on the actual class, not an absolute-value estimate or a generic quotient killing a geometric full-function section. By (7) the same selected value vanishes on EVERY original regular Fermat grid. At nonzero centers the product in (9) equals the scalar alpha^N C_i-beta^N C_j rather than zero. There is no contradiction: its remaining polynomial has degree kd-N, and lambda_C kills that lower degree. Thus applying (9) to the selected period is justified by the whole homogeneous source, not by declaring that scalar zero in an individual grid summand. For the actual event factors, coefficients are explicit half-root phases. Group factors by their unordered anchor pair and their ratio modulo Q. Covering all N phases of one Q-orbit detects (9) before coefficient expansion. This is a sufficient vanishing test; failure of this test is NOT a nonvanishing theorem. More complicated cycle cancellations and the remaining h sum are still present. The recently proved two-crossing winding selection in [the bridge-phase theorem](actual_bridge_charge_phase.md) uses the same full-cycle polynomial 1-t^N in its one-variable coefficient calculation. The multianchor rule (9) does not require that local bigon presentation, but it also does not exhaust the source kernel. ## 4. What rigidity does and does not establish The source line is fixed across the finite-flat family (1), and the full original polynomial classes have center-independent periods. This resolves the ambiguity of transporting that source from regular cyclotomic points to its nilpotent jet fiber. It does NOT imply that the original class has a nonzero projection to a geometric period. The perfect pairing (3) allows many nonzero elements with lambda=0; (9) gives source-relevant exact cancellations. Also N^k, the socle degree k(N-1), the clock domain, and P_h all vary with N. Fixed-level flatness or the source torsor alone therefore supplies no cross-level growth estimate. A comparison with the marked Bloch regulator and a nonzero selected geometric coefficient are still required for the volume conjecture. [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_charged_socle_and_fermat_source.py): exact Frobenius pairings, grid/nilpotent residue normalization, homogeneous center independence, and complete-cycle vanishing tests on original charged bridge polynomials.

title: Exact underclock feedback and charge elimination in the original source
text: # Exact underclock feedback and charge elimination in the original source 28 October 2026. This note promotes the independent-parameter bridge generating function to an exact whole-word identity, retaining the actual UNDER clock feedback. The additional operation is an explicit diagonal root-of-unity Gaussian, equivalently a normalized finite Fourier kernel. The bridge charges can then be eliminated with their fugacities retained. This does not prove geometric selection or a volume lower bound. In particular, ordinary evaluation of the independent generating function before this feedback changes the original scalar. We prove the precise failure rather than treating its parameters as independently adjustable. ## 1. Original source and the actual feedback matrix Use the complete original root family N>=2, d=N-1, Q=q^2=exp(2*pi*i/N), x=-q^(-1). The original external dimension/framing factor is chi_N; every crossing still contains its original kappa factor. For any signed braid word W on b heads, take the overbridge/closure events and k=B+b anchor segments of [the whole charged source](actual_global_charged_bridge_flow.md). The original scalar source is its equation (1), not a newly chosen functional. Denote the anchor on a segment by X_s. At crossing j of sign sigma_j, with overclock h_j, the UNDER transport is z_out=x^(sigma_j) z_in Q^(-sigma_j h_j). (1) For a port v let P_v list earlier UNDER encounters on its segment and S_v=sum_(ell in P_v) sigma_ell. Then literally z_v=x^(S_v) X_(s(v)) Q^(-sum_(ell in P_v) sigma_ell h_ell). (2) Let P_j,S_j denote these data at the UNDER INPUT of crossing j. The actual conditioned overbridge parameter a_j is alpha_j/u_j, where u_j is the UNDER OUTPUT and alpha_j=Q^(-h_j)/x, sigma_j=+1, alpha_j=Qx, sigma_j=-1. Substituting (1) and (2) gives the exact formula a_j=Q^(delta_j) x^(-S_j) X_(s(j))^(-1) Q^[sum_(ell in P_j) sigma_ell h_ell-epsilon_j h_j], delta_j=(1+sigma_j)/2, epsilon_j=(1-sigma_j)/2. (3) Thus the positive a_j has no self-clock dependence, while the negative one has the compulsory factor Q^(-h_j). Both signs retain all earlier UNDER clocks. These facts follow by cancellation of alpha_j with its own transport; no geometric central relation has been imposed. Introduce independent primitive Laurent variables R_i consisting of one A_j for each a_j and one Z_v for every event endpoint port. Equations (2)-(3) have the uniform form R_i(actual)=rho_i X^(v_i) Q^((T h)_i). (4) The integer matrix T and the monomials rho_i X^(v_i) are diagram data. For A_j the row is rho_j=Q^(delta_j)x^(-S_j), v_j=-e_(s(j)), T_(j,ell)=sigma_ell for ell in P_j, T_(j,j)=-epsilon_j, all other entries zero. (5) For an endpoint Z_v its row has rho_v=x^(S_v), v_v=e_(s(v)), and entries -sigma_ell for ell in P_v. No future UNDER crossing enters (5). Closure ports use their whole actual segment prefix, as in (2). ## 2. Independent event polynomials with charge fugacities Put F_n=(Q;Q)_n and define the finite formal series U_z(v)=sum_(n=0)^d (z;Q)_n v^n/F_n. (6) Take one overbridge e with crossings j_1,...,j_m in its physical order, signs sigma_r, and independent primitives A_r=A_(j_r), V=Z_in, W=Z_out. Define w_r=sum_(s<=r) sigma_s and t_0=1, t_r=(-1)^r q^(2+w_r)/(V A_r), z_0=Q^2x/(A_1 V), z_r=x^(-1) A_r/A_(r+1) for 1<=r<m, z_m=A_m W. Let Y_(e,r)=product_(s<=r) Y_(j_s), Y_(e,0)=1. The independent, event-normalized generating polynomial is E_e^0(R,Y)=N kappa^(w_m) [v_e^d] product_(r=0)^m U_(z_r)(v_e t_r Y_(e,r)). (7) The coefficient of Y^h is N times the entire actual bridge formula with independent parameters: n_0=d-h_1, n_r=h_r-h_(r+1), n_m=h_m. Indeed the exponent of Y_(j_s) is sum_(r>=s)n_r=h_s. This is exactly equation (3) of [the complete bridge-phase proof](actual_bridge_charge_phase.md), with every scalar, sign, Gaussian phase and endpoint retained. For a closure event on head i use its original numerator kernel, including its denominator and pivot but omitting only the explicit 1/N: C_i^0=eta_i Z_in^(-d) sum_(a=0)^d Z_in^(d-a)(t_i Z_out)^a, (eta_1,t_1)=(1,1), (eta_i,t_i)=(x/x^N,Q^(-1)) for i>1. (8) Set F_N^0(R,Y)=product_e E_e^0 product_i C_i^0. Each crossing clock occurs once and has range 0,...,d. Its coefficient remains a Laurent polynomial in the independent primitives R. No clock is yet summed after falsely freezing the actual spectator variables. ## 3. Exact source-preserving feedback theorem Define on Laurent monomials the linear operator G_T(R^nu Y^h)=Q^(nu^T T h) R^nu Y^h. (9) For every signed braid word and its original source, K_N=chi_N/N * CT_X [G_T F_N^0(R,Y)]_(Y=1, R_i=rho_i X^(v_i)). (10) In particular the full normalization is fixed by the original period, not by division by an unknown knot invariant. Proof. On its Y^h coefficient, (9) is exactly substitution (4) in every primitive monomial. Equation (7) then gives the actual bridge, and (8) gives the actual boundary event. There are k events and each has its original factor 1/N. Every original anchor orbit sum gives N times its constant term: after clearing the single event-input denominator, the numerator is nonnegative of total degree kd. If an orbit kept exponents e_s-d=N l_s, then e_s>=0 gives l_s>=0 and homogeneity gives sum l_s=0. Thus all aliases vanish, exactly as in the whole-source theorem. Its N^k cancels the k event factors 1/N. The remaining 1/N in (10) is the original averaged first-cut source. This proves (10), for links as well as knots and at arbitrary bridge number. It does not make sectorwise replacements of the marked row. The feedback has an exact finite Fourier realization. If m is the number of crossings, then for any polynomial with these clock ranges [G_T F(R,Y)]_(Y=1) =N^(-m) sum_(lambda,eta in (Z/N)^m) Q^(-lambda dot eta) F(R_i Q^((T eta)_i), Y_j=Q^(lambda_j)). (11) For a monomial the lambda sum enforces eta=h modulo N. Since h_j is already in 0,...,d, it gives its actual value, and the remaining phase is precisely (9). This verifies both the exponent and N^(-m), rather than N^(-2m). There are no hidden central or peripheral normalizers. On the coefficient basis G_T is diagonal unitary. That observation controls its coefficient norm only; the actual charged evaluation and clock sum can still cancel. ## 4. The bridge charges can be eliminated with feedback retained Formula (11) does allow the bridge charge sums to be performed exactly, but it requires ALL the Fourier fugacities. Choose the representatives 0<=lambda_j<N, put Y_j=Q^(lambda_j), and on a bridge write Y_r=product_(s<=r)Y_(j_s), Y_0=1, T_end=(-1)^m q^(2+w_m) W/V. Then its v-series in (7) is, modulo v^N, EXACTLY product_(r=0)^m U_(z_r)(v t_r Y_r) =U_(T_end Y_m)(v) product_(r=1)^m (v t_r Y_(r-1);Q)_(lambda_(j_r)) /(v t_r Y_(r-1);Q)_(epsilon_r). (12) The denominators in (12) have constant term one and hence a unique inverse modulo v^N. Equation (12) leaves just one coefficient [v^d] per bridge, together with the explicit Fourier feedback (11). It is a uniform charge elimination, not a knot-specific summation identity. Proof. For the finite Euler series P, U_z(v)=P(zv)/P(v) modulo v^N, and P(Qv)=P(v)/(1-v). The actual bridge parameters obey z_(r-1)t_(r-1)=Q^(epsilon_r)t_r, z_m t_m=T_end. Cancel consecutive P factors while retaining Y_r/Y_(r-1)=Q^lambda. Their remaining ratio is P(Q^epsilon w)/P(Q^lambda w)=(w;Q)_lambda/(w;Q)_epsilon, which proves (12). Lambda=0 recovers the independent-parameter telescoping, but the full original source requires (11), not that single Fourier fiber. ## 5. A precise obstruction to pre-feedback telescoping Evaluation at Y=1 is NOT a quotient respected by G_T. Whenever T_(ij) is nonzero modulo N, [(Y_j-1)R_i]_(Y=1)=0, [G_T((Y_j-1)R_i)]_(Y=1)=(Q^(T_(ij))-1)R_i !=0. (13) Thus the actual feedback does not descend to the ideal (Y_j-1). This is a direct obstruction to replacing the independent bridge generating function by its pre-summed Y=1 value, then attempting to restore the spectators afterwards. The audit below also checks that this omission changes full original pivotal scalars, rather than merely an arbitrary auxiliary observable. Although the histories in (5) are causal, the operation is not nilpotent transport: the phases in (9) have order up to N. Causal ordering therefore does not supply a uniform finite unipotence argument for the original clock sum. The exact conjugation laws are G_T R_i G_T^(-1)=R_i Q^(sum_j T_(ij) E_(Y_j)), G_T Y_j G_T^(-1)=Y_j Q^(sum_i T_(ij) E_(R_i)), (14) where E is the integer exponent operator. They make the missing coupling explicit. In a regular semiclassical chart, write nu/N=v, h/N=H. Feedback contributes the full phase exp(2*pi*i*N*v^T T H). Equivalently it shears logarithmic coordinates log R -> log R+2*pi*i*T H, log Y -> log Y+2*pi*i*T^T v. (15) For example, if F_N^0 has a smooth leading log action S_0 and the finite Fourier sum admits a critical description, its internal stationary equations are exactly H=partial_(log Y) S_0, Lambda=T^T partial_(log R) S_0, log Y=2*pi*i*Lambda, log R=log R_base+2*pi*i*T H. (16) The charged CT also imposes sum_i (v_i)_a partial_(log R_i)S_0=0 at every anchor. These are the feedback/implicit equations with the actual source. They contain the terms omitted by varying bridge charges with independent spectators. Equations (15)-(16) are a stationary interpretation of the exact (10)-(11), not a proof that the original contour meets a particular geometric branch. ## 6. What is proved and what remains The original whole period now has (i) an explicit clock-independent integer feedback matrix, (ii) a normalized Fourier realization, and (iii) an exact charge-eliminated bridge formula at every Fourier fiber. The coupled phase has not been replaced by its absolute value or by the zero-feedback fiber. No unknown multiplier has been introduced. This does not fix the selected geometric coefficient. In particular, the known surviving nonflat anchor cycles in [the exact fusion note](anchor_phase_cycles_and_exact_fusion.md) prevent a blanket argument that the remaining phase is a vertex gauge. Regular critical equations may still be compared with the previously proved holonomy/calibration equations, but neither (10) nor their implicit stationary form proves a nonzero original geometric period. No new knot is claimed to satisfy the volume conjecture here. Generic q-Weyl/determinant and quantum MacMahon approaches to knot invariants already occur in the literature; this note makes no novelty claim for that general architecture. Coverage references are [Huynh-Le](https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0503296), [quantum MacMahon](https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0303319), and [noncommutative Jones](https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0411505). Their proofs are not premises of the identities above. ## 7. Reproducible checks [audit_actual_clock_feedback_normal_form.py](../experiments/audit_actual_clock_feedback_normal_form.py) constructs (3)-(5) without using any clock values, then independently compares the whole substituted polynomial, every primitive port, and the charged coefficient with the actual bridge-flow implementation. It sums all allowed clocks and compares with original signed R matrices and the original pivotal averaged cut. Five whole sources are checked at N=2,3. At least one changes if feedback is suppressed. The same audit checks the normalized finite Fourier delta for N=2,...,9 with positive and negative primitive exponents, and 96 complete fugacity-preserving telescopes (12), including negative crossings and the extreme residues lambda=0,N-1. These numerical checks audit the all-N proofs; they do not replace them.

title: A uniform closed route in the original Pascal-cell source
text: # A uniform closed route in the original Pascal-cell source 29 October 2026. The exact positive angle cells of the actual divided fusion maps have a simultaneous, source-admitted closed route at every crossing of ANY signed braid. Its energy is exponential. In particular, the phase-free path partition of these cells cannot itself be the sharp geometric angle partition for the figure-eight knot. Coherent contraction of the physical maps is essential before such a geometric comparison. This is about the original averaged-trace presentation AFTER its authorized whole-word degree reduction. It is not a statement about every possible pointed presentation or a surviving coherent clock sector. ## 1. Exact physical alphabet and original source Use N>=2, d=N-1, q=exp(pi i/N), Q=q^2, and x=-q^(-1). The exact [physical fusion and crossing theorem](actual_reassociation_angle_kernel.md) gives C=C'_12 and its literal inverse with entries C_(a-r,b+r;a,b)=x^(-r)[b+r choose r]_Q, C^(-1)_(a-r,b+r;a,b) =(-1)^r Q^(r(r-1)/2) C_(a-r,b+r;a,b), 0<=r<=min(a,d-b). (1) Write C_21=Flip C Flip and D_2|a,b>=(-1)^b Q^(b(b-1)/2)x^(-2b)|a,b>. The FULL original checked crossings are R_+=kappa C D_2 C_21 C^(-1), R_-=kappa^(-1) C C_21^(-1) D_2^(-1) C^(-1). (2) No physical cutoffs or common Cartan scalars have been removed. All displayed diagonals, kappa and original closing pivots have unit modulus at completeness. Both signs are included below with their actual order. For the whole original knot word W, integer total-degree conservation first gives the exact source K_N=chi_N/N Tr[(I tensor g tensor ... tensor g)W]. (3) This is [the original charged-source theorem](actual_global_charged_bridge_flow.md#1-use-the-original-scalar-source-before-splitting). It is used BEFORE expanding W into fusion paths. It is not a sectorwise replacement of the full marked row, nor a rule for arbitrary insertions. The original dimension/framing line chi_N remains outside (3). The physical quarter gauge G_a=N^(1/4)/sqrt(s_a), s_a=|(Q;Q)_a|, commutes with the closing pivots. Thus its tensor similarity preserves (3) exactly. The squared entry of either C or C^(-1) in this gauge is |Chat_entry|^2=N^2 w_d(r,a-r,d-a)w_d(r,b,d-b-r), w_d(i,j,k)=1/(s_i s_j s_k), i+j+k=d. (4) The operator C_21 has the same formula with the two physical heads exchanged. The inverse phases in (1) remain in the coherent word. ## 2. One closed route works for all signs and all braid positions Put N=3r+1, d=3r, r>=1, and choose the PHYSICAL initial trace state a_star=(2r,r,2r,r,...). (5) Every adjacent pair is either (2r,r) or (r,2r). At each crossing use the following transfers, listed in operator ACTION order: | input pair | right C^(-1) | middle C_21 or C_21^(-1) | left C | output pair | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | (2r,r) | r | r | 0 | (2r,r) | | (r,2r) | 0 | r | r | (r,2r) | For a negative crossing its D_2^(-1) is between the right and middle maps; for a positive crossing D_2 is between the middle and left maps. It is diagonal and never changes this route or its nonzero modulus. Each intermediate pair is (2r,r) or (r,2r), so all physical bounds in (1) hold as ORDINARY integers. Inverse maps have exactly the same support and modulus as the forward maps. Each row therefore returns the pair to its initial value. Applying the indicated row at every crossing keeps the complete physical state (5) fixed after EVERY complete R. It supplies a closed route for any braid width and any signed word, regardless of crossing order. Its original pivotal factor in (3) is nonzero and of modulus one, and its single cut factor is 1/N. This is an admitted expanded route of the complete original source, not an isolated entry without boundary gluing. ## 3. Exact energy and its uniform growth Every active transfer in the table sees a high input head 2r and a low input head r in the orientation of that C. Both triples in (4) are EXACTLY (r,r,r). Each zero transfer contributes the two triples (0,a,d-a) and (0,b,d-b), with w_d(0,a,d-a)=1/N. Thus its squared entry is exactly one. There are two active C maps per crossing, giving four regular cells. For a word with m crossings, the product of squared, quarter-gauged path entries is exactly E_route=N^(4m) w_d(r,r,r)^(4m)=N^(4m)/s_r^(12m). (6) All internal gauge factors telescope, since the route is closed. Equation (6) is therefore also its ungauged squared modulus; no endpoint gauge or source normalizer is missing. Including the literal cut coefficient changes (6) by N^(-2), and including chi_N multiplies it by |chi_N|^2. These known external factors remain explicit. Let Z_path be the positive sum of squared entries over all closed physical paths in the alphabet (2), with the original trace boundary conditions. Then Z_path>=N^(4m)w_d(r,r,r)^(4m). (7) With Lambda(theta)=-integral_0^theta log(2sin t)dt and v_3=3Lambda(pi/3), the uniform endpoint factorial estimate gives log s_r=-(N/pi)Lambda(pi*r/N)+O(log N), lim_(N=3r+1) (1/N)log E_route=4m v_3/pi. (8) This is an exact all-r family with a proved rate, not extrapolation from a few levels. Every cell has the correct affine sum d and every physical head-flow/source constraint is satisfied. For the original figure-eight word [1,-2,1,-2], m=4 and its geometric volume is 2v_3 (two regular ideal tetrahedra). The lower rate in (8) is 16v_3/pi, whereas a sharp angle ENERGY partition has rate 2v_3/pi. Hence neither a polynomial normalization nor bounded polynomial multiplicity can identify the complete phase-free Z_path with that sharp positive geometric fiber. In particular the actual shared-spin relations alone do not imply the required geometric edge equations. ## 4. What has to remain coherent The route is NOT claimed to survive summing its internal C channels. For example, for R_+ at input (r,2r), the diagonal physical entry is zero: the literal positive R requires output first head b+k with k>=0, so returning it to r is impossible. Its nonzero expanded routes cancel exactly. For R_- the analogous statement holds at (2r,r). This is a constructive reason to perform the available complete crossing contractions before assigning an angle partition, not a new obstruction to doing so. It also prevents misidentifying (6) with an already coherently summed, nonzero original clock sector. The exact positive cells and coherent Gram remain useful. What fails is the shortcut of imposing the original physical head/source support on their phase-free path expansion and inferring a sharp geometric edge fiber from that support alone. An additional source-preserving coherent regrouping, such as complete-channel recoupling with its full mixed Gram, is necessary. This theorem does not rule out that route or a different global inner product. [Focused audit](../experiments/audit_actual_closed_pascal_route_energy.py): original coproduct-derived C and inverse, full positive and negative R, both path orders, quarter metric and all regular/boundary cells, original pivotal trace conversion, and nonzero closed routes at arbitrary adjacent positions.

title: Actual Racah cluster projectors cannot share an orthogonal positive metric
text: # Actual Racah cluster projectors cannot share an orthogonal positive metric 29 October 2026. This is an exact obstruction to one proposed shortcut for higher generic normals. Even the COMPLETE analytic root clusters of the two physical Casimirs need not be orthogonal projections for any common positive Hermitian form. A seven-level source example has rank-two cluster projectors P,Q with trace(PQ)>33. The bound would be at most two for orthogonal projections in any positive metric. This does not refute the proved all-partner first-normal estimate, higher scalar bounds, or a suitably weighted nonorthogonal transport estimate. It rules out obtaining those conclusions by declaring the two actual cluster decompositions simultaneously orthogonal. ## 1. The second normal retains an actual cluster overlap Use the same generic source as the [all-partner first-normal theorem](actual_all_partner_first_normal_bound.md). For a pair of complementary internal channels write e*=N-1-e, f*=N-1-f, d_j=[2j+1], and K_ij=[N]^2 S(e_i,f_j)^2 product_faces Delta^2, e_0=e,e_1=e*, f_0=f,f_1=f*. The proved exact source-projector identity is sum_(i,j=0,1) d_(e_i)d_(f_j) K_ij =[N]^2 tr(E_e^S E_f^T), (1) where E_e^S and E_f^T are the ANALYTIC complete cluster projectors on the actual saturated invariant lattice. Each has rank two when its two channels are distinct. The trace in (1) is the ordinary local multiplicity-space trace from the source identity; the original marked exterior has not been replaced by a trace invariant. Let t=log(zeta/q), and let [t^r] denote Taylor COEFFICIENTS, rather than unnormalized derivatives. If d_(e_i)d_(f_j)=a_ij,0+a_ij,1 t+a_ij,2 t^2+..., K_ij=W_N^2+k_ij,1 t+k_ij,2 t^2+..., [N]=c_N t+O(t^2), then the second coefficient of (1) is EXACTLY sum_ij(a_ij,0 k_ij,2+a_ij,1 k_ij,1+a_ij,2 W_N^2) =c_N^2 tr(E_e^S(q) E_f^T(q)). (2) Consequently the homogeneous first-normal Ward equation cannot simply be imposed at second order. The additional overlap is a real physical source quantity, rather than a removable convention. ## 2. An exact seven-level example Take N=7, D=6, q=exp(pi i/7), a=b=c=d=2, e=f=2, e*=f*=4. The ordinary invariant channel range is 0,1,2,3,4, so the saturated invariant lattice has rank five. The root eigenvalue of channel 2 coincides precisely with that of channel 4. None of channels 0,1,3 shares it. Thus the complete selected cluster has rank two in EACH pairing. Its projector is analytic at q by the proved cluster theorem. Set r=q+q^-1=2cos(pi/7). In its real cyclotomic subfield, r^3-r^2-2r+1=0, W_7^2=(1+r)^2. (3) Literal expansion of the FOUR actual seven-factorial germs in (1) gives [t^0] sum_ij d_(e_i)d_(f_j) K_ij =0, [t^1] sum_ij d_(e_i)d_(f_j) K_ij =0, [t^2] sum_ij d_(e_i)d_(f_j) K_ij =3444-5180r-6440r^2. (4) The leading quantum-integer coefficient is equally explicit: c_7=-14/(q-q^-1), c_7^2=-28-28r-56r^2. (5) For an independent check of the division, ordinary polynomial reduction modulo the cubic in (3) gives (-28-28r-56r^2)(24r^2+20r-11) =3444-5180r-6440r^2. (6) Equations (1),(4)--(6) therefore prove the EXACT source identity tr(E_2^S(q) E_2^T(q))=24r^2+20r-11. (7) Since pi/7<pi/3, one has r>1. Hence (7) is strictly greater than 33, in particular strictly greater than two. No numerical rounding, large-level extrapolation, or conjectural asymptotic is used. The audit evaluates (4) directly in Q[q]/Phi_14(q), retaining the actual generic t-series. In this example every individual Racah range is tail-free, because the untouched opposite sum a+b+c+d=8<=12. This makes the finite coefficient certificate especially short; it does not substitute a semisimple root value for the source germ. The calculation uses three Taylor coefficients of the root-unit factorial products after canceling their actual common [7] zero. ## 3. Why this excludes every common orthogonal positive metric Suppose H were a positive definite Hermitian form making BOTH P=E_2^S(q) and Q=E_2^T(q) self-adjoint. They are idempotents, so in an H-orthonormal basis they would be ordinary orthogonal projections. For an orthonormal basis u_1,u_2 of the range of P, tr(PQ)=tr(PQP)=sum_(j=1)^2 <Q u_j,u_j>_H, 0<=<Q u_j,u_j>_H<=1. Thus tr(PQ)<=2. This contradicts (7). Trace is invariant under simultaneous change of basis, so allowing a different physical gauge or a nondiagonal positive form does not repair the contradiction. This excludes simultaneous positive self-adjointness of the ACTUAL complete cluster projectors, already at one finite level. It does not exclude a positive form in which those projectors are nonorthogonal, a metric adapted only to one pairing, a weighted source/dual energy bound, or a direct bound on the scalar generic germs. The exact generic bilinear source metric remains a separate, valid statement; a transpose identity must not be turned into a Hermitian orthogonality identity. ## 4. Consequence for the higher-normal proof path The first-normal bound uses exact positive generic presentations on face-supported branches and first-order Ward/Fourier relations. A higher-order extension must retain the overlap in (2), together with its derivatives at subsequent orders, or find a different exact positive presentation. The actual cluster projectors cannot be made jointly orthogonal to bypass these terms. This is an obstruction to that proposed METHOD, not a counterexample to the general volume limit or to polynomial higher-normal scalar bounds.
