The global primitive measure, even-level coset and carry phases, original marked-cap monomial and coefficient-extraction identity still require their own proof. Focused audit: [literal circle, coefficients and support](../experiments/audit_actual_complete_circle_positive_face_polynomial.py), with [saved results](../experiments/actual_complete_circle_positive_face_polynomial_results.json). At 85 digits it checks 94 literal LARGE-white/dual/cup circle identities and 22 retained N-lift characters, with maximum source error below 4.6e-83. Independent continuant expansions check 79 original D polynomials and their 823 strictly positive coefficients; 522 forced-product coefficients check the all-label sine-binomial formula. Exact finite-field checks retain 6910 forbidden physical-pair zeros, 28211 circle zeros for unequal totals congruent modulo N, 5274 supported unwrapped pairs and 150 original physical-cup modular support identities. Three symbolic calculations check the phase, outer degree and centered mark exponents. No numerical global source transformation is asserted by this audit. The local modular support uses the one forced factor that remains after the cup cancellation. The global face grid, marked coefficient and exponential rate are separate from this local source statement.

title: The complete positive circle quotient has ordinary channels and an exact source metric
text: # The complete positive circle quotient has ordinary channels and an exact source metric 29 October 2026. The positive reflected complete-color circle has an explicit ordinary-channel quotient, with a once-power affine-angle normalization. Its original ordinary and marked co-sources have exact polynomial dual costs. This gives a positive all-width Cauchy form with the original whole source, rather than an ordinary positive trace. The quotient does not erase the circle's nilpotent data: its inclusion and projection do NOT compose to the identity. Whole-block braiding is well typed on these channels, whereas a crossing that splits the pair need not descend. The remaining macroscopic reassociation estimate and the global geometric edge equations are not proved here. ## 1. The actual positive form and its star Use N>=2, d=N-1, q=exp(pi i/N), Q=q^2, rho=q-q^-1 and the original complete physical V=V_N with H weights d-2a. Let E denote Ecal, so E|a>=(Q^(-a)-1)|a-1>, F|a>=(1-Q^(a+1))|a+1>, K|a>=q^d Q^(-a)|a>. Missing endpoints are zero. In the original positive Euclidean metric, E=-F^dagger and K^dagger=K^-1. On V tensor V let E_t,F_t,K_t be the actual coproducts, Omega=F_tE_t+qK_t+q^-1K_t^-1, and P the LITERAL exchange of the two physical legs. The complete ordinary circle is L=(-1)^d U_d(Omega/2), with its full auxiliary pivot and Cartan. The [positive reflection theorem](actual_complete_circle_reflection_positive.md) proves C=P L>=0, H=L P=P C P>=0, rank C=floor((N+1)/2)^2, ker C=ker L. (1) No positive pivotal trace is asserted. The actual adjoint identities are E_t^dagger P=-P F_t, F_t^dagger P=-P E_t, E_t^dagger C=-C F_t, F_t^dagger C=-C E_t, K_t^dagger C K_t=C, Omega^dagger C=C Omega. (2) For the first line expand E_t=E_1K_2+E_2 and F_t=F_1+K_1^-1F_2, then exchange the legs. The next line uses that L is an actual Hopf intertwiner. Thus ker C is a Hopf submodule, and Q_C=(V tensor V)/ker L, <[v],[w]>_C=v^dagger Cw (3) is positive definite, with E^dagger=-F and unitary K. This is a single-object star statement. Taking a tensor coproduct still reverses order under adjoints; product metrics are not thereby a positive monoidal source theory. The actual reflection/leg wiring remains. ## 2. The quotient is a complete sum of odd ordinary modules Put M=floor(d/2) and c_j=q^(2j+1)+q^(-2j-1), 0<=j<=M. These nodes are distinct and real. The exact Hopf decomposition is Q_C = orthogonal direct sum_(j=0)^M V_(2j+1). (4) Here V_l means the genuine l-dimensional ordinary highest-weight module, not its semisimplification. At odd N the last summand is the Steinberg V_N; it is retained. To prove (4), first use the equivalent Hopf module im L. At a paired Casimir node c_j, L has one nonzero image vector in precisely the physical integer degrees T=d-j,d-j+1,...,d+j. This follows from the complete pair Jordan blocks: a derivative can survive exactly when both members j and d-j are present. At odd N the simple Steinberg node has the SAME range. A nonzero image vector in the first degree is killed by E_t, since the preceding image weight space is zero, and has highest H weight 2j. Its F_t descendants are nonzero through order 2j, because E_t F_t^r v=rho^2 [r]_q[2j-r+1]_q F_t^(r-1)v, and every displayed q-number is nonzero. They span V_(2j+1). The dimensions sum to floor((N+1)/2)^2, the full rank in (1), so no extension or remaining channel is missing. Distinct real Casimirs are orthogonal by (2). ## 3. A canonical basis has explicit affine-angle weights Let E_j(z) be the ordinary Lagrange VALUE polynomial on the distinct nodes c_0,...,c_M, and set T_j=d-j, w_j=E_j(Omega)|0,T_j>, w_(j,r)=F_t^r w_j/F_r, 0<=r<=2j, F_r=(Q;Q)_r, s_r=|F_r|. The classes [w_(j,r)] form an orthogonal basis of Q_C. Value interpolation suffices modulo ker L; no generalized direction is deleted before the complete circle is applied. Their EXACT norms are ||[w_(j,r)]||_C^2=g_j beta(2j,r), beta(n,r)=s_n/[s_r s_(n-r)], (5) where g_j=2N beta(2j,j), 2j<d, g_(d/2)=N, 2j=d (odd N). (6) Here is a normalization proof. In degree T_j the positive CD resolution of L P has its j-th weight 2s_(d-j)^2/s_(d-2j), with weight s_(d/2)^2=N at the odd simple node. The first component of the reflected normalized eigenvector has modulus one. Projecting |0,T_j> to the quotient's c_j-channel thus gives this norm. Reflection s_a s_(d-a)=N gives (6). Finally (2) gives the descendant norm product product_(h=1)^r[-rho^2[h]_q[2j-h+1]_q]. Dividing by s_r^2 reduces it exactly to beta(2j,r), proving (5). These are once-power angle factors. With w_d(a,b,c)=1/(s_a s_b s_c), a+b+c=d, beta(2j,r)=N w_d(r,2j-r,d-2j), g_j=2N^2 w_d(j,j,d-2j) for paired nodes. (7) The odd Steinberg node has half that paired prefactor. All zero indices, scalar factors and true integer charges remain. Equations (5)--(7) do not identify a geometric triangulation's edge rows. In an orthonormal quotient basis the ladder coefficients have modulus 2sqrt(sin(pi(r+1)/N)sin(pi(2j-r)/N)). Consequently ||F||_Q, ||E||_Q<=2, ||K||_Q=1. (8) ## 4. Circle sewing retains the normal source instead of semisimplifying Let pi:V tensor V->Q_C be the quotient map in the orthonormal basis (5), so pi^dagger pi=C. Define iota=P pi^dagger. Both pi and iota are actual Hopf maps, by (2), and L=iota pi, pi iota=0 on every paired-node V_(2j+1), pi iota=N I on the odd Steinberg V_N. (9) Indeed pi L=(pi iota)pi and the induced circle on Q_C is its Casimir value, zero on the paired nodes and N at the odd simple node. Thus two complete circles sew to ZERO at every even level; at odd levels they retain precisely the genuine Steinberg channel. This is the full interior face contraction, including the normal directions, not an orthogonal identity resolution. Treating iota pi as an ordinary semisimple summand projector would lose the original nilpotent source. For the original cup p and normalized Hermite t, pi p=0, pi t=sqrt(2N^3)e_(0,0), iota e_(0,0)=sqrt(2/N)p, L t=2N p. (10) Thus the nonzero normal source is explicit even though the incoming cup itself is null. No radical is silently deleted from a physical input before its actual circle insertion. ## 5. The complete original boundary has a positive Cauchy form The original ordinary cap and restricted marked cap satisfy ell=pi_(0,0)/sqrt(2N^3), m_d=ell P/N=(pi P)_(0,0)/sqrt(2N^5). (11) The marked cap therefore uses H, not C. Their exact dual costs are 1/(2N^3) and 1/(2N^5). These statements follow also from the canonical highest norm g_0=2N and ell w_0=1/N. They retain the original turns; in particular m does not descend to Q_C because m p=1. The associated twist isometry is correspondingly typed: C uses R, whereas H uses the leg-exchanged R#=P R P, so R#^dagger H R#=H. No unexchanged R^dagger H R=H is presumed. Actual diagram reflection or duality must supply that leg exchange before using this transport. For an original 2k-head plat let v=W p^tensor k, with every full signed crossing, and retain its external line chi_N. After the k-1 ordinary caps, the original integer-degree conservation forces the last marked pair to degree d. Only THEN replace its unrestricted row by m_d. Put G_top=C^tensor(k-1) tensor H, Lambda=ell^tensor(k-1) tensor m_d. Tensoring the genuine local positive inequalities proves Lambda^dagger Lambda <= 2^(-k)N^(-(3k+2)) G_top, |K_N|^2<=|chi_N|^2 2^(-k)N^(-(3k+2)) v^dagger G_top v. (12) The dual cost is exact on the supported quotient. Adding exp(-N^2)I makes this a full positive metric with no larger dual cost; the added energy is negligible for a fixed word by the original coarse physical norm bound. This metric uses fixed operator/source data, not K_N. Its SHARP GEOMETRIC ENERGY BOUND is not proved. The marked restriction in (12) cannot be used for arbitrary non-degree-preserving exteriors. ## 6. Which overlap maps are well typed The whole-block braid R12 R23 carries L12 to L23 by the actual coproduct/naturality identity. It therefore maps Q_C tensor V to V tensor Q_C, preserving j, and is the literal mixed universal braiding of V_(2j+1) with V_N. The unrolled highest weight is exactly 2j, so no new half-Cartan mark or scalar is introduced. On an ordinary channel l=2j+1 the finite universal R and its inverse obey, in these positive single-object metrics, ||R_(l,N)^plusminus||<=sum_(r=0)^(l-1) 4^r/s_r. (13) The Cartan and checked flip are unitary. Each nilpotent coefficient has modulus1/s_r in the actual Ecal,F conventions; (8) proves (13). For l<=N/2 this is at most l[eN/(l-1)]^(l-1), with value1 for l=1, since s_r>=(4/N)^r r!. Hence every SUBLINEAR ordinary channel l=o(N) has exp(o(N)) block-braiding cost. The macroscopic channels retain their genuine angle energy rather than a claimed polynomial cost. A crossing which SPLITS the paired block is different. The original p12 tensor V lies in ker L12, yet its R23 image has nonzero ordinary cap kappa x^(-d)I. The cap inequality then implies that this image is not in ker C12. Thus a single split-pair R23 cannot propagate the same quotient. Actual reassociation must retain its full coupled ordinary-channel map and source interfaces; the local kernel cannot be discarded. This is the same concrete overlap test as [the cap-Ward source lemma](actual_complete_source_multiplicity_module.md#4b-a-local-cap-ward-quotient-does-not-propagate-through-an-adjacent-crossing), now for a genuine positive circle quotient. The quotient's integer labels and (7) are constructive inputs to an angle comparison. They do not prove the global full-2N edge character 2d, a coherent norm bound for arbitrary split-pair faces, or the sharp whole-source knot-volume bound. Those remain the substantive gluing problem, rather than a consequence of positivity of C alone. ### The first genuine split-pair face has a specified complete source module For an actual pair of overlapping COMPLETE circles the internal map is T_face=(I_V tensor pi)(iota tensor I_V): Q_C tensor V -> V tensor Q_C. (14) This is a Hopf map with the physical legs in their displayed order. It follows by factoring L23 L12, so it is valid with every exterior and all normal/source data. It is not an asserted unitary associator. The complete V_N source multiplicities on each side have dimension M+1. In the balanced quotient basis of (5), their highest vectors are h_j=sum_(r=0)^j alpha_(j,r)[w_(j,r)] tensor |j-r>, alpha_(j,r)=Q^(jr) F_j F_(2j-r)/[F_(j-r)F_(2j)], and on the right their coefficients are x^(-r)alpha_(j,r), with physical |j-r> first. These are actual unrolled highest-weight d vectors. The coproduct E recurrence determines them; its j equations on j+1 coefficients have all necessary nonzero arrows, so there is exactly one such vector per j. F^N=0 supplies its unique V_N lift. Thus no incomplete Clebsch source space is substituted. Their positive squared norms are exactly sum_(r=0)^j |alpha_(j,r)|^2 g_j beta(2j,r). (15) Equation (14) therefore reduces on the COMPLETE source to an explicit (M+1)-square ordinary-channel Racah packet with these fixed metrics. It carries the nontrivial macroscopic face estimate still needed for global geometric gluing. In its trivial-to-trivial channel there is already an exact source-coherent contraction: T_face[0,0]=2N I_V, (16) because pi_0=sqrt(2N^3)ell, iota_0=sqrt(2/N)p and the original snake is (I tensor ell)(p tensor I)=I. Thus both the same-pair sewing (9) and the source channel of the first overlapping face are polynomially controlled, with their full original factors retained. No polynomial norm is claimed for the remaining macroscopic Racah entries, and (15) is not identified with the geometric edge partition. ## 7. Audit [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_complete_circle_positive_quotient.py) checks the actual image-module decomposition and all ladder endpoints, the positive quotient's orthogonal metric (5), the complete sewing operator (9), both original cap types and the full-source positive inequality (12). It uses the original finite generators and crossings; no unknown scalar period selects the basis or metric. The finite quotient checks do not establish a macroscopic split-pair estimate or a global energy bound.

title: The complete crossing circle is positive after the literal face reflection
text:
# The complete crossing circle is positive after the literal face reflection 29 October 2026. The original complete-color crossing-circle operator has a positive reflected tensor at every level and in every physical integer-degree block. Its original ordinary cap has an exact polynomial dual cost in this semidefinite form. Same-pair signed twists are exact isometries. None of these statements identifies an arbitrary augmented link contraction with a positive norm, or proves an open cusp-color geometric-survival corridor. ## 1. Actual operator, reflection, and complete channels Put (d=N-1), (q=e^{\pi i/N}), (Q=q^2), (x=q^d), and \[ s_a=|(Q;Q)_a|,\qquad s_0=1,\qquad 0\leq a\leq d. \] On the two original complete physical heads let \(\Omega\) be the coproduct Casimir, including the original Cartan normalization. The [literal mixed-circle calculation](actual_crossing_circle_source_and_filling.md) proved, with the actual auxiliary pivot and no new color average, \[ L_N=(-1)^d U_d(\Omega/2),\qquad \mathcal P_N(\Omega)=0,\qquad \mathcal P_N(z)=2T_N(z/2)+2. 	ag{1} \] Here the scalar polynomial \(U_d\) has \(U_0=1,U_1(z/2)=z\). Let \(P|a,bangle=|b,aangle\) be the LITERAL tensor flip. It is a face reflection, not an added crossing or a braid half-twist. For total degree \(0\leq T\leq d\), use \(|u,T-uangle\), \(0\leq u\leq T\). The original block \(J_T\) is complex symmetric, and direct conjugation of its displayed entries in the [complete channel theorem](actual_complete_casimir_hermite_packet.md) gives \[ P\overline{J_T}=J_TP. 	ag{2} \] Its nodes, with multiplicities retained, are \[ c_j=q^{2j+1}+q^{-2j-1},\quad 0\leq j\leq T, \qquad 
u_j=(-1)^j q^{j(j+1)}. \] Let \(v_j=f(c_j)\) be its canonical eigenvector with first component one, as defined by the original continuant recurrence. Its last component is \((v_j)_T=x^T
u_j\). Thus uniqueness of its eigenline, (2), and its first component give \[ P\overline{v_j}=\overline{(v_j)_T}\,v_j. 	ag{3} \] All formulas below use this specified physical normalization, not a rescaled abstract Jordan basis. ## 2. Positive rank-one resolution in EVERY physical block The exact theorem is \[  oxed{\quad H_N=L_NP\succeq0,\qquad C_N=PL_N=PH_NP\succeq0.\quad} 	ag{4} \] In a low block \(T\leq d\), its full nonzero rank-one resolution is \[ H_N ig|_T=\sum_{\substack{j<d-j\leq T}}  rac{2s_T^2}{s_{T-j}s_{T+j-d}}\,v_jv_j^* +\mathbf1_{N\ \mathrm{odd},\ d/2\leq T}  rac{s_T^2}{s_{T-d/2}^2}\,v_{d/2}v_{d/2}^*. 	ag{5} \] Every displayed coefficient is STRICTLY positive. Unpaired simple nodes are killed. For \(T>d\), set \(K=2d-T\); translation of the first physical index by \(T-d\) identifies the block with the low block \(K\), including its literal reversal \(P\). Thus (5) covers all \(N^2\) physical pair states. In particular \[ \operatorname{rank}H_N =\operatorname{rank}C_N=\lfloor(N+1)/2floor^2. 	ag{6} \] Proof, including the signs. At a double node \(c=c_j=c_{d-j}\), write \(Q_j(z)=\prod_{k\leq T,k
e j,d-j}(z-c_k)\) and \(B_T=(-1)^T s_T^2\). The exact bilinear CD measure is \[ \sigma_j=v_j^{\mathsf T}f'(c) =(v_j)_T Q_j(c)/B_T. \] Since \(L_N(c)=0\), its entire Jordan contribution, including its normal part, is \[ L_N ig|_{c}= rac{L_N'(c)}{\sigma_j}v_jv_j^{\mathsf T}, \qquad L_N'(c)=(-1)^d rac{2N}{4-c^2}. 	ag{7} \] Equation (3) converts the reflected contribution to \[ (L_NP) ig|_c = rac{L_N'(c)B_T}{Q_j(c)}v_jv_j^*. 	ag{8} \] There are exactly \(d-T\) unpaired nodes; all lie above every paired node on the real line. Other paired factors in \(Q_j(c)\) are squares, and a possible self-paired node \(-2\) lies below it. Consequently \(\operatorname{sign}Q_j(c)=(-1)^{d-T}\). Together with \(\operatorname{sign}B_T=(-1)^T\), this proves strict positivity in (8), including even levels. The exact magnitude from the sine-factorial CD formula is the first coefficient in (5). At odd \(N\), the self-paired simple node \(-2\) has \(L_N(-2)=N\). The same argument uses \(\mathcal P_T'(-2)\) in place of \(Q_j(c)\); its sign is \((-1)^{d-T}=(-1)^T\), since \(d\) is even. Its exact coefficient is the second in (5). At any other simple node \(L_N(c_j)=0\). This proves (4)--(5). Counting the paired nodes, with both physical high/low blocks, gives (6). At the selected total degree \(T=d\), (5) simplifies particularly: \[ H_N ig|_d=N\sum_{j\ \mathrm{distinct}}m_jv_jv_j^*, \qquad m_j=2\ \mathrm{at\ double\ nodes},\quad m_j=1\ \mathrm{at\ the\ odd\ simple\ node}. 	ag{9} \] ## 3. Exact ordinary-cap cost and same-pair isometries Keep the original cup \(p\), ordinary cap \(\ell\), and normalized Hermite normal \(t\) from the [source frame theorem](actual_tame_c0_hermite_source_frame.md). They satisfy, with their literal scalar normalizations, \[ \ell=p^*P/N^2,\quad \ell t=1,\quad L_Np=0, \quad L_Nt=2Np. \] Therefore \[ C_Nt=2N^3\ell^*,\qquad  oxed{\quad \ell C_N^+\ell^*= rac1{2N^3},\qquad \ell^*\ell\preceq rac{C_N}{2N^3}.\quad} 	ag{10} \] Here \(+\) is the positive Moore--Penrose inverse. The first display explicitly puts \(\ell^*\) in the range of \(C_N\); any inverse solution differs from \(t/(2N^3)\) by its kernel, which \(\ell\) annihilates. Positive Cauchy then proves the second formula. This is an ALL-INPUT inequality on the physical pair, extending by zero outside degree \(d\) on its left and by the positive blocks on its right. No inverse of \(L_N\) is used. Tensoring (10), and tensoring with arbitrary spectator identities, gives for every physical \(2r+1\)-head vector \(\psi\) \[ |(\ell^{\otimes r}\otimes\langle d|)\psi|^2 \leq(2N^3)^{-r}\, \langle\psi,(C_N^{\otimes r}\otimes|dangle\langle d|) \psiangle. 	ag{11} \] It applies to the original marked scalar when the already proved whole-intertwiner theorem converts that scalar to this specified ordinary-cap matrix element. Arbitrary inserted marked exteriors retain their actual marked row. In particular \(p\) lies in the radical of \(C_N\), while the marked row has \(mp=1\); the marked row is NOT bounded in this seminorm by an illicit local replacement. The literal original same-pair crossing \(R\) satisfies \(R^*PR=P\) and commutes with \(L_N\). This holds on every physical block: (2) gives \(\Omega^*P=P\Omega\), and the actual polynomial \(r_N\) has unit values and purely imaginary logarithmic derivatives at the real double nodes. Thus \(\overline{r_N}r_N-1\) vanishes with the full multiplicity of \(\mathcal P_N\). Its functional calculus proves the assertion, with the original unit Cartan factor retained. Hence \[ (R^a)^* C_N R^a=C_N,\qquad a\in\mathbb Z. 	ag{12} \] Thus every signed same-pair twist is an exact isometry on this positive quotient. No invariance under an overlapping pair crossing is asserted. There is also a quantitative ordinary-color transmission bound on this SAME inserted-circle quotient. Since \(\Omega^*C_N=C_N\Omega\), its induced operator on \((V_d\otimes V_d)/\ker C_N\) is selfadjoint. At a double node its nilpotent value vector is in the radical, so the quotient has one ordinary eigenline; at the odd simple node it has the ordinary line. Every quotient eigenvalue is therefore one of the real \(c_j\). For \(c=2\cos	heta\), \(|U_{j-1}(c/2)|\leq j\), hence \[ L_j^*C_NL_j\preceq j^2C_N,\qquad 1\leq j\leq N. 	ag{12a} \] If \(\gcd(j,N)=1\), its retained nodal values are all nonzero and have modulus at least \(\sin(\pi/N)\geq2/N\). The possible odd simple node is interpreted by its removable value \(L_j(-2)=j\). Thus the inverse on this quotient has norm at most \(N/2\), and \[  rac4{N^2}C_N\preceq L_j^*C_NL_j\preceq j^2C_N \quad (\gcd(j,N)=1). 	ag{12b} \] These operator inequalities tensor with arbitrary spectators. They bound a transmission inserted on an existing complete-circle form; they do NOT express replacement of its defining \(L_N\) insertion by \(L_j\). That distinction is essential at the original cup below. ## 4. A once-power positive angle coefficient and a nonzero local channel For a paired node put \[ A=T-j,\quad B=T+j-d,\quad D=d-T. \] These are nonnegative ACTUAL integer indices with \(A+B+2D=d\). The coefficient in (5) is exactly \[ h_{T,j}= rac{2N^2}{s_As_Bs_D^2}. 	ag{13} \] The odd simple coefficient has the same formula without the factor 2 and with \(A=B\). This uses \(s_Ts_{d-T}=N\); it is a positive once-power four-angle factorial weight. It is not asserted to give the full edge incidence of an augmented-link triangulation. One original physical corner can be calculated without a Clebsch envelope, since every \((v_j)_0=1\): \[ (H_N|_T)_{0,0} =s_T^2\sum_{a=0}^{2T-d} rac1{s_as_{2T-d-a}}, \quad 2T\geq d, 	ag{14} \] and it is zero for \(2T<d\). The full sum over both members of a double pair supplies its factor2; the odd simple midpoint is counted once. Consequently the corner is strictly nonzero on every admitted physical block. The uniform all-index factorial estimate and midpoint maximization give, with \(	au=T/N\), \[ \log (H_N|_T)_{0,0} = rac N\pi\left[-2\Lambda(\pi	au) +2\Lambda igl(\pi(	au-	frac12) igr)ight] +O(\log N),\qquad 2T\geq d. 	ag{15} \] The formula is uniform through the endpoints, with the continuous odd extension of \(\Lambda\) if \(	au=1/2-1/(2N)\). To verify midpoint maximization, at fixed sum \(s\leq1\) the function \(\Lambda(\pi a)+\Lambda(\pi(s-a))\) increases up to \(s/2\) and decreases after it: its derivative has the sign of \(\sin(\pi(s-a))-\sin(\pi a)\). Selecting a nearest integer midpoint gives the lower bound; summing at most \(N\) terms gives the upper bound. Integer shifts by \(d=N-1\) cost only \(O(\log N)\). The bracket in (15) has its unique maximum at \(	au=3/4\), equal to \(4\Lambda(\pi/4)=v_8/2\). Thus \[ \log\max_T (H_N|_T)_{0,0} =Nv_8/(2\pi)+O(\log N). 	ag{16} \] This is a quantitative, positive, nonzero original local circle channel at all levels. It is not a nonzero geometric coefficient of an arbitrary assembled augmented-link source. ## 5. The open color corridor still requires an actual source argument The positivity is special to the COMPLETE circle. For any \(1\leq j<N\), the reflected ordinary circle \(PL_j\) is Hermitian but INDEFINITE already on the original source plane. Indeed \[ L_jp=\lambda_jp,\qquad \lambda_j=(-1)^{j-1} rac{\sin(\pi j/N)}{\sin(\pi/N)}
e0. \] In the basis \(p,t\), its Hermitian quadratic form has top-left entry zero and off-diagonal entry \(N^2\lambda_j
e0\), so its two-by-two determinant is negative. Thus a nonzero geometric coefficient on an OPEN cusp-color corridor cannot be inferred by continuing local positive-semidefiniteness. It may instead follow from a source-preserving contour and analytic continuation, but that requires its own original-cycle and Stokes/boundary estimates. Likewise local positivity does not identify a whole planar augmented network with a squared norm: all reflected leg identifications, ordinary pivots, the sole modified cut and any extra complete components have to match in the global tensor contraction. [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_complete_circle_reflection_positive.py) checks every physical block, the exact CD positive resolution, original cup/ordinary/marked typing, same-pair actual signed twists, and the positive corner/profile, with separate literal mixed-circle checks. The finite audit checks six literal mixed universal/pivotal circles at \(N=2,\ldots,7\); eleven complete physical PSD/CD/source/twist families at \(N=2,\ldots,12\), including every high-degree mirror; four uniform positive-corner profiles through \(N=128\).

title: A fixed complex external-color packet for the original complete core
text: # A fixed complex external-color packet for the original complete core 30 October 2026. This note assembles the exponentially accurate local interpolation into the actual shared-face period. The theorem applies to each fixed certified augmented plat at arbitrary fixed bridge width. Its object is the exact complete-image term in color reflection. The other reflected terms remain part of the long-filling problem. Subsequent geometric identification: the [marked deformation theorem](actual_complete_core_geometric_deformation.md) resolves the boundary reconstruction dependency stated below, retaining the primitive collar and the complex regulator boundary correction. It does not remove the ordinary-color subsets from the full source. ## 1. The finite object and theorem Fix a connected labeled convex ideal right-angled augmented source D covered by the [signed complete-source theorem](general_signed_augmented_source_volume.md). Retain its actual two marked faces, exterior normalization, and a vector of half twists epsilon_i in {0,1,-1}. Let R be its number of crossing circles and n=R-1 the dimension of the finite-face logarithmic torus after fixing scale. All constants below may depend on this fixed labeled diagram. Its bridge number and matching graph are otherwise unrestricted within that geometric certificate. Set d=N-1, M=floor(d/2), s0=d-2M, and delta_min=s0/(2N). The [exact color reflection](actual_external_circle_reflection_and_cusp.md) specifies the complete-image core F_N(h), before any asymptotics, by multiplying each complete channel a_i by cos(pi h_i(d-2a_i)/N). In particular F_N(0) is the original signed complete augmented source. Cosine makes F_N(h) an entire function of its external variables h. No interpolation of an unspecified sequence is being chosen here. The following holds on a fixed complex polydisc |chi_i|<rho, where chi=h/N. There are holomorphic critical actions S_N(chi), and nonsingular symmetric Hessians K_N(chi) of dimension m=2R-1, such that F_N(N chi)/F_N(0) = exp[N(S_N(chi)-S_N(0))] sqrt[det K_N(0)/det K_N(chi)] [1+O(N^-1)]. (1) The error is uniform on a smaller closed polydisc. The square root is the holomorphic branch equal to1 at chi=0. Thus the actual core is nonzero throughout that closed polydisc for all sufficiently large N. Both parities and composite quantum levels are included. The functions S_N converge holomorphically to S, and S(0)=Vol(Y_D^epsilon)/(2pi)=Vol(Q_D)/pi, lim (2pi/N) log|F_N(N chi)|=2pi Re S(chi). (2) The second equality is a locally uniform limit. The factor (1) retains S_N in its exponential: holomorphic convergence S_N -> S alone does not permit replacing exp(N S_N) by exp(N S). Only the COMPLETE VALUE of S in (2) is identified here with the actual hyperbolic volume. Identifying its whole germ with the marked geometric regulator requires the boundary reconstruction described in section7. The theorem also does not estimate the nonempty ordinary-color subsets in the original reflection identity. ## 2. Exact reflected period and analytic local factors Write B_(N,a)(x,b,c,y) = beta_a^2 D_a(x,b,y)D_a(x,c,y)P_(d-2a)(x,y). The [exact polynomial reflection](actual_positive_face_fixed_fold_packet.md) extends this original polynomial from 0<=a<=M to 0<=a<=d by B_(N,d-a)=B_(N,a); the half-twist eigenvalue obeys the same reflection. Consequently the original multiplicities k_a and cosine weights unfold to one full finite sum, with no omitted endpoint: F_N(N chi)=chi_(D,N) N^R product_i omega_M^epsilon_i *(2pi)^(-n) integral_(face torus) sum_(delta in Lambda_N^R) product_i B_(N,a_i)(r exp(i theta)) /product_(finite faces) (r_f exp(i theta_f))^d *exp[pi i N sum_i epsilon_i(delta_i^2-delta_min^2) +2pi i N sum_i chi_i delta_i] dtheta. (3) Here delta_i=(d-2a_i)/(2N), a_i=0,...,d. Lambda_N is the physical integer or half-integer lattice of mesh 1/N in the finite interval [-d/(2N),d/(2N)]. At fixed scale one theta coordinate is zero. The two marked face variables remain zero. Equation(3) is the literal marked coefficient measure, including its N^R factor and framing unit. Use r=r_N, the positive critical radius of the all-M coefficient. The [coefficient theorem](actual_positive_face_coefficient_saddle.md) gives r_N -> r_geom, transverse Hessian cN<=H_face,N<=CN, and fixed logarithmic derivatives O(N) on a common face neighborhood. Positive-matrix preconditioning makes the determinant factors nonzero on a fixed complex neighborhood, including the actual zero patterns. The [exponential interpolation theorem](actual_positive_face_exponential_fold_interpolation.md) supplies even holomorphic functions Phi_i,N(delta;w)=-H_i,N(delta;r_N exp w)/N on fixed complex delta and face neighborhoods, with Phi_i,N(0;w)=0, B_(N,a)(r_N exp w)/B_(N,M)(r_N exp w) = exp[-N(Phi_i,N(delta;w)-Phi_i,N(delta_min;w))] [1+O(exp(-cN))]. (4) This comparison holds on the actual REAL channel grid and for COMPLEX face variables w. Uniform holomorphic derivatives and comparison with V_i(delta;r_N exp w) hold on smaller neighborhoods; these functions converge to V_i(delta;r_geom exp w). In particular, at the finite radii, partial_delta^2 V_i(0;r_N exp w)=2C_i(r_N exp w), C_i=pi(sqrt(b_i(x_i+y_i)+x_i y_i) +sqrt(c_i(x_i+y_i)+x_i y_i))/(x_i+y_i)>0 at positive real radii. The comparison error in (4) is exponential, which is essential when the Fourier transform itself has an exponential decay. A relative O(N^-1) grid estimate would not suffice. ## 3. Excluding the original complement Choose small fixed cutoffs delta0,theta0 inside the neighborhoods of (4). If some |delta_i|>delta0, the original all-channel shared-radius bound gives an exp(-cN) gap relative to the complete scale. This is the bound proved from the literal determinant and forced polynomial in the [channel-rate theorem](actual_positive_face_channel_rate.md), together with the strict maximum at the fold. The external weight in (3) costs at most exp(pi N sum_i |Im chi_i|). A sufficiently small fixed chi polydisc preserves the gap. There are only polynomially many channels. For all |delta_i|<=delta0 but |theta|>theta0, apply the exact positive matrix contraction to every original determinant. Its pair-trace lower bounds cN are uniform for a/N in [1/2-delta0,1/2]. Indeed the bulk Cholesky-square bounds in the coefficient theorem use a fixed compact index interval strictly below N/2; choose delta0 so that every matrix under consideration contains that same macroscopic interval. The one-variable boundary factors need no pair trace. The remaining actual pair graph is connected and primitive, exactly as in that theorem. Thus, uniformly over these channels, |product_i B_(N,a_i)(r_N exp(i theta))| <= product_i B_(N,a_i)(r_N) *exp[-cN dist(theta,0)^2]. (5) Each forced polynomial has nonnegative coefficients and cannot increase the torus modulus. This is a global angular estimate on the actual physical summands, not on their local interpolants. Shrinking chi again preserves its fixed gap outside theta0. Both discarded parts of (3) are therefore bounded by a polynomial times exp[N(f_N-c)], where f_N=N^-1 log[product_i B_(N,M)(r_N)/product_f r_N,f^d]. Any polynomial factor is absorbed by reducing c for large N. ## 4. The selected joint critical point On the retained face box put w=i theta and define the marked logarithms psi_N(w)=N^-1 log[product_i B_(N,M)(r_N exp w)] -(d/N) sum_f log(r_N,f exp w_f), Psi_N(theta,delta;chi)=psi_N(i theta) -sum_i[Phi_i,N(delta_i;i theta)-Phi_i,N(delta_min;i theta)] +pi i sum_i epsilon_i(delta_i^2-delta_min^2) +2pi i sum_i chi_i delta_i. (6) All logs continue the original positive factors. The even-level anchor delta_min is retained. The framing and omega_M factors stay outside this phase. At chi=0, evenness makes every delta derivative vanish exactly at delta=0. Also d_theta psi_N(0)=0, and the anchor contributes only O(N^-2), with the same bound for fixed derivatives. The joint critical point therefore lies O(N^-2) from (theta,delta)=(0,0). The negative Hessian there has the blocks N^-1 H_face,N + O(N^-2), diag_i[2(C_i(r_N)-pi i epsilon_i)]+o(1). (7) Mixed theta/delta blocks vanish exactly at delta=0. The real quadratic part on real integration directions is uniformly positive. All fixed holomorphic derivatives of Psi_N are bounded independently of N. The analytic inverse-function argument now gives a unique nearby joint critical point z_N(chi) on a fixed small complex polydisc. One direct uniform construction is Newton iteration after multiplying by the inverse Hessian at chi=0: its norm is bounded, and the bounded third derivatives give a common contraction ball. Define S_N(chi)=Psi_N(z_N(chi);chi), K_N(chi)=-d_z^2 Psi_N(z_N(chi);chi). (8) The Hessian stays nonsingular and its real quadratic part stays positive along the translated real contour. S_N(chi)-f_N is uniformly small when chi is small. The neighborhood can therefore be chosen so that the preceding fixed complement gaps remain gaps relative to the selected critical value, not just relative to f_N. ## 5. Finite lattice to contour integral, with exponential errors Use (4) only on the retained physical grid. Its accumulated error in (3) is at most exp[N(f_N-c)] on a smaller fixed chi polydisc: the finite count is polynomial, the model is bounded by the original real scale up to the small complex Fourier cost, and (4) has a fixed exponential rate. For one channel write its lattice as z=alpha_N+j/N. Enclose its retained nodes in a rectangle whose vertical sides are halfway between the last retained node and the first deleted node, and whose horizontal sides have heights +/-eta. For a holomorphic f the exact residue identity is (1/N) sum_(retained nodes) f(z) =(1/(2i)) integral_(rectangle) cot(pi N(z-alpha_N)) f(z) dz. (9) On the upper and lower sides cot approaches -i and +i respectively, with errors O(exp(-2pi eta N)). On the vertical sides it is bounded because their real coordinates are lattice midpoints. The constant upper/lower terms deform to the real interval integral. The vertical closing segments are exponentially small by the original quadratic channel gap and its analytic continuation. Here are the estimates needed for that last assertion and for the horizontal errors. On the small box, the real Hessian bound from (7) and the bounded derivatives imply, for real theta and real channel coordinates x with imaginary shifts y, Re Psi_N(theta,x+i y;chi) <= f_N+C/N^2-c(|theta|^2+|x|^2) +C|y||x|+C|y|^2+C|chi|(|x|+|y|). After completing squares this is at most f_N+C/N^2+C'(|y|^2+|chi|^2). At a vertical edge |x_i| near delta0, retain half its negative quadratic term before completing squares. Choose eta sufficiently small compared with delta0. Then choose chi small compared with eta and delta0, so both the vertical edge loss and the horizontal cotangent loss 2pi eta dominate the possible phase growth. This estimate includes the cross term from the half-twist quadratic; a pointwise claim of only O(eta^2) growth would omit it. Apply (9) successively in all R channel variables. For the resulting mixed contours, |y|^2<=R eta^2. R is fixed, so reserve constants such that C'R eta^2<pi eta, then shrink chi. Every term containing at least one horizontal cotangent error or vertical segment retains a fixed exponential loss. Thus, uniformly on the local real theta box, sum_(local grid) exp(N Psi_N) =N^R integral_(local real delta box) exp(N Psi_N) ddelta +O(exp[N(f_N-c)]). (10) Changing N parity changes alpha_N only. There is no periodic extension past the original physical endpoints and no removal of a source factor. ## 6. Uniform saddle formula and limiting action The retained integral now has m=n+R=2R-1 real variables. Move the local box through z_N(chi) inside its holomorphic neighborhood. Its side faces keep the same fixed gap after decreasing rho. On the translated real box the quadratic part has positive real part. Expand at z_N(chi), scale by N^-1/2, and extend the Gaussian integral with an exponentially small error. The odd cubic term integrates to zero; bounded fourth and higher derivatives give relative O(N^-1). This proves F_N(N chi)=chi_(D,N) N^(2R) product_i omega_M^epsilon_i *(2pi)^(-n)(2pi/N)^(m/2) *exp[N S_N(chi)]/sqrt(det K_N(chi)) [1+O(N^-1)]. (11) The Gaussian square root is selected by the real positive quadratic part and continued from chi=0. It cannot vanish on the chosen polydisc. All omitted terms remain exponentially small relative to (11), because |Re(S_N(chi)-f_N)| was reserved below their gaps. Taking the ratio at zero gives (1) with every original normalization factor canceled literally. Uniformity and nonvanishing also permit differentiation of its holomorphic relative error on smaller polydiscs. For completeness, psi_N converges holomorphically on a smaller face neighborhood. Its real-radius limit is the original determinant and sine-product rate. Uniform bounds for its marked logarithm follow from positive-summand preconditioning and that rate. Cauchy estimates make the family locally compact; any subsequential holomorphic limit has the prescribed values on the real open cube, hence is unique by successive one-variable identity theorems. This proves convergence without exchanging an uncontrolled large determinant with a derivative. The same conclusion for Phi_i,N follows directly from its construction. The uniform critical-point contraction then gives S_N -> S and K_N -> K holomorphically. At chi=0, the actual facet-coning calculation in the coefficient theorem fixes the additive constant f_N -> Vol(Y_D^epsilon)/(2pi). The anchor and critical displacement tend to zero. Equation(11) has only polynomial outside factors and framing of unit modulus. These facts prove (2), including the actual complete hyperbolic volume. ## 7. What this proves on the general long-twist path The theorem supplies a fixed complex external-color neighborhood for the original complete core; the earlier h=O(sqrt N) packet did not supply this. It proves a selected nonzero analytic period, with its complete action fixed by actual geometry, for every fixed diagram in the stated certificate class. The [coupled polynomial system](actual_whole_source_coupled_face_difference_system.md) also identifies the ordered local momenta on regular character charts, including the face momenta and peripheral equation. At the two marked zero faces those charts can degenerate. For example x>0,b=y=0 gives E=x and D=x^2 for all channel deformation: the quadratic root is double and no longer records the chosen flag. A separate developing map or finite common-conjugated boundary limit is still needed to identify the whole S germ with the actual marked geometric regulator. The complete volume and cusp-Hessian matches alone do not prove that. The full color reflection has additional terms with one or more ordinary colors. The core also has an opposite-end alias that cancels only after those terms are restored. Consequently (1) cannot be substituted for a whole-source filling estimate. General proper-subset and combined far-alias bounds remain required for all independently long fixed twists. The twist threshold in that target depends on the fixed diagram; the twist numbers are fixed before N tends to infinity. ## Verification scope The argument uses the coefficient, signed-source, exact-reflection and exponential-interpolation theorems, with the original normalization and both parity anchors. The [focused audit](../experiments/audit_actual_complete_core_complex_packet.py) and [saved results](../experiments/actual_complete_core_complex_packet_results.json) check 10 literal original W/pi sources with off-grid external clocks, 24 shared K4 complex cores and exact face coefficients, 768 retained reflection entries, 20 cotangent basis identities and two full two-register contour identities, and 36 original fixed-window matrix gap samples. Finite complex values and nonzero samples are diagnostics. The written proof supplies the uniform estimates; these checks do not settle the remaining marked-geometric or mixed-source steps.

title: The complete Fourier core and the actual marked geometric deformation
status: Selected core action on the actual marked geometric germ
text: # The complete Fourier core and the actual marked geometric deformation 30 October 2026. The exact complete-image Fourier core has the volume rate of the actual nearby marked geometric representation when its small external deficits are real. For complex deficits the explicit peripheral boundary correction is retained. The proof uses the established complex-core packet, common marked circle reconstruction and literal primitive-collar theorem. This note does not estimate the ordinary-color subset terms of the full mixed source or prove the long-filled knot limit. ## 1. The selected source critical point and its local peripheral data Fix any connected original certified augmented plat, with its actual main mark, all matching circles and retained half twists epsilon_i. No one-main-component restriction is imposed. Use the exact entire complete-image core and its [complex packet](actual_complete_core_complex_packet.md). Let chi_i=h_i/N denote its external deficit coordinates, and let S(chi) be the limiting selected critical action, with the explicit chi-independent exterior and maximal-channel phases still outside this normalized action. Set delta_i=1/2-mu_i for its internal channel coordinates. Its phase is sum_i[Q_bi(delta_i)+Q_ci(delta_i)] -sum_(finite faces) log l_f +pi i sum_i epsilon_i delta_i^2 +2pi i sum_i chi_i delta_i. (1) All Q terms retain their actual sine and forced-factor normalization. The [marked circle reconstruction](actual_marked_deformed_circle_pattern.md) proves that its face-stationary radii are the curvatures of one common analytic line-circle pattern, with the original two marked lines and all actual triangle incidences. Thus this is not a collection of independently framed local solutions. For each circle use its actual ordered input/output pairs and product P_i. The selected disk eigenvalue is J_i=-exp(-2pi i delta_i). (2) It is exactly the continuation of the actual internal node and selected line supplied by the marked-pattern theorem, including the two-line triangles. Let C_i transport the incoming pair to the outgoing pair, with C_i A_in C_i^-1=A_out and [C_i,P_i]=0. Normalize its eigenvalue on the J_i^-1 line to one, and denote its eigenratio by R0_i. The [primitive-collar theorem](actual_deformed_circle_primitive_collar.md) proves the ACTUAL primitive, corner-preserving identity R0_i=E_bi E_ci/D_i, Log R0_i(0)=0, (3) with the source-selected roots and the literal line-face limit. A doubled reflection between the two middle faces or the reciprocal flag is not a substitute for (3). The theorem identifies this C_i with the recorded even collar, including its common marked-line limit. Since partial_delta(Q_b+Q_c)=-Log(E_b E_c/D), channel stationarity of (1) is precisely Log R0_i-2pi i epsilon_i delta_i=2pi i chi_i. (4) With m_i=exp(-pi i chi_i), this says m_i^2 R0_i(-J_i)^epsilon_i=1. Every logarithm is its germ at the complete point, with the existing primitive marking; no integer shear or new linear action character is chosen. ## 2. All actual group relations, not only the local eigenvalues For the global assembly, for each actual white face f use its reflection R_f in the common circle pattern. For complex parameters this means the holomorphic complexification of the two reflection matrices R_f^+,R_f^-, with R_f^-R_f^+=I. It agrees with ordinary reflection at real parameters; one does not conjugate the complex deformation variables. At every original Morse slice let F_0,...,F_(2k) be its ACTUAL region sequence. Define the original prefix and raw physical heads by Q_j=R_(F_j)^+ R_(F_0)^-, H_j=R_(F_j)^+ R_(F_(j-1))^-. (5) These telescope: H_j...H_1=Q_j. Every main incidence remains tangent, so H_j has determinant one and trace -2; the physical main meridian is its recorded trace +2 lift. The same region labels on an unchanged physical wire give the same based head at its two ends. At an actual cup or cap the first and last regions agree, so the ordered pair product is I. This is the inverse-pair relation of the literal ordinary and marked closures, without replacing the unrestricted quantum mark. The two closure phases can differ by their retained integer character; that character has not been deleted from the action. Across a box the outer regions agree on its two sides. Thus the input and output products are the same P_i. The collar C_i in (3) gives their actual simultaneous conjugacy. For a retained half twist put h_J=J_i^-1-1, a unit near completeness. The original physical auxiliary meridian is the regular matrix M_i=m_i R0_i h_J^(-epsilon_i) C_i^-1(P_i^-1-I)^epsilon_i. (6) This is exactly the original collar/Hurwitz expression from [the literal Morse presentation](actual_augmented_plat_critical_scheme.md), section 4. Its selected J_i-line eigenvalue is m_i, while det M_i=m_i^2 R0_i(-J_i)^epsilon_i=1. It commutes with P_i. Its inverse followed by the recorded Hurwitz half twist induces C_i on the main pair. At the complete point it is the original primitive crossing-circle meridian, with its recorded SL lift; it is not a separately chosen centralizer eigenvalue. The relations just verified are ALL the original Morse/van Kampen relations: shared physical wires, inverse-pair cups/caps, the drilled box threading word [2,1,1,2], and the retained signed Hurwitz move. Their presentation was proved in section 5 of the same critical-scheme note from the actual diagram. It applies at arbitrary fixed width and with every actual matching-graph cycle. Thus (5),(6) construct a representation of the ACTUAL augmented link group, with every main meridian parabolic and all auxiliary meridians prescribed by m_i. No additional global cycle or generic frame is needed for this group identity. A regular common conjugate may be used to compare with the old critical chart, but no independently chosen local conjugates are introduced. At chi=0 this is the complete geometric representation by the original certificate and primitive collar calibration. The complete geometric representation is irreducible. The already proved positive marked gluing rigidity says that its nearby decorated representation germ, modulo one common conjugation, is uniquely parameterized by the actual cusp meridian logs. Fixing every main cusp log to zero leaves precisely the auxiliary coordinates in (4). Hence the constructed family is the selected marked geometric deformation, not another character component. ## 3. The exact peripheral action differential The primitive projective logs, centered at completeness, are U_i=2Log m_i=-2pi i chi_i, V_i=2Log(-J_i)=-4pi i delta_i. (7) Here P_i is the original ordered disk longitude, with the preferred peripheral convention already proved for the threading word. A half-longitude or an independently inverted flag would change (7) and is not permitted. The actual half-twist shear has already entered (4),(6). Envelope differentiation of the selected critical value in (1) gives partial_i S=2pi i delta_i, d(2pi i S)=(1/2)sum_i V_i dU_i. (8) There is no new order-N exterior color character in the original core: the exact color dependence is its prescribed finite cosine transform. The retained exterior framing unit and maximal-channel half-twist phases are chi-independent and stay in the analytic packet. Their constant phase must not be mistaken for a change of (8). At completeness the actual positive face coefficient and facet coning already prove 2pi Re S(0)=Vol(Y_D). The old correctly marked geometric action has the same differential (8) and the same absolute regulator anchor. Their holomorphic difference is therefore a chi-independent constant whose real part is zero. This fixes the exponential rate without assigning an unproved Chern-- Simons constant. All actual constant source phases remain explicit. For genuinely complex meridian logs, the boundary correction is retained. The [marked regulator identity](complex_peripheral_action_and_conversion_bound.md) with U=2Log M,V=2Log ell gives 2pi Re S(chi)=Vol(rho_chi) +(1/2)sum_i Re U_i Im V_i. (9) Main-cusp terms vanish because their U logs are identically zero. Equation (9) uses the continuously selected longitude arguments and the complete anchor; it does not say that the bare real action equals the incomplete representation volume at arbitrary complex chi. ## 4. An exact finite-polynomial volume limit Equations (1)--(9) identify the action of the ACTUAL fixed-complex-neighborhood core packet with the actual marked geometric deformation. The finite face torus and finite channel residue rectangle already specify that core period and its nonzero amplitude. No unknown geometric intersection coefficient remains for this complete-image term. In particular, for each fixed labeled certified diagram and retained half-twist vector there is a rho>0 such that, locally uniformly for REAL |chi_i|<rho, lim_(N->infinity) (2pi/N)log|F_N(N chi)| =Vol(rho_chi). (10) Here F_N is the EXACT finite cosine polynomial of the original complete-image source, not an interpolation chosen from its values. The limit includes both parities and all sufficiently large quantum levels. The right side is the volume of the selected actual geometric representation of the original marked exterior. No cone-manifold completion is asserted. Indeed U_i=-2pi i chi_i is purely imaginary on this real slice, so the correction in (9) vanishes. On the fixed complex polydisc the same limit is the right side of (9), including its correction. This follows directly from the locally uniform rate of the complex-core theorem; its nonzero relative packet supplies the needed absence of nearby zeros. ## 5. The selected algebraic peripheral germ There is also a finite algebraic description of the representation germ, distinct from its analytic action. Normalize the actual marked strip by H=1 and the fixed finite center by X_ref=0. For each finite circle retain its coordinates (X_f,Y_f,r_f). The marked reconstruction equations are polynomial in these variables and in I_i=-(J_i+J_i^-1)/2. (11) For example, a finite/finite edge has equation (X_f-X_g)^2+(Y_f-Y_g)^2-r_f^2-r_g^2-2I_e r_f r_g=0; the line equations are Y_f-r_f I_e=0 or 1-Y_f-r_f I_e=0. Main edges have I_e=1. These are equations over the rational Laurent field Q(J_1,...,J_R), with 3R-1 normalized circle variables and 3R-1 equations. The proved circle-variable Jacobian is invertible at the actual complete point. Hence its selected local algebraic component is smooth of dimension R, projects analytically locally isomorphically to the J coordinates, and is dominant and generically finite over them. Equivalently its function field is a finite extension of Q(J_1,...,J_R). This assertion is about the selected component; it does not assert that every fiber of the global polynomial system is finite. The source-selected E roots are algebraic as well. With x,y,b the actual curvatures, write z=sin^2(pi delta)=(2+J+J^-1)/4. Then E_b^2-2(x+y+2bz)E_b+[(x+y)^2-4xy z]=0. (12) Adjoin the selected square roots on their recorded germ and the roots M_i^2=[R0_i(-J_i)^epsilon_i]^-1, M_i(0)=1. (13) The nonvanishing denominators are localized at the units already proved for the actual collar. The displayed expression for C also contains the physical divisor J-J^-1, which is NOT inverted here: its divided difference is the regular germ proved by the literal three-point collar map. In particular R0-1 vanishes when J=-1 with the other parameters free, and the selected quotient extends through that divisor. Thus (5),(6) give an algebraic family of actual marked representations on a finite algebraic extension of the selected circle component. Its peripheral image is the selected algebraic germ with all main meridians M=1. The internal parameters are auxiliary longitude coordinates; they are not external finite channel labels. At completeness the eliminated circle solution is even in each delta, and the actual meridian-log Jacobian is partial U_i/partial delta_j =-2(c_i-pi i epsilon_i) delta_ij, c_i=pi(T_bi(0)+T_ci(0))/(x_i+y_i)>0. (14) Here c_i is a scalar radial coefficient, distinct from the collar matrix C_i. The Jacobian is invertible, so the auxiliary meridian logs are local coordinates on this same actual marked peripheral germ. This is a local A-variety statement with a specified branch and marking. It does not compute a global eliminated A-polynomial, give a scalar quantum A-operator, or assert that S is an algebraic number. The function S is the regulator primitive with differential (8). ## 6. The remaining full-source and filling distinction The exact finite packet still uses its N-dependent selected critical phase S_N and unit Hessian factor. Holomorphic convergence S_N->S does not by itself justify replacing N S_N by N S in a relative formula. The geometric identification here concerns the limiting action and its actual peripheral marking. The full external-color source also contains ordinary-color subsets. Their source-exact transport, possible degeneracies, exponential gaps and far-end cancellation have not been supplied by this identification. Consequently the arbitrary independently long signed-filling theorem remains separate. No knot family or allowed slope set is narrowed in order to replace those remaining requirements. ## 7. Focused verification The [source audit](../experiments/audit_actual_complete_core_geometric_deformation.py) has [saved results](../experiments/actual_complete_core_geometric_deformation_results.json). It checks literal global Morse region words at widths2,3,4: nine charts,436 prefix products,304 unchanged wire incidences and54 actual cup/cap words. These exact finite-field word checks assert the source algebra, not a new geometric certificate for those arbitrary diagrams. Separately, it solves the actual tetrahedral and octahedral white-sphere marked fixtures jointly with the source channel stationarity equations for12 real/complex external parameter vectors and retained half twists. The collar is then reconstructed from its two contact-point images and selected fixed flag, independently of the source formula for R0. The audit compares36 such collars,108 literal threading/Hurwitz relations, 36 primitive auxiliary eigenlogs,60 main parabolic edges and144 actual box/cup prefix products at60 digits. The largest relative residual is below1.7e-58. Two symbolic differential checks retain the primitive factor2 and the regulator boundary sign. The companion collar audit already checks the genuinely flipped finite compactifications and their marked-line limit; those checks are not replaced here. The algebraic-germ corollary follows from the proved Jacobian and finite-type equations, rather than from these numerical fixtures. The theorem concerns the exact complete-image core. Ordinary-color subsets and long-filling estimates are separate requirements.

title: When one shared positive Cauchy torus loses exponential accuracy
status: Analytical exponential loss of the optimal undivided bound
text: # When one shared positive Cauchy torus loses exponential accuracy 31 October 2026. The theorem concerns the full positive endpoint source on its shared face variables. It does not assert growth of the oscillatory invariant beyond volume. ## 1. The two different capacities Fix an actual certified simple-white marked plat with $R$ ports and $R$ ordinary faces. Keep its adjacent protected faces exactly zero. Set $h_f=\log L_f$ at ordinary faces and fix the common-scale gauge $\sum_fh_f=0$. Write $$ \begin{aligned} F(h)&=\sum_e X_e(e^h)-\sum_f h_f,\\ J(h)&=\sum_e H_e(e^h)-\sum_f h_f,\\ X_e&=Q(x_e,b_e,y_e)+Q(x_e,c_e,y_e),\\ H_e&=\max\bigl(\{X_e\}\cup\{\log b_e:b_e>0\} \cup\{\log c_e:c_e>0\}\bigr). \end{aligned}\tag{1} $$ The complete triangle theorem gives a unique minimizing gauge class $h^*$ for $F$, with $$ F(h^*)=\Phi_D=\frac{\operatorname{Vol}(Y_D)}{2\pi}.\tag{2} $$ In contrast, $H_e$ is the weighted rate of the **full** positive endpoint polynomial, as proved in the [closed half-block theorem](actual_fejer_half_block_entropy.md), Section 2. All variables in each expression are shared across the original ports. Zero protected variables are removed from the supported corner sets. **Theorem.** Both infima in (1) are attained on the scale quotient, and $$ \min_hJ(h)=\Phi_D \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad X_e(e^{h^*})\geq\log b_e,\ \log c_e \text{ for every positive middle}.\tag{3} $$ In particular, a strict failure of this nonstrict packing condition at one port implies $$ \min_hJ(h)>\Phi_D.\tag{4} $$ This concerns nonstrict balance in (3). Equality at a local target does not imply the strict condition used by the full filling theorem. ## 2. Coercivity from the actual triangle incidences Let $a^*_{tf}$ be the normalized complete triangle angles. Each row has sum $1/2$, every ordinary face has sum one, and every allowed ordinary corner is positive. A row with just one ordinary corner has its fixed value $1/2$. For a real ordinary-face vector $v$, define $$ B_\triangle(v)=\frac12\sum_t\max_{f\in t\text{ ordinary}}v_f -\sum_fv_f.\tag{5} $$ Using the face balances of $a^*$, (5) is the sum of nonnegative row differences between a maximum and a strictly positive weighted mean. Equality forces $v$ to be constant on the allowed corners of every row. The ordinary-face adjacency graph is connected: removing the two marked vertices from a simple triangulated sphere leaves a connected graph. Every remaining white edge occurs in an actual triangle row. Hence equality forces all ordinary values to be equal. On the unit sphere of the zero-sum gauge, $B_\triangle$ is continuous and strictly positive. Thus, for some $\kappa>0$, $$ B_\triangle(h)\geq\kappa\lVert h\rVert_2.\tag{6} $$ The triangle Legendre identity, evaluated at a vertex with zero entropy, gives $Q(e^{h_f}:f\in t)\geq\tfrac12\max_{f\in t}h_f$. Consequently $F(h)\geq B_\triangle(h)$, and $J\geq F$ is also coercive. Both are continuous, so both minima are attained. If the gauge has dimension zero, the same attainment assertion is immediate, and the argument below does not require (6). Uniqueness of the minimizer of $F$ can also be seen directly. On each supported row, the strictly concave triangle entropy has an interior maximizer at finite positive weights. Its Legendre potential is strictly convex in directions that are not constant on that row. Connectedness of the ordinary-face graph therefore makes the sum strictly convex modulo common scale. The actual complete angles give its critical point $h^*$. ## 3. Equality and strict loss Since $J\geq F\geq\Phi_D$, the nonstrict condition in (3) makes $J(h^*)=F(h^*)=\Phi_D$ and proves one direction. Conversely, suppose $\min J=\Phi_D$ and let $h_0$ attain that minimum. Then $F(h_0)\leq J(h_0)=\Phi_D$, so uniqueness forces $h_0=h^*$. Every term $H_e-X_e$ is nonnegative. Their sum can vanish at $h^*$ only if every positive middle logarithm is at most $X_e$. This proves (3), and (4) follows immediately. No local optimizers have been chosen independently and no minimax interchange is used. ## 4. Even level-dependent positive radii cannot remove this loss For even $N$, let $d=N-1$ and let $P_{e,N}$ be the original full positive Fejer endpoint polynomial. Define its exact positive Cauchy bound $$ \operatorname{Cap}_N= \inf_{L_f>0} \frac{\left.\prod_eP_{e,N}\right|_{L_u=L_v=0}} {\prod_{f\text{ ordinary}}L_f^d}.\tag{7} $$ The infimum permits arbitrary $N$-dependent radii. The uniform closed coefficient entropy theorem gives, uniformly on every compact set of ordinary logarithmic weights, $$ G_N(h):=\frac1N\log \frac{\prod_eP_{e,N}(e^h)}{\prod_f e^{dh_f}} \longrightarrow J(h).\tag{8} $$ This follows by finite positive Laplace summation: every local coefficient has its uniform closed entropy, the number of monomials is polynomial in $N$, and the supported rational grids approximate the compact simplex. The difference between $d/N$ and one is uniform on compact logarithmic sets. The exact weighted maximum is $H_e$, with its original normalization. There is no escaping-minimizer loophole in (8). Each allowed pure-face monomial has degree $d$ and logarithmic coefficient $o(N)$ uniformly over the finitely many vertices. Its coefficient entropy is zero. Keeping one such monomial at each port gives $$ G_N(h)\geq\frac dN B_{\mathrm{port}}(h)-\varepsilon_N, \qquad\varepsilon_N\longrightarrow0,\tag{9} $$ where $B_{\mathrm{port}}(h)=\sum_e\max_{f\in e\text{ ordinary}}h_f-\sum_fh_f$. The two triangle rows at each port show $B_{\mathrm{port}}\geq B_\triangle$. Thus (6) and (9), together with the bounded value $G_N(h^*)$, put all finite-level minimizers in one fixed compact set for sufficiently large $N$. At each fixed level coercivity also gives attainment. Compact uniform convergence now proves $$ \lim_{\substack{N\to\infty\\N\text{ even}}} \frac1N\log\operatorname{Cap}_N=\min_hJ(h).\tag{10} $$ Let $Z_N$ denote the actual original marked coefficient of this same positive product. The [complete endpoint theorem](general_fejer_endpoint_source_volume.md) gives $N^{-1}\log Z_N\to\Phi_D$. Combining with (10) yields $$ \lim_{\substack{N\to\infty\\N\text{ even}}} \frac1N\log\frac{\operatorname{Cap}_N}{Z_N} =\min J-\Phi_D.\tag{11} $$ At a strictly unbalanced complete packing this is a positive exponential loss in the best undivided positive Cauchy bound. It is not a claim of excess growth in the coefficient, which still has the actual volume rate. The statement is already decisive along even levels; no odd regularization is needed for this obstruction. ## 5. Consequence for the general strategy One cannot repair a strict packing imbalance merely by optimizing a single positive torus for the full endpoint product, even with radii depending on the level. The proved [anchored shared-radius theorem](general_anchored_shared_radius_filling_volume.md) avoids this particular loss by separating genuine source sectors first. It is not contradicted by (4) or (11). The [finite actual-sector cover theorem](general_actual_sector_cover_filling_volume.md) retains those common face constraints while permitting finer decompositions. A [certified original source](actual_shared_radius_certificate_separation.md) shows that the anchored test itself is not universal, although a finer cover succeeds. The argument uses finite convex geometry, the original uniform local coefficient theorem and its actual endpoint volume calibration; it does not use a numerical optimizer as a proof.

title: The complete original source has a conserved indefinite form and an explicit positive Cauchy metric
text: # The complete original source has a conserved indefinite form and an explicit positive Cauchy metric 29 October 2026. On the COMPLETE N-dimensional three-head source multiplicity, both actual braid generators preserve one explicit indefinite Hermitian form. The original cup is null for this form and the ordinary cap is its prescribed dual. A different, full-rank positive Hermite metric has polynomial BOTH original boundary norms. Thus a special-inner-product Cauchy estimate is now literal for this complete source; the missing sharp statement is its coherent WORD ENERGY bound, not the Cauchy inequality or a boundary-normalization choice. ## 1. Complete module and literal sources Use N>=2, d=N-1, q=exp(pi i/N), Q=q^2, x=-q^(-1)=q^d, F_j=(Q;Q)_j. The [complete source theorem](actual_complete_source_multiplicity_module.md) identifies the actual three-head Hopf multiplicities with W=(V tensor V)_(integer degree d), basis e_u=|u,d-u>. There are N multiplicities; all value and Jordan-derivative channels remain. On W put A=Omega_12 and B=Omega_23. Explicitly, A_(u,u)=q+q^(-1)-q(1-Q^u)^2-q^(-1)(1-Q^(u+1))^2, A_(u-1,u)=A_(u,u-1)=-(1-Q^u)^2, B e_u=c_u e_u+b_u e_(u-1), c_u=q^(2u+1)+q^(-2u-1), b_u=Q^u+Q^(-u)-2. (1) Missing endpoint arrows vanish. The ACTUAL crossings on this entire module are R_12=kappa r_N(A), R_23=kappa r_N(B), with their literal inverses. The original common Cartan kappa=q^(d^2/2) is retained. The polynomial r_N has unit nodal values nu_j and the actual Hermite jets; no semisimple truncation is used. The original boundary vectors are p_u=N x^(u-d), ell_u=x^(-u)Q^(-u)/N, m_u=x^(d-u)/N^2. (2) The marked row here is only its degree-d restriction. Arbitrary marked exteriors retain the full matrix-valued functional in the source theorem. For an original cup--three-head-word--ordinary-cap tangle, closed by the prescribed cut of value one on I, its exact scalar is K_N=chi_N ell W p. (3) The full even-plat source theorem states when this scalar presentation applies; inserted nonintertwining exteriors are not replaced by (3). All original framing and modified-dimension factors stay in chi_N. ## 2. An actual common Hermitian form on ALL channels Let P be physical index reversal, P_(u,v)=delta_(u+v,d). It is a Hermitian unitary involution, with both positive and negative eigenvalues. Directly from (1), A^*P=PA, B^*P=PB. (4) For A, complex conjugation replaces Q by Q^(-1), and reversal takes each adjacent entry to that conjugate entry. Its diagonal behaves the same way. A is complex symmetric. For B its entries are real, while c_(d-u)=c_u and b_(N-u)=b_u give PBP=B^T. These proofs include both physical endpoints and all level parities. At each real double node c_j the actual crossing polynomial satisfies |r_N(c_j)|=1, r_N'(c_j)/r_N(c_j) purely imaginary. At the possible simple node only the first condition is required. Therefore bar(r_N)r_N-1 vanishes with the full multiplicity of P_N=T_N+2. The polynomial identity P_N(A)=P_N(B)=0 and (4) imply R_i^* P R_i=P, i=12,23. (5) The unit Cartan |kappa|=1 is included. This is an exact Hermite functional-calculus argument, including every nilpotent derivative. Consequently EVERY signed original word W preserves P on this complete module. It is not merely a leading semiclassical conservation law. The original sources themselves obey ell=p^*P/N^2, p^*Pp=0, m=p^*/N^3. (6) Thus (3) is chi_N p^*P Wp/N^2, an indefinite matrix coefficient between actual null source vectors. This does not make it a positive norm. The ordinary cup--cap bubble is still zero. For completeness a SOURCE-UNITARY coordinate system displays both the full dynamics and the cut. Let U_(u,k)=N^(-1/2)x^(u-d)Q^(-ku), D_(k,k)=q^k, V_0=U D^(-1), A_0=V_0^* A V_0, B_0=V_0^* B V_0. The orientation D^(-1) on the physical basis columns is compulsory. The exact nonzero entries are A_0|k>=c_k|k>+8sin^2(pi k/N)|k-1> +(c_(k-1)-c_0)|k-2>, B_0|k>=(1-Q^(-k))|k-1>+2q^(-2k-1)|k> +(1-Q^(-k-1))|k+1>. (7) The coefficients kill all would-be wraps at k=0,1,d. In particular ||A_0||<=14 and ||B_0||<=6 uniformly in N. This does not bound the high-degree functions r_N(A_0),r_N(B_0). The transformed P is (-1)^d times index reversal, and V_0^*p=N^(3/2)e_0, ell V_0=(-1)^d N^(-1/2)e_d^T, m V_0=N^(-3/2)e_0^T, K_N=chi_N(-1)^d N (W_0)_(d,0). (8) Thus this coordinate change has no exponential frame or source cost. ## 3. What positive Cauchy says, with its exact source cost For EVERY prescribed positive Hermitian G on W, actual Cauchy gives |K_N|^2<=|chi_N|^2 (ell G^(-1)ell^*) ((Wp)^*G(Wp)). (9) This uses the coherent vector Wp, not separately squared paths. A positive metric cannot be replaced by the conserved indefinite P. There is a useful optional source-balancing condition GPG=P, equivalently G^(-1)=PGP. (10) Then (6) gives the exact dual-source identity ell G^(-1)ell^*=p^*Gp/N^4. (11) Equation (9) has now balanced the actual source and co-source with one positive metric. Such metrics exist (I is one), but existence does not prove that the transported energy is geometrically small. For reference, any positive H yields a canonical P-compatible metric G=H^(1/2)|H^(-1/2)PH^(-1/2)|H^(1/2). (12) Indeed if C=H^(-1/2)PH^(-1/2), then H^(1/2)PH^(1/2)=C^(-1), and |C|C^(-1)|C|=C proves (10). This replacement can change energies exponentially; no tame comparison with a proposed geometric H is inferred from (12). Nor is the following actual Hermite metric assumed to satisfy (10). ## 4. A COMPLETE positive metric already controls both boundaries Let J be the specified complete anti-Pascal recoupling, and V_H the complete degree-d Hermite frame for A from [the all-channel packet theorem](actual_complete_casimir_hermite_packet.md). Keep its full bilinear Christoffel--Darboux inverse, including all derivative columns. Put L=V_H^(-1)J, G_0=L^*L/N, u=Lp, a=ell L^(-1), W_ch=L W L^(-1). (13) This is a full-rank positive Hermitian metric specified before the word W, without an unknown knot scalar. The exact original sources in each double channel c are u=N(-1)^d x^(-d)(-c,4-c^2), a=(x^d/N)(1,0). (14) At the possible simple node, u=Nx^(-d), a=x^d/N. These are the source theorem's complete CD/Chebyshev simplification; the potentially large crossing derivative cancels in the source value entry. Writing n_distinct=ceil(N/2), it gives ell G_0^(-1)ell^*=N||a||^2=n_distinct/N<=1, p^*G_0p=||u||^2/N<=8N^2. (15) The last constant includes N=2. All normalizer phases in (14) remain. Thus (9) becomes the explicit original-SOURCE positive-energy bound |K_N|^2<=|chi_N|^2 (n_distinct/N) E_N(W), E_N(W)=||W_ch u||^2/N=(Wp)^*G_0(Wp). (16) All mixed channel copies remain inside this norm. No dephasing or replacement of the full marked source is used. This is precisely Cauchy in a special positive inner product, with controlled actual boundary costs on the COMPLETE module, not only its c_0 plane. The desired geometric comparison for this PARTICULAR fixed metric is |chi_N|^2 E_N(W)<=exp(o(N)) Z_N(geometric angles). (17) It is now [proved false for the original figure-eight](actual_figure_eight_complete_channel_energy.md): an exact complete channel forces excessive energy at every odd level. The [terminal coherent Gram](actual_terminal_packet_positive_gram.md) supplies a different positive metric on the same full module, with sharp benchmark energy and an all-width Cauchy construction; its general-prefix energy remains open. The Hermite-diagonal braid has polynomial jets, but its conjugate through the full Racah matrix has the displayed excess. P-conservation does not imply (17). Making G depend on the completed unknown W to force constant energy merely moves that same quantity into the dual boundary cost. Thus the actual metric and boundary reduction are constructive; the sharp word-energy estimate is a distinct mathematical step, not a consequence of Cauchy alone. [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_complete_source_krein_cauchy.py): literal original full-Cartan pair crossing, complete anti-Pascal recoupling, both P-unitary generators, all source phases and unitary Fourier endpoints, full Hermite-source normalizers, and actual coherent word Cauchy energies in positive and P-compatible metrics. The finite audit checks twelve complete original Casimir/braid/source modules, including the full Hermite boundary metric, coherent signed-word Cauchy energy and non-diagonal P-compatible positive metrics. Compilation passes.

title: Complete source multiplicities with exact original braid and cap data
text: # Complete source multiplicities with exact original braid and cap data 29 October 2026. The original three-head cup source has a COMPLETE N-dimensional Hopf multiplicity module, including all intermediate Casimir Jordan channels. Both original adjacent braids act on this same module. Its recoupling is an explicit reversed q-Pascal matrix, not a projection onto the two-dimensional source channel. The actual cup and ordinary cap become opposite endpoint coordinates after that recoupling. The original Hermite source packet also has a polynomially conditioned recoupled frame, although the full recoupling matrix can have exponential norm. The same construction reduces the COMPLETE original even plat at arbitrary fixed width to a central-degree multiplicity space. The full marked cap is evaluated only after this whole invariant-tensor identification; its resulting source row and vector have explicitly polynomial norms. Every reduced signed generator is given below. No sharp whole-word norm, geometric coefficient, or complete-channel contractivity is inferred from this exact reduction. ## 1. Original finite modules and conventions Put N>=2, d=N-1, q=exp(pi*i/N), Q=q^2, x=q^d=-q^(-1), rho=q-q^(-1), F_a=(Q;Q)_a. On the original balanced V=V_d use F|a>=(1-Q^(a+1))|a+1>, Ecal|a>=(Q^(-a)-1)|a-1>, K|a>=xQ^(-a)|a>, H|a>=(d-2a)|a>, 0<=a<=d. (1) Missing endpoint arrows are zero. The original coproduct is F_12=F_1+K_1^(-1)F_2, E_12=Ecal_1 K_2+Ecal_2, K_12=K_1K_2. (2) Use these iterated coproducts on every physical prefix. All their N-th E and F powers vanish: the individual terms Q-commute, and the root q-binomial makes their N-th power the sum of the individual N-th powers. We retain the unrolled H, not only K=q^H. The original turns, including all N powers and the pivot, are p_(u,v)=N x^(-v) delta_(u+v,d), ell_(u,v)=x^(-u)Q^(-u)/N delta_(u+v,d), m_(u,v)=x^v/N^2, WITHOUT a degree delta. (3) The cup p and ordinary cap ell are literal Hopf maps. They satisfy the two snake equations, ell p=0 and m p=1. The marked row m is not an invariant cap and is never replaced by ell. The common Cartan kappa=q^(d^2/2), original framing, modified dimension and external scalar chi_N remain on the original crossing/source line. Write Omega=F_tot E_tot+qK_tot+q^(-1)K_tot^(-1). The original crossing is kappa r_N(Omega_pair), including its [confluent value AND derivative data](casimir_braiding_and_recoupling_lattice.md). Its inverse is the literal inverse polynomial. No semisimple root evaluation is substituted for a double channel. ## 2. A complete three-head Hom space from an explicit highest lift Let W=(V tensor V)_(integer degree d), with basis e_j=|j,d-j>, j=0,...,d. For EVERY w in W set H_L(w)=sum_(c=0)^d (-xQ)^c E_12^c w/F_c tensor |c>, I_w|a>=F_123^a H_L(w)/F_a, 0<=a<=d. (4) Then I_w is an actual unrolled Hopf intertwiner V -> V^tensor3. Moreover EVERY such intertwiner occurs exactly once. In particular Hom_Hopf,H(V,V^tensor3) is isomorphic to W, dim Hom=N, dim sum_w image(I_w)=N^2. (5) Here is a direct proof including endpoints. A highest vector of the required weight has integer degree d. If its last-head-c component is z_c, its E equation gives z_(c+1)=-xQ E_12 z_c/(1-Q^(c+1)), with the action interpreted as in (4). Thus the c=0 component w determines it and gives exactly H_L. The final c=d equation is E_12^N w=0. Conversely this proves the E equation for every w. Its total K and H are precisely the highest K=x,H=d of V. The quantum-group commutator then gives, along its F string, E_tot I_w|a>=(Q^(-a)-1)I_w|a-1>. The last F arrow is zero by F_tot^N=0. This proves the full intertwiner, not only a highest-weight kernel comparison. For each a<N, applying E_tot^a to I_w|a> returns a NONZERO scalar times H_L(w). Distinct a have different unrolled degrees. Consequently the N copies of V in (5) are independent. The proof also gives an inverse: restrict the highest vector to last color0. No complementary Clebsch channel or internal excursion was dropped. Both original adjacent signed braids commute with the entire Hopf action and H. They therefore act exactly on this complete module. The source cup intertwiner is w=p: E_12 p=0 gives H_L(p)=p tensor |0>, I_p(v)=p tensor v. (6) The generalized source vector t from the [tame Hermite theorem](actual_tame_c0_hermite_source_frame.md) must be lifted as H_L(t). The bare vector t tensor |0> is generally not highest and must not replace it. ### The total-character slice has no missing generalized extension The center identity follows directly by multiplying the N shifted factors FE=Omega-qK-q^(-1)K^(-1): T_N(Omega)+K^N+K^(-N)=0, T_0=2,T_1=z,T_(n+1)=zT_n-T_(n-1). (7) Indeed product_(r=0)^(N-1)[z-(uQ^r+u^(-1)Q^(-r))] =T_N(z)-u^N-u^(-N), with u=qK and q^N=-1; F^NE^N=0. On three heads K_tot^N=(-1)^d. The root Omega=-2 of T_N(z)+2(-1)^d is SIMPLE, since T_N'(-2)=(-1)^(N-1)N^2. Thus total-character extensions at -2 are not being silently removed. In fact ker(Omega_123+2) is exactly the N^2-dimensional image (5). Any highest vector in it has K=x, hence degree d modulo N. Degree d is covered by (4). The only other possible physical degree is 2N-1. A highest vector there would have a nonzero F string of length N, by the same coefficients in (1), ending outside the available degree range0,...,3d; so it is zero. Applying E repeatedly to an arbitrary vector in the kernel and using E^N=0 therefore places it in the strings (4). The intermediate pair Casimirs DO have their size-two Jordan channels, and all of those remain below. ## 3. Actual complete recoupling is an anti-Pascal matrix There is a second complete highest chart, H_R(w')=sum_(a=0)^d (-1)^a/F_a |a> tensor E_23^a w', whose inverse is first physical color0. The factor follows directly from the E equation: on its degree-d slice the K_23 factor at the next step is Q^(a+1), canceling the Q^(-(a+1)) in Ecal|a+1>. Define J by H_L(w)=H_R(Jw). Its exact coefficients are J_(i,j)=(-xQ)^(d-i)x^j Q^[i(i+1)/2-d(d+1)/2] [d-j choose i]_Q, i+j<=d; zero otherwise. (8) To prove (8), extract physical first color0 from (4). It requires c=d-i and exactly j first-head lowering arrows in E_12^c. The q-binomial expansion with E_1K_2 and E_2 gives the displayed Gaussian coefficient. The remaining exponent simplifies to i(i+1)/2-d(d+1)/2; no modular half inverse is used. The opposite antidiagonal is nonzero, so J is invertible. Thus this is a complete frame change including all colliding intermediate channels. Put A=Omega_12 restricted to W. It is the literal actual symmetric tridiagonal degree-d pair Casimir, with explicit entries A_(j,j)=q+q^(-1)-q(1-Q^j)^2-q^(-1)(1-Q^(j+1))^2, A_(j-1,j)=A_(j,j-1)=-(1-Q^j)^2, 1<=j<=d. On W the OTHER pair Casimir is B e_j=c_j e_j+b_j e_(j-1), c_j=q^(2j+1)+q^(-2j-1), b_j=Q^j+Q^(-j)-2, 1<=j<=d. (9) Direct extraction in (4) proves (9): only c=0,1 can reach last color0. Their F_2 E_2 terms cancel exactly; the remaining off diagonal is b_j. The right-chart calculation similarly gives J^(-1) A J=B, J A J^(-1)=B^T. (10) Consequently BOTH complete original signed braid generators are R_12=kappa r_N(A), R_23=kappa r_N(B)=J^(-1)R_12 J, (11) with their literal inverses for negative signs. The derivative conditions of r_N at every colliding c_j are essential in (11). The polynomial has degree<N and supplies the full matrix, not only its eigenvalues or its two-dimensional source restriction. Equivalently the entries of f(B) are products of the b_j times the confluent divided differences f[c_i,...,c_j]. The ordinary tridiagonal A has nonzero adjacent coefficients at all j=1,...,d.
