A toric-residue comparison must retain the differential source or construct its exact adapter, not replace this functional by evaluation on critical points. The hypothesis L_e<=N-1 is essential: a length-N Fermat block has missing interior coefficients, so strict Hall alone would not imply the lower bound (9). The theorem does not extend to a full-clock or knot-class statement. [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_flat_block_sublevel_transport.py): root-Pochhammer phases, unbalanced strict-Hall examples, convex critical points, original complex coefficients and the polynomial probability bound. These computations supplement the uniform proof above; no knot class or full-clock volume theorem is inferred from the examples.

title: Forced physical overbridges and charged full-block source fusion
text: # Forced physical overbridges and charged full-block source fusion 28 October 2026. This gives two constructive reductions of the original source, at every N, arbitrary braid width and arbitrary crossing signs. First, the exact bridge contractions continue through the actual closure pivots. A marked-cut extreme therefore removes a whole physical overbridge, including pieces on opposite sides of the braid cut. Second, full blocks remain exactly contractible after earlier fusions lower the source charges. All such contractions terminate, with explicit charge redistribution, scalars and clock feedback retained. This does not identify the remaining source with that of a smaller knot, make its defects sublinear, or establish geometric noncancellation. In particular the actual figure-eight macrodefects are transported into the reduced source, not removed by changing its definition. ## 1. Continue bridges through the original source Write d=N-1, Q=exp(2 pi i/N), x=-exp(-pi i/N). The [signed bridge theorem](actual_signed_overbridge_unwinding.md) gives, with the opposite physical pair fixed on its actual grids, M_j(Zout,Zin)=c_j Pout_j(Zout) Pin_j(Zin), Pin_j(Z)=Z^(-h_j)(b_j/Z;Q)_(d-h_j), Pout_j(Z)=(a_j Z;Q)_(h_j). (1) Every original c_j is the explicit signed scalar in that theorem, including kappa, the phase Q^(+/-h_j(h_j+1)/2), the spectator monomial, and 1/N. None is discarded here. Let an identity or original pivotal wire continue the first output to the next input. In the physical finite basis its operator is diag(eta t^a), 0<=a<=d. Thus t=1, eta=1 at the unpivoted marked continuation, whereas t=Q^(-1), eta=x^(1-N) (2) at an ordinary closing pivot. The whole original averaged marked row is converted to this unpivoted continuation with the SINGLE exterior factor 1/N **before** splitting crossings into clocks. This is the integer-degree source theorem already used in the [global charged state](actual_global_charged_bridge_flow.md). No sectorwise scalar-endomorphism or Schur argument is used. For arbitrary endpoint Fourier frame roots the exact continued wire is sum_(k,l) Pin_next(z_l) E_(l,k) Pout_prev(w_k) =N eta CT_Z Pout_prev(t Z) Pin_next(Z). (3) Indeed E=G_next diag(eta t^a) G_prev^(-1). The first matrix product recovers precisely the polynomial eta Pout_prev(t Z), since its degree is at most d. Multiplication by Pin_next has frequencies in [-d,d]. The remaining finite root sum is therefore N times its constant term, with no nonzero cyclic alias. This proves (3) even when the two old central frame parameters differ. It uses the finite interpolation source, not a bare full-Psi seam deformation. The old complementary identity consequently gives N eta (-a_j t)^h_next Q^(h_next(h_next-1)/2) *[h_j choose h_next]_Q *(a_j t b_next Q^(-1);Q)_(h_j-h_next), (4) when h_j>=h_next, and zero otherwise. Thus the same monotone clock simplex and q-multinomial compose across ALL closure continuations. The only changes are the displayed t and eta factors. Select every physical over-output-to-over-input continuation, including closure continuations, and freeze all unselected under and endpoint labels. These selected paths are disjoint. A directed cycle would be an entire link component with no under encounter. For a one-component knot with at least one crossing this is impossible: both encounters of each self-crossing lie on that component. Thus the selected components are genuine finite paths. Applying (3)--(4) to every such path gives exact simultaneous contraction of all TRUE physical overbridge interiors, independent of where the braid was cut. After homogenizing, each physical overbridge still has total block length exactly (d-h_first)+sum(h_j-h_next)+h_last=d. (5) The finite multinomial, every c_j, every closing eta and all t shifts remain. There is one factor 1/N per bridge, canceled by its anchor root sum as in the global charged theorem. The single exterior marked factor 1/N remains. In particular the number of polynomial bridge events may be reduced from the number of open-braid paths to the number of physical diagram overbridges. No cup, marked row or nonordinary turn is moved in this assertion. ## 2. A whole overbridge is forced to an extreme source face Use the actual finite cyclic-source support theorem from [the cut peeling proof](original_source_cyclic_variation_peeling.md) and its [current-clock dictionary](actual_alternating_balanced_source.md). For either sign, put u=[b-a-1], v=[a-c], t0=[c-e], z=[e-b]. A supported local crossing has u+v+t0+z=d. The actual overclock is h_plus=u+v, h_minus=u+z=d-t0. (6) The whole original source forces at its first position-1 crossing u=v=0, and at its last position-1 crossing v=t0=0. These are actual pathwise statements, for every cut color, before coefficient sums. They apply after the whole source replacement preceding (3). Suppose the first position-1 crossing is positive. It is an OVER encounter at the first cut head, and (6) forces h=0. After the exact bridge sums, monotonicity forces every subsequent clock of this physical overbridge to be zero. If the cut lies inside the bridge, the preceding encounter at that cut head must be the last negative position-1 crossing: only the negative OVER output is on that head. Equation (6) forces its clock d. Monotonicity forces the entire pre-cut portion of the same physical overbridge to have clock d. The bridge therefore has either all clocks zero (if the cut is its initial endpoint), or the form d,...,d | 0,...,0, (7) where the bar is precisely the marked continuation. Dually, if the last position-1 crossing is negative, the distinguished bridge has an all-d terminal portion, and an all-zero portion beyond the marked continuation if that continuation is inside the bridge. Consequently its homogeneous source kernel has exactly ONE nonzero-length block, and that block has length d: the input block, output block, or the single internal d-to-0 jump. All its other Pochhammer lengths vanish and its multinomial is one. The FULL bridge, of arbitrary length and signs, is thus a reproducing block against the complete remaining exterior, to which Section 3 applies. The propagation in this paragraph is a statement about the EXACT SUMMED clock sector. It is not a pointwise restriction on each unsummed cyclic path. For example at N=2 the word [1,2,-1,-2] has a supported original path with clocks (0,0,1,1); its increasing overbridge clocks cancel under (4). Only the initial clock extreme itself is the pointwise cut restriction. This applies to arbitrary signed words having first position-1 sign positive or last position-1 sign negative, with no alternation, twist-family or bridge-width hypothesis. A whole-word cyclic recut may put any positive position-1 occurrence first; if none exists, the last such occurrence is negative. Such a recut uses the original knot invariant's whole braid-conjugacy equivalence before decomposition, and is not an identification of its individual clock sectors. The exact source reduction itself needs only the stated first/last sign condition and the local support proof above. All feedback of the removed bridge remains explicit. In particular its under continuation is z_out=x^sigma z_in when h=0, z_out=x^sigma Q^sigma z_in when h=d. (8) The second line is Q^(-sigma d)=Q^sigma, not the first line. The original integer charge d and its phase must not be discarded as if this were a zero clock. Remaining bridge parameters still depend on all surviving clocks through the proved feedback matrix. ## 3. Full blocks fuse arbitrary relative source charges Write B_d(X,Y;a)=product_(r<d)(X-Q^r aY), s=aQ^(-1). Root complementation gives B_d=sum_(j=0)^d X^(d-j)(sY)^j. For ANY polynomial exterior F and ANY 0<=q_X,q_Y<=d, [X^q_X Y^q_Y] B_d(X,Y;a) F(X,Y,U) =s^(d-q_X) [Y^(q_X+q_Y-d)] F(sY,Y,U). (9) The right side is zero when its source charge is negative. This is an exact coefficient identity, without a bound on the degree or valency of F. To prove it, the term X^r of F contributes only j=d-q_X+r. The left side thus includes r<=q_X. On the right, every omitted r>q_X has Y-degree at least d-q_X+r>d>=q_Y in the unshifted source, and cannot contribute. Its scalar is exactly s^(d-q_X), as displayed. Equivalently the substituted exterior is needed only modulo the actual remaining source charge plus one. The new anchor charge is q_new=q_X+q_Y-d. (10) It stays at most min(q_X,q_Y), and is nonnegative precisely when the saturated pair has enough charge to support its d internal factors. Thus a full block never stops being contractible merely because earlier fusions lowered its endpoint charges. Equation (9) extends the previous q_X=q_Y=d source reproducing identity. All scalar monomials generated by the substitution remain. For a loop of ANY length L, B_L(X,X;a)=X^L (a;Q)_L. (11) Extract its displayed scalar and lower the charge of X by L; negative charge means zero. In particular a full loop requires q_X=d and then removes X by evaluating the entire exterior at X=0. Its scalar is (a;Q)_d=G_N(aQ^(-1)), G_N(t)=sum_(j=0)^d t^j. (12) At unit root phases this is the retained resonant value N, zero, or 2/(1-q^m) already computed in the general fusion theorem. For partial loops, (a;Q)_L can have exponential size and MUST remain; no tame-modulus claim is made for (11). A zero-charge anchor is also eliminated exactly by evaluating its whole incident polynomial at zero. Each outgoing B_L(X,Y;a) then contributes (-a)^L Q^(L(L-1)/2) Y^L; each incoming block contributes its other endpoint to the power L. These monomials lower the neighboring source charges by L, retaining their exact coefficients. A negative resulting charge gives another exact zero. It follows that loop extraction, zero-charge evaluation and all full-block contractions form a TERMINATING reduction for every original clock sector, with no branching sum or omitted current. Each loop step removes an edge, each other step removes an anchor, and no block length increases. The residual source is loop-free, has all charges between 1 and d, and has no length-d block. It is an exact charged polynomial exterior, not automatically the source of another knot diagram. ## 4. Defect transport and the full-block topology Let S_v count all incident factor lengths, with loops counted twice, and define delta_v=S_v-2q_v. Under a nonloop full contraction, S_new=S_X+S_Y-2d, q_new=q_X+q_Y-d, delta_new=delta_X+delta_Y. (13) Thus opposite macrodefects can cancel when the actual full-block adjacency permits their fusion. Other macrodefects can add. Partial loop extraction removes 2L from S and L from q, so preserves delta. A zero-charge evaluation distributes its removed incident lengths as precisely the charge loads just described. These are actual source transformations, rather than a declaration that the shell has become balanced. There is also a useful topology-only zero test. If a connected full-block subgraph has m vertices and r full edges, its internal degree rd cannot exceed sum q_v in a nonzero source coefficient. Since every q_v<=d, r>=m+1 forces zero. If r=m, all its q_v must equal d. Hence the full-block graph of a nonzero sector is a PSEUDOFOREST. Its trees reduce by (9) to charge q_C=sum_(v in C) q_v-(m-1)d. (14) A unicyclic component reduces to the explicit full-loop scalar and evaluation of its complete exterior at its surviving anchor zero. This gives exact outward monomial loads. A component with q_C<0 vanishes. Different spanning-tree elimination orders give equal complete source pairings because every step is the ordinary coefficient identity (9); the retained gauges and scalar phases can of course be expressed in different coordinates. Balanced star--triangle fusion is now available wherever the reduced actual anchor still has charge d, exactly three incident blocks, and total length 2d. These conditions are explicit and testable. The forced bridge alone does not ensure them. The [all-N figure-eight support theorem](actual_alternating_balanced_source.md) already shows why setting the remaining defects to zero would discard the original source. Repeating the new reduction does terminate, but termination at a positive geometric core or a nonzero leading scalar remains to be proved. ## 5. Reproducible audit python3 experiments/audit_actual_forced_source_fusion.py The audit checks identity and original pivot continuations between different finite Fourier frames at N=2,...,10, all relative charges and arbitrary monomial exteriors at those levels, twelve arbitrary sign/width physical-bridge support problems (including bridges crossing multiple closure heads), and eight COMPLETE original signed word sources. Every clock sector of each whole-source test is reduced by (9)--(12), compared with its unreduced exact source, then summed with the original feedback weights and compared with the original crossing matrices and pivotal cut. The N=3 tests include surviving reduced sources with charges strictly between 0 and d. These checks validate the formulas; the general proofs are the coefficient and support arguments above.

title: A full-source tree channel exceeds the hyperbolic volume rate
text: # A full-source tree channel exceeds the hyperbolic volume rate 28 October 2026. The short-complement forest representation is exact, but its individual source channels do not automatically satisfy the hyperbolic-volume bound. This failure already occurs for the original figure-eight source AFTER its forced full block has been contracted. An explicit all-short spanning-tree term has rate -5 J(1/5)=0.79366964575974769..., J(s)=integral_0^s log(2 sin(pi t)) dt, (1) whereas Vol(4_1)/(2 pi)=0.32306594721945051.... All central norm factors, short-root Jacobians and the extracted source loop are included. Thus direct absolute estimation of this exact tree representation cannot give the conjectured sharp upper bound. The statement concerns this representation and its absolute envelope; it does not exclude a further phase-aware regrouping of its channels. There is a separate algebraic limitation: if ordinary parent charges larger than N-1 are retained during iteration, jets only at the short roots can require order proportional to N, even at two anchors. Bounded anchor count alone does not bound that local jet depth. ## 1. The actual source after the forced full block Use N=5r+1, r>=1, d=N-1=5r and the actual overclocks of the figure-eight word [1,-2,1,-2] h=(0,v,w,t)=(0,3r,2r,4r). (2) The [actual finite block table](actual_alternating_balanced_source.md) gives its entire closure-contracted source, after the displayed unit coordinate gauges, as [A^d B^d C^d D^d] B_d(B,C;1) B_(d-v)(D,A;Q^(v+1)) B_v(A,B;Q^(-v+w+1)) B_(d-w)(C,B;Q^(w+2)) B_w(B,D;Q^(-w-t-1)) B_(d-t)(A,D;Q^(-v)) B_t(D,C;1), (3) with Q=exp(2 pi i/N) and B_L(X,Y;a)=product_(j<L)(X-Q^j aY). All original external and clock scalars remain; they have unit modulus or polynomial size at complete color in these singleton overbridges and do not alter the rates below. Contracting the first, genuinely forced full block sets B=Q^(-1)C. The middle C-to-B factor becomes a loop. Consequently (3) is EXACTLY Q^(-w) L_w [A^d C^w D^d] E(A,C,D), L_w=(Q^(w+1);Q)_(d-w)=F_d/F_w, (4) where F_k=(Q;Q)_k and E=B_(d-v)(D,A;Q^(v+1)) B_v(A,C;Q^(w-v)) B_w(C,D;Q^(-w-t)) B_(d-t)(A,D;Q^(-v)) B_t(D,C;1). (5) The factor Q^(-w) is the tail normalization of B_w(Q^(-1)C,D;...). The source charge of C is w, rather than d. To apply the original ordinary-d forest residue formula one equivalently uses [A^d C^d D^d] C^(d-w) E. (6) This monomial source padding is compulsory and is retained below. Equations (3)--(6) are ordinary coefficient identities, preserving the original source. No new boundary functional has been chosen. ## 2. A specified original relative-residue channel Choose the two actual tree edges A -> C: length v=3r, root coefficient Q^(-r), D -> C: length t=4r, root coefficient 1. (7) Their SHORT complementary polynomials are S_A=product_(i=0)^(2r)(A-Q^(2r+i)C), S_D=product_(j=0)^r(D-Q^(4r+j)C). (8) Take regular fixed centers C_C=1, C_A and C_D distinct from 0 and 1 and from each other. In the complete forest formula of [the original complementary source](actual_complementary_source_transport.md), the ALL-SHORT component contains every pair of roots in (8), with the original relative-cycle coefficient. Select precisely i=r, j=0: A=Q^(3r) C, D=Q^(4r) C, C^N=1. (9) This is not an assumed geometric critical point; it is one explicit nonzero term of the exact original relative residue formula. The two central factors in its numerator are K_A=C_A-1, K_D=C_D-1. At (9) their original Fermat denominators are 1-C_A and 1-C_D. They cancel EXACTLY, with product sign +1. Thus there is no omitted central multiplier, large-center choice or inverse central norm affecting this term. The remaining Jacobian is S_A'(A) S_D'(D) N C^d. (10) The numerator has total degree 3d-v-t, equal to the total degree of this Jacobian. Therefore the N root labels of C have identical values. Their sum cancels the N in (10) exactly. The whole selected channel, including the source loop (4), is, up to the fixed relative orientation sign, T_r=Q^(-w) L_w E_rest(Q^(3r),1,Q^(4r)) /[S_A'(Q^(3r)) S_D'(Q^(4r))], (11) where E_rest is (5) with the two selected long tree blocks removed. There is no factorial normalizer or root-label average suppressed in (11). An individual ungrouped C root has magnitude |T_r|/N; this has the same exponential rate. ## 3. Exact magnitude and its entropy All factors in (11) are nonzero. Directly splitting the short-root derivatives gives |S_A'|=|F_r|^2, |S_D'|=|F_r|. (12) The three remaining long products have respective root intervals 2r+1,...,4r; 3r+1,...,5r; 3r+1,...,4r. Their product magnitude is |F_(4r)/F_(2r)| * |F_(5r)/F_(3r)| *|F_(4r)/F_(3r)|. Together with |L_w|=N/|F_(2r)|, this gives |T_r|=N^2 |F_(4r)|^2 /(|F_(2r)|^2 |F_(3r)|^2 |F_r|^3) =N^2/|F_r|^5. (13) The final equality uses the exact root reflection |F_k F_(d-k)|=N at k=r and 2r. It is not an asymptotic estimate. The uniform factorial estimate log|F_k|=N J(k/N)+O(log N) now proves (1), since r/N tends to 1/5. The strict comparison with the figure-eight volume does not require decimal diagnostics. Since sin(pi s)<=pi s, -5J(1/5)>=1-log(2pi/5)>=2-2pi/5>26/35. The calibrated figure-eight volume is 2D(exp(pi i/3)), and the dilogarithm series gives D(exp(pi i/3))<=sum_(n>=1)1/n^2=pi^2/6. Hence its volume rate is at most pi/6<11/21<26/35. The actual rates are the decimals in (1). Thus the triangle-inequality envelope of this tree representation is too large even after the genuine source-forced full contraction. Its currents and root channels must undergo further cancellations or exact regrouping before a sharp Rivin-volume estimate is possible. We do not assert that (2) is a leading surviving clock sector, or that an individual residue rate is the rate of its complete source. The finite audit certifies nonzero complete clock-sector coefficients at several levels as an additional check, not an all-r hypothesis. ## 4. Short-root jets can require macroscopic depth The obstacle here is algebraic and has arbitrary degree. Let 1<=m<N, L=N-m, and put B=B_L(X,Y;a), S=B_m(X,Y;aQ^L), q_X=d, q_Y=2d, s<=floor((d+m-1)/m). Define the allowed homogeneous exterior H_s=X^d S(X,Y)^s Y^(d+m-1-ms). (14) Its degree is 3d-L=2d+m-1, precisely the exterior degree required by this pair of source charges. It vanishes to order s at EVERY short-root branch S=0. In particular all normal jets of order strictly less than s are zero there. Nevertheless [X^d Y^(2d)] B H_s =B(0,1) S(0,1)^s !=0. (15) Indeed the exterior factor X^d forces every other factor to its X-constant term. All their Y-degrees sum to 2d and their constants are nonzero for a!=0. For fixed m, s can be proportional to N. Already m=2, L=d-1 excludes the full blocks removed in (4). Therefore no unrestricted interpolation of these larger ordinary source charges using ONLY short-root jets of depth bounded by anchor count is valid. This does not obstruct retaining the original Fermat-root/mixed-current channels, or derivatives on a complete finite-Frobenius presentation. Such channels contain source data which short-root evaluations alone have lost. Nor is (14) claimed to be a new original-knot source: it refutes the unrestricted arbitrary-exterior interpolation needed for such a proposed closure. ## 5. Audit python3 experiments/audit_actual_forced_source_tree_entropy.py The audit verifies the actual figure-eight block table, the full source/loop reduction, the exact nonzero central-norm cancellation and ALL C-root labels of the specified relative-residue channel. It checks (13) independently by complex products and reflection, the actual fixed-clock source over finite cyclotomic fields, and the short-root-jet obstruction including m=2. It imports no volume proof; the rate comparison is the elementary argument above.

title: The actual four-line Fermat crossing and its unavoidable exponential action
text: # The actual four-line Fermat crossing and its unavoidable exponential action 28 October 2026. The compactified cap sources form an explicit full head frame with an exact inverse and the original basis as its normalized cap value. This gives a four-Fermat-line formula for the actual crossing. The full frame and EACH selected corner have a sharp positive exponential norm on fixed-log root charts, although the separate quad-line coefficients are polynomial. That action must be retained in a geometric comparison. The cyclic conjugation and existence of dilogarithmic gauge action are already established in the [actual Hilbert-90 gauge](actual_hilbert90_gauge_dilogarithm_action.md) and [controlled cyclic source](controlled_cyclic_euler_source.md). They are not counted as new here. The new content is the full dual frame, its cap-compatible four-leg actual kernel, the selected sharp norm scale, and an all-N support obstruction for independent frames. No positive geometric crossing identity or volume limit is claimed. ## 1. The full coherent frame has an explicit dual Use N>=2, d=N-1, q,Q,Z,S,P,L from [the cap-residue theorem](cap_wall_fermat_quad_residue_transport.md). Thus u^N+v^N=w^N, uvw!=0, and P_n=v^n/product_(r=1)^n(w-uQ^r), L_n=v^-n product_(r=0)^(n-1)(w-uQ^r). The N-column coherent frame is M_(n,j)=P_n(uQ^j,v,w), 0<=n,j<N. (1) It has the EXACT inverse (M^-1)_(j,n) =v^N Q^n L_n(uQ^j,v,w) /[N(uQ^j)^(N-1)(w-uQ^j)]. (2) Indeed the columns are eigenvectors of A=Z^-1(wI-vS), with distinct eigenvalues uQ^j. The corresponding left eigenvectors are L(uQ^j,v,w)Z. Different eigenvalues are orthogonal, while their diagonal pairing is L(uQ^j,v,w)Z P(uQ^j,v,w) =N(uQ^j)^(N-1)(w-uQ^j)/v^N. (3) To compute it, sum (w-uQ^j)Q^n/(w-uQ^(j+n)) and use the logarithmic derivative of w^N-u^N. Every factor in (3) is a unit on the chart. This proves (2), including its output clock. ## 2. A cap-normalized circulant, with exact inverse Set w=1 and take u=(1-v^N)^(1/N), u(0)=1. Order the columns by k=-j modulo N. Multiply column k>=1 by v^(N-k)/F_(N-k), and leave column k=0 unchanged. Call the result K(v). The all-cusp residue formulas prove K(0)=I. (4) Extend p_n=P_n(u,v,1) periodically. Put H_(n,k)=p_(n-k), r_0=1, r_k=(uQ;Q)_(N-k)/F_(N-k), 1<=k<N. Then exactly K=H diag(r_k). (5) For P_n(uQ^-k)=p_(n-k)/p_(-k) and p_(-k)=v^(N-k)/(uQ;Q)_(N-k), proving (5). All r_k tend to one, with r_k-1=O(v^N). Thus the FULL head frame, not only one vector, extends invertibly through the actual cap wall. The circulant has an especially simple inverse. For general homogeneous u,v,w, define kappa=v^N/[N u^(N-1)(w-u)], h_n=kappa (v/Q)^n/product_(r=1)^n(w-uQ^-r). Then H^-1_(n,k)=h_(n-k). (6) For a proof, (2) at j=0 gives the zeroth row of the inverse circulant; finite-product reflection gives exactly h_n. Thus (6) is a finite cyclic beta-convolution identity with its WHOLE rational scalar. At the cap branch kappa→1 and H→I. The apparent 0/0 has this prescribed regular extension. The associated known cyclic Weyl shear is exactly H^-1 S H=S, H^-1 Z H=u^-1(wI-vS)Z. (7) It follows from u H(QS)=(w-vS)H(S) and ZH(S)=H(QS)Z. The new clock's Nth power is one precisely because w^N-v^N=u^N. Its compensating root u must not be dropped. ## 3. The original crossing in four Fermat lines Let R be either original mixed crossing, with its original Cartan scalar inside R or in the specified external line. Choose Fermat triples f_i on its two incoming and two outgoing heads. Define R_F=(M_3^-1 tensor M_4^-1)R(M_1 tensor M_2). Equations (1)--(3) give its explicit four-line kernel: (R_F)_(j3,j4;j1,j2) =v3^N v4^N / [N^2 (u3Q^j3)^(N-1)(w3-u3Q^j3) (u4Q^j4)^(N-1)(w4-u4Q^j4)] *sum_(n1,n2,n3,n4) Q^(n3+n4) L_n3(u3Q^j3,v3,w3)L_n4(u4Q^j4,v4,w4) R_(n3,n4;n1,n2) P_n1(u1Q^j1,v1,w1)P_n2(u2Q^j2,v2,w2). (8) The original crossing support reduces this to three independent finite indices. There is no asymptotic substitution or new cap. One can instead use the cap-normalized K frames, or H with the explicit r factors in (5). The four external kernels are then p and the reflected cyclic sources h in (6). At all four cap walls this identity specializes back to the original crossing MATRIX by (4). In a whole plat every interior inverse frame cancels; actual rows, columns, coupons and scalar lines all move. There are two distinct applications. For the original PHYSICAL head R in (8), cups and caps remain their original balanced arrays, transported by these frames; they are not replaced by corner vectors. The literal cup is C_x|d,0>, so the physical transformed cup keeps (K_1^-1 tensor K_2^-1)C_x|d,0>. Alternatively first use the proved pair-fused corner presentation, then apply these head frames to its RELATIVE heads. Its within-pair crossing has four such lines, while its between-pair kernel acts on four relative heads and has eight external lines. The formulas apply to both presentations, but they must not be conflated. The transported Hopf currents are also explicit. On a balanced head of color x, K_head=xZ^-1 and F_head=S(1-QZ); their H images follow by (7). At completeness the original scaled E is the exact cyclic expression S^-1(Z^-1-1). At other colors its original bottom projector must also move. No bare current is left in the old relative frame. Equation (8) is an exact four-line ACTUAL identity. Arbitrary independent f_i are not thereby geometric shared-face data. ## 4. Sharp exponential norms include every selected corner Take canonical unit roots and compatible fixed logarithms u=exp(a/N), v=exp(b/N), w=1, exp(a)+exp(b)=1. Assume the central values stay away from zero and the logarithms in a fixed compact set. Define gamma_*=-integral_0^(1/6)log(2sin(pi t))dt >0. Then lim (1/N)log||H||_2=lim (1/N)log||H^-1||_2=gamma_*, lim (1/N)log cond_2(H)=2gamma_*. (9) The same holds for the cap-normalized frame K. For EVERY corner j=j(N), uniformly in that choice, lim (1/N)log||K e_j||_2=gamma_*, lim (1/N)log||e_j^t K^-1||_2=gamma_*. (10) In the existing figure-eight normalization, gamma_*=Vol(4_1)/(4pi); the integral definition alone suffices. These are the standard Euclidean norms of the explicitly chosen head basis. When used on the actual relative corner presentation, they concern its original corner sources. A further nonunitary physical fusion change needs its own comparison and may not be ignored in a whole physical norm estimate. Here is a complete proof. The elementary marked root-product comparison gives, uniformly in n,k, N^-C/|F_n| <= |p_n|, |h_n| <= N^C/|F_n|, N^-C <= |r_k| <= N^C. (11) For each product the relative logarithmic errors are O(1/min(j,N-j)); their sum is O(log N). The finitely many endpoint ratios have nonzero limits, because the marked central value of u differs from one. For h use (6), the identical inverse-Q factorial magnitude, and the nonzero bounded kappa. The r assertion is the same comparison in (5). The elementary uniform factorial estimate proved in [the full-Euler estimate](full_euler_atom_dilog_and_endpoint_regions.md) is log|F_n|=N J(n/N)+O(log N), J(s)=integral_0^s log(2sin(pi t))dt. Its minimum is J(1/6)=-gamma_* and its maximum is J(5/6)=gamma_*. Consequently max_n 1/|F_n| has rate gamma_*. The norm of an N by N matrix is between its maximum entry magnitude and N times that magnitude. Applied to H and H^-1, this proves (9). Every circulant column is a permutation of p, and every inverse row a permutation of h, so their Euclidean norms have the same rate. The polynomial r factors in (5) prove both claims for K and (10). In particular e_j^t K^-1 K e_j is EXACTLY one, while the product of its selected row and column norms has rate 2gamma_*. This is selected source cancellation, not merely poor conditioning of an unrelated auxiliary module. The polynomial quad-LINE coefficients do not make the FULL frame subexponential. This dilogarithmic action has to enter the geometric phase calculation. There is no contradiction with the cap theorem's fixed-log line bounds: a full raw frame includes uQ^j with bulk j, whose marked logarithms need not stay bounded. Even for fixed-log selected lines, a polynomial transition COEFFICIENT compares two vectors which can both have exponential norm. For comparison, the UNNORMALIZED coherent frame M in (1) is even worse: lim (1/N)log||M||_2 =lim (1/N)log||M^-1||_2=2gamma_*, lim (1/N)log cond_2(M)=4gamma_*. Its largest entry is exactly max|p_n|/min|p_n|, since M_(n,j)=p_(n+j)/p_j. In (2), the inverse entries equal p_j/p_(n+j) times a uniformly polynomial factor, using L_n P_n=(w-u)/(w-uQ^n). The factorial profile proves the displayed limits. The cap column factors in (5) therefore remove part, but not all, of the exponential condition number. Both normalizations must remain explicit in a four-face comparison. ## 5. What tetrahedral variable the principal shear needs For fixed-log roots u,v→1, let the input clock be A, output clock U, and let p be their common wavefunction momentum. S has symbol p^-1. Equation (7) has the principal graph t=U/A=1-p^-1. (12) Its generating action is Li_2(t)-Li_2(1), with the branches inherited from the cyclic product. Differentiation gives p_out=p_in=(1-t)^-1. If p is in the upper half-plane, t is its positive quad rotation. The variable needing a geometric mark is the BULK ratio U/A, not the central Fermat value u^N. The actual momentum has a holonomy meaning. In the existing Gauss coordinates K=x/U, e=(1-x^2/U)p/x, f=(1-U)/p, G=[[K,e],[Kf,fe+K^-1]], direct multiplication gives G(1,p^-1)^t=x^-1(1,p^-1)^t. (13) Thus p^-1 is the selected meridian eigenflag in that frame. The other three reference flags must still be identified with the actual shared developing flags to make (12) a geometric tetrahedron. A single eigenflag/source ratio does not establish that four-face comparison. The action's existence is already known; its exact four-leg source and scale (9)--(10) are the new comparison information here. ## 6. Independent line frames cannot be one basic tetrahedron There is an all-N support obstruction to a naive reading of (8). Take four INDEPENDENT cap parameters z_i with u_i=(1-z_i^N)^(1/N), v_i=z_i, w_i=1 and H frames. Every entry of (H_3^-1 tensor H_4^-1)R(H_1 tensor H_2) is a NONZERO algebraic germ. For input (a,b) and output (c,e), let r=-a mod N and s=-b mod N in the head range. The coefficient of z_1^r z_2^s z_3^c z_4^e is uniquely the original route with both intermediate R indices (0,0). It equals R_(00,00) (-1)^(c+e)Q^[c(c-1)/2+e(e-1)/2] /[F_r F_s F_c F_e], (14) which is nonzero with the original Cartan line retained. Each degree is less than N, so no central correction to u_i enters. The four cyclic shifts fix both intermediate indices uniquely, which proves (14) with no possible cancellation. The basic matrix tetrahedron kernel instead has strict support delta i+j=l modulo N, hence only N^3 potential nonzero entries. Independent diagonal face gauges and Weyl index permutations preserve that support count. Therefore this generic four-line actual kernel cannot be a SINGLE such tetrahedron under those changes. Coupled shared-face parameters, additional shears, or several tetrahedra are necessary. This does not exclude a genuine four-face geometric identity. It states precisely what (8) alone lacks. Proving actual shared developing-flag relations, with their full source and phase, remains the next comparison; no broad volume claim follows here. ## 7. Reproducible checks The [audit](../experiments/audit_actual_four_line_fermat_crossing.py) and [saved output](../experiments/actual_four_line_fermat_crossing_results.json) pass 56 full coherent/circulant frames at N=2,...,8, including the dual inverse, exact nonlinear clock transport and all column normalizations. They check 56 mixed positive/negative original crossing entries by an independent sum using the literal E and Cartan coefficients, with the full four-line kernel retained. The 8,771 support witness coefficients are nonzero at every matrix position in these levels. Five norm-scale diagnostics through N=256 approach the limits in (9)--(10); the limits are proved by the uniform product estimates, not those samples.

title: The saturated four-port factorial action is a hyperideal tetrahedron volume
text: # The saturated four-port factorial action is a hyperideal tetrahedron volume 29 October 2026. The positive FACE-NORMALIZED Racah partition has an explicit local geometric action. Six folded Casimir labels determine the six dihedral angles of a truncated hyperideal tetrahedron; the four supported face sums are precisely its four vertex-angle conditions. The optimized action equals its actual hyperbolic volume divided by pi. This is proved here from a Lorentz Gram construction, finite rational identities and a direct first-variation calculation. No asymptotic 6j volume theorem is an input. The face normalization is essential. This note does not identify an arbitrary physical recoupling energy with that normalization, discard high partners/normals, or infer a global knot triangulation from one local tetrahedron. The actual four-port source kernel and its weighting must be matched separately. ## 1. The exact local angle dictionary and positive scalar action Order the six colors as (a,b,c,d,e,f). The four vertex triples and three opposite quadrilateral sums are F=(a+b+e, c+d+e, a+d+f, b+c+f), Q=(a+b+c+d, a+c+e+f, b+d+e+f). (1) For the geometric theorem first take real scaled colors in 0<a,b,c,d,e,f<1/2, every F_i>1. (2) Put alpha_a=pi-2pi a, and similarly for the other five. These angles are in (0,pi), and at each of the four indicated vertices sum_incident alpha=3pi-2pi F_i<pi. (3) Thus each vertex will be hyperideal, with a geodesic polar truncation triangle of area pi-sum alpha=2pi(F_i-1). All triangle deficits F_i-2(color in that face) are strictly between 0 and 1. The source-compatible quantum scaling is EXACTLY a=(j_a+1/2)/N, alpha_a=pi-(2j_a+1)pi/N, c_(j_a)=q^(2j_a+1)+q^(-2j_a-1)=-2cos alpha_a. (4) If the six folded integer labels are <=floor((N-1)/2) and every face sum is >=N-1, then (3) is at most pi-pi/N. Its truncation triangle area is (2pi/N)(faceSum-(N-1)+1/2). The only zero edge angles are the odd simple Steinberg labels. They are treated by continuous limiting geometry, not as strictly positive interior tetrahedral angles. These are internal Casimir angle coordinates; (4) is not an auxiliary-meridian identification. Let L(t)=integral_0^t log|2sin pi u|du, with period 1. On the interval max F_i<Z<min Q_k define A(Z)=L(Z-1)-sum_(i=1)^4 L(Z-F_i) -sum_(k=1)^3 L(Q_k-Z), M=(1/2)sum_faces [sum_(edges in face)L(F_i-2edge)-L(F_i-1)], Psi=max_Z A(Z)+M. (5) The interval is nonempty: every Q_k-F_i is a positive triangle deficit from one of the other faces. It lies in (1,2). For reference the finite positive scalar producing (5) is R_N=N sum_(max faceSum<=z<=min quadSum) s_(z-(N-1)) / {product_faces s_(z-faceSum) product_quads s_(quadSum-z)}, D_face=product_(edges in face)s_(faceSum-2edge) /[N s_(faceSum-(N-1))], W_N=R_N sqrt(product_faces D_face). (6) All factors in (6) are positive. It is the root of the explicitly normalized squared generic factorial expression, not the bare Racah sum. The phase-coherent root sum follows because its numerator has exactly one [N] zero and its seven denominator indices are <N. The finite phase/metric statements are proved in [the supported Racah theorem](actual_supported_racah_common_phase_and_normal_metric.md). For the shifted scaled variables (4), use Z=(z+7/4)/N: Z-F_i=(z-faceSum+1/4)/N, Q_k-Z=(quadSum-z+1/4)/N. Uniform all-index factorial estimates then give (5) as the limiting logarithmic action, with O(log N) endpoint errors. The geometric identification of this action is independent of a proposed source normalization. At six colors 1/3 the bare optimized A is 3v3/pi, whereas Psi=v3/pi; omitting M would already give the wrong volume. In these conventions log W_N/N has action Psi; the SQUARED weight W_N^2 has action 2Psi. That factor must be retained in a later energy or doubled-source comparison. ## 2. An own existence/uniqueness construction of the tetrahedron Number the vertices by the four triples in (1). The edge endpoints are a:13, b:14, c:24, d:23, e:12, f:34. Let n_i be its four outward face normals, face i opposite vertex i. Their prescribed Lorentz Gram matrix is G_ii=1, G_12=-cos alpha_f, G_13=-cos alpha_c, G_14=-cos alpha_d, G_23=-cos alpha_b, G_24=-cos alpha_a, G_34=-cos alpha_e. (7) We prove that G has signature (3,1), rather than assuming an angle realization theorem. Every three-by-three principal minor corresponds to three angles A,B,C at a vertex, A+B+C<pi. Its determinant is -4 cos((A+B+C)/2)cos((A+B-C)/2) cos((A-B+C)/2)cos((-A+B+C)/2)<0. (8) Its two-by-two minors are sin^2(alpha)>0, so that block has signature (2,1) and can be realized in Lorentz three-space. Its inverse has all entries negative: its off-diagonal cofactors have numerator cos C+cos A cos B>sin A sin B>0 and its determinant is negative. If the three inner products of the fourth normal with this block are nonpositive, its projection to the block has nonpositive square. Adding a new spacelike coordinate makes its square one, with a nonzero fourth component. This constructs G with signature (3,1). Otherwise choose a nonacute dihedral A>=pi/2 among these products and call its two normals n_0,n_1. At most two dihedrals can be nonacute, and two such edges must be opposite, because any two meeting at a vertex have sum <pi. The other products of n_0 are -cos B,-cos C, and those of n_1 are -cos D,-cos E. The three old normals have last mutual angle F, with D+E+F<pi. The vertex conditions imply B+D<pi-A, C+E<pi-A. In n_1-perpendicular Lorentz space define m_2=(n_2+cos D n_1)/sin D, m_3=(n_3+cos E n_1)/sin E, <m_2,m_3>=-(cos F+cos D cos E)/(sin D sin E)<-1. Write n_0=(-cos A)n_1+sin A u. The two required products of u with m_2,m_3 are both <-1: for example <u,m_2>=(-cos B-cos A cos D)/(sin A sin D)<-1. The inverse Gram matrix of m_2,m_3 has every entry negative. Thus their prescribed negative-product projection of u has negative square. An additional spacelike coordinate again makes u^2=1 and constructs the fourth normal independently. This proves det G<0 throughout (2), including the possible two opposite obtuse edges. Let C=adj(G). Its diagonal entries are negative by (8), so the dual vectors v_i=-sum_j(G^-1)_ij n_j have positive squares. Their off-diagonal products are strictly negative. Indeed Jacobi's minor identity gives (G^-1)_ii(G^-1)_jj-(G^-1)_ij^2 =sin^2(alpha_complement)/det G<0. No off-diagonal inverse entry can therefore vanish. The angle domain is convex and connected, and at a small regular angle all those entries are negative; continuity fixes their sign everywhere. Normalize the v_i to square one. Every pair has product <-1, so their projective edge crosses the Klein ball. Their sum is timelike, and has negative product with every v_i. It supplies an interior point of the four face halfspaces AND the four vertex-polar halfspaces. Cutting the six projective edges by those polar planes gives twelve finite hyperbolic vertices. Each lies strictly on the proper side of the other two polar planes, by the negative products. The result is a compact convex truncated tetrahedron, with four triangular polar faces and four right-angled hexagonal original faces. Its six original dihedrals are (7); every new truncation edge is right-angled. There are no assumed end or completeness conditions in this compact local construction. Its ordered face-normal Gram fixes it up to isometry. For an explicit compactness check, suppose a remaining point were ideal and write it in the vertex cone as x=sum_i t_i v_i, t_i>=0. The polar inequalities <x,v_i><=0 and x^2=0 force <x,v_i>=0 on every active coefficient. This would put the nonzero active vector t in the kernel of its principal vertex Gram block. All such blocks are nonsingular: their determinants are complementary principal minors of G divided by det G (size one and two were checked above; size three uses G_ii=1). Thus no ideal point remains after truncation. The length along original edge a, between its polar truncations, is ell_a=arccosh[ C_13/sqrt(C_11 C_33) ]>0. (9) The cofactor in (9) is positive since det G<0 and (G^-1)_13<0. The formula follows by restricting to the Lorentz plane spanned by its two normalized hyperideal endpoints. Other edges are obtained by vertex relabeling. ## 3. The optimized derivative is EXACTLY that truncated edge length Here is a finite rational certificate for the derivative, with all branches fixed by the positive interval. Set u_a=exp(2pi i a), etc., P=product_edges u. Let U_i be the four products of u on the faces in (1), and V_k the three products on the quads. Then product U_i=product V_k=P^2. Write n=exp(2pi i Z). The stationarity equation A'(Z)=0 is exactly (n-1)product_k(n-V_k)-product_i(n-U_i) =n(A2 n^2+A1 n+A0)=0, A2=sum U_i-1-sum V_k, A1=sum_(k<l)V_kV_l+sum V_k-sum_(i<j)U_iU_j, A0=sum_(i<j<l)U_iU_jU_l-P^2-sum_(k<l)V_kV_l. (10) Expansion gives the independent identity A1^2-4A2A0=16P^2 det G. (11) In (11), G has off-diagonals cos(2pi color), which is exactly (7). Also A0=P^2 conjugate(A2) and A1/P is real. Thus the two roots of (10) are distinct and on the unit circle. A2 cannot vanish, since that would make (11)/P^2 a nonnegative real square instead of 16det G<0. The function A' tends to +infinity at the lower positive interval endpoint and to -infinity at the upper one. It is continuous inside, and (10) permits at most two simple critical points there. The number is odd, so there is EXACTLY one, Z_*. It is a strict global maximum, with nonzero negative second derivative. This also fixes a smooth selected branch on the entire connected domain (2). For edge a let B(n)=u_c (n-U_1)(n-U_3)/[(n-V_1)(n-V_2)], R_a= sin pi(a+e-b)sin pi(a+b-e) /[sin pi(b+e-a)sin pi(F_1-1)] *sin pi(a+f-d)sin pi(a+d-f) /[sin pi(d+f-a)sin pi(F_3-1)]. All displayed sines in R_a are positive. Differentiating (5) at its selected stationary Z_* gives E_a:=exp(partial_a Psi)=B(n_*)sqrt(R_a)>0. (12) To verify (12), the bare derivative is the ratio of the two sin(Z-F) factors to the two sin(Q-Z) factors incident to a. Their canceled phase is u_c. The four face derivatives give R_a. Let n_+,n_- be the two roots of (10). Direct rational products give B(n_+)B(n_-)=1/R_a, B(n_+)+B(n_-)=C_13/(2K_a), K_a=sin pi(a+e-b)sin pi(a+b-e) sin pi(a+f-d)sin pi(a+d-f), sqrt(C_11 C_33) sqrt(R_a)=4K_a. (13) These are uniform algebraic identities, not tests at selected colors. For an explicit cleared-polynomial verification, put A=-A1-A2(U_1+U_3), B=A2 U_1U_3-A0, C=-A1-A2(V_1+V_2), D=A2 V_1V_2-A0, Den=C^2 A0-CD A1+D^2 A2. The sum/product of the two B(n) are respectively u_c[2AC A0-(AD+BC)A1+2BD A2]/Den, u_c^2[A^2 A0-AB A1+B^2 A2]/Den. With edge variables written a,...,f temporarily for u_a,...,u_f, the claimed product is (be-a)(abe-1)(df-a)(adf-1) /[(ae-b)(ab-e)(af-d)(ad-f)], and the claimed sum is 8a^2bdef C_13 /[(ae-b)(ab-e)(af-d)(ad-f)]. Substitute (10), multiply these explicit denominators, and expand: both polynomial differences are identically zero in six independent variables. The final identity in (13) is the elementary three-face Gram determinant (8), with its sine factors. The accompanying audit performs these symbolic zero checks; no interpolation is involved. Consequently the two possible E_a values are reciprocal and have sum 2C_13/sqrt(C_11C_33). They are exp(+ell_a), exp(-ell_a). Near the regular ideal limit all colors approach 1/3 from above; the metric factor in (12) diverges while its bare ratio remains finite and positive. Thus the selected E_a is the positive-length branch there. It cannot change branch on (2), since ell_a never vanishes. By connectedness and tetrahedral relabeling, partial_edge Psi=ell_edge for all six edges. (14) ## 4. An elementary volume-variation proof and its constant For completeness the needed first variation can be derived directly. On the hyperboloid the coordinate vector restricted to a totally geodesic face satisfies Delta_face x=2x. It follows by differentiating the usual cosh/sinh coordinates on H^2. A face with moving outward unit normal n has normal speed -<dot n,x>. The divergence theorem within that face therefore gives dot V=-(1/2)sum_faces sum_edges integral_edge <dot n,nu_edge> ds. For an edge between face normals n_i,n_j and angle alpha, the outward conormal within face i is (n_j+cos alpha n_i)/sin alpha. Adding its two face contributions uses d<n_i,n_j>=sin alpha d alpha, and gives dV=-(1/2)sum_edges ell_edge d alpha_edge. (15) The new truncation edges have fixed angle pi/2, hence contribute zero. Using alpha=pi-2pi color, (15) becomes dV=pi sum ell_edge d(color). Equations (14),(15) show that V-pi Psi is constant on the connected domain (2). Calibrate at the regular ideal boundary a=...=f=1/3. Then F_i=1, Q_k=4/3, Z_*=7/6, and A(Z_*)=-6L(1/6)=3v3/pi, M=6L(1/3)=-2v3/pi, Psi=v3/pi. (16) The Lobachevsky duplication identity gives Lambda(pi/6)=(3/2)Lambda(pi/3), so (16) has no numerical calibration. The Gram construction converges to the regular ideal tetrahedron, whose volume is v3=3Lambda(pi/3). One can justify volume convergence here without a realization or rigidity theorem. For the regular family take fixed Euclidean regular tetrahedral unit vectors t_i with mutual products -1/3 and use n_i=(T,S t_i), T^2=(3cos alpha-1)/4, S^2=1+T^2. At alpha=pi/3 their Klein faces have distance 1/3 from the center, giving the four ideal vertices -t_i. The finite polar truncation vertices converge to those same vertices. Here are exact uniform end inequalities. Set c=cos alpha, t=T/S and rho=3t=sqrt((9c-3)/(c+1))>1. The projective hyperideal vertex at -t_i is rho(-t_i). In a fixed upper-half-space frame sending w=-t_i to infinity, its polar cut is |z|^2+y^2<=(rho+1)/(rho-1). For every incident j!=i, t_j dot w=1/3. Its original face inequality therefore gives exactly 2(t_j)_perp dot z <=(t+1/3)+(t-1/3)(|z|^2+y^2) <=2(rho+1)/3. The three fixed perpendicular normals surround the origin at angles 120 degrees. Hence |z|<=C uniformly as rho decreases to 1. The cross-sectional area is bounded, and its volume above y=Y is <=C/Y^2. Do this in the four disjoint ideal-end frames; the remaining compact regions converge. This proves volume convergence to the ideal tetrahedron and fixes the constant in (15), with no O(epsilon) end estimate left as an assumption. We have therefore proved the LOCAL GEOMETRIC IDENTITY pi Psi(a,b,c,d,e,f)=Vol(truncated hyperideal tetrahedron). (17) Both sides extend continuously to the closed angle chamber. For Psi this follows directly from continuity of L and maximization on a continuously varying compact interval. The corresponding geometric extension is the limit from the interior; no assertion that every boundary point retains a nondegenerate truncated-tetrahedron cell is needed. In particular at six colors 1/2, Z_*=7/4 and Psi=v8/pi; the six original edge lengths tend to zero at the escaping ideal corners. The limiting cell is the regular ideal octahedron, not a tetrahedron with positive edges. One can check its geometry directly: G=2I-J and its four normalized polar normals are m_i=-n_i+(1/2)sum_j n_j. Then distinct n_i,n_j and distinct m_i,m_j have product -1, while <n_i,m_j> is -2 for i=j and zero otherwise. These are exactly the eight regular-octahedron face normals (1,sigma_1,sigma_2,sigma_3)/sqrt(2), partitioned by the product of the three signs. Thus the octahedral constant is attached to an explicit geometric cell, not only a limiting dilogarithm number. ## 5. Exact stationarity data, and what a global source still needs The local action supplies more than a constant fit. The colors give the actual face-normal Gram (7), its polar triangle areas are (3), and the optimized derivatives are the six metric edge lengths (14). For a specified gluing of such cells, (15) gives its first variation on EVERY allowed dihedral-angle tangent, not merely on a chosen one-parameter source family. In particular variations exchanging two angles around one fixed total-angle edge force equality of their corresponding truncated lengths. More generally a linear constraint matrix C gives the exact stationarity condition length vector in image(C^T). (18) If the ONLY angle constraints are sums around actual common edges, (18) forces one common length per glued edge. Three such matched alternating lengths determine a right-angled hexagon by elementary hyperbolic cosine laws, so the prescribed original hexagonal faces then match isometrically. Actual angle sums, link degree/winding, boundary markings and end completeness must still be checked. Additional source constraints can reduce the tangent space, and then stationarity in that smaller space does not imply this full metric gluing. No global strict-concavity or complete-manifold maximum theorem is asserted solely from the local derivative identity. There is a concrete obstruction to using just the four support inequalities as a complete volume-maximization certificate. Equation (14) gives partial_edge Psi>0 at every strict point. Increasing any color preserves those four inequalities. Along the line toward six colors 1/2, Psi therefore increases to v8/pi. By continuity that is the maximum over the CLOSED support chamber, and there is NO interior stationary point under only these inequalities. A geometric interior critical point for a larger graph needs the actual additional edge constraints, boundary potentials or their full source counterparts; the local face supports alone do not supply them. The [generic actual four-port theorem](actual_general_four_port_single_racah_kernel.md) now gives an explicit separable row/column gauge relating its literal inverse kernel L_(G,E) to the seven-factorial sum S. Its four Delta face factors give exactly the normalization in (6) after root-zero removal. Thus this finite scalar/generic normalization is explicit; it is not being taken from a named 6j evaluation. But identifying the resulting weight with a useful FULL marked-source Cauchy energy still requires controlled gauge transport, complete colliding partners and root normals, and the graph's actual port/edge incidence in (18). No individual partner value or semisimple normalization may replace that comparison. The bare Racah term is already wrong at the regular ideal tetrahedron by the factor in (16). ## 6. Uniform local quantum-volume theorem, including moving boundary colors The geometry identity has the following UNIFORM finite-level consequence. There is an absolute constant C such that, for EVERY N and every six folded integer labels satisfying all four face sums >=N-1, the positive normalized scalar W_N in (6) obeys |log W_N-(N/pi)Vol_ext(T(a_N))|<=C log(N+1), a_(N,edge)=(j_edge+1/2)/N. (19) The domain is empty at any level with no supported sextuple. The symbol Vol_ext is the continuous geometric extension of (17); at strict angles it is the ordinary compact truncated-tetrahedron volume, while zero-angle boundary cells are interpreted by their geometric limits. Constants in (19) do not depend on a distance from any face, edge, corner or the octahedral endpoint. Both level parities and composite N are included. Here is the full uniform estimate. Write F_i^int,Q_k^int for the integer forms (1), z_-=max F_i^int and z_+=min Q_k^int. All true factorial indices are in [0,N-1]. The elementary uniform estimate log s_n=N L(n/N)+O(log(N+1)), 0<=n<=N-1, has an absolute constant. Applying it to the fixed eight factorials in each positive R_N term changes its logarithm by O(log N). At its actual point Z_z=(z+7/4)/N, the action arguments differ from those true indices divided by N by exactly numerator: 3/(4N), each of seven denominators: 1/(4N). For a face metric the three deficits and its excess differ by exactly 1/(2N). The shifted and original arguments are all in [0,1]. The uniform modulus |L(t+epsilon)-L(t)| <=C0 |epsilon|(1+|log|epsilon||) therefore changes N times these actions by O(log N), including when an original factorial index is zero. The explicit N factors in R_N and D_face add only O(log N). The geometric maximization interval is I=[(z_-+3/2)/N,(z_++2)/N], whereas the true grid runs from (z_-+7/4)/N to (z_++7/4)/N in steps 1/N. Its first and last points are inset by exactly 1/(4N) from the two respective endpoints. Every point of I is within 1/N of a true grid point, even when z_-=z_+. The same modulus of L, now for its eight action terms, shows that the continuous maximum and the true-grid maximum differ by O(log N/N), uniformly. There are at most N positive terms: z_+-z_-<=N-1 by the complementary triangle-deficit bounds. The largest term bounds their sum from below, and N times it bounds the sum from above. Thus log W_N=N Psi(a_N)+O(log N) with one universal error constant. Equation (17) proves (19). No nonzero Hessian, separation from a boundary, selected complex cycle or asymptotic interpolation of an unobserved normal was used in this argument. In particular ANY convergent supported color sequence a_N->a in the closed chamber satisfies lim (pi/N)log W_N=Vol_ext(T(a)). (20) This is a genuine broad LOCAL quantum-volume theorem for the explicitly gauged scalar/residue. Its squared weight has twice the logarithmic action. It does not turn (19) into a full marked recoupling norm or authorize replacing a partner germ by its positive value core; those source requirements in section 5 remain. Audit: [universal rational certificates and local geometry](../experiments/audit_actual_four_port_hyperideal_angle_volume.py), with [recorded results](../experiments/actual_four_port_hyperideal_angle_volume_results.json). It verifies four symbolic identities in six independent edge variables, all six derivative/Gram lengths in regular, unequal and opposite-obtuse chambers, three independent direct regular geometric volume integrals, and the exact half-step angle ranges at eight full physical levels. Finite profiles check normalization; the uniform proof is the Gram construction, symbolic identities and first variation above. The range audit also verifies all shifted factorial arguments, exact quarter-grid endpoint insets and the <=N positive-term count in (19). The four-port theorem has the stated selected positive-length sheet and source scope; it is not a general graph-energy estimate. The scalar consequence (19) uses the supported Racah theorem with its half-step shifts and boundary-uniform constants. It does not extend the low-fold jet estimate to the retained partner current.

title: What a Tauberian argument would need from the original positive Fourier energy
text: # What a Tauberian argument would need from the original positive Fourier energy 28 October 2026. The positive Fourier energy is the right actual object for testing an Abelian/Tauberian approach. It permits elementary, self-contained statements about its Laplace transform and its exponential rate. Positivity alone identifies a limsup, however; it does not force the volume limit or suppress exceptional low levels. The results below give a precise additional cross-level condition that WOULD turn a critical Laplace singularity into the full original volume limit. No such cross-level condition or sharp singularity has yet been derived from the actual A-source. This is a criterion and a source-scope audit, not a proof of the conjecture. ## 1. The exact original energy and its existing bound Use the original unitary color Fourier transform and original reduced normalization from [the independently audited Plancherel identity](ordinary_color_plancherel_bound_audit.md). For every fixed knot presentation, E_N=sum_k |chat_(N,k)|²=|K_N|²+R_N, 1<=R_N<=N^B, N>=2, (1) with a fixed constant/power allowed in the upper bound. Every pivot, Cartan and framing factor is retained. The ordinary-color remainder is the original remainder, not a positive replacement model. Thus log E_N=log(1+|K_N|²)+O(log N). (2) For any fixed lambda>0, log E_N/N ->lambda iff (2pi/N)log|K_N| ->pi*lambda. (3) In particular the desired energy exponent is lambda=Vol/pi. The [direct ordinary-color coefficient bound](actual_regular_fast_color_elimination.md) gives, for an ell-crossing b-braid, ||C_j||_1<=j^(ell+b-1)4^(ell*j). Taking j=N and using (1) proves E_N<=exp(CN) for a fixed C. This provides an actual nonempty convergence half-plane for the positive Laplace series Z(s)=sum_(N>=2) E_N exp(-sN). (4) It does not identify its sharp convergence boundary geometrically. ## 2. The abscissa gives exactly the exponential limsup Put lambda*=limsup_N log(E_N)/N, finite and nonnegative. Then (4) converges for real s>lambda* and diverges for s<lambda*. Indeed, for s>lambda*, choose epsilon<(s-lambda*). Eventually E_N<=exp((lambda*+epsilon)N), so comparison with a geometric series proves convergence. For s<lambda*, infinitely many terms satisfy E_N>=exp((s+epsilon)N), so the terms of (4) do not even tend to zero. The convergence boundary itself can be convergent or divergent. Consequently a source-derived proof that Z(s) is finite for every s>Vol/pi would give the sharp original exponential UPPER bound. Locating its abscissa at Vol/pi would identify the corresponding limsup. Positivity makes these implications exact, but does not compute the abscissa. Merely naming the abscissa is not an estimate. ## 3. A power singularity gives a genuine cumulative Tauberian conclusion Here is a special case sufficient to explain the Karamata-type idea, proved independently rather than assumed. Suppose, for lambda>0, alpha>0 and C>0, an actual calculation establishes Z(lambda+t) ~ C t^(-alpha), t down to0. (5) Then A(x):=sum_(2<=N<=x) exp(-lambda N)E_N ~ C x^alpha/Gamma(alpha+1). (6) Proof. Write a_N=exp(-lambda N)E_N>=0 and define finite positive measures on x>=0 by nu_t=(t^alpha/C) sum_N a_N exp(-tN) delta_(tN). For each integer k>=0 their Laplace moments satisfy integral exp(-kx)dnu_t =(t^alpha/C)Z(lambda+(k+1)t)->(k+1)^(-alpha). (7) Under y=exp(-x), these are ordinary polynomial moments on [0,1]. The candidate limit has x-density exp(-x)x^(alpha-1)/Gamma(alpha); its moments are exactly (7), by the defining Gamma integral. Polynomial moment convergence implies convergence against every continuous function on [0,1]: Bernstein polynomials approximate such a function uniformly, since uniform continuity and the binomial variance bound force the approximation error to zero. The measures' total masses tend to one, so the uniform approximation error is uniform in t. This proves the claimed weak convergence without a separate Tauberian theorem. The bounded function y^-1 times the indicator y>=exp(-1) has just one jump, at a point with zero limit mass. Approximate it from above and below by continuous functions. Hence (t^alpha/C)A(1/t) ->integral_0^1 x^(alpha-1)/Gamma(alpha)dx =1/Gamma(alpha+1), which proves (6). An immediate useful consequence is that HIGH-ENERGY LEVELS OCCUR IN EVERY FIXED MULTIPLICATIVE WINDOW: for each delta in(0,1), A(n)-A((1-delta)n) ~ C[1-(1-delta)^alpha] n^alpha/Gamma(alpha+1)>0. (8) Thus no fixed proportional interval can avoid all near-rate levels. Also the UNTILTED cumulative energy S(n)=sum_(N<=n)E_N obeys log S(n)/n ->lambda. (9) For the upper bound S(n)<=exp(lambda n)A(n). For the lower bound, use (8) and exp(lambda(1-delta)n), then let delta decrease to zero. Equations (6),(8),(9) are stronger than a bare limsup. They still do not prove log E_N/N->lambda for every individual N. ## 4. An operative cross-level condition completing the implication The following one-sided source-transport condition suffices. Suppose there are fixed delta0>0, L>=0 and A0>=0 such that, for every large n, E_(n-r)<=n^A0 exp(Lr) E_n, 0<=r<=delta0*n. (10) It prevents an exponentially deep drop from preceding nearby levels; it does not assert positivity of the original unsquared period. An exact source-preserving map between the relevant positive Fourier spaces, with norm at most n^(A0/2)exp(Lr/2), would prove (10). Then the cumulative exponential law (9) implies log E_n/n ->lambda. (11) To prove it, fix 0<delta<delta0. Since lambda>0, (9) gives S(n)-S((1-delta)n)=exp(lambda n+o(n)). By (10) this difference is at most n^(A0+1)exp(L delta n)E_n. Hence liminf log E_n/n>=lambda-Ldelta. Let delta decrease to zero; the upper bound E_n<=S(n) proves (11). Combining (3),(5),(10) therefore proves the original volume limit with V=pi*lambda. An O(1) bound on each negative neighboring log-increment implies (10). In contrast, a polynomial comparison at ONE neighboring step, E_(n-1)<=n^A E_n, accumulates to exp(O(r log n)); it does not imply (10). Such a weak comparison allows narrow exponentially deep dips. It cannot be substituted into this proof without further control. The power singularity (5) is itself a substantial averaged asymptotic. It is stronger information than the convergence abscissa. Neither (5) nor (10) is being inferred from positivity or from an algebraic classical characteristic. ## 5. What the current actual source does and does not supply The available exact A-equation transports COLOR j at a fixed q: sum_i a_i(q,-q^j) C_(j+i)(q)=0. The energy E_N changes the color range, the Hilbert-space dimension, AND the parameter q_N when N changes. The fixed-q recurrence does not provide an operator from the level n-r Fourier space to the level n Fourier space. The quantum-group coproduct is also at fixed q. Connected-sum multiplication changes the KNOT at a fixed level; it is not a submultiplicative relation in the LEVEL N. The verified cross-level polynomial rigidity of the color family identifies that family, but gives no norm estimate of the form (10). There is a concrete actual-source reason not to replace this missing level map by uniform continuity of a fixed-color polynomial in q. For 4_1, its exact Newton formula gives C_N(q_(N+1))=1 for EVERY N: at that root the evaluation node Q^N+Q^-N equals the first node Q+Q^-1, so all positive Newton indices vanish. The same fixed color at q_N is K_N. Thus a q-displacement of order N^-2 can cross the entire high-color boundary response. This does not disprove (10) for the COMPLETE level energies E_N,E_(N+1); it shows why fixed-q pointing and low-color derivative estimates do not supply it. Likewise each exact pointed Gram ratio is positive at its own level. It has not been rewritten as the moments of one fixed positive transfer operator across levels, nor as a positive renewal equation with a specified spectral edge. Either construction, with the original source and nonzero edge weight verified, could supply Tauberian input. The existing level-dependent Gram identity does not. There is even a small exact original hyperbolic-source warning against assuming cross-level moment/log-convex structure for raw E_N. For 4_1, the independently proved whole-source formula gives K_2=5, K_3=13, K_4=27, R_2=1, R_3=2, R_4=3, E_2=26, E_3=171, E_4=732. Thus E_2 E_4-E_3²=-10209<0. (12) So positivity within each Fourier space does not imply positivity of the cross-level Hankel matrix, or a raw positive moment representation of E_(n+2). This does not exclude an eventual inequality, a known polynomial normalization, or a different source-derived transfer. It simply prevents assuming that structure from Plancherel alone. ## 6. A minimal counterexample to positivity-only inference For any lambda>0, let E_N=exp(lambda N) at even N and E_N=1 at odd N. This is NOT a knot counterexample. Its purpose is to check the exact logical strength of the proposed Tauberian inference. It satisfies Z(lambda+t)~1/(2t), A(x)~x/2, log S(n)/n->lambda, but log E_N/N alternates between lambda and0. It violates (10). Thus even the pure-pole singularity and positivity leave an individual-level survival condition to establish. The useful next target is consequently a SOURCE-DERIVED positive Laplace/renewal description or a cross-level comparison such as (10). Neither is currently available. A Tauberian argument can use those inputs efficiently; it cannot create them or resolve the geometric branch coupling by itself. Reproduce the exact source warning and the positive-sequence checks: ```sh python3 experiments/audit_actual_fourier_energy_tauberian.py ``` Coverage only: this is the classical positive-measure Tauberian setting; see [Michael Taylor, Karamata's Tauberian Theorem](https://mtaylor.web.unc.edu/wp-content/uploads/sites/16915/2020/07/karamata.pdf). Section 3 supplies its own moment proof for the precise power-law case used here; no quoted theorem supplies the missing knot-source inputs.

title: Actual Fourier polarization gives a nonzero geometric normal block
text: # Actual Fourier polarization gives a nonzero geometric normal block Research theorem, 27 October 2026. Fourier-transforming the SECOND physical cut, while retaining the original first-cut rank-one row, gives an exact new partial family for the original root state. Its specified proper finite-array lift has a nonzero geometric formal Gaussian block. The two external coordinates are the first physical position and the second Fourier label. They correspond to (A,p_e), which is birational on the complete discrete-faithful framing torsor. The displayed source is the ACTUAL finite sum over both external labels. A subsequent root Ward reduction fixes the first input and retains only the Fourier-label sum, as described below. Neither source is the residue eta=0 of the old band variable. No selected global geometric contribution or volume conjecture follows from the existence of this local block. ## 1. Exact finite polarization and the unchanged selected source Use the literal four-port tensor T_(c,d;a,b) from [the two physical cuts](actual_two_cut_framing_port_reconstruction.md). All original pivots, caps, Cartan/framing lines, meridian marks and the full peripheral factor stay in T or its recorded external line. The second cut is an identity wire, with no new pivot. At level N put Q_N=exp(2pi*i/N) and V_(j,b)=Q_N^(jb), (V^-1)_(b,j)=Q_N^(-jb)/N, T^V=(I tensor V)T(I tensor V^-1). Keep the original first-cut row: define the RAW partial array Jtilde_(a,j)=sum_c T^V_(c,j;a,j). (1) Then finite basis invariance of the identity closure proves EXACTLY P_N(M)=(1/N)sum_(a,j=0)^(N-1) Jtilde_(a,j). (2) The first factor 1/N is the original cut average. The inverse Fourier matrix contributes another 1/N INSIDE Jtilde. Neither is silently removed or treated as a second physical pivotal trace. Here P_N denotes the originally selected scalar with its chosen reduced/full external line; the original pointing at completeness and every external d_N factor are unchanged on the two sides. For a conserving tangle c+d=a+b, put q=d-b. Formula (1) becomes Jtilde_(a,j)=(1/N)sum_(b,q) Q_N^(jq) T_(a-q,b+q;a,b). (3) All four original head bounds are retained by zero extension. Crucially c is summed in (1), not set to a. A double diagonal at BOTH cuts would impose q=0 and lose the new Fourier label. The [whole Vandermonde construction](actual_two_cut_fourier_polarization_and_cap.md) retains the actual generic inverse, source, normal connection and endpoint carries. For the stationary construction here specify also the proper ROOT LIFT obtained from (3) by using Q^(jq)/N off root. It equals (1) at every original root. Off root this kernel is generally DIFFERENT from V(Q)^-1, and its total external sum need not equal the original whole q-germ. This distinction is retained; no equality of their higher q-normal source jets is inferred. ## 2. The open phase is made from the original finite coefficients Let the braid have m crossings. The old two-position array has external labels (a,b) and r=m-1 remaining cycle flows u. Opening the two ports with balanced offset (-q,+q) adds one boundary-flow parameter. A spanning tree in the connected remaining graph gives an integral particular flow linear in q; the same internal cycle coordinates u remain. No lattice index or hidden determinant occurs. Every original position/transfer is consequently an integral affine function of (a,b,q,u). Substitute these functions into the original finite factorial/Cartan coefficients. Their compact formal expansion therefore defines a genuine open phase germ S_open(a_log,b_log,t,u_log), t=Hq, a_log=Ha, b_log=Hb, H=Log Q, and the actual nonzero amplitude with all half-step and source lines. The variable compact arguments must stay in the established regular shape chart. At t=0 this is exactly the old closed coefficient model. This construction uses its WHOLE finite-product expressions, not an unjustified summation of fixed-offset asymptotic formulas. The actual boundary proper-ratio calculation in the two-cut theorem gives on the closed geometric critical surface partial_t S_open=Log p_e. (4) The balanced exchange lowers the first output and raises the second; the first-cut wave momentum is one in its original constant boundary frame. Hence (4) has the stated sign and contains the original factorial-boundary adapter. Flattened logarithms and peripheral signs are those of the original marked critical correspondence. Put v=Hj. The proper lift (3) has the exact additional monomial Q^(jq)=exp(vt/H), Phi=S_open+vt. (5) The new external variables are (a_log,v). Its internal variables are x=(b_log,u_log), together with t, of dimension m+1=r+2. ## 3. A complete discrete-faithful framing torsor has birational (A,p_e) The following proof supplies a nonempty regular polarization chart for EVERY complete discrete-faithful knot representation in the actual geometric model. It does not assert this for arbitrary reducible or nondiscrete representation components. Normalize the cut meridian J=[[1,1],[0,1]] and retain F(r,s)=[[r,1-r],[s,-s]], s nonzero, A=1/(1+s). For the chosen actual physical second edge retain its developed PREFIX words U,V. The actual inverse clock is k=ell_U/ell_V, ell_W=d_W+(a_W-d_W)r+b_Ws+c_W r(1-r)/s. (6) An independent second physical position exists by the actual two-position theorem, so k depends nontrivially on r. Here U,V are group words, UV^-1 is a nontrivial parabolic meridian, and det U=det V=1. Let t_W=Tr W, h_W=a_W-d_W and sigma=(-1)^ell for its actual prefix strand position ell; the Fourier sample label is still j. The exact prefix/momentum identities give, with u_p=p+p^-1 and v_p=p^-1-p, A_0=c_U+s t_U, A_1=c_V+s t_V, u_p=sigma(A_0-kA_1)/[s(k-1)], D=-sigma s(k-1)v_p, D=c_C+s h_C-2c_Cr, C=U-kV. (7) First, every UPPER TRIANGULAR word W of this discrete torsion-free projective group has diagonal entries a,a^-1 with a^2=1, hence h_W=0. Indeed if |a| differs from one, suitable conjugates W^n J W^-n are nontrivial translations converging to the identity. If |a|=1 and a^2 has infinite order, choose a^(2n) tending to one; then W^n J W^-n J^-1 is a nontrivial translation tending to the identity. Both contradict discreteness. If a^2 has finite nontrivial order, the upper triangular W is diagonalizable with projectively finite order, contradicting torsion-freeness. This proves the assertion without a stabilizer classification theorem. Suppose p were independent of r. Since k_r is nonzero, differentiating the Mobius expression in (7) forces A_0=A_1 as functions of s. Thus c_U=c_V and t_U=t_V. Now C_0=U-V has c=0, trace zero and determinant zero, so C_0=b E_12. It is nonzero because UV^-1 is a nontrivial meridian. Equality of the two determinants forces b c_V=0, hence c_U=c_V=0. Both U,V are upper triangular; the previous paragraph gives h_U=h_V=0. Equation (6) then makes k independent of r, a contradiction. Therefore (A,p) is etale on a nonempty open of the complete geometric framing torsor. The same upper-word argument shows c_U,c_V are not both zero. On the open set with the displayed denominators units, (7) has the explicit rational inverse s=(1-A)/A, k=(s u_p+sigma A_0)/(s u_p+sigma A_1), C=U-kV, D=-sigma s(k-1)v_p, r=(c_C+s h_C-D)/(2c_C). (8) Thus the function field of the framing torsor equals its field in (A,p): no new framing cover is introduced by this polarization. Any existing marked representation, SL2-sign or half-density cover is still retained. This is a birational assertion on the indicated open sets, not a global compactification or cycle identification. At a generic old position-projection caustic p=+1 or -1, k_p=0 but differentiating (8) gives r_p=-sigma s(k-1)/c_C !=0. (9) Thus the new chart resolves those old two-position caustics when the other displayed units and original shape chart remain regular. The exact geometric two-form is Omega_cut=-ell_V(k-1)/(A_1-A_0) dlog A wedge dlog p. (10) This is the prefix density in its new rational coordinates, not a claim about the old finite band cap variable. It is regular at the generic caustics in (9). ## 4. The ACTUAL new stationary block is nondegenerate At t=0 let x=(b_log,u_log). Fixing the first physical position in the old geometric Morse--Bott model leaves one framing tangent xi. Hence H_0=partial_x^2 S_open has rank r and radical span(xi). Let c=partial_x partial_t S_open and gamma=partial_t^2 S_open. Differentiating (4) along the critical framing gives mu=c dot xi=dlog p_e(xi), which is nonzero precisely on the new etale polarization chart. The internal Hessian of (5) is the actual bordered matrix H_new=[[H_0,c],[c^t,gamma]]. (11) It is invertible. If H_new(delta_x,delta_t)=0, pairing its first row with xi gives mu delta_t=0, hence delta_t=0. Then delta_x lies in the old radical, and the last equation gives delta_x=0. No invertibility of an old two-position transverse minor is used. Thus this proof also applies where that old minor is singular. For each new external pair with eta=exp(v), eta p_e=1, the old closed geometric point at t=0 solves all new internal critical equations. The formal implicit-function theorem for (11) makes it the UNIQUE critical germ there. In particular all the old closed equations still hold, and Phi_critical=S_geo, (12) with exactly the same marked regulator action and retained base characters: the new term vt vanishes at t=0. The comparison is now an actual Fourier partial-family critical construction, not substitution into the old band-generating cap. The regular marked representation/gluing branch has the meridian as a local coordinate. Nonzero mu and det H_new persist in that meridian deformation germ. Thus the same construction supplies the geometric formal normal line and action S_geo(M) there. The birational function-field statement of Section 3 was specifically at completeness; it is not promoted to a global statement over every peripheral point. On an old regular (A,B) chart, choose xi with xi_b=1 and first contract u. If H_perp is the old r-by-r transverse Hessian, its remaining Schur block in (b,t) is [[0,mu],[mu,gamma_eff]], det H_new=-mu^2 det H_perp. (13) The formula is independent of gamma_eff. At an old projection caustic xi_b may vanish, so that normalization and old minor are not used; the direct kernel proof of (11) remains valid. ## 5. Fourier normalization and the remaining actual source The amplitude at the new critical point is the SAME original nonzero coefficient amplitude at q=0. The Fourier character is one there. Equations (11)--(13) therefore give a nonzero formal normal block, with algebraic coefficients on the new chart and the original square-root/phase mark retained in its Gaussian line. The two extra discrete sums b,q contribute their logarithmic measure H^-2, while the inverse Fourier matrix contributes 1/N. On the physical sequence H_N=2pi*i/N their product is EXACTLY (1/N)H_N^-2=1/(2pi*i H_N). (14) This is the normalized two-variable formal Fourier pairing. With the explicit convention that its cross Gaussian exp(zt/H) has pairing one, composition after the old transverse contraction gives numerical leading coefficient a_perp/mu for that declared ordered cross pairing. The oriented external two-form has an additional minus sign: v=-Log p implies db/dv=-1/mu, consistently with (10). This is a FIXED ordered- Fourier phase, not a variable source correction. Another ordered Gaussian square-root mark carries its corresponding fixed phase in the recorded base line. Neither the original physical 1/N in (2) nor any peripheral character is absorbed into an unspecified variable unit. The resulting amplitude has the same exponential action (12); no new exponential factor is generated by the Fourier pair. This is a formal, coefficientwise statement from the original proper finite-array model. It asserts neither analytic stationary-phase asymptotics for its growing sums nor survival of this block in the final selected contraction. In particular the CORRECT new final source is still the finite sum in (2). Its Fourier label j takes all original N head values. It has not become eta=0, a choice of one momentum boundary, or an unmarked sum over the old quadratic framing sheets. A global comparison must transport that finite source, its endpoint carries and the actual whole-V versus proper-root-lift distinction above. [Exact bordered-Hessian and rational-polarization checks](../experiments/audit_actual_fourier_polarized_normal_block.py) and [saved results](../experiments/actual_fourier_polarized_normal_block_results.json). They pass four exact bordered-Hessian identities, 548 rational forward/inverse and density-Jacobian cases, and 120 old-caustic cases with nonzero new momentum derivative, including both prefix parities. Finite-field cases check the rational identities; the discrete-faithful argument in Section 3 is a separate direct proof. The [Fourier partial support theorem](partial_geometric_support_theorem.md), Section 7, applies the global finite-array certificate to the specified proper root lift and this SAME formal block. It retains the full first-cut sum, the two exterior labels, the original and Fourier factors 1/N, and the distinction from whole-V normal jets. Its geometric A-factor assertion concerns that actual all-level ROOT partial family, rather than an asserted off-root q-normal equivalence or the final sourced scalar sum.
