text: # The actual marked line-circle pattern near the complete source 30 October 2026. This note reconstructs a local analytic circle pattern on the ACTUAL labeled white-face sphere, including its two marked line faces. Its radii agree with the stationary limiting face action. It also retains the selected fixed-point germs of the local product of physical meridians at the degenerate marked triangles. The ordered auxiliary meridian and full regulator comparison remain separate until their actual collar words are calculated. Follow-up: the [primitive collar calculation](actual_deformed_circle_primitive_collar.md) and [global geometric assembly](actual_complete_core_geometric_deformation.md) now supply those steps. The full reflected-color filling estimate remains outside these geometric theorems. ## 1. Actual incidence and a finite reconstruction system Use the labeled convex ideal right-angled certificate and original main mark of [the matching geometry](general_augmented_plat_matching_geometry.md). The [white-normal construction](actual_right_angled_selected_framing_obstruction.md), section 2, gives a SIMPLICIAL triangulated sphere C. Its vertices are the R+2 actual white faces, and its 2R triangles are the shaded source vertices. Each triangle has two main edges and one matching edge. The two marked white faces u,v share the original MAIN edge. These are incidence hypotheses already supplied by this certificate; no arbitrary routed graph or combinatorial repair is introduced. Make one common orientation-preserving normalization of the complete circle picture. The outward marked disks are the halfplanes Y<=0 and Y>=1. Their common ideal point is infinity. All other outward disks are finite disjoint circles inside the strip, with positive radii. Keep their original labels and choose one finite center's horizontal coordinate as the last translation normalization. For each finite face f use unknowns (X_f,Y_f,r_f). Let delta_i be one small complex parameter for each actual matching edge. On a main edge put I_e=1, and on matching edge i put I_e=cos(2pi delta_i). The equations are, with the ACTUAL signed line side, (X_f-X_g)^2+(Y_f-Y_g)^2 =r_f^2+r_g^2+2I_e r_f r_g, (1a) Y_f=r_f I_e on the lower marked line, (1b) 1-Y_f=r_f I_e on the upper marked line. (1c) The marked line-line edge is automatic and has no equation. Fix the chosen X-coordinate at its complete value. There are 3R-1 remaining variables and 3R-1 equations, since C has 3R edges. These are holomorphic polynomial/trigonometric equations; their real version is the usual signed circle inversive-distance equation. Complexification uses X,Y,r as independent holomorphic coordinates, not complex conjugation. The Jacobian in these variables is invertible at delta=0. Consequently (1) has a unique nearby holomorphic solution for all delta in one fixed complex polydisc. It is real for real delta and even separately in each delta_i. Radii remain nonzero. This assertion is local for each fixed certified diagram, at arbitrary fixed bridge width. ## 2. Proof of the full Jacobian rank, including the line faces Consider an infinitesimal kernel vector of (1) at delta=0. The original center triangles have the following angle interpretations. A triangle with three finite circles is its nondegenerate Euclidean center triangle. For one marked line, the direction to its infinite center is the fixed outward vertical direction, and the two finite angles are the limits of the center-triangle angles. For two marked lines the two vertical directions are opposite: the finite angle is pi and the other two angles are zero. The side signs in (1b,c) are essential here. In the actual cyclic order around a finite face these direction angles sum to 2pi. Their first variation therefore vanishes. At complete tangency the already proved source gradient is theta/(2pi). The [positive finite-face Hessian and rank](actual_original_boundary_transverse_rank.md) thus force every logarithmic radius variation to be the same constant: only the scale kernel remains. This uses the limiting Hessian on the original finite-face gauge slice, not an assumed parametrization by off-critical flat representations. There are exactly two triangles containing the edge uv. In either, the finite circle is tangent to BOTH normalized lines, so r=1/2. Linearizing its two equations gives dr=0. Hence the common radius scale variation is zero: all dr_f=0. With the radii fixed, an all-finite triangle has fixed three side lengths, so its center velocities are one infinitesimal Euclidean motion. A one-line triangle has dY_f=dY_g=0. At the complete point its horizontal separation has absolute value 2sqrt(r_f r_g)>0. Its fixed finite edge length therefore gives dX_f=dX_g: its two centers have one common horizontal translation, with zero rotation and vertical translation. Delete the two triangles incident to uv. Their union is a topological disk with four-edge boundary; the remaining triangles form a triangulated disk with connected adjacency graph. This last statement follows by joining two triangle interior points by a path in the disk interior and perturbing that path to avoid vertices and cross edges transversely. Every finite vertex occurs in this remaining disk: its sphere link has at least three triangles, whereas only two triangles were deleted. There is a remaining one-line triangle, since the link of u has at least three triangles and only its two uv triangles were removed. Two remaining triangles sharing a finite-finite edge have the same infinitesimal Euclidean motion, because they agree at two distinct centers. If their common edge contains a marked line, both are one-line triangles; agreement at their common finite center identifies their horizontal translations. Starting at a remaining one-line triangle and using the connected adjacency graph therefore leaves one horizontal translation for ALL finite centers. The fixed X-coordinate removes it. The Jacobian kernel is zero. Since the finite system is square, the holomorphic implicit-function theorem proves the assertion in section 1. No Bessel packet, finite-color stationarity, or new source-cycle hypothesis is used in this reconstruction. ## 3. The full local face force is the deformed center angle Here all variables are curvatures, so l_f=1/r_f. For one ordered source triangle (x,b,y), put mu=1/2-delta and s=sin(pi delta), c=cos(pi delta), A=x+y, D=A^2-4xy s^2, T_b=sqrt[bA+xy+b^2s^2], E_b=A+2bs^2+2sT_b. Select every root by the positive complete value and continue analytically. Let Q_b be ONE determinant rate, ONE beta rate and HALF the forced-product rate from the [actual channel action](actual_positive_face_channel_rate.md): Q_b=I(2mu)-2I(mu)+integral_0^mu log lambda_b(t)dt +(1/2)J_mu(x,y). (2) Thus Q_b+Q_c is exactly the full original circle rate, with its sine normalization retained. Direct differentiation cancels the sine factors: partial_delta Q_b=-Log(E_b/sqrt D), Q_b(0)=F(x,b,y). (3) For positive curvatures its center triangle has two main tangent side lengths r_x+r_b,r_b+r_y and matching side length L_xy=sqrt[(r_x+r_y)^2-4r_xr_y sin^2(pi delta)]. The middle angle and the outer x-angle obey theta_b=2atan[b c/T_b], cos theta_x=[x(y-x)+b(y+x cos(2pi delta))]/[(x+b)sqrt D], sin theta_x=2x c T_b/[(x+b)sqrt D]. (4) Exchange x,y for the third angle. These formulas also specify the selected complex angle germs. Differentiating (4) gives exactly partial_delta(theta_j/(2pi)) =-partial_log l_j Log(E_b/sqrt D). (5) For the middle angle both sides are -b s/T_b. For the outer angle, differentiate its cosine and sine: their squared sum is one and (cos theta_x)(partial sin theta_x)-(sin theta_x)(partial cos theta_x) gives (5) after substitution. This is an elementary rational identity in x,b,y,s and the displayed roots. The complete source already fixes the integration constant, so integrating (5) proves partial_log l_j Q_b=theta_j/(2pi). (6) One marked zero curvature is obtained by the corresponding line limit. With two zero curvatures the single finite angle is pi and (6) is the single-variable homogeneous rate (1/2)log l. The geometry of that triangle's strip is retained by (1), not by assigning extra information to this degenerate angle formula. ## 4. Identification with the stationary source radii The real solution of (1) for small real delta preserves all original cyclic center-direction orders. Its main tangencies and prescribed matching intersections give exactly the angles (4), including the one-line and two-line conventions in section 2. Thus their sums at every finite circle are 2pi. Holomorphic continuation preserves these identities on the fixed complex polydisc. By (6), its curvatures solve the actual limiting face-stationary equations of the complete Fourier-core action, with the two marked faces zero. After fixing the source's one positive curvature scale, the complete face Hessian is invertible. Its holomorphic implicit-function theorem therefore identifies these normalized curvatures with the UNIQUE nearby source stationary radii, for every small delta. This is a full face-momentum identification, not only agreement of the cusp Hessian. The line-side equations also prove the missing strip consistency explicitly. At either triangle containing uv, one finite circle is tangent to one marked line and has matching inversive cosine cos psi with the other, where psi=2pi delta_i. For strip height H, H=r_f(1+cos psi), l_f=2cos^2(pi delta_i)/H. (7) The same H occurs on the adjacent uv triangle. It was fixed in (1), not chosen independently for two source factors. At complete delta0 this is the usual r_f=H/2. Formula (7) survives even though that triangle's source characteristic quadratic has a repeated root. ## 5. Selected fixed-point germs at a marked triangle The actual ordered product of two white reflections at matching edge i has trace -2cos(2pi delta_i) in the recorded negative-parabolic lift. At delta_i=0 it is a nontrivial parabolic, supplied by the original certificate. Choosing the eigenvalues lambda_+=-exp(-2pi i delta_i), lambda_-=-exp( 2pi i delta_i) (8) therefore gives two holomorphic fixed-line germs. This is elementary: a nonzero off-diagonal entry of the complete parabolic remains a unit, so the eigenline can be solved explicitly in that affine chart using lambda_+ or lambda_-. Their collision at delta0 is retained. The internal source node is exactly -2cos(2pi delta), so (8) records its two actual eigenvalue branches; it is not a free square root of the collapsed scalar characteristic. For clarity an actual two-line calculation resolves the 200 case. Take the finite circle centered at X+i r, tangent to the lower line, and the upper matching line at height H=r(1+cos psi). The matching product P=r_upper r_circle, with the original outward reflection signs, has trace -2cos psi. Its fixed points are p_+=X+r sin psi+iH, p_-=X-r sin psi+iH. (9) The recorded lift may be written P=(i/r) [[bar c+2iH, r^2-c bar c-2iH c], [1, -c]], c=X+ir. Here bar c means X-ir; after complexification it is this holomorphic expression. At p_+ its eigenvalue is -exp(-i psi), at p_- it is -exp(i psi). If the matching line is instead the LOWER line and the circle is tangent to the upper one, the selected lambda_+ line is the point X-r sin psi on that lower line. Reversing the ordered product exchanges its eigenvalues. These are literal orientation adapters, not independently reset choices of a local frame. Equations (7)--(9) retain the actual selected line germs that the limiting 200 quadratic alone loses. They do not identify a finite-N Bessel logarithmic derivative with a single classical characteristic. ## 6. What is still required for the complete geometric action The reconstructed ordered main meridians are parabolic because every main incidence in (1) remains tangent. Their matching products have (8). This establishes the local marked circle data and the source face equations on the actual labeled sphere. To identify the entire continued core critical action with the marked geometric deformation, one must still calculate the ACTUAL auxiliary collar transporter between the two middle circles, including its half-twist and primitive marking. Its eigenvalue logarithm must equal the source channel derivative -Log(E_b E_c/D), with the recorded sign and any integral logarithmic character. One must then check the actual group relations and peripheral word, and use the already fixed complete regulator value. Neither existence of circle positions nor the Hessian match alone replaces this ordered peripheral calculation. No general mixed-color packet, ordinary-color subset bound, or filled-volume claim is made here. Focused audit: [marked reconstruction and selected flags](../experiments/audit_actual_marked_deformed_circle_pattern.py), with [saved results](../experiments/actual_marked_deformed_circle_pattern_results.json). It checks 15 exact symbolic gradient and ordered line-eigenvalue identities; the full 5- and 11-dimensional Jacobians of the original octahedral and cuboctahedral checkerboard fixtures; 24 real/complex deformed patterns; 144 actual triangle/source-angle checks; 48 shared-strip checks; and 144 selected matching eigenlines. The numerical residuals are below 1.1e-13. These finite fixtures audit the general Jacobian argument; they do not replace it or prove an auxiliary primitive-collar formula. The auxiliary primitive-collar identification is separate from the marked circle-pattern theorem.

title: The full dilogarithm resolves the actual charged flag pentagon at the root
text: # The full dilogarithm resolves the actual charged flag pentagon at the root 28 October 2026. The full modular dilogarithm has an actual finite marked realization at the charged cup. Its values at the marked clock spectrum are regular and invertible at the physical root. They implement a mixed full-Phi/nilpotent pentagon with its original source factor nonzero and of modulus sqrt(N). The integer mark is fixed by an explicit operator preparing the original cup, not by an arbitrary choice of a cyclic spectral cut. This removes the singular norm-root factors in the earlier [mixed cyclic/nilpotent pentagon](actual_shared_quantum_flags_and_charged_exchange.md). It does not realize all three classical five-point certificates inside the original crossing or choose its geometric period. ## 1. The exact full function and its marked unit-root values Use the full literature function with the normalization proved in [the rational evaluation](rational_quantum_dilogarithm_torsor.md) and retained in [the exact circle/boundary source](actual_modular_dilog_circle_and_boundary_source.md). Write Q=exp(2pi*i/N), d=N-1, and Psi(z)=V_N(exp z)(1-exp(Nz))^((N+1)/(2N)+i z/(2pi)) exp[i Li_2(exp(Nz))/(2pi N)], V_N(t)=(1-t^N)^(d/(2N)) product_(ell=1)^d(1-Q^ell t)^(-ell/N). (1) All marks are anchored at Re z=-infinity, as in those notes. In particular Psi(z+2pi*i/N)=Psi(z)/(1-exp z). (2) For j=1,...,N the points z_j=2pi*i*j/N lie in the interior or top boundary of the selected strip. They are regular and nonzero, including j=N. The bottom point z=0 is a zero and is deliberately a different mark. Repeated use of (2) gives Psi(2pi*i*j/N)=phi_N/F_(j-1), F_a=(Q;Q)_a, phi_N=Psi(2pi*i/N) =sqrt(N) exp{i pi[1/4-(N+N^(-1))/12]}. (3) This fixes the scalar and phase, including even levels. Here is a direct proof of the scalar. In (1) approach z=log r+2pi*i/N with r increasing to one. Its central zero cancels the ell=d factor. The resulting anchored finite product is phi_N=N^(d/N) exp[i pi/(12N)] product_(ell=1)^(N-2) (1-Q^(ell+1))^(-ell/N). (4) For 1<=a<N the anchored argument of 1-Q^a is pi*a/N-pi/2. Summing the arguments in (4) gives the phase in (3). For the modulus, either pair complementary factors in (4), or use the exact radial identity |Psi(log r)|^2=(1-r)(1-r^N). Equation (2) then yields |Psi(log r+2pi*i/N)|^2=(1-r^N)/(1-r), which tends to N. This proves (3) with no unspecified root phase. The negative orientation is the conjugate-reflected formula with the opposite phase. ## 2. The actual coupled flag oscillator has a fixed integer mark Take the complete original heads, with x=-q^(-1), lambda=x^(-1)=Qx, k=x^N=(-1)^(N-1), and typed cyclic marks S_1^N=mu, S_2^N=k mu. In the notation of [the actual shared flags](actual_shared_quantum_flags_and_charged_exchange.md), Delta=f_1+K_1^(-1)S_2-S_1, gamma=-e_2K_1, v=Z_2^(-1)+S_1e_2, Delta v=QvDelta, v^N=1, Delta^N=gamma^N=0, gamma Delta=lambda(Q^(-1)v-1). (5) Let E_j(v) be the v=Q^j spectral projectors, with E_N=E_0. Then Delta E_1(v)=0. (6) For example (5) makes Delta injective on every E_j with j!=1. If Delta E_1 were nonzero, the remaining N-1 injective arrows would contradict Delta^N=0. There is a direct actual preparation of this cut. Put A=-S_1e_2Z_2, C=P(A), P(A)=sum_(h=0)^d (-1)^hQ^(h(h-1)/2)A^h/F_h. (7) These use the actual finite e_2; A^N=0. Then v=C Z_2^(-1) C^(-1), Delta=C(K_1^(-1)J_(+,2))C^(-1), C gamma=gamma C. (8) Here J_+ is the literal strict raising shift on the second head. The first identity follows from the finite Euler recurrence: A Z_2^(-1)=Q^(-1)Z_2^(-1)A, so conjugation gives Z_2^(-1)(1-Q^(-1)A)=v. The third follows by direct commutation of A with -e_2K_1. For the second, both proposed raising operators obey (5) with the same gamma and v. Their difference has image in ker(gamma), and their clock covariance therefore allows only the E_1 input. Both vanish on that input, by (6) and the literal endpoint of J_+. Thus their difference is zero. For the original cup p of the preceding notes, exactly p=N x^(-d) C|0,d>. Indeed the coefficient of |h,d-h> in C|0,d> is x^h, by the ordinary factorial reflection. Consequently J_v=sum_(j=1)^N j E_j(v)=C(N-J_2)C^(-1), [J_v,Delta]=-Delta, J_v p=p, (J_v+J_1+J_2)p=Np. (9) The actual cap and the actual integer source charge fix this mark. Equation (9) is not an identification of J_v with an arbitrary interior Pachner edge winding. ## 3. An invertible marked full-Phi matrix at the physical root For t positive near one, with its indicated logarithm, define F_v(t)=sum_(j=1)^N Psi(Log t+2pi*i*j/N) E_j(v). (10) This is a marked evaluation, not a single-valued cyclic functional calculus that identifies the top and bottom logarithmic values at eigenvalue one. All coefficients in (10) are holomorphic and nonzero near t=1. Hence F_v(t) and its inverse are regular there. The elementary shift (2), applied only to the nonzero arrows Delta:E_j->E_(j-1), j>=2, gives F_v(t)Delta F_v(t)^(-1) =Delta(1-Q^(-1)t v). (11) There is no exceptional wrap to check: (6) is the actual missing arrow, not an arrow removed by hand. At t=1, write F_v=F_v(1). Equations (3) and (8) give the explicit original-head realization F_v=phi_N sum_(j=1)^N E_j(v)/F_(j-1) =phi_N C diag_b[1/F_(d-b)] C^(-1), F_v p=phi_N p. (12) The phase and modulus of phi_N are those in (3). In particular the selected source coefficient is nonzero and polynomial in size at every N. The relation to the old norm-one cyclic atom is exact. Let nu^N=1-t^N and let C_t=V_N(tv) with its anchored cyclic functional calculus. Then F_v(t)=B(t) nu^(-J_v) C_t, B(t)=(1-t^N)^((N+1)/(2N)+i Log t/(2pi)) exp[i Li_2(t^N)/(2pi N)]. (13) Thus the full modular factor supplies an **integer degree gauge**, rather than just a central scalar. The apparent singular factors in (13) combine to the regular marked matrix (10). Dropping nu^(-J_v) would return the singular rescaled cyclic pentagon. The preparation C itself has a contractive core at unit marks. Let H_A act on the second head by H_A|b>=lambda^(-b)|b>/F_b. Then A=H_A(S_1 tensor J_minus)H_A^(-1). Both C=P(A) and C^(-1) are therefore factorial frames around a literal norm-one nilpotent shift. Their Euler factor and their inverse are the original full-Psi relative moments at the appropriate orientation; their diagonal factorial frames are reflected or ordinary moments as in Section 5 below. Thus (12) has an exact fixed-complexity full-Psi period presentation with the same polynomial boundary-kernel types as the original word. This is not a polynomial norm bound for C or F_v: their exponential actions remain in the full functions. ## 4. The actual physical-root mixed pentagon and its source For every scalar a, the finite Euler polynomial of the original root satisfies F_v P(aDelta) =P(aDelta)P(-aQ^(-1)Delta v) F_v. (14) Indeed (11) conjugates the left Euler argument to aDelta-aQ^(-1)Delta v. The two summands Q-commute. The finite ordered binomial theorem gives their Euler factorization; every term of total Delta-degree >=N vanishes. This proves (14) independently of an assumed published operator pentagon, at the physical root and with the actual original endpoints. Keep the full original marked cap m, with mp=1. Because Delta p=0 and vp=Qp, both sides have exactly m F_v P(aDelta)p =m P(aDelta)P(-aQ^(-1)Delta v)F_vp =phi_N. (15) Every original common Cartan, framing and peripheral line remains identical outside (15). The scalar phi_N has not been reset to one. This is a physical-root source-compatible mixed pentagon, with no free auxiliary t and no singular norm-root specialization. The nilpotent P factors can each be replaced by their exact full-Psi circle/radial periods. Since their series truncate, this is a finite linear replacement carrying all relative boundary components. It does not yet prove a homology pushforward between two unspecified full-Faddeev face networks or identify their geometric intersection coefficient. ## 5. The literal middle-five-point source gauges lie in the same class The [literal middle configuration](actual_middle_five_point_wall_factorization.md) requires the original argument n=e_1S_2, the corrected reciprocal U, and its explicit diagonal Gamma. These have a common **contractive** transfer, not an uncontrolled nonnormal one. Put T=J_(minus,1) tensor S_2, H_n|j>=lambda^j c_j^+|j>, H_U|j>=lambda^j F_j|j>, c_j^+=(-1)^jQ^(j(j-1)/2)/F_j. Then n=H_n T H_n^(-1), U=H_U T H_U^(-1), Gamma=H_U H_n^(-1), H_U=N lambda^(-d)Q^(-1) Rev H_n Rev, (16) where Rev|j>=|d-j>. Each identity follows from its consecutive coefficient ratio and includes the strict zero endpoint. For unit S_2, ||T||<=1. Let c_a^- be the corresponding Euler coefficient at Q^(-1). Finite factorial reflection gives Gamma_j=N^2 Q^j c_(d-j)^+ c_(d-j)^-, Gamma_j^(-1)=Q^(-j)c_j^+ c_j^-. (17) Each c_a^epsilon is exactly the one-full-Psi circle minus radial source of the modular-circle theorem. Thus both Gamma and its inverse are two-full-Psi relative periods. At radius one their boundary kernels are unit phase/power diagonals, with only the displayed N^2 scalar. For reflected coefficients, the radial power is t^j; for ordinary ones it is t^(N-j-1). Each radial diagonal operator has norm at most 1/(2pi). The Gaussian phases and the degree reversal in (16) are explicit and retain their original roots. This does not claim that Gamma has polynomial norm: its exponential action is now carried by the full Psi functions in its period, rather than hidden in a discarded boundary frame. A component with one radial factor and another circle factor can still have an exponential period. No global dominance estimate follows from the local radial bound alone. ## 6. Exact scope and the remaining geometric comparison The full completion is compatible with an actual charged cap mark and supplies (14) at the physical root, where the norm-one cyclic version was singular. The literal middle-five-point factorial transition also has the exact full-Psi/source realization (16)--(17). These are concrete local source bridges. The three classical five-point certificates have specific shared flags and face orders. Their complete factor products have not yet been identified with the mixed factors of (14) or with a proper full-Phi tetrahedral pentagon before source extraction. In particular, merely replacing a cyclic function by Psi does not make the literal candidates 1-Z and X Q-commute; their additive defect persists. The required positive quad/Fourier change must carry its full source and integer mark, with (16)--(17) giving an explicit test for its boundary normalization. Furthermore, ordinary Taylor projection is not natural under arbitrary Laurent inversions: Psi-V begins in t^N Log t, and multiplication by t^(-N) exposes a nonvanishing logarithmic source. The circle/radial formula is integrable for precisely a<N. A proposed five-point move leaving that range must retain its logarithmic/carry counterterms. Nothing in (14) requires this invalid extension; its Delta grading is strictly positive and nilpotent. Thus the construction gives a genuine physical-root mixed pentagon and nonzero original cap coefficient, not yet the whole positive triangulation period or a geometric lower bound. ## 7. Reproducible independent checks Run python3 experiments/audit_actual_marked_full_phi_flag_pentagon.py Exact prime-field checks cover 54 actual marked-root pentagons through N=10, nine complete literal-five-point moment gauges, and their original cups and integer marks. The common phi_N scalar is retained symbolically in those homogeneous identities. Independent complex finite-product checks cover every marked unit-root value (3) through N=20 at both orientations and verify the exact phase and modulus. title: An explicit marked multiport Chebyshev packet
text: # An explicit marked multiport Chebyshev packet 29 October 2026. The correctly marked original plat source has an explicit coherent multivariate polynomial packet. After its actual complete-circle quotient, every variable has half bandwidth and exact tensor Chebyshev/Parseval reconstruction with polynomial dual cost. This works at arbitrary FIXED bridge width, both level parities and all composite levels. The physical source-to-packet transform may carry exponential factorial energy; no sharp volume estimate for that energy is asserted. The construction uses C on ordinary pairs and H on the marked pair. It therefore avoids the proved all-C six-port source obstruction. It is a final-source identity/inequality, not a claim that arbitrary split-pair crossings descend to the quotient or that node values may replace the original generic-q normal germ. ## 1. Original source and the exact middle-degree extraction Put N>=2,d=N-1,q=exp(pi i/N),Q=q^2,x=q^d, M=floor(d/2). For a 2k-head plat, let v=W p^tensor k be the COMPLETE original output state after any fixed signed braid word, with its full Cartan and source factors. Retain the external normalization chi_N explicitly. The following identities more generally hold for any input v of TOTAL integer degree kd, so apply with every allowed degree-preserving exterior. Write the original ordinary and full marked rows as ell_(a,b)=x^a/N delta_(a+b,d), m_(a,b)=x^b/N^2 (unrestricted a,b), K_raw=(ell^tensor(k-1) tensor m)v. Let P_mid project EACH consecutive physical pair to degree d and define its actual coefficient tensor psi_(a1,...,ak) =v_(a1,d-a1,...,ak,d-ak), 0<=ai<=d. (1) The ordinary caps force their k-1 pair degrees to d. The TOTAL integer degree then forces the last pair degree to d too. Hence K_raw=(ell^tensor(k-1) tensor m_d) P_mid v, (2) where m_d is the marked row RESTRICTED only after this argument. No arbitrary local marking replacement is made. Every C=P L_N and H=L_N P is block diagonal in pair degree, so P_mid COMMUTES with the actual positive product G_top=C^tensor(k-1) tensor H. Thus E_mid=(P_mid v)^dagger G_top(P_mid v) <=v^dagger G_top v. (3) The source is preserved while the positive energy is reduced. ## 2. The literal pair-CD polynomials, not a new spectral model Let A be the original middle-degree pair Casimir, in the physical basis |a,d-a>, a=0,...,d. Its entries are A_(a,a)=D_a=4qQ^a-q(1+Q)Q^(2a), A_(a,a+1)=A_(a+1,a)=t_a=-(1-Q^(a+1))^2. All t_a for a<d are nonzero. Define the actual continuants f_0(z)=1, f_1(z)=(z-D_0)/t_0, f_(a+1)(z)=((z-D_a)f_a(z)-t_(a-1)f_(a-1)(z))/t_a. (4) Then f_a(c_j) is component a of the normalized actual Casimir eigenvector v_j with first component one. The distinct nodes are c_j=2cos((2j+1)pi/N), j=0,...,M, with multiplicities m_j=2 except the odd simple endpoint m_M=1. The [full physical CD proof](actual_complete_circle_reflection_positive.md) gives H_d=N sum_j m_j v_j v_j^dagger, C_d=N sum_j m_j conjugate(v_j) v_j^T. (5) Indeed H=L_N P has the first resolution. In degree d, physical reversal obeys P v_j=(x^d nu_j) conjugate(v_j), with nu_j=(-1)^j q^[j(j+1)] of unit modulus, proving the second. The weights in (5) come from the first normals of the COMPLETE circle at its double Casimir zeros; they have not been supplied by discarding the root Jordan data. The original cup also proves f_a(c_0)=x^a. (6) ## 3. The coherent polynomial and its exact original marked corner Define the KNOWN linear transform of the physical tensor (1) F_N(z_1,...,z_k)=sum_(a1,...,ak) psi_(a1,...,ak) f_(a1)(z_1)...f_(a(k-1))(z_(k-1)) f_(ak)#(z_k), (7) where # conjugates coefficients in the real Casimir variable. The conjugate on the MARKED variable is essential. Its presence is forced by H rather than C, not a freely chosen phase. All physical colors are coherently summed in (7) BEFORE an absolute value or positive norm is taken. Equations (5),(6) prove EXACTLY E_mid=N^k sum_(j1,...,jk) m_j1...m_jk |F_N(c_j1,...,c_jk)|^2, (8) K_raw=x^d N^(-(k+1)) F_N(c_0,...,c_0). (9) The actual invariant is chi_N K_raw; no external normalization is silently omitted. Formula (9) concerns the original marked scalar, not an unknown terminal amplitude chosen to define the transform. The full corner value uses only f_a(c_0)=x^a and the literal factors in (2): its last phase is x^(d-ak), not x^ak. Consequently |K_raw|^2 <= E_mid/(2^k N^(3k+2)), (10) because c_0 is a DOUBLE node of weight 2 for every N>=2. This is the original cap Cauchy budget, now a concrete all-port polynomial kernel with an explicit physical source and positive measure. ## 4. Exact half-bandwidth fold and polynomial tensor DCT Raw F_N has degree at most d in EACH variable. Let G_N(z)=product_(j=0)^M(z-c_j). Take the remainder of (7) by G_N in each variable, independently, and call it Fbar_N. This is an explicit SOURCE-INDEPENDENT linear fold, of degree at most M in every variable. All grid values in (8),(9) are unchanged. This folding is made only AFTER the full circle/source identity (5); it is not an all-input replacement of the original pair algebra C[z]/P_N by a semisimple algebra before its coupon acts. It makes no assertion about q-normal derivatives or about arbitrary analytic continuation off the physical grid. Expand Fbar_N=sum_(0<=ri<=M) A_r product_i T_(ri)(z_i/2). The exact weighted discrete orthogonality 2M<N gives the tensor DCT A_r=(2^s(r)/N^k) sum_j (product_i m_ji) F_N(c_j1,...,c_jk) product_i cos(ri theta_ji), theta_j=(2j+1)pi/N, s(r)=#{i:ri>0}. (11) In particular |A_r|<=2^k max_grid|F_N| and max_[-2,2]^k |Fbar_N|<=N^k max_grid|F_N|. The DCT itself has no hidden exponential condition factor at fixed k. Exact Parseval is (1/N^k) sum_j (product_i m_ji)|F_N(c_j1,...,c_jk)|^2 =sum_r 2^(-s(r))|A_r|^2, E_mid=N^(2k) sum_r 2^(-s(r))|A_r|^2. (12) The original source in these COHERENT coefficient coordinates is K_raw=x^d/N^(k+1) sum_r A_r product_i cos(ri pi/N). Its exact squared dual norm for the Parseval coefficient norm is N^(-2k-2)(N/2)^k=1/(2^k N^(k+2)), (13) since sum_(r=0)^M 2^(r>0) cos(r pi/N)^2=N/2. This is a polynomial original-source cost at every fixed width. In particular the six-port case k=3 has a literal three-variable marked packet, full tensor-grid reconstruction, and dual cost 1/(8N^5) in the coefficient norm, equivalently 1/(8N^11) against E_mid. ## 5. Scope and the branching gate that remains The three-C trivalent observation on the unchanged saturated source has a proper simplex support and an exact marked null-direction, as proved in [the marked metric audit](actual_three_belt_saturated_source_and_marked_metric.md). The present CCH packet is DIFFERENT: final pair-degree extraction and its marked coefficient conjugation keep the literal original co-source. They do not claim that its values form the zero-current three-object Hopf invariant. The last pair's physical reversal has the explicit moment currents in that note, equations (16),(17). The DCT in (11) is controlled, but the source-to-continuant map in (7), the high-degree fold, and the resulting coefficients A_r need not have polynomial norms in the original physical metric. Their actual coherent energy is exactly what (8),(12) retain. Also a corner value is not automatically as large as the grid maximum. Thus no general sharp upper, original-cycle survival, geometric edge equations, or trivalent augmented-graph volume equality follows merely from this positive representation. A geometric energy certificate for the actual packet (7), keeping its last-pair current, would be a substantive next step. Audit: [literal marked braid sources, pair CD, coherent grid and tensor Parseval](../experiments/audit_actual_marked_multiport_chebyshev_source_packet.py). The marked Chebyshev packet does not give a sharp geometric bound or a generic-q germ.

title: Actual marked-theta link, four octahedra and its source angle slice
text: # Actual marked-theta link, four octahedra and its source angle slice 29 October 2026. The marked two-vertex source is literally a three-box fully augmented pretzel diagram, with its crossing circles retained. This gives the missing source-to-topology dictionary. Its complement has volume 4v8 for ANY fixed signed twists on the three physical boxes. The independently proved whole-source limit is therefore its actual hyperbolic volume. An explicit sixteen-tetrahedron angle assignment also realizes the full untwisted scalar rate, not just its value at the maximum. This is a local three-circle result, not a general graph theorem. ## 1. Literal original source, before any channel decomposition Let C be the actual auxiliary [2,1,1,2] three-braid, closed on its third head with the original pivot. Its complete-color value is L_N by the [all-input circle theorem](actual_crossing_circle_source_and_filling.md). It is an actual additional link component, with no division by its zero ordinary quantum dimension. On six ordered physical heads place R^(e_1)L_N on heads12, R^(e_2)L_N on heads34, and R^(e_3)L_N on heads56. Use the matching (16),(23),(45) at the bottom and the top. At the bottom use the original cups; at the top use ordinary caps on23 and45, and the sole original unrestricted marked row on16. Explicitly they are p_ab=N x^(-b)delta_(a+b,d), ell_ab=x^a delta_(a+b,d)/N, m_ab=x^b/N^2. This is EXACTLY the original s=3 pretzel source A_(3,N)(R^(e_1)L_N,R^(e_2)L_N,R^(e_3)L_N) (1) in the [literal source and transfer theorem](actual_odd_pretzel_augmented_transfer_source.md). The black matching is precisely p_16 p_23 p_45, and its white caps and marked arc are precisely those used in the [all-channel marked contraction](actual_trivalent_all_channel_marked_contraction.md). Thus its raw scalar is the WHOLE channel sum Theta_N(e) in the [whole-label theorem](actual_trivalent_marked_theta_label_asymptotic.md). There is no additional trace average, magnetic projection or state replacement in (1). Keeping the original marked row first is essential: the total physical degree later forces its missing degree equation. The three cup factors N^3, two ordinary cap factors N^-2 and marked factor N^-2 leave exactly the original one-cut factor N^-1. That factor is already inside (1). The auxiliary circles remain ordinary closed components. When e_i is even, its two physical strands do not swap endpoints; when it is odd, they do. Following the displayed matchings determines all main components. At e=(0,0,0) there are three main components and three crossing circles, hence six components. Other parity choices change the main component count, not the retained three circles. ## 2. Reversible actual face cut and the hyperbolic complement The explicit projection-plane and crossing-disk cut of the [augmented pretzel geometry](actual_augmented_pretzel_geometric_volume.md) applies to (1), including its untwisted diagram. At s=3 each of the two cut projection cells P_3 has ideal vertices Z_k,U_k^+,U_k^-, k mod3, and faces W_+=(U_2^+,U_1^+,U_0^+), W_-=(U_0^-,U_1^-,U_2^-), Q_k=(Z_k,U_k^+,Z_(k+1),U_k^-), T_k^+=(Z_k,U_(k-1)^+,U_k^+), T_k^-=(Z_k,U_k^-,U_(k-1)^-). (2) Here the k-th retained crossing disk is the bowtie T_k^+,T_k^-, with common crossing-circle vertex Z_k. The planar arc between two disks is Q_k. The two other projection regions are W_+,W_-. These are the faces traced from the actual ordered pretzel matching; restoring the disk collars reverses the cut. The two projection copies p=0,1 have opposite orientations. White faces W_+,W_-,Q_k glue across p by the identity label map. For e_k even, the shaded gluing is WITHIN each projection copy, T_k^+ -> T_k^-, Z_k -> Z_k, U_(k-1)^+ -> U_(k-1)^-, U_k^+ -> U_k^-. For e_k odd it is ACROSS the projection copies, with the two outer indices exchanged: T_k^+(p) -> T_k^-(1-p), Z_k -> Z_k, U_(k-1)^+ -> U_k^-, U_k^+ -> U_(k-1)^-. (3) The cross-copy change is part of the oriented half-twist gluing. A swap within the same oriented copy would be a different map. Each P_3 is the double of the directly constructed right-angled ideal triangular antiprism across its triangular base. That antiprism is a regular ideal octahedron. Thus (2),(3) use FOUR actual regular ideal octahedra. The supporting planes and Lorentz-normal proof are given in the cited geometry construction; no polyhedron recognition is being inferred from the quantum growth constant. Every edge cycle in (2),(3) has four right angles. The regular octahedral symmetries and the displayed reflections preserve the canonical horospheres. Consequently there is no edge dilation, and the ideal links are connected nonsingular flat tori. Shrinking their horospheres gives full complete finite-volume cusp ends and a compact core. This constructs the complete hyperbolic metric on the literal complement, with Vol(S^3 minus L(e))=4v8. (4) All choices of the three parities have the same metric volume. A further full twist is the actual crossing-disk collar twist. With the crossing circle RETAINED, it changes the boundary marking by an integral disk-longitude shear. After the disk boundary is treated as a cusp, the induced pure three-punctured-sphere map is isotopic to the identity: one can undo the collar rotation allowing that cusp boundary to rotate. Thus the unmarked complementary gluing remains the one in (3). This is an unmarked-complement homeomorphism, not invariance of the quantum source or its preferred filling slope. Positive versus negative odd crossings differ by just such full twists. Hence (4) holds for all fixed signed integer triples e. ## 3. An actual positive ideal angle slice for the scalar rate Here take the UNTWiSTED gluing, e=(0,0,0). Split each P_3 across its internal triangle (Z_0,Z_1,Z_2). The four octahedra are O_(p,s), p,s in {0,1}; s records the plus/minus half. After forgetting that sign in the abstract labels, each octahedron has vertices Z_0,Z_1,Z_2,U_0,U_1,U_2 and faces Z=(Z_0,Z_1,Z_2), U=(U_0,U_1,U_2), q_k=(Z_k,U_k,Z_(k+1)), t_k=(Z_k,U_(k-1),U_k). All maps fix the abstract vertex indices. Faces Z,t_k flip s; faces U,q_k flip p. Every octahedral boundary-edge cycle therefore visits all four (p,s) cells with the same abstract edge label. There are twelve such cycles. Ideal vertex classes have the six labels Z_0,Z_1,Z_2,U_0,U_1,U_2, the actual six cusps. In EVERY octahedron choose the opposite-vertex axis A=Z_0, B=U_1, (v_0,v_1,v_2,v_3)=(Z_1,Z_2,U_2,U_0). Triangulate it by (A,B,v_i,v_(i+1)), i mod4, with the appropriate positive orientation. This is a genuine triangulation of the regular octahedron; all boundary faces are its existing triangles. The resulting triangulation of the actual link has sixteen positive ideal tetrahedra and four distinct internal axis edges. For ANY 0<x_i<1/2 assign to the i-th tetrahedron in cell (p,s) alpha_(p,s,i)=pi x_(i+2p+s mod4), beta_(p,s,i)=pi/2-alpha_(p,s,i). Put dihedral angle pi/2 on AB and its opposite v_i v_(i+1), alpha on A v_i and B v_(i+1), and beta on the two other opposite edges. Each tetrahedron is a positive ideal angle triple. Internal axis edges have four right angles. The four equatorial boundary edges also contribute one right angle per cell, hence 2pi per cycle. A radial boundary edge at v_i has, in one octahedron, angle pi/2+alpha_i-alpha_(i-1) at A, pi/2-alpha_i+alpha_(i-1) at B. For each column i the four cells use each of x_0,...,x_3 exactly once. Summing either radial expression over its actual four-cell edge cycle is EXACTLY 2pi. This proves all edge angle equations symbolically on the entire open four-cube. It is not a test only at the regular point. Each of the four right-tetrahedron angle triples (pi x_i,pi/2-pi x_i,pi/2) occurs four times. Thus the actual angle volume on this slice is V_angle(x)=4 sum_(i=1)^4 [Lambda(pi x_i)+Lambda(pi/2-pi x_i)]. (5) Let a_i be the continuum limits of j_i/N and S=sum a_i. On the supported folded source set S>=1, a_i<=1/2, put x_i=S/2-a_i, i=1,2,3, x_4=1-S/2. These lie in the closed half-angle cube and sum to one. Interior labels give its positive slice; physical boundary labels are limits. The exact finite half-steps and prefactors stay in the whole-label source proof, rather than being called continuum shape equations. Its fully magnetic-contracted factorial rate is E=sum_i[L(2x_i)-4L(x_i)] =-2 sum_i[L(x_i)+L(1/2-x_i)], L(t)=integral_0^t log(2sin pi u)du. Since L(t)=-Lambda(pi t)/pi, (5) gives the PRECISE calibration V_angle(x)=2pi E(x). (6) Hence the source rate is the volume functional of an explicit positive angle slice in the ACTUAL triangulation. Each summand in (5) is strictly concave in x_i, with its unique maximum at 1/4. At this point every tetrahedron has shape i and the entire face and cusp certificate of section2 applies. It is the actual complete metric, not a merely lower-dimensional critical point of the source. In particular its full fixed-periphery criticality follows from the complete gluing and the already proved [full-slice variational certificate](source_volume_casson_rivin_certificate.md). This distinguishes the actual geometric anchor from stationarity only along the displayed source family. Off-center angles in this slice are NOT asserted to solve the real modulus gluing equations or to be actual link representations. For example the complex shape product around one internal axis is, up to the chosen reciprocal convention, product_i tan(pi x_i). The equation sum x_i=1 does not force that product to one. This is a precise additional geometric equation, not a missing angle sum. At the maximum it is one. No peripheral meridian meaning is assigned to the INTERNAL labels x_i. ## 4. Original external line and the actual volume equality The [complete augmented-source normalization](actual_complete_augmented_source_normalization.md) applies to this multicomponent diagram. It proves scalarity on the chosen original cut without using link connectivity. At complete color the physical twist is theta_d=kappa^(-1), hence all prescribed framing/peripheral characters have modulus one. Thus for the original one-cut enhanced Kashaev evaluation |<L(e)>_N|=|Theta_N(e)|. (7) For the full one-cut modified convention the additional entire dimension specializes to i^(N+3)/N, so its absolute value is |Theta_N(e)|/N. There is one such factor, not one per component. All auxiliary circle traces and all Cartan phases were already inside (1). No division by [N]=0 is introduced in either statement. The whole-label theorem proves for every FIXED signed e and both level parities, including composites, Theta_N(e)=N^(3/2)e^(2Nj0) Omega_N^(sum e) /[16 product_i sqrt(2-i e_i)] (1+O_e(1/N)), j0=v8/pi. Each square root has positive real part, so its leading coefficient is nonzero. Combining this actual source result with (4),(7) proves lim_(N->infinity) (2pi/N)log|<L(e)>_N| =4v8=Vol(S^3 minus L(e)). (8) The modified one-cut version has the same rate. The half-twist and full-twist source phases have been retained throughout; their geometric volume invariance has not been used to delete crossings from the quantum tensor diagram. ## 5. Reusable geometry and the remaining graph gate If only the white faces of the two P_3 projection cells are glued, the remaining shaded faces form six totally geodesic pairs of ideal triangles, one pair for each T_k^+ or T_k^-. Each is a genuine three-punctured sphere: its three sides are glued by the original white identity maps, and its two corners at each ideal puncture join to a cusp. Orthogonality of white and shaded faces makes the seam across every boundary edge smooth and totally geodesic. Thus this is a concrete four-octahedron geometric block with six geodesic pants boundary components. Matching boundary pants by any orientation-compatible puncture permutation preserves their canonical equal horocycles and gives a reusable complete geometric gluing operation. The theta link is obtained by the three recorded pairings of those pants. This does NOT yet identify a quantum six-port block for arbitrary graph sewing. Formula (1) closes all three circles and the entire magnetic tensor with a particular white/marked partner. A larger graph does not in general contain that closed local contraction. Its open kernel must retain the three paired normals, ordered boundary sources and the unique physical mark. One cannot replace that kernel by the positive scalar in (1), or apply the Latin angle assignment across a different graph without its actual edge table. The four-octahedron block and (6) are explicit local geometric data; the open-source identification is the remaining substantive gate. title: Actual full-volume ray components and exact normalization-cell pruning
text: # Actual full-volume ray components and exact normalization-cell pruning 28 October 2026. A strict exponential gap for EVERY radial component of the full-dilogarithm source is false for original hyperbolic knots. This can be proved in a literal Markov stabilization of the original word, with its original pivotal source. The resulting ray group is an explicit nonzero tame scalar times the WHOLE original invariant. The constructive conclusion is to contract complete normalization cells before estimating irreducible boundary components. Circle and ray terms of these cells combine exactly to their original normalization. No unproved knot value is used to define a replacement source. ## 1. A universal pivotal evaluation on the actual fusion channel Use the actual strict equal-color crossing and its original factors: R_+=kappa C D U_+ C^(-1), C=F_2 U_- F_1 F_2^(-1), C^(-1)=F_2 F_1^(-1) V_- F_2^(-1), d=N-1, F_j=(Q;Q)_j, g_b=x^(-d)Q^(-b). The notation and scalar line are those of [the original strict factorization](actual_euler_gaussian_cauchy_network.md). Let r=diag(r_0,...,r_d) be ANY diagonal on the second relative head. Then the exact operator identity is Tr_2[(I tensor g) kappa C D U_+ (I tensor r) C^(-1)] =kappa x^(-d) r_0 I. (1) In particular this holds before choosing a fixed cut entry, an averaged marker or an exterior tangle. All color, Cartan and pivotal factors are retained. No assumption on the norm or nonvanishing of r is made. Here is a direct all-level proof. Total integer degree makes the partial trace diagonal. Fix its first input a and the relative channel k. Expanding the original C,C^(-1),U_+,D coefficients, then setting j=k-b and s=j+(central shift-j), gives its value T_k(a)=kappa x^(-d-2k)(-1)^k F_k sum_(s=0)^k Q^[-k+(k-s)(k-s-1)/2] J_s(a)/(F_s F_(k-s)), J_s(a)=sum_(j=0)^s (-1)^(s-j) Q^[j(j+1)/2] (Q^(a-j+1);Q)_s/(F_j F_(s-j)). (2) The Pochhammer in (2) automatically kills illegal head indices: j>a contains 1-Q^0, and upper overflow contains 1-Q^N. Thus the displayed extended sum is exactly the original supported sum, including endpoints. The finite q-binomial theorem gives J_s(a)=(-1)^s. To verify this without a summation citation, expand (T Q^(1-j);Q)_s as a polynomial in T=Q^a. The j-sum of its coefficient of T^ell contains (Q^(1-ell);Q)_s. It vanishes for 1<=ell<=s; the constant coefficient is (-1)^s (Q;Q)_s/F_s=(-1)^s. Applying the same finite binomial theorem to the remaining s-sum gives T_k(a)=kappa x^(-d-2k)Q^(-k)(1;Q)_k =kappa x^(-d) delta_(k,0). (3) This proves (1) for every N>=2, including composite and even N. It does not rely on a scalar-endomorphism theorem for the modified crossing. The modified partial trace itself has been computed. For r=I, (1) is the original positive Markov/kink scalar alpha=kappa x^(-d). For general r the extra factor is exactly r_0. That factor must remain in the peripheral/framing line; it is not automatically a unit or a numerical normalization. ## 2. A radial component of an original Markov-stabilized knot Positively Markov-stabilize ANY original knot word. In its kink, split only the positive F_2 at the left end of C^(-1), using the EXACT full-Psi coefficient source from [the circle/ray theorem](actual_modular_dilog_circle_and_boundary_source.md). Keep every other factor as the original finite operator, or equivalently as its complete unsplit relative source. The positive factorial coefficient is F_k=N Q^(d-k) v_(+,d-k) =N Q^(d-k)[B_(+,d-k)(R)-E_(+,d-k)(R)]. (4) Its selected radial term, including the minus sign, has coefficient F_k^ray=-N Q^(d-k) E_(+,d-k)(R), r_k=F_k^ray/F_k. Replacing that F_2 in C^(-1) is exactly insertion of (I tensor r) immediately after C^(-1). Equation (1), with the unchanged Markov normalization alpha, therefore gives WHOLE radial group = h_N(R) K_N, h_N(R)=-N Q^(-1) E_(+,N-1)(R). (5) This is an identity of the actual stabilized source for every N, not an approximation or a source chosen from K_N. Since (1) is an operator identity, it applies equally to every original cut convention and to arbitrary exterior tensors. No sectorwise Ward replacement is performed after the decomposition. The corresponding circle group is (1-h_N)K_N. Their sum is exactly K_N. Expanding the other factors into circles and rays merely refines each of these groups into a fixed finite number of actual relative components; that count depends on the diagram, not on N. ## 3. The radial group has the same exponential rate Fix ANY 0<R<1 and put phi_R=Li_2(R)/(2*pi), c_R=R sqrt(1-R)/[-log(1-R)], 0<c_R<1. The exact small-disk full-Psi expansion, with two fixed derivatives, is uniform on 0<=t<=R. Its central logarithmic terms are exponentially small there and extend with the required fixed derivatives at t=0 for all sufficiently large N. Consequently Psi(log t)/(1-t^N) =sqrt(1-t) exp[-i N Li_2(t)/(2*pi)] (1+O_(R,C^2)(1/N)). The phase phi(t)=Li_2(t)/(2*pi) has no stationary point on [0,R]: phi'(t)=-log(1-t)/(2*pi*t)>0 and phi'(0)=1/(2*pi). Two integrations by parts yield E_(+,N-1)(R) =[c_R exp(-iN phi_R)-1]/N+O_R(N^(-2)), h_N(R)=Q^(-1)[1-c_R exp(-iN phi_R)]+O_R(1/N). (6) Thus h_N is bounded above and below by positive R-dependent constants for all sufficiently large N. The circle factor is tame and nonzero too: 1-h_N=c_R exp(-iN phi_R)+O_R(1/N). Multiplication by either factor changes normalized logarithmic growth by o(1), and preserves zeros at all sufficiently large levels. In particular the ray group (5) in a Markov-stabilized original figure-eight knot has the independently proved rate Vol(4_1)/(2*pi), not a strict smaller rate. This is a whole-knot example; the exterior has not been replaced by a scalar toy model. It follows that no theorem asserting a strict gap for every non-pure- circle component can hold for arbitrary original presentations. If all finitely many refined ray components had strictly smaller limsup rate, their group would too, contradicting (5)-(6) for the figure-eight. This does not refute a statement about a correctly pruned presentation or a grouped boundary class. ## 4. A source-compatible normalization quotient There are two exact pruning rules available BEFORE any asymptotics: 1. An adjacent typed fusion pair C_x^(-1)C_x or C_x C_x^(-1) is the identity on the original finite heads. If its full relative sources were already split, their COMPLETE sum is retained and contracted; individual rays need not be negligible. 2. A visible positive pivotal Markov cell in the form (1) is replaced by its original alpha times r_0. A complete circle-plus-ray cell has r_0=1. An isolated ray or circle group has the explicit factor in (5)-(6), which can be retained as a nonzero tame scalar. These are contextual operator identities: tensoring with an exterior, composing at its open port, and applying the original cap/source preserve them. On the channel algebra the Markov evaluation is the character r->r_0; its kernel is an ideal. This gives a precise pointed quotient for THESE normalization cells, rather than discarding all radial edges. The original alpha and any r_0 depending on peripheral variables remain specified until the actual source is evaluated. A fixed finite pruning sequence terminates because it removes visible fusion pairs or kink cells. No confluence or canonical reduced form is claimed. Negative kinks may also be removed as COMPLETE original normalization cells by their original Markov identity; the arbitrary-r evaluation (1) is asserted only for the displayed positive cell. The rule does not move arbitrary internal projectors or defects to the boundary. The actual failure of that operation is documented in [the interior-wall test](actual_interior_wall_cut_relocation.md). Nor does it claim that every remaining boundary component has a gap. The meaningful global target is now the source-preserving geometric comparison AFTER these explicit normalization groups have been contracted or retained with their known nonzero factors. ## 5. Reproducible audit `experiments/audit_actual_markov_ray_normalization.py` evaluates the original finite crossing independently, checks (1) for every channel and cut entry at complete and generic root colors, verifies both binomial sums, contracts literal whole figure-eight cut matrices with the normalized cell, and checks the exact radial factor against (6). The algebraic all-level proof and uniform lower bound are above.

title: The marked crossing-circle rectangle has ratio at most one
status: Actual primitive-word bound c at most one
text: # The marked crossing-circle rectangle has ratio at most one A crossing circle in an augmented link surrounds two main strands. Its complete cusp has a distinguished rectangle determined by the original crossing disk and its meridian paths. This note proves that the positive ratio \(c\) of that disk-framed rectangle satisfies \[ 0<c\le1. \tag{1} \] The hypothesis is an actual complete right-angled matching-polyhedron certificate, including its labeled face pairings and primitive peripheral curves. An abstract ideal rectangle without those identifications need not satisfy (1). The consequence is a restriction on the trace used by the quantum recoupling formula: it lies at or below \(-2\). The proof is geometric but short. The marked paths make the target an element of the complete manifold's holonomy group. If \(c>1\), that element would be an elliptic rotation with an interior fixed axis, contradicting the free deck action. The endpoint \(c=1\) is a nonidentity parabolic element and is allowed. ## 1. The rectangle and the based meridian matrices Assume the labeled cut, complete cusp metric and primitive crossing-circle paths of the [matching-polyhedron certificate](general_augmented_plat_matching_geometry.md). In its disk-framed coordinate, the rectangle has vertices \[ (1,E,-1,-E),\qquad E=e^{2\pi i x},\qquad 0<x<\tfrac12,\qquad c=\cot(\pi x)>0. \] The parameter \(x\) describes this rectangle. The number \(c\) is its ratio in the stated disk framing, not an arbitrary choice of Euclidean scale. Let \(A,B\) be determinant-one lifts of the two based main-meridian holonomies. Their basepaths are those of the original threading diagram. They can be normalized as \[ A=-\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\0&1\end{pmatrix},\qquad B=-\begin{pmatrix}1&0\\-4&1\end{pmatrix}. \] Put \(P=BA\), \(H=P+I\), so \(H^2=0\). The pure transport through the crossing disk has the form \(C=I+bH\), and the transported outgoing meridian is \(B_{\mathrm{out}}=CBC^{-1}\). The retained half-twist sign is \(\epsilon\in\{0,+1,-1\}\). Let \(\tau_\epsilon\) be the primitive cusp shape in that actual signed diagram. The collar calculation and quantum sign calibration give \[ \tau_\epsilon=\frac{2ic}{1-\epsilon ic},\qquad b-\frac\epsilon2=\frac1{\tau_\epsilon},\qquad b=-\frac{i}{2c}. \tag{2} \] Thus the same coefficient \(b\) is obtained for all three retained signs. The inverse cup bend in the quantum contraction fixes the target word. It is \[ W=B^{-1}B_{\mathrm{out}},\qquad \operatorname{Tr}W=2+16b^2=2-\frac4{c^2}. \tag{3} \] This is the [actual geometric target formula](actual_matching_edge_geometric_target_polynomial.md). To use completeness, we must know that \(W\) really belongs to the marked holonomy group. For a half-twisted disk, that does not follow by simply assuming that the pure transport \(C\) is itself a group element. The next step supplies the actual words. ## 2. Recovering the group word at each half-twist sign Set \(S=I+H/2\), and let \(\mu\) be the based auxiliary meridian. The primitive-collar reconstruction in the [critical-scheme theorem](actual_augmented_plat_critical_scheme.md), at its complete endpoint \(J=-1\), gives the projective identity \[ \mu=C^{-1}S^\epsilon. \tag{4} \] The scalar in this identity is accounted for explicitly. The generic factor \((P^{-1}-I)^\epsilon\) specializes through \[ P^{-1}-I=-2S, \] and the recorded factor \(h_J^{-\epsilon}=(-2)^{-\epsilon}\) cancels it. Any remaining central lift sign does not affect conjugation. Thus (4) represents the primitive meridian rather than a substituted half-longitude. Direct multiplication gives \[ SBS^{-1}=A,\qquad S^{-1}BS=BAB^{-1}. \tag{5} \] Substituting \(C=\mu^{-1}S^\epsilon\) into \(B_{\mathrm{out}}=CBC^{-1}\) yields \[ B_{\mathrm{out}}= \begin{cases} \mu^{-1}B\mu,&\epsilon=0,\\ \mu^{-1}A\mu,&\epsilon=+1,\\ \mu^{-1}BAB^{-1}\mu,&\epsilon=-1. \end{cases} \tag{6} \] Every line is an actual based holonomy word in the same complete manifold. The common basepaths of \(A,B,\mu\) come from the original threading convention. Therefore \(W=B^{-1}B_{\mathrm{out}}\) is a group element for every retained sign. Nothing requires \(S\) itself to belong to that group. Changing a determinant-one lift sign cannot change whether the corresponding projective element is elliptic or parabolic. ## 3. Completeness rules out a ratio greater than one The certified metric is complete, and its universal developing cover is hyperbolic three-space. Its holonomy acts by deck transformations and hence freely: no nonidentity element fixes an interior point. Suppose \(c>1\). Equation (3) gives \(-2<\operatorname{Tr}W<2\). The determinant-one matrix then has distinct eigenvalues \(e^{i\theta},e^{-i\theta}\), with \(0<\theta<\pi\). Its projective action is a nontrivial rotation about the geodesic joining its two ideal fixed points. That rotation fixes the interior points of its axis, contradicting the free deck action. Consequently \(c\le1\), which proves (1). This argument uses the actual marked word (6). It needs no additional conjectural packing inequality. It also explains the role of the hypothesis: an abstract rectangle does not supply a deck transformation, so the same contradiction would not be available. At equality, the target is parabolic rather than the identity. In the chosen lift, \[ W=\begin{pmatrix} 8b^2-4b+1&4b^2\\ 16b^2&8b^2+4b+1 \end{pmatrix}. \] When \(c=1\), equation (2) gives \(b=-i/2\), and \[ W+I=\begin{pmatrix}2i&-1\\-4&-2i\end{pmatrix}\ne0, \qquad (W+I)^2=0. \] A nontrivial parabolic transformation has no interior fixed point, so completeness does not exclude this case. A strict inequality would require another argument about this particular word. ## 4. Consequence for the spectral target For every crossing circle covered by the complete marked certificate, \[ \begin{array}{ll} c<1:&\operatorname{Tr}W<-2,\\ c=1:&\operatorname{Tr}W=-2. \end{array} \] Thus the target is either real and outside the physical Casimir interval \([-2,2]\), or at its parabolic endpoint. The formal branch \(c>1\) still exists in the local algebraic four-parabolic relation, but it cannot be the complete geometry with these marked identifications. The conclusion concerns the trace, not every entry of a surrounding operator. It does not place all physical rows in a favorable support domain, identify the surrounding continuant state, or prove that a contour contribution survives. Those are separate analytical tasks. The [focused calculation](../experiments/audit_actual_matching_circle_rectangle_bound.py) checks the scalar cancellation, the three based words, the trace and the nonidentity endpoint matrix through sixteen exact identities; the free-deck argument above proves the general geometric restriction.

text: # The original physical operator kernel and its positive anti-diagonal packet 30 October 2026. The actual pivotal reshuffle turns an anti-diagonal entry of the completed exceptional Casimir polynomial into the squared modulus of ONE original ordinary column, with an explicit positive factor. Then the exact finite identity is [p_a(J_t)]_(u,v) =s_(a+h)/(s_h^2 s_(a-h)) |f_(d-h,a)(u)|^2. (2) No projectors or target channels have been discarded in (2). The opposite anti-diagonal entry equals (2), since the original root J_t is symmetric under transpose. The high physical total uses the already proved exact generic translated adapter, and hence the same formula in its low coordinates. Here is the full source and phase proof. Use the actual maps of the [completed projector theorem](actual_matching_edge_completed_projector_block.md): B(K)_(a,b,c,e)=K_(a,b;d-e,d-c) pV(d-e)pV(d-c), (R Psi)_(a,b,c,e)=s(a) Psi_(b,c,e,a), s(j)=(-1)^d q^(d-2j), A=B^-1 R B. In the first line pV(j)=pV(j,d-j), and dummy outside labels are unrelated to the channel a. Direct inversion, retaining the nested cup order, gives for every physical operator K (A^-1 K)_(a,b;x,y) =s(d-x)^-1 pV(d-b)/pV(x) K_(d-x,a;y,d-b). (3) The original measure cancellation is h0_a K_a=k_a N A p_a(Omega), where h0_a=k_a N s_(2a)/s_a^2 and K_a=W_a pi_a. On the chosen anti-diagonal, (3) therefore gives [p_a(J_t)]_(u,v) =s_(2a)/s_a^2 s(d-v)^-1 pV(d-v)/pV(v) K_a(d-v,u;u,d-v). (4) At the root the actual physical cup is pV(j)=N q^(-d^2+dj). Consequently s(d-v)^-1 pV(d-v)/pV(v)=1 EXACTLY: its remaining exponent is N(d-2v), and its sign cancels (-1)^d. The original white map, in channel row r=a-h, is pi_a(r;x,y)=G_(a,r)^-1 conjugate(W_a(y,x;r)), G_(a,r)=s_(2a)/(s_r s_(2a-r)). Thus (4) is s_(a-h)s_(a+h)/s_a^2 times |W_a(d-v,u;a-h)|^2. The channel row is absent if h>a, proving (1) independently of polynomial bandwidth. When h<=a, this Clebsch column has low degree d-h. Its actual first endpoint has modulus s_a/(s_h s_(a-h)). The root reflected recurrence gives |f_(d-h,a)(d-v)|=|f_(d-h,a)(u)|, because those two indices add to d-h. Substitution proves (2). In particular d-h>=d-a automatically lies in the original complete-column range; no unsupported ordinary formula at a different degree is invoked. ## 2. A uniform nonzero relative operator amplitude Write the ACTUAL scaled parameters alpha=a/N, delta=h/N, nu=u/N, tau_prime=(d-h)/N=1-delta-1/N. Consider any fixed compact inside 0<delta<alpha<=1/2, 0<nu<(1-delta)/2. (5) As usual alpha denotes an admissible discrete sequence; its endpoint 1/2 is interpreted by the actual folded sequences a/N. Physical u+v<=d is retained. The transformed ordinary arguments stay in a fixed compact of the full physical tube, since tau_prime>1/2 and 0<nu<tau_prime. The original total (u+v)/N may be BELOW 1/2. The proved [ordinary full-domain packet](actual_q_hahn_full_physical_complex_packet.md) has the actual, nonzero amplitude B_alpha and phase Phi_alpha: f_(d-h,a)(u)=N^-1/2 B_alpha(tau_prime,nu) exp[N Phi_alpha(tau_prime,nu)](1+O(N^-1)). Equation (2) now gives directly [p_a(J_t)]_(u,v) =s_(a+h)/(N s_h^2 s_(a-h)) |B_alpha(tau_prime,nu)|^2 exp[2N Re Phi_alpha(tau_prime,nu)](1+O(N^-1)). (6) The error is uniform on (5), and the leading factor is positive and nonzero. Both integer offsets remain in tau_prime and in B; there is no replacement of tau_prime by 1-delta inside the N-scaled exponential. For an entirely smooth amplitude, put J(x)=integral_0^x log(2sin(pi s)) ds. The uniform sine-factorial formula s_(Nx)=sqrt(2N sin(pi x)) exp[N J(x)](1+O(N^-1)) on compact subsets of 0<x<1 rewrites (6) as [p_a(J_t)]_(u,v)=N^-2 C_alpha(delta,tau_prime,nu) exp[N H_alpha(delta,tau_prime,nu)] (1+O(N^-1)), (7) H_alpha=J(alpha+delta)-2J(delta)-J(alpha-delta) +2Re Phi_alpha(tau_prime,nu), C_alpha=|B_alpha(tau_prime,nu)|^2/(2sin(pi delta)) *sqrt(sin(pi(alpha+delta))/sin(pi(alpha-delta))). All scalar arguments in (7) remain strictly between zero and one on the stated compact. This is an actual local matrix-entry asymptotic, rather than a scalar-symbol substitution or a spectral stationary-phase conjecture. ## 3. Genuine q jets come from the generic reshuffle One MUST NOT differentiate the absolute square in (2). The original generic identity is instead p_a(Omega)=D_a/(rho_a beta_N) B^-1 R^-1 S_(2a), S_(2a)=W_a p_(2a) W_a^T. (8) Every anti-diagonal entry of the right side has exactly ONE channel row r=a-h and its complement 2a-r. The two Clebsch entries, original ordinary cup, physical inverse cups, turn, and scalar in (8) retain their genuine q dependence. There is no sum in this entry which could hide cancellation between exponentially larger summands. Their original Clebsch endpoint factors and the cups in (8) are root-unit products with harmonic logarithmic derivative bounds. Therefore, for each fixed m, on (5) there are constants C_m,L_m independent of the physical labels and level parity such that |partial_epsilon^m [p_a(Omega(q exp(epsilon)))]_(u,v)|_0 <=C_m N^L_m [p_a(J_t(q))]_(u,v). (9) All derivatives in (9) include the q dependence of the polynomial AND of the original matrix. The completed face-normalized operator has the same bound. This is an upper bound for genuine normals, not their nonzero amplitude. The analogous entry remains identically zero outside |u-v|<=a at generic q, by bandwidth. ## 4. The entire physical kernel, with its original phase The same proof also gives every entry. Let 0<=u<=v<=t<=d, h=v-u, and 0<=h<=a. Then [p_a(J_t)]_(u,v) =q^[-d(t-u-v)] s_(a+h)/(s_h^2 s_(a-h)) *conjugate(f_(d-h,a)(u)) f_(d-h,a)(t-v). (10) Here (3) uses the original entry K_a(d-v,u;t-v,d-t+u), in degree d-h. Its white reversal gives W_a(d-v,u) times conjugate(W_a(d-t+u,t-v)), divided by the same G_(a,a-h). The root reflected recurrence is f_(d-h,a)(d-h-r)=f_(d-h,a)(d-h) conjugate(f_(d-h,a)(r)). The two endpoint factors cancel because the final normalized endpoint has modulus one. The remaining cup and turn ratio in (3) is exactly q^[-d(t-u-v)]. This proves (10), including its phase. Entries below the diagonal follow by transpose symmetry of the ROOT J_t. Both arguments u and t-v are actual physical arguments in the same complete column. The generic tensor corresponding to (10) still has only one channel row. Consequently the genuine-jet bound (9) holds for every strict physical entry covered below, with the positive right side replaced by the modulus of (10). This uses (8), not differentiation of the conjugation or root reflection in (10). There is a useful finite product for its entire scalar. The exact root identity s_h s_(d-h)=N gives s_(a+h)/(s_h^2 s_(a-h)) =P_(N,a)(h) :=N^-1 product_(r=1)^(d-a) 2sin[pi(h+r)/N] *product_(r=1)^a 2sin[pi(h+r)/N]. (11) For h<=a, cancel the two products using s_(d-a+h)=N/s_(a-h). For each physical integer a<h<=d, the first product instead contains its factor with h+r=N, hence vanishes. Thus (11) is a literal finite entire function, not an interpolation inferred from the leading sine-factorial rate. ## 5. A source-matching complex root kernel and relative amplitude Use independent scaled variables delta,nu,lambda, corresponding on the physical grid to h=N delta, u=N nu, t-v=N lambda, v=N(nu+delta), t=N(nu+lambda+delta). For fixed actual alpha=a/N, take compact subsets of the convex tube 0<Re delta<alpha, Re nu>0, Re lambda>0, Re(nu+lambda+delta)<1. (12) The channel remains an integer. Put tau_prime=1-delta-1/N. For all large N, (tau_prime,nu) and (tau_prime,lambda) lie in fixed compacts of the proved full physical ordinary tube. If fhat denotes that original finite continuation, define fhat_a^#(tau,nu)=conjugate(fhat_a(conjugate(tau),conjugate(nu))), where fhat_a(tau,nu) is understood to have the scaled arguments (Nnu,N(tau-nu)). Define the finite root kernel K_(N,a)(delta,nu,lambda) =exp[-pi i(N-1)(lambda-nu)] P_(N,a)(N delta) fhat_a^#(tau_prime,nu) fhat_a(tau_prime,lambda). (13) Equation (10) proves EXACT equality with the original physical matrix entry at every grid point in (12). All factors of (13) are explicit original finite functions or the finite product (11). (14) The square root is its positive real branch continued on (12). Then the ACTUAL finite function (13) satisfies K_(N,a)=N^-2 C exp(N H)(1+O(N^-1)). This complex continuation is for the ROOT kernel. It does not by itself continue the genuine generic-q normals of (8) to complex magnetic rows, nor identify (13)'s branch at a particular geometric frame. Those are separate requirements. ## 6. text: # The matching-edge target gauge and its completed projector pairs Follow-up: the [native-energy theorem](actual_matching_edge_native_projector_energy.md) now gives the column measures and polynomial relative derivative costs for these completed operators. Consequently N_g=theta_g Pi_g as an identity of ACTUAL operators. The exact scalar is theta_g=(-1)^(d-g) zeta^(2d^2-g^2)/N^2 *[d+g+1]!/([d-g]![2g+1]!). (3) Here is a direct proof from the original matrix, without a quoted theta or quantum-group norm formula. In physical degree d the entry of the bent tensor S_(2g) at (d,0,0,d) is the previously derived chi X. Undoing the physical bend gives (N_g)_(d,0)=zeta^[2g(g-d)] F_d^2 / (L^2 F_(d-g)^2 F_(2g)), (4) where the two indices in (4) are the first physical magnetic index in that degree-d block. In particular its row d means (d,0), and its column zero means (0,d). The product of the original lower offdiagonals of that tridiagonal block is product_(r=0)^(d-1) zeta^-N(1-Q^(r+1))^2 =zeta^(-Nd) F_d^2. The extreme adjugate entry of zI-Omega therefore gives (Pi_g)_(d,0)=zeta^(-Nd)F_d^2/chi'(lambda_g), chi(z)=product_(h=0)^d(z-lambda_h). (5) This adjugate identity is the unique lower path through a tridiagonal matrix; it also follows by induction on its size. The elementary factorization of eigenvalue differences yields chi'(lambda_g)=(zeta-zeta^-1)^(2d)(-1)^(d-g) [d-g]![d+g+1]!/[2g+1]. (6) Divide (4) by (5). Since F_k=zeta^[k(k-1)/2](1-Q)^k[k]!, the residual exponent before inserting L is -g^2. Substituting L=N zeta^-d^2 proves (3). ## 2. The actual target scalar becomes a face factor The exact target product of the preceding block theorem is h_g=1/(b_(2g)J_(d-g)V_(d-g)) =(-1)^d zeta^(g^2+d) [g]!^2[d-g]!^2[2g+1]![2d+1]! / ([d]!^2[d+g+1]!^2). Define the already proved regular face factor and a universal scalar D_g=(-1)^g[N][g]!^2[d-g]!/[d+g+1]!, beta_N=zeta^(2d^2+d)/N^2 *[2d+1]!/([N][d]!^2). (7) Multiplication of the ACTUAL products gives exactly h_g theta_g=beta_N D_g. (8) At the root D_g(q)=1 for every g, while beta_N(q)=(-1)^d q^(d+2)/N^2. (9) All these root-zero cancellations are performed generically. Both D_g and beta_N/beta_N(q) are holomorphic units on a uniform disk of radius c/[N^2(1+log N)], and every fixed relative jet has polynomial cost, by their explicit root-unit factorial products. For clarity, let R be the ACTUAL last-to-first cyclic tensor turn (R Psi)(u,v,w,z)=(-1)^d zeta^(d-2u) Psi(v,w,z,u), B(K)=K(pV tensor pV)P. Equations (1)--(8) give the exact typed target identity h_g T_(2g)=beta_N R B(D_g Pi_g). (10) It holds at generic zeta through the entire range 0<=g<=d. The physical reversal and odd-d turn remain in (10). At the root the norm of B on Hilbert--Schmidt matrices is N^2, and the norm of R is one. Equation (9) cancels that physical scale. Fixed generic derivatives of the combined map beta_N R B have only polynomial cost. This removes its scalar factorial cost; it says nothing by itself about the operator norms of the Pi_g. ## 3. Pair before taking the normal Fix the original folded row a, and put F_ag=G_ag D_g, G_ag=(-1)^d S_ag/[N], F_ag(q)=R_N(a,g)>0. For a paired target choose 0<=g<g'=d-g and set Q_g=Pi_g+Pi_g', M_g=(Omega-lambda_g' I)Q_g, H_ag=(F_ag-F_ag')/(lambda_g-lambda_g'). (11) Each of the three quantities in (11) is holomorphic at the root. For Q_g, the quadratic cluster factor (z-lambda_g)(z-lambda_g') is coprime there to the product of the other cluster factors. Bezout gives its spectral projector as a polynomial in Omega with coefficients regular at q. This is the generic sum in (11), so it remains regular through the collision. The polynomial identity product_h(Omega-lambda_h I)=0 holds generically and hence at q; in particular Q_g(q)^2=Q_g(q), M_g(q)^2=0. (12) The odd simple target g=d/2 is kept separately and its Pi_g is already regular. No positivity or Hermitian self-adjointness is asserted for any of these projectors. For H_ag, the numerator vanishes because the positive scalar partners have the same root value and D_g(q)=D_g'(q)=1. The denominator has a SIMPLE zero, with its actual TARGET convention lambda_g-lambda_g' =-(zeta^s-zeta^-s)(zeta^N-zeta^-N), s=d-2g, partial_t(lambda_g-lambda_g')(0)=2N Delta_g, Delta_g=q^(2g+1)-q^(-2g-1). (13) This sign is opposite to the compiler's small-index minus large-index gap: its channel index is m=d-g. It must not be inferred from a root-only eigenvalue formula. The exact regular paired identity is F_ag Pi_g+F_ag' Pi_g' =F_ag' Q_g+H_ag M_g. (14) Thus at the root it is R_N(a,g)Q_g(q)+H_ag(q)M_g(q). The nilpotent Hermite term is retained; equality of the two scalar root values does not remove it. There are uniform scalar jet estimates, for every fixed r, |[t^r]F_ag|<=C_r P_N^r R_N(a,g), |[t^r]H_ag|<=C_r P_N^(r+1) R_N(a,g), P_N=N^2(1+log N). (15) Indeed the first bound is the existing scalar/face theorem. On a slightly smaller common disk, (F_ag-F_ag')/t has size at most C P_N R_N(a,g) by Cauchy's formula and its zero at the center. The function (lambda_g-lambda_g')/t is a unit on that disk, uniformly bounded below: its root magnitude is 4N sin(pi s/N)>=8, and its two elementary factors have controlled relative changes there. Dividing and applying Cauchy again proves the second bound. Both numerator and gap derivatives are included. ## 4. The resulting source interface and its remaining estimate The full weighted recoupling inside the block is now sum_(g=0)^d G_ag h_g T_(2g) =beta_N R B[ sum_(g<d-g)(F_ag' Q_g+H_ag M_g) + the odd simple term F_(a,d/2) Pi_(d/2) ]. (16) The last term is included only when d is even. Its a is still the original folded row label. Every term on the right is regular BEFORE the whole-network first normal is taken. Its first derivative uses only Q_g,M_g and their FIRST generic-q derivatives. The scalar H_ag' already retains the necessary second derivatives of the original F weights. Equation (16) is equivalent to the prior Taylor-two Laurent extraction, with the partner cancellation performed explicitly rather than left between separate singular target terms. There is also a complete cancellation of the original universal scalar. Retain u_a=rho_a/rho_a(q) from the marked block theorem, put v_N=beta_N/beta_N(q), and define the ACTUAL physical reshuffle A(t)=B(t)^-1 R(t) B(t). The original measure identity and (9) give h0_a gamma_a^-1 rho_a(q) beta_N(q)=k_a N, h0_a K_a(t)=k_a N u_a(t)v_N(t) A(t) E_a(t), (17) where E_a denotes the regular completed sum in square brackets in (16). Every factor in (17) is regular. At the root A is an isometry for the Hilbert--Schmidt norm: B is N^2 times a unitary map, R is unitary, and B^-1 is N^-2 times a unitary map. Its fixed jets have polynomial cost. The equalities use the original physical cups, not a new metric on the internal channels. Let C(t) be the ordinary complementary closure and nu_N its original trace-normal constant as in the preceding marked block theorem. Then the exact signed weighted sector is h0_a omega_a^epsilon Z_Delta =k_a N omega_a^epsilon/nu_N *[t^1]{u_a v_N C(t)(A(t)E_a(t))}. (18) The retained phase omega_a^epsilon remains unchanged. For a concrete upper bound define, in the original physical basis, J_C^(1)=max_(r=0,1)||[t^r]C||, J_g^cl=max_(r=0,1)(||[t^r]Q_g||_HS+||[t^r]M_g||_HS), J_mid=max_(r=0,1)||[t^r]Pi_(d/2)||_HS (only when d is even). Using (15),(17) and |nu_N|=N/sin(pi/N) gives |h0_a omega_a^epsilon Z_Delta| <=C k_a sin(pi/N) P_N^2 J_C^(1) *[sum_(g<d-g) R_N(a,g)J_g^cl + R_N(a,d/2)J_mid]. (19) The last summand is again omitted when d is odd. A weighted Cauchy inequality can be applied to this positive scalar sum, with these specified native cluster costs. Formula (19) improves the earlier unpaired target bound: only regular completed cluster first jets remain, and no target scalar factorial gauge is left unidentified. It does not assert that the J_g^cl are polynomial or subexponential. The [physical generic-jet theorem](actual_q_hahn_physical_generic_jet_bound.md) controls all fixed q jets of original normalized physical columns and their genuine divided pair. It is relevant to the next step, but does not automatically bound the Q_g,M_g here. In particular a root spectral derivative cannot be substituted for Q_g' or M_g'. The latter contain the variation of the actual Casimir matrix and its generic spectral data.
