title: The original exceptional operator as a continuant period
status: Exact operator period and retained normal poles
text: # The original exceptional operator as a continuant period 30 October 2026. The completed matching block has an exact generic contour representation whose entries are original forward and backward continuants. It retains the paired double poles, moving-q normals, physical target order and finite propagation. This separates an actual operator period from evaluation of its scalar polynomial at a classical trace. No geometric saddle contribution or sharp complementary contraction estimate is asserted. ## 1. The original generic matrix and its actual spectrum Put d=N-1 and use zeta=q exp(h), q=exp(pi i/N). In a physical total-degree block 0<=t<=d, the original Casimir J_t(zeta) has diagonal A_r, upper U_r and lower L_r, r=0,...,t: Q=zeta^2, A_r=zeta^-1 Q^(r-t)(1-Q^(N-r))(1-Q^r) +zeta^(-2d-1)Q^r(1-Q^(N-t+r))(1-Q^(t-r)) +zeta^(2d+1)Q^-t+zeta^(-2d-1)Q^t, U_r=zeta^-N Q^(2r+1-t)(1-Q^(N-r-1))(1-Q^(t-r)), L_r=zeta^-N(1-Q^(N-t+r))(1-Q^(r+1)). (1) The offdiagonals are indexed 0<=r<t. These are the actual entries proved in [the physical generic-jet theorem](actual_q_hahn_physical_generic_jet_bound.md). In particular U and L are NOT identified away from the root. All internal offdiagonals are nonzero at q. The actual generic high-degree adapter identifies total degree 2d-t with this same matrix, with the translated physical indices; no new norm or complex conjugation is imposed. Its generic characteristic polynomial is chi_t(zeta,z)=product_(m=0)^t (z-lambda_m(zeta)), lambda_m(zeta)=zeta^(2N-2m-1)+zeta^(-2N+2m+1). (2) This follows from the original normalized Clebsch columns for m=0,...,t and their distinct generic eigenvalues. Their generic source identity then extends (2) to q. The target label used in the recoupling is g=d-m, so (2) is exactly the target Casimir zeta^(2g+1)+zeta^(-2g-1), with its original moving-q derivative. At q the only repeated eigenvalues are the pairs m and d-m when both occur in this block. Their multiplicity is two. An odd-level middle label is simple. An unreduced tridiagonal matrix has one-dimensional eigenspaces: its first coordinate determines an eigenvector recursively and cannot vanish. Therefore every paired node here has a genuine Jordan block of size two, rather than two independent eigenspaces. ## 2. Exact Green entries with both continuants retained Define the prefix and suffix determinants P_r(z)=det(zI-J_t[0,...,r-1]), P_0=1, S_r(z)=det(zI-J_t[r,...,t]), S_(t+1)=1. (3) All quantities retain their dependence on zeta. They satisfy the original forward and backward determinant recurrences. For example P_(r+1)=(z-A_r)P_r-U_(r-1)L_(r-1)P_(r-1). For z outside the actual spectrum, set R_t(zeta,z)=(zI-J_t)^-1. The exact entries are (R_t)_(u,v)= (product_(r=u)^(v-1) U_r) P_u S_(v+1)/chi_t, u<=v, (product_(r=v)^(u-1) L_r) P_v S_(u+1)/chi_t, v<=u. (4) Empty products are one, so the two formulas agree on the diagonal. Expanding a tridiagonal cofactor proves (4): the intervening chain uses exactly the indicated upper or lower entries, and the two remaining blocks supply the prefix and suffix. Equivalently direct multiplication by zI-J_t verifies (4) using (3). No root-only reflection is differentiated to obtain the backward factor. ## 3. The exact generic operator period and its bandwidth Let p_a(zeta,z) and D_a(zeta) be the original polynomial and face factor in [the generic target identity](actual_matching_edge_geometric_target_polynomial.md). For the original folded range 0<=a<=floor(d/2), their coefficients are holomorphic near q after the displayed common face zero is canceled. The completed operator before the fixed physical bend and pivotal turn is E_a(zeta)=D_a(zeta)^-1 p_a(zeta,Omega(zeta)). (5) Fix one contour Gamma enclosing ALL the root spectral nodes, for example the positively oriented circle |z|=3. For zeta in a sufficiently small neighborhood of q, the same contour encloses every moving node and meets none. On each physical block, E_(a,t)(zeta) =D_a(zeta)^-1/(2pi i) integral_Gamma p_a(zeta,z) R_t(zeta,z) dz. (6) This follows either by Cauchy's formula on the generic eigenspaces, then holomorphic continuation, or by expanding the resolvent at infinity and taking the coefficient of z^-1. Thus (6) is valid at the paired root WITHOUT deleting its double poles. Substitution of (4) is an exact single spectral-period representation of every native magnetic matrix entry. The original polynomial has degree a. Since J_t is tridiagonal, (E_(a,t)(zeta))_(u,v)=0 if |u-v|>a. (7) This is a generic identity, so every fixed moving-q derivative has the SAME bandwidth. Equivalently (6) has exact cancellation outside this band. This assertion is about the actual target physical coordinates BEFORE the recorded bend and pivotal turn; it does not silently permute the original outside ports. The full source substitution retains beta_N times the original bend and turn, the row factor and half-twist, and the whole-source marked normal, exactly as in the completed target theorem. Those factors have not been absorbed into a chosen resolvent norm. ## 4. Genuine moving-q normals and the reduced pole budget Differentiate in h with z FIXED. The exact identity is partial_h R_t=R_t (partial_h J_t) R_t. Consequently the first normal of (6) is partial_h E_(a,t) =-(partial_h D_a)/D_a *E_(a,t) +D_a^-1/(2pi i) integral_Gamma [(partial_h p_a)R_t+p_a R_t(partial_h J_t)R_t] dz. (8) The partial derivative of p_a retains every generic-q coefficient. The derivative of J_t is the derivative of (1), including the distinct generic upper and lower entries. Formula (8) therefore includes moving spectral nodes and moving generalized eigenspaces, not merely a derivative of the scalar root value. There is a useful exact reduction at a paired node lambda. Let Q(h) be its analytic two-dimensional cluster projector, and let its two actual analytic eigenbranches be lambda_1(h),lambda_2(h). At h=0 put Q=Q(0), M=(J_t(q)-lambda)Q, M^2=0. Then the root resolvent on this cluster is R_cluster=Q/(z-lambda)+M/(z-lambda)^2. (9) The apparent fourth-order pole in R(partial_h J)R vanishes. Indeed differentiate the exact cluster identity (J-lambda_1)(J-lambda_2)Q(h)=0 and sandwich it by Q. It gives Q J' M+M J' Q=(lambda_1'+lambda_2')M, M J' M=0. (10) The second equation follows by multiplication by M. Thus the same-cluster contribution to R J' R is exactly Q J' Q/(z-lambda)^2 +(lambda_1'+lambda_2')M/(z-lambda)^3. (11) Terms between different spectral clusters remain in (8); they must not be discarded. They contain the actual motion of the cluster projectors. The source derivative of the paired gap is lambda_j'-lambda_(d-j)'=-2N(q^(2j+1)-q^(-2j-1)), in convention (2). More generally the r-th moving-q derivative of the resolvent has pole order at most r+2 at a paired node and at most r+1 at a simple node. To see this WITHOUT assuming diagonalizability at the root, the exact analytic cluster resolvent is R_cluster(h,z)= [(z-lambda_1(h))Q(h)+(J(h)-lambda_2(h))Q(h)] /[(z-lambda_1(h))(z-lambda_2(h))]. (12) Each h derivative increases the specialized denominator pole order by at most one. All numerators and cluster projectors in (12) are holomorphic. The corresponding scalar spectral derivatives needed in an r-th operator normal consequently have order at most r+1, with the actual q derivatives still retained. In particular the first normal needs scalar spectral derivatives only through order two, consistent with the prior Taylor-two calculation. These are exact pole budgets, not size bounds on the cluster projectors. ## 5. Scalar continuation is distinct from contour contribution The [source-polynomial root theorem](actual_matching_edge_racah_root_location.md) gives a canonical Log p_a and a leading scalar action throughout C minus [2,infinity). This is a statement about p_a, not about R_t. The latter has the actual nodes of (2), all in [-2,2] at q, including their double poles. In particular a target below -2 is off the root spectrum. A general target in (-2,2) lies in its spectral interval, among nodes that become dense as N grows. Any deformation of (6) must avoid those actual poles or account for their residues. The scalar's zero-free continuation does not permit deleting them. The exact numerator in (4) is where selected forward/backward boundary estimates can enter. A proof of a geometric contribution must still analyze that numerator together with chi_t, the fixed spectral contour, and the actual surrounding coherent state. It cannot replace p_a(Omega) by p_a(lambda_geometric) pointwise. Equations (4),(6),(8),(12) expose that remaining operator problem while preserving its original source and every required normal. Audit: [actual Green entries, contour coefficients, normal poles and bandwidth](../experiments/audit_actual_matching_edge_continuant_operator_period.py). The operator-period identity includes no contour deformation or scalar-to-operator asymptotic.

title: The original cross-central Green kernel has a selected spectral action
status: Actual Green action and generic jets on strict support
text: # The original cross-central Green kernel has a selected spectral action 30 October 2026. The exact exceptional operator period now has a source-selected leading Green-kernel action when its two physical rows lie strictly on opposite sides of the midpoint. The actual characteristic denominator, all phases and both level parities are retained. On the anti-diagonal the original Green entry is strictly negative for every real spectral parameter below -2. Every fixed genuine generic-q jet costs only a polynomial relative to that root Green entry on the strict fixed compacts below. This is an integrand theorem. It neither deforms the fixed contour nor proves that its geometric critical point contributes. ## 1. Exact original phases and the anti-diagonal sign Use the original root matrix J_t of [the continuant operator period](actual_matching_edge_continuant_operator_period.md), with 0<=t<=d=N-1. Let 0<=u<=v<=t, q=exp(pi i/N), theta=pi/N, and Delta_m(z)=det(J_[m]-zI), D_t(z)=det(J_t-zI) =product_(h=0)^t [2cos((2h+1)theta)-z]. The original upper and lower entries agree AT THE ROOT and equal U_r=-a_r exp[i(2r+1-t)theta], a_r=4sin((t-r)theta)sin((r+1)theta)>0. (1) The root reversal is J_t reversed=conjugate(J_t). Thus the trailing determinant of size t-v is conjugate(Delta_(t-v)(conjugate z)). Substitution in the exact Green formula gives (zI-J_t)^-1_(u,v) =-exp[i theta(v-u)(u+v-t)] *product_(r=u)^(v-1) a_r *Delta_u(z) conjugate(Delta_(t-v)(conjugate z))/D_t(z). (2) The single minus sign is important. The upper product has sign (-1)^(v-u), the two zI-J continuants have signs (-1)^u and (-1)^(t-v), and the full characteristic determinant has sign (-1)^(t+1). Their ratio is -1, independent of every label and level parity. Also sum_(r=u)^(v-1)(2r+1-t)=(v-u)(u+v-t) exactly. For a real z<-2 the denominator D_t(z) is positive. If u+v=t, the phase in (2) is one and its two prefix lengths agree. Hence (zI-J_t)^-1_(u,t-u) =-product_(r=u)^(t-u-1) a_r *|Delta_u(z)|^2/D_t(z)<0, 0<=u<=floor(t/2). (3) Strictness is exact, not asymptotic. For u=0 the empty determinant is one. For u>0, the already proved positive imaginary part of the physical half-prefix implies Delta_u(z)!=0 for every real z; its proof needs only u<=floor(t/2), not a complete-channel assumption. See the explicit extension in the [physical generic-jet theorem](actual_q_hahn_physical_generic_jet_bound.md). Equation (3) is the sign of the original matrix entry. It does not replace the surrounding state or mark by a positive functional. ## 2. A fully normalized leading Green action Take actual integer sequences with t/N->tau, u/N->nu, v/N->omega, 0<nu<tau/2<omega<tau<1. (4) Uniformity is on compact subsets of this strict real domain. The row indices remain physical integers. They are not analytically continued to complex magnetic coordinates. Use the selected prefix action proved in [the original off-spectrum prefix theorem](actual_casimir_off_spectrum_prefix_action.md): A_tau(s)=-4 exp[i pi(2s-tau)] sin(pi(tau-s))sin(pi s), w=2-z, S_(tau,b)(z)=integral_0^b Log[(w+2A_tau(s)+sqrt(w(w+4A_tau(s))))/2] ds. (5) The logarithm and square root are selected at negative real spectral infinity. Write S^#_(tau,b)(z)=conjugate(S_(tau,b)(conjugate z)), which is a holomorphic function on the conjugate prefix domain. Define beta_1=pi(1-tau+2nu), beta_2=pi(1-tau+2(tau-omega)). Both lie strictly between zero and pi. Let U be the component containing the real interval z<-2 of {Re[exp(-i beta_1/2)(2-z)]>0} intersect {Re[exp(+i beta_2/2)(2-z)]>0} minus [-2,2]. (6) In particular U contains a complex neighborhood of every compact real interval below -2. Every compact subset of U is in the two finite prefix domains for all sufficiently large N. Their actual determinants are nonzero there, as is D_t. Use (2) to mark the logarithm of minus the Green entry: retain its literal phase theta(v-u)(u+v-t), the positive logarithms of a_r, the two selected prefix logarithms, and the denominator product logarithms continued from their positive values at z<-2. Then N^-1 Log[-(zI-J_t)^-1_(u,v)] -> G_(tau,nu,omega)(z), G_(tau,nu,omega)(z) =i pi(omega-nu)(nu+omega-tau) +integral_nu^omega log[4sin(pi(tau-s))sin(pi s)] ds +S_(tau,nu)(z)+S^#_(tau,tau-omega)(z) -integral_0^tau Log[2cos(2pi s)-z] ds. (7) Convergence is locally uniform on U, with every fixed z derivative. The proof uses the actual identity (2): each prefix limit is (5), the middle positive product has a smooth Riemann-sum limit on the strict interval in (4), and the EXACT denominator product has the last integral in (7). All its roots remain in [-2,2], so on a compact of U that Riemann sum and its spectral derivatives converge uniformly. No unknown function of z can be added to (7). The normalized logarithm is an accumulated source phase, not the principal argument of the scalar Green entry. On the anti-diagonal omega=tau-nu, (7) is real for z<-2, in agreement with the exact negative sign (3). ## 3. The genuine generic-q Green normals have relative polynomial bounds Keep a fixed compact of the parameter and spectral domain (4),(6), and now use the original generic matrix J_t(q exp(h)), including its distinct upper and lower entries. Write R_uv(h,z) for its Green entry. For all sufficiently large N there are constants c,C>0, independent of N and the physical integer labels in this compact, such that |R_uv(h,z)/R_uv(0,z)|<=C, |R_uv(0,z)/R_uv(h,z)|<=C, |h|<=c N^-2. (8) In particular the generic entry is nonzero on this disk and |partial_h^r R_uv(0,z)| <=C_r N^(2r)|R_uv(0,z)| (9) for every fixed r. The inverse Green entry has the corresponding relative bound. These are upper bounds; no nonzero asymptotic amplitude for a particular normal is inferred. Here is a proof retaining the source factors. Each original generic entry in the physical tridiagonal block has h derivative O(N) for |h|<=c/N^2. Its finitely many exponent factors have size O(N), and their moduli are bounded on that disk. Fixed bandwidth therefore gives an operator-norm perturbation O(N|h|) in either prefix. At the root, the two prefix inverses on the chosen compact are uniformly bounded by the proved strict-half-prefix theorem and its conjugate. Thus their relative determinant factors are det(I+E), with ||E||<=C N|h|. For N large this is less than 1/2, and the trace logarithm gives |Log det(I+E)|<=C N^2 |h|. This bounds BOTH determinant ratios. The trailing generic prefix is perturbed as its own actual matrix; the root reflection is used only to establish its initial inverse bound, never differentiated. All intervening upper entries in the Green product are uniformly bounded away from zero at the root: the strict support has u/N>0 and v/N<tau, and both sine factors in (1) have fixed margins on that interval. Their individual logarithmic variations are O(N|h|), so their product and its inverse have the same exp[O(N^2|h|)] relative control. Finally the EXACT generic denominator is product_(m=0)^t[lambda_m(q exp(h))-z]. The spectral compact has positive distance from [-2,2]; each moving node varies by O(N|h|), so this denominator and its inverse satisfy the same relative bound. Combining these facts in the original generic Green formula proves (8). Cauchy's inequality on that very disk proves (9), retaining all numerator and spectral-node derivatives. ## 4. The original scalar integrand and its remaining contour problem Let a/N->alpha in (0,1/2]. The actual Casimir polynomial has the selected logarithmic limit Psi_alpha(z) from [the source root-location theorem](actual_matching_edge_racah_root_location.md). At the root the original face factor is D_a(q)=1. Thus, on the common domain just specified, the ACTUAL spectral integrand in the completed-operator formula has leading action Psi_alpha(z)+G_(tau,nu,omega)(z). (10) In particular its spectral stationarity equation is explicitly Psi_alpha'(z)+G_(tau,nu,omega)'(z)=0, G'(z)=-integral_0^nu [w(w+4A_tau(s))]^-1/2 ds -integral_0^(tau-omega) [w(w+4conjugate(A_tau(s)))]^-1/2 ds +integral_0^tau [2cos(2pi s)-z]^-1 ds. (11) The roots in (11) are those of (5) and its conjugate continuation, not newly chosen square roots. The denominator term is essential; it is fixed by the original finite characteristic polynomial. Equation (10) is an action for the real-physical-row INTEGRAND, not an asymptotic for the contour integral or for its surrounding coherent contraction. A deformation of the original fixed contour still has to retain every actual spectral pole and normal. Targets in (-2,2), midpoint prefixes, complex physical rows and relative amplitude expansions are outside the theorem here. The normal bound (9) does not assert that an individual normal has that action. Neither (3) nor (7) implies dominance of the real off-spectrum ray. There is also an explicit endpoint issue for a closed contour. A fixed contour enclosing the spectral interval can cross the scalar's limiting cut [2,infinity). A contour staying in that scalar slit may instead need an N-dependent closing segment approaching 2, between the largest Casimir node and the smallest scalar zero. Fixed-compact limits (7),(10), or the fixed-compact normal bound (9), do not control such a segment. Audit: [actual Green phases, strict anti-diagonal signs and selected logarithms](../experiments/audit_actual_matching_edge_cross_central_green_action.py). The theorem bounds the stated integrand and normals. It does not select a contour or prove a geometric contribution to the full source.

title: The deficient packet retains the diagram regulator and its source character
status: Absolute source regulator with marked turn character
text: # The deficient packet retains the diagram regulator and its source character 30 October 2026. The absolute reflected anchor of the deficient packet introduces no new Bloch–Wigner regulator constant. The fully normalized original circle coefficient has an exact degree-reflection identity. Its endpoint Bloch symbol is invariant under the corresponding rational involution, with absolute normalization fixed on the real chart. The physical turn nevertheless contributes an explicit integer-linear character. It is one on the original lattice, and cannot be discarded in a continued stationary action. Consequently the existing endpoint-volume theorem applies to the source-marked full critical action after this character is retained. This does not assign the hyperbolic volume to a bare polynomial-kernel value, or prove that the original degree cycle contributes there. ## 1. An exact reflection of the normalized circle coefficient Put d=N-1, q=exp(pi i/N), 0<=a<=floor(d/2), beta_a=s_(2a)/s_a^2, and let k_a be the original fold multiplicity. Use the actual monic determinant R_a(z;c) and define V_a(h)=product_(j=a+1)^(d-a) 2sin(pi(h+j)/N), c_t=-cos(pi(t+1)/N), h=d-t. After the removable ordinary-column denominators are canceled, the original circle-channel coefficient has the entire continuation C_a(t;r,s)=k_a beta_a^2 V_a(h) q^[d(r+s-t)] *R_a(q^(t-2r);c_t) R_a(q^(t-2s);c_t). (1) Here t,r,s may be complex, while N,a remain integers. To verify the normalization, start with the actual complete-circle coefficient k_a N P_a(h) x^-t nu_a^-1 fhat_a(t,r) fhat_a(t,s), x=q^d, nu_a=(-1)^a q^[a(a+1)], P_a(h)=N^-1 product_(j=1)^(d-a)2sin(pi(h+j)/N) *product_(j=1)^a2sin(pi(h+j)/N). The exact ordinary normalization is fhat_a(t,r)=beta_a q^[dr+(a^2-da)/2] R_a(q^(t-2r);c_t)/S_a(t), S_a(t)=product_(j=0)^(a-1)2sin(pi(t-j)/N). Thus N P_a/S_a^2=V_a, and the remaining channel unit is (-1)^a q^[-a(d+1)]=1. This proves (1), first away from the apparent poles and then by its removable continuation. The retained half twist multiplies both sides by the same original kappa^epsilon nu_a^epsilon, and does not change any comparison below. Set t_H=N-t-2, r_H=r+N-t-1, s_H=s+N-t-1. Then, EXACTLY as entire finite functions, C_a(t;r,s)=C_a(t_H;r_H,s_H). (2) Indeed c_(t_H)=-c_t and q^(t_H-2r_H)=-q^(t-2r). The monic recurrence gives R_a(-z;-c)=(-1)^a R_a(z;c). Reindexing j by N-j in the residual product gives V_a(d-t_H)=(-1)^(d-2a)V_a(d-t), while the monomial in (1) changes by q^(dN)=(-1)^d. These signs cancel. This proves (2) with scalar ONE, not an unspecified function of the degree or channel. The [joint deficient packet](actual_q_hahn_joint_deficient_degree_packet.md) uses precisely this reflection for its two absolute anchors. At the negative-real determinant anchor the reflected columns lie in the already selected ordinary packet. The offset -2 and all factors above are retained. Formula (2) then continues the same normalized coefficient to the large complex arguments of the geometric frame. No independent normalization is chosen there. ## 2. The reflected endpoint symbol has exactly the same regulator Work at the complete channel endpoint xi=1/2. Use the symbol from the [endpoint regulator theorem](actual_augmented_plat_endpoint_regulator.md): B(T,U,Z)=-[U]-[T/U]+2[Z]+2[-1/Z]+[U/Z]+[-TZ/U]. (3) The rational endpoint-root chart is U=T(a-1)^2/(Ta^2+1), Z=(a-1)/(a+1). The degree reflection sends T to T_H=1/T and U to U_H=U/T. Its SAME magnetic multiplier determines a_H=(2Ta-T+1)/((T-1)a+2), Z_H=(T+1)(a-1)/(3Ta-T-a+3). (4) These identities follow by substitution in the original inverse momentum formula. Direct substitution also gives U_H=T_H(a_H-1)^2/(T_H a_H^2+1). The map (T,a)->(1/T,a_H) is a rational involution. This is the degree reflection of (2), not a replacement for the separate physical high-degree adapter. There is an exact rational exterior-square identity delta B(T_H,U_H,Z_H)=delta B(T,U,Z), delta[z]=z wedge (1-z). (5) Here is a short factor certificate. Put A=2Ta-T+1, B0=(T-1)a+2, F=Ta^2+1. Expanding (3) gives delta B = T wedge (T+1)+A wedge T-A wedge F +2A wedge (a-1)+B0 wedge F-2B0 wedge (a-1) +F wedge a+2a wedge (a-1). Under (4) the corresponding factors become T_H=1/T, a_H=A/B0, a_H-1=(T+1)(a-1)/B0, A_H=(T+1)^2 a/(T B0), B0_H=(T+1)^2/(T B0), F_H=(T+1)^2 F/(T B0^2). Bilinearity and antisymmetry now give (5), retaining every positive rational constant; only the torsion sign is removed in the rational exterior square. The focused audit expands the two symbols separately. The regular complex chart is connected, and contains generic real points. All maps in (3),(4) have real coefficients. Therefore the differential formula for the Bloch–Wigner dilogarithm makes the regulator difference constant, and the generic real point makes it zero: D B(T_H,U_H,Z_H)=D B(T,U,Z). (6) This is an ABSOLUTE regulator comparison; equality of magnetic momenta alone would not prove it. The sine normalization has not disappeared from this argument. A single normalized column has symbol B(T,U,Z)+[T]-[-T]. The exact reflection factor S_a(t_H)/S_a(t), at xi=1/2, contributes -[T_H]+[-T_H]+[T]-[-T]. It therefore converts the reflected column normalization to the original one. The complete inverse measure has symbol -2[T]+2[-T], canceling the two column additions. Its remaining symbol is exactly the sum of the two terms (3). Thus (6) accounts for both columns AND the original measure, including the residual sine product in (1). There is no uncomputed additive regulator constant from the absolute reflected anchors. ## 3. The exact physical turn supplies a Poisson character Let u<=v be the target rows, h=v-u, l=t_target-v, and put t=d-h, r=t-u=d-v, s=l. The literal inverse turn and nested physical cups give the original W_a pi_a entry from the polynomial entry with multiplier beta_a^-1 q^[(d+2)u+d l+2N h]. (7) This is the actual cup convention pV(j)=N q^(-d^2+dj) and turn s(j)=(-1)^d q^(d-2j). Substituting the entire polynomial kernel and h0_a=k_a N beta_a gives the EXACT continued identity h0_a (W_a pi_a)_continued(t;r,s) =exp(-2pi i r) C_a(t;r,s). (8) Equivalently the character is exp(2pi i v), since r=d-v. It is one on every physical integer entry. Off the grid it is a genuine exponential, and adds -2pi i r/N to the action normalized by N (where r itself is the unscaled index). For the other physical degree chamber use the already proved exact high-block index translation. The displayed r is then its normalized low coordinate; its complete integer affine expression in the physical indices must be pulled back along with the character. The high adapter adds no independent coefficient scalar. The compiler also records the choice of the degree logarithm: x^-t=q^(-dt), whereas the equal INTEGER expression (-1)^t q^t with the positive product logarithm differs off the grid by exp(-2pi i t). In scaled coordinates tau=t/N, using the marked inverse logarithm of nu_a, the literal coefficient action is Theta_epsilon-2pi i tau; (8) supplies the additional -2pi i r/N. Changing the logarithm of a fixed integer channel unit adds its explicit imaginary constant; the channel is real and held at the endpoint, so such a constant contributes no regulator. Neither degree nor magnetic characters may be silently removed. These are exact reindexings of EXISTING source sectors. In the [shared Fourier compiler](actual_matching_graph_shared_cycle_fourier_compiler.md), the actual wire has r=epsilon x_c+B_c with B_c an integer affine function of the retained matching labels. Since X_c=Q^x_c, the factor in (8) is X_c^(-N epsilon) exp(-2pi i B_c). At each original matching state the latter factor is one, and [X_c^b]_N X_c^(-N epsilon)L_c=[X_c^b]_N L_c. Thus the integer winding is reindexed and the marked charge b=1 is UNCHANGED. The same fact on the original product-cotangent cycle is equality of all lattice residues. On a continued degree cycle the affine B_c character must also remain. This is not a guessed correction fitted to the hyperbolic volume. The subsequently proved [specified generic boundary lift](actual_matching_edge_generic_deficient_operator_lift.md) has root value exp(-2pi i v) K_ent. Its own character therefore cancels exp(2pi i v) from the actual physical turn, restoring C_a exactly. Thus (8) describes the bare canceled-root continuation; it is not an additional uncanceled magnetic character of the restored specified generic lift. The two off-grid continuations remain distinct, and the original degree logarithm and global source marks remain retained. This consequence uses the proved generic lift, not variation of q in the canceled root formula. ## 4. Exactly when the existing volume theorem applies Equations (2),(6) show that the actual deficient packet carries the same endpoint regulator as the original crossing-circle diagram, for either physical adapter and every retained half twist. The exact typed turn changes only the explicitly recorded monomial characters, not its Bloch symbol. Summing these symbols at the complete geometric representation therefore gives the ACTUAL augmented-link volume by the degree-one diagram theorem. To identify this regulator with a numerical critical action one must still use the full marked stationary equations. With all the characters above retained, the existing identity is Im G-sum D(B)=rho dot Im(gradient G), G=2pi i phi. It applies to the reflected expression too: its normalized dilogarithms, sine primitives, and exact monomials have the same real-quadratic/imaginary-linear form, with real constant in G. At FULL correctly marked stationarity the right side vanishes; the held endpoint channel has zero real logarithm. Hence 2pi Re phi=Vol(actual augmented link). This is the volume of the source-marked critical candidate, not the rate of the bare p_a(J) entry or of an absolute envelope. The required winding reindexing fixes action bookkeeping; it does not prove a nonzero coefficient of that critical point in the original degree period. Generic operator boundary lifts, global cycle transport and competing-source estimates remain separate. Focused verification: [exact symbol and source normalization audit](../experiments/audit_actual_matching_edge_deficient_packet_regulator.py) and [saved results](../experiments/actual_matching_edge_deficient_packet_regulator_results.json). It checks the rational involution and full wedge difference, original Newton numerators in both parity families, literal nested cups and turn, the unchanged cyclic mark, and the absolute regulator calibration. The reflected root anchors do not imply a generic moving-q lift. The regulator identity does not establish a contributing global degree cycle. The conclusion requires full marked stationarity and includes neither a cycle coefficient nor an unproved generic lift. Scoped update: the final paragraph of section 3 records the exact character cancellation of the generic-lift theorem. It changes no residue-cycle or global-contribution claim above.

title: The actual degree cycle across the finite-head wall
status: Source-null ordered periods and exact boundary normal residues
text: # The actual degree cycle across the finite-head wall 30 October 2026. The specified generic exceptional lift can be used on a larger original physical-grid residue cycle by adding explicitly proved source-null local tori. This is a statement about PERIODS, not multivariable removability of its poles. Moving that enlarged cycle still meets genuine channel-row divisors. Their pole coefficients, their cotangent finite parts, and their first source-normal densities are calculated below with the actual lattice step and original complement retained. The theorem does not deform the whole cycle to the geometric saddle or prove a nonzero global coefficient. It supplies the exact boundary currents that such a deformation must retain. ## 1. The original meromorphic source at a chosen matching cut Use the [specified generic lift](actual_matching_edge_generic_deficient_operator_lift.md), with N>=3, d=N-1, L=2a, m=d-a, s=d-2a, and zeta=q0 exp(epsilon), q0=exp(pi i/N), P=pi i/Log zeta, lambda=2 Log zeta. In the upper ordered physical sector u<=v<=t_target<=d put h=v-u, ell=t_target-v, sigma=d-h, r=a-h. The actual generic continued coefficient, including its actual outside contraction when desired, has the form F(epsilon,h,z)=p_L(epsilon,a-h) E(epsilon,h,z), (1) where p_L(epsilon,r)=exp(pi i r) zeta^[r(L-r-1)] Fhat_P(r) Fhat_P(L-r)/F_L(zeta). Here E is NOT an assigned amplitude. It is exactly the two specified large white numerators H_m, their original scalar and high adapter, the actual physical inverse cups, the face factor if present, and the unchanged complement and source mark. All are the factors in the cited lift. Statements at a single channel divisor below are on charts where these other factors are jointly holomorphic in the index variables AND epsilon on a common germ. Additional source divisors must be kept as additional residues, not discarded by (1). The original scalar source has the product-cotangent realization in [the exact factorial interpolation](exact_factorial_interpolation_and_complex_contours.md), section 5, now with the moving-period factorial. Use the ACTUAL free integral lattice coordinates x after its closure constraints. Its initial cycle is the sum of small ordered product tori around the allowed lattice states. The original finite sum, all outside phases, and exposed mark are retained. No degree is assumed independent merely because it has been named h. For n_free lattice variables every period below uses the normalization (2pi i)^(-n_free); each original product cotangent residue therefore equals its literal summand. The opposite ordered sector is left unchanged unless its own literal adapter is applied. Enlarging only the sector above already preserves the complete source when it is added to that unchanged remainder. ## 2. Forbidden physical grid tori are source-null at generic q Consider a physical grid point with h>a, all four ports legal, and all other source factors regular. Then 0<=sigma=d-h<m. The two large numerators in (1) have magnetic rows i_1=sigma-u=d-v, i_2=ell, 0<=i_1,i_2<=sigma. Both H_m(Q^i,Q^(sigma-i)) vanish IDENTICALLY for generic zeta. Indeed each kth Newton summand contains the factors product_(j<k)(Q^i-Q^j) *product_(j<m-k)(Q^(sigma-i)-Q^j). Either k>i or m-k>sigma-i, because m>sigma. This proves the zero before root specialization. All remaining denominator factors are regular in the specified generic germ. Let y=x-x0 be the primitive free lattice coordinates near this grid point. If h is nonconstant on that lattice chart, its channel pole has equation l(y)=h-h0, a nonzero integral linear form. Each numerator is in the maximal ideal (y), so their product is in (y)^2. The channel cup has at most a simple pole on l=0 in this range. Hence the local source has the form F=A(epsilon,y)/l(y)+B(epsilon,y), A in (y)^2, B in (y)^2. (2) Multiplication by a holomorphic original complement preserves this property. It holds identically in epsilon, including every genuine normal coefficient. Choose an index with nonzero coefficient of l, and order the local torus radii so its term dominates the sum of the others. The torus then avoids l=0. Expand 1/l by the corresponding convergent geometric series. Every resulting Laurent monomial in F has TOTAL degree at least one. Each factor pi cot(pi y_j) is y_j^-1 times a power series whose nonconstant terms have positive even degree. Thus the coefficient of product_j y_j^-1 is zero. The original local period is exactly (2pi i)^(-n_free) integral_(that ordered torus) F product_j pi cot(pi x_j) dx_j=0. (3) This proof does not assert that F is holomorphic at the crossing of the divisors. It computes the actual ordered residue. It applies to every epsilon in the generic germ, so all required q normals of (3) vanish as well. Consequently one may add all such forbidden physical-grid tori to the original supported cycle: their periods are zero term by term. The resulting finite sum of periods still equals the WHOLE original source, after the unchanged other sector and every original matching state are included. This supplies a generic counterpart of the root entire kernel's enlarged grid, without falsely identifying their off-grid functions. If h is constant on a free-lattice chamber and equals a forbidden value, the original contribution is identically zero. Its meromorphic lift may not be restricted to that polar chamber by substituting 0/0. Such a chamber is retained as zero; (2),(3) do not manufacture an independent degree direction or a deformation out of it. ## 3. Exact pole and finite-part coefficients of the original cup Write h0=a+k, 1<=k<=m, so r=-k. The moving-period recurrence gives R_k:=Res_(r=-k) Fhat_P(r) =-1/[lambda product_(j=1)^(k-1)(1-zeta^(-2j))]. (4) To compute its finite part, let g0=partial_z Log Fhat_P(0). Then Fhat_P(-k+z)=R_k/z+R_k c_k+O(z), c_k=g0-lambda/2 +lambda sum_(j=1)^(k-1)zeta^(-2j)/(1-zeta^(-2j)). (5) Equations (4),(5) follow by writing Fhat_P(z)/product_(j=0)^(k-1)(1-zeta^(2(z-j))) and expanding its single zero factor. No reflection with moving endpoint P-1 is substituted for the fixed original L. Put M_k=exp(-pi i k) zeta^[-k(L+k-1)], B_k=Fhat_P(L+k), B'_k=partial_z Fhat_P(L+k). The CUP coefficients in the r coordinate are A_k=R_k M_k B_k/F_L, Bcup_k=R_k M_k/F_L *{[c_k+pi i+(Log zeta)(L+2k-1)]B_k-B'_k}. (6) Thus p_L(r)=A_k/(r+k)+Bcup_k+O(r+k). Formula (6) keeps B_k and B'_k separately; it does not divide by the complementary factorial when that factorial has a root zero. In h coordinates the FULL actual lift (1) has F=A_h/(h-h0)+B_h+O(h-h0), A_h=-A_k E(h0), B_h=Bcup_k E(h0)-A_k partial_h E(h0). (7) These are explicit original-source densities, including derivatives of the actual complement. Replacing E by one, or by a selected local eigenvalue, changes the boundary term. ## 4. Primitive lattice step and the exact contour correction Fix the other primitive coordinates and write a varying degree as h=A0 x+B0, with A0 a nonzero integer. The original one-form is pi cot(pi x) dx =(pi/A0) cot(pi(h-B0)/A0) dh. (8) If x0=(h0-B0)/A0 is an integer, its Laurent residue in h is ONE and its constant term is zero. The crossed residue of the original weighted lift is therefore B_h, not A_h. If x0 is not an integer, the cotangent is regular and the crossed residue is (pi/A0) cot(pi x0) A_h. (9) More generally a retained analytic weight with expansion w=c_(-1)/(h-h0)+c0+... gives c_(-1)B_h+c0 A_h. This records the Jacobian, possible nonprimitive step, and the coalescence of the lattice and channel poles. For two oriented contours bounding a finite annular chain on this chart, Cauchy's theorem gives the EXACT difference of their source periods as the sum of (7)--(9), with the actual crossing orientations, plus the residues of EVERY other crossed source divisor. On a family of charts the same identity is integrated against all retained remaining source cycles. Coincident additional divisors require their actual iterated or multivariate residues; they are not covered by a single-wall formula. The local ordered tori in section 2 specify the initial lattice intersections, rather than silently changing their residue convention. This is a concrete correction to a proposed degree transport. It does not assert that any chosen geometric contour is homologous to the original one, or that a noncompact cap has negligible integral. ## 5. The late-wall first normal is the actual root density For k>=s+1, n=L+k lies in [N,2N-1]. The complementary finite factorial has exactly one root zero. From the original integer product, partial_epsilon F_n|0=-2N^2 F_(n-N)(q0). The root functional equation with a full N-step gives partial_z Fhat_N(n)=-2pi i F_(n-N)(q0). Consequently (6) yields A_k(0)=0, partial_epsilon A_k|0=P'(0) Bcup_k(0), P'(0)=-N^2/(pi i). (10) On these walls the root cup is regular. If the actual other factors in (1) are holomorphic, (10) proves the full source identity Res_(r=-k) partial_epsilon F|0=P'(0) F(0,-k), Res_(h=a+k) partial_epsilon F|0=-P'(0) F(0,a+k). (11) This includes the actual outside coefficient, rather than only the scalar cup. It is a POLE coefficient. At a resonant cotangent wall the complete boundary period still uses the finite part in (7),(8). For the early walls 1<=k<=s, sigma=m-k belongs to [a,m-1]. Each actual large numerator has the root factor P_s(T)=product_(j=a)^(m-1)(T-Q^j), with T=Q^sigma. At this fixed channel wall each is O(epsilon). Their product is O(epsilon^2), whereas the cup pole coefficient is a root unit. Thus the full lift has ZERO first-normal pole residue there. This does not say its cotangent finite part vanishes at an arbitrary off-grid point. At original physical grid points the stronger generic source-null theorem (3) applies. Finally the original exposed trace normal is nu_N=2N(-1)^N/(q0-q0^-1). Hence P'(0)/nu_N=(-1)^(N+1) N sin(pi/N)/pi. (12) Its modulus is bounded away from zero and tends to one, at both parities. Thus an isolated late-wall source-normal residue has an explicit order-one coefficient times its actual root density (and the opposite sign in h). This coefficient is not the global geometric intersection number, the complete cotangent finite part, or a proof that the surrounding coherent contraction is nonzero. Focused verification: [actual numerator and boundary audit](../experiments/audit_actual_matching_edge_degree_cycle_boundary.py) and [saved results](../experiments/actual_matching_edge_degree_cycle_boundary_results.json). The audit checks the literal large-numerator generic zeros, both wall ranges, primitive cotangent weights, ordered diagonal-wall residues, the original moving-period cup Laurent coefficients, and the actual exposed-normal normalization. Numerical checks of local densities do not substitute for the ordered-cycle proof in section 2. Additional divisors, constant-degree chambers, noncompact caps, and the global geometric intersection remain outside the conclusion. The residue argument does not establish removability of omitted divisors or identify a globally contributing cycle.

title: An entire finite source for the completed exceptional operator
status: Entire root kernel with exact lattice zeros
text: # An entire finite source for the completed exceptional operator 30 October 2026. The source-matching operator kernel has a complete cancellation of its apparent ordinary-column poles. Its exact finite continuation is a product of TWO original q-Hahn determinant polynomials and a residual sine product. Every monomial phase cancels. It matches the actual completed matrix on the entire physical grid, including the entries outside its bandwidth, which are identically zero. This is a root-value source identity. It supplies the exact function in the needed second chart, but does not yet supply its asymptotic there or a continuation of genuine generic-q normals. In particular the zeros on the forbidden physical grid must remain in any such analysis. ## 1. Exact finite normalization and cancellation Put N>=3, d=N-1, q=exp(pi i/N), theta=pi/N and 0<=a<=floor(d/2). Let J_t be the original low physical Casimir block in total degree t, and let p_a be its original exceptional polynomial. The [source-exact kernel](actual_matching_edge_antidiagonal_operator_packet.md) uses output row u<=v=input row, h=v-u and l=t-v. Write sigma=d-h, c=-cos((sigma+1)theta)=cos(h theta), z_1=q^(-sigma+2u), z_2=q^(sigma-2l), beta_a=s_(2a)/s_a^2, s_n=product_(r=1)^n 2sin(r theta). The variables h,u,l may now be arbitrary complex numbers; the channel a and level N remain integers. The polynomial R_a(z;c) is the SAME monic original determinant as in [the joint source theorem](actual_q_hahn_joint_accretive_determinant.md): R_0=1, R_1=z+c/cos(theta), R_(n+1)=[z+c/(cos(n theta)cos((n+1)theta))]R_n +B_n[cos^2(n theta)-c^2]R_(n-1), B_n=sin^2(n theta)/[cos^2(n theta) sin((2n-1)theta)sin((2n+1)theta)]. (1) All denominators used in (1), through degree a, are nonzero. Define K_ent(h,u,l)=beta_a^2/N *product_(r=a+1)^(d-a) 2sin((h+r)theta) *R_a(z_1;c) R_a(z_2;c). (2) An empty product is one. Formula (2) is an ENTIRE finite function of h,u,l: it is a finite Laurent polynomial in their elementary exponentials. It is not a quotient requiring a prescription at an ordinary-channel pole. Here is the full phase check. Set S_a(h)=product_(r=1)^a 2sin((h+r)theta). The actual normalized ordinary continuation from the joint source theorem is fhat_a(sigma,u)=beta_a q^[d u+(a^2-da)/2] R_a(q^(sigma-2u);c)/S_a(h). (3) This follows from that theorem's formula (5), using sin((sigma-r)theta)=sin((h+r+1)theta). The holomorphic conjugate on this chart is therefore fhat_a^#(sigma,u)=beta_a q^[-d u-(a^2-da)/2] R_a(q^(-sigma+2u);c)/S_a(h), (4) because the coefficients of R_a(z;c) are real polynomials in c and c itself is real under holomorphic conjugation. This is NOT pointwise conjugation at complex h,u. The prior exact kernel is q^[-d(l-u)] P_(N,a)(h) fhat_a^#(sigma,u) fhat_a(sigma,l), P_(N,a)(h)=N^-1 product_(r=1)^(d-a) 2sin((h+r)theta) *product_(r=1)^a 2sin((h+r)theta). The three q monomials in (3),(4) and the preceding line cancel EXACTLY, including the constants (a^2-da)/2. Moreover P_(N,a)(h)/S_a(h)^2 =N^-1 product_(r=a+1)^(d-a) 2sin((h+r)theta), (5) since a<=d-a. This proves (2) as an identity of finite meromorphic functions, hence provides its removable continuation everywhere. No branch of a logarithm, square root or noninteger channel enters the cancellation. ## 2. It matches the ENTIRE original physical grid For every original 0<=u<=v<=t<=d, let h=v-u and l=t-v. Then [p_a(J_t)]_(u,v)=K_ent(h,u,l). (6) For h<=a, this is the already proved original kernel identity and the exact cancellation above. For h>a the original left side is zero at GENERIC q, since a degree-a polynomial of a tridiagonal matrix has bandwidth a. We now prove that the right side is zero at these actual grid points too, without assuming that (3) is a physical column when sigma<a. There are two different forbidden ranges. If a<h<=d-a, the residual product in (2) contains r=N-h=sigma+1. Indeed a+1<=r<=d-a, and its sine is sin(pi)=0. Thus (2) vanishes irrespective of the two determinant values. If d-a<h<=d, then 0<=sigma=d-h<a. In this case the actual physical rows satisfy 0<=u,l<=sigma. The original finite Newton numerator of the ordinary column vanishes at EVERY node U=Q^r, 0<=r<=sigma, where Q=q^2. To see this directly, its kth summand contains product_(j<k)(U-Q^j) *product_(j<a-k)(Q^sigma/U-Q^j). Either k>r or a-k>sigma-r, because a>sigma. The corresponding product is zero. The other coefficients are regular: 2a<N and the root leading coefficient [2a choose a]_Q is nonzero. The exact original numerator-to-determinant relation therefore gives R_a(q^(sigma-2r);-cos((sigma+1)theta))=0, 0<=r<=sigma<a. (7) For z_1 use r=sigma-u, and for z_2 use r=l. Thus BOTH determinants in (2) vanish. This proves (6) also in the second forbidden range. It does not mistakenly apply the second argument to the first range, where sigma can still be at least a. Shift the real part of its global flag w0 by a small real e; the actual white reflection then changes z-w to -1-e+i d0. At e=0, partial_e Log A2=-2/(1+d0^2), partial_e Sigma=i/[pi(1+d0^2)] !=0. title: The two geometric defects lie across the complete-channel support wall
text: # The two geometric defects lie across the complete-channel support wall 30 October 2026. For the prescribed-pair frame on any actual certified right-angled matching cut, the two failed ordinary factors at one matching edge have a precise common chart. Their normalized total degree has real part BELOW 1/2; their magnetic rows are strictly inside that degree. After the actual inverse turn, the target rows are physical and cross-central, but their separation has real part ABOVE 1/2. This identifies exactly which inequality in the controlled exceptional-kernel tube fails. The statement is geometric and algebraic. It neither continues an actual finite kernel across that wall nor supplies an asymptotic there. ## 1. A strict failed triangle has a deficient normalized degree Let (a0,a1,a2) be an original prefix triple in a generic regular frame. Assume zero is strictly inside its real convex hull, and Im(a0 conjugate(a2))!=0. Multiplying all entries by one nonzero scalar, put a0=1 and arg a2=theta in (-pi,pi), theta!=0. The strict positive relation among the three diagonals implies a1=-b0-b2 a2, b0,b2>0. Conversely such a relation makes zero an interior point of the triangle. Thus the argument beta of a1 lies strictly between pi and pi+theta, with these arguments lifted to the same interval of length less than pi. The actual wire exponentials and their canonical logarithms are X1=-a0/a1, X2=-a1/a2, xj=Log_(0,2pi)(Xj)/(2pi i), 0<Re xj<1. If theta<0, the two wire arguments are pi-beta and beta-theta-pi. They are positive and their sum is -theta. If theta>0, the arguments are 3pi-beta and pi+beta-theta, with sum 4pi-theta. Hence theta<0: 0<Re(x1+x2)=-theta/(2pi)<1/2, theta>0: 3/2<Re(x1+x2)=2-theta/(2pi)<2. (1) Use the original degree adapters even though the complete channel is no longer in their physical support. Define low: sigma=x1+x2, r=x1; high: sigma=2-x1-x2, r=1-x2. In both cases 0<Re sigma<1/2, 0<Re r<Re sigma. (2) No wire endpoint has been crossed. It is the complete-channel total degree bound, rather than a magnetic-row endpoint, that fails. ## 2. The two exceptional ends share this same complex degree The prescribed-pair theorem chooses the polarization line to leave the white-normal polyhedron through the interiors of the two shaded facets at one matching edge. For a generic transverse line, the induced affine map on each triangular facet is nonsingular. Its strict barycentric relation therefore gives the strict convex-hull hypothesis of section 1, not merely a boundary relation. The input and output triples at this edge have the SAME outer prefix diagonals a0,a2. They consequently have the same theta and the same adapter in (1). Their canonical wire sums have equal real parts, and their exponentials are both a0/a2. Their imaginary parts therefore agree as well. They share an EXACT complex normalized total sigma. Write their two normalized magnetic rows as r,s. Then 0<Re r,Re s<Re sigma<1/2. (3) The generic family can additionally avoid Re(r-s)=0. The relevant target-total ratio is the holomorphic ratio of the two middle prefix diagonals. It is nonconstant: otherwise the two transported first meridians would be proportional as linear trace functions on every rank-one projector, hence equal after using their common trace -2. The actual nontrivial complete collar does not fix that meridian. A nonconstant holomorphic ratio cannot take only positive-real values on the open prescribed-pair family. Its real seam is thus a proper excluded set, compatible with all the existing strict margins. ## 3. The actual target chart has exactly the opposite support defect First suppose the original adapter is low. Write O=exp(2pi i sigma), R=exp(2pi i r), S=exp(2pi i s). The original local prefix traces are (-1/R,-1/S,1/O). Undoing their actual inverse-turn relation gives target exponentials T_target=R/S, V_input=1/S, U_output=O/S. (4) Their canonical physical logarithms have total 1+r-s and rows 1-s, sigma-s. If Re r<Re s, this target is low. If Re r>Re s, apply its original high adapter: the normalized total is 1-r+s and the rows are 1-r, sigma-r. For an original high adapter, the exponentials are instead V_input=O/S,U_output=1/S; this only reverses the target input/output order in the same calculation. In a fixed component choose m,M from r,s by their smaller and larger real parts. This does not take a nonholomorphic minimum inside an action: the choice is fixed on that component. The normalized ordered target chart is delta=1-sigma, nu=sigma-M, lambda=m, tau=nu+lambda+delta=1+m-M, u=nu, v=nu+delta=1-M. (5) It follows immediately from (3) that 1/2<Re delta<1, Re nu>0, Re lambda>0, Re(nu+lambda+delta)<1, 1/2<Re tau<1, 0<Re u<Re tau/2<Re v<Re tau. (6) For the two midpoint inequalities, the positive differences are Re(tau/2-u)=[1+Re(r+s)-2Re sigma]/2>0, Re(v-tau/2)=[1-Re(r+s)]/2>0. Thus EVERY inequality of the proved exceptional-kernel tube is satisfied except its bandwidth condition Re delta<alpha<=1/2. This description is uniform in bridge width and uses the actual typed turn and degree adapters, not a freely selected target frame. ## 4. What continuation is actually required The controlled root kernel has delta=h/N, where h is the row separation, and requires 0<Re delta<a/N. At generic quantum parameter the original polynomial p_a(J_t) has bandwidth a. Consequently ALL real physical integer entries with h>a vanish identically, together with every retained generic-q jet. The geometric chamber (6) is beyond that support wall at the complete fold a/N->1/2. This does not make its complex geometric coordinates meaningless. It specifies what an analytic period or new transition kernel must justify; it cannot be supplied by a nonzero relative estimate merely extended from the present tube. In particular the normalized ordinary factors used inside that tube are outside their established complete-degree range after (2). Their apparent endpoint factors, zeros or poles must be retained in any proposed continuation rather than canceled after specialization. A block estimate or contraction tree that factors EVERY grouped patch back into ordinary packets on their old physical domains cannot remove this obstruction under the common K-frame hypothesis: it would make every original factor strictly physical and selected, contrary to the white-normal theorem. A genuinely coupled packet or source-exact frame transition remains a different possibility. This is a direct structural corollary of the audited prefix, adapter, prescribed-facet and inverse-turn identities. No new finite-kernel asymptotic, nonvanishing contribution or global equality is claimed. The multi-block conclusion is conditional on a common K frame. No finite continuation through the wall is inferred.
