In its norm, a step costs at most rho(T(x))+epsilon+o(1); neighboring metric changes cost 1+o(1). Products over ANY prefix therefore obey the integral bound uniformly in the prefix endpoint. Apply the same argument to adj T in reverse order, and use the EXACT identity T^-1=adj T/det T. The polynomial endpoint norms cost o(N). Let epsilon decrease to zero. Positivity of the continuous spectral radii makes the logarithmic limit uniform. This proves (6), with the original endpoint vectors retained. It is a source-sensitive bound on a specified solution, not a claim that the entire inverse norm is controlled or that every growing channel couples to the source. ## 5. Actual two-channel barrier and the full Fourier energy For (4), write R(x)=rho(M(x)) and H(x)=integral_0^x log R(s)ds, J(x)=integral_0^x log(2sin(pi s))ds. The eigenvalues are explicit: L_±=(2-z+z^2 ± z sqrt(z^2-2z+5))/2. (7) The square root has its principal analytic branch here, since its argument has real part at least 7/2 on the unit circle. R is continuous and positive; for example |2-z+z^2|^2>=7/8 gives R>=sqrt(14)/8. For a two-by-two matrix, rho(adj M)=rho(M). The determinant product in backward propagation is exactly product_(ell=n+1)^(N-1)|det M_(N,ell)| =|F_(N-2)|/|F_(n-1)|. (8) The endpoint-uniform factorial estimate and |F_(N-2)|=O(N^2) give its logarithm as -N J(n/N)+O(log N), uniformly for n>=1. Thus (1/N)log|C_n| <=h(n/N)+o(1), h(x)=min{H(x), H(1)-H(x)+J(x)}. (9) Retain the original complete evaluation T_n(1)=|F_n|^2 in (1). The triangle bound on this exact sum, now with its n-dependent coefficient transport retained, gives limsup_N (1/N)log|K_N| <=B_2:=max_(0<=x<=1){2J(x)+h(x)}. (10) By the independently audited ordinary-color theorem, the full root-color Fourier energy E_N=|K_N|^2+poly(N) consequently satisfies limsup_N (pi/N)log E_N<=2pi max(0,B_2). (11) This use of Plancherel keeps the actual cancellations of ordinary rows; bounding every entry of the Newton evaluation matrix separately would lose that information and give a larger estimate. There is a useful exact simplification of (10). R(1-x)=R(x), J(1-x)=-J(x), and d/dx[2H(x)-J(x)] =log(|L_max(x)|/|L_min(x)|)>=0. The switch in (9) is therefore at x=1/2. Since J<=0 on [0,1/2], B_2=max_(0<=u<=1/2){H(u)-3J(u)}. (12) This is a completely specified one-variable positive-norm barrier, not the desired volume inserted as a hypothesis. The audit bounds it rigorously between 0.5775 and 0.5780; its numerical value is approximately 0.57776062097. It improves the one-sided envelope, approximately 0.94608, but is above the known selected rate 0.45010961003. Hence even these two exact endpoint sources do not eliminate the remaining outer phase. ### 5.1 A certificate for the global norm barrier The location of the maximum in (12), and the quoted interval, can be verified without an unproved plot. Put v=4sin^2(pi u), so 0<=v<=4. The derivative of H-3J has the sign of log[R/v^(3/2)]. For v<1, R>=sqrt(|1-z|)=v^(1/4)>v^(3/2), so the derivative is positive. For v>1 use the quadratic Schur test on L^2-A L+B, with A=2-z+z^2 and B=1-z. Its roots lie inside radius r precisely when |B|<r^2 and |r^2 A-B conjugate(A)|<r^3-|B|^2/r. To prove this test, normalize r=1 and subtract b times the reversed conjugate polynomial from w^2+a w+b. On the unit circle the subtracted term has modulus |b| times the original. Rouche's argument reduces the root count to w[(1-|b|^2)w+a-b conjugate(a)], giving the stated inequality. Here r=v^(3/2). The first condition is exactly v>1; squaring the second and using z+z^(-1)=2-v reduces it to P(v)>0, where P(v)=v^10-2v^9+6v^8-9v^7+9v^6-6v^5 -2v^4+5v^3-4v^2+1. (12a) The identities used in this reduction are |A|^2=4-5v+2v^2 and conjugate(B)A^2+B conjugate(A)^2=v(v^3-5v^2+9v-4). The exact Euclidean Sturm sequence for P has sign variations 4 at v=1 and 3 at v=4, omitting zero terms. It also has variations 4 and 3 at 57/50 and 29/25 respectively. Thus P has exactly one root v_* in (1,4), with 57/50<v_*<29/25. Since P(1)<0 and P(4)>0, the derivative changes from positive to negative there. This proves that u_*=asin(sqrt(v_*)/2)/pi is the UNIQUE global maximizer in (12). The audit computes the exact Sturm signs and verifies the polynomial reduction before any numerical integration. On 0<=u<=u_* the larger-modulus root is L_+ in (7). Indeed equality of root moduli would force A^2/B real. Its imaginary part can vanish, away from the endpoints, only if 4c^3-6c^2+5c-1=0, c=cos(2pi u). For c>=2/5 that polynomial is positive, since its derivative is 12(c-1/2)^2+2 and its value at 2/5 is positive. Here c>=1-v_*/2>2/5, so no root-modulus crossing occurs before u_*. For the actual rigorous interval in the audit, isolate v_* to a rational width below 10^(-35), use interval arithmetic for u_*, and integrate log|L_+| by 4096 interval RANGE cells on [0,u_*]. Every cell's whole image is enclosed, so this is a rigorous integral bound without a quadrature error assumption. The log-sine primitive is evaluated by J(u)=-Im Li_2(exp(2pi i u))/(2pi), also with complex interval arithmetic. The resulting enclosure lies strictly between 0.5775 and 0.5780. ## 6. The same two-channel system retains the geometric algebra The failure of polynomial coefficient growth does not sever the source from the geometric curve. Before taking absolute values, the coefficient phase in (1) changes its consecutive ratio to -z L. Complete Newton evaluation contributes -(1-z)^2/z. Thus the joint complex stationary equation is L(1-z)^2=1. Eliminating L from this and (4) gives exactly -z^2(z^3-4z^2+7z-5)=0. (13) The nonzero cubic has discriminant -23 and is the already identified five-crossing geometric critical field. Equation (13) is an algebraic coupling calculation, not a new thimble-selection or cancellation proof. It makes precise what the wider mechanism must retain: the non-tame coefficient channel together with the evaluation phase, rather than separate positive norm maxima. [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_multichannel_newton_green.py): generic finite identities, all-index actual root coefficients, both polynomial endpoint vectors, exact determinant products, dominated initial branch, two-sided propagation diagnostics, certified barrier, and cubic elimination.

title: The native highest-weight energy has a geometric action
status: Local energy cells; global phase gap retained
text: # The native highest-weight energy has a geometric action 30 October 2026. The exponential native projector cost is already geometric in a simple physical block. Its exact normalization also shows why a general comparison cannot assign a positive volume to every normalized magnetic summand or discard the phases at a maximum. ## 1. Exact highest-weight energy, both parities Put q=exp(pi i/N), d=N-1, s_r=product_(h=1)^r 2sin(pi h/N), and choose 0<=j<=floor(d/2). In the physical degree t=j the original normalized column is a highest vector. Its exact entries are f_u=C_j(q;j,u)=q^(ju) s_j/(s_u s_(j-u)), 0<=u<=j. (1) This follows directly from the original generic highest-vector ratio: at the root its negative-index Pochhammer factors give q^(u^2) [j choose u]_(q^2), and the Gaussian binomial has phase q^[u(j-u)] and positive magnitude s_j/(s_u s_(j-u)). The generic source is specialized only after this calculation. The actual Christoffel--Darboux measure of this simple degree block is |sigma_(j,j)|=s_(2j)/s_j^2. (2) For 2j<d, cancel the last factor in the original formula s_(2j+1)/(s_j^2 |1-q^(4j+2)|). For the odd simple midpoint 2j=d, the separately retained measure N/s_j^2 is the same expression, since s_d=N. No zero denominator is evaluated in this cancellation. Therefore its native rank-one projector norm is exactly E_(j,j)=sum_(u=0)^j W_N(j,u), W_N(j,u)=s_j^4/[s_(2j)s_u^2 s_(j-u)^2]. (3) For j<d-j this is the degree-t=j block of the completed cluster projector, not the singular individual projector on larger degrees. For 2j=d it is the degree-t=j block of the isolated midpoint projector. Formula (3) does not maximize over the other physical degrees of either operator. ## 2. Its complete local variational profile Let J(x)=integral_0^x log(2sin(pi y))dy. The endpoint-controlled factorial estimate log s_r=N J(r/N)+O(log N), uniform for 0<=r<N, gives, with xi=j/N and x=u/N, N^(-1)log W_N(j,u)=e(xi,x)+O(log N/N), e(xi,x)=4J(xi)-J(2xi)-2J(x)-2J(xi-x). (4) This is uniform on 0<=x<=xi<=1/2, with continuous endpoint values. For fixed 0<xi<=1/2 the action is strictly concave in 0<x<xi: e_x=2 log[sin(pi(xi-x))/sin(pi x)], e_xx=-2pi sin(pi xi)/[sin(pi x)sin(pi(xi-x))]<0. (5) Its unique maximum is x=xi/2. The actual discrete support contains a point within 1/N of this maximum, and has at most N points. Bounding (3) between its largest summand and N times that summand therefore proves, whenever j/N tends to xi in [0,1/2], lim N^(-1)log E_(j,j)=m(xi), m(xi)=4J(xi)-J(2xi)-4J(xi/2). (6) This statement includes both level parities. Moreover m'(xi)=2 log[cos(pi xi/2)/cos(pi xi)]>0 (0<xi<1/2), m(0)=0, m(1/2)=-4J(1/4)=v8/(2pi). (7) For even N=2h and j=h-1, the actual measure in (2) is 1/sin(pi/N); for odd N=2h+1,j=h it is one. This polynomial difference does not change the common folded limit (7). Thus the native exponential obstruction is not restricted to odd levels. ## 3. Four actual ideal tetrahedra at the folded color Write Lambda(a)=-integral_0^a log|2sin b|db, so J(x)=-Lambda(pi x)/pi. At xi=1/2, (4) becomes 2pi e(1/2,x) =4[Lambda(pi x)+Lambda(pi(1/2-x))] =4 Vol T(pi x,pi(1/2-x),pi/2), 0<x<1/2. (8) The tetrahedra in (8) have positive angles summing to pi. They also glue to an explicit convex ideal octahedron O_x. In the upper half-space boundary take its six ideal vertices to be 0, infinity, 1, -1, zeta, -zeta, zeta=exp(2pi i x). (9) The four unit-circle vertices form a Euclidean rectangle. Their unit-hemisphere plane separates the other two vertices. The upper half is the ideal quadrangular pyramid with apex infinity; reflection in that hemisphere gives the lower half with apex zero. Split the base along the diameter from 1 to -1. The two upper tetrahedra have the Euclidean triangle (1,zeta,-1), or (1,-zeta,-1), as a horospherical triangle at infinity. Each has angles pi x,pi(1/2-x),pi/2, up to permutation. Reflection gives two more tetrahedra of the same volume. These four tetrahedra fill the convex hull in (9). One can check the supporting planes directly: the vertical halfspace over each rectangle edge contains the origin, because the rectangle contains its center. It therefore contains ALL six vertices. Reflecting that halfspace in the unit hemisphere fixes the four rectangle vertices and exchanges zero and infinity, so the four lower face halfspaces contain all six vertices as well. Their eight triangular faces form the octahedral boundary. Along a shared rectangle edge, the two interior dihedral angles sum to either 2pi x or pi-2pi x, both strictly less than pi. The remaining pyramid edges have angle pi/2. Thus the joined boundary is locally convex; equivalently its eight triangular face planes support all six vertices. There is no hidden negative-volume piece. It follows that 2pi e(1/2,x)=Vol(O_x). At x=1/4 its eight faces form the regular ideal octahedron and its volume is v8. Equation (5) gives this as the unique maximum in this family. This is a geometric interpretation of ONE native degree-block energy, not a claim that this octahedron is already a cell in the supplied link complement. ## 4. The compulsory face subtraction away from the fold The same interpretation is signed for other colors. The elementary duplication identity Lambda(2a)=2Lambda(a)-2Lambda(pi/2-a) converts (4), for 0<x<xi<1/2, to 2pi e(xi,x) =4 Vol T(pi x,pi(xi-x),pi(1-xi)) -4Lambda(pi(1/2-xi)). (10) The second term is forced by the original measure (2). It is positive before its subtraction, since Lambda is positive on (0,pi/2). At x=0 the tetrahedron flattens and e(xi,0)=-(2/pi)Lambda(pi(1/2-xi))<0. (11) Consequently no representation of EVERY CD-normalized magnetic summand's action as a sum of nonnegative ideal-cell volumes can be correct without additional boundary terms or cancellations. This does not prevent the completed energy from having a positive geometric maximum: (6),(7) prove that its maximum is strictly positive. It identifies a necessary normalization in any such argument. ## 5. What a shared-variable action must retain For general physical degree and channel, the exact local energy is sum_u |C_j(t,u)|^2/|sigma_(t,j)|. On strict compacts where the selected ordinary packet applies, its summand has the action 2 Re Phi_xi(tau,nu)-kappa(tau,xi), (12) where kappa is the leading logarithm of the ACTUAL measure. Here tau, nu and xi are real admissible scaled physical indices; the complex packet supplies their selected action, not a different complex-degree operator norm. In the two chambers supplied by its factorial formulas, kappa=J(tau-xi)+J(tau+xi)-2J(tau), tau+xi<1, kappa=J(tau-xi)+J(tau+xi-1)-2J(tau), tau+xi>1. (13) The odd self-paired endpoint has the corresponding limit 2J(tau-1/2)-2J(tau). Polynomial factors in the finite measures do not contribute to (13). Formula (12) describes a normalized summand; the sum over u and the sum over physical degree are still to be taken. If a positive comparison energy is constructed by sewing these actual columns, its candidate action is the SUM of (12), together with the remaining original boundary weights, restricted to the SAME magnetic wire variables and exact affine degree constraints used in that sewing. Taking separate maxima in tau or nu before sewing changes that variational problem. Neither the existence of such a useful global comparison nor its equality with the manifold's angle-volume problem is proved here. The selected geometric framing generally gives COMPLEX magnetic coordinates. The localization theorem puts them in the selected physical tube, but does not put them on the real grid defining this positive energy. An identification with a real angle polytope, or a justified deformation of the original sum, is therefore an additional step; the local complex packet alone supplies neither. There is a further exact local warning about stationarity. Equation (1) has the marked highest-weight action Phi_high(xi,x)=J(xi)-J(x)-J(xi-x)+pi i xi x. At the energy maximum x=xi/2, partial_x Phi_high=pi i xi, exp(partial_x Phi_high)=exp(pi i xi). (14) At the folded value this multiplier is i, although the real energy derivative vanishes. Real-energy stationarity constrains the modulus of a transport multiplier; it does not by itself impose its marked phase or a full complex gluing equation. In a real link network those phases may cancel through the actual shared incidence and boundary characters, but that requires a separate proof. This example does not assert that an open column ought to have trivial boundary momentum. Thus the missing global bridge is precise: construct the actual sewn energy with its signed face terms and shared variables, and prove that its stationarity, INCLUDING the retained phase and peripheral conditions, gives the degree-one geometric gluing. The local octahedral volume and the correctly normalized summands alone do not establish that bridge or a nonzero original quantum period. ## 6. The larger full folded cost is twice an ideal cube volume The separate [full magnetic-energy theorem](actual_matching_edge_magnetic_energy_profile.md) now computes the full folded operator rate as 5v3/pi, with effective volume 10v3, for the odd simple projector and the actual even completed pair. This maximizes over physical degree and is strictly larger than the highest-weight block cost in (8). Here is an explicit local polyhedron with that larger two-copy volume. In Minkowski coordinates with form (-+++), let V_epsilon=(sqrt(3),epsilon_1,epsilon_2,epsilon_3), epsilon_i in {+1,-1}. These null vectors project to the eight Klein vertices of the cube [-1/sqrt(3),1/sqrt(3)]^3. The four vertices with product epsilon_i=+1 form a regular ideal tetrahedron: every distinct pair has the same Lorentz product, and the signed coordinate symmetries permute its vertices. Its face opposite V_epsilon has normal n_epsilon=(1,-sqrt(3)epsilon_1, -sqrt(3)epsilon_2,-sqrt(3)epsilon_3), <n_epsilon,n_epsilon>=8, <V_epsilon,n_epsilon>=-4sqrt(3). Reflection in that face sends the opposite vertex to V_epsilon-2<V_epsilon,n_epsilon>n_epsilon/8 =2V_(-epsilon). (15) Thus the four adjacent corner tetrahedra are also regular ideal tetrahedra, congruent to the central one. They fill the cube without overlap. Indeed the central tetrahedron has the four Klein inequalities epsilon dot x>=-1/sqrt(3), for sign triples of product +1. Inside the cube, two such inequalities cannot fail simultaneously: adding them would violate one coordinate bound of the cube. The part failing one inequality is precisely the tetrahedron with its opposite cube corner and the three neighboring central vertices. This gives the usual central tetrahedron and four corner tetrahedra as an actual geometric partition. Each original cube edge lies in one regular tetrahedron and has dihedral angle pi/3. Along each triangulated square-face diagonal, three tetrahedral angles add to pi. This is the regular ideal six-square-faced cube, with its stated angle data. Consequently this regular ideal cube has volume 5v3, and TWO copies have volume 10v3. This is an exact geometric interpretation of the local full folded COST. It supplies no face pairing, cusp marking, degree-one chain, or volume upper inequality for the original link complement. Attaching the local cube to a source diagram remains a separate shared-incidence problem. Focused audit: [original highest vectors, CD measures and ideal shapes](../experiments/audit_actual_native_magnetic_energy_local_geometry.py). It verifies 817 original finite highest-vector entries with their phases, 167 bilinear measures, 23 even/odd folded measure formulas, and all four actual tetrahedron cross ratios. The global sewing and phase-matching problem is not a conclusion of these checks. The cube addition also checks all four Lorentz reflections (15) exactly. The theorem concerns a degree block. It does not identify cells in the actual source complement, a real-grid geometric saddle, or a global volume equality. The cube volume is a local boundary-cost interpretation. It is not identified with the right-angled matching polyhedron; the topology of those constructions remains distinct.

title: The actual graph complement from one rectified core and octahedra
text: # The actual graph complement from one rectified core and octahedra 29 October 2026. This is a general GEOMETRIC theorem for the literal ordered noncrossing (NC) cubic sources. It gives the actual complete hyperbolic volume, rather than a scalar-vertex volume surrogate. Its input is a finite positive right-angled ideal core certificate. It does not prove the growing-color quantum asymptotic. Let Gamma be a connected plane cubic graph in the original NC source class, with b black and b white vertices and E=3b edges. Keep a crossing circle on each physical edge box. Suppose Q is a convex right-angled ideal polyhedron with the following labeled medial incidence: * Its ideal vertices x_e are the edges e of Gamma. * At every vertex v of Gamma there is a triangular face T_v with the three incident edge labels. * At every face f of Gamma there is a polygon F_f following its edge boundary. Every polyhedral edge separates a T_v from an F_f. The certificate includes the labeled oriented face cycles and positive supporting-plane inequalities. In particular a matching unlabeled polyhedron or cusp count is not sufficient. Such a Q will be called the ideal rectified core; this term means the ideal medial polyhedron, not the untruncated projective polyhedron used in some literature. Then the ACTUAL retained-circle source link L_Gamma(e), with any fixed signed edge twist integers e, has a complete hyperbolic metric and Vol(S^3 minus L_Gamma(e)) = 4b v8 + 2 Vol(Q). (1) The topology and peripheral crossings in this assertion are those of the original cups, caps and edge boxes. No quantum twist has been removed. Equation (1) is the target for an eventual full-source limit, not a proof of that limit. ## 1. A finite explicit octahedron on an ideal triangle Use the Lorentz product of signature (-,+,+,+). Normalize the three future null lifts a,b,c of a triangular face so that their pairwise products are -1. This is possible uniquely by positive rescaling: the three scale products are prescribed positive numbers. Let n be its outward unit spacelike normal. The regular ideal octahedron on the OTHER side of this face has three further vertices a' = b+c+sqrt(2)n, b' = c+a+sqrt(2)n, c' = a+b+sqrt(2)n. (2) These are future null vectors. Opposite pairs (a,a'), (b,b'), (c,c') have product -2 and every other pair has product -1. Thus the six vectors are Lorentz isometric to the standard regular ideal octahedron: four independent vectors determine an isometry by their Gram matrix, and the remaining two satisfy the same linear equations. The choice of +n places its interior outside Q. The three octahedral faces adjacent to the attaching face merge with the corresponding F_f faces. Indeed their third vertices have the form a+b+sqrt(2)n. If m is the normal of F_f along the edge ab, then <m,a>=<m,b>=<m,n>=0, the last equality being the right-angle condition. Thus all three vertices lie in that same supporting plane. The remaining boundary faces are an opposite WHITE triangle (a',b',c') and three SHADED triangles S_(v,e_a)=(a,b',c'), and cyclically. (3) Their outward unit normals are respectively n_white=2n+(a+b+c)/sqrt(2), n_a=n+sqrt(2)a, and cyclically. (4) Their incident products vanish. Equations (2)--(4) prove directly that all the surviving boundary dihedral angles are right angles. Attach an octahedron along EVERY T_v. This is an abstract gluing of convex cells along full ideal faces. The union is topologically a ball: the attaching triangles have disjoint interiors, and the same statement holds after small cusp truncation. We do not need to assume that all developed octahedra in a chosen global drawing have disjoint interiors. The intrinsic cell metric and the actual face identifications below are enough to construct the complete manifold. Flat boundary seams are merged only as intrinsic coplanar faces. Each original F_f is an ideal polygon. An attached coplanar triangle lies outside one of its sides, with its third ideal vertex on the empty ideal-boundary interval between that side's endpoints. Different sides have disjoint such intervals. These attachments therefore form an embedded ideal polygon with twice as many vertices. This also justifies the merged white-face isometries used below. ## 2. The complete labeled bowtie cell Call the resulting ball P. It contains Q and exactly 2b octahedra, with disjoint interiors in its intrinsic cell decomposition. Hence Vol(P)=Vol(Q)+2b v8. (5) It has 3E ideal vertices: E original x_e and three new vertices for each of the 2b original graph vertices. Its shaded faces are the 2E triangles S_(v,e). Its white faces are the 2b opposite octahedral triangles and the b+2 expanded old face polygons, hence E+2 in total. Every boundary edge separates a white and a shaded face. The boundary has 6E edges and Euler characteristic 2. For each edge e=vw, the two shaded triangles S_(v,e),S_(w,e) meet at x_e. They are precisely the two sides of its retained crossing disk. Their other vertices correspond to the two physical strand arcs at that end of the box. At each trivalent graph vertex the three original nested cup/cap arcs connect the three incident disks in a triangle. Consequently the white-face and cusp incidence is exactly the Fisher expansion T(Gamma), as independently traced in [the actual boundary construction](actual_six_pants_boundary_torsor_and_sewing.md). This is a reversible topological cut: shrink each opposite white triangle toward the original vertex cup/cap matching; trace each expanded F_f along the original planar region; restore each pair of shaded triangles as its crossing disk. It recovers the literal NC diagram. In particular it does not use an arbitrary incidence permutation in place of the original ordered ports. Take two copies P^0,P^1 with opposite orientations. Glue each WHITE face across the copies by its labels. At e=vw an even box twist glues S_(v,e) to S_(w,e) within each copy, fixing x_e and matching the actual two strand positions. An odd twist uses the opposite copy and exchanges these two outer strand positions. These are exactly the disk maps from the original two-strand box; the same orientation rule is written explicitly for theta in [the marked-theta geometry](actual_marked_theta_link_and_angle_geometry.md). Because every shaded face is an ideal triangle, each prescribed vertex bijection is an isometry. Around every actual boundary edge the alternating white and disk maps give four right angles. At an old flat seam the two copies supply two angles pi. Internal attaching faces already have smooth neighborhoods. Thus all finite edge and face neighborhoods in the glued cell metric are hyperbolic. ## 3. Simultaneous horospheres and completeness Completeness requires more than the angle sums. At an original ideal vertex x_e the Q link is a Euclidean rectangle. Its two opposite sides belong to T_v and T_w, and have equal length on EVERY horosphere. Normalize its horosphere so that this length is 1. Do this independently at each original ideal vertex. On each triangular T_v, all three corner horocycle segments now have length 1: they are its canonical mutually tangent decoration. Equality of opposite rectangle sides shows there is no incompatibility between the two triangles at x_e. Equip each attached regular octahedron with its canonical decoration having side length 1 at every cusp square. Its three old vertex horospheres then agree with those just chosen on Q. Its new vertices use that same canonical decoration. Every S_(v,e) consequently has the canonical decoration at ALL THREE corners. Every shaded face pairing, including an outer-vertex exchange, preserves it. White pairings preserve decorations because they join identical copies. After uniformly shrinking these horospheres, they are disjoint and the complement of their ends is compact. The ideal links glue as compact nonsingular Euclidean surfaces. They are orientable, and the reversible link cut identifies them as the link's cusp tori. There is no dilation holonomy. Their ends are complete standard hyperbolic cusps. This proves completeness and finite volume of the literal link complement, with volume twice (5), establishing (1). Further full twists are crossing-disk collar homeomorphisms while the circle remains drilled. They change the preferred peripheral marking by the actual integral shear. They do not change the unmarked complete volume. The quantum twist phases and any later filling slopes must still retain that shear. ## 4. Algebraic input and an explicit nondegenerate example The input is finite real-algebraic data: future null vertex lifts, spacelike outward face normals, incidence equalities, strict supporting inequalities, the labeled convex face cycles, and vanishing Lorentz products at adjacent faces. A finite convex-hull/incidence check certifies the stated Q. Formulae (2)--(4) use only arithmetic and positive square roots. No limiting geometric realization or a choice of formal peripheral series is needed for this complete anchor. For the cube graph, the core is explicitly the convex hull in the Klein ball of (±1,±1,0)/sqrt(2) and their coordinate permutations. (6) Its six square planes are ±X_i=1/sqrt(2). Its eight triangular planes are ±X_1±X_2±X_3=sqrt(2). The corresponding Lorentz normals have norms squared 1/2 and 1, respectively; each incident square/triangle pair has product zero. Every vertex is ideal, and the strict nonincident supporting inequalities check directly. Thus it is a positive ideal right-angled cuboctahedron with the required cube labels. Here b=4 and Vol(actual augmented cube link)=16v8+2Vol(Q_cube). (7) The [exact audit](../experiments/audit_actual_nc_graph_rectified_core_geometry.py) checks this certificate and all eight octahedral attachments, their merged supporting planes, right angles and the actual resulting 36-vertex/72-edge/38-face bowtie incidence. The general proof is the cell construction above, not extrapolation from this example. The theta graph has a degenerate triangular core rather than a positive three-dimensional Q. Its separately proved four-octahedron construction has volume 4v8; it is not being passed through the strict hypothesis here. ### The input class is closed under actual vertex grafts Two such positive cores can be glued along triangular faces by the specified three-port bijection, putting their interiors on opposite sides of the common plane. The adjacent white polygons merge because their dihedral angles add to pi. The resulting union is convex. For an explicit proof, the two convex cores lie in opposite closed halfspaces and intersect exactly in the common triangle T. If x,y are in different cores, minimize d(x,z)+d(z,y) over z in T. This function tends to infinity when z escapes to an ideal end, so a minimum is attained at a finite point. Every finite seam point is locally convex because the right angles add to pi; T has no finite vertices. The minimizing broken path therefore straightens locally across the seam to the ambient geodesic. It is a single geodesic, contained in the union. Points in the same core are already joined there by a geodesic. This proves convexity. Its ideal end vertices and the remaining right-angled boundary faces have exactly the medial incidence of the planar three-edge vertex sum of the two graphs. The canonical unit decorations agree at the seam. Volumes add, and the finite certificate is transported by the explicit face isometry. This gives a constructive closure operation on the geometric input class, not an existence assumption for every planar graph. When the operation uses the ordered interval/outer-face graft of [the NC cube insertion](actual_nc_spin_one_flow_order_certificate.md), it also retains the actual original source topology. In particular, start with the literal cube and repeatedly insert an ordered cube at any allowed interval vertex. Equivalently take the theta source followed by k>=1 such cube insertions. The resulting genuinely branching family has b=1+3k and a core formed from k copies of Q_cube. Its actual hyperbolic volume is Vol(S^3 minus L_Gamma(e)) =(4+12k)v8+2k Vol(Q_cube). (7a) The choices include arbitrary finite ordered binary branching trees. This establishes positive core existence and actual geometry throughout that family. The fixed-level spin-one theorem does not yet provide its all-N quantum limit. ## 5. The precise remaining quantum target For every graph satisfying the input certificate, the desired equality now has a geometrically specified right side: lim_N (2pi/N)log |K_N(L_Gamma(e))| =4b v8+2Vol(Q). (8) The exposed-mark first-normal source formula is exact, but it does not yet prove (8). The shared Q contribution is a global graph term; independent theta scalars cannot supply it. Growing-label control of the full magnetic first normal, coherent noncancellation, and the outer-color packet needed for fillings remain to be proved. For coverage only, the ideal medial polyhedron appears as the truncated rectification in [Belletti's paper](https://msp.org/agt/2025/25-2/agt-v25-n2-p01-p.pdf). Fully augmented right-angled cell decompositions and octahedral subclasses are discussed in [Purcell's exposition](https://users.monash.edu.au/~jpurcell/papers/expos-auglinks.pdf). No proof or quantum-invariant identification from those sources is used in the construction above, and no novelty of the geometric operation is asserted. The cube audit determines the six square faces from the source’s opposite black/white ribbon orders. In the vertex-graft argument, minimizing paths use the exact common triangle and cannot escape to an ideal end.

title: An exact first-normal reduction for arbitrary original NC Morse graphs
text: # An exact first-normal reduction for arbitrary original NC Morse graphs 29 October 2026. Every fixed graph in the actual noncrossing Morse class has a source-exact reduction to an ordinary magnetic spin network with ONE retained generic-q normal. This includes a distinct boundary term when the sole marked white vertex has an unsaturated root source. The original unrestricted mark remains on the physical V_N strand. No Euclidean norm, semisimple root quotient, scalar Frobenius vertex, or vanishing source normal is substituted for it. This is an exact finite source theorem at arbitrary fixed width. It does not establish a norm bound, noncancellation, a stationary cycle, or a geometric volume for a general graph. ## 1. The graph is an original ordered Morse diagram Use precisely the class in section5 of the [literal trivalent vertex theorem](actual_trivalent_complete_circle_vertex_kernel.md). There are b black and b white vertices and E=3b ordered edge slots. Each color class partitions {0,...,E-1} into sorted triples; each partition is noncrossing. At a triple (a,b,c) the actual matching is (2a+1,2c+2), (2a+2,2b+1), (2b+2,2c+1). Removing innermost adjacent arcs gives an original nested cup/cap Morse word. There is no free incidence permutation or unrecorded braid. Choose a white vertex v* whose outer cap is EXPOSED: it is not contained in any other top cap. Mark that arc; all other caps are ordinary. Its row is the original UNRESTRICTED m. Equivalently, all ordinary top caps can be removed by innermost removals without passing over the marked arc. Every noncrossing partition has such a top-level block, so this leaves the arbitrary graph class intact while restricting its bare pointing. Replacing a NESTED cap by the same bare m is not covered. A genuine cut at that location requires pivotal transport through the enclosing caps, which is not a local unmodified m replacement. Fix labels 0<=j_e<=M=floor((N-1)/2) and signed integer exponents e_e. The edge coupon is the actual full-normal sector R^(e_e)L_(j_e)=omega_(j_e)^(e_e) h0_(j_e) W_(j_e) pi_(j_e), pi_j=G_j^(-1)W_j^dagger P, G_(j,r)=s_(2j)/(s_r s_(2j-r)), h0_j=k_j N s_(2j)/s_j^2, k_j=2 if 2j<d, k_j=1 if 2j=d, omega_j=kappa(-1)^j q^[j(j+1)]. (1) Here d=N-1, q=exp(pi i/N), Q=q^2, kappa=q^(d^2/2), F_u=(Q;Q)_u, s_u=|F_u|. The paired coupon is nilpotent; pi_j W_j=0 there. Formula(1) includes its first normal BEFORE passing to an ordinary object. All external original line/framing factors remain outside the raw scalar Z_Gamma defined here. ## 2. Explicit local regular lifts and canonical ordinary tensors Set zeta=q exp(t). Every prime below means d/dt at t=0. Let V_N(t) be the generic highest-weight d module in the same balanced basis. Its physical cup has highest coefficient N zeta^(-d^2): pV_(u,d-u)(t)=N zeta^(-d^2)(-1)^u zeta^[u(d-u-1)] F_u(t)F_(d-u)(t)/F_d(t), ellV(t)=pV(t)^(-1). (2) It specializes exactly to p_(u,v)=N x^(-v)delta_(u+v,d) and ell_(u,v)=x^u/N delta_(u+v,d). On the ordinary object Q_j of highest weight 2j choose pQ_j with highest coefficient ONE, using the same formula with d replaced by 2j and the leading scale omitted. The physical Clebsch map W_j(t) starts at degree l=d-j with h_u(t)=(-1)^u zeta^(-du) Q^[u(l-1)-u(u-1)/2](Q^(j+1);Q)_u F_(d-u)/F_d, W_(j,r)(t)=F_pair(t)^r h(t)/F_r(t), 0<=r<=2j. (3) All displayed factorial denominators have index <N and are units. The direct highest recurrence and E,F commutator prove covariance; the last F endpoint follows because E_pair is injective above degree d. These facts were proved explicitly in the [all-channel marked calculation](actual_trivalent_all_channel_marked_contraction.md), section3. No generic decomposition theorem is required. Keep the ROOT constants h0_j, omega_j and gamma_j=q^(2-j^2)/N^2 fixed as t varies. Define the chosen regular lift pi_j(t)=gamma_j^(-1)D_t(W_j(t)), D_t(W_j)=pQ_j(t)^T W_j(t)^T [ellV(t)^T tensor ellV(t)^T]P. (4) At t=0 this is precisely the actual pi_j in(1). Direct cup matrices and K covariance give D_t^2(W_j)=W_j. This is a lift of the fixed-root coupon, not an assertion about the full moving-q germ of the original circle, pivot, or framed R. Constant omega_j^(e_e) in the lift is legitimate because(1) is an exact all-normal root equality. At any triangle triple (a,b,c), let Theta_abc(t) be the genuine ordinary invariant in Q_a(t) tensor Q_b(t) tensor Q_c(t), normalized by Theta_abc(2a,b+c-a,0)=1. (5) It is an explicit regular finite tensor. Put J=a+b+c, r=b+c-a, r1=a+b-c. Its third-color-zero slice is Theta_abc(2a-k,r+k,0) =(-1)^k zeta^[k(2a+1-k)] F_(r+k)F_(2a-k)/(F_r F_(2a)), 0<=k<=r1. (6) All other slices are forced by v_u=-K_c(u-1)/E_c(u-1,u) E_ab v_(u-1). (7) Every denominator in(6),(7) is a unit at the root. The corresponding integer-H invariant space is one-dimensional. Outside the ordinary triangle range it is zero, by the rectangular lowest F equation. Define the LOCAL source coefficient by the finite original index sum s_abc(t)=<2a,b+c-a,0| [pi_a(t) tensor pi_b(t) tensor pi_c(t)]J_source(t), J_source(t)=pV_16(t)pV_23(t)pV_45(t). (8) Then the whole black tensor is U_abc(t)=s_abc(t)Theta_abc(t). At the root its value is explicitly s_abc(0)=N^3 A_N(a,b,c)/G_(b,b+c-a), (9) where the [proved positive source formula](actual_trivalent_all_channel_positive_scalar_and_regular_cubes.md) includes its original phase. Thus s_abc(0)!=0 exactly when J>=d within the triangle range; it is zero for J<d. The derivative in(8) is a retained local source current, not determined merely by(9). ## 3. The exact ordinary spin network and all root constants Keep each vertex's actual increasing edge order. At a black vertex v with incident labels (a,b,c), place Theta_abc(t), and put s_v(t)=s_abc(t). At a white vertex with the SAME displayed incident order place D_t(Theta_cba(t)), and put s_v(t)=s_cba(t). The dual reverses the abstract object order, so its resulting row is again indexed in (a,b,c) order. No same-order adjoint may be substituted. Contract equal magnetic edge indices, with their dimensions 2j_e+1, to obtain the explicitly specified finite spin network Xi_Gamma(t). It contains the genuine ordinary 3j tensors and cups; it is not defined by the original unknown closed scalar. All its factors and their first derivatives are given by(2),(6),(7). Define the EXACT fixed root factor C_Gamma=product_edges [h0_j gamma_j omega_j^(e_e)], S_Gamma(t)=product_vertices s_v(t). (10) The h0_j and G_j can have factorial exponential growth. They have not been declared polynomial or suppressed. A single gamma_j occurs per edge, because that edge meets exactly one white vertex. Let F_Gamma(t) be the ordinary closed original physical graph with the regular lifted coupons (1),(4), and with an ordinary cap also at the eventually marked arc. Genuine local duality gives Lambda_abc(t)=gamma_a gamma_b gamma_c D_t(U_cba(t)). Substitution at every vertex is therefore the all-width index identity F_Gamma(t)=C_Gamma S_Gamma(t) Xi_Gamma(t). (11) This does not require a factorization of Xi_Gamma into vertex norms or source-independent inverse frames. The magnetic contraction is retained in full, on the actual graph wiring. ## 4. The original marked scalar is exactly the first normal Remove all other caps in their actual innermost Morse order. Exposure ensures that this leaves the two marked legs as a genuine generic invariant physical column. Bend with the SAME pV(t). Every remaining map is then a generic Hopf map; hence the resulting open map on V_N(t) is a scalar z_Gamma(t)I. To prove scalarity directly, its generic K eigenvalues are distinct and all its interior F arrows are nonzero, so commuting with K,F forces a scalar matrix. Every entry is regular at t=0, by(2)--(4); thus z_Gamma is holomorphic. The physical closing trace, including the cup's sign, is exactly ellV pV^T=(-1)^d K_V, F_Gamma(t)=D_N(t) z_Gamma(t), D_N(t)=(-1)^d[N]_(q exp(t)), D_N(0)=0, nu_N:=D_N'(0)=2N(-1)^N/(q-q^(-1))!=0. (12) The original unrestricted root marked row has m pV(0)=1. Thus the original marked source is z_Gamma(0), with no extra component factor: Z_Gamma=C_Gamma/nu_N *[S_Gamma'(0)Xi_Gamma(0) +S_Gamma(0)Xi_Gamma'(0)]. (13) Only the chosen physical trace quotient is differentiated. The mark has never been transported through a paired image or replaced by an ordinary cap. In particular (13) retains the current that would be lost by first specializing the generic ordinary graph to its root zero. The factor 1/nu_N has magnitude sin(pi/N)/N; this alone gives no bound for the differentiated tensors or their source coefficients. The answer is independent of the chosen regular Hopf lift. Two such lifts with the same original root coupons give the same root open map, hence the same z_Gamma(0). Their ordinary closures differ by D_N(t) times a holomorphic scalar vanishing at t=0, so their first normals agree. Individual local source and spin-network derivatives may change with the lift; their complete combination in(13) does not. ### 4a. Why an inner bare mark is not a movable pivotal cut The exposure hypothesis is necessary for the bare row used here. On the ordered cube at N=3, give all twelve edges label j=1 and zero twist. Reduce q to 375 in the prime field of order 1009; this has exact order six and every denominator is a unit. The actual physical contraction with bare m on the exposed white block (0,10,11) is 155. Putting the same bare m on the NESTED block (1,8,9), leaving all other coupons unchanged, gives 620. The ordinary trace and its first normal are unchanged, so these two bare insertions cannot both be its normalized pivotal cut. Their difference is an exact cyclotomic counterexample, not a floating-point discrepancy. The original proof's phrase allowing an arbitrary white vertex was therefore too broad. It has been corrected to the exposed hypothesis in section1, and the audit retains this negative test. Moving a genuine cut through an enclosing cap requires its actual pivotal transport. It cannot justify deleting the marked-white current in (15) while leaving that enclosing ordinary cap row unchanged. ## 5. Exact source support and the marked-white boundary term The following alternatives are valid for every graph above. * A nontriangle triple at ANY vertex makes Z_Gamma=0. If black, its generic invariant column is zero. If white, genuine ordered duality makes its generic ordinary row zero. In either case F_Gamma is identically zero. By generic scalarity and D_N(t)!=0 off its isolated root, the physical open scalar is identically zero and its marked specialization is zero as well. This includes a nontriangle MARKED white vertex; no local invariance of m is presumed. * A triangle with J<d at a black or an UNMARKED white vertex makes Z_Gamma=0 directly at the root: respectively the actual black column or the ordinary cap row is zero before estimating or summing. The marked white row is not included in this local deletion rule. * If every vertex has J>=d, all s_v(0) are nonzero, and (11),(12) force Xi_Gamma(0)=0. The complete formula is then Z_Gamma=C_Gamma [product_v s_v(0)] Xi_Gamma'(0)/nu_N. (14) * Suppose every black and unmarked white vertex has J>=d but the marked white triangle has J<d. There is exactly one zero source factor, s_v*(0)=0. Its full contribution is Z_Gamma=C_Gamma [product_(v!=v*) s_v(0)] s_v*'(0) Xi_Gamma(0)/nu_N. (15) Its ordinary root coefficient alone does not justify deleting this term. The derivative can be nonzero. A subsequent WHOLE-source result now proves its value zero for the closed complete-circle diagrams here: omit all three caps of the exposed marked vertex, obtain a regular six-head invariant, and apply its three complete circles last. Their unsupported product annihilates the saturated source before the mark acts. The full typed proof is in [the exposed six-port pruning theorem](actual_exposed_six_port_complete_circle_pruning.md). This does not set s_v*' to zero or delete an arbitrary open current. If at least two s_v(0) vanish, holomorphy of every factor in(11) gives a double zero and hence Z_Gamma=0. If there is a sole black or unmarked-white zero, (13) and the direct deletion above give the exact compatibility identity s_v'(0)Xi_Gamma(0)=0. This is a consequence of the whole original source, not a license to discard an arbitrary normal. ## 6. The retained normal is explicitly local and finite These formulas can be evaluated using first jets only. For example, put L_u=-sum_(k=1)^u 2k Q^k/(1-Q^k), L_0=0. The logarithmic derivative of the nonzero highest coefficient in(3) is h_u'/h_u=u(2l-d-u-1)+L_(j+u)-L_j+L_(d-u)-L_d. (16) All terms are physical units. With f_r=1-Q^r, its actual descendants and derivatives satisfy W_(r+1)=F_pair W_r/f_(r+1), W_(r+1)'=(F_pair' W_r+F_pair W_r')/f_(r+1) +2(r+1)Q^(r+1)W_(r+1)/f_(r+1). (17) For a canonical cup of highest weight L and scale p0(t), p_(u,L-u)'/p_(u,L-u) =p0'/p0+u(L-u-1)+L_u+L_(L-u)-L_L, ell'=-ell p' ell. (18) Here p0'/p0=-d^2 on V_N and zero on Q_j. Differentiating (4) gives pi_j'; differentiating the four factors in(8) gives s_abc' by a finite sum with one differentiated factor. Equations(6),(7),(18) similarly give Xi_Gamma' by a sum of ordinary magnetic contractions with ONE first-jet tensor or cup. This construction retains the full original source normal at any fixed width, without inverses of paired frames. The [exact first-jet audit](../experiments/audit_actual_nc_morse_graph_first_normal_source_reduction.py) checks these local jet identities and original marked graph contractions. Its sole-unsaturated-marked cube fixture has a nonzero LOCAL source normal but zero exterior spin value; it therefore asserts no nonzero boundary contribution merely from that local current. Both factors in(15) are retained. General norm/nonzero/volume control for the ordinary network normal in(14) remains open. Equation(15)'s local current is retained, while its closed complete-circle source value is now annihilated by the separate physical support theorem. No off-complete auxiliary-color or arbitrary open-current cancellation is inferred. The exposed bare mark and a nested bare mark have different contraction laws. The pointing hypothesis and the dipole correction are required; no network geometry follows from the finite source identity.

title: A graphic vanishing-order certificate for the actual spin-one packet
text: # A graphic vanishing-order certificate for the actual spin-one packet 29 October 2026. There is an exact generic algebraic model for the ordinary network in the [original first-normal graph reduction](actual_nc_morse_graph_first_normal_source_reduction.md). When EVERY ordinary edge is Q_1, the full network is an explicit flow polynomial, including its scalar normalization. This proves a simple root for every connected original NC cubic graph at N=3. It also gives an exact graph criterion at N=4 and a genuine unbounded class with arbitrary branching and no two-edge neck, where that root is simple as well. No first-nonzero-coefficient convention replaces the original FIXED first normal. Every original marked value below uses an EXPOSED top cap, as required by the corrected first-normal theorem. A bare mark at a nested cap needs additional pivotal transport and is not covered. The generic unmarked network identity(2) itself is independent of this pointing. These are fixed-level source/order theorems. They are not an all-N asymptotic, a volume estimate, or a graph extension of a knot-volume limit. At N>4 the all-j=1 source is unsaturated, so that same label choice does not supply an asymptotic family of surviving sources. ## 1. The exact generic packet is a flow polynomial Let Gamma be a connected graph in the literal NC/Morse class, with b black and b white vertices, E=3b ordered edges, and the original opposite ribbon orientations at black and white vertices. Put the canonical ordinary Q_1 tensor Theta_111 at every black vertex and its genuine pivotal dual at every white vertex. Their ordered contraction is Xi_Gamma(zeta), as defined in the first-normal theorem. Use a generic zeta near either exp(pi i/3) or exp(pi i/4), and put d0=zeta+zeta^(-1), delta=-d0, D=d0^2, g(zeta)=-zeta^7 d0. For a subset A of graph edges, let k(A) be the number of connected components of the spanning subgraph, including isolated vertices. Define the FINITE polynomial F_Gamma(D)=sum_(A subset edges) (-1)^(E-|A|) D^[|A|-2b+k(A)]. (1) Then the actual complete magnetic network obeys the generic identity Xi_Gamma(zeta)=g(zeta)^b F_Gamma(D). (2) All fields and normal derivatives are retained in (2). In particular its vanishing order is the order of the displayed polynomial at the appropriate D, since g and D' are nonzero at these two roots. ## 2. Own two-head cabling proof, with the actual pivotal tensors Use an AUXILIARY ordinary highest-weight-one object W of dimension two; this is a finite algebraic factorization of Q_1, not a replacement of the original physical V_N source. Its canonical cup and cap are p=[[0,1],[-zeta^(-1),0]], ell=p^(-1)=[[0,-zeta],[1,0]], sum_(a,b) ell_ab p_ab=delta. On W tensor W put e=|p><ell| and Pi=I-e/delta. The following literal matrices give Pi=i pi and pi i=I: i=(|00>, |10>+zeta^(-1)|01>, zeta^(-1)|11>), pi=[[1,0,0,0], [0,1/d0,zeta/d0,0], [0,0,0,zeta]]. (3) Direct substitution in the original balanced E,F,K matrices verifies that these are ordinary Q_1 intertwiners. The genuine Q_1 cup has highest coefficient one, as in the general source theorem. Its right dual gives the ALL-INPUT identity D(i)=zeta^(-1) pi. (4) The actual nested six-leg fundamental cup source, followed by pi on its three consecutive pairs, is u Theta_111, where u=-zeta^(-2)/d0. (5) Both sides are invariant in the same one-dimensional homogeneous space. To fix (5), take the canonical corner (2,1,0): its only physical contribution has three cup coefficients -zeta^(-1), one pi coefficient zeta, one 1/d0, and one 1. This gives (5). Equation (4) similarly follows from its four-by-three matrices, or from the row0/column00 coefficient and covariance. Let T_Gamma be the literal fundamental Morse contraction with Pi on each edge and the SAME nested vertex cups/caps. White duality, without a Hermitian conjugate, gives T_Gamma=(zeta^(-3)u^2)^b Xi_Gamma =(zeta^(-7)/d0^2)^b Xi_Gamma. (6) Now expand every Pi as I-e/delta. Let A be the edges on which I is chosen. The surviving curves are exactly the boundary components of the plane ribbon neighborhood of (vertices,A): the I edge joins its two vertex disks and the e term closes the two deleted ends. The literal NC vertex order, including the reversed white ribbon order, is essential here. Their number is boundary(A)=2k(A)-2b+|A|. Every resulting fundamental circle evaluates to delta, by the exact cup/cap above. The coefficient for the deleted edges is (-1/delta)^(E-|A|). Hence T_Gamma=delta^(2b-E) F_Gamma(delta^2) =delta^(-b)F_Gamma(D). Together with (6) this proves (2). The proof retains each state with its sign; no absolute-state estimate or graph projector has been used. ## 3. Exact simple zero for every connected NC graph at N=3 The plane dual H of Gamma has b+2 vertices. Its chromatic polynomial has the elementary subset expansion P_H(D)=sum_(B subset edges(H))(-1)^|B| D^k_H(B). For complementary primal and dual edge sets, the plane Euler formula gives k_H(B)=|A|-2b+k_Gamma(A)+1. Thus directly P_H(D)=D F_Gamma(D). (7) Every connected cubic BIPARTITE graph is bridgeless. A bridge cut would give 3(n_black-n_white)=+1 or -1 on one side, an impossibility. It also has no cut vertex: among three incident edges separated into at least two groups, some group has one edge, making a bridge. Thus every facial boundary is a simple cycle. A repeated vertex would, by a small arc in that face and the Jordan separation, be a cut vertex. The dual H is loopless and has no cut vertex. For the latter claim, remove one dual vertex f. Every remaining dual component meets f. Walk around its simple primal facial cycle. At a cubic boundary vertex the two other incident faces share the third edge. Thus two successive neighboring faces of f lie in the same component of H-f. All neighbors, hence all of H-f, are connected. Parallel dual edges can be discarded without changing P_H or this conclusion. Here is an elementary nonzero-derivative proof, not an appeal to a graph-polynomial name. For a connected loopless graph H with at least one edge put beta(H)=(-1)^|vertices(H)| P_H'(1). A cut-vertex factorization P_H=D^(1-r) product_(blocks)P_block makes beta zero if there are at least two nontrivial blocks. For K_2 it is one. If H is simple and 2-connected with at least three vertices, choose an edge e=uv. Both H-e and H/e are connected, and at least one is 2-connected after parallel edges are suppressed. Indeed only the contracted vertex can cut H/e. If it does, H-{u,v} has at least two components, each meeting both u and v by 2-connectivity. After any one other vertex is removed, another such component still joins u to v without e; this proves H-e remains 2-connected. Deletion/contraction P_H=P_(H-e)-P_(H/e) consequently gives beta(H)=beta(H-e)+beta(H/e)>0 by induction on edges/vertices, using the block factorization for non-2-connected children. This proves an INTEGER positive beta for our dual H. In particular F_Gamma(1)=0, F_Gamma'(1)=(-1)^b beta(H)!=0. (8) At q=exp(pi i/3), D=1 and D'=2(q-q^(-1))!=0, so Xi_Gamma has EXACT order one for every connected NC graph, including graphs with two-edge necks. This is an unbounded genuinely branched source result at this fixed level, not only a cube check. All j=1 triples are supported at N=3. Substituting the actual local constants h0=3, gamma=q/9, s=54q and the original trace derivative into the general source formula gives the particularly simple answer Z_(Gamma,N=3)=108^b beta(H)>0 (9) for untwisted edges. Arbitrary signed edge twists multiply this by the literal omega_1^(sum e), and cannot change its nonzero magnitude. ## 4. At N=4 the criterion is different and retains higher zeros Now q=exp(pi i/4), D=2, and D'!=0. A cubic graph admits no nowhere-zero 2-flow: the unique nonzero mod2 current cannot have zero boundary at a vertex of odd degree. This fact also follows from (1) by counting solutions of the incidence equations over F_2 with inclusion/exclusion. Hence F_Gamma(2)=0. Formula (2) gives the EXACT criterion ord_q Xi_Gamma=1 if and only if F_Gamma'(2)!=0. (10) The original all-j=1 sector is supported at N=4 as well. Its physical constants are h0=8sqrt(2), gamma=q/16 and s=64sqrt(2)q^(-1). Since D'/nu_4=-1/sqrt(2), its entire original magnetic contraction is Z_(Gamma,N=4)=(-1)^(b+1) 2^(12b-1/2) F_Gamma'(2). (11) At N=4 this is in fact the WHOLE full-circle marked source at that level. Here M=1. Any edge labeled zero belongs to a black vertex with sum of labels at most two, below d=3, so its actual black source is zero. Thus only the all-j=1 labeling survives. At N=3 there are also supported (0,1,1) vertices; equation(9) remains the specified all-j=1 sector there, without a claim about their additional sum. Connectivity alone does NOT prove a simple zero here. The literal four-vertex NC dipole has F_dipole(D)=(D-1)(D-2)^2, so Xi has exact order TWO and its original fixed first-normal source is zero. Selecting its next nonzero coefficient would compute a different invariant. This agrees with the full paired L_N^2 source obstruction, while (2) determines the whole order explicitly. ## 5. A literal branching insertion that preserves a simple zero Use the actual ordered cube from the vertex theorem: black: (0,1,2),(3,4,11),(5,9,10),(6,7,8), white: (0,10,11),(1,8,9),(2,3,7),(4,5,6). Let an existing black vertex occupy an interval (a,a+1,a+2). Remove it and insert the cube edge row at that interval. The cube's outer white vertex (0,10,11) is removed; its three ports are glued IN ORDER to the original three external edges. Map those original edge slots to a+(0,10,11), all later original edges by +9, and every cube edge k to a+k. Keep every other vertex and the original marked white arc. This is a literal NC/Morse operation. Existing white partitions are mapped monotonically. The new internal white triples are nested in the previously empty gap between the first two distinguished ports. New black triples occupy the interval replacing the removed black triple; all other black triples lie outside or surround it. Thus both partitions remain noncrossing, and their original cup/cap matchings give the required physical ribbon diagram without a bare permutation. It is a genuine planar vertex three-sum. It preserves three-edge connectivity: if a putative cut has at most two edges, restore each deleted degree-three vertex on the majority side of its three ports. In an internally split piece with internal cut count t and p of its three ports on one side, three-edge connectivity of the restored piece gives t+min(p,3-p)>=3, hence t>=2. Two split pieces force at least four cut edges. If only one splits and t=2, its port minority supplies at least one seam edge; if t>=3 the contradiction is already internal. If neither piece splits, their three seam edges are the cut. Each case contradicts the proposed two-edge bound. The dual operation is a clique sum along its common triangle. Colorings on that triangle are three distinct colors. Their number is D(D-1)(D-2), and all choices have the same extension count. Counting for all integer D>=3, then using polynomial identity, gives F_new=F_old F_cube/[(D-1)(D-2)], F_cube=(D-1)(D-2)(D^3-9D^2+29D-32). (12) The cube polynomial follows independently by inclusion/exclusion (1), or coloring its dual three-part complete graph with two vertices per part. Equation(12) is a GENERIC identity before root specialization; its vanishing denominator is canceled with the numerator zeros. It is not root multiplication of L_N coupons or a Frobenius vertex. Starting at the theta graph, k insertions therefore give b=1+3k and F_Gamma=(D-1)(D-2)(D^3-9D^2+29D-32)^k. (13) Every inserted cube creates two interval black vertices where a new copy can be inserted. Independent choices generate arbitrary finite ordered binary branching trees, not merely one cyclic chain. They all have a simple root at both D=1 and D=2, since the cubic factor is -11 and -2 there. The original fixed-channel marked values are Z_(N=3)=108^(1+3k) 11^k, Z_(N=4)=2^[12(1+3k)+k-1/2], (14) up to the retained signed edge-twist unit. These formulas determine their complete first-normal contractions at the indicated levels. ## 6. Scope of the order certificate The generic cabling, signed state expansion and graph insertion are source-exact; the [focused audit](../experiments/audit_actual_nc_spin_one_flow_order_certificate.py) checks literal fundamental Morse contractions as well as ordinary spin and original physical marked source contractions. The proof above is not inferred from isolated numerical graph values. What remains is an order/noncancellation estimate for actual supported labels growing with N. The Q_1 flow model does not provide it. A generic geometric principal symbol or an arbitrary first-nonzero Laurent convention cannot supply the missing fixed-normal theorem. Unsaturated marked-white terms in the general graph reduction remain retained; every vertex in the two fixed-level sectors above is supported. The flow-order certificate is a fixed-level source statement, not an all-N volume claim.

title: Exact three-port source sewing before and after the root normal
text: # Exact three-port source sewing before and after the root normal 29 October 2026. An actual NC/Morse vertex substitution has a generic three-port elimination, with an explicitly normalized theta denominator. At a supported boundary it preserves the original FIXED first normal: the new raw marked scalar is the product of the two old raw scalars divided by the positive actual marked theta scalar. This is not root multiplication of circle coupons. Unsupported boundaries retain their explicit open-column/source jets before an actual six-head support identity proves their complete-circle contribution zero. The theorem is channelwise at arbitrary N, with all three correlated boundary labels and original normal factors retained. It supplies a survival transfer when the two actual input sources are known. It does not prove a new all-N asymptotic for an unsolved primitive cube block, identify arbitrary six-pants boundary maps, or complete the graph-volume problem. ## 1. A literal NC vertex substitution, including the pointing Let A,B be ordered NC/Morse graphs of the [corrected exposed-source theorem](actual_nc_morse_graph_first_normal_source_reduction.md). A has an interval black vertex u on edge slots (a,a+1,a+2), and an EXPOSED white marked cap elsewhere. B has an outer white vertex w on edge slots (0,k,E_B-1), so every other white block is in one of its two gaps. Give B the exposed mark at w. Match the three boundary labels in their displayed order; call them (a0,b0,c0). Remove u and w and glue their three edge ends IN ORDER. Concretely replace A's three-slot interval by B's whole edge row, map the three old A contacts to a+(0,k,E_B-1), move subsequent A slots by E_B-3, and map every B slot e to a+e. Keep the other vertices. Black A blocks surround or avoid the replacement interval; the inserted black blocks are noncrossing within it. The old white blocks are mapped monotonically, and new white blocks lie strictly in the two previously empty contact gaps. Thus both new partitions remain noncrossing. The original p/ell matchings give a literal new Morse word. A's exposed marked cap remains exposed; no inserted white block can surround its contacts. All statements below use that point, not a bare mark moved to a nested cap. The two merged edge exponents ADD. The new edge has ONE coupon R^(e_A+e_B)L_j, not the product of the two old circle coupons. No L_j^2 has been substituted or inverted at the root. ## 2. A genuine invariant output column, not a guessed scalar exterior Fix generic zeta near q=exp(pi i/N), and the canonical ordinary Q_j tensors, duals and actual edge constants of the first-normal theorem. Assume first that every local ordinary triple is triangular. Remove ONLY B's outer white row D(Theta_c0,b0,a0). Contract every other ordinary vertex in B. The resulting column is Y_B(zeta) in Q_a0 tensor Q_b0 tensor Q_c0. (1) It is a genuine homogeneous invariant. For a direct proof, the noncrossing black source is built by inserting interval invariant triples, hence is globally invariant. Every white block other than w can then be removed in its innermost interval order, by a genuine ordinary invariant covector. All blocks are in w's two gaps. What remains are its three ordered output ports, with no intervening cap, braid, or free tensor permutation. The ordinary invariant space has dimension ONE at generic zeta, and its normalized Theta_a0,b0,c0 has corner (2a0,b0+c0-a0,0) equal to one. Every local coefficient is regular at the root. Consequently Y_B=alpha_B Theta_a0,b0,c0, alpha_B=(Y_B)_(2a0,b0+c0-a0,0), (2) with alpha_B a HOLomorphic finite function, computed by the open magnetic contraction. This is an all-entry identity of that source column and can be paired with an arbitrary exterior row. No invariant or regularity assumption about A's exterior row is needed. Let Xi_A,Xi_B,Xi_new be the complete ordinary networks. The fully normalized ordinary theta is Xi_theta=D(Theta_c0,b0,a0)Theta_a0,b0,c0. Then (2) gives exact generic identities Xi_B=alpha_B Xi_theta, Xi_new=alpha_B Xi_A, Xi_theta Xi_new=Xi_A Xi_B. (3) The scalar alpha_B is not defined by contracting the unknown final invariant: it is the explicit open corner in (2). In particular its regularity is proved BEFORE division by Xi_theta. If the boundary triple is nontriangular, the actual invariant column (1) is zero and the new source is identically zero. Nontriangular interior vertices are likewise zero; they are not omitted as a semisimple convention. ## 3. The denominator has an exact root order and source normalization Write a,b,c for the boundary labels in this section and set J=a+b+c, r=b+c-a, r1=a+b-c, r2=a+c-b, F_l=(zeta^2;zeta^2)_l. The independently proved finite Vandermonde evaluation is Xi_theta=(-1)^r1 zeta^[2c-r1(r-1)] F_(2b)F_r2 F_(J+1) /[(1-zeta^2)F_r F_(2a)F_r1 F_(2c)]. (4) All denominator factorials have index <N. Thus ord_q Xi_theta=1 if J>=d, and 0 if J<d, d=N-1. (5) The numerator contains at most one factor 1-zeta^(2N), since J+1<2N. Formula (4) applies to odd simple and even/odd paired axes without separating away their original source factors. Let F_A,F_B,F_new be the ordinary GENERIC physical closures in the chosen regular Hopf lift, and use C,S as in the first-normal theorem. The new constants are exactly C_new=C_A C_B/C_theta, C_theta=product_(boundary j)h0_j gamma_j, S_new=product_(vertices of A except u)s_v *product_(vertices of B except w)s_v. (6) Boundary edge twists are added, so their omega factors occur in C_new with the correct sum. Both removed source factors are the actual s_abc and s_cba. In particular the cross-multiplied identity is F_theta F_new=F_A F_B, F_theta=C_theta s_abc s_cba Xi_theta. (7) This keeps ALL phases, G factors, h0 first normals and fixed gamma units. Each remains present exactly once on a new edge. The source identity is generic and does not divide by nilpotent root operators. For J>=d the actual s_abc(0),s_cba(0) are nonzero, Xi_theta has a simple zero, and F_theta'(0)=nu_N Z_theta!=0, nu_N=2N(-1)^N/(q-q^(-1)), Z_theta=N^2 k_a k_b k_c s_r s_r1 s_r2/s_(J-d) *R_N(a,b,c)^2>0. (8) Here R_N is the already proved positive finite source partition, not an assumed quantum 6j. Equation (8) is a fully explicit boundary weight. It may be exponential and must not be called a polynomial normalization cost. ## 4. Exact fixed-normal gluing and order addition Each exposed physical closure is F_G=D_N z_G, where D_N=(-1)^d[N]_zeta has its simple zero at q and z_G is the actual regular open scalar. For a SUPPORTED boundary (J>=d), equation(7) therefore gives a holomorphic identity z_new=z_A z_B/z_theta, because z_theta(q)=Z_theta>0. In particular the original raw marked scalars, with no transported or repeated mark, obey Z_new=Z_A Z_B/Z_theta. (9) This formula holds even if one of the pieces has a zero raw scalar or a retained unsaturated marked-white current. Those pieces are the complete exposed original sources, not just a selected leading saddle. All such terms are included in their z_G. For nonzero generic ordinary spin networks, (3) gives v(Xi_new)=v(Xi_A)+v(Xi_B)-v(Xi_theta), (10) where v is the exact order at q. The regular alpha_B proves this without assigning a first-nonzero convention to the original source. For supported seams and nonzero physical closure germs one similarly has v(F_new)=v(F_A)+v(F_B)-1. Thus two genuine simple physical zeros give a simple zero after sewing. If a piece has higher order, its fixed first-normal value vanishes and (9) retains that zero. Any original external lines remain explicit. If K_G=chi_G Z_G, then the corresponding relation has the extra factor chi_new chi_theta/(chi_A chi_B); it cannot be suppressed without the actual framing/normalization certificate. ## 5. All boundary channels, including the unsaturated current The ordinary column (2) and identity (3) hold at EVERY triangular folded boundary label. For J<d, Xi_theta(q) is a unit. The two removed source factors s_abc(q),s_cba(q) are zero; it is not valid to divide root marked scalars by Z_theta=0. Instead the exact formula is Z_new=C_new/nu_N *d/dt|0 {S_new(t) Xi_A(t) alpha_B(t)}. (11) All local source factors in S_new are defined by actual finite Clebsch/cup contractions and their explicit first jets. Thus (11) retains the local unsaturated source normals, including a local marked-white current inherited from A. It does not infer them from the zero closed values of the removed boundary vertices. Using alpha_B=Xi_B/Xi_theta here is harmless because this particular ordinary denominator is a root unit. For full circles, the shared boundary triple must be summed ONCE, and its three labels remain correlated. If Z_A(a,b,c),Z_B(a,b,c) denote the complete coherent interior sums with those labels fixed, the whole new scalar is exactly sum_(a+b+c>=d) Z_A(a,b,c) Z_B(a,b,c)/Z_theta(a,b,c). (12) There is no omitted unsaturated correction in this COMPLETE-circle operation. The [exposed six-port pruning theorem](actual_exposed_six_port_complete_circle_pruning.md) proves it before the exterior or mark acts: remove B's three boundary coupons and every ordinary cap other than its omitted outer vertex. The remaining physical six-head column is a regular generic invariant, so its root lies in the actual saturated S_N. The three boundary coupons commute with those disjoint cap removals and can be applied last. Their full complete-circle product annihilates S_N when J<d. This proves that the exact expression(11) vanishes as a WHOLE source; it does not set its local source derivatives to zero. Nontriangles are zero as well. The positive denominator in (12) does not make its numerator a square: the two actual packets need not be conjugates. A physical mirror/reflection identity would still be needed before asserting a positive graph norm. ## 6. An explicit primitive cube corner, with three finite sum variables For the genuine ordered cube use black blocks (0,1,2),(3,4,11),(5,9,10),(6,7,8) and ordinary white blocks (1,8,9),(2,3,7),(4,5,6), leaving outer white (0,10,11) OPEN. Put j_0=a,j_10=b,j_11=c, fix boundary magnetic colors r_0=2a,r_10=b+c-a,r_11=0, and write J_v for the sum of edge labels at the indicated vertex. Define B0=j_1+j_2-a, B1=j_3+j_4+c, B2=j_5+j_9+a-c. For free magnetic integers u,v,w set r_1=u, r_2=B0-u, r_3=v, r_4=B1-v, r_5=w, r_9=B2-w, r_8=J_(1,8,9)-B2-u+w, r_7=J_(2,3,7)-B0+u-v, r_6=J_(4,5,6)-B1+v-w. (13) The remaining black magnetic equation holds identically by boundary weight conservation. Therefore alpha_cube is exactly the triple sum over (13) of the FOUR canonical black Theta entries and the THREE genuine white dual Theta entries. Require 0<=r_e<=2j_e on EVERY edge; otherwise the term is zero. Each individual entry is the explicit finite ordinary coefficient(6),(7) of the first-normal theorem, including its phase. There is no extra closed physical source or unknown inverse frame in this formula. This is a usable all-N primitive open-column scalar. The full column is alpha_cube Theta_boundary by (2), so the triple sum is not just one arbitrarily chosen bad entry. At spin one its exact evaluation is g^3(D^3-9D^2+29D-32), recovering the independently proved generic flow model. A positive high-fold evaluation or a large-N nonzero estimate for the general triple sum remains open; absolute values of its summands would discard precisely the coherence to be proved. ## 7. An exact order-two counterexample to a graph-only criterion At N=5, d=4 and M=2, take two actual ordered cubes. In A give its interval black edges (0,1,2) labels (1,1,1); every other edge has label2. In B give its outer white edges (0,10,11) labels (1,1,1); every other edge has label2. Perform the typed substitution. The new graph has fourteen vertices and twenty-one edges and is three-edge-connected by the vertex-sum proof. Its marked cap remains exposed. Every remaining vertex triple has sum FIVE or SIX, hence is fully supported and has the strictly positive local source scalar. The separating three-edge triple itself has sum3<d. The new ordinary network nevertheless has order EXACTLY TWO. Here is a compact exact certificate for the only additional zero needed. Evaluate B's triple sum(13) in Q(q), with Phi_10(q)=q^4-q^3+q^2-q+1=0. There are fifty nonzero terms. Group them by u=r_1=0,1,2,3. Their reduced coefficients in the basis (1,q,q^2,q^3) are u=0: ( 58, -58, 0, -92), u=1: (-386, 236, -92, 476), u=2: ( 476,-234, 150, -528), u=3: (-148, 56, -58, 144). Each column sums to zero. This is an exact reduction of the explicit finite canonical Clebsch sum, using only polynomial arithmetic and inversion of units modulo Phi_10. It proves alpha_B(q)=0 over the complex numbers, not just in one finite field. Its first derivative is nonzero. The exact rational first-jet formulas reduce modulo the prime 1021 at q->432, a primitive tenth root, to alpha_B'(q)->909, Xi_A'(q)->775. Every denominator is a unit in this reduction. A zero algebraic derivative would reduce to zero, so these nonzero images certify nonzero derivatives. Xi_A(q)=0 independently: A's exposed outer triple is (1,2,2), whose regular outer-column factor contains the simple Xi_theta zero. Thus v(Xi_A)=1 and v(alpha_B)=1. Equation(3) gives v(Xi_new)=2; its second Taylor coefficient has nonzero image 775*909=1006 modulo1021. All NEW vertex source factors are nonzero by their supported sums. Therefore the new physical ordinary closure also has order two, and the original fixed-first-normal marked sector is ZERO. Its higher normal is nonzero. This is not a zero of the full channel sum or a counterexample to a volume statement. It proves that connectivity, absence of a two-edge neck, and positive supported VERTEX scalars do not by themselves ensure simple source order. The separating source constraint matters. It agrees with the all-N six-port pruning theorem rather than deleting its higher jet. The [focused audit](../experiments/audit_actual_nc_three_port_source_sewing.py) checks open-column invariance and all entries, exact local theta normalization, NC/pivotal pointing, ordinary and full marked sewing, the cube triple-sum corner, the physical divided-current pruning, and the exact cyclotomic certificate above. No graph-volume or unconditional all-N cube survival claim is made. The exact exposed statements do not give an all-N primitive-core estimate.

title: The actual negative-band boundary moment is a Ward current
text: # The actual negative-band boundary moment is a Ward current Research proof, 27 October 2026. The boundary moment suggested by the pure-prefix framing chart has an exact whole finite-source model. It is the original cut paired with a particular K-Ward current, rather than the original identity source. Literal signed crossing tensors disprove a universal normalization identifying the two. Separately, the original Ward factorial has an exact inverse-norm boundary atom with a nonzero simple polar coefficient. These are explicit actual operations, but their occurrence in the selected full geometric contraction is not asserted. The physical edge clock B and the Fourier output-band variable eta_F remain INDEPENDENT. The geometric parameter eta_geo=p inverse is used only in the stated principal Fourier incidence and its algebraic boundary chart, not as an automatic image of the finite cap. ## 1. An exact all-level finite boundary functional Retain the literal tensor and all original pivots of [the two-cut construction](actual_two_cut_framing_port_reconstruction.md). Let C_X=P(A X B_word) be its original one-cut endomorphism after inserting the coupon X at the second cut. Here B_word is a word prefix; it differs from the physical clock B. In the balanced frame the original source is Phi(C)=(1/N)sum_(c,a) C_ca. Put \[ F(\eta_F)=\sum_{a,b,c,d}T_{c,d;a,b}\eta_F^{d-b}. \] The identity second-cut source is Phi(C_I)=F_0/N. In the pure-prefix geometric chart one instead encounters \[ J(\eta_{geo})=\frac{\eta_{geo}}{s(1-\eta_{geo})^2},\qquad [\eta^0]J(\eta)F(\eta) =\frac1s\sum_{m=1}^{N-1}mF_{-m}. \tag{1} \] The finite sum in (1) is exact on the Fourier side too, but this does not identify its source with the geometric one. Let U be the literal raising shift, U e_j=e_(j+1), U^N=0. Define \[ X_- =\sum_{m=1}^{N-1}mU^m=U(1-U)^{-2},\qquad \mathcal M_N(T)=\frac1N\sum_{m=1}^{N-1}mF_{-m}. \] Then for EVERY four-port tensor, including its arbitrary whole crossing couplings and actual sources, \[ \mathcal M_N(T)=\Phi(C_{X_-}). \tag{2} \] Indeed the coefficient of E_bd in X_- is b-d for b>d and zero otherwise, exactly the negative output-band weight. All finite bands, and the same single factor 1/N, are retained. This is a coupon/source formula, not a replacement of the original identity coupon by an asymptotically convenient function. ## 2. The coupon is an exact true K-Ward boundary In the actual head frame K=xQ^(-J_head). For m=1,...,N-1, \[ K U^m K^{-1}=Q^{-m}U^m. \] Consequently the WHOLE rational coupon \[ H_- =\sum_{m=1}^{N-1}\frac{m}{Q^{-m}-1}U^m \] is regular at a primitive N-th root and satisfies \[ X_-=(\operatorname{Ad}K-I)H_-. \tag{3} \] Every denominator in (3) is a unit there. The meridian scalar x cancels in Ad K; its other appearances in the original tensors and source are still retained. Actual A and B_word intertwine the true total K. The diagonal pivotal trace, for both the ordinary and frozen pivotal routes, commutes with this group-like action. Thus the exact source identity is \[ \boxed{\quad \mathcal M_N(T)=\Phi\bigl((\operatorname{Ad}K_{cut}-I)C_{H_-}\bigr) =\frac1N\sum_{c,a}(Q^{a-c}-1)(C_{H_-})_{ca}.\quad} \tag{4} \] This is a genuine Hopf Ward row. The last source row is generally NONZERO: the original balanced rank-one source is not invariant on every cut matrix. Its value on the scalar C_I does not imply its invariance on the charged C_(H_-). Additional weighted crossings, prefix coupons or nonintertwining coupons retain their actual K defects in the same ordered insertion formula; they may not be commuted away. At the physical unitary root, in the old flat head metric, the shift U has norm one. Using |1-Q^m|=2 sin(pi m/N) at least 4 min(m,N-m)/N gives \[ \|X_-\|\leq N(N-1)/2,\qquad \|H_-\|\leq\frac N4\sum_{m=1}^{N-1}\frac{m}{\min(m,N-m)} =O(N^2\log N). \tag{5} \] This is a polynomial root bound for this specific Ward primitive. It is not a whole-word R norm estimate or a tame comparison of different source metrics. Whole q-normal derivatives must still be taken from (3)-(4) with the actual moving tensors and source. ## 3. Actual signed tensor counterexamples to identity-source recovery For the literal flip tensor (the two-cut unknot), F_j=N-|j| and sum_(m>0)mF_-m=N(N^2-1)/6. Hence its proposed unknot-normalized boundary functional would be \[ \widehat{\mathcal M}_N(T) =\frac{6}{N(N^2-1)}\sum_{m>0}mF_{-m}. \tag{6} \] It cannot be identified with the original source for arbitrary actual words. Here is an exact characteristic-zero actual crossing calculation. At N=2 let q=i, eta_half=exp(pi i/4), and retain \[ R_+=\begin{pmatrix} \eta_{half}&0&0&0\\ 0&0&\eta_{half}^{-1}&0\\ 0&\eta_{half}^{-1}&2i\eta_{half}^{-1}&0\\ 0&0&0&\eta_{half} \end{pmatrix},\quad g=K^{-1}=\operatorname{diag}(-i,i),\quad R_-=R_+^{-1}. \] These are the literal actual balanced coefficients, not an unrelated matrix model. Keep the external line (i/2)eta_half^(-3 writhe) from the existing actual implementation. Cutting between a positive crossing and its inverse gives \[ T^{pair}_{c,d;a,b} =\frac i2\operatorname{ptr}_g [R_-(I\otimes E_{bd})R_+]_{ca},\qquad F_{pair}(\eta_F)=i(\eta_F^{-1}-\eta_F). \tag{7} \] Thus its original source is zero whereas its negative-band moment is nonzero. Cutting outside that cancelling pair instead gives a constant F equal to zero and moment zero. The complete original source is unchanged; (1) detects the actual inserted Ward current and its placement. No discarded pivotal or framing factor explains the discrepancy. The failure is not limited to a zero-source link.
