Moving the last magnetic leg to the front by the ACTUAL snakes gives (C Theta)(a,b,c)=K(a)Theta(b,c,a), K(a)=zeta^(d-2a), C Theta=Theta. (6) The clock follows directly from ell_d^T p_d=K^(-1), since d is even. For the scalar in (6), C^3 is K_total and hence is identity on integer H=0 invariants. The generic invariant line has dimension one. At a real positive generic zeta the scalar is real, so its cube being one forces it to be one. All entries are rational functions of zeta; therefore this is a rational identity. Dualizing gives the matching white rotation, with inverse clock. No plain permutation of the three magnetic legs is substituted for (6). Here is the explicit prism cut in the ordered cube: top cycle (0,4,1,6), edges (0,11,3,2), bottom cycle (5,2,7,3), edges (9,5,6,8), rung pairs (0,5),(4,2),(1,7),(6,3), rung edges 1,10,4,7, respectively. (7) Apply (6) only to put each indicated rung into the cup/evaluation slot. On a rung, substitute Theta=(W tensor I)p_d/a_m and its actual dual. The two intermediate cup/cap matrices cancel, and the surviving map on its four side legs is W D(W)/a_m^2=c_m e_m. (8) This is an all-side-legs-open identity: D(W)W=eta_m I is used only to identify the normalized projector e_m. For example the elementary sum in (8) is W_(ab,r)D(W)_(r,ce)/a_m^2; when a side leg is brought around a bend its p_d and ell_d are the same inverses in (6). The opposite cyclic move contributes K^(-1), so no residual independent clock is removed. This proves the rung replacement before doing the four-side contraction. After the four replacements, (7) is precisely the cyclic four-box pretzel closure with e_m in each box. Its two strand orientations are the ones supplied by the preceding snakes. Writing its edge indices as a_u,b_u (u modulo 4), the remaining contraction is sum_(a_0,b_0,...,a_3,b_3) K(a_0)K(b_0) product_(u=0)^3 (Rturn_zeta e_m)_((a_u,b_u);(a_(u+1),b_(u+1))). This is Tr[(K tensor K)(Rturn_zeta e_m)^4]. Equivalently its entry in terms of the unturned box is exactly the ratio pV(d-b_(u+1)) / pV(d-a_u) in (4); it is the generic physical ratio, not a root monomial. Denoting the unmarked ordinary cube spin network by Xi, the result is the generic rational identity Xi_cube=c_m^4 F_4(e_m), F_4(e_m)=Tr[(K tensor K)(Rturn_zeta e_m)^4]. (9) For an explicit index check of this last closure, let t_i be the four top edges in (7), and b_i its four bottom edges, indices modulo 4. The four rung contractions, in that order and after removing c_m, are exactly K(t_3)^(-1) e_((t_3,t_0);(b_3,b_0)), K(t_0) e_((b_1,b_0);(t_1,t_0)), K(t_1)^(-1) e_((t_1,t_2);(b_1,b_2)), K(b_2) e_((b_3,b_2);(t_3,t_2)). (9a) For the last row, the initial clock is K(b_3)^(-1)K(r)^(-1); the black vertex's H=0 condition makes it K(b_2). The other three rows follow directly from (6), putting the black rung in its third slot and the white rung in its first slot, then applying (8). The full pivotal self-duality of the channel projector reads e_((a,b);(c,e)) =P_d(d-b)P_d(d-a)/[P_d(d-e)P_d(d-c)] *e_((d-e,d-c);(d-b,d-a)). (9b) It follows by dualizing W D(W)/eta (or directly from the nested pair cup); it includes both reversed tensor order and both cup ratios. Apply (9b) to rows 2 and 4 of (9a). In the four turn factors of (9) make the bijective index substitution (a_0,a_1,a_2,a_3)=(d-t_3,t_0,d-t_1,t_2), (b'_0,b'_1,b'_2,b'_3)=(b_3,d-b_0,b_1,d-b_2). Their four e entries are now exactly those in (9a). Their scalar ratios agree by P_d(d-u)=K(u)^(-1)P_d(u) and the e entry's cleared weight equality K(t_3)K(t_0)=K(b_3)K(b_0). The remaining clocks are precisely K(a_0)K(b'_0), the pivotal trace in (9). This proves (9) by finite substitution, without a picture-dependent cyclic trace. The vertex orders, rungs and clocks in (6)--(9b) are the source certificate. An unlabeled cube or a product of closed theta values would not establish (9). ## 3. Regular specialization preserves the original physical mark At the odd root c_m=-2 is isolated from EVERY other pair node. Consequently the generic e_m has a regular spectral-projector lift, and specializes to the full E_St. This assertion includes its zero first normals on the OTHER double nodes; it is stronger than matching values at distinct nodes. Formula (4) is regular there as well. The generic ordinary trace of the four-box closure is [N]_zeta times its open scalar, because d is even. The original exposed physical mark extracts exactly the root of this scalar: m pV=1. Equivalently, with t=Log(zeta/q), nu_N=(d/dt)[N]_(q exp t)|_(t=0) =2N(-1)^N/(q-q^(-1)), F_4(e_m)'(0)/nu_N=phi(h_N^4). (10) This is the genuine marked closure of the [full pair source algebra](actual_pair_casimir_commutant_and_rotated_trace.md). It is legitimate to choose the regular projector lift here: the root open scalar depends only on the root coupon. A change of lift alters the unmarked closure by [N] times a scalar vanishing at the root, and hence does not alter (10). It does NOT say that E_St is the original moving-q complete-circle germ. Since F_4(e_m)(q)=0, differentiating (9) retains no c_m' term. The finite ratio in (5) gives at the root c_m(q)=(-1)^m q^[-m^2+5m]=q^[-3m^2+4m]. (11) Indeed F_(3m+1)/(F_m F_(2m+1)) reduces, after removing its COMMON root zero, to product_(u=1)^m(1-Q^(N+u))/F_m=1. No vanishing F_N is canceled by a value-only substitution. In the full original source reduction at this central label, h0_m=N, gamma_m=q^(2-m^2)/N^2, s_mmm=N^3 A_N, G_(m,r)=1. There are twelve edge factors h0 gamma and eight source coefficients. The [exposed first-normal theorem](actual_nc_morse_graph_first_normal_source_reduction.md) and (9)--(11) therefore give Z_cube,St=(N gamma_m)^12 (N^3 A_N)^8 c_m(q)^4 phi(h_N^4) product_l omega_m^(e_l). Its magnitude prefactor is N^12 S_N^8. The entire residual phase is q^[24-32m^2+32m]=q^[-8N(2m-3)]=1. This proves (1), including its absolute normalization and original marked cut. ## 4. A full-root positive polynomial, with every nodal value explicit Use the real Casimir Newton basis of [the genuine turn theorem](actual_newton_turn_positive_gram.md): c_j=q^(2j+1)+q^(-2j-1), Bhat_r(z)=product_(j<r)(c_j-z)/s_r^2, Rturn Bhat_r=Bhat_(d-r), phi(Bhat_i Bhat_j)=delta_(i+j,d). (12) The full isolated projector is E_St=Bhat_m^2. To see this without losing normals, its polynomial has degree d, a DOUBLE zero at every paired node, value one at -2, and product_(j<m)(c_j+2)=N=s_m^2. Thus it is the full Hermite projector. The proved positive multiplication formula followed by (12) yields h_N(z)=sum_(r=0)^m beta(m,r)^2 Bhat_r(z). (13) Its half degree and all its first normal coefficients are fixed by this genuine polynomial identity. For every distinct node j<=m, direct sine factorization gives Bhat_r(c_j)=0, r>j, Bhat_r(c_j)=s_(j+r)/[s_(j-r)s_r^2], r<=j. Consequently h_N(c_j)=sum_(r=0)^j s_(j+r)/[s_(j-r)s_r^2] beta(m,r)^2 =P_(N,j)>0. (14) This is EXACTLY the positive all-node factorial sum in [the actual one-leg source](actual_trivalent_one_channel_source_packet.md), with its own source phase kept there. Equation (14) identifies the polynomial values with that sum; the stronger full-normal statement is (13). In particular h_N(-2)=S_N and h_N(c_0)=1. For clarity the positive multiplication coefficients are, when i+j<N, mu_(i,j,k)=s_(i+j)s_k / [s_i s_j s_(k-i)s_(k-j)s_(i+j-k)]>0, max(i,j)<=k<=i+j; the product vanishes in the FULL algebra if i+j>=N. Write h_N^2= sum a_k Bhat_k. Then a_k=sum_(i,j<=m, max(i,j)<=k<=i+j) beta(m,i)^2 beta(m,j)^2 mu_(i,j,k)>0, phi(h_N^4)=sum_(k=0)^d a_k a_(d-k)>0. (15) The last strictness holds at EVERY k, since one can choose i+j=k with i,j<=m. This uses the original functional, so the first normals that define phi have not been discarded. No assertion that Rturn(h_N^2)=h_N^2 is needed. In fact the analogous square-turn identity is false generically with the full cups (3); the audit explicitly records this failed stronger premise. ## 5. What the positive period does and does not settle At N=3, h_N=(4-z)/3 and phi(h_N^4)=11. Formula (1) then gives 108^4 times 11 in the zero-twist central sector, agreeing with the independently derived exact spin-one cube source. The geometric target for the full retained-circle cube source is Vol(actual augmented cube)=16v8+2Vol(Q_cube), where Q_cube is the explicitly labeled ideal right-angled cuboctahedron of the [rectified-core geometric theorem](actual_nc_graph_rectified_core_geometry.md). The period in (15) is the remaining correlated-core contribution; it is not a product of four independent theta-block norms. The [positive cuboctahedral period theorem](actual_positive_newton_cuboctahedral_period.md) now proves lim_(N odd) pi log(phi(h_N^4))/N=Vol(Q_cube). Combining it with S_N=(1/4)N^(-3/2)exp(Nv8/pi)(1+O(1/N)) and (1) proves that THIS central sector has rate 16v8+2Vol(Q_cube), the actual cube-link volume. It does not control the other joint sectors, their interference or even levels. The accompanying profile calculation tests the more precise candidate phi(h_N^4) ~ C_4 N^(-9/2) exp(N J_4), J_4=(16/pi)[Lambda(3pi/8)+Lambda(pi/8)], C_4=4^(-3) sin(pi/4) cos(pi/4)^(-1/2)/2. These growing-level values are labeled as prefactor calibrations, not used as a proof of this asymptotic in the present note. The exact source reduction (1) and strict positivity (15) are unconditional. Audit: [original generic cups, full-root kernels and literal marked cubes](../experiments/audit_actual_odd_central_cube_reflection_packet.py), with [recorded results](../experiments/actual_odd_central_cube_reflection_packet_results.json). It checks six generic cyclic/rung families at zeta=2,3; six odd full physical root kernels including all polynomial normals; eight literal marked cube sources with signed edge powers; and five multiprecision positive-period prefactor calibrations. Finite checks supplement the pivotal and full-polynomial proofs above; they do not establish a whole-color or all-parity source limit. The result concerns the stated reflected source, not equality with the whole cube invariant.

title: The exact complex color packet for arbitrary signed Conway coupons
status: Exact complex packet and selected shear
text: # The exact complex color packet for arbitrary signed Conway coupons 29 October 2026. For every retained C(FG), with F and G robust, and every fixed choice of pure or signed odd-half-twist coupons, the original mixed-color source has the finite analytic packet required by the general filling theorem. Its uniform complex asymptotic has power N^(3/2), a nonzero marked amplitude, and both level parities. The changed odd action is explicitly identified with a local shear of the pure action; it is not replaced by the pure colored action. The representation and primitive peripheral interpretation of that shear are a separate geometric statement. This note proves the exact source packet, its phase, Hessian, and whole-source error estimates. ## 1. An exact finite definition in original Newton coordinates Fix the actual expression and epsilon_l in {0,+1,-1} at each of its H individual circle leaves. The physical coupon is T(R^epsilon_l L_(N-h_l)), with t_l=h_l/N. Put D=N-1, M=floor(D/2), q=exp(pi i/N), kappa=q^(D^2/2), with the original half-Cartan mark. Let G_N be the canonical sine-factorial completion, G_N(r)=s_r, and put A_N(v,t)=N^2 s_(2v)/ [s_v^2 G_N(v-Nt)G_N(v+Nt)], 0<=v<=M. (1) For a retained high Newton index r define the EXACT finite functions d_N^0(r,t)=A_N(r,t), d_N^epsilon(r,t)=kappa^epsilon sum_(v=r)^M (-1)^v q^[epsilon v(r+1)] [v choose r]_q A_N(v,t), epsilon=+-1. (2) Here [v choose r]_q=s_v/(s_r s_(v-r)). These are the coefficients of the literal transported core, by the [full Newton half-twist identity](actual_odd_conway_newton_transport.md). For physical integers h<r, (2) is EXACTLY that coefficient in the full repeated-root algebra, including its normal directions. For complex t near zero it is its specified factorial continuation. All functions in (1)--(2) are holomorphic and even in t. Remove only the explicit common unit phase: ell_N^epsilon(r,t)=exp(-i epsilon pi D/4)d_N^epsilon(r,t), eta_N=exp[(i pi D/4)sum_l epsilon_l]. (3) The positive coupon is the Schwarz reflection of the negative one, including its original q and kappa phases. For complex parameters this means ell_N^+(r,t)=overline(ell_N^-(r,overline(t))); it does not mean conjugating a variable inside a holomorphic function. The [strict leaf interval](actual_conway_strict_leaf_quarter_bound.md) places all complete leaf coordinates strictly above 1/4. Choose a small fixed rectangular window B about the unique complete optimizer in the d=2H-3 free integer wire coordinates of the [pure finite-window construction](actual_conway_complex_window_laplace.md). All leaf indices in this window lie in one compact subinterval of (1/4,1/2); all retained product inequalities are strict. The last forced-flat product has exact coefficient one and is removed using its actual input relation i+j=D. Every other wire index has the exact form r_w=N L_w(y)+delta_w, with fixed integer offsets delta_w. The remaining lattice is primitive Z^d. Define C_N^epsilon(t)=sum_(k in Z^d, k/N in B) product_leaves ell_N^(epsilon_l)(r_l,t_l) product_retained_gates mu_N(r_left,r_right,r_out). (4) The mu_N are the original positive Newton multiplication coefficients, not their asymptotic equivalents. Thus (4) is a finite, explicit, separately-even holomorphic function. For all sufficiently large N, each state in its fixed window is an actual admissible core state for every physical small deficit. No support cutoff moves with t. ## 2. The selected local action and amplitude Use t=h/N throughout; the older mixed-source note uses pi t for its second variable. Put Y=exp(2pi i x), H_t=exp(2pi i t) and D_t=(1-Y/H_t)(1-Y H_t). The source-selected quadratic is mu^2-p_0 mu-q_0=0, p_0=-Y^-1[(H_t+H_t^-1)Y^2+2]/D_t, q_0=-Y^-2(1-Y^2)^2/D_t^2, mu(x,0)=-Y^-1. (5) On a fixed complex neighborhood of the high x interval and a small fixed t disk this root is nonzero, analytic and dominant in the actual high-to-low source transport. Define S(x,t)=integral_x^(1/2) Log mu(u,t)du, C(x,t)=sqrt(mu(x,t)) exp[integral_x^(1/2) nu(u,t)/mu(u,t)du]. (6) The logarithm and square root equal zero and one respectively at x=1/2. The correction nu is computed from the exact source recurrence: nu=[p_1+q_1/mu-q_0 mu_x/mu^2]/[1+q_0/mu^2]. (7) Here p_1,q_1 are the 1/N derivatives of the EXPLICIT rational recurrence coefficients in the [selected mixed-inner theorem](actual_pretzel_mixed_inner_source_wkb.md), with its color variable replaced by pi t. Its terminal source is U_M=1; C is therefore normalized by that finite source. In particular S(x,0)=i pi(1/2-x)^2, C(x,0)=sqrt(sin(pi x))exp[-3pi i(1/2-x)/2]. (8) Let g(x,t)=J(2x)-2J(x)-J(x-t)-J(x+t), f_0(x,t)=g(x,t), f_-(x,t)=g(x,t)+S(x,t)-S(x,0), f_+(x,t)=overline(f_-(overline(x),overline(t))). (9) The three functions all equal g(x,0) at t=0, but their color derivatives differ. Their local leading amplitudes are b_0(x,t)=sqrt(sin(2pi x))/ [2^(3/2)sin(pi x)sqrt(sin(pi(x-t))sin(pi(x+t)))], b_-(x,t)=b_0(x,t) exp[i pi(3/4-x)] C(x,t), b_+(x,t)=overline(b_-(overline(x),overline(t))). (10) All marks continue from the positive complete factorial branches. They are nonzero after shrinking the fixed domains. At completeness, b_epsilon(x,0)/b_0(x,0) =sqrt(sin(pi x))exp(-i epsilon pi x/2), epsilon=+-1. (11) These formulas include the source's quadratic color phase. Indeed the literal finite sum is A_(h,r)=D_(h,r)U_(h,r), and the canonical factorial marks give exactly q^(h^2)D_(h,r)/D_(0,r) =G_N(r)^2/[G_N(r-h)G_N(r+h)]. (12) The apparent q^(h^2) has thus combined with the factorial phases; it has not been discarded as an external unit factor. ## 3. Exponentially accurate joint interpolation of the finite grid This step is necessary before using a complex wire saddle. A merely O(1/N) coefficient approximation on the real grid would not suffice. The selected mixed-source theorem supplies a holomorphic E_N(x,t), on a fixed joint neighborhood, satisfying U_(Nt,r)=exp(E_N(r/N,t))[1+O(exp(-sigma N))], exp(E_N(x,t))=C(x,t)exp[N S(x,t)][1+O(N^-1)]. (13) Both estimates are uniform in the specified complex t disk. The first compares the ACTUAL finite source with its interpolation on the physical high-index grid. Its proof uses the exact endpoint zero in the continued fraction followed by optimally truncated analytic Euler--Maclaurin; no homogeneous solution is substituted. The remaining chirp must use a fixed analytic lattice mark. Take nu_N(z)=exp[-i pi z+i pi z(z+1)/N], P_N(x)=kappa^-1 exp(i pi D/4)/nu_N(Nx). At integer r, nu_N(r)=(-1)^r q^(r(r+1)) exactly. Moreover P_N(x)exp[N S(x,0)] =exp[i pi(3/4-x-1/(2N))]. (14) This fixes the continuous chirp before the lattice contour estimate. Replacing exp(-i pi r) by an arbitrary off-grid branch would move a whole lattice frequency and is not done here. For complex x define the exact pure interpolation A_N^hol(x,t)=N^2 G_N(2Nx)/ [G_N(Nx)^2G_N(N(x-t))G_N(N(x+t))]. (15) A joint analytic interpolant of the NEGATIVE normalized coefficient is I_N^-(x,t)=A_N^hol(x,t) P_N(x)exp(E_N(x,t)). (16) At the physical high grid it agrees with ell_N^- up to the relative exponential error in (13). Formula (12) proves that this is the same finite coefficient (2), including its phase. For the positive sign use its Schwarz reflection, and for the pure coupon use (15) itself. Equations (8),(13)--(16) and the canonical factorial expansion give I_N^epsilon(x,t)=N^(1/2)b_epsilon(x,t) exp[N f_epsilon(x,t)][1+O(N^-1)] (17) uniformly holomorphically on a smaller fixed joint neighborhood. The factor exp(-i pi/(2N)) in (14) belongs to the displayed error, not to an omitted constant or parity phase. ## 4. Exact identification of the changed action as a shear There is a useful equivalent expression for (9). For each epsilon in {0,+1,-1}, solve near s=0 the implicit equation t=s-epsilon g_s(x,s)/(2pi i). (18) Its derivative in s at completeness is 1-epsilon i cot(pi x), which is nonzero. Then EXACTLY f_epsilon(x,t)=g(x,s)-epsilon g_s(x,s)^2/(4pi i), partial_x f_epsilon=g_x(x,s), partial_t f_epsilon=g_s(x,s). (19) The last two identities follow by differentiating (18); what needs proof is that (19) is the action selected by the original source. For epsilon=-1 put E=exp(2pi i x), H=exp(2pi i t), T=exp(2pi i s). Exponentiating (18) gives H=T(E-T)/(ET-1), T^2+E(H-1)T-H=0, T=1 at H=1. (20) The pure ordered-port quantity K=exp(-g_x(x,s)) is -(1-E/T)(1-ET)/(1+E)^2. Eliminating T from (20) gives K^2(1+E)^2+K[(H+H^-1)E^2+2]+(1-E)^2=0. (21) On the other hand, differentiating the ACTUAL selected action (9) in x and using (5) gives exp(-partial_x f_-)=E mu D_t/(1+E)^2, which obeys precisely (21). At H=1 the polynomial factors as (K+1)[K(1+E)^2+(1-E)^2], and both constructions take the branch K=tan(pi x)^2. Their x derivatives therefore agree, with the logarithms fixed at t=0. Their difference could only depend on t. Both actions tend to zero as x tends to 1/2: S(1/2,t)=0 and J(1/2+t)=-J(1/2-t); the implicit shear has s=t and g_s=0 there. This fixes that remaining function to zero. Schwarz reflection proves the positive case, and epsilon=0 is immediate. Thus the half-twist source really implements this action change; matching its Hessian alone was not used to identify it. ## 5. The finite packet's uniform complex saddle Let y be the primitive free wire coordinates. With all exact turn relations retained in their affine limiting maps, put F_epsilon(y,t)=sum_l f_(epsilon_l)(x_l(y),t_l) +sum_retained_gates m(w_g(y)). At t=0 it is the pure complete action. Its wire Hessian is negative definite, so it has one holomorphic critical branch y_*(t) near the strict complete optimizer. Set Phi_epsilon(t)=F_epsilon(y_*(t),t). (22) To specify the amplitude without losing integer offsets, write r_w=N L_w(y)+delta_w. Use the leaf amplitudes (10), the usual positive gate amplitude b_mu(x,y,z)=2^(-3/2) sqrt[sin(pi(x+y))sin(pi z)/ (sin(pi x)sin(pi y)sin(pi(z-x))sin(pi(z-y)) sin(pi(x+y-z)))], and multiply their product by the EXACT leading offset factor exp[sum_l delta_l partial_x f_(epsilon_l) +sum_g grad m(w_g) dot delta_(w_g)]. (23) Call the resulting holomorphic nonzero function b_E(y,t). In (23) the changed f_epsilon is essential at nonzero colors; one must not reuse a pure colored offset factor. Define a_epsilon(t)=(2pi)^(d/2)b_E(y_*(t),t)/ sqrt(det[-F_(epsilon,yy)(y_*(t),t)]). (24) The determinant square root is positive at completeness. All factors are fixed by the original grid and its canonical factorial marks. Then, uniformly on a fixed smaller complex color polydisk, C_N^epsilon(t)=N^(3/2)a_epsilon(t) exp[N Phi_epsilon(t)][1+O(N^-1)]. (25) Proof with the finite errors retained. Replace the grid leaf factors in (4) by (16), (15), or their reflected versions, and use the canonical interpolation for each unchanged gate. The total grid error is bounded by poly(N)exp[N(F0+C||t||^2-sigma)], because (13) is relative at each original state and all local actions are even perturbations of the complete real action. Shrink the fixed color disk until this is exponentially below Re Phi_epsilon(t). This estimates the error BEFORE any oscillatory saddle cancellation. The interpolated summand has amplitude N^(3-H)b_E and phase F_epsilon, uniformly holomorphically on the same fixed wire tube. Apply the finite tensor-cotangent rectangle proof from the pure window theorem: vertical half-grid sides retain a boundary gap; each nonconstant horizontal kernel term loses exp(-2pi N eta), dominating the O(eta^2) complete phase increase and sufficiently small complex-color perturbation. The constant horizontal terms give N^d times the ordinary integral, including all orientations. Replacing half-grid endpoints by the fixed rectangle costs only exponentially small boundary strips. Translate that integral to its nearby complex critical point. The endpoint connectors retain their gap, its real tangent Gaussian is uniformly nondegenerate, and the odd first corrections integrate to zero. This gives relative O(N^-1), with power N^(3-H+d/2)=N^(3/2). Adding back the already bounded exponential grid residual proves (25) for the EXACT finite function (4). Neither parity changes the lattice density or any displayed phase. ## 6. Nonzero amplitude, color Hessian and the whole physical source The functions Phi_epsilon and a_epsilon are separately even. At zero, Phi_epsilon(0)=F0, a_epsilon(0)=a_pure(0) product_(epsilon_l!=0) sqrt(sin(pi x_(l,*)))exp(-i epsilon_l pi x_(l,*)/2), (26) which is nonzero. Since F_(y t_l)(y,0)=0 identically by evenness, the critical-point Schur correction vanishes. With c_l=cot(pi x_(l,*)), partial_(t_l)partial_(t_m) Phi_epsilon(0) =[-2pi c_l/(1-epsilon_l i c_l)] delta_lm =2pi i tau_l delta_lm, tau_l=i c_l/(1-epsilon_l i c_l), Im tau_l>0. (27) For epsilon=-1 this is tau=(1+exp(2pi i x))/2; for epsilon=+1 it is -(1+exp(-2pi i x))/2. The pure value is i cot(pi x). These are the packet parameters; the corresponding geometric cusp ratios are twice these numbers in the original full-twist convention. At the level of the exact local action (19), if U_old=-2pi i s and V=-2g_s, then U_new=-2pi i t=U_old-epsilon V/2. Identifying these as the primitive paths on a changed half-twist partner requires its literal geometric cut, not just this generating-function equation. The negative-definite real part of the diagonal Hessian and separate evenness give, after shrinking the fixed complex polydisk, |C_N^epsilon(u+iv)|<=poly(N) exp[N(F0-a||u||^2+B||v||^2)], a>0. (28) The bound concerns the finite packet itself by (25); imaginary quadratic cross terms are absorbed by completing squares. Finally the [whole mixed-source gap](actual_odd_conway_uniform_mixed_source_gap.md) controls all actual aliases. On real physical colors, the omitted core states outside B have a fixed gap from the common concave majorant and its unique complete maximizer. Therefore, uniformly for 0<=h_l<=delta N, |Z_N(h)-eta_N C_N^epsilon(h/N)| <=poly(N)exp[N(F0-gamma)], (29) for some fixed delta,gamma>0. The full physical color complement has its separately proved gap as well. Thus (25),(27)--(29) supply ALL quantum source hypotheses of the general long-filling transfer for the changed coupons, with mu=3/2 and eta_N exactly as in (3). The actual peripheral geometry remains its distinct hypothesis. ## 7. The same action transformation holds on the entire source branch Let Phi_0(s) be the optimized PURE colored action, with all its actual wire equations retained. Since f_(epsilon,x)=g_x in (19), the changed critical wire state is precisely the pure critical wire state at the corresponding local s parameters. The global action identity is consequently t_i=s_i-epsilon_i partial_i Phi_0(s)/(2pi i), Phi_epsilon(t)=Phi_0(s) -sum_i epsilon_i [partial_i Phi_0(s)]^2/(4pi i). (30) The first map has invertible diagonal derivative 1-epsilon_i i cot(pi x_(i,*)) at zero. It therefore fixes a unique small analytic branch. Differentiation gives partial_(t_i)Phi_epsilon=partial_(s_i)Phi_0 exactly; mixed source couplings are retained in this global map. At a full-twist filling saddle with charges +1, this implies the action identity S_epsilon,p = S_0,p_eff, p_eff,i=p_i-epsilon_i/2, (31) at their corresponding critical points. This is an equality of selected analytic ACTIONS, not a replacement of the actual filled manifold by a pure rational-slope filling. Multiplying the pure half-integral slope equation by two would also double its rotation charge, so primitive geometric completion does not follow that way. The original changed meridian and its physical filling equation must still be used. Audit: [finite coefficients, action shear and color normalization](../experiments/audit_actual_odd_conway_complex_color_packet.py). The [recorded results](../experiments/actual_odd_conway_complex_color_packet_results.json) pass 18 exact finite transported-source comparisons, 12 continuous chirp/parity checks, the symbolic selected-port, implicit-derivative, Hessian and effective-slope identities, and eight complex amplitude calibrations across both parities. title: Signed half twists and long fillings of arbitrarily branching Conway factors
status: Full signed long-filled knot and link equality
text: # Signed half twists and long fillings of arbitrarily branching Conway factors 29 October 2026. The original marked quantum invariant has its full hyperbolic-volume limit for every fixed signed half-twist pattern on C(FG), where both children are robust, after independently sufficiently long fixed signed integral fillings of any auxiliary subset. Every such expression has a constructible pattern giving a KNOT when all auxiliary circles are filled. No fixed diagram width, branching depth, turn depth, level parity, or prime-level condition is imposed. This research proof assembles the independently checked full-source gap, finite complex packet, actual marked representation, and primitive geometric completion. It is not a theorem for arbitrary hyperbolic knots. The exact grammar and the excluded minimal case are below. ## 1. The class and theorem Start with the original retained crossing-circle leaf h and seed A=h^3. Let F and G be any fixed finite expressions generated by A, literal quarter-turns, and stacking. Use the actual cylindrical closure C(FG). At each individual leaf l choose epsilon_l in {0,+1,-1}, replacing h_j by the actual T(R^epsilon_l L_j). Keep all original auxiliary circles, marks, and normalization. This includes arbitrary finite branching, arbitrary turn depth, and independent half-twist signs. Let Y^epsilon be this augmented-link exterior. Choose any subset I of auxiliary circles and independently sufficiently large fixed signed integers p_i. Fill by the original disk-framed full twists R^(-2p_i). The resulting literal crossing power at a filled leaf is epsilon_i-2p_i. Unfilled auxiliary colors remain complete; p_i=0 is not used to represent an unfilled cusp. Then Y^epsilon(p) is the actual complete hyperbolic filled exterior and lim_(N->infinity) (2pi/N) log|K_(E,N)^epsilon(p)| =Vol(Y^epsilon(p)). (1) Both level parities and composite levels are included. The diagram, half twists, filling subset, and slopes are fixed before N tends to infinity. The threshold may depend on the fixed diagram and signs; it does not require the slopes to have the same sign or comparable magnitudes. The invariant is the original marked one-cut scalar, with its explicit nonzero enhancement factor of subexponential modulus. For the reduced enhanced Kashaev invariant this outer factor has unit modulus. For the full one-cut modified normalization it has modulus 1/N, once rather than once per auxiliary circle. These facts follow from the [original normalization comparison](actual_complete_augmented_source_normalization.md) and the independently derived [Kashaev crossing comparison](kashaev_crossing_and_period_lattice.md). The minimal C(A) is excluded from this mixed-color filling statement. Its complete half-twist volume equality is a separate proved result. No equality for all alternating, arborescent, or hyperbolic knots is claimed simply from the name of this expression grammar. ## 2. The actual complete source and the whole-source gap The [full Newton transport theorem](actual_odd_conway_newton_transport.md) retains every repeated-root normal coordinate and the original Cartan phase. Its complete-source leading coefficient is nonzero for every fixed epsilon pattern. The complete critical point is the pure one; every complete leaf lies strictly above one quarter. The [supporting-plane theorem](actual_odd_conway_uniform_mixed_source_gap.md) proves a uniform gap for every alias subset and the entire physical color complement on C(FG). Its mechanism is uniform across this grammar: each proper-seed leaf lies between 1/4 and atan(sqrt(2))/pi, and the tangent to its complete action dominates the full alias profile by a fixed positive amount. Product tangents cancel by stationarity under the actual affine wire relations. No separate estimate is needed for each expression or for each number of aliases. The [half-partner geometry theorem](actual_conway_half_twist_partner_geometry.md) constructs the actual complete augmented complement by changed shaded face pairings. All pointwise edge words and complete horosphere links are checked. Its volume is 2pi times the same complete source action. The [finite complex-color packet](actual_odd_conway_complex_color_packet.md) is separately even and has a uniform complex asymptotic with power N^(3/2) and nonzero leading amplitude. The fixed finite grid, all D=N-1 offsets, and the exponentially small interpolation residual are retained. The [marked odd deformation](actual_odd_conway_marked_peripheral_deformation.md) constructs the actual near-complete link-group representation and the primitive peripheral coordinates of that SAME selected action. Together these results supply every hypothesis of the [general original-source filling theorem](general_original_source_long_filling_transfer.md). ## 3. The global peripheral shear Let Phi_0(t) be the already proved pure critical action, with all auxiliary colors allowed to vary near completeness. Write a_i(t)=partial_i Phi_0(t), U_i^0=-2pi i t_i, V_i^0=-2a_i(t), G_0(t)=2pi i Phi_0(t). (2) The exact changed-source/geometry correspondence is chi_i=t_i-epsilon_i a_i(t)/(2pi i), Phi_epsilon(chi)=Phi_0(t) -sum_i epsilon_i a_i(t)^2/(4pi i). (3) At zero, Phi_0''=-2pi diag(c_i), c_i=cot(pi x_(i,*))>0. The Jacobian of t->chi is diag(1-epsilon_i i c_i), hence invertible. Equation (3) defines a unique holomorphic branch t(chi) near zero. The local selected-source identity is proved in the complex packet by its exact Ward quadratic and the zero-action endpoint x=1/2. Its global extension is elementary. At fixed wire coordinate x the implicit local relation is chi=t-epsilon*g_t(x,t)/(2pi i), and f_epsilon(x,chi)=g(x,t)-epsilon*g_t(x,t)^2/(4pi i). Differentiation at fixed chi gives f_epsilon,x=g_x; differentiation at fixed x gives f_epsilon,chi=g_t. Thus the complete network wire equations are exactly the old pure equations at the hidden colors t. At their critical point g_t=partial_i Phi_0. This proves (3), including all interactions between distinct cusps and all turns and products. The same computation gives partial_i Phi_epsilon=a_i(t), U_i^epsilon=U_i^0-epsilon_i V_i^0/2=-2pi i chi_i, V_i^epsilon=V_i^0=-2 partial_i Phi_epsilon, G_epsilon=G_0-sum_i epsilon_i (V_i^0)^2/8, dG_epsilon=(1/2)sum_i V_i^epsilon dU_i^epsilon. (4) Its packet cusp ratios are tau_i^epsilon=i c_i/(1-epsilon_i i c_i), Im tau_i^epsilon=c_i/(1+epsilon_i^2 c_i^2)>0. (5) For epsilon=-1 this is (1+exp(2pi i x_(i,*)))/2; for epsilon=+1 it is -(1+exp(-2pi i x_(i,*)))/2. The geometric primitive cusp ratio is twice the packet ratio, as required by the original full-twist convention. Equations (3)--(5) are used together with the actual selected finite packet and the original odd-link primitive paths. Neither the algebraic shear alone nor a match of Hessians is used to infer the asymptotic. ## 4. Filling stationarity and an exact action simplification The general original-source filling theorem uses the unique small critical point chi_*(p) of S_epsilon,p(chi)=Phi_epsilon(chi) +(pi i/2)sum_(i in I)(chi_i-1)^2/p_i. (6) In the original normalization it proves the stronger asymptotic K_(E,N)^epsilon(p)=Xi_N eta_N kappa^(-sum_(i in I)p_i) N^(3/2) D_(E,epsilon)(p) exp[N S_epsilon,p(chi_*)] *[1+O_p(N^-1)], eta_N=exp[(i pi (N-1)/4)sum_l epsilon_l], D_(E,epsilon)(p)!=0. (6a) Here Xi_N is the already recorded enhancement/framing factor, not another copy of a factor inside the raw source. The nonzero D is the explicit Gaussian-and-sinh prefactor of the general transfer. Its minimal signed charge sectors add. Every original color, alias, normal term, endpoint current, and nonminimal charge is controlled before taking this limit. In particular (6a) is a full-sequence statement and is not obtained by taking the modulus term by term. Its saddle equation gives the primitive filling condition U_i^epsilon+p_i V_i^epsilon=-2pi i. (7) The regulator anchor is the actual complete volume, and the marked volume identity is Vol(rho_chi)=Im G_epsilon(chi) -(1/2)sum_i Re U_i^epsilon Im V_i^epsilon. At (7) this equals 2pi Re S_epsilon,p(chi_*). The [general geometric completion proof](general_source_regulator_hyperbolic_equality.md) applies to the actual nearby bounded framed representation, with all unfilled cusps parabolic and the primitive small logs in (7). It constructs the smooth complete hyperbolic metric on the intended filled topology. Combining its volume with (6a) proves (1). There is also a useful exact simplification. At the saddle put P_i=p_i-epsilon_i/2 and substitute (3). Then a_i(t)+(pi i/P_i)(t_i-1)=0, S_epsilon,p(chi_*)=Phi_0(t_*) +(pi i/2)sum_(i in I)(t_i-1)^2/P_i. (8) For an unfilled cusp, chi_i=0 implies t_i=0 on the local branch: separate evenness factors a_i=t_i Q_i(t), and its coefficient remains nonzero near completeness. Thus it contributes no extra term in (8). Equation (8) is an identity of selected actions, not an assertion that the odd link is the pure link with a rational filling. At an odd leaf multiplying U_i^0+(p_i-epsilon_i/2)V_i^0=-2pi i by two produces the primitive pure-cusp slope (2,2p_i-epsilon_i) with total logarithmic angle -4pi i. Ordinary smooth pure-link Dehn filling therefore cannot replace the marked odd-link completion in (7). ## 5. The constructive knot subfamily The [literal connectivity theorem](actual_conway_half_twist_partner_geometry.md#5-literal-main-connectivity) gives a linear-time parity assignment for EVERY robust expression. The allowed endpoint matchings are I,U,X; a seed realizes U or X without internal circles, a turn swaps I and U, and stacking has only one circle-creating pair, U times U. Every subtree retains at least two feasible matching types, so the root can be chosen U or X. Its cylindrical closure has one main component. Either sign can be used at every odd leaf. Full-twist fillings preserve the resulting endpoint permutation. Filling all auxiliary circles therefore gives knots for arbitrary fixed branching and turn depth. Equation (1) applies to this entire constructible knot subfamily. No fixed diagram width or turn depth is imposed; a statement about the knots' intrinsic minimal bridge numbers is not needed here. ## 6. A-structure scope The relevant marked branch is algebraic. With E=exp(2pi i x), T=exp(2pi i t), H=exp(2pi i chi), and Q=(E-T)/(ET-1), the local equations following from (3)--(4) are H=T Q^(-epsilon), M=H^(-1), L=Q^(-2), kappa=-(1-E/T)(1-ET)/(1+E)^2. (9) Together with the actual product and turn equations these describe the selected auxiliary peripheral branch. All multipliers here are projective similarity multipliers (squared SL eigenvalues), with the original centered logarithms retained. The pole divisors are excluded and the complete oriented branch is specified. The calibrated primitive G_epsilon and the source-selected nonzero period carry information beyond the elimination ideal. No whole classical knot A-polynomial, generic-main-meridian quantum operator, or automatic dominant-period selection is inferred from elimination. Those general extensions remain part of the larger active objective. The half-integral notation has a simple algebraic explanation. Over the peripheral torus with coordinates M,L, retain ell with ell^2=L. This finite etale double cover is a mu_2 torsor in characteristic zero. On it the change is the INTEGRAL monomial map (M^0,ell) -> (M^0 ell^(-epsilon),ell). (10) The source branch supplies ell=Q^(-1)=exp(V/2), continued from ell=1. Thus the internal algebraic data trivialize the pulled-back torsor locally. With several cusps the cover has group (mu_2)^b. Forgetting this marked square root loses the information needed to distinguish the physical odd meridians. It does not justify a half-integral change of primitive basis on the same cusp torus. On the logarithmic cover, the primitive changes by G_epsilon=G_0-sum epsilon_i V_i^2/8, as in (4). This is an explicit algebraic correspondence together with its calibrated action change. Neither the elementary torsor nor its trivialization alone proves the asymptotic: selection and survival of the period are supplied by the finite-source packet and the whole-color bound. ## 7. Verification and limits The [independent six-leaf certificate](../experiments/audit_actual_odd_conway_six_leaf_calibration.py) checks C(A A) beyond the old three-leaf examples. It proves the nine stationary gradient equations and positive Hessian exactly, retains the D=N-1 multiplier 4/3, and gives the pure leading amplitude 3^(5/4)/32768. Its 36 signed complete-source and 18 mixed-color finite-level comparisons are explicitly numerical diagnostics; they are not premises of the general convergence proof. [Literature coverage](positive_conway_literature_coverage.md) is kept separate from the own proofs. The result retains its literal grammar, long-slope quantifiers, and original invariant. The active general objective remains open beyond classes with these source and geometry certificates, including arbitrary knot diagrams and the full generic quantum A-operator formulation.

text: # Actual mixed peripheral geometry for arbitrary odd/pure Conway patterns 29 October 2026. Every fixed signed odd/pure coupon pattern on a retained robust Conway factor has an actual marked representation family realizing its selected mixed-source action. The odd shaded gluings satisfy their full pointwise edge words away from completeness. The physical auxiliary meridians and preferred disk longitudes obey U_i=-2pi i chi_i, V_i=-2 partial_i phi(chi). (1) The source phase changes by an explicit canonical shear. It is not the pure packet with the same color variables. In particular the complete half-twist marking is retained in every filling equation. This supplies the geometric input for the whole original-source long-filling transfer. Its analytic source hypotheses must be supplied by the separately proved odd-coupon gap and complex packet. The present proof works for arbitrary fixed turn depth, branching and coupon signs; it is not a cyclic or pretzel-only construction. ## 1. An exact change of the physical color coordinate Write the pure leaf action as g(x,t)=J(2x)-2J(x)-J(x-t)-J(x+t), J(a)=integral_0^a Log(2sin(pi u))du, v=g_t=Log[sin(pi(x-t))/sin(pi(x+t))]. (2) The continued marks are those of the complete positive chamber. For a coupon epsilon in {0,+1,-1} define the hidden pure parameter t=t_epsilon(x,chi) and transformed action by chi=t-epsilon*v/(2pi i), f_epsilon(x,chi)=g(x,t)-epsilon*v^2/(4pi i). (3) For epsilon=0 this is simply the original pure leaf. At t=0 the derivative of the first equation with respect to t is 1-epsilon*i cot(pi x), which is nonzero for 0<x<1/2. Thus (3) determines one holomorphic branch near every complete leaf. The function t is odd in chi; f_epsilon is even. Direct differentiation, including the implicit t dependence, gives EXACTLY df_epsilon=g_x dx+v dchi. (4) Thus the internal wire derivative remains g_x evaluated at the hidden parameter, while the derivative in the PHYSICAL color is v. ## 2. This is the action selected by the original odd source The exact finite mixed half-twist source has the selected analytic action, for epsilon=-1, f_src(x,chi)=g(x,chi)+S(x,pi chi)-S(x,0), S(x,a)=integral_x^(1/2) Log mu(s,a)ds, (5) where mu is the source-selected root of the explicit quadratic in [the mixed finite-source theorem](actual_pretzel_mixed_inner_source_wkb.md), with mu(x,0)=-exp(-2pi i x). This formula keeps the original q^(h^2) term: in the normalized physical coefficient its phase cancels exactly against the two shifted factorial phases, as in that theorem. No order-N phase has been dropped from (5). Put E=exp(2pi i x), H=exp(2pi i chi), K=exp(-partial_x f_src). With D=(1-E/H)(1-EH), the source quadratic and its selected root give K=E mu D/(1+E)^2, K^2(1+E)^2+K[(H+H^-1)E^2+2]+(1-E)^2=0. (6) At H=1 this polynomial factors as (K+1)[K(1+E)^2+(1-E)^2]. The SOURCE selects K=tan(pi x)^2, not K=-1. On the fixed high-index interval x>1/4 its selected eigenvalue is simple; the same regular branch continues for small complex chi. Now let T=exp(2pi i t) in (3). Since exp(v)=(E-T)/(ET-1), its epsilon=-1 equation is H=T(E-T)/(ET-1), T^2+E(H-1)T-H=0, (7) with T=1 at H=1. The pure ordered port value is K=(E-T)(1-ET)/[T(1+E)^2]. (8) Eliminating T between (7),(8) gives precisely (6). Its branch agrees at H=1, so (4) and the selected source have the same x derivative. This fixes the derivative, not yet the possible chi-dependent constant. That constant is fixed at x=1/2: both (5) and (3) tend to zero there, because S(1/2,a)=0, g(1/2,t)=0 and g_t(1/2,t)=0. Continue the common high branch to that endpoint. Therefore f_src=f_- EXACTLY on the selected neighborhood, with the original complete mark retained. The positive coupon is the Schwarz conjugate of the negative finite source. Conjugating (3), including i->-i, proves f_src,+ = f_+. In particular (3) is an identification with the selected finite source, not a newly proposed definition of its quantum phase. ## 3. Universal port data with either shaded pairing For arbitrary nearby complex E,R normalize a port to (0,infinity,1,R). Choose a leaf flag Z satisfying Z^2-(1+E)Z+ER=0. (9) In the first half use apex Z, and in the second half apex Z/E. For the hidden pure parameter this means Z=(1+E)/(1+T), R=T(1+E)^2/[E(1+T)^2]=1/(1+K). (10) Use the same four white/completion matrices as in the pure proof: W0=[[1,0],[0,E]], W1=[[1,E-1],[0,E]], W2=[[E-R,R(1-E)],[E-1,1-ER]], W3=[[R,0],[1-E,ER]]. (11) W0,W2 send Z to Z/E by (9). The pure shaded map is S=[[0,-ER],[1,-1-E]], pairing the two shaded triangles within one half. At an odd leaf use instead the ACTUAL cross-half pairings (Z,infinity,1) -> (Z/E,R,0), (Z,R,0) -> (Z/E,infinity,1), whose matrices are A=[[R,-R],[1,ER-1-E]], B=[[R/E-1-1/E,R],[-1,R]]. (12) The second is the inverse of the first with E replaced by E^-1 and R retained. Equation (9) checks both apex correspondences. These are the same local puncture and copy permutations proved by the literal half-disk rotation in [the complete half-partner proof](actual_conway_half_twist_partner_geometry.md). They are not a change of the original main-wire compiler. Crucially, the three odd edge relations hold for INDEPENDENT E,R: W0^-1 B W2^-1 A=identity, W2^-1 B W0^-1 A=identity, W1^-1 B W3^-1 A=identity. (13) These are rational 2-by-2 matrix identities. No complete relation R=(1+E)^2/(4E), unit-modulus condition, or equality of edge angles is needed. The reverse words are their inverses. Thus all odd side and CAP-base edge words remain pointwise trivial, including translations and dilations, throughout the mixed deformation. ## 4. Assemble actual representations for the whole grammar At each leaf use (3),(10), and retain the original multiplication action m and every actual turn/final closing relation. Let F(y,chi)=sum_leaves f_epsilon(x_i(y),chi_i) +sum_products m. At zero it is the pure complete action. Its wire Hessian is therefore negative definite there. The implicit-function theorem gives its one holomorphic critical branch y_*(chi), and phi(chi)=F(y_*(chi),chi). By (4), internal stationarity is exactly the old ordered port cross-ratio matching, with each pure g_x evaluated at its own hidden t_i. The nine prism transport identities, all turn identities and the final cylindrical identities from the pure marked-deformation proof are rational identities, so they continue unchanged. They supply a SINGLE Mobius map on every original white face, even if its deformed triangular pieces are not coplanar. For complex source parameters the construction uses holomorphic charts: the second prism's coordinates invert its angle phases, as in the rational transport identities. The normalized port value R remains the same in its two charts, and the leaf apex pair is specified directly by (9). No antiholomorphic operation on the physical parameters is being used. Three-point charts are regular near the complete anchor; stationarity matches their fourth points. Use the exact pure shaded words at pure leaves and (13) at odd leaves. The actual closed bowtie quotient, with the changed local half-disk pairings, supplies the labeled fundamental-group presentation. All its face-edge words are now identities. Thus the matrices give an ACTUAL representation of the original half-twist partner link group, in a bounded framed neighborhood of its complete holonomy. The small meridian around a main segment still crosses its two white sectors and is W_(j-1)^-1 Wj at that corner. Their derivatives at the common flag are equal, so this meridian is exactly parabolic; it stays nonidentity near completeness. Its peripheral commutant consists of translations. Therefore ALL main cusps remain parabolic, including when the changed pairing joins many old main components into one knot component. ## 5. Exact primitive auxiliary meridians and longitude Define rho=Z/(1+E-Z), Q=(E-Z)/(Z-1). (14) The common longitude is the actual disk path W2^-1 W0. In the selected flag-at-infinity coordinate its multiplier is Q^2. The pure meridian is S^-1, with multiplier rho. At the two half-twist markings the primitive collar paths are mu_geometric,+ = A^-1 W0, mu_geometric,- = W0^-1 B. Direct differentiation at the finite flag Z, taking the reciprocal to get the flag-at-infinity multiplier, gives respectively exp(U_plus)=rho Q, exp(U_minus)=rho/Q, exp(V)=Q^2. (15) These paths reduce at completeness to the primitive translations -2 and 2E, while the disk longitude translates by -2(E+1). Their primitivity and sign were independently checked on the two-rectangle cusp lattice. Thus (15) retains the original integral collar paths; it is not an arbitrary choice of eigenvalue square root. The physical coupon R^-1 uses the geometric positive-diagonal meridian, and R uses the negative-diagonal meridian. This local sign can be checked against the literal threading and Hurwitz convention, without identifying a meridian from a Hessian. Write P for its actual disk-product SL(2) matrix. At the complete negative coupon, the source-selected regular local calculation gives C=I-(P+I)/(1+E), Tr P=-2. (16) Here C is the actual auxiliary meridian from the typed loop [2,1,1,2] followed by R^-1; the preferred PSL longitude is -P. Consequently its complete translation ratio is lambda/mu=1+E, exactly the positive-diagonal primitive path above. Formula (16) and its actual word meaning are proved by the explicit local threading calculation in [the regular character lift](actual_pretzel_mixed_regular_character_lift.md), sections 4--5. They concern one coupon and do not use a cyclic global pretzel gluing. Reversing the retained half twist changes the meridian by one disk longitude, giving the other path. There is also a direct algebraic check against the finite source: eliminating Z from (9) and rho Q=H^-1 gives exactly (6), with its selected complete branch. Thus the actual primitive meridian and the selected physical-color variable agree, beyond the complete translation calibration. Using (10),(14), rho=exp(-2pi i t), Q=exp(-v). Hence for the physical epsilon convention, with all small logs continued from zero, U= -2pi i t-epsilon*V/2 =-2pi i[t-epsilon*v/(2pi i)]=-2pi i chi, V=-2v=-2 partial_chi f_epsilon. (17) Equations (15)--(17) are exact on the connected local branch. In particular the framing correction is a HALF-longitude shear between different cusp lattices, not an assertion that lambda/2 itself is a primitive loop in either lattice. The actual integral paths were fixed before writing their logarithms. ## 6. The full source primitive, regulator and filling equation The envelope rule in the stationary wires now gives (1) for every auxiliary component of the whole source. Unfilled auxiliary colors have chi_i=0. Separate evenness then gives V_i=0 as well, so they remain parabolic. All main components were treated in section 4. Put G=2pi i phi, retaining the known real Cartan/framing constant. Then dG=(1/2)sum_i V_i dU_i. (18) Locally the change in the leaf primitive is explicitly G_epsilon=G_pure-epsilon*V^2/8. (19) Its derivative is exactly the shear U_new=U_pure-epsilon V/2. Thus the quadratic framing term required by the odd cusp is PRESENT in the selected action, rather than appended after a volume comparison. The original SL(2) pivot spin is retained when taking eigenlogs; (1),(17) use centered PSL(2) similarity multipliers, the squares of those eigenvalues, as in the general transfer theorem. At the complete point Im G(0)=2pi phi(0) is the ACTUAL half-twist partner volume by the complete geometry theorem. The same oriented fundamental-chain boundary calculation therefore gives the absolute regulator identity Vol(rho_chi)=Im G-(1/2)sum_i Re U_i Im V_i. (20) This uses the actual nearby representation just constructed, its primitive markings, and its complete geometric anchor. It does not compare unrelated Bloch cycles by equal regulators. For independently sufficiently long fixed signed integral full twists on any chosen auxiliary subset, the original transfer saddle phi_i(chi)+(pi i/p_i)(chi_i-1)=0 is precisely U_i+p_i V_i=-2pi i. The unfilled peripheral groups remain parabolic. The general geometric completion theorem therefore makes this actual nearby representation the smooth complete hyperbolic holonomy of the correctly marked filled topology. At its saddle, (20) equals 2pi Re[phi(chi)+(pi i/2)sum_i(chi_i-1)^2/p_i]. (21) This completion uses the ACTUAL ODD-LINK primitive basis. In the hidden pure variables its equation reads U_pure+(p_i-epsilon_i/2)V=-2pi i. Multiplying it by two would give the pure-link primitive pair (2,2p_i-epsilon_i) with right-hand side -4pi i, not the smooth primitive 2pi equation. Consequently the half-integer shear must not be replaced by an assertion about ordinary rational Dehn filling of the pure partner. It relates local marked representation branches of different face-paired topologies. Whenever the separately proved odd-source whole-color gap and exact complex packet supply the analytic transfer hypotheses, (21) is therefore the FULL original invariant's actual filled hyperbolic volume limit. For retained C(FG) these are the current source inputs; the stronger all-color theorem does not include the small C(h^3) exception merely because the geometric construction also works there. Finally choose one of the constructive one-main-component patterns from the complete half-partner theorem and fill all auxiliary circles. The resulting topology is a KNOT for every integral full-twist tuple. Thus, with the stated original-source inputs, this geometry applies to arbitrarily branching long-filled knot families, rather than only links or a fixed-width twist/pretzel subclass. Audit: [generic odd transport, actual peripheral flags and selected-source shear](../experiments/audit_actual_odd_conway_marked_peripheral_deformation.py) and [results](../experiments/actual_odd_conway_marked_peripheral_deformation_results.json). The finite audit checks the three odd edge words over Q(E,R), both peripheral commutators, all apex and primitive multiplier formulas, the actual meridian/source resultants at both signs, and the exact implicit generating-function derivatives. No complete-R specialization or numerical phase samples are used. The odd-link construction uses its own primitive filling equation, not a rational filling of the pure link. title: Odd half twists in the full Conway Newton source
text: # Odd half twists in the full Conway Newton source 29 October 2026. A literal half twist has an explicit triangular transport matrix in the FULL Newton algebra. It yields a new uniform Newton-coordinate bound for every auxiliary-color alias. At complete colors, the already selected local coherent coefficient and a concave global envelope prove the original-source asymptotic for arbitrary fixed half-twist patterns in every retained robust Conway factor. This note concerns exact transport and complete colors. The later [supporting-plane theorem](actual_odd_conway_uniform_mixed_source_gap.md) supplies the whole mixed-color gap for C(FG), with both children robust; it excludes C(A). Neither result by itself supplies a long-filling theorem. The changed source is not obtained by dropping phases from the positive source. ## 1. Exact full-algebra half-twist transport Use the original pair algebra H_N, actual turn T, crossing R, and Newton basis Bhat_v of the [pure auxiliary-color theorem](actual_pure_conway_auxiliary_color_leaf.md). Put D=N-1, q=exp(pi i/N), x=q^D=-q^-1, kappa=q^(D^2/2), with its original unreset half-Cartan mark. For epsilon=+1 or -1 define T_epsilon(f)=T(R^epsilon T(f)). Then, for EVERY 0<=v<=D, exactly in the full repeated-root algebra, T_epsilon(Bhat_v) =kappa^epsilon (-1)^v sum_(r=0)^v q^[epsilon v(r+1)] [v choose r]_q Bhat_r, [v choose r]_q=s_v/[s_r s_(v-r)]>0. (1) In particular the actual odd leaf is h_j^epsilon=T(R^epsilon L_j)=T_epsilon(h_j). (2) Proof. The literal continuant source identity gives T_-(Bhat_v)=kappa^-1 f_v. One can also obtain it by comparing the FULL two-band formula for every actual L_j with the pure-color formula: the L_j form a basis, so this comparison proves the linear identity on the entire algebra, not only its values at the nodes. The independently proved finite continuant expansion is f_v=x^v sum_(r=0)^v (Q^-v;Q)_r Q^r P_r/F_r^3, P_r=q^(r^2) B_r, F_r=(Q;Q)_r, Q=q^2. Insert s_r^2=(-1)^r q^[-r(r+1)]F_r^2 and (Q^-v;Q)_r=(-1)^r Q^[-vr+r(r-1)/2]F_v/F_(v-r). The coefficient of Bhat_r becomes x^v q^[r^2-2vr] {v choose r}_Q =(-1)^v q^[-v(r+1)] [v choose r]_q. This proves (1) for epsilon=-1, including v>D/2 and every normal coordinate. The actual inverse crossings are coefficient-conjugate polynomials in the real Newton basis: their nodal values are reciprocal unit phases and their first logarithmic derivatives are purely imaginary. Uniqueness of Hermite interpolation proves the full polynomial identity. The turn reverses this real basis, so it commutes with coefficient conjugation. Conjugating the preceding formula proves (1) for epsilon=+1. No Hermitian positivity is being asserted. ## 2. A uniform full-Newton bound for the actual color alias Write the exact pure split h_j=C_j+A_j. Every A_j has support v>=ceil(N/2), and each of its coefficients has modulus at most N/2. More precisely its support is v>=N-h for a low complementary color 1<=h<=floor(N/2). The actual half-twist alias is T_epsilon(A_j). Equation (1) gives the exact coefficientwise upper bound |[Bhat_r]T_epsilon(A_j)| <=(N/2) sum_(v=max(r,N-h))^D s_v/[s_r s_(v-r)]. (3) Let J(t)=integral_0^t log(2sin(pi u))du. The endpoint-uniform factorial estimate then gives, uniformly over ALL physical colors and all Newton indices, |[Bhat_r]T_epsilon(A_j)| <=poly(N) exp[N k(r/N)], k(u)=-2J(u/2), 0<=u<=1. (4) Here and below a zero coefficient causes no difficulty. Indeed the largest possible exponent in (3), after relaxing its lower bound to v/N>=max(u,1/2), is max_(w>=max(u,1/2)) [J(w)-J(u)-J(w-u)]. Its derivative in w is log[sin(pi w)/sin(pi(w-u))]. The maximum is at w=(1+u)/2. Reflection J(1-a)=-J(a), followed by duplication J(2a)=2J(a)-2J(1/2-a), reduces its value to -2J(u/2). The argument includes u=0,1 by continuity; the exact factorial errors are O(log N) uniformly there. The maximum of k is at u=1/3 and equals v_3/pi, where v_3 is the regular ideal tetrahedron volume. On u>=1/2 it is strictly decreasing, since k'(u)=-log(2sin(pi u/2))<0. In particular k(1/2)=-2J(1/4). This is a coordinate bound for the original normal source, so it may be propagated through the positive Newton product and the actual index-reversing turn. It is not a bound in a nodal quotient or an unspecified operator norm. There is a useful exact small-color estimate as well. Set v=N-t. Root factorial reflection gives [N-t choose r]_q=[t+r-1 choose t-1]_q <=binomial(t+r-1,t-1) <=binomial(N-1,t-1). (5) The middle inequality follows from the nonnegative coefficients of the ordinary Gaussian polynomial at a unit root. Thus for 1<=h<=floor(N/2), every alias coefficient is at most (Nh/2) binomial(N-1,h-1). (6) In a corridor h<=delta N, delta<1/2, this costs at most poly(N) exp[N H(delta)], where H(delta)=-delta log delta-(1-delta)log(1-delta)->0. For h=1 each transport coefficient actually has modulus one: [D choose r]_q=1. Thus an alias can occupy ALL Newton coordinates, including their normals; it is no longer square-zero under products. A sharper color-dependent envelope is obtained by keeping chi=h/N in (3): it is k_chi(u)=J(u+chi)-J(u)-J(chi), u<=1-2chi, k_chi(u)=-2J(u/2), u>=1-2chi. (7) These expressions agree at the joining point. This is an upper envelope, not an assertion that the signed alias attains it. ## 3. Complete odd coefficients: the exact selected source At j=N there is no alias. The old finite original-source transform gives, with M=floor(D/2), h_N^-=exp(-i pi D/4) sum_(r=0)^M a_(N,r) W_(N,r) Bhat_r, a_(N,r)=N^2 s_(2r)/s_r^4. (8) For reference W is fixed by the literal finite sums, not chosen as a formal recurrence solution: A_r=sum_(v=r)^M Q^(-vr) F_(2v)/(F_v^3 F_(v-r)), D_r=Q^(-r^2)F_(2r)/F_r^3, W_(N,r)=kappa^-1 exp(i pi D/4) (A_r/D_r)/[(-1)^r q^(r(r+1))]. The [selected high-index theorem](actual_pretzel_coherent_inner_gauss_elimination.md) proves, uniformly on compact subintervals 1/4<u<1/2, W_(N,r)=sqrt(sin(pi u))exp(i pi u/2)[1+O(N^-1)], u=r/N. (9) The [actual quarter-transition theorem](actual_complete_circle_boundary_packet.md) extends this same nonzero selected expression to a fixed neighborhood of u=1/4. Its exponentially accurate source transport includes the initial second channel and all coupling errors. Distinct recurrence roots alone would not justify this extension. At ALL indices the [two-branch source bound](actual_pretzel_all_index_backward_envelope.md) gives |W_(N,r)|<=poly(N)exp[N E(pi r/N)], where E(pi u)=g(1/4)-g(u), 0<=u<=1/4; E(pi u)=0, 1/4<=u<=1/2; g(u)=J(2u)-4J(u). (10) The first identity is exact because g'(u)=2log cot(pi u). Consequently the full coefficient envelope for a complete odd leaf is the CONCAVE function g_tilde(u)=g(max(u,1/4)), 0<=u<=1/2. (11) It is constant below 1/4 and agrees with g above it; its derivatives join at zero. The positive-half-twist formulas are the coefficient conjugates of (8)--(9), with the same envelope. This is a coherent coefficient theorem; termwise absolute values in its original inner factorial sum would give a different bound. ## 4. Arbitrary fixed half-twist patterns at complete colors Fix any retained cylindrical robust factor and independently choose epsilon_l in {0,+1,-1} at each of its individual leaves. Replace its actual h_N leaf by T(R^epsilon_l L_N), leaving every product, turn, mark and external normalization unchanged. Let Z_N^epsilon be this literal raw closed source and Z_N^0 its pure counterpart. Let x_(l,*) be the unique complete positive maximizing leaf labels. The [strict-quarter theorem](actual_conway_strict_leaf_quarter_bound.md) gives x_(l,*)>1/4 for every leaf of every such factor. Then Z_N^epsilon =exp[(i pi D/4)sum_l epsilon_l] a_E(0) N^(3/2) exp[N phi_E(0)] product_(epsilon_l!=0) [sqrt(sin(pi x_(l,*))) exp(-i epsilon_l pi x_(l,*)/2)] *[1+O(N^-1)]. (12) Here a_E(0)>0 and phi_E(0) are the original pure-source normalization and action from the finite Conway packet. The displayed leading coefficient is nonzero. Both parities, every normal direction and every fixed mixture of half-twist signs are included. Proof of the global source claim. Replace g by g_tilde only at the odd-marked leaves in the complete variational action. Each retained product action m is concave, and the support polytope is convex. The resulting majorant action is therefore concave. By the strict quarter theorem it agrees with the pure action on a neighborhood of its strict complete maximizer. That point is still stationary with negative definite Hessian in the free wire coordinates, hence is its unique GLOBAL maximizer. A second maximum would give a constant segment through that strictly concave neighborhood. The complement of any fixed small central window therefore has a strict exponential gap for the majorant. Equations (8),(10), the uniform factorial estimates and the polynomial state count bound the whole original complex sum there, before any cancellation. On the central window every odd coefficient has (9), with its original common phase in (8). The resulting smooth nonzero multiplier of the positive summand is exactly the product in (12), evaluated at the critical point. The already proved lattice Laplace argument, or its real-parameter version with this smooth complex amplitude, proves (12). There is no assumption of positivity of the odd source. Thus its exponential rate is the same complete geometric action 2pi phi_E(0) as the pure factor. Identifying this with the half-twist partner's actual volume also uses its literal shaded-face gluing; volume invariance is not a substitute for the quantum proof above. ## 5. What is still needed for odd-coupon long fillings The mixed half-twist CORE has its [proved uniform envelope g_tilde](actual_pretzel_global_core_spectral_gap.md), including colors outside a fixed corridor, by the actual selected mixed-source recurrence. Its high-index physical-color packet is also known. Equations (3)--(7) bound the changed alias in the correct FULL Newton coordinates. The subsequent [supporting-plane theorem](actual_odd_conway_uniform_mixed_source_gap.md) proves its exponential gap after arbitrary C(FG) composition, with both children robust. The minimal C(A) remains outside that estimate. In particular the alias is not confined to output indices above one half and products containing two aliases no longer vanish. The pure source's square-zero seed argument cannot be reused. The separately proved [complex packet](actual_odd_conway_complex_color_packet.md) and [actual marked deformation](actual_odd_conway_marked_peripheral_deformation.md) now complete the required interfaces for the [long-filled knot and link theorem](actual_odd_conway_long_filling_volume.md). Audit: [full physical transport, alias bounds and complete-source calibration](../experiments/audit_actual_odd_conway_newton_transport.py). The finite transport and alias checks are diagnostics for the exact formulas. They do not establish the asymptotic estimates by sampling.

title: A whole mixed-color gap for arbitrary robust odd-coupon Conway factors
text: # A whole mixed-color gap for arbitrary robust odd-coupon Conway factors 29 October 2026. For every retained C(FG), with F and G robust, arbitrary fixed pure or signed odd-half-twist coupons have a uniform gap for ALL actual alias sectors and for the entire physical color complement. The estimate permits arbitrarily many aliases and arbitrary fixed turns and branching. It uses supporting planes of the actual concave source action, with the full Newton alias profile. The minimal retained factor C(A), A=h^3, is EXCLUDED from this theorem. Its complete odd-coupon asymptotic is already proved, but the stronger leaf bound used here does not hold for it. No claim for its whole mixed-color source follows by ignoring that exception. ## 1. Exact changed source and statement Fix a literal C(FG) and a choice epsilon_l in {0,+1,-1} at each individual leaf. The actual mixed leaf is h_j^epsilon=T(R^epsilon L_j), 1<=j<=N. All turns, products, pivots and the original marked cylindrical closure are unchanged. Write its exact full-algebra decomposition as C_j^epsilon+A_j^epsilon, obtained by applying the half-twist transport to the pure core and alias separately. At epsilon=0 this is the pure split. Let Z_N(j) be the original closed source and Z_N^core(j) the circuit using only the C_j^epsilon. Let F0 be the complete PURE maximizing action. The [complete odd-source theorem](actual_odd_conway_newton_transport.md) already proves the nonzero complete asymptotic with this same F0. There is gamma>0 such that, uniformly over the ENTIRE physical color cube, for all sufficiently large N, |Z_N(j)-Z_N^core(j)| <= exp[N(F0-gamma)]. (1) For every fixed sufficiently small delta>0 there is gamma_delta>0 such that max_(some N-j_l>=delta N) |Z_N(j)| <=exp[N(F0-gamma_delta)]. (2) Both parities and composite levels are included. The expression, coupon signs and delta are fixed before N tends to infinity. These are whole original-source bounds, including all normal coordinates; no semisimple quotient or positive-matrix replacement is used. ## 2. A stricter leaf interval for every C(FG) Use the port variables of the [strict-quarter theorem](actual_conway_strict_leaf_quarter_bound.md). At every proper robust macro-port of this CLOSED factor, they obey 0<X<1, 0<Y<1. At a proper seed A=h^3 its three leaf cotangents all equal X, and its port invariant is Y=1/(4X^2-1). Therefore Y<1 gives 1/sqrt(2)<X<1, 1/4<a_l< a0:=atan(sqrt(2))/pi <1/3 (3) for EVERY complete maximizing leaf label a_l. This is why both root children must be robust: C(A) instead has X=1/2 and its leaves lie at atan(2)/pi, outside (3). ## 3. One supporting plane dominates an alias at every output Put g(a)=J(2a)-4J(a), k(u)=-2J(u/2), 0<=u<=1, J(u)=integral_0^u log(2sin(pi t))dt. The new full-Newton transport theorem gives the global alias rate k. For every a in [1/4,a0] its tangent to g satisfies the UNIFORM strict inequality k(u) <= g(a)+g'(a)(u-a)-c0 for all 0<=u<=1, (4) c0=g(1/4)-(3/4)log2=2Catalan/pi-(3/4)log2>0. Here is a direct proof, including both ends of the output interval. Write s=g'(a)=2log cot(pi a), so -log2<=s<=0. The function k is strictly concave in the interior, with k'(u)=-log(2sin(pi u/2)). Its slope decreases from +infinity to -log2. The maximizer u(a) of k(u)-su lies in [1/3,1], and is characterized by k'(u)=s, with u=1 at s=-log2. The minimum tangent gap is I(a)=g(a)+s(u(a)-a)-k(u(a)). On the interior, I'(a)=g''(a)(u(a)-a)<0, since u(a)>=1/3>a. Continuity extends this monotonicity to the endpoints. Thus I(a)>=I(a0)=g(a0)-(1-a0)log2. Since g' decreases from zero to -log2 on [1/4,a0], integration gives g(a0)>=g(1/4)-(a0-1/4)log2. This proves (4). For an explicit elementary positive certificate, the alternating Catalan series gives Catalan>1-1/9=8/9. Using pi<22/7 and log2<7/10, c0>56/99-21/40=161/3960>0. (5) No numerical optimizer or special-function decimal is needed to establish the margin. ## 4. Sum the source supporting planes before estimating states For an odd coupon its all-color core has the uniform upper rate g_tilde(u)=g(max(u,1/4)), 0<=u<=1/2, (6) by the [actual mixed-source recurrence](actual_pretzel_global_core_spectral_gap.md). In that recurrence's normalization, the modulus of the actual Newton core coefficient is exactly N^2 s_(2r)/s_r^4 * |V_(h,r)|. Its complete factorial rate is g, so the recurrence bound adds E and g+E is precisely g_tilde. No coefficientwise domination is inferred by applying an oscillatory transform to the pure core inequality. The error beyond this rate is uniformly o(N), including all colors and both index endpoints. A pure core has rate at most g(u), hence also at most g_tilde(u). At a complete maximizing leaf a_l in (3), concavity gives g_tilde(u)<=g(a_l)+g'(a_l)(u-a_l). (7) For every alias, the [full Newton transport bound](actual_odd_conway_newton_transport.md) gives rate at most k(u) on its ENTIRE range 0<=u<=1, so (4) applies. A pure alias has polynomial coefficients and rate zero; it obeys the same upper bound because k(u)>=0 on [0,1]. Every actual positive Newton multiplication has action m on max(x,y)<=z<=x+y<=1. This domain is convex, m is concave, and at its complete strict state w_* its tangent gives m(w)<=m(w_*)+grad m(w_*) dot(w-w_*). (8) Expand the exact original source according to its alias subset S. Its state support may allow alias leaf outputs above one half, but every product still lies in the SAME domain in (8). The actual turn equations and final closing input relation are the same affine relations as before. Thus one may add (4),(7),(8) for any one of these expanded states, even when it lies outside the pure-leaf polytope. All linear terms cancel by stationarity of the original pure action in its free wire coordinates. The resulting upper rate is F0-|S|c0. (9) This is the essential reason the argument handles multiple aliases. No assertion that their products vanish is made; indeed those products generally do not vanish after an odd half twist. At finite N use the actual scaled wire labels r/N, which remain in the domains of all the supporting inequalities. Their turn and closing equations have right-hand side 1-1/N. Thus the cancellation of the fixed tangent linear terms has only O(1/N) error; multiplying by N costs O(1). The endpoint-uniform factorial errors cost O(log N). The fixed tree has only polynomially many Newton states and finitely many alias subsets. Their uniformly subexponential coefficient factors can therefore be absorbed into half the fixed margin in (9). Summing all nonempty S proves (1). ## 5. The complete physical color complement Replace g by g_tilde at all leaves to get a convenient common majorant for the all-core circuit. It is concave and agrees with the pure action near its strict complete optimizer, by (3). Consequently that optimizer is its unique global maximum with value F0. Outside a small fixed neighborhood W of that state the majorant has a strict compactness gap, uniformly over all colors. The finite physical supports have the same inequalities and affine relations with O(1/N) shifts. Every convergent sequence of finite states therefore limits to the stated compact support. The same outside-W gap, slightly reduced, holds for all sufficiently large N. Choose beta<1/2 larger than every leaf coordinate throughout W. For an odd coupon, the actual mixed-source theorem gives, uniformly for delta N<=h<=floor((N-1)/2) and r<=beta N, log|core_coefficient_(N,h,r)| <=N[g_tilde(r/N)-gamma(delta,beta)+o(1)], (10) where gamma(delta,beta)>0. It retains the actual terminal source, both recurrence branches, and repeated-root endpoint colors. For a pure coupon the exact factorial formula gives the analogous strict loss from g_chi(u)=g(u)-[J(u-chi)+J(u+chi)-2J(u)], chi=h/N>=delta, uniformly near its interior complete coordinate; if h>r its coefficient is zero. A physical color j<=floor(N/2) has zero core and needs no further core estimate. If some deficit is at least delta N, every all-core state either lies outside W and loses the majorant gap, or lies inside W and loses the positive amount in (10) at that leaf. Uniformity and the polynomial state count prove a strict whole-core complement gap. Combine it with (1) to obtain (2). ## 6. Scope of the advance This proves the full physical color-gap hypothesis needed for long-filling transfer for arbitrary fixed coupon patterns on C(FG). The complete signed source is already nonzero by its separately proved local coherent amplitude and global plateau bound. The [exact finite analytic packet](actual_odd_conway_complex_color_packet.md) for these CHANGED mixed coupons and the [marked odd deformation](actual_odd_conway_marked_peripheral_deformation.md) are proved separately. Literal connectivity is supplied by the [half-partner theorem](actual_conway_half_twist_partner_geometry.md). Together they give the [long-filled knot and link equality](actual_odd_conway_long_filling_volume.md). None of these interfaces is obtained by substituting the unchanged pure colored packet for the actual odd source. Audit: [exact port, tangent and transport certificates](../experiments/audit_actual_odd_conway_uniform_mixed_source_gap.py). The all-expression proof is the supporting-plane argument above, not an extrapolation from finitely sampled source values. The mixed-source gap requires a separately established changed complex packet and marked geometric deformation.

title: The marked logarithmic class of the source-preserving odd form
status: Marked logarithmic periods and the finite-q integer noncancellation criterion
text: # The marked logarithmic class of the source-preserving odd form 30 October 2026. The underlying odd framing form is the pullback of an explicit integral logarithmic class. Keeping q0 gives a stronger two-integer noncancellation criterion. Neither calculation assigns those integers to the original quantum cycle or removes its coherent base weight. ## 1. The actual marked functions Use the fixed original cut and the ACTUAL routed first head of [the source-preserving odd-period theorem](actual_source_preserving_odd_framing_period.md). The recorded route and its inverse remain in the source. In its complete parabolic frame write F(r,s)=[[r,1-r],[s,-s]], A=(1+s)^-1, mu_e=I+c[[b,-b^2],[1,-b]], c!=0, R=r-sb, p_e=(R-1)/R, k-1=(c/s)R(1-R), q0=exp(pi i/N), N>=2. (1) Here mu_e is the actual Hurwitz-transformed meridian, not the unrouted edge meridian. The constant c is nonzero exactly when this routed first-head position detects the residual framing. The underlying original marked density is Omega_src=(c_D/s)dr wedge dLog A, c_D!=0, independent of r,s. (2) Work on its regular framed locus where s!=0,-1 and R!=0,1, with any additional source divisors also removed. Define the units f=1-A=s/(1+s), g_0=R, g_1=R-1, Psi=(f,k-1): framed locus -> (C*)^2. (3) These are algebraic functions of the ACTUAL marked physical clocks and relative wave momentum. For example R=1/(1-p_e). They do not depend on logarithm branches or on reparametrizing the same framed point. They do depend on the chosen cut, route and orientations; changing those data is an actual source adapter, not an invariance assertion about (3). The principal odd form computed from the literal two bands is (p_e^-1-p_e)Omega_src =c_D ds wedge d(k-1)/[(1+s)s(k-1)] =c_D dlog f wedge dlog(k-1). (4) Thus (4) is precisely the pullback of dlog z1 wedge dlog z2 through Psi, with its original nonzero scalar and orientation. This is a logarithmic class on the FRAMING orbit. It is not a Bloch regulator, and it must not be substituted for the separately proved Bloch-regulator value of the actual three-manifold. ## 2. Closed-cycle pairing, proved directly Let Gamma be a compact closed oriented two-cycle in the displayed regular locus, or a finite sum of smooth such cycles. For two nonvanishing functions u,v there, write dlog u=dlog|u|+i alpha_u, where alpha_u is the globally defined closed argument one-form. Every term of dlog u wedge dlog v containing a modulus derivative is exact: log|u| and log|v| are single-valued real functions, and the argument one-forms are closed. Its closed-cycle integral is therefore -integral_Gamma alpha_u wedge alpha_v. The map (u/|u|,v/|v|):Gamma->S1 x S1 has an integer degree n. One elementary description is the signed number of inverse images of a regular point after subdividing the cycle. Local change of variables and cancellation along paired subdivision edges give integral_Gamma alpha_u wedge alpha_v=(2pi)^2 n. Consequently integral_Gamma dlog u wedge dlog v=(2pi i)^2 n. (5) The same argument extends additively to integral cycles. In particular the period of (4) is (2pi i)^2 c_D deg(arg Psi). This proves the normalization without selecting a geometric cycle or citing a cohomological comparison theorem. For an unramified finite cover of degree d over such a cycle, its FULL transferred cycle pairs with the pulled-back form as d times the original period. This follows by summing the local sheets in the integral. A zero pairing therefore stays zero under transfer. One selected lift instead requires its actual descent and multiplicity; the covering map alone does not select an original nonzero period. This statement concerns the specified transported source cycle, not an assertion about character polynomials of arbitrary manifold covers. ## 3. The retained q0 detects two integer classes Keep the actual finite quantum coefficient in the UNDERLYING rational symbol form, and put Omega_q=(p_e^-1-q0 p_e)Omega_src, lambda=(r/s)dlog A. Since d lambda=Omega_src/c_D and dR=dr-b ds, direct substitution of p_e gives the exact identity Omega_q=(1-q0)c_D d lambda +c_D dlog f wedge [dlog g_1+q0 dlog g_0]. (6) No primitive is dropped on a relative chain. On a CLOSED Gamma, however, the first term integrates to zero. Define the two integers n_j=(2pi i)^-2 integral_Gamma dlog f wedge dlog g_j. Then integral_Gamma Omega_q=(2pi i)^2 c_D(n_1+q0 n_0). (7) The argument of q0 lies strictly between zero and pi. Thus (7) vanishes if and only if n_0=n_1=0. More quantitatively, for a nonzero integer pair, |n_1+q0 n_0|>=sin(pi/N)>=2/N. (8) If n_0!=0 use its imaginary part; otherwise |n_1|>=1. The last bound follows from concavity of sine on [0,pi/2]. This covers both parities and all N>=2. No restriction on the relative sizes or signs of the two integers is needed. At q0=1 the two classes combine: because k-1=-c g_0 g_1/s and dlog f wedge dlog s=0, deg(arg Psi)=n_0+n_1. The finite-q criterion is strictly sharper: opposite nonzero integers may have zero classical total degree, while (7) is still nonzero with only polynomial loss. This remains a criterion for the stated rational SYMBOL form, not an assertion that a finite quantum packet has already been replaced by it. ## 4. The original source still requires relative transport The odd-period theorem proves the unchanged scalar exactly as Tr(e_t C0(T1-q0T_-1))/kappa_N(t). The original scalar density (2) contains a marked row 1/N; this new source has the additional base weight N beta_a(t)/kappa_N(t), with its original finite head sum. It cannot be absorbed into c_D as A varies. A legitimate first-cut Gaussian retains its own nonzero factor; an arbitrary replacement by a closed two-cycle with constant weight is not licensed by (5).
