Choose M=floor(N^(1-alpha)), with max(epsilon,C_1*epsilon/q)<alpha<1. Then the far normal edge has the strict bound |Atilde_N|<=|N^(C_upper)G_N(u_F)| exp[-(q*alpha-C_1*epsilon+o(1))M log N]. (20) Throughout that collar the additional normal cost is exp(o(N)); finite-height connector lengths and cotangent bounds add only polynomial factors. Estimate (20) compares to the retained bulk source itself, not to an assumed volume bound for it. Arbitrarily fixed bounded normal jets obey the same kind of bound on slightly smaller contours by Cauchy's formula after pole cancellation. One may allow offset size L=o(M), at the additional cost exp[O((L+1)log N)]: the same regularized Gamma calculation and bounded-height estimate use |Im s|=O(L+1). In particular the small thickenings in Section 5 with beta>alpha do not remove (20). This extension concerns a single common radial normal and its specified small offsets, not arbitrary nested scales. The actual conclusion is a uniform active-cluster OUTWARD quantum collar for every physical face, whenever the inactive bulk allowance is available. The original residues and all upper normalizers are retained, and the selected outside cotangent integers have exactly zero residue. It does not glue different face collars, prove a global mass bound, or classify every nested tangential escape. Section 7 supplies the finite-N whole-packet estimate; no scalar noncancellation or full volume theorem is inferred. [Independent face audit](../experiments/audit_actual_physical_face_outward_action.py): 790 proper physical faces of seven original signed words, 4877 exact maximal minors, primitive outward vectors and 28 radial phase checks. The all-word conclusions use the proofs above, not this finite census. The supplementary complex checks in [the two-neighbor audit](../experiments/audit_actual_regular_head_face_cot_filling.py) also pass nine normalized Gamma-factor checks, eighteen exact upper window reflections, and three mixed-direction pole cancellations. The latter use a cluster with q=2*(-1)+(-1)*(-3)=1, so an individual factor goes toward a pole while the COMPLETE product has the stated descending logarithmic coefficient. These are checks of exact local identities, not substitutes for the uniform proof or global source gluing.

title: Independent audit of the physical-face outward action theorem
text: # Independent audit of the physical-face outward action theorem 28 October 2026. This note checks the local hypotheses and formulas of [the physical-face theorem](actual_physical_face_outward_action.md), including its quantum Gamma packet. The remaining global cycle, gluing and knot-volume estimate are not established here. The theorem concerns a NONEMPTY one-component braid word. The empty one-head unknot has a constant factorial density and zero radial q; it is an irrelevant but literal exception to an unrestricted phrase "every braid word." ## Algebra and face geometry I independently re-derived the signed head gathering from the actual negative-root chirp. The head exponents are even, and each independent total transfer has exponent minus one. The transfer coordinates are integrally free for a one-component closure, with one additional base color; this also follows from the separate source lattice proof in [the transfer-face note](actual_transfer_only_face_downhill_patch.md). The interval-column proof of total unimodularity is valid. After restricting to selected arc rows, successive row differences produce at most one positive and one negative entry per column. Expansion or zero column sums give determinants in {0,+1,-1}. Unit transfer rows and upper inequality signs preserve the assertion. Consequently the physical vertices are binary and independent active rows give honest affine unimodular source coordinates. The parity argument proves q_F!=0 whenever a transfer endpoint is active. With no active transfer, physical support forces a zero head to be an over-to-under minimum and a unit head to be an under-to-over maximum; hence q_F=-2 times the sum of active inward normals, which cannot vanish by strict interior feasibility. The k=1 constraints cannot be facets because they force independent head endpoint equalities. The remaining facet cases and the codimension-at-least-two halfspace construction are correct. A primitive normal direction with selected inward slope -1 exists, so its positive integer source normal is invalid for all tangent values, including complex ones. ## Action, marks and the exact quantum packet Both endpoints of I(s)=integral_0^s log|2sin(pi t)|dt have the SAME coefficient delta*v*log(delta). No upper-end sign is missing. Integer cardinal and full-Psi norm characters have exactly constant modulus along the prescribed real displacements. Thus their leading marks do not reverse the strict far-normal height drop. The statement is correctly a face-to-far-edge estimate; it does not assert monotonicity at every point of a general interpolating sweep. I checked the whole factorial factorization Fhat(s)=(-h)^s Gamma(s+1) A_N(s). Its branch is the original Gaussian branch. The 1/t coefficient in LogGamma(t+s+1)-LogGamma(t-s)-(2s+1)log t cancels exactly, leaving a summable O((|s|+1)^3/t^2) error. This proves the stated zero-free A_N and inverse bound on a fixed sufficiently small O(N) disk. The exact upper reflection retains both N=F_d and its chirp; the cardinal orientations exchange correctly under reflection. For negative normal arguments, Gamma reflection and the COMPLETE window leave nonnegative powers of sin(pi*s). This cancels the negative-integer Gamma poles before estimating. Positive arguments use ordinary Stirling. Summing the signed slopes r_i beta_i gives exactly q_F(v_F), and hence the displayed leading term -q M log(N/(M+1)). Bounded offsets cost O(log N); smaller growing offsets cost the stated O((L+1)log N). Upper endpoint powers N^c are retained explicitly. No estimate of separated polar cardinal modes has been substituted for the complete packet. ## Scope required for a global use The exact inactive-bulk allowance (18) is a substantive hypothesis. It is not supplied merely by bounds on B and 1-B in a continued chart near an outside-band integer divisor. The note states this correctly. Retained inactive mode exponentials belong in that bulk reference; their wrong-side growth cannot be omitted. The zero-residue normal extension is exact after re-presenting the COMPLETE finite residue source in the chosen unimodular chart. It is not a pointwise replacement of the old cotangent product. Partial chart transitions, valid physical residues swept in a larger move, side curtains, repeated visits and escaping tangential regions still need the separate global control identified in the original note. The [exact audit](../experiments/audit_actual_physical_face_outward_action.py) checks seven signed braid words, 790 proper physical faces, 4,877 maximal minors and 28 logarithmic phase diagnostics. These finite tests supplement the uniform witness and face-enumeration proof.

title: An ordinary pivotal cap coherently collapses reassociation to one angle weight
text: # An ordinary pivotal cap coherently collapses reassociation to one angle weight 29 October 2026. Contracting the original ordinary pivotal cap with the actual three-head reassociation packet annihilates every middle input except the top index d=N-1. The surviving map is a phase times weighted truncated addition. In the source-fixing quarter-factorial metric its squared coefficient is exactly ONE positive affine-angle weight. All intermediate terms have been summed coherently first. The inverse-packet/cup move has an equally explicit bottom-index selection and the same one-weight energy. These are exact local operator/source identities for arbitrary exteriors, not merely scalar normalizations. The marked cap is different: its complete retained packet is given below and is not replaced by the ordinary cap. ## 1. Actual packet, source and metric conventions Put q=exp(pi*i/N), Q=q^2, d=N-1, x=-q^-1=q^d, N>=2, F_a=(Q;Q)_a and s_a=|F_a|. Keep the original finite transfers C'_12|a,b>=sum_r x^-r [b+r choose r]_Q |a-r,b+r>, (C'_12)^-1|a,b> =sum_r (-1)^r Q^[r(r-1)/2]x^-r [b+r choose r]_Q |a-r,b+r>, (1) 0<=r<=min(a,d-b). These are the original nilpotent Euler matrices and their full inverse, including strict head endpoints. The actual packet is A=(C'_23)^-1 C'_12. (2) Its full entry, derived by its UNIQUE intermediate state, is |a,b,c> -> |a-r,b+r-s,c+s>, A=(-1)^s Q^[s(s-1)/2]x^[-(r+s)] [b+r choose r]_Q[c+s choose s]_Q, (3) r<=min(a,d-b), s<=min(b+r,d-c), r,s>=0. The normalized original ordinary cap and cup are ellhat= sqrt(N) ell, ellhat|u,v>=(xQ)^-u/sqrt(N) delta_(u+v,d), phat=p/N^(3/2), phat=sum_(u=0)^d x^(u-d)/sqrt(N) |u,d-u>. (4) Indeed the literal original turns are ell|u,v>=x^v g_u/N delta_(u+v,d), p_(u,v)=N x^-v delta, g_u=x^-d Q^-u. Thus(4) retains the original pivot, not a cap with a favorable substituted phase. The normalized cap and cup both have norm1. Literal ell and p are restored by their stated N powers; all external Cartan/framing/peripheral lines are unchanged. Use the PHYSICAL gauge and squared metric B_a=L_a^-1/4, h_a=B_a^2=sqrt(N)/s_a, L_a=s_a^2/N. (5) Root reflection gives B_a B_(d-a)=1. These original turns are fixed by B on paired legs. Hats on maps below mean conjugation by B on their physical input/output legs. This is not the length normalization b_l=B_l/D_l and is not the different tame-current metric L^(1/2). ## 2. Exact cap selection, including the coherent root sum Define K=(ellhat_12 tensor I_3) A. For every physical input, K|a,b,c>=0 unless b=d and a+c<=d. (6) In the surviving case n=a+c, K|a,d,c>=N^-1/2 (-1)^a Q^[a(a-1)/2-a]x^(-2a) [n choose a]_Q |n>. (7) Proof. The cap condition in(3) fixes s=a+b-d. If this is negative, or s>d-c, the contraction is zero. Otherwise its allowed r range is exactly0,...,d-b. The ordinary pivotal cap phase supplies Q^r, and all the remaining factors are independent of r. Its complete coherent sum is sum_(r=0)^(d-b) Q^r[b+r choose r]_Q =[N choose b+1]_Q. (8) For completeness, q-Pascal gives [j+1 choose b+1]-[j choose b+1]=Q^(j-b)[j choose b]. Sum from j=b to d. At the primitive root the resulting Gaussian polynomial is zero for b<d and one for b=d. Its intermediate factorials have no zero denominator; [N choose N]=1 is its literal polynomial value. This works at every even and composite level as well. Thus b=d, r=0, s=a, n=c+a, with the strict condition n<=d. Substitution of the original cap coefficient gives precisely(7). This is cancellation of the full finite packet, not one selected term or an assumed homogeneous-source quotient. ## 3. The doubled packet has exactly one positive angle weight Define w_d(i,j,k)=1/(s_i s_j s_k), i+j+k=d. Applying(5) to(7) gives the exact entry Khat_(n;(a,b,c)) =delta_(b,d)delta_(n,a+c<=d) q^[a(n-N-1)] sqrt(w_d(a,c,d-n)). (9) Indeed the squared gauge ratio is h_n/(h_a h_d h_c)=s_a s_c/s_n. Consequently |Khat_(n;(a,d,c))|^2 =(1/N)|[a+c choose a]_Q|=w_d(a,c,d-a-c). (10) For the LITERAL original cap ell the right side is w_d/N, because ell=ellhat/sqrt(N). No original scalar line was discarded. The complete doubled input Gram retains the mixed copies: (Khat^*Khat)_(a,d,c ; a',d,c') =delta_(a+c,a'+c') q^[a'(a'+c'-N-1)-a(a+c-N-1)] sqrt(w_d(a,c,d-a-c)w_d(a',c',d-a'-c')). (11) All other middle-input rows/columns are zero. The positive trace on the one remaining output has supplied the UNWRAPPED constraint n=n'. It admits either exact N or2N Fourier character expression, since n,n' lie in0,...,d. This does not identify n=n' with a global triangulation edge sum2d. The non-diagonal terms of(11) have not been dephased. Rows of Khat have disjoint total-input-degree support, so Khat Khat^*=diag(R_n), R_n=sum_(a=0)^n w_d(a,n-a,d-n), ||Khat||_op^2=max_n R_n, ||Khat||_HS^2=sum_n R_n=Z_(3,N). (12) Here Z_(3,N) is the positive affine angle-simplex partition, with total d and zero angles retained. Thus the EXACT map has the one-tetrahedron energy exponent log||Khat||_op^2=log||Khat||_HS^2+O(logN) =N v_3/pi+O(logN). (13) The uniform factorial estimate and the unique simplex maximum at thirds prove(13); no isolated numerical saddle is a premise. Equation(12), not a separate entrywise Cauchy estimate, gives its quantitative all-exterior boundary norm. ## 4. The inverse-packet cup move Let J=A^-1(phat_12 tensor I_3). Its exact output selection is J|n> supported on |a,0,c>, a+c=n+d, n<=a<=d, J_(a,0,c ; n)=N^-1/2 x^[2(a-d)] [c choose d-a]_Q. (14) Proof. Write the cup index as p and apply C'_23 followed by (C'_12)^-1. The desired output fixes s=d-a-b and p=a+r. The remaining finite r sum is sum_(r=0)^b (-1)^r Q^[r(r-1)/2][b choose r]_Q =(1;Q)_b. It is zero unless b=0; for b=0 one has r=0,p=a,s=d-a and c=n+s. Substitution gives(14), with every inverse phase retained. Thus this is an exact cup/current cancellation, not an adjoint claimed from a nonunitary packet. In the SAME physical metric(5), |Jhat_(a,0,n+d-a ; n)|^2 =w_d(n,d-a,a-n). (15) To check it directly, the squared gauge ratio is h_a h_0 h_c/h_n=N s_n/(s_a s_c). Multiplying the squared coefficient in(14) and using s_a s_(d-a)=N gives(15). It follows that Jhat^*Jhat=diag(R_(d-n)), so its operator/HS norms have the same exact one-weight partition as(12). The literal original cup p restores the factor N^(3/2) in amplitude, or N^3 in energy. These polynomial factors remain explicit. ## 5. What is retained at the marked cap The actual full marked row is m_(u,v)=x^v/N^2, WITHOUT a degree delta. It cannot use(8). Its complete packet on arbitrary input has output n=c+s, 0<=s<=d-c, and the exact coefficient (m_12 A)_(n;(a,b,c)) =N^-2 (-1)^s Q^[s(s-1)/2]x^[b-2s] [c+s choose s]_Q *sum_(r=max(0,s-b))^(min(a,d-b)) [b+r choose r]_Q. (16) An empty interval means zero. This follows directly from(3) and the unrestricted original row; no source component is omitted. It is the remaining finite current packet when a marked boundary is present. Only if the FULL exterior has already forced pair degree d can the corresponding restricted marked row be used. Even then its r sum lacks Q^r and equals (Q^(-(d-b));Q)_(d-b), not the delta in(8). It is generally nonzero away from b=d. Thus the ordinary cap elimination is source-exact and useful, but does not delete the last marked source or its normal currents. If a beta or divided-Ward factorization is used to express(2), all its terms must add back to(6)--(16). Keeping only a bare balanced residue would not establish these identities. ## 6. Positive multiplication form and iteration scope Write sigma_a=q^[a(a-N-1)] and g_j=q^[j(j-1)/2]. Since q^(ac)=g_(a+c)/(g_a g_c), the unitary port phases in(9) can be displayed explicitly. After transporting those phases, the positive two-input part is T^+_(n;a,c)=N^-1/2 delta_(n=a+c<=d) sqrt(s_n/(s_a s_c)). (17) For W_j=1/sqrt(s_j) it is exactly T^+=N^-1/2 W^-1 M(W tensor W), where M is multiplication in C[z]/(z^N), in its canonical monomial basis. Consequently these positive kernels associate exactly, and their internal factorials telescope on a rooted tree. Actual port phases and the removed middle |d> registers must still be retained in the original diagram. They are not declared globally canceled by(17). The [complete cap-tree calculation](actual_cap_tree_angle_energy.md) gives the arbitrary-width boundary-tree energy with these original node types. This does not assert that every signed braid reduces to such a tree: overlapping recoupling cycles, Gaussian feedback and especially the full marked packet(16) remain. No broad knot survival or sharp whole-source volume estimate follows merely from this local contraction. [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_pivotal_cap_reassociation_angle_packet.py): full original finite packet matrices, ordinary cap and cup source, complete phases and forced indices, exact mixed-copy Gram, one-weight norms, and the unrestricted marked packet. The finite audit checks seven levels N=2,...,8 and all 1,295 three-head input columns, checking the full original cap and inverse-cup matrices, the retained marked packet, phases, mixed-copy Gram and one-weight norms. The algebraic proofs above establish the all-level statements; these finite checks are supplementary.

title: The literal planar three-port double and its original Morse source
text: # The literal planar three-port double and its original Morse source 30 October 2026. This certifies the topology and pointing of the planar three-port double used in the whole-source reflection calculation. It constructs an original augmented-link Morse diagram; it does not assume the doubled graph admits the older two-row noncrossing ordering. It does not prove the proposed theta-normalized quantum contraction. ## 1. Delete, reflect and sew the embedded vertex Start with the ACTUAL plane cubic source graph Gamma and an exposed trivalent vertex w. Retain its cyclic order and the three labeled incident edge ribbons a,b,c. Choose a small vertex disk meeting exactly these ribbons once and containing no circle coupon. Deleting its interior leaves a three-leg ribbon graph in the complementary disk. For a connected double assume this remaining graph is connected; otherwise the same construction records all its components rather than discarding one. Reflect this entire remaining ribbon disk, reversing its planar cyclic orders and interchanging black/white source orientations. Glue its three boundary ends to their corresponding original ends by the orientation-reversing boundary identification. This is the embedded three-edge vertex sum Gamma_double=(Gamma minus w) union (mirror Gamma minus mirror w). At the physical six-strand boundary, use the cyclic terminal list (a-,a+,b-,b+,c-,c+). The reflected disk reads this list in reverse order. Glue each actual labeled terminal to its reflected copy; in clockwise position indices this is j -> 5-j. Thus the full head reversal is prescribed geometrically. A free permutation of ports, or a same-order adjoint of a trivalent tensor, is not this gluing. ## 2. One original circle per merged edge Construct the augmented diagram from the SEWN ribbon graph. Replace each surviving trivalent vertex by its original three planar main strand arcs. In its cyclic labels the pairs are (a+,b-), (b+,c-), (c+,a-). The two main strands follow each edge ribbon. Put exactly ONE actual crossing circle on every resulting edge, with its twice-punctured spanning disk and any recorded signed twist. In particular each of the THREE seam edges receives one circle. An equivalent cut description amputates the three boundary circle coupons before reflecting, then inserts one coupon on each sewn edge. Reflecting two already decorated edge stubs and retaining both circles would give a different diagram. At even levels it could also replace one required nilpotent coupon by its vanishing square. No such step is allowed by this certificate. This expansion gives precisely the Fisher matching graph of the sewn Gamma. It retains every vertex arc, disk label and component. The existence of the actual planar diagram follows from the ribbon disk gluing, not from a graph incidence count. ## 3. An actual Morse word and a legitimate exposed mark Make the planar main arcs piecewise smooth and choose a generic height. After small disjoint isotopies their critical heights and the circle boxes are distinct. Reading height gives an explicit finite sequence of the original cups, caps, identity strips and circle coupons. Local orientations of a two-strand box are changed only by its actual cup/cap bends, hence by the genuine turned coupon and its recorded clocks. No crossing of two planar main arcs is introduced. This is an original Morse source even if it has many alternating cup/cap levels. It need not have all black vertices in one row or all white vertices in another. Arbitrary structural relabelings of heads are not substituted for these actual identity strips. Because w was exposed, choose the seam sector corresponding to its original outside-face corner. A main arc bordering that sector gives a distinguished ONE-HEAD cut. Choose the planar point at infinity in that white region and place this cut at the exposed closing cap from the start. The remaining whole tangle is a generic Hopf endomorphism of the physical V_d and therefore scalar. Its actual ordinary trace has the single factor (-1)^d[N]. The original physical marked row extracts that scalar because m pV=1. This justifies the exposed physical pointing of the NEW diagram. It does not move a bare mark through an enclosing cap of an already fixed diagram. If a proposed source formula starts at another cut, its whole pivotal transport must still be supplied. ## 4. The geometric volume subtraction, when cores are certified Suppose Gamma has the positive labeled ideal rectified core Q of [the proved NC core theorem](actual_nc_graph_rectified_core_geometry.md), and w corresponds to its actual triangular face T_w. Reflect a copy of Q and glue the two copies along those triangles with the prescribed three-port correspondence. The adjacent right angles sum to pi, so the seam's white faces merge. The convex-face union proof in that same theorem gives the positive core of Gamma_double; its volume is 2Vol(Q). Its remaining face labels are exactly those of the ribbon vertex sum above. If Gamma has b black and b white vertices, Gamma_double has 2b-1 of each type. Its actual augmented link therefore has volume 4(2b-1)v8+4Vol(Q) =2[4b v8+2Vol(Q)]-4v8. (1) The subtracted 4v8 is the complete marked theta-link volume. Thus a source double formula with a theta denominator has the expected GEOMETRIC normalization. Equation (1) does not prove that source formula, its positivity, or its asymptotic rate. It is conditional on the actual positive core and the correctly sewn original diagram.

title: An exact positive full-source formula for planar three-port doubles
text: # An exact positive full-source formula for planar three-port doubles 30 October 2026. A literal planar three-port double has an exact nonnegative complete-circle source at EVERY quantum level. All interior and seam colors are summed; there are no fixed Steinberg cycle projections. The formula is a sum of squared COHERENT boundary packets, with the positive original marked theta scalar as its prescribed weight. It retains the single physical mark and every paired circle normal. The primitive half can have arbitrary fixed size and branching. Its boundary packet is still a genuine coherent contraction, not a product of local black scalar magnitudes. Thus this theorem removes cancellation between the double's boundary sectors; it does not yet compute their exponential size or prove the volume limit for arbitrary plats. ## 1. A reflection operation on the whole original Morse word Let J_n reverse ALL n physical V_N tensor factors. For a matrix F:V_N^tensor a -> V_N^tensor b put F^sharp = J_a F^dagger J_b. (1) This reverses composition and tensor order. It is a whole-word operation, not a partial transpose of one leg. Set d=N-1, q=exp(pi i/N), x=q^d. For the original physical cup and cap, p_(u,v)=N x^-v delta_(u+v,d), ell_(u,v)=x^u delta_(u+v,d)/N, one has exactly p^sharp=N^2 ell, ell^sharp=N^-2 p. (2) Indeed p^dagger P=N^2 ell, with P=J_2. The original unrestricted marked row is m_(u,v)=x^v/N^2; it is NOT replaced by its local adjoint in this argument. Let L_j be a FULL complete-circle Hermite sector. Its actual all-degree factorization, including a paired root normal, is L_j=F_j F_j^dagger P. Consequently L_j^sharp=L_j, (R^e L_j)^sharp=R^-e L_j. (3) For the second identity use the proved all-input equality R^e L_j=omega_j^e L_j with |omega_j|=1. If a structural crossing is present elsewhere in the original word, it obeys the independently proved identity P R^dagger P=R^-1 as well. These are actual matrix identities, including both parities; a paired nilpotent is not being replaced by a projector. In a Morse word from a physical one-head cut back to that head, the numbers of cups and caps are equal. Therefore every scale N^2 in (2) cancels globally. The word obtained by reversing its composition and tensor order, exchanging its cups/caps, and reversing its signed crossings is exactly T^sharp=T^dagger. It is the literal reflected Morse diagram. Boundary labels are transported by that same geometric reflection, including its reversal of the cyclic three-port order. The cut word T is a Hopf endomorphism of the original V_N. This module is irreducible: its interior E and F coefficients are all nonzero and its K weights are distinct. Hence T=z I. The original marked closure extracts precisely z, since m p=1. Its reflected one-head cut is z-bar I, so Z_reflected(reflected boundary labels) =conjugate(Z_original(boundary labels)). (4) This proves the marked identity without reflecting a bare local m, without moving a bare mark through a nested cap, and without first specializing an ordinary quantum trace to zero. A correct generic first-normal trace quotient gives the same scalar, but is not needed to establish (4). Any original exterior framing line is reflected and conjugated separately. Legitimate one-head cuts on another physical main arc give the same raw scalar when needed in the seam construction. To verify this, choose the regular generic lift of the WHOLE labeled diagram. Its closed scalar F(zeta) equals D_N(zeta) times the open scalar at either cut, where D_N is the same physical V_N quantum dimension. Away from its isolated zeros those open scalars agree; they are regular and therefore agree at the root. This transports the complete cut tangle, not a bare local marked row. The chosen lift is used only to establish this equality of the actual root coupons. ## 2. The double is a specified physical source Start with an actual planar complete-circle graph source Gamma and a specified three-port vertex disk for which its punctured source has an actual Morse realization. For example take the exposed outer white vertex of an original NC/Morse graph. Remove that vertex disk, reflect its remaining planar piece as in section1, and glue the two disk boundaries in their reversed cyclic order. The seam has three edges, not six consecutive edge coupons. Install ONE original complete-circle coupon on each merged edge. Equivalently remove the old boundary circle coupons before joining the two pieces and reinstall one on each seam. Signed seam exponents add; reflected partners cancel there. Reflect every remaining signed crossing in the second half as required by (3). Expand the surviving vertices to their actual nested main-strand arcs. A generic planar height produces the corresponding cups, caps and turned-circle Morse word. Choose its single physical one-head mark on an outer-face seam main arc FROM THE START. This construction is the planar vertex sum Gamma #_3 reflected(Gamma), with its actual source orientations. It does not assert that the result has the previous one-row NC edge order, nor insert unrecorded edge permutations or structural crossings to force such an order. The [geometric source certificate](actual_planar_three_port_double_topology.md) records this disk construction, including its six-terminal reversal. The algebra below uses only its specified physical port joining and one-circle-per-seam convention. Applying two old root circle coupons in succession instead would give a different source and is NOT the double studied here. ## 3. Exact theta division before taking the fixed root normal Let D_N be the supported folded triples 0<=a,b,c<=floor((N-1)/2), a+b+c>=N-1. Write theta_N(a,b,c)>0 for the RAW original marked theta source with these three full-circle sectors and no twists. Its positivity and normalization are proved in the all-channel marked-theta theorem. Let Z_Gamma(a,b,c) be the original coherent source with these three boundary sectors fixed and EVERY other complete-circle color summed. The mark is a legitimate physical cut of the original closed source. The [three-port source sewing theorem](actual_nc_three_port_source_sewing.md) has an all-entry local proof. Removing the ordinary boundary invariant row from the regular generic lift leaves a genuine invariant column Y_Gamma(zeta)=alpha_Gamma(zeta) Theta_abc(zeta). The canonical Theta corner is one, so alpha is the finite open-corner contraction and is regular BEFORE dividing by a closed theta. The same argument applies to the literal disk joining in section2: the punctured source is an actual composition of Hopf morphisms, not a bare permutation of a six-head array. For a supported triple the ordinary theta has exactly one root zero. Its local source scalar is nonzero. The generic cross-multiplied sewing identity can therefore be divided by its single common quantum dimension factor BEFORE specializing. The one-circle-per-seam edge constants and the two removed source scalars give exactly Z_sewn(a,b,c)=Z_A(a,b,c) Z_B(a,b,c)/theta_N(a,b,c). (5) No paired projector norm or root L_j inverse is used. The retained first normal is the originally specified one; higher nonzero coefficients are not selected if it vanishes. Nontriangles vanish. For unsupported triples the actual product of three complete circles kills the regular saturated six-head boundary source before the exterior or the mark acts, by the exposed six-port pruning theorem. Thus there is no missing marked-white boundary current in the COMPLETE-circle sum. This is a whole-source statement; it is not an assertion that an arbitrary open local current vanishes. At the reflected boundary identify its labels by the actual reversed cyclic port map. Equation (4) makes its coherent packet the conjugate of Z_Gamma, while theta is symmetric and positive. Therefore the RAW original source of the double is exactly Z_double = sum_(a,b,c in D_N) |Z_Gamma(a,b,c)|^2/theta_N(a,b,c) >= 0. (6) All interior color sums in each factor of (6) are performed coherently. The sum includes every physical seam triple. Both parity cases and all paired first normals occur. If D_N is empty the sum and source are zero. If D_N is nonempty, strict positivity holds exactly when at least one coherent boundary packet is nonzero. No universal nonvanishing premise for an unknown primitive piece is added. ## 4. What the positive formula controls quantitatively Define the actual weighted boundary maximum B_N=max_(j in D_N) |Z_Gamma(j)|/sqrt(theta_N(j)). When the supported set is nonempty, B_N^2 <= Z_double <= |D_N| B_N^2, |D_N| <= N^3. (7) Hence whenever the source is nonzero its complete exponential rate is controlled, with an O(log N/N) error, by the largest COHERENT weighted boundary packet. This is a full-source estimate, not a norm of one fixed central channel or an absolute magnetic-state envelope. Equation (6) does not make the inside of each Z_Gamma a positive factorial sum. Estimating that coherent packet is still required to identify (7) with the actual doubled hyperbolic volume. In particular known projected cube or ladder packets cannot be substituted for the full Z_Gamma in (6). The double class has arbitrary fixed primitive size; it is a specified subclass of physical planar sources, not a proof for every fixed k-bridge skeleton. ## 5. A literal full-color NC cube double There is an especially direct certificate using the original ordered cube, with interval black vertex (0,1,2) and outer white vertex (0,10,11). Its ribbon reflection swaps the color classes and has edge permutation (1 10)(2 11)(4 7)(5 8), with 0,3,6,9 fixed. (8) It maps the interval black boundary to the outer white boundary IN THE DISPLAYED ORDER. The induced rotations at the other vertices are the genuine pivotal cyclic moves, not plain magnetic-leg swaps. Insert the reflected cube at that interval by the existing literal NC graft. The result has fourteen trivalent vertices and twenty-one complete circles. Its original mark stays exposed in that construction. Reflecting the signed interior edge exponents by (8) gives exactly (6). The focused audit computes this TWENTY-ONE-CIRCLE source directly by full physical magnetic tensors, with all colors already assembled in each complete L_N coupon. It independently compares the result to the supported three-color sum in (6), and checks each reflected boundary packet against the conjugate-root calculation. In particular none of its cycle colors is frozen to the central channel. Audit: [whole-word reflection and full physical doubles](../experiments/audit_actual_planar_three_port_reflection_double.py). The reflection-double identities do not give a full-source volume estimate. The size estimate for the remaining coherent half-packet is separate from these identities.

title: The original plat source has explicit cup/cap Gram supports
text: # The original plat source has explicit cup/cap Gram supports 28 October 2026. For EVERY fixed actual 2k-head plat word, the original scalar has an exact matrix-element presentation between two specified positive pure states, with a unitary pivot and explicit polynomial normalization. No period is divided out and neither state is chosen to favor a geometric saddle. The transported cup state satisfies the actual incoming inverse-meridian constraints exactly. The cap state has the outgoing inverse-meridian constraints in mean square with O(N^-2) error. Hence their positive moment limits have the two honest compact braid/cap supports. Their intersection satisfies precisely the plat representation relations within this bounded star-character space. It is not asserted to exhaust the unrestricted representation variety. The overlap need not have nonzero limiting mass. No exponential overlap estimate, joint atomic-shape comparison or volume bound is inferred. ## 1. Exact original source, after its permitted whole-degree restriction Use N>=2, d=N-1, q=exp(pi*i/N), Q=q^2 and x=-q^(-1), with the original balanced basis and actual pivot g_i=x^(1-N)Q^(-i). On a standard neighboring primal/dual pair the original left cup p and ordinary right cap l are p_(i,j)=N x^(-j) delta_(i+j,d), l_(i,j)=x^j g_i/N delta_(i+j,d). Since |x|=1, l=N^(-2) p^* G, G=diag(g on the primal leg). (1) Both the N and 1/N are the literal actual turn normalizations. The full original marked cap is m_(i,j)=x^j/N^2, with NO degree delta. It is not changed termwise in an arbitrary decomposed tensor. Put u=p^(tensor k). It has total INTEGER degree kd. Every original crossing preserves that degree, so the fully assembled W u still has degree kd. The k-1 ordinary top caps force degree d on each of their pairs. Consequently the last MARKED pair also has degree d in the whole scalar pairing. On that specific degree-d subspace, m=N^(-3)p^*. (2) Thus with any chosen marked pair r_*, the exact originally pointed plat scalar is P_N=chi_N N^(-2k-1) <u,G_top W u>, G_top=product_(r!=r_*) diag(g on primal leg of pair r). (3) Here chi_N is the unchanged original external line, including whatever framing/full peripheral convention has been specified. No component of g or chi_N is reset. Formula (3) uses integer-degree conservation BEFORE the marked-cap restriction. The replacement (2) is not asserted for arbitrary degree-changing coupon insertions or for separated nonconserving current sectors. In the actual flat metric ||p||^2=N^3, so ||u||^2=N^(3k). Define uhat=u/N^(3k/2), phihat=G_top^* uhat. The pivot is unitary, and g=x^(-N)K on each primal head. Hence G_top is a fixed-degree bounded polynomial in the original Cartans, with its exact parity phase retained. Equation (3) becomes P_N=chi_N N^(k-1) <phihat,W uhat>. (4) This is an exact same-source scalar identity, not positivity of a pivotal trace. The states here are fixed by the actual turns. ## 2. The actual inverse-meridian equations of every cup Let the bounded physical based quantum meridians H_j and their exact transport be those of [the all-word theorem](actual_bounded_quantum_meridian_transport.md). Define, as a two-by-two matrix of physical operators, A_r=H_(2r)H_(2r-1)-I, 1<=r<=k. (5) EVERY entry of A_r annihilates u exactly. Here is a direct proof. On the local pair the actual cup obeys E_tot p=0, F_tot p=0, K_tot p=p. The two product matrices L_(-,2)L_(-,1) and L_(+,2)L_(+,1) therefore act as the identity on each auxiliary component of p. Their ratio is precisely the local H_2 H_1, so its difference from I kills p. For a later pair the global based product is P^(-1)(H_2 H_1)P, where P consists only of earlier heads. Its matrix entries commute with the local pair's entries. Thus each term of the difference still annihilates that cup, irrespective of the state on the earlier heads. This proves (5) for the full tensor u, with the original ordering. The total product T=H_(2k)...H_1 also acts as I on u and is preserved by W. Its preservation follows from the original total E,F,K Hopf intertwining, equivalently the preserved products of L_+ and L_-. Let psi_N=W uhat/||W uhat||. It exists for EVERY N because W is invertible and uhat is nonzero; no assumption on the scalar pairing (4) is required. Define A_(r,W)=W A_r W^(-1). All of these are the N-uniformly bounded Nielsen polynomials already proved in the physical-meridian theorem, and A_(r,W) psi_N=0, (T-I)psi_N=0. (6) Thus for the POSITIVE pure Gram state of psi_N, <psi_N,A_(r,W)^* A_(r,W)psi_N>=0 (7) entrywise, exactly at each level. These are the actual transported bottom cup constraints, not a newly imposed classical graph. ## 3. The actual top cap has controlled mean-square support The cap state in (4) is phihat=G_top^* uhat. Since A_r uhat=0, A_r phihat=[A_r,G_top^*] uhat. (8) All entries of A_r and G_top are fixed-degree polynomials in the actual bounded scaled head observables. Their star commutators have the proved norm bound C_k/N. Therefore ||(A_r)_(ab) phihat||<=C_k/N, <phihat,(A_r)_(ab)^*(A_r)_(ab)phihat><=C_k^2/N^2. (9) This includes the marked pair: it has no pivot of its own in G_top, but pivots on earlier heads can enter its based prefix. Equation (8) handles them rather than treating the based constraint as a local unbased one. The estimate is independent of W and does not replace the original marked source before its permitted whole-degree use. The stronger exact cap-row equations for ordinary top caps are also consistent with (9); they are not needed to infer support here. ## 4. Positive limits and the honest plat intersection The all-word bound supplies a common finite bounded star family for H_j, all W H_j W^(-1), their entries and adjoints. Their commutators are O(1/N). Consequently subsequential moment limits of the two positive pure states have compact commutative realizations as in the physical-meridian theorem. At every character write h_j for the SL2 matrices determined by H_j; the physical meridians are -h_j and have trace two. The limiting cup measure is supported by phi_W(h_(2r))phi_W(h_(2r-1))=I for all r, h_(2k)...h_1=I, (10) where phi_W is the EXACT Nielsen word read contravariantly from the actual W. This follows from the zero mean squares (7). The cap measure is supported by h_(2r)h_(2r-1)=I for all r, (11) by (9). No positivity of the original pivotal closing is assumed. The intersection of (10) and (11) is the subset of the bounded character space satisfying the honest plat representation relations, including degenerate/central meridians. To verify the group statement, take free meridian generators at the braid's top. Each top cap identifies its two oriented meridians as inverses, giving (11). Pull the bottom meridians through the literal braid Hurwitz words; its bottom caps then give precisely (10). These are exactly the Wirtinger/van-Kampen identifications of the plat diagram. The total product relation is redundant once all adjacent cap products are I, but it is genuinely retained by the quantum source as well. For a one-component knot any noncentral trace-two meridian has parabolic centralizer, so its commuting peripheral image is boundary-parabolic. If it is central in PSL2, normal generation makes the representation trivial. Hence the sharp representation volume bound applies to every representation in this intersection. This is not yet a claim that its joint atomic shapes have the saturated critical regulator values. ## 5. A bounded overlap limit also has this intersection support There is a further statement which does not assume a nonzero overlap. For any fixed polynomial observable F in that bounded star family set omega_N(F)=<phihat,F psi_N>. (12) Its norm is at most the operator norm of F. Polarization expresses it as a linear combination of four positive vector Gram functionals of phihat+i^j psi_N, whose norms are at most four. Their subsequential compact commutative realizations from Section 4 therefore give a bounded complex measure for (12), possibly the ZERO measure. From (6) we have omega_N(F A_(r,W))=0. From (9), <phihat,A_r^* F psi_N>=O(1/N); commuting fixed-degree observables changes this by O(1/N). Consequently the limit annihilates every polynomial multiple of A_(r,W) and A_r^*. Including all adjoints and using continuous approximation shows that it is supported on the intersection (10)-(11). There is no division by omega_N(1) or P_N. These moments belong to the exact scalar representation (4). They are not asserted equal to old marked-cap moments after arbitrary degree-changing coupon insertions, for which (2) need not hold. The distinction from an exponential theorem is essential. From (4), |P_N|=|chi_N| N^(k-1)||W uhat|| |omega_N(1)|. (13) The overlap can be exponentially small, and every fixed-degree moment in (12) can then tend to zero. The separate positive cup and cap measures do not create a normalized overlap measure or a nonzero intersection coefficient. Dividing by that small overlap would destroy the uniform moment bound just proved. No claim is made that the discrete-faithful point lies in this real compact intersection. Complex stationary deformation and its original source still matter. The new unconditional result is the SAME original scalar's explicit cup/cap support and bounded overlap-support statements, for all widths and words. A sharp upper bound still needs exponential control of that overlap and of the associated atomic regulator at singular shape charts. A volume lower bound also needs nonzero geometric selection. Neither conclusion is inferred here. [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_plat_gram_support.py): exact full marked-source reduction, all cup and transported constraints, retained total product and pivots, plus direct flat-complex mean-square cap bounds. Both crossing signs and marked-pair locations are retained.

title: A source-exact bulk Agmon energy for the actual pointed quantum-A system
text: # A source-exact bulk Agmon energy for the actual pointed quantum-A system 28 October 2026. The actual bounded-jet pointed system admits a positive weighted energy with its original boundary source. On any compact arc whose weighted classical symbol has a fixed gap from zero, a direct localized Plancherel argument bounds the interior energy by that source and explicit boundary packets. No eigenvector diagonalization, global inverse bound or cancellation of source terms is assumed. This is a quantitative general theorem for the actual fixed-band system of EVERY knot. It is local in the color coordinate: turning-point, resonance and end packets remain. It does not yet give their sharp geometric connection estimate or a new volume-conjecture class. ## 1. Actual system and exact positive weighted energy Use the uniformly scaled bounded-jet matrix and source of [the pointed Gram theorem](pointed_a_gram_period.md), M_N y=b_N, R_N y=(C_(j_*),...,C_N)^t. (1) Its block size and bandwidth are fixed independently of N, all entries are uniformly bounded, and b_N is supported on the prescribed fixed number of INITIAL IDENTITY rows. Those initial jet values are fixed small-color Laurent polynomials and their bounded-order jets; their scaled norms are uniformly bounded. Every solution has the same constant-color vector, even when its higher jets are not unique. Interior recurrence rows, indexed by their initial color j, have form (M_N y)_j=sum_(i=0)^d A_(i,N)(j) y_(j+i). Uniformly on compact color intervals, their fixed-size matrix coefficients satisfy A_(i,N)(j)=A_i(j/N)+O(1/N), A_i are continuously differentiable. (2) These are not assumptions about an unknown asymptotic solution. For the actual system they follow directly from its finite monomial and binomial formula (2.1) and the N^-r jet scaling. Its symbol is exactly the proved block polynomial A_B(x,L) of equation (5.2) there. Possible root-level nullspaces and the entire jet budget remain in (1). Let phi be a fixed real C2 function of x=j/N. Give each COLUMN color block weight exp(N phi(j/N)), calling the resulting diagonal matrix W_c. Give a recurrence ROW the same weight at its row label j; each initial identity row receives the weight of its prescribed color. Call this W_r. Define u=W_c y, L_(phi,N)=W_r M_N W_c^-1, P_(phi,N)=L_(phi,N)^dagger L_(phi,N). (3) Then, EXACTLY, L_(phi,N)u=W_r b_N, <u,P_(phi,N)u>=||W_r b_N||^2. (4) This is the full sourced Hermitian energy. No affine term or normal component has been discarded. Choose phi(0)=0. Since the source colors are fixed, their N phi(j/N) are bounded; the right side of (4) is uniformly bounded. The original complete color is still the selected constant jet in (1), not an arbitrary solution of the principal symbol. Despite the potentially exponential values of W_c and W_r themselves, the nonzero entries of L_(phi,N) involve only bounded local ratios. In an interior row their leading coefficients are A_i(x) exp(-i phi'(x)), (5) where i in (5) is the INTEGER shift index, not sqrt(-1). The uniform error is O(1/N). Thus L_phi and P_phi still have bounded entries and fixed bandwidth. The Hermitian bulk symbol is the POSITIVE matrix A_B(x,exp(-phi'(x)) L)^dagger A_B(x,exp(-phi'(x)) L), |L|=1. (6) It is not obtained by silently treating a moving eigenframe as unitary. ## 2. A proved local coercivity theorem Let I be a compact color interval contained in (0,1). Suppose the explicit weighted block symbol satisfies sigma_min A_B(x,exp(-phi'(x)) exp(i theta))>=eta>0 for x in I, theta real. (7) This is independently checkable from the specified finite operator. For the actual lower-triangular jet symbol, invertibility is equivalent to the scalar A_cl not vanishing on that circle. On a compact arc fixed dimension and continuity then give the positive eta; no semisimplicity or separation of different eigenvalues is needed. For vectors u supported in I and a fixed small interior margin, ||L_(phi,N)u|| >=(eta-C N^-1/2)||u||. (8) Here the operator includes EVERY row meeting that support. There is no artificial Dirichlet deletion of its boundary output rows. Proof. On the color lattice choose a bounded-overlap partition sum_l chi_l^2=1 with windows of length ell=floor(sqrt(N)) and |chi_l(j+i)-chi_l(j)|<=C/ell for bounded i. Freeze (5) at each window center. The full-line constant-coefficient operator has Fourier multiplier A_B(x_l,exp(-phi'(x_l))exp(i theta)); ordinary Plancherel and (7) give norm at least eta on every localized vector. The difference from the actual operator is at most C ell/N on each window by (2) and phi in C2. Bounded overlap gives the same bound after summing the squared localized norms. Its commutator with chi_l has summed norm at most C/ell times ||u||, by fixed bandwidth and the displayed difference bound. Since sum_l ||chi_l L_phi u||^2 =||L_phi u||^2, the direct-sum triangle inequality yields eta||u|| <=||L_phi u||+C(ell/N+1/ell)||u||. This is (8). The proof handles block coefficients, repeated roots away from the weighted circle, and nonnormal actual transfers. ## 3. Apply it to the original response, keeping boundary currents Let chi be a smooth cutoff supported in I and equal to one on a smaller interval I'. Let B_chi contain all its transition colors and their fixed bandwidth neighbors. Applying (8) to chi u and using the EXACT equation (4) gives, for large N, ||chi u|| <=(2/eta)[ ||chi W_r b_N|| +(C/N)||u restricted to B_chi|| ]. (9) The cutoff on recurrence rows uses their original label j. On initial identity rows it uses their prescribed color, so the source convention is unchanged. Formula (9) follows from L_phi(chi u)=chi W_r b_N+[L_phi,chi]u. The commutator is EXPLICITLY supported in B_chi and has norm at most C/N for a fixed scaled cutoff. A cutoff over ell lattice steps instead has C/ell and its corresponding retained boundary packet. These are the original normal/endpoint flux terms of the estimate; they are not asserted small without their actual source connection. Since R_N selects the constant jet and commutes with the color weight, (9) also bounds the weighted interior ordinary-color energy. It holds for every actual truncated-jet solution; higher-jet nonuniqueness is not removed by choosing a favorable solution. A global kernel can still be supported by the boundary packets, and nothing here divides by an unproved finite Evans or resonance determinant. ## 4. A regulator barrier is a possible weight, not a free boundary estimate On a genuinely identified peripheral branch set phi(x)=-R(x)/(2pi). In the recorded color convention dR/dx=2pi log|L_branch|, so exp(-phi')=|L_branch|. Exactly at that eikonal radius the symbol gap (7) is zero. On a compact regular arc with distinct root moduli one may tilt phi' by a fixed small amount so its circle lies strictly between adjacent root moduli. Then (7)--(9) hold. The tilt can tend to zero AFTER the large-N bound, while every boundary packet remains. This gives genuine controlled propagation THROUGH a forbidden bulk arc, rather than assuming contraction of instantaneous eigenvectors. It works at eigenvalue collisions away from the chosen weighted circle as well. At a root on that circle the estimate stops; the corresponding turning or interface packet must be connected by an additional source estimate. The original fixed initial packet and complete-color resonance also remain. The geometric bound |R|<=Vol(X) bounds this ABSOLUTE weight whenever the spectral component has actually been identified as a peripheral representation branch. It does not bound its omitted boundary packets, choose among several branches, or prove such an identification for an arbitrary annihilator. A general sharp upper theorem still needs a source-compatible connection estimate across the finite set of turning/interface/end packets. Equations (4) and (9) show precisely where their cumulative amplification enters; it cannot be replaced by uniqueness or by a largest-root integral. The SOURCE ANCHOR must also remain. For the polynomial initial-source bound following (4), normalize instead phi(x)=-[R(x)-R(0)]/(2pi). Recovering an unweighted value then costs the regulator DIFFERENCE R(x)-R(0), whose geometric bound is in general 2Vol(X), not Vol(X). Keeping phi=-R/(2pi) simply puts the compensating exponential into the weighted initial source. Fixed small-color pointing does not by itself prove that every spectral branch has regulator zero there. A sharp bound needs its actual branch/source normalization as well as the boundary connections. No constant action shift has been used to conceal that factor. [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_pointed_a_bulk_agmon.py): the actual figure-eight affine coefficients with fixed original source, weighted positive-energy identities, compact off-root-circle bulk coercivity, and the retained cutoff commutator equation. Numerical checks supplement the all-fixed-band proof (2)--(9), not a new knot-class assertion.

title: Quantitative inward propagation for the actual pointed-A boundary response
text: # Quantitative inward propagation for the actual pointed-A boundary response 28 October 2026. A uniformly off-characteristic color interval has a controlled whole-line Green extension and an explicit finite-interval observability estimate. Weighted energy entering from its retained boundary packets decays exponentially inward. The constants remain polynomial when the spectral gap shrinks slower than N^-1/2. This upgrades [bulk Agmon coercivity](actual_pointed_a_bulk_agmon_energy.md) to a resolvent and a maximum estimate for the actual fixed-band source system. It accounts for nonnormality without diagonalizing transfers. Both boundary packets remain in the general case. It is not a claim that an arbitrary square finite compression has a tame inverse, or that the required right-hand source packet is already bounded by volume. ## 1. Broad operator class and actual inputs Let the block size r and shift radius d>=1 be fixed. On a lattice interval J=[a,b] of length O(N), consider the ACTUAL weighted recurrence (L_N u)_j=sum_(i=-d)^d C_(i,N)(j) u_(j+i). (1) The forward-only case has zero coefficients for negative i. Assume uniform boundedness of the coefficients, and that they are within C/N of matrices A_(i,N)(j/N) having a uniform Lipschitz bound on J/N. The functions A may depend on N. Suppose sigma_min(sum_i A_(i,N)(x) exp(i i theta))>=eta_N>0 for x in J/N, theta real. (2) In exp(i i theta), the first i is sqrt(-1), the second the integer shift index. The notation is solely the Fourier symbol of (1). Require eta_N>=4C_0 N^-1/2, where C_0 depends on those uniform bounds and on fixed r,d. Eventually strict inequality suffices. These are independently checkable coefficient hypotheses. For the actual pointed jet matrix, after its proved jet scaling and color weight exp(N phi_N(x)), its symbol is A_B(x,exp(-phi_N'(x))exp(i theta)). The hypotheses above follow from the actual finite monomial formula whenever phi_N' and phi_N'' are uniformly bounded and this radius has gap eta_N. No unknown period is used. All original jet components and source rows remain. A shrinking radius tilt with a fixed smooth profile is allowed; an unbounded derivative of that profile is not. ## 2. A controlled whole-line extension and inverse Extend each coefficient sequence constantly beyond the two ends of J. Equivalently clamp the symbol path at its endpoint values; the actual coefficients keep their O(1/N) error there. This defines an auxiliary operator L_ext on ell2(Z,C^r), agreeing with the actual recurrence on J. The extension is part of the PROOF; it replaces neither the original outside word nor its source. The sqrt(N)-window Plancherel argument gives ||L_ext v|| >=(eta_N-C_0 N^-1/2)||v|| >=eta_N||v||/2. (3) The same proof applies to L_ext^dagger. Its coefficients are shifted adjoints of those in (1), hence have the same slow variation, and its frozen symbol is the adjoint of (2), with the same singular-value gap. Thus its kernel is zero too. The range of L_ext is closed by (3) and dense by the zero adjoint kernel. Therefore it is onto and G_N=L_ext^-1 exists, ||G_N||<=2/eta_N. (4) This is a two-sided, source-independent resolvent theorem, with no assumption of normal matrices or distinct eigenvalues. The constants do not grow with interval length. The proof uses full output rows; it does not discard the leakage rows at an interval endpoint. ## 3. Exponential Green decay, proved by bounded conjugations Put K_1=sum_i |i|sup_j||C_(i,N)(j)|| and K_1^+=max(1,K_1). Choose mu_N=min(1/d, eta_N/(8K_1^+)). (5) For a fixed source color k, multiply by the BOUNDED weights W_R(j)=exp(mu_N min(|j-k|,R)). Their neighboring ratios differ from one by at most exp(mu_N|i|)-1<=2mu_N|i|. Consequently ||W_R L_ext W_R^-1-L_ext||<=2mu_N K_1<=eta_N/4. Neumann inversion using (4) bounds the conjugated inverse by 4/eta_N, uniformly in R. Applying it to a block point source at k and then letting R increase proves the explicit kernel bound ||(G_N)_(j,k)||<= (4/eta_N)exp(-mu_N|j-k|). (6) No unbounded conjugation or imported decay theorem is used. Block sources and multiplicities are included in the operator norm. ## 4. Exact finite-interval boundary observability Suppose u is the original response on J and satisfies (1)=f on all rows whose stencil is inside J. Let J_in=[a+d,b-d]; retaining this slightly smaller row set works for both shift orientations. Zero extend u from J and call it u_J. Then exactly L_ext u_J=1_(J_in)f+B_left u_left+B_right u_right. (7) The two u-side packets contain the first and last 2d physical color blocks of J. The two B operators are simply the corresponding boundary rows of L_ext; they are explicit, have fixed support and uniformly bounded norm. Their row supports lie within distance d of the respective endpoint. If J is shorter than 4d the analogous finite-dimensional estimate uses all its blocks as boundary data. Uniqueness of (4) gives an EXACT representation by applying G_N to (7). In particular ||u_J||_2 <=C eta_N^-1 (||f_(J_in)||_2+||u_left||_2+||u_right||_2). (8) More precisely, for any j in J, (6) gives ||u_j|| <=C eta_N^-1 [ sum_(k in J_in) exp(-mu_N|j-k|)||f_k|| +exp(-mu_N dist(j,left))||u_left||_2 +exp(-mu_N dist(j,right))||u_right||_2 ]. (9) The fixed-width ambiguity in dist is absorbed into C. Summing the geometric series proves the uniform maximum/observability estimate sup_J||u_j|| <=C eta_N^-1(1+mu_N^-1) (sup_(J_in)||f_j||+||u_left||+||u_right||). (10) Thus a regular homogeneous bulk transmits only the retained boundary packets, with exponential distance suppression. On a compact bulk interval of the actual pointed jet system, its initial identity rows lie outside J, so f is zero in (9); this is NOT a replacement by an arbitrary homogeneous solution. Those initial rows remain original boundary data. More general actual affine sources may lie inside a regular interval; their full row and column weighting remains in f. An initial identity row is not silently assigned the bulk symbol (2). For eta_N=N^-gamma with 0<=gamma<1/2, the inverse and maximum constants are polynomial and the decay length is O(N^gamma). Thus the loss is exp(o(N)), even for a shrinking off-characteristic tilt. This also applies to the full normal-jet blocks, not only their constant-color projection. The latter can be selected afterwards. ## 5. Which boundary data are genuinely necessary The general estimate needs BOTH sides. Spectral gap alone does not make a recurrence stable in the forward direction. The elementary scalar recurrence u_(j+1)=2u_j has a fixed unit-circle gap, yet left data u_0=1 grow to 2^j. Its reciprocal recurrence demonstrates the opposite direction. These examples concern the broad operator class, not a proposed replacement knot state. Nor does (4) prove a tame inverse for any chosen square compression. For example I-2T has min_(|L|=1)|1-2L|=1, but the n-by-n upper bidiagonal compression has inverse sum_(k=0)^(n-1)2^k T^k, of norm at least 2^(n-1). It has dropped an output leakage row and imposed the wrong boundary condition. The full-output estimate and (7) retain precisely the boundary data which prevent that inference. There is a genuine one-sided improvement under an EXTRA checkable stability condition. Suppose the monic actual companion equals T(j/N) up to O(1/N), with T uniformly bounded and Lipschitz, and has uniformly rho(T(x))<=1-delta on the interval. Then its positive Lyapunov metric sum_(k>=0)(T^dagger)^k T^k/(1-delta/2)^(2k) is uniformly bounded and Lipschitz. Its neighboring metric changes are 1+O(1/N), so for large N the actual transfer contracts by 1-c_delta. Variation of constants gives a uniform one-sided bound from the full LEFT initial packet and its actual sources. If the inverse companions have that property, the analogous theorem uses the RIGHT packet. Mixed stable/unstable spectra do not satisfy either premise. For an actual geometric radius between spectral branches, mixed spectra are the usual case. The missing incoming packet is then genuine source data, not an error that the local gap controls. The pointed initial rows, cyclic root matching and normal resonance must determine it with a quantified bound. This is exactly the boundary-response problem retained by the positive Schur reduction. For the ACTUAL bounded-jet problem the initial fixed-color packet is known polynomially, including all its retained jets. The far packet is different: the ordinary-color theorem bounds only CONSTANT values C_j(q_N), j<N, not their q-normal jets. Those jets, and the complete coordinate itself, may carry exponential size. Replacing the full right-hand packet in (8)--(10) by the ordinary-color bound would therefore drop source data. Bounding it by an unknown multiple of the target period would not close the estimate either. An actual cyclic/Weyl or source-Schur certificate is needed there. ## 6. Consequence for a sharp volume estimate The theorem gives controlled inward propagation on every certified regular interval. It accounts for repeated roots away from the chosen circle, nonnormal jet blocks and shrinking gaps. A regulator primitive is a legitimate weight there only on a genuinely identified peripheral branch. It must also retain its SOURCE anchor: normalizing the small-color source changes the recovery factor to R(x)-R(0), which may be as large as twice the knot volume. It follows that a sharp Vol upper bound needs a quantified connection of the actual endpoint/turning packets, with that source anchoring. Equations (7)--(10) remove uncontrolled regular-interval amplification from this question; they do not supply those remaining boundary values or assume them equal to the desired invariant. [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_pointed_a_interval_observability.py): actual full-source figure-eight intervals with full leakage rows, explicit nonnormal Green kernels and the finite-compression caution. The all-operator proof is (2)--(10); the finite checks do not assert a new sharp knot class.

title: The actual pointed commutant is scalar on its selected Mellin state
text:
# The actual pointed commutant is scalar on its selected Mellin state Research obstruction and constructive formal adapter, 27 October 2026. The canonical actual Mellin companion cannot directly provide a nontrivial irreducible critical-field observable through an endomorphism which commutes with whole quantum transport and preserves its source lattice. Such endomorphisms have a scalar character on the selected state. A concrete critical observable instead exists on the actual partial Gaussian insertion module; it has a covariant, rather than horizontal, transport rule. No geometric candidate for the final selected cyclotomic residue is constructed here. The distinction identifies a necessary change of object before applying the critical trace nonvanishing theorem. ## 1. The entire admissible horizontal lattice is one-dimensional Use the original [actual Mellin source](fourier_mellin_actual_source.md), with F=k(Q,X), R=k(Q)[[X]], sigma(X)=QX, and Q an indeterminate: \[ AZ=B
e0,\qquad Z\in X^{n_0}R,\qquad \widehat A=(S-\sigma(B)/B)A. \] All fixed left-shift conventions, source coefficients and finite color pointing are those of that construction. Its exact affine equation has exactly one solution in this lattice. Let d be the order of \(\widehat A\), C its forward companion, \(T=C^{-1}\sigma\), \(v=J_dZ\), and \(\ell J_df=Af/B\). If \(w\in k(Q)((X))^d\) satisfies \(Tw=w\), the companion's first rows force \(w=J_dW\) for its first component W. If also \(W\in X^{n_0}R\), then \[ h=\ell w=AW/B,\qquad \sigma h=h. \] The sigma invariants of k(Q)((X)) are exactly k(Q): its coefficient of X^j satisfies \((Q^j-1)h_j=0\), which forces h_j=0 for j!=0. Thus h=c(Q). The source-lattice uniqueness gives \[ W=c(Q)Z,\qquad w=c(Q)v. 	ag{1.1} \] No minimal-annihilator, semisimplicity or rationality of Z is assumed. This statement concerns the supplied homogeneous SOURCE object and its lattice, not arbitrary solutions in a larger formal lattice. ## 2. A whole admissible endomorphism has a scalar character Let Theta be an F-linear companion endomorphism with \[ \Theta T=T\Theta. 	ag{2.1} \] Require that Theta preserves the specified formal source lattice, or just that the first component of Theta v lies in X^(n_0)R. For instance a matrix regular at X=0 preserves X^(n_0)R^d and has this property. Rational poles at X=0 do NOT automatically preserve it; the actual lattice condition must be checked. The vector Theta v is horizontal. Equation (1.1) therefore gives \[ \Theta v=\chi(\Theta)v, \qquad \chi(\Theta)\in k(Q). 	ag{2.2} \] On the algebra of lattice-preserving endomorphisms, chi is a unital algebra character. It is exactly computable by \[ \chi(\Theta)=[X^0]\,\ell\Theta J_dZ. 	ag{2.3} \] Only finitely many fixed color coefficients enter this constant coefficient for a fixed rational Theta. Thus this is a consequence of the ACTUAL finite pointing, not an unmarked eigenvalue choice. In particular Theta cannot satisfy an irreducible polynomial \(p(z)\in F[z]\) of degree greater than one: applying p(Theta) to v gives p(chi(Theta))=0, a rational root of that polynomial. Hence the full actual pointed companion does not carry the irreducible critical observable proposed in [the critical trace theorem](irreducible_critical_source_and_whole_norm.md) through such an admissible horizontal endomorphism. The same obstruction is visible in exact moments: \[ \ell\Theta^jv=\chi(\Theta)^j,\qquad \operatorname{rank}(m_{i+j})_{i,j}=1. 	ag{2.4} \] At any admissible root, monodromy H_0 itself satisfies H_0v_0=v_0, so \(\ell_0H_0^jv_0=1\). Functional calculus of that monodromy sees only this source-one direction, regardless of the other spectrum. It cannot manufacture higher critical moments or identify its characteristic polynomial with the classical A-polynomial. Neither (2.2) nor (2.4) proves that the knot has no geometric period quotient. They exclude this particular construction on the raw pointed object. Endomorphisms which do not preserve the lattice, root-only operators without a whole lift, relative correspondences, and observables with a nonzero covariant derivative are different objects. ## 3. Actual inserted partial moments provide a different observable There is a concrete associated-graded adapter before final framing contraction. Use the ACTUAL two-index partial family and nondegenerate transverse formal contraction of [the partial support theorem](partial_geometric_support_theorem.md). Keep both framing indices external and the full base, cut, pivot, half-density and peripheral normalization lines. Put H=Log Q. Let F_0 be the rational function field of the external meridian and framing variables on the marked chart, and K/F_0 its finite separable geometric critical field, of degree d. Keep any Gaussian line separate from K; a square-root sign is not an extra critical point. The field K is generated by the critical values of the actual internal flow monomials z_i=Q^(j_i). A fixed rational linear combination \(	heta=\sum c_i z_i\) can be chosen primitive: each pair of distinct embeddings excludes one proper linear hyperplane of choices c, and there are finitely many pairs. The insertions theta^j, 0<=j<d, are literal finite sums of monomial weights on the SAME finite array. They change no underlying invariant or selected source. Their unweighted member j=0 is the original partial array. Let G_sigma be its transverse formal contraction at the conjugate critical place sigma and form \[ M_{\sigma,j}(H)=  rac{G_\sigma(	heta^j I)}{G_\sigma(I)}, \quad 0\le j<d. 	ag{3.1} \] The denominator is nonzero by the actual transverse support theorem. The common exponential and base line cancel in this ratio. Termwise formal Gaussian contraction gives algebraic coefficients and \[ M_{\sigma,j}=\sigma(	heta)^j+O(H). 	ag{3.2} \] Thus M is a unit matrix over the normal closure's formal H-ring: its leading determinant is the nonzero Vandermonde. Define \[ D_	heta=\operatorname{diag}(\sigma	heta),\qquad \Theta_H=M^{-1}D_	heta M. 	ag{3.3} \] This is an explicit formula from d actual inserted partial moments, at every formal order. Galois conjugation permutes both the rows of M and the entries of D_theta, so Theta_H descends to F_0[[H]]. It satisfies the exact irreducible critical relation \[ p(\Theta_H)=0, 	ag{3.4} \] where p is the minimal polynomial of theta. Its leading operator is multiplication by theta in the power basis. The distinguished source e_0 has M e_0=(1,...,1)^t; it has not been replaced by a favored critical point. The matrix in (3.3) is a completed formal insertion operator, not an actual finite-N companion endomorphism or a claim that the raw multiplication theta commutes with quantum integration. Generally Theta_H e_0 is NOT e_1: the raw first insertion column is sigma(theta)+O(H), while M Theta_H e_0 is exactly sigma(theta). Powers of Theta_H therefore correspond to explicitly renormalized combinations of insertion columns, including their formal counterterms, rather than to the uncorrected higher raw moments. ## 4. Its covariant rule explains the escape from the obstruction Let delta be the external meridian derivation, extended uniquely to the separable critical field. In the normalized branch frame the insertion connection is ordinary differentiation. In the actual moment frame it is \[ 
abla=M^{-1}\delta M =\delta+M^{-1}(\delta M). \] Its commutator with the critical observable is exactly \[ [
abla,\Theta_H] =M^{-1}\operatorname{diag}(\delta\sigma	heta)M. 	ag{4.1} \] The analogous formal meridian difference rule uses the actual transverse block ratios b_sigma=T G_sigma(I)/G_sigma(I), already constructed in the partial support theorem. In branch coordinates transport is diag(b_sigma) sigma_H. Pulling this back by M gives the exact conjugation rule \[ \mathcal T_H\Theta_H\mathcal T_H^{-1} =M^{-1}\operatorname{diag}(\sigma_H(\sigma	heta))M. 	ag{4.2} \] Equations (4.1)--(4.2) are Leibniz/covariant laws, not the zero commutator (2.1). If theta varies on the geometric branch, the commutator (4.1) and the conjugation DIFFERENCE T_H Theta_H T_H^(-1)-Theta_H in (4.2) are nonzero. In addition the coefficient field and lattice are those of the completed critical insertion module, not the original formal X-lattice. Both changes are essential. This constructs the correct formal shape observable from actual insertions rather than guessing an extra monodromy eigenvalue. It still leaves an explicit gap: the final finite two-index co-source, its endpoint carries and logarithmic moments have not been mapped to the trace pairing on this insertion module. Hence (3.3) gives no selected critical trace weight or global volume norm. The exact boundary currents in the full certificate must still be transported through that map. No q^N, M^N, parity, or peripheral factor has been discarded in making the partial formal adapter. ## 5. The raw actual compact co-source has infinite moment rank There is a second concrete obstruction to extracting a finite critical field directly from the unmodified cut. The exact [actual centralizer Toeplitz row](centralizer_normal_residue_and_actual_cut_moments.md) has on the identity insertion the moments \[ \mu(b^h)= rac1N\sum_{j=0}^{N-1} (-1)^h rac{(j+1)^{\overline h}}{(N+1)^{\overline h}} = rac{(-1)^h}{h+1}. 	ag{5.1} \] The equality follows by summing (j+1)^(rising h)=h! binom(j+h,h). These moments are the same at EVERY N and equal the integral of (-T)^h on 0<=T<=1. Every finite Hankel matrix (mu(b^(i+j))) is nonsingular: after removing the alternating signs its quadratic form is \[ \int_0^1|\sum_i c_iT^i|^2dT>0 \] for a nonzero coefficient vector. Thus this raw co-source cannot factor through any finite algebra k[b]/p with nonzero p. Such a factorization would force mu(p q)=0 for every polynomial q; taking q to have the conjugate coefficients gives a strictly positive integral. The same argument can be made after any generic complex specialization of the remaining rational parameters. This is compatible with the finite matrix size: the actual Toeplitz maps T_N(b^h) are NOT powers of T_N(b). Their multiplication is a star product. Consequently a finite initial trace-Gram calculation does not certify a polynomial relation for the raw b insertion. The full relation moments must be proved after the proposed action-normalized or relative reduction. The renormalized observable in Section 3 and the raw compact coordinate are different objects.

title: Pointed metric certificates and the cost of a modulus crossing
text: # Pointed metric certificates and the cost of a modulus crossing 28 October 2026. A varying positive metric gives an exact transport certificate for the original source. It is useful only when its source cost and conditioning are bounded independently. A concrete two-channel calculation below shows that a full-space quadratic certificate with subexponential conditioning can still be forced to pay the pointwise spectral envelope, even for a specified single input and output. Thus source endpoint costs alone do not recover coherent phase cancellation. This complements, and does not reprove, [the exact Gaussian conversion example](analytic_two_channel_conversion_counterexample.md). The example is an analytic matrix cocycle, not an actual knot operator. The final section states a source-specific adjoint certificate whose geometric construction remains open. ## 1. Exact metric and cocycle statements Let v_(j+1)=T_j v_j, j=0,...,n-1, with original input v_0=s and original output A=l^*v_n. For positive definite Hermitian H_j, T_j^*H_(j+1)T_j <= exp(2h_j) H_j (1) is equivalent, by taking square roots, to ||H_(j+1)^(1/2) T_j H_j^(-1/2)||<=exp(h_j). There is no scalarity or unitarity assumption. Iteration gives |A| <= exp(sum h_j) sqrt[(s^*H_0s)(l^*H_n^(-1)l)]. (2) All actual external source factors multiply (2) unchanged. Applied to the actual recurrence in [the macroscopic source theorem](actual_macroscopic_a_spectral_upper_bound.md), the certificate must be uniform on its specified tiny complex-q circle. Its entire original initial color packet is s; it cannot be replaced by a truncated normal Taylor series. The usual finite-horizon Gramian clarifies what (1) proves. Normalize A_j=exp(-h_j)T_j and write P_(k:j)=A_(k-1)...A_j, P_(j:j)=I. If ||P_(k:j)||<=B_N for EVERY subinterval, then H_j=sum_(k=j)^n P_(k:j)^*P_(k:j) =I+A_j^*H_(j+1)A_j, I<=H_j<=(n-j+1)B_N^2 I. (3) Conversely a certificate I<=H_j<=C_N I bounds every normalized subproduct by sqrt(C_N). Thus a uniformly tame full-space Gramian is essentially equivalent to a tame bound for ALL subproducts, not merely the selected full scalar. Formula (3), constructed from unknown products, is an equivalence and not a new geometric estimate. Scalar rescalings of H_j move telescoping scalar terms into h_j. They do not remove anisotropic condition numbers; the endpoint source factor in (2) must always be retained. There is an exact test using ANY fixed partition of the time interval. Let P_i be its subproducts and let J list the partition nodes, including both endpoints. The logarithmic right side B of (2) obeys B>=sum_i log||P_i||+log(||s|| ||l||) -1/2 sum_(j in J) log cond H_j. (3a) Indeed each interval costs at least log||P_i|| minus its endpoint metric ratio. Interior scalar ratios telescope, leaving the displayed condition numbers. The source costs satisfy s^*H_0s>=lambda_min(H_0)||s||^2 and l^*H_n^(-1)l>=||l||^2/lambda_max(H_n), proving (3a). Thus tame full metrics cannot hide known large subinterval norms. An actual source norm which is exponentially small is still retained in (3a); no lower bound on an unknown color packet is assumed. ## 2. An exact lower bound on every positive quadratic certificate Suppose each T_j is upper triangular in one fixed orthonormal basis. Split at an arbitrary m and write P_pre=T_(m-1)...T_0 and P_post=T_(n-1)...T_m. Their diagonal entries have the form e_2^*P_pre=D_pre e_2^*, P_post e_1=A_post e_1. Keep the actual source s=e_2 and l=e_1, not an operator norm source. Define the full bound furnished by (2) as B=sum_j h_j+1/2 log[(H_0)_(22)(H_n^(-1))_(11)]. Then EVERY positive definite certificate (1) satisfies exactly B >= log|D_pre A_post|-1/2 log cond(H_m). (4) Proof. The pre-product inequality, in its dual norm, gives |D_pre|^2 (H_0^(-1))_(22) <=exp(2h_pre)(H_m^(-1))_(22). Since H_(22)(H^(-1))_(22)>=1, this implies (H_0)_(22)>=exp(-2h_pre)|D_pre|^2/(H_m^(-1))_(22). The post-product inequality on e_1 gives (H_n^(-1))_(11) >=exp(-2h_post)|A_post|^2/(H_m)_(11). Multiply, and use (H_m)_(11)(H_m^(-1))_(22)<=cond(H_m). This proves (4). Neither endpoint is required to be comparable to the identity; their EXACT actual-source costs are already included in B. ## 3. Distinct expanding roots still force the envelope cost Use the analytic cocycle from the cited conversion proof, allowing a harmless common positive multiplier exp(c): T_(N,j)=exp(c) [[exp(a(j/N-1/2)), N^(-p)], [0,exp(-a(j/N-1/2)+i theta)]], 0<theta<min(a,pi), p fixed, j=0,...,N-1. (5) Its two eigenvalues are distinct at every real x and their moduli cross at x=1/2. Choosing c>a/2 makes BOTH roots expanding everywhere. The separately proved exact Gaussian computation gives lim (1/N)log|e_1^*P_N e_2| =c+Gamma, Gamma=a/4-theta^2/(4a)>0. (6) Each complete marked eigenbranch instead has rate c. The pointwise spectral envelope has rate c+a/4. No real eigenvalue collision is involved in these different quantities. Take m=ceil(N/2). Directly summing the two diagonal logarithms gives log|D_pre A_post|=N(c+a/4)+O(1/N). Therefore (4) yields B/N >=c+a/4-(log cond H_m)/(2N)+O(N^(-2)). (7) If log cond H_m=o(N), this FULL-SPACE quadratic certificate pays at least the scalar envelope, although the actual selected amplitude has the smaller rate (6). To reach its true rate with (1)--(2), log cond H_m >= N theta^2/(2a)-o(N). (8) Exponential anisotropy is thus necessary for that improvement. This is not a zero-source example or an appeal to a backward metric. It applies to the nonzero, explicitly calculated source in (6). The same issue can occur at a modulus-only crossing such as the independently derived 6_1 quartic; this does NOT assert that the model cocycle (5) is its actual quantum recurrence. ## 4. What a source-restricted certificate would need A semidefinite observable Gramian can exclude irrelevant directions. If H_n>=ll^* and T_j^*H_(j+1)T_j<=exp(2h_j)H_j, then |A|^2<=exp(2 sum h_j) s^*H_0s. (9) The rank-one choice H_j=w_jw_j^* with the EXACT backward adjoint w_j=T_j^*w_(j+1), w_n=l satisfies equality. Its initial pairing is the UNKNOWN answer itself. Likewise restricting to the exact forward trajectory line gives condition number one but requires knowing that trajectory. Neither observation supplies the missing estimate. There is, however, a useful independently checkable residual criterion. Give explicit candidate adjoint vectors w_j with w_n=l and defects r_j=w_j-T_j^*w_(j+1). For the original forward state one has the exact identity A=w_0^*s-sum_(j=0)^(n-1) r_j^*v_j. (10) Thus any proved forward bounds ||v_j||<=B_j imply |A|<=|w_0^*s|+sum_j B_j ||r_j||. (11) The safe spectral-envelope theorem already supplies forward bounds of this kind on its actual denominator-avoiding circle. To improve the final exponent, one must CONSTRUCT w_j whose original boundary pairing and weighted residual sum in (11) have the desired geometric rate. Algebraic WKB candidates and their finite-difference residuals can be tested directly; merely taking formal O(1/N) residuals does not suffice when B_j is exponentially large. The equivalent positive defect estimate is also explicit: for eta>0, T_j^*w_(j+1)w_(j+1)^*T_j <=(1+eta)w_jw_j^*+(1+eta^(-1))r_jr_j^*. It retains the entire residual observable rather than inserting an uncontrolled positive completion of a rank-one metric. The Gaussian conversion example shows that those residuals may encode a genuine additional exponential branch action. Distinct roots and a real modulus gap alone cannot justify deleting it.
