One may divide by z first; the remaining function vanishes at z=-h for h!=0 and hence also at h=0 by holomorphy, which proves divisibility by z+h. The h^0 term of (5) is zero because E_b(z)+E_b(-z)=2[A+2b sin^2(pi z)]. The h^1 term is zero as well. To verify its normalization explicitly, let gap=E_b(z)-E_b(-z). The coefficient needed in log e is (gap'-[partial_z Log tan(pi z)] gap)/(2 gap) =(1/2)partial_z Log[gap/tan(pi z)] =(1/2)partial_z Log J_b(z)=a_b(z). (6) Here gap/tan(pi z)=4cos(pi z)sqrt[T_b^2+b^2sin^2(pi z)] is a nonzero even function. Thus (6) has no fold pole. The constant case is exact. Since F(z,0)=partial_h F(z,0)=0, division gives Rcal(z,h)=h^2 z(z+h) F_2(z,h), |e_b^*(z,h)-(the RHS of (3) applied to e_b^*)| <=C h^2 |z|. (7) The latter quotient at z=-h is understood by its removable limit; (7) is a uniform analytic residual bound on a smaller fixed disk. This analytic residual controls the ACTUAL physical real sequence. The original positive pivot bound e_a>=A is already proved. On a small positive real interval e_b^*(z,h)/A>=exp(c z) for small h, unless T_b=0, which is exact. Subtract (3) for the two sequences and use the same positive Gaussian propagation kernel as in the signed theorem. Start at 2delta0 and estimate only z<=delta0. Its initial error is exponentially suppressed. With z=k/N the residual (7) is O(k/N^3), so sum_(j>=k) C(k/j)e^[-c(j^2-k^2)/N] j/N^3 <=C/N^2. For k<=sqrt(N) use a Gaussian integral; for k>=sqrt(N) use tail length O(N/k). Therefore, uniformly at all physical real pivots with 0<z<=delta0, including k=1/2 or1, e_a/e_b^*(z,1/N)=1+O(N^-2). (8) No actual meromorphic index continuation or generic-q normal has been asserted in this passage. ## 3. The fixed real folded packet Let delta=(d-2a)/(2N), delta_min=s0/(2N), so successive channel steps have size h and the removed pivot is at their MIDPOINT. The forced-factor ratio is exactly D at the same midpoint. Taking the logarithm of these step ratios and using (8), then the midpoint quadrature formula, proves uniformly for delta_min<=delta<=delta0 on the original integer-channel grid B_(N,a)/B_(N,M) =exp[-N(V(delta)-V(delta_min))] *sqrt[ J_b(delta_min)J_c(delta_min) /(J_b(delta)J_c(delta)) ] *[1+O(N^-1)]. (9) Indeed each step has log ratio -V'(z)-h(a_b(z)+a_c(z))+O(h^2). There are O(N) steps. The midpoint sum for V' has total error O(h), and that for h a has error O(h^2). Its integral is one half of the logarithm of the J product. Formula (9) retains the actual even-level delta_min, the scalar beta and the forced product. It gives the earlier Gaussian packet by expanding V(delta)=C delta^2+O(delta^4), with C=pi(T_b+T_c)/A. In particular the limiting rate is even analytic; there is no cubic term in this centered variable. The RIGHT HAND SIDE of (9) is a specified holomorphic model on a fixed complex disk. The comparison in (9) is proved on the physical REAL grid. An O(N^-1) error there cannot be treated as an exponentially small Fourier error when the frequency is of order N. Uniform complex continuation of the exact finite source, or an exponentially accurate physical-grid replacement with controlled analytic remainder, is a further requirement. ## 4. An exact source-native reflected sequence There is nevertheless an exact full finite sequence across the fold. Let H_a^1 be the actual root q-Hahn Newton numerator, for every integer 0<=a<=d. Define its homogeneous polynomial Z_a(x,b,y)=(-q)^a q^(-a^2)y^a H_a^1(-x/(qb),-b/(qy)). (10) The finite Newton sum makes this a polynomial: each denominator b or y cancels in its own summand. Thus zero faces are assigned by polynomial evaluation. Below the fold, the original determinant identity gives Z_a=beta_a D_a, with its exact phase. For m=d-a>=a and s=m-a, the actual root numerator collision is H_m^1(U,V)=product_(r=a)^(m-1)(UV-Q^r) H_a^1(U,V). It follows either from the original Newton coefficient identity or the already proved large-partner relation in [the source gauge theorem](actual_generic_boundary_gauge_and_source.md). Here UV=Q^-1 x/y. Its product is Q^-s y^-s P_s(x,y), while the ratio of monomials in (10) is (-1)^s q^[s-(m^2-a^2)] y^s. Since m+a=d and q^N=-1, the remaining scalar is (-1)^s q^(-sN)=1. Hence EXACTLY Z_(d-a)(x,b,y)=P_s(x,y) Z_a(x,b,y). (11) This uses the actual large numerator; beta_m D_m is not evaluated at a singular virtual matrix. Define the virtual forced factor in the partner range to be P_s^-1. Its product with the two Z_m factors has a polynomial cancellation, giving B_ext,(d-a)=Z_(d-a)^b Z_(d-a)^c/P_s =Z_a^b Z_a^c P_s=B_(N,a). (12) At the even bridge (11) is Z_(M+1)=(x+y)Z_M. At the first odd bridge it is Z_(M+1)=P_2 Z_(M-1). Thus all endpoints remain specified even where a naively divided recurrence would be singular. The canceled rational presentation in (12) does not introduce a pole on its polynomial value. Finally omega_(d-a)=omega_a exactly, because its ratio is (-1)^s q^(Ns)=1. Pairing the two original integer indices therefore gives the exact Fourier identity sum_(a=0)^M k_a omega_a^epsilon B_(N,a) cos[pi(d-2a)chi] =sum_(a=0)^d omega_a^epsilon B_ext,a exp[pi i(d-2a)chi]. (13) It holds for every complex chi. The same equality holds after the unchanged shared-face coefficient extraction and tensoring the circle color registers. It is exactly the complete-image core of [the entire color packet](actual_augmented_plat_entire_core_color_packet.md), not the full mixed source: its explicit nonempty ordinary-color alias subsets remain present. The finite support and both parities are retained; there is no cyclic replacement of the physical head interval and no choice of a new Fourier interpolation. ## 5. A finite q-difference system with its endpoints retained The reflected sequence also has an exact quantum difference system. Use the polynomial Z_j of (10) for 0<=j<=d. Clearing the denominators in the original second-order recurrence gives u_j Z_j^b=v_j^b Z_(j-1)^b-w_j Z_(j-2)^b, u_j=cos((j-1)theta)sin(j theta), v_j^b=sin((2j-1)theta) [A+2b cos(j theta)cos((j-1)theta)], w_j=sin((j-1)theta)cos(j theta) [A^2-4xy cos^2((j-1)theta)]. (14) Set Z_-1=0. Below the fold (14) is the original continuant, including j=1. Above it (11) proves (14) without dividing by a vanishing u_j. Explicitly set l=d-j and D_r=(x-Q^r y)(x-Q^(-r)y). The reflected coefficients satisfy u_j=-w_(l+2)/D_(l+1), v_j^b=-v_(l+2)^b, w_j=-u_(l+2)D_(l+2). After inserting Z_j=P_(d-2l)Z_l, equation (14) becomes the negative of the lower recurrence at l+2 times its common factor. The first fold bridges are checked directly: at odd N the middle coefficient at j=M+1 is zero and (11) is precisely the resulting equation; at even N the equation at j=M+1 gives Z_(M+1)=A Z_M, and the equation at j=M+2 is its retained zero-leading-coefficient consequence. Thus it does not choose a second solution there. At the last index j=N, u_N=0 and the recurrence is still exact: Z_d=P_d and Z_(d-1)=P_(d-2)Z_1, with P_d=D_1 P_(d-2), give v_N^b Z_d=w_N Z_(d-1). This is the actual terminal relation, not a periodic closing arrow. Let Pcal_j denote P_(d-2j) below the fold and its canceled reciprocal presentation above it. Uniformly, Pcal_j=P_d/product_(r=1)^j D_r, Pcal_j/Pcal_(j-1)=D_j^(-1), 0<=j<=d. Work over the face coefficient ring localized at product_(r=1)^d D_r. These factors do not vanish on the stated positive radius compacts. The auxiliary components below may be RATIONAL face functions; only their first component has already been proved to be the original homogeneous face polynomial after cancellation. Put Y_j=(Z_j^b Z_j^c, Z_j^b Z_(j-1)^c, Z_(j-1)^b Z_j^c, Z_(j-1)^b Z_(j-1)^c)^T, V_j=omega_j^epsilon Pcal_j Y_j. The tensor product of (14), with all factors still ordered, is u_j^2 D_j V_j=(-Q^j)^epsilon M_j V_(j-1), M_j= [ v_j^b v_j^c, -v_j^b w_j, -w_j v_j^c, w_j^2 ] [ u_j v_j^b, 0, -u_j w_j, 0 ] [ u_j v_j^c, -u_j w_j, 0, 0 ] [ u_j^2, 0, 0, 0 ]. (15) Here the exact twist ratio is omega_j/omega_(j-1)=-Q^j. Extend V_j by ZERO outside 0,...,d. Equation (15) holds at j=0 because u_0=0, and at j=N because its first row is the product of the two terminal scalar relations while its other rows contain u_N. Thus (15) is exact on the entire integer line with that finite support. No endpoint term has been discarded. All coefficients in (15) are Laurent polynomials in w=Q^j. For explicit substitution, put S(w)=(q^(-1)w-q w^(-1))/(2i), C(w)=(q^(-1)w+q w^(-1))/2, u(w)=[S(w)+sin(theta)]/2, v_b(w)=S(w)[A+b(C(w)+cos(theta))], wcoef(w)=[S(w)-sin(theta)]/2 *[x^2+y^2-xy(Q^(-1)w+Q w^(-1))], D(w)=x^2+y^2-xy(w+w^(-1)), L(w)=u(w)^2 D(w). Form M(w) from the displayed matrix using these Laurent functions. For the ACTUAL finite polynomial vector and shift mathcal V(z)=sum_(j=0)^d V_j z^j, Theta f(z)=f(Qz), coefficientwise summation of (15) gives exactly [L(Theta)-z(-Q Theta)^epsilon M(Q Theta)] mathcal V(z)=0. (16) The system has four components, z degree at most one, and Theta powers only in [-5,5] for epsilon in {0,1,-1}, independently of N: L has powers in [-3,3], M in [-4,4], and the twist shifts these by at most one. This is not merely the root identity Theta^N-1. It is a root-level external-color system, not a generic-q, varying-N colored-Jones AJ operator. The first component, multiplied by exp(pi i d chi) at z=exp(-2pi i chi), is the literal single-circle Fourier core in (13). Keep this Fourier gauge when naming the external shift. If mathcal S(chi)=exp(pi i d chi) mathcal V(exp(-2pi i chi)), then exp(pi i d chi) Theta mathcal V =q^d mathcal S(chi-1/N). Thus on the full source vector Theta is q^d times the unit deficit shift chi -> chi-1/N, not the bare shift. Equation (16) uses its specified finite period, not a solution chosen by a formal asymptotic expansion. After the full source's face coefficient extraction, face multiplications in (16) couple nearby coefficient indices; no closed scalar equation for an arbitrary whole network is asserted without retaining that coupled family. ## 6. Its local principal characteristic and remaining analytic issue For a/N->mu write r=cos^2(pi mu), A=x+y, D=A^2-4xy r, B_b=A+2br, B_c=A+2cr. The original single scaled-continuant characteristic is e_b^2-2B_b e_b+D=0. Tensoring the two roots and dividing by the forced-factor ratio gives the four eigenvalues lambda=e_b e_c/D. Their characteristic is the explicit palindromic quartic D(lambda^4+1)-4B_b B_c(lambda^3+lambda) +(4B_b^2+4B_c^2-2D)lambda^2=0. (17) Indeed each root pair multiplies to D; their pairwise products give the displayed elementary symmetric functions. The original twist multiplies lambda by (-J)^epsilon, J=exp(2pi i mu). The Fourier stationary characteristic of (16) is therefore z (-J)^epsilon lambda=1. (18) The reduced quartic must not erase the factors of the FULL finite system. In the classical limit u=(1/2)sin(2pi mu) and M_cl=u^2 times the tensor transfer matrix. If P(w) denotes the left side of (17), the full principal determinant is det[L_cl I-z(-J)^epsilon M_cl] =u^8 D^3 P(z(-J)^epsilon). (19) Thus (17) is the reduced characteristic where uD!=0. At the complete fold u=0 the full symbol degenerates; these factors have not been declared globally harmless peripheral factors or canceled from the actual operator. It is the specified finite source and its endpoint relations, together with the selected analytic branch, that provide the extension discussed here. For real mu just below1/2, the positive original pivots select e_b=E_b(1/2-mu), e_c=E_c(1/2-mu), with the single-variable cases interpreted as above. Their continued local logarithmic branch is fixed by (1), not by an arbitrary root of (17). This identifies the principal characteristic of the actual finite source system. Equations (16)--(18) do not yet prove a uniform complex-color packet, the nonzero coefficient of a deformed period, an actual global A-polynomial identification, or a gap for the ordinary-color alias subsets. title: The radial positive Fourier comparison does not supply a common geometric frame
status: Conditional radial-frame obstruction; no rate gap
text: # The radial positive Fourier comparison does not supply a common geometric frame 30 October 2026. The positive coefficient partition retains the original shared Kirchhoff and Fourier constraints. Nevertheless its ordinary radial coefficient saddles cannot all assemble into the complete geometric representation of a certified right-angled augmented plat. The obstruction is conditional on that proposed assembly; it is not an exponential gap theorem for the positive partition. ## 1. Actual source and geometric hypotheses Use the original marked matching source and the positive partition of [the shared Fourier comparison](actual_matching_graph_positive_fourier_partition.md). Retain its actual port orders, cup/cap monomials, half-twist phases, folded channels and exact ordinary channel metric. For the geometric conclusion assume the literal Morse-prefix and positive right-angled matching-polyhedron certificate of [the selected-frame obstruction](actual_right_angled_selected_framing_obstruction.md). Hyperbolicity alone is not substituted for that certificate. At matching edge i write xi_i=a_i/N, omega_i=w_i/N, rho_i=|omega_i|, t_i=d-|w_i|, tau_i=t_i/N, lambda_v=k_v/N. We discuss strict radial saddles: in the limiting coordinates 1/2<tau_i<1, 0<lambda_v<xi_i, and xi_i>0. The complete support condition is rho_i<=xi_i. Any assertion about the COMPLETE geometric representation further requires its endpoint channel xi_i=1/2 at every crossing disk. A saddle at other channels is not identified with that complete representation. The coefficient variational theorem supplies the actual selected ordinary kernel at y_v=log w_v^*, nu_v=tau_i/2-i y_v/(2pi), Y_v^*=exp[2pi i(lambda_v+1/2-xi_i)]. (1) Here w_v^*>0 is the coefficient's radial tilt; it is unrelated to the signed integral matching variable w_i. These are local ordinary kernel statements, not a claim about completed partner amplitudes. ## 2. Why every radial local factor is central The central domain of the proved joint packet is 1/2<Re tau<1, |2Re nu-Re tau|<1/2. (2) Every point (1) lies strictly in this domain, since its last expression is zero. The local source selects its continued characteristic there. This assertion respects BOTH actual degree adapters. In the low block the original physical wires are nu and tau-nu, with real parts tau/2. In the high block they are 1+nu-tau and 1-nu, with real parts 1-tau/2. Thus the high adapter has the same normalized central point; it is not obtained by applying a low formula to the wrong physical total degree. Reversing the two physical ports replaces nu by tau-nu and leaves the central property intact. It also respects BOTH ends of a matching edge. The actual white map is the reversed conjugate Clebsch column with its ordinary positive channel metric. The exact shared-cycle compiler proves that, after its own endpoint scalar, it uses the SAME normalized finite f as the black map. The distinct physical input/output momentum conventions are those of the selected-local certificate; they are not changed by declaring a new reciprocal branch. Consequently, if these factors assemble into an actual framed critical representation, every input and every output has the source-selected central coordinate (2). It follows immediately from the selected-frame obstruction that: No all-ordinary strict radial Fourier reconstruction can assemble into the complete positively oriented geometric representation in one common actual source frame. (3) The geometric theorem covers the retained half twists and actual projection prefixes. The contradiction does not use a freely chosen circle packing or unrelated face labels. In particular adding the real constrained stationarity equations of the positive partition cannot make such an assembly possible: (3) already holds before those extra equations are imposed. ## 3. The exact coefficient phase contains missing coordinate data This failure is also visible directly in the original finite source. On physical cycle c write the actual FIRST port at vertex v as u_v=epsilon_v x_c+B_v, epsilon_v in {+1,-1}, b_v=max(0,T_i-d), T_i=d+w_i. The scalar B_v is the literal propagated affine offset. It is not reduced modulo N. The exact vertex expansion is c_v c_(t_i,a_i) sum_k p_(t_i,a_i,k) q^[(d-2a_i+2k)(epsilon_v x_c+B_v-b_v)-t_i k]. (4) After extracting the x_c character, the k-dependent residual phase in (4) has the exact successive ratio exp{2pi i[(B_v-b_v)/N-t_i/(2N)]}. (5) No endpoint scalar, cup monomial or half-twist factor changes (5), because those factors are independent of this coefficient index k. Other vertices retain their own coefficient indices. Thus on a fixed affine sign chamber, the leading logarithmic phase has derivative with respect to lambda_v equal to 2pi i delta_v, delta_v=(B_v-b_v)/N-tau_i/2. (6) Taking positive moduli deletes exactly this derivative. In contrast, the positive coefficient action L has derivative L_lambda=-y_v. The positive constrained lambda equations therefore match the real radial tilts through cycle multipliers, but do not by themselves match the real magnetic coordinates. More explicitly, suppose one tries to reconstruct the same radial local saddle on the original physical cycle. Write X_c=x_c/N. Its actual normalized first coordinate must satisfy nu_v=epsilon_v X_c+(B_v-b_v)/N. (7) Combining (7) with (1) requires BOTH equations epsilon_v Im X_c=-y_v/(2pi), epsilon_v Re X_c+delta_v=0. (8) The first is the radial magnitude matching. The second is the real center matching whose term is retained by (5),(6) and omitted in the positive envelope. It is not a consequence of Kirchhoff closure. Equivalently, on the original displayed logarithmic character, if one introduces a complex multiplier Lambda_c for the cycle's linear coefficient constraint, the local equation is -y_v+2pi i delta_v+epsilon_v Lambda_c=0. (9) With Lambda_c=2pi i X_c, (9) gives exactly (8). A real multiplier for the positive action retains only its real part. All of these statements concern the original affine lift. Introducing additional logarithmic characters or changing that lift would be extra data, not a justification for deleting (5). ## 4. What the retained Fourier constraints do prove The positive comparison still preserves a genuine phase equation. Let epsilon_b be the slope of the recorded first coordinate at each actual cup or restored cap of c. The exact source character is m_c=sum_v epsilon_v(d-2a_i+2k_v) +d sum_b epsilon_b. The actual even-cycle proof makes E_c=sum_v epsilon_v+sum_b epsilon_b even. Fourier extraction requires m_c=2b_c modulo 2N, where b_c is one at the original marked cycle and zero elsewhere. Substitution of (1), using d=N-1, gives EXACTLY product_v (Y_v^*)^epsilon_v (-1)^(sum_b epsilon_b) =Q^(E_c/2+b_c). (10) Thus the cup signs, finite pivotal correction and original one-unit charge remain specified. Their limiting product is one. Equation (10) closes these particular phase characters on the actual physical cycles; it does not supply (8), a common geometric frame, all complex edge equations, or a contributing source integration cycle. For reference, the interior positive action with its original scalar is S=sum_i [ b(xi_i,rho_i) +L(1-rho_i,xi_i,lambda_(i,W)) +L(1-rho_i,xi_i,lambda_(i,pi)) ], b(xi,rho)=J(xi+rho)-2J(xi)-2J(rho)-J(xi-rho). (11) Here S is the rate of the UNSQUARED coefficient weight; each summand of Z_F has rate 2S. This follows directly from the exact B_N in the positive partition and the uniform sine-factorial estimate. Its variables still satisfy the shared Kirchhoff equations and one fixed Fourier winding branch. Equation (11) is a local interior rate, not a global Laplace theorem covering its boundary. In particular no Casson--Rivin identification of (11) is obtained by differentiating it and ignoring (6). ## 5. Scope and the retained route This obstruction does NOT prove a strict numerical rate gap between the positive partition and the original source. Boundary maximizing sequences, different coherent regroupings, nonradial saddles and cancellations remain separate questions. It does not rule out a volume identity whose numerical value is obtained in another way. The existing [selected-factor localization](actual_augmented_plat_selected_factor_localization.md) instead puts every ordinary factor outside ONE prescribed matching edge on its actual selected FULL physical packet. Those coordinates need not be central or radial. The two exceptional factors are kept in their exact marked four-port block, with every target and required generic normal retained. The present calculation preserves that route; it does not replace its remaining contraction and period estimates. Focused audit: [finite phase derivatives and adapter identities](../experiments/audit_actual_positive_fourier_radial_geometric_obstruction.py). The radial obstruction does not give a rate gap or a boundary conclusion. The common-frame hypothesis and exceptional-block route remain essential.

title: The positive Newton capacity can exceed the complete rate
status: Certified polynomial capacity; source adapter still open
text: # The positive Newton capacity can exceed the complete rate 30 October 2026. This concerns the proposed absolute Newton majorant, not the original alternating low-color source. The exact local kernel and one-port source interface below apply to the proved flat-plat compiler. The obstruction family is an actual certified matched graph with specified positive determinant polynomials; its full original-source identification is CONDITIONAL on a compiler adapter described in section3. All remaining half-twist signs are explicitly ZERO, so these polynomial Newton coefficients are nonnegative and maximal-label restriction is a lower bound. No signed-source conclusion is made. ## 0. The exact original Newton coefficient Put q=exp(pi i/N), d=N-1, s_j=2sin(pi j/N), S_j=product_(k=1)^j s_k, and B_r(z)=product_(k=0)^(r-1)(q^(2k+1)+q^(-2k-1)-z), Bhat_r=B_r/S_r^2. For the original untwisted face operator T of [the exact one-port correspondence](actual_small_circle_polynomial_face_insertion.md), including its q^(dp) character, the finite identity is Bhat_r(-T)c^m = sum_(0<=i,j<=r; i+j<=m) [m r]_s [m+r-i-j r]_s [r i]_s [r j]_s x^i y^j c^(m-i-j), (0) for 0<=m,r<N. Here [n r]_s=product_(k=1)^r s_(n-r+k)/s_k; it is zero for n<r. Terms with second upper index>=N have the exact numerator zero s_N. There is no vanishing denominator. Thus every coefficient is nonnegative. Moreover T and Bhat_r(-T) commute with multiplication by c^N; the higher block is preserved, not wrapped. A proof is given in the appendix. Let P_rem be the original product of the remaining positive circle polynomials before merging b,c. The actual positive one-port coefficient is Z_r=[L^(d F_sm)] [Bhat_r(-T)P_rem]_(c=b,u=v=0)>=0. Its source scalar is N^(R-1) product_remaining(k_a beta_a^2), since every remaining epsilon is0. The source theorem retains its ordinary caps, mark, physical support and finite-grid measure. Input terms divisible by c^N cannot reach the ordinary merged target d<N. This one-port original-source identity assumes connected identity smoothing and distinct unmarked middle faces, exactly as in its linked source theorem. It does not extend the graph family through an absent flat-plat adapter. For 1<=h<=floor(N/2), the exact original Chebyshev--Newton identity is T_h=sum_(r=0)^(h-1) (-1)^(h-1+r) b_(h,r) Bhat_r(-T), b_(h,r)=S_r^2 S_(h+r)/[S_(2r+1)S_(h-r-1)]>0, b_(h,r)<=N/2. The last uniform bound follows from the actual sine product: its log-concavity in h puts the maximum at h=N/2; double-angle cancellation gives 2 product_(k=1)^r s_(2k)/product_(k=0)^r s_(2k+1). Its successive ratio changes once from <=1 to >=1, so the two endpoints suffice. They are csc(pi/N) and either N/2 or csc(pi/N), all <=N/2. This is also proved in [the pure-leaf calculation](actual_pure_conway_auxiliary_color_leaf.md). The majorant studied here is the TRUE sum sum_r b_(h,r)Z_r, retaining these magnitudes rather than replacing all of them by N/2. ## 1. The complete shared-face angle problem Use one actual untwisted port with distinct unmarked middle faces b,c and distinct unmarked outer faces x,y. Its two removed triangles are (x,b,y),(x,c,y). Retain ALL other original triangle incidences and the original marked faces u,v. Let R be the number of original circles. For every remaining triangle t and incident face f introduce a_tf>=0, with sum_f a_tf=1/2. Its center angle is theta_tf=2pi a_tf. Corners at u,v are fixed zero. The exact fold local entropy is S_t(a_t)=V(2pi a_t)/(2pi), V(theta)=2 sum_j[Lambda(theta_j/2)+Lambda((pi-theta_j)/2)]. These are the source-normalized triangle entropies; no local constant or exterior phase is reset. Put rho=r/N, mu=m/N, xi=i/N, eta=j/N for the exact positive Newton coefficient (0). Its limiting domain is 0<=rho<=1/2, rho<=mu<=1, 0<=xi,eta<=rho, xi+eta<=mu, mu+rho-xi-eta<=1. (1) The true physical cap is rho<h/N; it approaches1/2 when h=floor(N/2). The actual root-zero wall at the last boundary is interpreted by approach from its nonzero side, not as replacing a vanished coefficient. Let K(mu,rho,xi,eta) be J(mu)+J(mu+rho-xi-eta)-J(mu-rho)-J(mu-xi-eta) -J(xi)-J(rho-xi)-J(eta)-J(rho-eta), (2) where J(t)=integral_0^t log(2sin(pi z))dz. This is the sum of four ideal-tetrahedron volumes/pi, with normalized angle triples (rho,mu-rho,1-mu), (rho,mu-xi-eta,1-mu-rho+xi+eta), (xi,rho-xi,1-rho), (eta,rho-eta,1-rho). The FULL shared-face constraints are sum_(t incident f) a_tf =1 for f outside{x,y,b,c,u,v}, sum_t a_tx=1-xi, sum_t a_ty=1-eta, sum_t a_tb=1-mu+xi+eta, sum_t a_tc=mu. (3) They follow directly from the exact finite monomial: c^m -> x^i y^j c^(m-i-j), followed by c=b and target exponent d. The input b exponent is d-m+i+j. Thus these are not factorwise maxima or independently chosen local degrees. Their sum is R-1, exactly the total remaining triangle degree. Define C_Newt=max_(1),(3) [sum_remaining S_t+K]. (4) The polytope is compact and the objective continuous and concave. It is the natural shared capacity for the positive one-port Newton coefficient with every other channel at maximal fold. The ordinary source polynomial and its normalized Newton kernel are nonnegative. The source measure N^(R-1), k factors and odd maximal-fold beta=1 are subexponential; no exponential normalization is omitted. ## 2. Euler--Lagrange equations and the lost phase At a strict constrained maximum let l_f>0 be the shared face multipliers. Use the Lagrangian sum S_t+K+sum_f log(l_f)(sum_t a_tf-demand_f). The triangle equations are exactly the original source circle-angle equations, tan(theta_tf/2) proportional to l_f. Write s(t)=sin(pi t). The remaining interior equations are s(mu)s(mu+rho-xi-eta) / [s(mu-rho)s(mu-xi-eta)] = l_c/l_b, s(mu-xi-eta)s(rho-xi) / [s(mu+rho-xi-eta)s(xi)] = l_b/l_x, s(mu-xi-eta)s(rho-eta) / [s(mu+rho-xi-eta)s(eta)] = l_b/l_y, s(mu+rho-xi-eta)s(mu-rho) / [s(rho-xi)s(rho-eta)] =1. (5) At an active rho boundary the last equality is replaced by its KKT inequality. These equations do not retain the original factor (-1)^(h-1+r) in the low-color Newton sum. In the actual complex stationarity equation that factor contributes the linear character pi i rho (with its fixed lattice mark); its exponential rho equation would have the opposite sign. Dropping it is therefore a change of critical scheme, not a harmless choice of a logarithm. ## 3. A certified two-sided Apollonian matched-graph family Start from the actual octahedral-white source used in the frozen smoothing-fixed-radius note: white faces0,1,2,3 form the equator, 4,5 are the two poles, matching edges are01,12,34,35, and marked MAIN23 is unchanged. In the marked chart, faces2,3 are the parallel lines y=0,2; circles0,1 have curvatures2 and centers(0,1/2),(0,3/2), and circles4,5 have curvature1 and centers(-sqrt2,1),(sqrt2,1). Make n literal Apollonian insertions into triangle(0,1,4), and n into triangle(0,1,5), each successive insertion inside the triangle adjacent to the retained matched edge01. On each side the new matching edge is the previous-middle/new-middle edge, exactly as in the frozen one-sided construction. Both constructions have disjoint interiors. The old matching01 remains; marked MAIN23 is untouched. The explicit small disks have curvatures B_n=4n^2+4sqrt2 n+1 and centers (+/- (2n+sqrt2)/B_n,1). The already proved tangent-disk and supporting-halfspace induction applies separately on the two sides. Thus this is an actual connected certified augmented matched graph, not an arbitrary angle graph. Identity smoothing at01 merges its two opposite final middle faces b_n,c_n; its two chains keep the smoothed projection connected and the marked faces distinct. There is an essential presentation qualification. The embedded dual and chosen matching give a literal general Morse augmented diagram, with its original cyclic ports. The currently proved marked coefficient compiler, however, assumes a fixed FLAT PLAT with k bottom cups, k top caps and its specified gap sweep. No adapter has yet been proved that carries the successive local subdivisions into that compiler while preserving this positive coefficient formula. Nor is a common bridge width over all n asserted. Choosing a fixed depth gives a finite graph, but a general link-to-plat isotopy by itself is not the missing adapter. Consequently the unconditional obstruction below concerns its specified positive determinant polynomial and capacity. Its conclusion for the original flat-plat quantum source requires that actual adapter; the exact one-port kernel formula alone does not supply it. The two original triangles at01 now have the SAME curvatures (l_x,l_b,l_y)=(2,B_n,2), (l_x,l_c,l_y)=(2,B_n,2). Put a_n=(2/pi)atan(1/sqrt(B_n+1)). Their normalized angles (theta_x,theta_b,theta_y)/pi are (a_n,1-2a_n,a_n), and a_n->0. KEEP EVERY remaining original packing angle exactly as it was. Its demands in (3) are met by rho=1/4, mu=1/2+a_n, xi=eta=a_n. (6) For sufficiently large fixed n these lie strictly in (1), and the four kernel tetrahedron triples are (1/4,1/4+a_n,1/2-a_n), (1/4,1/2-a_n,1/4+a_n), (a_n,1/4-a_n,3/4), (a_n,1/4-a_n,3/4). Let F0=Vol(Y_n)/(2pi) be the geometric complete capacity of this certified matched graph. Its identification with the original flat-plat complete rate requires the stated compiler adapter. The value of the FULL shared objective at this feasible state exceeds F0 by E(a_n)=K(1/2+a_n,1/4,a_n,a_n) -V(pi a_n,pi(1-2a_n),pi a_n)/pi. (7) The subtraction is the TWO deleted source triangle entropies, each V/(2pi), not one. By continuity of the actual Lobachevsky functions, E(a_n) -> 2 Catalan/pi = v_oct/(2pi)>0. (8) Indeed the last two kernel tetrahedra flatten, the first two tend to the right ideal tetrahedron with angles(pi/4,pi/4,pi/2), of volume Catalan, while the old two source triangle entropies tend to0. Hence for every sufficiently large FIXED n, C_Newt >= F0+E(a_n)>F0. (9) This refutes the proposed universal strict comparison even AFTER allowing all shared radii/angles to readjust: (6) is already a feasible full angle state. It does not refute the original volume conjecture. ## 4. A lower bound for the specified positive coefficient The following lower-bound step uses only the supplied positive determinant saddle estimates. At odd N, M=d/2, each normalized remaining white polynomial D_M has degree M and nonnegative coefficients. For a fixed strict source-angle triple, its prescribed coefficient with exponents M theta_j/pi+O(1) has exponential rate V(theta)/(2pi). This follows from the SAME PSD contraction proof as the frozen face-coefficient saddle, applied to that single two/three-variable pencil and its prescribed interior logarithmic-gradient target: pair traces give the global torus gap, the Hessian is cN on its homogeneity quotient, and the finite saddle moves o(1). One-variable forced faces are literal monomials. Fixed zero marked corners are deleted before this argument; all other corners in this fixed certified packing are strictly positive. There are compatible integer exponents with all these triple fractions and all original ordinary face targets. Scale the remaining packing flows by d rather than N: every row then has the integer sum M=d/2, and all face columns outside x,y,b,c already have target d. Round within the bipartite row/face incidence network, allowing the four displayed face columns to vary by O(1). Impose the integer floor and ceiling of each given entry as lower and upper bounds. The row equations and fixed face-column equations form a totally unimodular network matrix. Its bounded feasible polytope has an integral vertex, preserving every fixed integer margin and changing each entry by at most1. Marked zeros stay zero. Strict positive entries stay positive for large N. The resulting actual remaining input monomial has c exponent m=d(1/2+a_n)+O(1)<N, and its deficits determine i=d a_n+O(1), j=d a_n+O(1), with the merged b target exactly d. Choose r=N/4+O(1) integer. Every finite kernel sine product is then in its strict nonzero domain. The exact Newton coefficient formula and the uniform sine-product estimates show that this ONE product of positive coefficients contributes rate F0+E(a_n). Thus for the specified positive Newton polynomial coefficient at maximal remaining labels, liminf_(N odd) N^-1 log Z_(r_N) >= F0+E(a_n). (10) The specified original-compiler scalar, if its adapter is established, is polynomial and does not change this inequality. For h_N=floor(N/2), r_N=N/4+O(1), the exact coefficient b_(h_N,r_N) has exponential rate zero directly from the exact finite sine products: lim N^-1 log b_(h_N,r_N) =2J(1/4)+J(3/4)-J(1/2)-J(1/4)=0, using J(3/4)=-J(1/4), J(1/2)=0 and the uniform O(log N) factorial errors. No off-grid color interpolation is needed for this step. Consequently the TRUE absolute Newton expansion sum_(r<h_N) b_(h_N,r) Z_r also has lower rate at least F0+E(a_n). This is not an artifact of replacing b by its upper bound N/2. To obtain a volume-rate upper bound for the alternating polynomial, one would therefore need exponential cancellation in the retained signs (-1)^(h_N-1+r), possibly together with remaining source sums. No such upper bound or cancellation theorem has been proved here. The positive-polynomial majorant cannot supply a capacity comparison on all certified matched graphs. Without the presentation adapter this is not a claimed flat-plat source counterexample. Finally, (9) prevents an interpretation of the maximizing positive capacity as Vol(rho)/(2pi) for a representation of the SAME original group with the actual source normalization. Such an interpretation would contradict the independently proved universal representation- volume bound. The missing Newton phase in (5) identifies a concrete reason that the positive critical scheme is not the original one. ## Appendix: proof of the finite positive Newton identity One may first work at generic q, writing s_j=(q^j-q^-j)/i and c_j=q^(2j+1)+q^(-2j-1). The original operator acts by T c^m=-c_m c^m+s_m^2(x+y)c^(m-1) +s_m s_(m-1)xy c^(m-2). (A1) The literal coefficients at the bottom two rows are zero, so there are no negative powers. Define D(c^m)=s_m c^(m-1), R_j(c^k)=s_(k+2j+2)c^(k+1) +s_(k+j+1)(x+y)c^k+s_k xy c^(k-1). Direct computation gives R_0 D=T+c_0, D R_j=R_(j+1)D+s_1 s_(2j+2)I, sum_(j=0)^(r-1) s_1 s_(2j+2)=c_0-c_r. It follows inductively that B_r(-T)=R_0 R_1...R_(r-1)D^r. (A4) This already proves the exact zero for r>m. For r<=m, the coefficient of x^i y^j c^(m-i-j) asserted by (0), after multiplication by S_r^2, is C_r(m;i,j)= S_m S_(m+r-i-j) S_r^2 / [S_(m-r)S_(m-i-j)S_i S_(r-i)S_j S_(r-j)]. (A5) The recurrence B_(r+1)(-T)=(T+c_r)B_r(-T), using (A1), proves (A5). For completeness, set k=m-i-j. After dividing on the generic open set and clearing the factors, the only identity needed is s_(k-r)s_(r+1-i)s_(r+1-j) +s_(k+1)[s_i s_(r+1-j)+s_j s_(r+1-i)] +s_(k+r+2)s_i s_j =s_(k+i+j-r)s_(r+1)^2. (A6) This follows by substituting s_a=(q^a-q^-a)/i. The zero-index boundary terms of the recurrence are recovered after clearing denominators, or directly from (A4). Thus the generic polynomial identity holds. Specialize it through the finite products in (0): all denominators S_r,S_i,S_j,S_(r-i),S_(r-j) are nonzero for r<N. If m+r-i-j<N, all surviving sine factors are positive; otherwise its interval of r consecutive numerator factors contains s_N, since m-i-j<N. This proves the claimed root positivity. At the top endpoint r=d, only m=d and i+j=d survive, and every binomial [d choose i]_s equals1. Hence a useful exact endpoint is Bhat_d(-T)c^d=sum_(i=0)^d x^i y^(d-i), Bhat_d(-T)c^m=0 for m<d. (A7) ## Validation and remaining source interface The [focused audit](../experiments/audit_actual_positive_newton_capacity_obstruction.py) and [saved results](../experiments/actual_positive_newton_capacity_obstruction_results.json) check the exact local identity against the original coproduct Casimir: 2,436 monomial paths, including812 high totals and756 preserved whole-N blocks, 55,562 low-color matrix entries and15,316 complete-color entries. Two cleared symbolic identities and1,286 exact numerator-zero cases check the finite formula; finite-field arithmetic verifies equality, while nonnegativity is supplied by the sine-product proof. Four explicit two-sided matched graphs check76 matching incidences, 1,416 white and2,376 shaded support inequalities,228 right angles and 62 shared-face equations. Six integral-flow roundings check132 integer row margins,60 fixed face columns and all strict Newton domains. Eighteen literal determinant coefficients include three-, two- and one-variable cases. The finite coefficient/entropy profiles are diagnostics; the limit and positive gap follow from the written analytic arguments. The audit does not label the graph family as a flat-plat source fixture. The two-sided supporting-halfspace, matching, mark and load calculations do not supply the missing flat-plat compiler adapter. The classical capacity identity is geometric. Its use for the source remains conditional on the stated source interface.

title: An exact positive Newton period with cuboctahedral hyperbolic volume
text: # An exact positive Newton period with cuboctahedral hyperbolic volume 29 October 2026. For every odd N=2m+1 define the ACTUAL root polynomial h=Rturn(E_St) in H_N and the original Frobenius period W_N=phi(h^4). The [positive multiplication theorem](actual_positive_newton_multiplication.md) retains the full source and proves W_N>0. This note proves lim_(N odd ->infty) (pi/N)log W_N=Vol(Q_cube), (1) where Q_cube is the explicit ideal right-angled cuboctahedron in the [actual core geometry](actual_nc_graph_rectified_core_geometry.md). The proof is a real, strictly concave volume maximization. No stationary-phase noncancellation or contour-selection assumption occurs. The [literal cube source reduction](actual_odd_central_cube_reflection_packet.md) then gives the corresponding actual hyperbolic-volume rate for its ODD CENTRAL JOINT SECTOR. The full color sum and even levels are not asserted here. A sector is not substituted for the whole invariant. ## 1. Exact positive partition with every root normal Use d=2m, s_r=product_(u=1)^r 2sin(pi u/N), and Bhat_r from the Newton theorem. That theorem gives h=sum_(i=0)^m b_i Bhat_i, b_i=s_m^2/(s_i^2s_(m-i)^2)>0, h^2=sum_(k=0)^d a_k Bhat_k, a_k=sum_(0<=i,j<=m, max(i,j)<=k<=i+j) b_i b_j mu_(i,j,k), W_N=sum_(k=0)^d a_k a_(d-k). (2) The last equation is the original full Frobenius pairing, not a value-only trace. Every a_k is strictly positive. Its summation labels can be written (i,j,u,v,k), with the first pair producing k and the second producing d-k. There are only polynomially many such labels. Put L(x)=integral_0^x log(2sin(pi t))dt, continuously on [0,1]. The uniform sine-factorial estimate is log s_r=N L(r/N)+O(log N), for every 0<=r<=d, including endpoints. Define g(x)=-2L(x)-2L(1/2-x), 0<=x<=1/2, mu(x,y,z)=L(x+y)+L(z)-L(x)-L(y) -L(z-x)-L(z-y)-L(x+y-z). (3) The mu-domain is max(x,y)<=z<=x+y<=1. The exact summands in (2) have logarithm N times A(i,j,u,v,k)=g(i)+g(j)+g(u)+g(v) +mu(i,j,k)+mu(u,v,1-k) (4) up to O(log N), when the letters now denote their scaled real labels. Replacing d/N by 1 or m/N by 1/2 changes these estimates by O(log N), uniformly. This follows from the modulus of continuity of L at 0,1, not from an invalid bounded derivative at those endpoints. Let P be the compact convex polytope defined by 0<=i,j,u,v<=1/2 and the two mu-domain constraints in (4). Positivity and polynomial state count give the upper bound by max_P A. Any strictly interior feasible point can be rounded to actual odd-level integers with O(1/N) changes; a single positive term supplies the matching lower bound at an interior maximizer. Thus it suffices to find that maximum. ## 2. Each multiplication action is a positive tetrahedral volume For a mu-triple put p=z-x, q=z-y, r=x+y-z, w=1-x-y. They are nonnegative and p+q+2r+w=1. Write V(alpha,beta,gamma) for the volume of the ideal tetrahedron with dihedral angles pi alpha, pi beta, pi gamma, where their sum is 1. Thus V=-pi[L(alpha)+L(beta)+L(gamma)]. The identity L(1-t)=-L(t) gives EXACTLY pi mu = V(p+r,q+r,w) +V(p,q,2r+w)+V(p+q,r,r+w). (5) All three are positive ideal angle triples when p,q,r,w>0. Also pi g(x)=2V(x,1/2-x,1/2). (6) The ideal tetrahedron volume is strictly concave on its angle simplex. For an elementary Hessian check, eliminate its third angle; the diagonal coefficients involve cot(alpha)+cot(gamma)>0 and the determinant uses cot(alpha)cot(beta)+cot(beta)cot(gamma) +cot(gamma)cot(alpha)=1. Hence the negative Hessian is positive definite. The linear angle map in (5) is injective: its second triangle supplies p,q and its third supplies r. Therefore mu is strictly concave on its open domain. Continuity extends concavity to the closed domain. The same conclusion holds for g. This is a positive volume functional for the FULL period partition. Off its maximum the tetrahedra in (5) are not yet asserted to be the metric tetrahedra of a glued cuboctahedron. The exact value at the maximum is compared with the actual polyhedron in section 4. ## 3. Unique global maximum and its algebraic equation The polytope and A are invariant under i<->j, u<->v, and exchange of the two pairs with k->1-k. Averaging over these symmetries cannot decrease a concave function. The strict concavity of the four g terms forces i=j=u=v=t at a maximizing point unless those values already agree. With these fixed, strict concavity of the two mu terms forces k=1/2. It is therefore enough to maximize on 1/4<=t<=1/2 the function A_sym(t)=6g(t)+2[L(2t)-L(2t-1/2)]. (7) In its interior, A_sym'(t)=-12log tan(pi t)+4log[-tan(2pi t)]. (8) The derivative tends to +infinity at 1/4 and to -infinity at 1/2. The original strict concavity, or direct differentiation of (8), gives a unique maximum. Setting y=tan(pi t)>1 in (8) yields 2y/(y^2-1)=y^3, hence y^2=2. Thus t*=atan(sqrt(2))/pi. All inequalities in P that can be strict are strict at (t*,t*,t*,t*,1/2). In particular rounding i,j,u,v to the nearest t*N and taking k=m gives actual summands at every large odd level. This completes the positive Laplace proof of the limit N^(-1)log W_N=A_sym(t*), without choosing a subsequence inside odd N. ## 4. Direct volume of the ACTUAL ideal cuboctahedron Let theta=atan(sqrt(2)) and delta=pi/2-theta. The Klein vertices of Q_cube are the permutations of (±1,±1,0)/sqrt(2). Its supporting planes and all right angles were certified in the core geometry. For a completely explicit volume calculation order its twelve vertices by choosing the zero coordinate in order 0,1,2, then the other two signs in order (--),(-+),(+-),(++). Cone its faces to vertex 0, which is (0,-1/sqrt(2),-1/sqrt(2)). The nonincident face fans give the following fourteen geometric tetrahedra, specified by the unordered sets of their three other vertices; each tetrahedron is positively reoriented when computing its shape: (4,8,5), (4,5,9), (6,10,7), (6,7,11), (2,9,3), (2,3,11), (1,5,3), (1,3,7), (1,5,8), (2,4,9), (3,5,9), (1,7,10), (2,6,11), (3,7,11). (9) These are disjoint face cones in a convex polyhedron. The first eight triangulate its four nonincident square faces; the last six are its nonincident triangular faces. There is no tetrahedron recognition based only on a numerical volume. Stereographic coordinates z=(X+iY)/(1-Z) and the cross-ratio formula give ten tetrahedra of angle type A, two of B, and two of E: A=(theta,delta,pi/2), B=(theta,theta,pi-2theta), E=(2theta-pi/2,delta,pi-theta). (10) Representative positive cross ratios are respectively 2/3+i sqrt(2)/3, 1/3+2i sqrt(2)/3, and 2/3+i sqrt(2)/6. Their three cyclic shape arguments give (10) directly. For example the E angles follow from the shapes 2+i sqrt(2) and -1/3+i sqrt(2)/3, together with tan(2theta-pi/2)=1/(2sqrt(2)). The audit verifies every cross ratio in (9) algebraically in Q(sqrt(2),i), using its positive shape representative rather than treating the displayed vertex order as an orientation. With Lambda(x)=-integral_0^x log|2sin t|dt, (9),(10) give Vol(Q_cube)=12Lambda(theta)+12Lambda(delta) -2Lambda(2theta)+2Lambda(2theta-pi/2). (11) On the other hand L(t)=-Lambda(pi t)/pi, so substituting t* into (7) gives precisely pi A_sym(t*)=(11). This proves the claimed equality with the ACTUAL complete core volume in (1). ## 5. The original cube sector and the remaining whole-source problem The separately proved literal exposed-source identity is Z_(cube,central)=N^12 S_N^8 W_N omega_m^(sum e), where S_N is the original positive central trivalent scalar after its recorded unit phase, lim N^(-1)log S_N=v8/pi, and the retained twists are unit characters in this fixed sector. Therefore lim_(N odd) (2pi/N)log|Z_(cube,central)| =16v8+2Vol(Q_cube) =Vol(S^3 minus the ACTUAL augmented cube link). (12) The last equality is the independent complete-core construction with b=4. Thus the geometric growth is present in an actual source sector and its complete positive partition, including every root normal. This does NOT establish that other color sectors cannot cancel or exceed it, nor the corresponding even-level assertion. Those are still required before claiming the full cube volume conjecture, and general graphs need their own full-source control. Audit: [positive partition and exact cuboctahedral shapes](../experiments/audit_actual_positive_newton_cuboctahedral_period.py). Finite values check the implementation; the limiting equality follows from the uniform factorial envelope, strict concavity, lattice rounding and the explicit geometric tetrahedra above.

title: Positive multiplication in the actual full Newton source algebra
text: # Positive multiplication in the actual full Newton source algebra 29 October 2026. The actual two-head source algebra has an explicit NONNEGATIVE multiplication table in the same full Newton basis in which the genuine quarter-turn reverses coordinates. This includes every paired first normal, both level parities and composite levels. It is not a positive model substituted for the original source. Let N>=2, d=N-1, q=exp(pi i/N), Q=q^2, and c_j=q^(2j+1)+q^(-2j-1), s_r=product_(u=1)^r 2sin(pi u/N), s_0=1, B_r(z)=product_(j=0)^(r-1)(c_j-z), Bhat_r=B_r/s_r^2, 0<=r<=d. The physical algebra is H_N=C[z]/P_N with P_N=2T_N(z/2)+2. The [actual Newton turn theorem](actual_newton_turn_positive_gram.md) identifies this with the full original Hopf commutant and proves Rturn Bhat_r=Bhat_(d-r), phi(Bhat_i Bhat_j)=delta_(i+j,d), original cup-mark closure(f)=f(c_0)=alpha_0, phi(f)=alpha_d, if f=sum_r alpha_r Bhat_r. (1) The turn in (1) is the actual root operator with its original cups and caps. Its simple root formula is NOT an arbitrary generic-q continuation. ## 1. Uniform multiplication theorem If i+j<N, then in the ACTUAL algebra Bhat_i Bhat_j=sum_(k=max(i,j))^(i+j) mu_(i,j,k) Bhat_k, mu_(i,j,k)=s_(i+j)s_k /[s_i s_j s_(k-i)s_(k-j)s_(i+j-k)] > 0. (2) If i+j>=N, their product is ZERO in H_N, including all root normals. Every denominator in (2) has index less than N. The formula is symmetric in i,j and its unit cases are exact. Here is an own generic finite proof. For generic zeta define [u]=(zeta^u-zeta^(-u))/(zeta-zeta^(-1)), [u]!=product_[1,u], t=-(zeta-zeta^(-1))^2, and use the same generic nodes and B polynomials. Then B_i B_j=sum_(k=max(i,j))^(i+j) A_(i,j,k) B_k, A_(i,j,k)=t^(i+j-k) [i]![j]![i+j]! /([k]![k-i]![k-j]![i+j-k]!). (3) By symmetry take i<=j. Starting at i=0, multiply by c_i-z and use (c_i-z)B_k=B_(k+1)+(c_i-c_k)B_k, c_i-c_k=t[k+i+1][k-i]. (4) The coefficient recurrence is A_(i+1,j,k)=A_(i,j,k-1)+(c_i-c_k)A_(i,j,k). After division by the nonzero interior factorial factors in (3), this is exactly the elementary identity [i+1][i+j+1]=[k][k-j]+[k+i+1][i+j+1-k]. (5) Expand the four powers of zeta on each side to verify (5). At the lower and upper endpoints the same recurrence follows by its zero factors or its leading coefficient 1. This proves (3) as a finite rational identity, without a summation formula or a fit to samples. At the principal root and i+j<N, [u]!=s_u/(2sin(pi/N))^u. The powers of 2sin cancel t, and multiplication by s_k^2/(s_i^2s_j^2) converts (3) precisely to (2). For i+j>=N, c_(d-u)=c_u implies the polynomial identity B_N/B_j=B_(N-j). Since i>=N-j, B_i B_j is divisible by B_N=(-1)^N P_N. This is divisibility WITH MULTIPLICITIES, not equality only at distinct nodes. Hence the zero assertion holds on the full physical source. ## 2. A positive cone preserved by genuine operations Let C_N consist of all sum alpha_r Bhat_r with alpha_r real and >=0. Equations (1),(2) prove that C_N is preserved by: * actual serial multiplication of two-head boxes; * the genuine quarter-turn; * sums and multiplication by nonnegative real scalars. Both actual closures in (1) are nonnegative on this cone. Thus any specified physical two-head circuit built from cone-valued coupons by these operations has an exact positive finite contraction. There is no cancellation of positive terms and no lost normal coefficient. Associativity is inherited from the actual polynomial/operator algebra. No separate move normalization or conjectural topological invariance has been imposed on a new state sum. This does NOT say that a crossing R^e is cone-valued, that an arbitrary multiport graph reduces to this alphabet, or that every such circuit is hyperbolic. A proposed application must supply its actual ordered two-head decomposition and preserve its original marking. The nonzero test is also finite. A multiplication gate permits precisely i+j<N, max(i,j)<=k<=i+j. (6) A turn replaces r by d-r. A closure fixes r=0 or r=d. Therefore a whole typed circuit with strictly positive allowed input coordinates is nonzero if and only if at least one internal label assignment satisfies (6) and its turn/closure constraints. This is an exact finite support certificate, not a claim that topology alone ensures it. ## 3. The original complete circle belongs to this cone at every level For the actual complete circle use L_N(z)=(-1)^d U_d(z/2)=(-1)^d P_N'(z)/N. The original Frobenius functional is phi(f)=(-1)^d N^2[z^d](f mod P_N). Consequently phi(L_N f)=N Tr(m_f)=N sum_(j=0)^d f(c_j), (7) where m_f is multiplication by f in H_N. To prove the trace identity, first take a monic polynomial with distinct roots and apply its exact Lagrange interpolation to P' f mod P. Its leading coefficient is the sum of f at those roots. Both sides are polynomial expressions in the coefficients of P and f, so equality extends to repeated roots by clearing the interpolation denominators. The trace counts algebraic multiplicity and does not omit the paired blocks. By (1), the r-th Newton coefficient of L_N is phi(L_N Bhat_(d-r)). Put M=floor(d/2), v=d-r, and let k_l be 2 on a paired node and 1 on the odd simple node. Formula (7) gives the explicit coefficients lambda_r=0, r<d-M, lambda_r=N sum_(l=v)^M k_l s_(l+v)/[s_(l-v)s_v^2]>0, r>=d-M. (8) Indeed Bhat_v(c_l)=0 for l<v, while for v<=l<=M the factorization c_t-c_l=4sin((l+t+1)pi/N)sin((l-t)pi/N) gives Bhat_v(c_l)=s_(l+v)/(s_(l-v)s_v^2). For v>M the polynomial already vanishes at every root, so its trace is zero. This proves (8) with all multiplicities, including N=2 and both parities. Thus complete-circle/turn/multiplication circuits give a genuine all-level positive family inside the original source theory. Their exact zeros remain important: for even N the support in (8) starts at N/2, so L_N^2=0 by (2). Positivity does not hide that zero. The same statement holds for EACH complete-circle sector. Let E_j be the full Hermite cluster projector and L_j=L_N E_j. Formula (7) with f replaced by E_j f gives phi(L_j f)=N k_j f(c_j). Thus, with the original paired multiplicity k_j retained, Rturn(L_j)/(N k_j)=h_j =sum_(v=0)^j s_(j+v)/[s_(j-v)s_v^2] Bhat_v. (8a) Every coefficient is strictly positive and every other coefficient is zero. This applies to both parities, including paired nilpotent sectors; it does not replace L_j by a projector. No derivative of f is missing: the derivative in L_j is precisely the full Frobenius/trace identity that produced (8a). ## 4. Odd simple projector and the primitive cube period At N=2m+1, the simple Steinberg node is c_m=-2. Its genuine spectral projector is E_St=B_m^2/N^2=Bhat_m^2, (9) because B_m(c_m)=N and s_m^2=N; it has the required DOUBLE zero at every paired node. Apply (2) and the actual turn to obtain h=Rturn(E_St)=sum_(v=0)^m beta(m,v)^2 Bhat_v, beta(m,v)=s_m/[s_v s_(m-v)]>0. (10) All coefficients in (10) are positive; this proof uses the complete polynomial projector rather than interpolation at simple values. Write h^2=sum a_k Bhat_k. Formula (2) gives a_k=sum_(0<=i,j<=m, max(i,j)<=k<=i+j) beta(m,i)^2 beta(m,j)^2 mu_(i,j,k)>0 for EVERY 0<=k<=d. (11) For nonemptiness choose i+j=k with i,j<=m. Therefore phi(h^4)=sum_(k=0)^d a_k a_(d-k)>0. (12) No identity Rturn(h^2)=h^2 is needed for (12). In particular a root observation of that identity is not being continued generically. The separate primitive-cube calculation must still prove its actual normalization and the asymptotic/geometric interpretation of this period. Equation (12) supplies its cancellation-free positive form. More generally every h^p, p>=2, has positive coefficients at ALL indices 0,...,d: h has a positive constant term and (11) starts the induction. In particular phi(h^p)>0 for every such p. This is an exact period statement, not an automatic topological or volume identification for each power. Audit: [generic finite products and full root-algebra verification](../experiments/audit_actual_positive_newton_multiplication.py). The uniform proofs above establish positivity; finite tests independently check the formulas, the actual repeated-root quotient and complete-circle coefficients. They are not a general graph volume theorem.

title: A rational Bloch regulator for every positive-source volume maximum
text: # A rational Bloch regulator for every positive-source volume maximum **Later geometric result, 29 October 2026:** for every retained cylindrical robust Conway factor, the [actual cell realization](actual_positive_conway_hyperbolic_volume.md) now identifies the source class with the geometric rational Bloch class over a common number field, and its regulator with the actual complete complement volume. The abstract rational-angle theorem below continues to apply more broadly and does not itself supply a manifold. 29 October 2026. The algebraic volume period of every robust positive Conway source is the regulator of an actual rational Bloch cycle. The cycle is obtained by subtracting the complex-conjugate shape symbols. Its boundary vanishes by the source's full constrained stationarity equations. This is stronger than a formal sum of algebraic dilogarithms, but does not identify the cycle with the marked fundamental class of a link complement. The argument applies to EVERY rational affine ideal-angle volume problem in the [algebraic maximum theorem](positive_source_algebraic_volume_period.md), including boundary maxima and nonunique optimizers. It uses that theorem's quotient by the exact flat Hessian kernel; it does not assume that an optimizer is isolated in the original wire coordinates. ## 1. The rational Bloch group and regulator convention Let K be a number field with its specified complex embedding, stable under complex conjugation. Write U_K=K^times tensor_Z Q, additively, and write ell(a) for the image of a nonzero field element in U_K. Thus ell(ab)=ell(a)+ell(b); roots of unity have image zero. Let P(K)_Q be the Q-vector space on symbols [z], z in K minus {0,1}, modulo the five-term relations [x]-[y]+[y/x] -[(1-x^-1)/(1-y^-1)]+[(1-x)/(1-y)]=0, (1) where the displayed arguments are defined and different from 0 and 1. Use the boundary convention delta[z]=ell(z) wedge ell(1-z), B(K)_Q=ker(delta:P(K)_Q -> exterior^2 U_K). (2) This is the rational Bloch group, not an assertion of an integral lift or of a particular K_3 lattice. The five-term relation has zero boundary by direct expansion. In fact put X=ell(x), Y=ell(y), A=ell(1-x), B=ell(1-y), C=ell(x-y). The five pairs ell(z),ell(1-z) in (1) are (X,A), (Y,B), (Y-X,C-X), (Y+A-X-B,C-X-B), (A-B,C-B). Their signed wedge sum is identically zero in the free exterior algebra on X,Y,A,B,C. Thus (2) is well defined without requiring algebraic independence of the displayed field elements. Let D(z) be the Bloch-Wigner dilogarithm, normalized so that a positive ideal tetrahedron of shape z has hyperbolic volume D(z). Then D(bar z)=-D(z). The same five-term relation holds for D, so R_K:P(K)_Q -> R, R_K([z])=D(z) (3) is a well-defined regulator component for the specified embedding. For completeness, the five-term identity follows from dD(z)=log|z| d arg(1-z)-log|1-z| d arg(z). Applying this alternating bilinear differential to the preceding zero wedge sum shows that the five-term D expression is locally constant in x,y. The complex domain with x,y different from 0,1 and from each other is connected. Letting y tend to x, all three ratio arguments tend to 1, where D has continuous value zero; the first two terms cancel. The constant is therefore zero. This also fixes the sign convention and normalization in (3). ## 2. The algebraic data selected by the source maximum Use the notation of the algebraic maximum theorem. The compact rational polytope carries positive rational weights w_j and rational affine ideal-angle triples alpha_j. Let F be its smallest face containing all maxima. On F discard the atoms which are identically flat, and call the remaining set I. Those positive atoms have the SAME angle triples at every maximum. After removing their common rational flat kernel, choose rational coordinates y_l in which the positive angles read alpha_jr=a_jr+sum_l b_jrl y_l, a_jr,b_jrl in Q. The proved algebraicity theorem supplies an optimum y_* for which the phases, sine values and positive shapes are algebraic. More explicitly choose a positive integer B clearing the b denominators, and put u_l=exp(pi i y_*l/B), t_jr=exp(pi i alpha_jr), s_jr=2sin(pi alpha_jr)>0. Then t_jr=eta_jr product_l u_l^(B b_jrl), eta_jr=exp(pi i a_jr), (4) where eta_jr is a root of unity. Choose K to contain these finitely many algebraic numbers and their conjugates. It is a finite number field stable under the given complex conjugation. No assertion that K is the trace field of a manifold is being made. All positive angles are interior in their simplices at a relative- interior maximizer of F. Constrained stationarity in EVERY quotient tangent y_l gives sum_(j in I,r) w_j b_jrl log s_jr=0. (5) For an integer C clearing the rational exponents, (5) gives the exact algebraic relation product_(j,r) s_jr^(C w_j b_jrl)=1. (6) There is no winding ambiguity here: the s_jr are positive real numbers, and (6) is derived from the selected real maximum. Its image in U_K, divided by the nonzero rational C, is sum_(j,r) w_j b_jrl ell(s_jr)=0. (7) Equations (4) and (7), not merely the algebraicity of the shapes, are the reason the regulator has a Bloch-cycle lift. ## 3. The antisymmetric shape boundary For a positive angle triple (a,b,c), a+b+c=1, set t_a=exp(pi i a), s_a=2sin(pi a), and cyclically, z=t_a s_b/s_c. The Euclidean angle sine rule, or an elementary sine identity, gives 1-z=t_b^-1 s_a/s_c. (8) For the elementary check multiply (8) by sin(pi c): it says sin(pi c)=exp(pi i a)sin(pi b)+exp(-pi i b)sin(pi a). The imaginary parts cancel and the real part is sin(pi(a+b)), which equals sin(pi c). In particular Im z>0 and z has the prescribed ordered ideal angles. Write T_r=ell(t_r), S_r=ell(s_r). Since s_r is positive real, conjugation fixes S_r and sends T_r to -T_r. Also T_a+T_b+T_c=ell(-1)=0 in U_K. Using (8) to expand both shape boundaries therefore gives the exact identity delta([z]-[bar z]) =2(T_a wedge S_a+T_b wedge S_b+T_c wedge S_c). (9) For clarity, the individual unsymmetrized expansion is delta[z]=-T_a wedge T_b +T_a wedge(S_a-S_c)+T_b wedge(S_b-S_c) +S_b wedge S_a-S_b wedge S_c-S_c wedge S_a. The phase-phase and sine-sine terms are unchanged by conjugation; only the two middle phase-sine terms change sign. Their difference is (9). Thus the proof does not assume that the unsymmetrized sum of positive shape symbols already has zero boundary. ## 4. Stationarity kills the complete rational boundary Define the source class beta=(1/2) sum_(j in I) w_j([z_j]-[bar z_j]) in P(K)_Q. (10) By (4), after torsion has been removed, T_jr=B sum_l b_jrl U_l, U_l=ell(u_l). Equations (9) and (7) now give delta beta =sum_(j,r) w_j T_jr wedge S_jr =B sum_l U_l wedge (sum_(j,r) w_j b_jrl S_jr) =0. (11) Hence beta is in B(K)_Q. It is anti-invariant under complex conjugation and its regulator is EXACTLY R_K(beta)=sum_(j in I) w_j D(z_j)=max_P V. (12) There is no undetermined additive multiple of a volume constant in (12): the symbols use their actual positive shapes and the regulator uses actual ideal-tetrahedron volume. If there are no positive atoms, beta=0 and the maximum is zero. If there are no quotient tangent variables, (4) makes every T_jr zero and the same proof works directly. This construction includes rational weights and affine constants of arbitrary denominators. Passing to Q coefficients removes the roots of unity in (4), the factor ell(-1) in (9), and the cleared exponent in (6). The argument does NOT remove that torsion integrally. No integral K-theory, integral Bloch boundary, or integral peripheral normalization is asserted. The ordered positive triples are uniquely selected by the maximum, even when some original wire coordinates are free. Thus (10) does not depend on choosing values for those flat coordinates. It is unchanged as a displayed symbol expression by a rational change of quotient coordinates; the coordinates are used to prove (11), not to define its shapes. There is also an elementary descent which removes the auxiliary phase field. Put F_shape=Q(z_j,bar z_j : j in I) subset K. The displayed expression beta already belongs to P(F_shape)_Q. The inclusion F_shape^times -> K^times is injective; tensoring with Q preserves that injection. Exterior squares of vector spaces preserve injections as well (extend a basis of the smaller space to a basis of the larger one). Thus exterior^2 U_(F_shape) -> exterior^2 U_K is injective. The image of delta beta is zero by (11), so its boundary was zero over F_shape itself. Consequently beta belongs to B(F_shape)_Q. This descent uses neither a presumed injection of Bloch groups nor a Galois or Hilbert-90 theorem. The phase coordinates merely provide a finite algebraic field in which the boundary calculation is transparent. For an empty atom list the class is zero over Q. ## 5. The full original quantum limit is a Bloch regulator For EVERY fixed robust actual positive Conway expression E, the [whole-source variational theorem](actual_positive_conway_variational_limit.md) and the algebraic maximum theorem yield, along all levels and both parities, lim_(N -> infinity) (2pi/N)log Z_(E,N) =2 max_(P_E) V_E =R_(F_shape)(B_E), B_E=sum_(j in I_E)([z_j]-[bar z_j]) in B(F_shape)_Q. (13) The weights here are all one and B_E=2 beta. Although its displayed symbol expression has integer coefficients, its proved zero-boundary statement is rational; possible integral torsion has not been checked. Z_(E,N) is the entire original source, with all colors and repeated-root normal directions retained. The class is selected by that exact source's positive variational problem, not by choosing an arbitrary branch of an A-polynomial. The [cap-sum reduction](actual_conway_cap_sum_reduction.md) is compatible with this construction. At a cap-closed product, the maximizing polytope is a Cartesian product, its final gate is flat, and the positive atom list is the union of the two lists. Thus, in a common number field, B_(cap FG)=B_(cap F)+B_(cap G). This agrees with the literal componentwise connected sum and exact source multiplication. It also shows why a nonzero Bloch regulator alone cannot certify a single complete hyperbolic complement. ## 6. The remaining geometric question is now more precise We have an actual source-selected RATIONAL BLOCH CLASS, and its regulator is the full quantum limit in (13). What is still missing for a broad hyperbolic-knot theorem is a proof that this regulator is the volume of the actual complement, for example by identifying the class with its marked geometric Bloch class or by supplying a source-compatible complete gluing certificate with the same volume. The vanishing in (11) is algebraic and global, but it is not a face pairing, an edge winding count, a cusp completeness equation, or a fundamental-class degree computation. It also does not identify K with a trace field, construct a generic-meridian A-torsor, or show that a formal source cycle is the preferred geometric representation. Those statements must not be inferred from the word "Bloch". Audit: [formal wedge and stationarity certificates](../experiments/audit_actual_positive_source_bloch_regulator.py) and [results](../experiments/actual_positive_source_bloch_regulator_results.json). The identities are uniform symbolic exterior-algebra calculations; finite numerical volumes are not used in their proof. Descent to the conjugation-stable shape field uses exterior-square injectivity. It does not assume that Bloch groups inject under field extension. The marked manifold-class comparison remains open.

title: A uniform all-index bound for the actual coherent pretzel inner packet
text: # A uniform all-index bound for the actual coherent pretzel inner packet 29 October 2026. The exact original-source Ward recurrence, together with its proved high-index source anchor, bounds EVERY remaining inner index. The estimate retains both classical characteristic branches, every endpoint factorial and both parities. Its prefactor is polynomial in N, uniformly even at r=0. No rational first-order factorization or choice of a single growing branch is assumed. ## 1. Literal selected packet and theorem Use N>=2, q=exp(pi i/N), Q=q^2, M=floor((N-1)/2), and F_a=(Q;Q)_a. In the EXACT original rotated box, reversing the two finite sums gives the inner packet \[ A_r=\sum_{v=r}^M Q^{-vr}\frac{F_{2v}}{F_v^3F_{v-r}}, \qquad D_r=Q^{-r^2}\frac{F_{2r}}{F_r^3}, \qquad U_r=A_r/D_r,\quad 0\leq r\leq M. \tag{1} \] All D_r are nonzero, including r=0 and r=M. These are the same packets in the [actual coherent inner elimination theorem](actual_pretzel_coherent_inner_gauss_elimination.md), not an arbitrary solution of their recurrence. That finite source transformation proves, at BOTH parities, \[ |U_r|\leq2N,\qquad \lceil N/4\rceil\leq r\leq M. \tag{2} \] Only this upper bound is needed here; its nonzero amplitude and phase are not substituted into a different index range. The same theorem proves the full selected Ward equation, with Y=Q^r, \[ QY^2(1-Q^2Y)A_{r+2} +Y(2Q^3Y^2+Q+1)A_{r+1} -Q(QY+1)(QY^2-1)A_r=0, \tag{3} \] and actual endpoints A_M=D_M, A_(M+1)=0. Define the continuous nonnegative envelope \[ E(u)=\begin{cases} \displaystyle\frac2\pi\int_u^{\pi/4}\log\cot v\,dv, &0\leq u\leq\pi/4,\\ 0, &\pi/4\leq u\leq\pi/2. \end{cases} \tag{4} \] The integral is finite at zero. The explicit uniform bound is \[ \boxed{|A_r|\leq8e^{128}N^{129}|D_r| \exp\{N E(\pi r/N)\}, \quad N\geq12,\quad0\leq r\leq M.} \tag{5} \] The constants are deliberately coarse and independent of N,r. In particular the exponential error after this full two-branch envelope is uniformly o(N). This is a bound for the literal finite packet BEFORE the original outer Newton sum and Hermite source; no boundary packet or original current has been dropped. ## 2. Exact factorial cancellation in the normalized recurrence The adjacent diagonal ratio is \[ \frac{D_{r+1}}{D_r} =Q^{-1}Y^{-2}\frac{(1-QY^2)(1+QY)}{(1-QY)^2}. \tag{6} \] The factors 1-QY^2 and 1+QY are EXACTLY those in the backward coefficient of (3). Cancelling them algebraically, rather than estimating inverse factorials separately, gives \[ U_r=p_N(Y)U_{r+1}+q_N(Y)U_{r+2}, \tag{7} \] \[ p_N(Y)=-\frac{Q^{-2}Y^{-1}(2Q^3Y^2+Q+1)}{(1-QY)^2}, \quad q_N(Y)=-\frac{Q^{-4}Y^{-2}(1-Q^3Y^2)(1+Q^2Y)} {(1-QY)^2(1-Q^2Y)}. \tag{8} \] For r=M-1 the numerator of q_N vanishes at BOTH parities: 1-Q^(2M+1)=0 for odd N, or 1+Q^(M+1)=0 for even N. Thus (7) extends to that last step with any assigned U_(M+1), for example zero. This is an exact cancellation of the terminal factorial zero, not division by D_(M+1). The proof below initializes instead at two genuine high-index U values in (2), so it needs no choice of a value beyond M. ## 3. Shifted classical matrix and a globally conditioned frame Put R=ceil(N/4), delta=pi/N, and for 0<=r<R use Z=Q^(r+1)=exp(2iu), u=(r+1)delta. The shifted classical backward matrix is \[ T_0(u)=\begin{pmatrix}p_0&q_0\\1&0\end{pmatrix},\qquad p_0=-\frac{Z^{-1}(2Z^2+2)}{(1-Z)^2},\quad q_0=-\frac{Z^{-2}(1+Z)^2}{(1-Z)^2}. \tag{9} \] On the unit circle its eigenvalues are mu_1=-Z^(-1), mu_2=Z^(-1)c, c=cot(u)^2, rho(u)=max(1,c). They remain DISTINCT even where their moduli meet. Use the normalized right eigenvector matrix \[ V(u)=\left( \frac{(-Z^{-1},1)^{\mathsf T}}{\sqrt2}, \frac{(Z^{-1}c,1)^{\mathsf T}}{\sqrt{1+c^2}} \right). \tag{10} \] Its column correlation is (1-c)/sqrt(2(1+c^2)), whose modulus is at most1/sqrt2. Therefore, UNIFORMLY for 0<u<pi/2, \[ \|V(u)\|_2<\sqrt2,\qquad \|V(u)^{-1}\|_2<2, \qquad \|V'(u)\|_2\leq4. \tag{11} \] For the derivative, write the second column as (e^(-2iu)cos theta,sin theta), theta=atan(tan(u)^2). If t=tan u, then theta'=2t(1+t^2)/(1+t^4)<=2, since 1+t^4-t-t^3=(t-1)^2(t^2+t+1)>=0. Its squared derivative norm is at most8; the first column's is2. Thus the Frobenius bound is sqrt10<4. This controls the frame all the way toward u=0; there is no hidden exponentially ill-conditioned change of basis. ## 4. The exact matrix has only a harmonic RELATIVE error Let T_N(r) be the companion matrix from (7). In the shifted Z coordinate, its coefficients are \[ p_N=-\frac{Z^{-1}(2Z^2+1+Q^{-1})}{(1-Z)^2},\qquad q_N=-\frac{Q^{-2}Z^{-2}(1-QZ^2)(1+QZ)} {(1-Z)^2(1-QZ)}. \tag{12} \] For N>=12 and r<R, u<=pi/3 and u+delta<pi/2. In particular |1+Z|^2>=1 and |1-QZ|=2sin(u+delta)>=2sin u>=4(r+1)/N, |Q-1|<=2pi/N. The difference in p is exactly -Z^(-1)(Q^(-1)-1)/(1-Z)^2. For q use the elementary numerator identity \[ (1-QZ^2)(1+QZ)-(1+Z)^2(1-QZ) =(Q-1)Z(2+Z-QZ^2). \tag{13} \] Dividing by rho>=c=|q_0| gives the uniform estimates |p_N-p_0|/rho<=2pi/(r+1), |q_N-q_0|/rho<=6pi/(r+1). Hence \[ \|T_N(r)-T_0(u)\|_2\leq\frac{8\pi}{r+1}\rho(u). \tag{14} \] Large absolute entries near r=0 have NOT been called small. They are controlled relative to the full eigenvalue envelope, whose large second branch is kept. Combining (11), (14) and the step u->u+delta proves \[ \|V(u)^{-1}T_N(r)V(u+\delta)\|_2 \leq\rho(u)\left(1+\frac{128}{r+1}\right). \tag{15} \] Indeed the frame change contributes at most8pi/N; the error term contributes at most16sqrt2*pi/(r+1). Their sum is less than 128/(r+1). This argument uses a full operator-norm bound and therefore allows arbitrary mixing of the two characteristic branches; it does not posit adiabatic survival of either one. ## 5. Selected high-index boundary to all-index estimate Write X_r=(U_r,U_(r+1))^T and X_r=T_N(r)X_(r+1). For N>=12 both R and R+1 are within the high range in (2). Thus ||X_R||<=2sqrt2 N. Iterating (15), using (11) at both ends, gives \[ |U_r|\leq8N \prod_{j=r}^{R-1}\rho((j+1)\pi/N) \left(1+\frac{128}{j+1}\right). \tag{16} \] The second product is at most exp(128 H_N)<=e^128 N^128. The logarithm of the first is the RIGHT Riemann sum of the nonnegative decreasing function max(0,2log cot u). Even for r=0 it is bounded ABOVE by its finite improper integral: sum_(j=r)^(R-1) log rho((j+1)pi/N) <=(N/pi) integral_(pi*r/N)^(pi/4) 2log cot u du =N E(pi*r/N). This proves (5) for r<R. Equation (2) proves it for r>=R. The argument is uniform at all indices, with no epsilon-dependent unstated endpoint constants. In particular, after the existing uniform sine-factorial estimate for D_r is applied, the whole coherent inner packet has precisely the two-branch upper envelope. Its lower-index excess is E(u); it is NOT assumed to be zero. Whether the positive outer Newton profile absorbs that excess is a separate variational inequality. This theorem supplies the source-faithful estimate needed for that comparison; it does not alone prove augmented-base survival, a volume LOWER bound, or a filling theorem. ## 6. Validation The [audit](../experiments/audit_actual_pretzel_all_index_backward_envelope.py) checks the original finite sum, selected Ward boundaries, exact normalized recurrence and endpoint cancellation, both high-range anchors, shifted coefficient differences, uniformly conditioned moving frame and its one-step bound, and the full coherent all-index envelope at both parities. Tests never replace the selected solution by an arbitrary recurrence branch.

title: A varying-radius alias estimate lowers the proved width threshold to nine
text: # A varying-radius alias estimate lowers the proved width threshold to nine 29 October 2026. The original short RP band admits a stronger global bound when its TRUE sine-binomial coefficients and its varying monic spectral radius are kept together. The uniform rate is B_*=(1/pi) integral_0^(pi/2) log rho(u) du < 81/100, instead of the previous (1/2)log(4+sqrt(15)). This proves the ENTIRE original-color source gap for every fixed odd width s>=9. All color endpoints, the even middle color, and the original Hermite normal jets remain. The previously proved corridor/filling and geometric-completion arguments therefore apply unchanged at those widths. This does not remove every width restriction: s=3,5,7 remain outside the present global alias argument. No assertion for them is obtained by naming this positive envelope a sharp source asymptotic. ## 1. Keep the exact original short-band coefficients Use q=exp(pi i/N), Q=q^2, d=N-1, s_a=|(Q;Q)_a| and the monic physical middle continuants p_l. The exact identity in [the original global alias theorem](actual_pretzel_global_alias_and_colored_source_gap.md) is (-1)^(N+h-1) P_(N,h)(z) =sum_(l=0)^(h-1) (-1)^l q^(3l^2+4l+1-2hl-h) [h+l choose 2l+1]_Q bar p_l(z). (1) It holds for EVERY 1<=h<=floor(N/2), including h=N/2 at even N. All Gaussian factorial indices are below N. The actual alias is R P_(N,h), not P alone and not a semisimple truncation. The monic recurrence has p_(l+1)=(z-D_l)p_l-a_(l-1)^2 p_(l-1), D_l=4qQ^l-q(1+Q)Q^(2l), a_(l-1)=-(1-Q^l)^2, (p_0,p_(-1))=(1,0). (2) The finite root phases in (1) are retained. Only after this exact identity will absolute values be taken. In particular no conjectural Laurent positivity or ordinary-color unitarity is needed. ## 2. Exact pointwise maximal frozen radius Freeze u=pi l/N in [0,pi/2]. After a unit phase change the two frozen roots obey lambda^2-d_z lambda+a^2=0, d_z=z exp(-2iu)-4+2exp(2iu), a=4sin(u)^2. (3) For z=-2 define t=sqrt(1+8sin(u)^2), rho(u)=(t+1)/2 * [2+sqrt((t+1)(3-t))]. (4) This is EXACTLY the larger root modulus in (3), not a numerical fit. For a derivation put y=1-cos(2u), so a=2y, d_(-2)=-4+4i sin(2u). Then |d_(-2)|^2=16(1+2y-y^2), |d_(-2)^2-4a^2|=16sqrt(1+4y). If the root moduli are rho and a^2/rho, their squared sum is (|d|^2+|d^2-4a^2|)/2. Solving this quadratic and taking its positive square root gives (4). Equivalently set t-1=2sin theta; then rho(u)=(1+sin theta+cos theta)^2, 0<=theta<=pi/2. In particular rho is continuous, positive, rho>=a, and 4<=rho<=3+2sqrt(2). It is the POINTWISE maximum over all real z in [-2,2]. Indeed at z=2 the roots both equal -a. For fixed a, a root of modulus r>=a makes d_z lie on the ellipse d=r exp(i theta)+(a^2/r) exp(-i theta). Its closed interior is exactly the region where both roots have modulus at most r. For r=rho(u), the z=-2 endpoint lies on the ellipse and the z=2 endpoint lies inside. Convexity covers their entire affine z-segment. The two endpoints u=0,pi/2 follow directly from (3); no inverse eigenframe is used there. ## 3. A uniform varying-product estimate for the actual polynomials Put I(v)=integral_0^v log rho(pi t) dt, 0<=v<=1/2. The exact companions of (2), divided at their l-th step by rho(pi l/N), converge uniformly to a bounded continuous family whose root moduli are at most one, uniformly for z in [-2,2]. Their coefficients have no singular root endpoint. The frozen-block Cayley--Hamilton argument therefore gives max_(z in[-2,2]) |p_l(z)| <=exp[N I(l/N)+epsilon_N N], max_(0<=l<=floor(N/2)) epsilon_N ->0. (5) For clarity this is an actual product bound, not an adiabatic claim. For a fixed block length L, the exact normalized block differs uniformly by o(1) from its frozen power. A bounded 2x2 matrix with root moduli at most one has ||B^L||<=CL by Cayley--Hamilton, also at a double root. First choose L to make log(CL)/L small, then N large, and concatenate blocks. Uniform continuity of log rho turns the scalar product of radii into N I(l/N)+o(N), uniformly in l. The initial vector is exactly (1,0). This proves (5) through BOTH index endpoints without a conditioned eigenvector factor. ## 4. The entire sine-binomial envelope has an exact global maximum Let J(x)=integral_0^x log(2sin(pi t)) dt, 0<=x<=1. The already proved UNIFORM factorial estimate gives, with alpha=h/N and beta=l/N, log |[h+l choose 2l+1]_Q| =N[J(alpha+beta)-J(2beta)-J(alpha-beta)]+O(log N). (6) The index shifts by one cost O(log N), uniformly even at zero and N-1. This estimate is applied only to actual indices below N. Combining (5),(6), the possible term rate in (1) is at most F(alpha,beta)=J(alpha+beta)-J(2beta)-J(alpha-beta)+I(beta), 0<=beta<=alpha<=1/2. (7) Its maximum is EXACTLY B_*=I(1/2). Here is an elementary proof. For 0<beta<alpha<1/2, partial_alpha F=log[sin pi(alpha+beta)/sin pi(alpha-beta)]>=0, because their difference is 2cos(pi alpha)sin(pi beta)>=0. Thus maximize first at alpha=1/2. At that boundary, d/d beta F(1/2,beta) =log[rho(pi beta)/(4sin(pi beta)^2)]>=0, using rho>=a in section2. Therefore the maximum occurs at (alpha,beta)=(1/2,1/2). Since J(0)=J(1)=0, its value is B_*. All boundary cases follow by continuity of J and I. No unsupported interior saddle or numerical optimization is being used. Sum the at most N terms in (1). The polynomial degree is h-1<=N/2; complex Markov on [-2,2] controls N^(-2) times its first derivative at every actual node with only the same fixed factor as before. The actual crossing R has faithful Hermite norm at most9/8. Hence limsup_N (1/N) log max_(1<=h<=floor(N/2)) ||R P_(N,h)||_H <= B_*. (8) Thus (8) retains ALL original source normal jets and the actual crossing. It is not a bound for an unrelated positive comparison model. ## 5.
