title: Exact partner reflection of the normalized Racah root value
text: # Exact partner reflection of the normalized Racah root value 29 October 2026. For every supported folded sextuple, the normalized squared Racah VALUE is unchanged under ANY of the sixty-four independent reflections j -> N-1-j. The proof uses the actual generic source normalization, a genuine cyclic turn, a uniform factorial certificate, and residues of channel projectors on a saturated analytic invariant lattice. It does not assume a semisimple root quotient or a named 6j symmetry. All higher normal currents remain present; they are NOT invariant, as an exact first-normal counterexample below shows. ## 1. Statement and the precise metric convention Fix N>=2, D=N-1, q=exp(pi i/N). Start with six folded spins a,b,c,d,e,f in [0,D/2], with all four admissible face sums F=(a+b+e,c+d+e,a+d+f,b+c+f) >= D. (1) Admissible means the ordinary triangle conditions and integer face sums. The original graph channels are INTEGER spins; the same proof allows admissible half-integral spins with the phase stated below. Let Q=(a+b+c+d,a+c+e+f,b+d+e+f). At generic zeta define S=sum_(z=max F)^(min Q) (-1)^z[z+1]! /(product_i[z-F_i]! product_k[Q_k-z]!), Delta_F^2=[F-2x]![F-2y]![F-2z]!/[F+1]!, mathcal W(zeta)^2=[N]^2 S^2 product_faces Delta_F^2. (2) The factorials are symmetric quantum factorials, retained GENERICALLY. For a partner branch replace any subset of the six spins by D-j in these SAME formulas. Every branch of (2) has a finite root limit. For INTEGER spins it is the positive quantity W_N^2=R_N^2 product_faces d_F, R_N=N sum_(max F<=z<=min(Q,2D)) s_(z-D)/(product_i s_(z-F_i) product_k s_(Q_k-z)), d_F=product_(j in face)s_(F-2j)/(N s_(F-D)), s_r=product_(u=1)^r 2sin(pi u/N). (3) Then EXACTLY W_N^2(j_1,...,j_6) =W_N^2(D-j_1,j_2,...,j_6)=... (4) under all sixty-four independent partner choices, at both parities and every composite level. No asymptotic assertion is used. For admissible half-integral spins the generic squared expression has mathcal W(q)^2=(-1)^[2sum_six j] W_N^2. That sign is unchanged by every partner reflection, since its exponent changes by 2D-4j, an even integer. Thus both the signed generic metric value and the positive sine-factorial convention satisfy (4). No positive-square convention is silently extended to half spins. ## 2. The full actual source fixes a reciprocal trace normalization Let A=2a,B=2b,C=2c,D0=2d,E=2e,G=2f be INTEGER highest weights. Use the ACTUAL invariant columns S_E,T_G and inverse source matrix L_(G,E) from [the generic all-port source theorem](actual_general_four_port_single_racah_kernel.md). Write its explicitly proved seven-factorial prefactor as p: L_(G,E)^ABCD=p_abcd(e,f) S. This p includes every actual cup, cyclic sign, monomial and factorial. The reciprocal coefficient is not obtained by squaring p and guessing an ordered norm ratio. Indeed let C_A move the last V_A to the front by its actual snakes, so it multiplies by (-1)^A K_A. It gives C_A S_G^BCDA=T_G^ABCD, C_A T_E^BCDA=S_E^ABCD. (5) For the second equality, the two cyclic moves interchange the two coupled pairs in S_E. Their clock is K_A K_B=K_E, while the internal cup reversal has ratio P_E(E-r)/P_E(r)=(-1)^E zeta^(-E+2r). The monomial cancels K_E, and the total sign is (-1)^(A+B+E)=1 by channel parity. This proves (5) on ALL external colors, not just on a highest corner. It follows that the actual reciprocal matrix is R_(E,G)^ABCD=L_(E,G)^BCDA. (6) The exact source prefactors consequently satisfy p_abcd(e,f) p_bcda(f,e) =[2e+1][2f+1] product_faces Delta_F^2. (7) Here is a uniform own algebraic certificate for (7). In the all-port theorem, put s=(A+B+C+D0)/2, Gmax=min(A+D0,B+C), n=(Gmax-G)/2, t0=s-Gmax and M=(Gmax+G)/2+1. Its finite product V_n can be written V_n=zeta^[n+2n(t0+n)] F_M F_(s+1-n)F_t0 / [F_(G+1)F_(s+1)F_n F_(t0+n)]. (8) Replace every symmetric factorial by zeta^[-r(r-1)/2]F_r/(1-Q)^r in the explicit source prefactor p=chi_E X_E/(b_G J_n S0 V_n). There are FOUR algebraic cases: the two choices of Gmax and the two choices of the cyclic Emax. For all four, literal cancellation gives the following ratio to the right side of (7): nonzero F_r exponents: none, residual zeta exponent:0, residual (1-Q) exponent:0, residual sign exponent: E+G-3A-2B-C-2D0. (9) This last integer is even because E=A+B mod2 and G=B+C mod2. The accompanying certificate represents each F_r by its INDEPENDENT symbolic linear argument in A,B,C,D0,E,G and verifies all four factor-exponent dictionaries identically. Quadratic zeta exponents are expanded as polynomial identities. Thus (9) is a finite uniform factorial proof, not a numerical fit or an assumed orthogonality norm. Let M_abcd=Inv_K(V_A tensor V_B tensor V_C tensor V_D0), over generic meromorphic germs K. On this ACTUAL space let Pi_e^S and Pi_f^T be the generic rank-one channel projectors for the two pairings. By ordinary matrix trace in the source basis, (6),(7) give tr(Pi_e^S Pi_f^T)=R_(E,G)L_(G,E) =[2e+1][2f+1] product_faces Delta_F^2 S^2, mathcal W^2=[N]^2 tr(Pi_e^S Pi_f^T)/ ([2e+1][2f+1]). (10) This is the proper source-normalized, gauge-free trace identity. It uses an ordinary trace on the multiplicity space, not an illicit replacement of the original marked physical row by a quantum trace. The all-port source identities already keep that row and any exterior outside the local recoupling. No original framing or crossing scalar has been canceled in (10). There is a corresponding exact GENERIC diagonal bilinear transport, which fixes the distinction from an incorrectly ordered Clebsch norm. Write L_(G,E)=a_E b_G S with the actual separable source gauges in the all-port theorem, and D_E=Delta_abe^2 Delta_cde^2, D_G=Delta_bcf^2 Delta_daf^2. Equations (6),(7) give M_S(E)=a_E^2/([2e+1]D_E), M_T(G)=[2f+1]D_G/b_G^2, R=M_S^(-1) L^T M_T, L^T M_T L=M_S. (10a) The transpose is bilinear, not a Hermitian adjoint. These generic weights can have zeros, poles and phases at the root, so (10a) does not supply a positive full confluent metric or a bound on its source conditioning. It retains the actual source gauges rather than replacing the reciprocal prefactor by its square. ## 3. Every partner has exactly the needed physical channel collision For one folded face (x,y,z) with x,y,z<=D/2 and x+y+z>=D, any subset of partner flips gives D<=x'+y'+z'<=2D, 0<=y'+z'-x'<=D, and its two cyclic versions. (11) The minimum of the first expression is the folded sum and its maximum is three D minus that sum. The minimum of the second over flips is foldedSum-D, and its maximum is 2D-foldedSum. This proves (11) before any root calculation, including boundary faces. Fix ANY partner branch of all six labels. The ACTUAL generic left channel range is I_S=[|a-b|,a+b] intersect [|c-d|,c+d], step1. (12) Both e and e*=D-e lie in this range by (11). Applying its deficit bound to BOTH values gives max I_S <= D+min(e,e*) < N+min(e,e*). (13) All indices in I_S are nonnegative. The root Casimir eigenvalues are lambda_j(q)=q^(2j+1)+q^(-2j-1). Equality to lambda_e means j=e mod N or j=D-e mod N. Equation (13) excludes EVERY upward alias e+N and e*+N, and there are no downward aliases because 0<=e,e*<=D<N. Thus the complete collision class in the FULL actual range (12) is EXACTLY {e,e*}. The same proof applies to the right range and {f,f*}. The argument retains all generic high channels in (12); it does not truncate a channel range to its folded half. Other eigenvalue clusters can collide too, but none collides with this selected one. ## 4. Saturation makes the residue comparison legitimate Let O be the analytic-germ ring at zeta=q, K its fraction field, and V_A(O),... the ordinary highest-weight modules with the original balanced matrices. Those matrices are holomorphic even for high partners: their entries contain no divided-factorial denominators. The actual generic invariant lattice is Lambda=Inv_K(V_A(K) tensor V_B(K) tensor V_C(K) tensor V_D0(K)) intersect V_A(O) tensor V_B(O) tensor V_C(O) tensor V_D0(O). (14) It is a finite free O module. Indeed it is a saturated submodule of a finite free module over the one-dimensional local analytic DVR; torsion-free finite modules there have an O basis. The generic rank is the already proved channel dimension |I_S|=|I_T|. Each interval Casimir preserves (14): it is an actual holomorphic Hopf intertwiner and preserves generic invariants, so it preserves their intersection with the ambient lattice. Consequently its matrix on Lambda is holomorphic. This is the point that prevents singular generic source frames from being mistaken for a regular root basis. If e!=e*, the eigenvalue gap is a SIMPLE zero: D_logzeta(lambda_e-lambda_e*)|q =2N(q^(2e+1)-q^(-2e-1))!=0. (15) If this factor vanished the node would be -2 and e=e*=D/2. The unique-collision statement of section3 shows that the pair's minimal factor is coprime at q to the factors for all other channels. Finite polynomial Bezout therefore constructs an analytic cluster projector E_e onto the two selected generic eigenlines. Hence Pi_e=E_e (A-lambda_e* I)/(lambda_e-lambda_e*), Pi_e+Pi_e*=E_e, (16) where A is the interval Casimir. Each projector has at most a simple pole on the ACTUAL saturated lattice, and their residues are opposite. No semisimplicity assumption at the root was used. If e=e*=D/2, the same Bezout argument constructs its analytic single-channel projector. The corresponding generic quantum dimension is exactly [2e+1]=[N], which has one simple zero. For a paired e the dimension is a root unit and [2e*+1]|q=-[2e+1]|q. (17) Identical conclusions hold for f and the other interval Casimir. ## 5. Laurent orders prove the full sixty-four value identity Let r be the number of PAIRED selected internal channels among e,f. The preceding saturated-lattice construction gives tr(Pi_e Pi_f)=O(t^-r), t=log(zeta/q). The scalar [N] has a simple zero, and each simple internal channel contributes exactly one [N] to the denominator of (10). Therefore the scalar prefactor in (10) has zero order r. The product has a finite limit, without any deletion of a normal direction. For a paired e, replace Pi_e by Pi_e*=E_e-Pi_e. The coefficient of t^-r in the trace changes sign: E_e is analytic and its product with Pi_f has pole order at most r-1. At the same time the nonzero leading quantum-dimension factor [2e+1] changes sign by (17). The signs cancel in (10). The simple case e=e* is tautological. This proves one internal-edge partner reflection for ANY choice of the other five partner values, including an odd simple f. The f proof is identical. Finally the face/opposite incidence in (2) is invariant under every tetrahedral vertex relabeling, and this group acts transitively on the six edges. Any chosen edge can thus be put in the internal e position of (10). After any previous reflections, (11)--(17) still hold. Iterating proves ALL sixty-four choices in (4), with no parity or prime-level exception. For clarity the root positivity and retained tail can also be read directly from (2). All seven denominator factorial indices are in [0,D] by (11) and the opposite-face difference identities. The root value core z<=2D has common phase and is nonempty since max F<=2D. The tail z>2D contains the additional factor [2N] and vanishes ONLY at the value. Thus (3) has strictly positive terms. This is compatible with, and does not replace, the source/projector proof of its symmetry. ## 6. The full generic normal is retained and is not symmetric There is an EXACT generic relation in place of an incorrect jet symmetry. For a paired e write d_j=[2j+1] and let E_e=Pi_e+Pi_e* be its analytic cluster on the SAME actual source space. Equation (10) gives, before specialization, d_e* mathcal W(e*,f)^2+d_e mathcal W(e,f)^2 =[N]^2/d_f tr(E_e Pi_f). (17a) The right side is O(t), with t=log(zeta/q), whether f is paired or simple. The four terms retain their full generic gauges and normal currents. Analyticity of the clusters proves the stated orders. In particular the weighted sum in (17b) has zero first normal, although its individual summands need not. These are source/projector conservation identities, not bounds on the individual cluster trace or an instruction to dephase copies. Set G(zeta)=(-1)^D S(zeta)/[N]. Termwise removal of the actual zeros gives the exact local analytic decomposition G=C+[2N]T. (18) Here C contains z<=2D and T contains z>2D, with BOTH [N] and [2N] removed in its numerator. All true denominator indices are <N, and z+1<3N on these partner branches, so C,T are analytic. For the latter bound, every folded opposite sum is >=D; replacing its four labels gives at most 4D minus that sum, hence <=3D. This accounts for every numerator zero and loses no tail. For the logarithmic generic derivative, dot G(q)=dot C(q)+4N/(q-q^-1) T(q). (19) There are actual partner branches where this additional normal is nonzero. At N=4, labels (2,2,2,2,2,1) give T(q)=-1 and the missing current is exactly 8sqrt(2)i. It is not valid to differentiate the positive value core alone. Their first Taylor coefficients reduce respectively to 994 and 426, a difference 441!=0 modulo 1009. Thus the actual algebraic first derivatives differ over C; the certificate is a nonvanishing proof, not a numerical trend. The audit retains the full C+[2N]T and every face-normalization jet in this comparison. The theorem is therefore an EXACT ROOT VALUE symmetry, not a generic-q symmetry or a bound on all partner normal jets. title: The actual cyclic head has a rank-one moment relation and an orbit co-source
text: # The actual cyclic head has a rank-one moment relation and an orbit co-source Research proof, 27 October 2026. The proposed multiplicative relation is exact for the actual repaired head. Its natural moment covector differs from the original Whittaker row. Retaining their finite orbit path gives the original source and an explicit whole Ward homotopy. Actual R coefficients transport the moment framing, but do not make the orbit row an eigenrow. Thus the relation yields an exact source sum rule rather than survival of the geometric line in the last sum. This is a direct finite-matrix calculation. No classification or published multiplicative-moment proof is used. ## 1. Exact framed multiplicative relation before root specialization Use the actual matrices from [the highest/Whittaker boundary construction](actual_highest_whittaker_boundary_and_moving_walls.md): \[ B=\operatorname{diag}(1,Q,\ldots,Q^{N-1}),\quad P=\sum_{j=0}^{N-2}E_{j+1,j}+E_{0,N-1},\quad P^N=I. \] Write Z=Q^N, delta=1-Z, v=e_0, w=e_0^t, e=vw=E_00, so wv=1. Since W=eP=E_(0,N-1), the exact relation BP-QPB=delta W gives \[ \boxed{\quad BPB^{-1}P^{-1}=Q[I+(Z^{-1}-1)vw].\quad} \tag{1} \] For example W B inverse P inverse=Q^(-(N-1))e, proving every coefficient and the sign in (1). With the actual framing vector v and scaled covector what=(Z inverse minus one)w, it is the framed equation Q inverse BPB inverse P inverse=I+v what. Its determinant forces and satisfies 1+what v=Z inverse. The inverse equation is equally exact: \[ PB P^{-1}B^{-1}=Q^{-1}[I+(Z-1)e]. \tag{2} \] It is the rank of the Q-NORMALIZED commutator minus I that is at most one. The factor Q cannot be dropped: at a primitive N-th root Q is not one. Generically Z not one makes that rank exactly one. At Z=1 it drops to zero, but the divided normal retains \[ \left[\frac{Q^{-1}BPB^{-1}P^{-1}-I}{1-Q^N}\right]_{Q_N}=e. \tag{3} \] The actual whole lift specifies w through what=(Z inverse minus one)w. A bare root moment relation with what=0 does not reconstruct that divided covector or the selected source. ## 2. Both actual endpoint walls use this same marked projector Let kappa=M-M inverse, e_top=P inverse eP. The cyclic expressions and actual finite generators factor WHOLE as \[ F_{cyc}=P(I-QB),\quad \mathcal E_{cyc}=P^{-1}(MB^{-1}-M^{-1}I), \] \[ \boxed{\quad F=F_{cyc}(I-e_{top})=F_{cyc}-\delta eP,\qquad \mathcal E=\mathcal E_{cyc}(I-e) =\mathcal E_{cyc}-\kappa P^{-1}e. \quad} \tag{4} \] The first equation deletes the last raising arrow and the second deletes the first lowering arrow. Thus both actual walls have the same rank-one framing transported to the appropriate end. The multiplicative commutator itself only sees the Q-wall delta; the independent meridian character kappa must also be retained. In particular F^N=0 while F_cyc^N=delta(Q;Q)_(N-1)I, and the original pair detects the divided wrap value N. At a primitive root E_cyc^N=(-1)^(N-1)(M^N-M inverse N)I. These are the actual central norms and endpoint factors, including the ones entering the full modified-dimension ratio. Neither (1) nor its root rank drop replaces these norms by numerical units or equates their different normal directions. ## 3. The actual co-source is a required finite orbit path The natural moment covector is w. The original output row is ell=ones transpose. It is recovered exactly by the finite path \[ S_P=\sum_{r=0}^{N-1}P^r,\qquad \ell=w S_P,\qquad Q_0=v\ell=e S_P. \tag{5} \] Thus the exact highest-input period is ell C v=w S_P C v, not just w C v on arbitrary current matrices. Both anchors equal one on I, but their rows are not proportional for N greater than one. Any simultaneous change of basis carries w,ell and S_P together; it cannot erase their relative orbit path. There is a source-preserving framed period identity, not just the unpointed matrix relation. Write Delta_mom=BPB inverse P inverse minus QI and lambda(C)=ell C v. Combining (1) and (5) gives \[ \Delta_{mom}S_P=Q(Z^{-1}-1)Q_0, \] \[ \boxed{\quad \lambda(C_1\Delta_{mom}S_P C_2) =Q(Z^{-1}-1)\lambda(C_1)\lambda(C_2). \quad} \tag{5a} \] This holds for arbitrary actual whole matrices C_1,C_2 with their coefficient lines consistently retained. It is the literal rank-one cut/source factorization: Q_0=v ell. Dividing the already specified whole equation by delta and evaluating at the root gives coefficient Q_N on the right. Equivalently the selected divided moment insertion is Q_N Q_0. Without S_P the right factor would have the different moment row w. Thus (5a) is an actual whole loop/source identity with its required orbit path, not permission to discard that path or to assign a new value to the uninserted period. The norm of S_P in the original flat unitary head metric is N, and the norm of ell is sqrt N. No exponential source scale is introduced by (5). Conversely these elementary source bounds are not a bound on the actual R word or its period. There is an exact WHOLE source-current comparison. Put D_K C=K C K inverse minus C with K=xB inverse, and define \[ \beta_K(X)=\sum_{c=1}^{N-1}\frac{X_{c,0}}{Q^{-c}-1}. \] Every displayed denominator is a unit at a primitive N-th root. Entrywise multiplication gives \[ \boxed{\quad \ell C v-wCv=\beta_K(D_K C).\quad} \tag{6} \] This is the K-only specialization of the established actual Ward source homotopies. It holds before jets on arbitrary C, so all derivatives of beta_K, K, C and the original peripheral line are retained. At the physical root its exact flat-metric row norm is \[ \|\beta_K\|^2 =\sum_{c=1}^{N-1}\frac1{4\sin^2(\pi c/N)} =\frac{N^2-1}{12}. \tag{7} \] For a direct proof of the last identity, apply two logarithmic derivatives at one to (t^N-1)/(t-1), whose roots are the nontrivial N-th roots. This gives sum Q^c/(1-Q^c)^2=-(N^2-1)/12; each negative summand is the corresponding reciprocal squared sine. ## 4. Exact consequence for the actual one-index Fourier source Use the whole Vandermonde change on the SECOND wire and put A_j[c,a]=T^V_(c,j;a,j). Define \[ J^{Whit}_j=\ell A_j v,\qquad J^{mom}_j=w A_j v. \] Equation (6) gives the WHOLE coefficientwise relation \[ J^{Whit}_j-J^{mom}_j=\beta_K(D_K A_j). \tag{8} \] At the original root, charge conservation and the ordinary scalar closure prove \[ J^{mom}_j=P_N/N,\qquad J^{Whit}_j=P_N/N+\beta_K(D_K A_j),\qquad \sum_j\beta_K(D_K A_j)=0. \tag{9} \] Indeed setting c=a=0 forces the old second offset to zero; Fourier transformation then contributes precisely 1/N and no j dependence. The first formula is not an off-root scalarity claim. The whole sum of (8) is beta_K(D_K C); it vanishes at the root for the uninserted fully reclosed scalar C, while inserted currents and normal derivatives retain their actual defects. Equation (9) is a genuine constraint on the final finite j source. It also explains a limitation: replacing the Whittaker orbit by the natural moment row loses ALL nonconstant Fourier geometry. The geometric formal block may occur in this Ward sector, whose sum is controlled only after closure. A nonzero local block or a rank-one moment relation does not prove its selected survival. ## 5. Actual R transports the framing but not the orbit row trivially For any actual invertible crossing R, conjugating ALL B_i,P_i,e_i and their vector/covector maps preserves (1)-(4) algebraically. This is a strict identity of the actual finite matrix algebra; it is not a claim that individual generators remain fixed. For two highest inputs the literal actual coefficients give \[ R(v\otimes v)=r_{00}(v\otimes v),\qquad (w\otimes w)R=r_{00}(w\otimes w). \] The full scalar r_00, including its half-Cartan mark, is retained. Thus the highest moment framing is compatible up to this actual scalar. For two copies of the original boundary object, its tensor orbit row has the exact residual \[ (\ell\otimes\ell)R-r_{00}(\ell\otimes\ell) =(w\otimes w)[S_P\otimes S_P,R]. \tag{10} \] It is generally nonzero. At N=2, q=i, eta_half=exp(pi i/4), the literal positive crossing matrix displayed in [the actual boundary-moment audit](actual_negative_band_boundary_moment_and_ward_atom.md) has r_00=eta_half. The input (0,1) component of (10) is eta_half inverse minus eta_half=-sqrt(2)i, not zero. Multiplying the crossing by its retained scalar normalization multiplies both sides; it does not remove this defect. Actual word, cap and prefix transport must carry the orbit path and this residual. This is a local boundary-object covariance test. A full original braid still has its pivotal caps on the other strands; their source is not replaced by ell tensor ell. The actual fully sourced one-index identity is (8)-(9), with those original caps retained. Even the naive tensor product of the moment pairs is not another rank-one pair: for B_tot=B_1B_2,P_tot=P_1P_2 its normalized commutator is (I+a e_1)(I+a e_2), a=Z inverse minus one. For generic Z not plus or minus one its defect has rank 2N-1, preserved by every simultaneous crossing conjugation. The true Hopf/coprod and source fusion therefore cannot be replaced by that naive product if a rank-one target is desired. ## 6. Exact audit and scope [The independent script](../experiments/audit_rank_one_moment_orbit_source.py) and [its output](../experiments/rank_one_moment_orbit_source_results.json) check the whole framed relation, endpoint projectors, root divided class, orbit path, current homotopy, actual Fourier sum rule and literal R residual, including a characteristic-zero example. The usable whole object is the framed pair B,P,v,w WITH its original orbit co-source S_P, both actual endpoint deletions and the meridian characters. This is more precise than a bare root commutator relation. It supplies exact source-current identities; it does not identify a global geometric cycle, make the final source horizontal by itself, or prove a volume limit. ## 7. Existing terminology and the root specialization The defining rank-one multiplicative-commutator relation occurs in [Chalykh--Fairon, Section 3, page 10](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1704.05814). Their invertible-coordinate presentation has rank(XZX inverse Z inverse minus q_0 I)=1. Our actual generic pair has X=B, Z=P and q_0=Q. At Q^N=1 its rank drops to zero, so the root belongs to the rank-at-most-one closure, with the divided marking (3) retained. Their Proposition 3.3 assumes q_0 is not a root of unity. Their subsequent regular coordinate chart also excludes x_i=q_0 x_j, which the actual clock spectrum violates. No smoothness or coordinate theorem there is applied to this resonant root/source section; only the defining coverage is used. The additional [aligned source-frame theorem](flat_cyclic_source_frame_and_scalar_period.md) proves the whole matrix-algebra classification directly, including its necessary alignment and flat-saturation hypotheses. The [actual Fourier cancellation theorem](actual_fourier_source_cancellation.md) then constructs a nonzero geometric Ward block whose selected cyclic sum vanishes. These distinguish frame rigidity from the remaining selected-period problem.

title: The full actual reassociation is an angle half-density
text: # The full actual reassociation is an angle half-density 29 October 2026. Every entry of the actual adjacent-pair fusion reassociation has a unique two-transfer path. In the source-fixing physical quarter-factorial gauge, its squared entry is exactly a product of FOUR positive affine-angle weights, one per cell. The full root phase and all strict finite-head inequalities are explicit. This is an all-entry, all-exterior tensor identity. It supplies actual shared-charge incidence, rather than assigning independent angle variables after taking absolute values. It does not yet identify this cell complex with a geometric ideal triangulation or bound its global partition by knot volume. ## 1. The actual divided-power fusion is one finite Euler operator Put `q=exp(pi*i/N)`, `Q=q^2`, `d=N-1`, `F_a=(Q;Q)_a`, `s_a=|F_a|`, and use the original balanced head basis. Let S^-|a>=|a-1> for a>0, S^-|0>=0, mathsfF|a>=(1-Q^(a+1))|a+1>, mathsfF|d>=0. For a nonzero original meridian root x, divide the ACTUAL Borel fusion column indexed `(a,b)` by its explicit `F_a`, and denote the resulting map by C'_x. Its exact kernel is (C'_x)_(a-r,b+r;a,b)=x^(-r) [b+r choose r]_Q, 0<=r<=min(a,d-b). (1) All other entries vanish. This follows either from the original coproduct powers or from the physical kernel of [actual fusion](actual_borel_regular_fusion_and_divided_cap_period.md). No relative index is identified with a physical one without this map. Set `T_x=x^(-1) S^- tensor mathsfF`. Then `T_x^N=0` and C'_x=p_N(T_x), p_N(t)=sum_(r=0)^d t^r/F_r, (C'_x)^(-1)=sum_(r=0)^d (-1)^r Q^(r(r-1)/2)t^r/F_r evaluated at t=T_x. (2) Indeed the r-th power has coefficient `x^-r F_(b+r)/F_b`. The finite Euler inverse follows by q-binomial convolution. Its inverse entry is (1) times `(-1)^r Q^(r(r-1)/2)`, with exactly the SAME strict support. Every endpoint and zero transfer is retained. For reference the head relation is EXACT at both finite endpoints: S^- mathsfF=(1-Q)I+Q mathsfF S^-. On three heads it gives `T_23 T_12=Q T_12 T_23+(1-Q)T_13`, where `T_13=(xy)^(-1)S_1^- mathsfF_3` if the two fusion parameters are x,y. Thus the overlap is an actual finite q-oscillator algebra, with no silently omitted rank-one endpoint correction. ## 2. Every reassociation entry, including its phase Let A_xy=(I tensor C'_y)^(-1)(C'_x tensor I). For input `(a,b,c)` the only possible outputs are (u,v,w)=(a-r,b+r-s,c+s), 0<=r<=min(a,d-b), 0<=s<=min(b+r,d-c). (3) For each input/output there is at most one path, since `r=a-u`, `s=w-c`. The COMPLETE entry is A_(u,v,w;a,b,c) =(-1)^s Q^(s(s-1)/2)x^(-r)y^(-s) [b+r choose r]_Q [c+s choose s]_Q. (4) In particular the intermediate head bound `b+r<=d` is essential; checking only the final output would add spurious entries. Formula (4) follows by multiplying the two literal kernels (1)--(2). It is an operator identity on the complete finite three-head space, so it preserves ANY adjoining tensor, source or current when all their interfaces are transported. No knot scalar occurs in it. Assume now `|x|=|y|=1`, including the original complete source. Write `beta_(L,r)=s_L/(s_r s_(L-r))`. The principal half-root identity `[L choose r]_Q=q^(r(L-r)) beta_(L,r)` gives the exact unit phase omega=(-1)^s x^(-r)y^(-s) q^[rb+sc+s(s-1)]. (5) All signs and the half-period q are kept, at odd and even N. There is also an exact Fourier polarization of this phase: omega=zeta_out(u,w) zeta_in(a,b,c) q^(-ub-wc), zeta_out=(-1)^w x^u y^(-w)q^(w^2-w), zeta_in=(-1)^c x^(-a)y^c q^(ab+c). (5a) Substituting `u=a-r,w=c+s` proves (5a). Its bilinear part is a TWO-variable 2N-half-clock Fourier phase. The physical indices still lie in the original N-windows with the strict constraints (3); an unwindowed Fourier/Plancherel replacement is not authorized by this phase identity alone. ## 3. Source-fixing quarter gauge and four positive cells Use the PHYSICAL gauge g_a=L_a^(-1/4)=N^(1/4)/sqrt(s_a), L_a=s_a^2/N, h_a=g_a^2=sqrt(N)/s_a. It is source-fixing because `g_a g_(d-a)=1`. The original cup and ordinary cap are fixed on their complementary physical indices; the full marked row has this property on its degree-d restriction. The original integer-degree argument forces that restriction only after the other ordinary caps have been assembled. We use exactly that whole-source scope, as in [the physical weighted-source theorem](actual_weighted_fourier_plat_energy.md). Original pivots commute with this gauge. No marked corner is inserted in an arbitrary exterior. Let `Ahat=g^(tensor 3) A (g^(-1))^(tensor 3)`. For every entry (3), |Ahat_entry|^2 = beta_(a,r) beta_(b+r,r) beta_(b+r,s) beta_(c+s,s) = N^4 product_(j=1)^4 w_N(alpha_j), (6) where `w_N(i,j,k)=1/(s_i s_j s_k)` and alpha_1=(r,a-r,d-a), alpha_2=(r,b,d-b-r), alpha_3=(s,b+r-s,d-b-r), alpha_4=(s,c,d-c-s). (7) Every alpha has nonnegative integer entries summing EXACTLY to d. The full complex half-density is therefore Ahat_entry=N^2 omega sqrt(product_j w_N(alpha_j)). (8) Proof. The squared gauge ratio is `s_a s_b s_c/[s_(a-r)s_(b+r-s)s_(c+s)]`. Multiply this by the squared magnitudes of the two binomials in (4). Inserting the intermediate `s_(b+r)` expresses the result as the four beta factors in (6). Finally each beta is exactly `N w_N(r,L-r,d-L)` by root complementation. This proves (6)--(8) without changing or suppressing any original source factor. For a single C'_x or its inverse, the corresponding two-cell formula is |Chat'_entry|^2 =N^2 w_N(r,a-r,d-a)w_N(r,b,d-b-r). (9) The inverse has the additional unit phase from (2), so its positive cell kernel is identical, while its coherent composition differs. ### Exact incidence, rather than independent angles The four cells in (7) satisfy alpha_1,1=alpha_2,1=r, alpha_3,1=alpha_4,1=s, alpha_2,3=alpha_3,3=d-(b+r). (10) The external ports are recovered by a=alpha_1,1+alpha_1,2, b=alpha_2,2, c=alpha_4,2, u=alpha_1,2, v=alpha_3,2, w=alpha_4,1+alpha_4,2. (11) Conversely four nonnegative sum-d triples satisfying (10), with these boundary values, recover exactly one admissible entry (3). Thus (7),(10),(11) are a bijective actual local charge model; their five free integer parameters are `(a,b,c,r,s)`. In particular the intermediate upper wall is the shared NONNEGATIVE charge `alpha_2,3=alpha_3,3`. Integer total degree is conserved. These are proven shared-spin constraints. They are not by themselves the geometric equation that sums dihedral angles to 2pi around each edge of an ideal triangulation. That further global identification, including peripherals, must be established rather than inferred from the presence of positive sum-d cells. ## 4. Exact factorization through the normalized b coefficients This kernel is compatible with the proposed LENGTH normalization, not an unrelated square-root replacement. Put B_L(X,Y)=product_(j=0)^(L-1)(X-Q^jY), D_L=s_L^(1/2)/N^(1/4), b_L=B_L/D_L, m_j=s_j/sqrt(N), tau_(L,r)=sqrt(m_r m_(L-r)) [X^(L-r)Y^r]b_L. The [normalized coefficient Gram identity](actual_length_normalized_star_gram.md) is exactly |tau_(L,r)|^2=sqrt(N)w_N(r,L-r,d-L), arg(tau_(L,r))=arg[(-1)^r q^(r(L-1))]. (12) For one positive or inverse fusion cell let `m=b+r`. Then Chat'_entry=sqrt(N) eta_+ tau_(a,r)tau_(m,r), (Chat'^(-1))_entry=sqrt(N) eta_- tau_(a,r)tau_(m,r), eta_+=x^(-r)q^[r(2-a-r)], eta_-=(-1)^r x^(-r)q^[r(1-a)]. (13) For the full reassociation the exact complex coefficient is Ahat_entry=N eta tau_(a,r)tau_(b+r,r) tau_(b+r,s)tau_(c+s,s), eta=(-1)^s x^(-r)y^(-s) q^[r(2-a-r)+s(1-b-r)]. (14) Multiplying the four phases in (12) proves (14), including (5). In particular ZERO lengths are retained: `b_0=N^(1/4)` and `tau_(0,0)=N^(-1/4)`. At the all-zero input the factor `N tau_(0,0)^4` is one, as the original operator requires. The b-length tensor and physical quarter gauge have therefore been matched with their actual normalizers and source types. ## 5. Positive energies and the full coherent Gram For a fixed input i, the exact column energy is the positive sum ||Ahat e_i||^2=N^4 sum_(r,s satisfying (3)) product_j w_N(alpha_j). (15) The Hilbert--Schmidt energy is its sum over all physical inputs. Thus each local positive cell contributes ONE w, not its square. This is a genuine identity for the entire column, not a saddle approximation or a single selected large entry. The FULL Gram, however, is (Ahat^*Ahat)_(i,j) =N^4 sum_(common output o) conj(omega_(o,i))omega_(o,j) sqrt(W_(o,i)W_(o,j)), W_(o,i)=product_four_cells w_N. (16) Off-diagonal replicas remain. They cannot be deleted as an exact source operation. Any all-exterior upper comparison obtained by Cauchy must bound or retain these mixed terms; (16) states their phase and incidence explicitly. The original marked source has not been assumed positive or diagonal. ## 6. The complete original crossing uses the same physical cells There is no remaining standalone factorial diagonal between these physical Euler maps. Let `C'_(21)=Flip C'_(12) Flip`, and retain the original Gaussian D_2|a,b>=(-1)^b Q^(b(b-1)/2)x^(-2b)|a,b>. For the original same-color braid at every meridian root x, R_+=kappa C'_(12) D_2 C'_(21) (C'_(12))^(-1), R_-=kappa^(-1) C'_(12) (C'_(21))^(-1) D_2^(-1)(C'_(12))^(-1). (17) Here kappa is the original full common Cartan scalar, not a new normalization. To verify (17), start with the exact all-integer-degree factorization in [the Pascal theorem](actual_pascal_coherent_gram.md#61-an-exact-pascalgaussian-alphabet-for-original-braid-crossings). There `C=C' diag(F_a)`. Conjugating its relative Euler factor U by this diagonal gives coefficient `x^-r F_(a+r)/(F_a F_r)=x^-r[a+r choose r]`, exactly the physical C'_(21), with its strict bounds. The diagonal commutes with D_2. This proves (17) in EVERY total degree and hence as a full operator. The negative formula is its literal inverse. At completeness D_2, kappa and all original pivots/framing phases have modulus one. In the SAME source-fixing quarter gauge, each of the three C' factors in a crossing has the two-cell kernel (9). Their inverse phases, upper/lower walls and original finite source remain present. This is an exact coherent physical alphabet at arbitrary braid width, not a source-null completion or a deletion of the inhomogeneous current. It provides six positive cell weights per crossing before any shared-head contractions. To turn the resulting positive comparison into a sharp volume theorem one still needs its global geometric edge/peripheral constraints or a further coherent contraction. Neither is asserted merely from (17). In particular a generic positive path partition is not automatically the partition on an ideal geometric triangulation. [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_reassociation_angle_kernel.py): original coproduct-derived fusion, finite Euler inverses, all strict reassociation entries, half-root phases, b_0 and normalized coefficient factorization, exact local charge incidence and both original signed crossing operators with retained common Cartan.

title: The literal reflected two-circle source and its two-octahedron geometry
text: # The literal reflected two-circle source and its two-octahedron geometry 29 October 2026. The positive original circuit \[ E_N=\phi\!\left(\mathscr R(RL_N)\,R^{-1}L_N\right) =\|\,\mathscr R(R^{-1}L_N)\,\|_{\mathrm{Newt}}^{\,2} \tag{1} \] has a genuine four-component hyperbolic interpretation. The labeled cut-and-reglue certificate below gives two regular ideal octahedra, volume \(2v_8\). This is a complete-base calibration, not yet a new broad family of filled knots. ## 1. Exact source diagram and cut-open port table Let \(C\) be the actual auxiliary three-braid \([2,1,1,2]\), with its THIRD top and bottom endpoints joined outside on the right. Its first two top/bottom endpoints stay open. The original pivotal color-\(N\) evaluation of this circle is precisely \(L_N\), with no extra trace normalization. Use the literal single crossings \(X_\pm\). The diagram is the denominator closure of \[ \mathscr R(X_+C)\,(X_-C). \tag{2} \] Thus it is fixed before evaluating any invariant. Its two auxiliary circles are distinct. Deleting them leaves the genuine diagram \(\mathscr R(X_+)X_-=X_-^2\), whose braid closure has two components. There are therefore FOUR components in (2). In the audit's crossing convention its unmodified planar code is [(1,10,2,11),(2,19,3,16),(15,19,10,18),(17,15,18,14), (16,3,17,4),(11,4,12,5),(5,8,0,9),(12,7,13,8), (6,13,7,14),(9,0,6,1)]. The retained half crossings are 0 and 5; the auxiliary loops run through crossings 1--4 and 6--9. A simultaneous mirror convention does not change the absolute invariant or volume conclusion. Cut along the projection sphere and the two twice-punctured crossing disks. Keep each half twist as its actual regluing. This produces two balls \(P_+,P_-\). A crossing-disk cut replaces its local circle gadget by two shaded triangles with a common circle vertex. This is reversed by restoring the disk collar and the third-strand closure defining \(C\). Label the four main arc segments between the disks cyclically by \(p_0=Y_+,p_1=Z_+,p_2=Y_-,p_3=Z_-\). The unturned disk sides see \((p_0,p_1)\), \((p_2,p_3)\). The GENUINE quarter-turn shifts the second disk's cyclic port order by one, giving \((p_3,p_0)\), \((p_1,p_2)\). With circle vertices \(X_0,X_1\), the shaded triangles in either cut ball are consequently | Face | Vertices | | --- | --- | | \(A\) | \(X_0,Y_+,Z_+\) | | \(B\) | \(X_0,Y_-,Z_-\) | | \(C\) | \(X_1,Y_+,Z_-\) | | \(D\) | \(X_1,Y_-,Z_+\) | Their edges form the octahedral graph, with opposite pairs \(\{X_0,X_1\},\{Y_+,Y_-\},\{Z_+,Z_-\}\). The four white complementary regions are \[ W_0=(X_0,Y_+,Z_-),\ W_1=(X_0,Y_-,Z_+),\ W_2=(X_1,Y_+,Z_+),\ W_3=(X_1,Y_-,Z_-). \] Without the port shift the disk-side pairs would repeat; it would be incorrect to replace this actual turn by scalar multiplication. White gluing is \(W_j^+\to W_j^-\), with identity vertex map. The odd half twists exchange the upper/lower disk sides, giving | Source | Target | Vertex map | | --- | --- | --- | | \(A^+\) | \(B^-\) | \(X_0\to X_0,\ Y_+\to Y_-,\ Z_+\to Z_-\) | | \(A^-\) | \(B^+\) | same rule | | \(C^+\) | \(D^-\) | \(X_1\to X_1,\ Y_+\to Y_-,\ Z_-\to Z_+\) | | \(C^-\) | \(D^+\) | same rule | This follows by tracing the two punctures through the single crossing, not by matching a computed volume. Restoring the white sphere and these disk collars reverses the cut and gives (2). The sign of the half twist retains its source disk-framing convention. Adding a full disk twist changes its preferred filling meridian but not this unmarked exterior quotient. No new filling-peripheral identification is inferred from this complete-base certificate. ## 2. Exact positive metric, edge cycles, and four complete cusp tori Realize each cell as a regular ideal octahedron, for example \[ X_0=0,\quad X_1=\infty,\quad Y_\pm=\pm1,\quad Z_\pm=\pm i . \] Use opposite labeled orientations on the two copies. Every displayed triangle map is realized by an octahedral symmetry followed by the appropriate face reflection. In the hyperboloid model take center \(O=(1,0,0,0)\) and normalized ideal lifts \((1,\pm e_1),(1,\pm e_2),(1,\pm e_3)\). An octahedral symmetry fixes \(O\) and maps these lifts EXACTLY; reflection in a target face fixes its three lifts. Thus all face maps preserve the canonical horospheres, not just ideal endpoints. The finite combinatorial checks from this table are: * The 24 octahedral boundary-edge occurrences form six cycles of length four. Their dihedral angles sum to \(4(\pi/2)=2\pi\). Matched endpoint horospheres exclude a dilation along an edge. * The ideal vertex classes are \(X_0^\pm\), \(X_1^\pm\), all \(Y_\pm^\pm\), and all \(Z_\pm^\pm\). They give the four actual components. * Their links have respectively \(2,2,4,4\) Euclidean squares. Every link edge is paired twice and every link vertex has four right-angle sectors. Each link is connected and orientable, with Euler characteristic zero, hence a nonsingular torus. Shrinking compatible horospheres first gives disjoint actual corner sections and full horoball ends. The remaining core is compact. The resulting positive curvature-minus-one metric is complete and finite-volume on the actual complement of (2). An explicit eight-tetrahedron version makes the check reproducible. Put \(v=(Y_+,Z_+,Y_-,Z_-)\). The tetrahedra in \(P_+\) are \((X_1,X_0,v_j,v_{j+1})\), \(j\bmod4\); reverse the last two labels in \(P_-\). Their shapes are \(i\) in the respective reflected frames. Internal and external face maps have local permutation \(0132\). The audit builds these maps from the table, checks all face pairs and exact rational edge-angle sums, and checks the links. Thus the volume is \(8D(i)=2v_8\). This link is genuinely hyperbolic, not merely a JSJ/composite explanation of the observed exponent. ## 3. The original quantum limit and what generalizes Section 6 of [the Newton-turn theorem](actual_newton_turn_positive_gram.md) proves the whole-source identity (1) and \(\lim N^{-1}\log E_N=v_8/\pi\), using the actual finite coefficients, all-index endpoint bound, and a nonzero high-index lower term. Both level parities and all composite levels are included. The original single-cut reduced normalization changes (1) only by its recorded unit phase; the optional one-cut modified convention adds \(1/N\), not one factor per component. Therefore \[ \lim_{N\to\infty}\frac{2\pi}{N} \log|\langle L_{\mathrm{ref}}\rangle_N| =2v_8=\operatorname{Vol}(S^3\setminus L_{\mathrm{ref}}). \tag{3} \] Here \(L_{\mathrm{ref}}\) is the explicit diagram (2), not a census name. There is an exact reusable non-scalar tangle gluing: \[ \phi(f^\sharp\mathscr Rg) =\sum_{r=0}^d\overline{\alpha_r(f)}\alpha_r(g). \tag{4} \] It preserves all physical source ports and gives positive entire reflected circuits. But its quantum separating cut is not automatically the projection/disk cut of the geometric octahedra. A general tangle double need not have a verified geodesic separating surface, and its \(N\)-channel overlap is not a scalar product of independent local invariants. Two known packet norms alone do not control the sharp coherent overlap or its geometric critical point. There is now a separate verified extension at THIS actual outer crossing-disk seam. The [bandlimited nodal theorem](actual_complete_circle_nodal_energy_and_belt_sewing.md) controls the full complete-circle channel sum, and the [balanced belt-stack certificate](actual_balanced_octahedral_belt_stack_volume.md) glues the cut two-octahedron pieces along their literal geodesic pants. The subsequent coherent boundary-source theorem extends this to every fixed sign word of \(n\geq1\) pieces and every fixed integer outer collar: the original complete-link limit is \(2n v_8\). There are \(n+3\) components for an even outer power and \(n+2\) for an odd one; the balanced positive case was the first subclass. It is a cyclic one-belt operation, not a claim about arbitrary graph vertices or the new bases' fixed Dehn fillings. In a genuinely branched construction with three paired boundary slots, the original vertex is a SIX-port tensor. Its saturated source has dimension \((N^3+N)/2\) and the explicit divided-power kernel of [the six-port source theorem](actual_six_port_divided_power_source_kernel.md). It cannot be replaced by independent two-port scalar Frobenius multiplication vertices. The bounded confluent construction controls its finite normal order, but not its coherent geometric energy. Thus the present exact base and gluing metric are useful analytic inputs; they do not prove closure under arbitrary octahedral graphs or an arbitrary-bridge volume conjecture. Audit: [actual tangle and exact octahedral face/edge/cusp certificate](../experiments/audit_actual_reflected_two_circle_octahedral_base.py). Software census names and numerical volumes, when requested in the audit, are diagnostics only; the written proof is the reversible disk/projection cut and the exact metric checks above. This base certificate does not establish a general graph or filling theorem.

title: Reflection-compatible original cap metrics, and the remaining leg-order test
text: # Reflection-compatible original cap metrics, and the remaining leg-order test 29 October 2026. The positive complete-circle form controls the original ordinary and marked boundaries, but with DIFFERENT literal leg flips. This gives an all-width positive boundary estimate with polynomial dual cost. It does not yet identify an arbitrary untwisted fully augmented planar diagram with a Hilbert norm square. A concrete single-leg bend below shows why that last wiring check cannot be omitted. ## 1. Actual pair sources and the two positive forms Put N>=2, d=N-1, q=exp(pi*i/N), Q=q^2, x=q^d. On two original physical heads retain \[ p_{a,b}=Nx^{-b}\delta_{a+b,d},\quad \ell_{a,b}=x^{-a}Q^{-a}\delta_{a+b,d}/N, \quad m_{a,b}=x^b/N^2. \] Let P|a,b>=|b,a> be the literal tensor flip, NOT a crossing. Write m_d=m times the INTEGER pair-degree-d projector. Since x^2=Q^(-1), the exact row identities are \[ \ell=N^{-2}p^\dagger P,\qquad m_d=N^{-3}p^\dagger=N^{-1}\ell P. \tag{1} \] The original complete crossing circle satisfies the independently proved [full physical positivity theorem](actual_complete_circle_reflection_positive.md): \[ C=PL_N\succeq0,\qquad H=L_NP=PCP\succeq0. \] The original Hermite source normal t has ell t=1, m_d t=0, L_Nt=2Np. Consequently the already derived ordinary-cap identity is C t=2N^3 ell^dagger and ell C^+ ell^dagger=1/(2N^3). Conjugating by the TRUE flip P gives the new marked identity \[ H(Pt)=2Np,\qquad \boxed{\displaystyle m_d H^+m_d^\dagger=\frac1{2N^5},\qquad m_d^\dagger m_d\preceq\frac H{2N^5}.} \tag{2} \] Indeed H^+=PC^+P and m_d=ell P/N. Equivalently Pt/(2N^4) is an explicit inverse solution for m_d^dagger, and its pairing with m_d is 1/(2N^5). No inverse of L_N or deletion of its radical is made. Ordinary ell uses C; marked m_d uses H. Both distinctions matter. Since Cp=0 and m_d p=1, the marked row is not bounded by C. The UNRESTRICTED m is not bounded by H either: H|0,0>=0 while m|0,0>=1/N^2. It is the whole-source degree argument below, not a local marked-row substitution, that permits (2). ## 2. All-width original marked boundary estimate Consider the original k-cup plat source p^(tensor k) and a full original signed word W preserving total INTEGER degree. Each cup has degree d. After the k-1 ordinary output caps have fixed their pair degrees d, the remaining marked pair is forced to degree d. Therefore, on the ACTUAL incoming total degree kd, \[ (\ell^{\otimes(k-1)}\otimes m)W p^{\otimes k} =(\ell^{\otimes(k-1)}\otimes m_d)W p^{\otimes k}. \tag{3} \] Put Lambda=ell^(tensor(k-1)) tensor m_d and \[ Q_{\mathrm{top}}=C^{\otimes(k-1)}\otimes H,\qquad c_k=2^{-k}N^{-(3k+2)}. \] Tensor the actual pair dual norms. This gives EXACTLY \[ \boxed{\displaystyle \Lambda Q_{\mathrm{top}}^+\Lambda^\dagger=c_k,\qquad \Lambda^\dagger\Lambda\preceq c_k Q_{\mathrm{top}}.} \tag{4} \] For the original scalar, with its existing framing/peripheral line chi_N unchanged, one consequently has \[ |K_N|^2\leq|\chi_N|^2c_k \langle Wp^{\otimes k},Q_{\mathrm{top}}Wp^{\otimes k}\rangle. \tag{5} \] The estimate extends to arbitrary coefficient Hilbert spaces and keeps every actual pivot already present in ell. It neither assumes W is unitary nor pays a condition number for its unknown state. It is a boundary Cauchy theorem, NOT yet a geometric bound for the positive energy on the right. On ordinary pairs the original signed same-pair twists are exact C-isometries. On the marked H pair, their REFLECTED conjugates P R^a P are H-isometries. Replacing one by the other without the literal leg interface would not be a source identity. ## 3. Reflection of original crossings and a genuine bend caveat The full original equal-color balanced crossing is complex symmetric. In its strict coefficient, reversing input(a,b) and output(b+k,a-k) leaves the full factorial ratio, x power, and Q exponent unchanged. The independently checked actual inverse is Rminus=P conjugate(R)P. Thus \[ P R_{\mathrm{minus}}P=R^\dagger. \tag{6} \] This is the correct reflected-adjoint statement; P remains a leg exchange, not a physical extra braid. Similarly, a reflected ordinary cap is p^dagger P/N^2, whereas the legitimately restricted marked one is p^dagger/N^3. These are different boundary orientations. There is a local obstruction to treating PSD as invariant under ARBITRARY planar bending. Regard the actual cup as the matrix N U: \[ U_{a,b}=x^{-b}\delta_{a+b,d},\qquad U^\dagger U=I,\qquad \ell_{a,b}=(U^{-1})_{a,b}/N. \] Using these very turns to dualize one physical leg of a four-port form B gives \[ (\mathcal D_2B)_{ab;cd} =\sum_{u,v}U_{bu}B_{av;cu}(U^{-1})_{vd},\qquad \mathcal D_2B=(I\otimes U)B^{\mathsf T_2}(I\otimes U^{-1}). \tag{7} \] The factors N from cup and cap cancel. At N=2 the ACTUAL positive H=L_2P has its sole nonzero block on |01>,|10> equal to \[ \begin{pmatrix}4&-4i\\4i&4\end{pmatrix}. \] Its one-leg transpose, and hence the actually turned form (7), has eigenvalues 4,4,4,-4. Thus a single-leg source duality is NOT in general a positive Hilbert congruence. A bare ordinary bubble gives the related warning ell p=0, whereas replacing ell by p^dagger/N^2 would incorrectly give N. This is a statement about a DIFFERENT bipartition of an already formed four-port Gram tensor. It is NOT the genuine antiparallel crossing circle, whose reflection must be transported together with its dual object. The next section verifies the distinction explicitly. ## 4. Genuine dual objects introduce no local positivity failure Use standard dual bases for V*. With the original antipode conventions, the self-duality isometry from V* to V is \[ T=U^{\mathsf T},\qquad T S(h)^{\mathsf T}T^{-1}=h, \quad h\in\{H,K,\mathcal E,F\}. \tag{8} \] For example S(E)=-EK^(-1), S(F)=-KF. Checking the single nonzero entry in each raising/lowering column proves (8), including the endpoints; S(H)=-H and S(K)=K^(-1). The standard coevaluation becomes the original p/N after I tensor T, and standard evaluation becomes N ell after T^(-1) tensor I. Thus this is the actual duality, rather than a guessed rotation of the positive form. For any choices of the two object orientations, put D=T^(epsilon) tensor T^(eta), epsilon,eta in {0,1}, and transport BOTH the circle and its reflection: \[ L_{\epsilon\eta}=D L_ND^{-1},\qquad P_{\epsilon\eta}=D P D^{-1},\qquad L_{\epsilon\eta}P_{\epsilon\eta}=DHD^\dagger\succeq0. \tag{9} \] All D are unitary. In particular no negative eigenvalue in (7) disproves the antiparallel instance of (9). This transport can be chosen consistently along EVERY oriented diagram wire: assign the appropriate object isometry to that wire, and transform a coupon B by D_out B D_in^(-1). Each contracted internal port cancels a D with its inverse. This elementary tensor identity holds for arbitrary exteriors and all leg orderings. It does not require an extra sign or an arbitrary new crossing. If left and right self-duality conventions are instead identified, their exact discrepancy is the original pivot. Namely, with g_a=x^(-d)Q^(-a), \[ U^{-1}U^{\mathsf T}=g,\qquad U^{\mathsf T}U^{-1}=g^{-1},\qquad UgU^{-1}=g^{-1}. \tag{10} \] These identities are direct antidiagonal multiplication. They show which unitary clocks must remain when a turn changes sides. Their existence permits a consistent genuine-dual description; it does NOT license deleting a pivotal holonomy on a closed component. The unresolved global check is therefore more specific than an orientation-sign problem. One must exhibit the projection-plane cut of the ACTUAL fully augmented tensor graph, with its remaining wire contractions and original turns, as a common ket/bra pairing of the transported positive forms (9), or another positive boundary pairing of polynomial cost. A positive coupon on each face is not itself that graph identity. The original ordinary bubble, for example, is ell p=0, whereas replacing its pivotal contraction by p^dagger p/N^2 would give N. No proof that a correctly cut reduced fully augmented diagram must use the bad bipartition (7) is asserted. Conversely no arbitrary global norm-square theorem follows here merely from (9). Until the complete wiring identity is proved, (5) and (9) are the supported all-width source and oriented-local results; the global geometric energy estimate remains open. [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_reflection_marked_boundary_metric.py) checks eight exact original-module source levels, five tensor-source widths, seven genuine-dual circle families, and the exact N=2 different-bipartition diagnostic. It also checks the literal full crossings, all source inverse solutions, original degree restriction, and both left/right pivotal discrepancies.

title: Exponential ordinary-color control and elimination of fast modes on a regular arc
text: # Exponential ordinary-color control and elimination of fast modes on a regular arc 28 October 2026. Two statements below are proved directly for the original source. First, every fixed knot diagram has an exp(CN) bound for ALL ordinary colors j<=cN on a fixed O(1/N) complex annulus around q_N. Second, on a compact arc where the highest surviving classical coefficient is nonzero, the higher quantum-order terms can be eliminated using a slow-forward / fast-backward comparison. No eigenframe, lower bound for the actual leading coefficient, or bound on an inverse braid is used. This weakens the order-survival hypothesis of the [macroscopic spectral bound](actual_macroscopic_a_spectral_upper_bound.md) on a regular arc. It does NOT yet remove it globally across zeros of the highest surviving classical coefficient. That additional gluing problem, including a zero at the selected endpoint, is stated explicitly below. ## 1. Actual ordinary colors are exponentially bounded on the full annulus Fix an original zero-framed b-strand braid closure representing a knot, and let C_j(q) be its ordinary reduced color-j scalar, with the original half-Cartan, pivot K(q), and framing twist. For fixed c,S>0 there are constants A,B, depending on the word,c,S, such that |C_j(exp((pi*i+s)/N))| <= j^B exp(Aj), 1<=j<=cN, |s|<=S. (1) In particular the right side is exp(CN). This includes j>=N and both parities. It is a statement about the GENERIC ordinary Laurent polynomial family, not a quotient-color assertion for a high ADO color. There is no division by a vanishing quantum dimension in the proof. Proof. Use the ordinary highest-weight basis with E v_a=[a]_q[j-a]_q v_(a-1), F v_a=v_(a+1), H v_a=(j-1-2a)v_a, 0<=a<j. In the original positive R, the h-transfer coefficient before its Cartan factor is q^(h(h-1)/2) rho^h/[h]! * [a]!/[a-h]! * product_(r=0)^(h-1)[j-a+r], rho=q-q^-1. Equivalently it is q^(h(h-1)/2-h(a-h)) [a choose h]_(q²) * product_(r=0)^(h-1)(q^(j-a+r)-q^(-j+a-r)). (2) This is an exact polynomial cancellation, valid also where a divided factorial in the first expression vanishes. The inverse has the same form, with the corresponding input/color and an altered q-monomial. All those monomial exponents, including the Cartan weight product/2, have absolute value at most Cj². Keep the marked half-root q^(1/2)=exp((pi*i+s)/(2N)); no parity simplification is made. In fact, in the Laurent coefficient norm in the marked half-root, each entry in (2) has norm at most 4^j: the Gaussian coefficient has coefficient sum binom(a,h)<=2^j, and each of the h binomial factors has coefficient norm two. Monomials do not change this norm. The same argument applies to the inverse crossing. If the fixed braid has ell crossings, summing its at most j choices per crossing and its j^(b-1) environmental trace indices gives the explicit coarse bound ||C_j||_(Laurent coefficient l1) <=j^(ell+b-1) 4^(ell*j). (2a) Pivots, the full common Cartan line, and the zero-framing correction are monomials and have coefficient norm one. This is a bound for the original reduced cut, so no dimension denominator has been inserted. Together with the directly proved degree O_word(j²), (2a) is an alternative proof of (1). Gaussian Pascal gives nonnegative integer coefficients, total coefficient sum binom(a,h)<=2^a, and degree h(a-h)<=j²/4. Therefore |[a choose h]_(q²)| <= 2^j exp(S j²/(2N)). (3) Each factor in the product in (2) is at most 2exp(2Sj/N), while any remaining q-monomial costs exp(CSj²/N). Since j<=cN, both crossing signs consequently have every entry bounded by exp(A0 j). A checked two-head matrix has at most j nonzero entries in any row or column, so its original flat operator norm is at most j exp(A0 j). A fixed braid word has norm at most j^B0 exp(A1 j). The ordinary pivot has norm at most exp(Sj/N), and the zero-framing scalar has modulus at most exp(C_word Sj²/N). The literal reduced cut is C_j(q)=theta_j^(-w) [Tr_env(W_j(q)(I tensor K(q)^(tensor(b-1))))]_(0,0). Bounding that trace by j^(b-1) times the matrix norm proves (1). This is the original cut definition. At exceptional q it follows by the displayed integral matrix expressions/continuity, with no replacement of the pivot or source. ## 2. The exact slow-forward / fast-backward system Suppose the actual generic color family has a specified recurrence sum_(i=0)^d a_i(q,-q^j) C_(j+i)(q)=0, (4) with Laurent polynomial coefficients. Remove a common q-1 power. Let m be the HIGHEST index for which a_m(1,M) is not identically zero; assume 1<=m<d and put r=d-m. On a compact x interval I suppose |a_m(1,-exp(pi*i*x))| >= c0 >0. (5) All estimates below are uniform for q=q_N exp(s/N), |s|<=epsilon_N, epsilon_N->0. In particular they apply at s=0. On I and fixed finitely many neighboring mesh points, division by a_m is harmless. Put g_i(j)=a_i(q,-q^j)/a_m(q,-q^j), 0<=i<m, Y_j=(C_j,...,C_(j+m-1))^t, z_j=C_(j+m)+sum_(i<m)g_i(j)C_(j+i). (6) These are the original scalar values, not new independent solutions. With A_j the m by m companion having last row -g_i(j), Y_(j+1)=A_j Y_j+e_m z_j. (7) For i=m+t, iterating (7) a fixed t+1 steps expresses C_(j+i) as a bounded row times Y_j plus a bounded linear combination of z_j,...,z_(j+t). All those rows are uniformly bounded because d is fixed and the g_i are bounded. For i>m, a_i(q,M)=(q-1)b_i(q,M), (8) since its specialization at q=1 is identically zero. Thus its ratio to a_m is O(1/N), uniformly on (5). Substituting these fixed forward expansions into (4), and absorbing the resulting O(1/N) coefficient of z_j, gives the EXACT relation z_j=c_j Y_j+sum_(l=1)^r b_(j,l) z_(j+l), ||c_j||+sum_l|b_(j,l)| <= C/N. (9) No approximation or factorization of a characteristic polynomial is used to obtain (9). In particular, no division by a_d occurs. Equation (9) is a backward-contracting fast system even if the original d by d forward companion is unbounded or undefined at a particular q. ## 3. A two-boundary comparison with a macroscopic right buffer Let A(x) be the classical m by m companion formed from a_0(1,M),...,a_m(1,M), and rho(x) its spectral radius. Fix epsilon>0. The positive Lyapunov metric from the spectral-bound note gives, uniformly on I and for large N, a norm in which one step in (7) has cost at most R_j=rho(j/N)+2epsilon. (10) The metric and its inverse are bounded. Its variation on adjacent mesh points is absorbed in the fixed epsilon. In particular R_j is bounded above and below by positive constants, including when rho=0. Let w_a=1 and w_(j+1)=R_j w_j. After dividing by w_j and using the metric, (7),(9) imply scalar inequalities with one fixed constant C: U_(j+1)<=U_j+C Z_j, Z_j<=h C U_j+h C sum_(l=1)^r Z_(j+l), h=1/N, (11) where U_j=||Y_j||/w_j and Z_j=|z_j|/w_j. Bounded ratios w_(j+l)/w_j for l<=r have been included in C. Take the equations for a<=j<B, specifying only U_a and the r terminal values Z_B,...,Z_(B+r-1). Suppose the latter are at most exp(C1N). This is available for the original source by (1); the weight w_j and the bounded rows in (6) change that bound only by another exp(C2N). Here is an elementary positive supersolution for this mixed boundary problem. Choose kappa=2C and lambda=4C², increasing them slightly if needed for strict inequalities. For sufficiently large N let eta=N^(-1/(2r)), U_j^slow=A exp(lambda h(j-a)), Z_j^slow=kappa h U_j^slow, Z_j^fast=B0 eta^(B-j), U_j^fast=4C eta Z_j^fast. (12) Take A>=max(1,U_a) and B0>=max terminal Z_j. The sum of the slow and fast packets is a strict supersolution of (11). For its fast Z-row, the future contribution is at most h C r eta^-r=Cr/sqrt(N)->0. For its slow Z-row the future contribution is O(h²) relative to U_j^slow. The U-rows follow respectively from exp(lambda h)-1> C kappa h and 4C>C+4C eta. These verify every inequality for large N. For completeness, comparison needs no invertibility theorem. If an actual component exceeded its supersolution, take the largest ratio over the finite U,Z array. It cannot be on the specified boundaries. At an interior component, (11) and the strict supersolution make the ratio a strict subaverage of ratios no greater than that maximum, a contradiction. Thus (12) bounds the original solution. For a target T with B-T>=delta N, delta>0 fixed, the terminal term is <=exp(C2N) N^(-(B-T)/(2r))=exp(-Omega(N log N)). (13) The slow term costs exp(O(1)) beyond w_T and A. Therefore, if U_a is polynomial, the original selected solution satisfies limsup (1/N)log||Y_T|| <= integral_(lim a/N)^(lim T/N) log(rho(x)) dx, (14) interpreting the right side by epsilon-downward limiting if needed. For the usual nonzero lower classical coefficient its logarithm is integrable. All terminal fast data were retained and bounded; they were not set to zero. ## 4. A genuine partial extension of the actual whole-source theorem Suppose (4) is an actual all-level ordinary color recurrence, its highest surviving classical index m>=1, and (5) holds on I=[1/k,1+delta] for some fixed delta>0. Start with the m colors ending at the actual positive macroscopic window J_N=1+floor((N-1)/k). These initial values are polynomially bounded. Take T=N and B=floor((1+delta/2)N). The ordinary-color exponential bound (1) supplies every terminal value needed in (12), even though those colors are larger than N. Consequently (14) gives limsup (1/N)log|K_N| <= integral_(1/k)^1 log rho_m(x) dx. (15) This uses the finite roots of the HIGHEST SURVIVING CLASSICAL order, even when d>m. It proves actual scalar control, not merely a formal slow characteristic. At s=0 the exact color recurrence and (5) suffice; there is no moving-q denominator to regularize and no inverse of the actual leading coefficient. The complex-annulus version of the same argument is also valid when the initial packet has its independently proved polynomial complex bound. ## 5. The precise remaining exceptional-set problem The condition (5) is essential in this proof. Near a zero of a_m(1,M), the coefficients g_i and the small coefficients in (9) need not remain bounded. The old d-order forward companion can still be polynomially bounded on a suitable tiny q-circle, but multiplying that bound over a fixed macroscopic buffer costs exp(O(N log N)), not exp(o(N)). Conversely a shrinking buffer need not suppress the a priori exp(CN) terminal data by (13). Thus those two estimates cannot simply be combined to assert global elimination through a turning core. This note proves neither that such exceptional cores necessarily add growth for a knot, nor that they can be omitted. A compatible global slow/fast transport or an additional source constraint at every core is still needed to remove the classical-order-survival assumption for an arbitrary annihilator. It also proves no geometric inequality for the finite-root integral and no selected lower bound. Reproduce the finite coefficient cancellations and exact defect-system identity with ```sh python3 experiments/audit_actual_regular_fast_color_elimination.py ``` The audit supplements the proofs above; it does not replace the uniform barrier argument or claim an exceptional-core theorem.

title: Exact two-neighbor filling of regular physical head faces
text: # Exact two-neighbor filling of regular physical head faces 28 October 2026. Grouping the TWO actual crossings neighboring a physical head before estimating its normal contour gives a source-faithful outward filling at every regular physical head endpoint. This uses the complete original scalar state, not a discarded tail of a low-band Hardy kernel, a new boundary state, or an independent output projection. The theorem is uniform for every fixed signed braid and bridge count. Its scope is a head face whose other head colors AND all transfers remain in a fixed bulk chamber. Simultaneous head/transfer endpoint clusters are excluded. The estimate does not by itself give the sharp whole-knot volume bound or geometric noncancellation. ## 1. Exact signed scalar and the head-factor composition identity Retain N>=2, d=N-1, Q=exp(2*pi*i/N), x=-exp(-pi*i/N), the original kappa, all pivots and the original external chi_N. Let Fhat_+ be the actual factorial interpolant and Fhat_- its conjugate-root partner. Their exact relation is Fhat_-(s)=g_N(s) Fhat_+(s), g_N(s)=exp[i*pi*s-i*pi*s*(s+1)/N]. (1) Indeed both factorials have the SAME real meromorphic sine-factorial part in their independent Barnes definition; only their displayed quadratic chirps differ. This proves (1) as a whole meromorphic identity, including every normal coefficient. It is not just equality at integer states. In particular g_N(n)=(-1)^n Q^(-n(n+1)/2). For positive transfer k, the actual signed checked coefficients are r_+(a,b;k)=kappa x^(-a-b+k) Q^(b*(a-k)) Fhat_+(b+k)Fhat_+(a) /[Fhat_+(k)Fhat_+(b)Fhat_+(a-k)], r_-(a,b;k)=kappa^(-1) x^(a+b-k) Q^(-a*(b-k)) Fhat_-(a+k)Fhat_-(b) /[Fhat_-(k)Fhat_-(a)Fhat_-(b-k)]. (2) Their unwrapped outputs are respectively (b+k,a-k) and (b-k,a+k). The physical OVER strand always loses k, and the physical UNDER strand always gains k; the sign determines which tensor slot has that role. Replace each Fhat_- in (2) using (1), retaining its entire factor g_N. At EITHER crossing sign the head incidences are now exactly OVER input: +1, OVER output: -1, UNDER input: -1, UNDER output: +1, (3) and its transfer has exponent -1. Thus, on any closed physical knot, the complete ordered scalar product has the exact meromorphic form A_N(u)=E_N(u) product_(physical arcs e) Fhat_+(h_e(u))^(c_e) product_j Fhat_+(k_j)^(-1), (4) where c_e=+2 for UNDER output -> OVER input, c_e=-2 for OVER output -> UNDER input, c_e= 0 for a continued OVER or UNDER role. (5) All original kappa, half-Cartan, g_N conversion chirps and closure pivots are retained in the specified nonzero entire exponential E_N; the original external chi_N/N stays outside unchanged. The logarithm of E_N is an explicit quadratic polynomial with quadratic coefficients O_word(1/N) and linear coefficients O_word(1); its external state-independent factor is not normalized away. Formula (4) is an EXACT two-neighbor composition identity. If different physical arcs have the same state linear form, their factors are multiplied, not declared independent. ## 2. Which endpoint can occur with nonzero adjacent transfers? Consider a physical arc of color h. At h=0 with both adjacent transfers strictly positive, its previous crossing cannot have UNDER output: the UNDER input h-k would be negative. Its next crossing cannot have OVER input: the OVER output h-k would be negative. Therefore this is necessarily an OVER-output -> UNDER-input local MINIMUM and c_e=-2. At h=d with both adjacent transfers strictly positive, its previous crossing cannot have OVER output (its input would be d+k), and its next crossing cannot have UNDER input (its output would be d+k). It is a local MAXIMUM, UNDER output -> OVER input, and c_e=+2. These statements use the actual nonnegative transfer convention at both crossing signs. They are physical state inequalities, not a positivity claim about crossing coefficients. If one of the adjacent transfers is zero, this deduction is unavailable and that joint corner is deliberately retained. ## 3. The exact whole source and its normal cotangent contour Use the [cardinal completion](actual_scalar_cardinal_source_completion.md) of the COMPLETE original averaged marked source, before splitting any head bands. For a one-component diagram its coordinates are exactly u=(t,k_1,...,k_m), and every arc h=t+sum_j epsilon_j k_j has epsilon_j in {0,+1,-1}. Hence (t,k) -> (h,k), determinant 1, (6) is an INTEGRAL bijection. All original valid states have 0<=h,k_j<=d. Choose a fixed O(N) complex box in these coordinates, and sufficient fixed cardinal powers at each original factorial occurrence. The completed scalar is holomorphic throughout the box, equals the original scalar on valid integer states, and vanishes at invalid integer states, including simultaneous scalar poles. Consequently the original scalar is exactly chi_N/N times the product cotangent residue integral of that completed scalar in (h,k). Every pi*cot(pi*h) and pi*cot(pi*k_j) factor is retained. This assertion follows by the finite residue sum, not by dropping a transformed source factor: a pointwise pullback of the old cotangent in t would instead be pi*cot(pi*(h-sum epsilon_j k_j)). Taking the k residues first gives integer k and its exact periodic equality with pi*cot(pi*h). Thus the new source representation and the old one have the SAME complete integer residues, with no Jacobian, grid factor, or omitted side current. For a regular lower head face the original left normal edge Re h=-1/2 can now move to Re h=-M-1/2. All negative integer cotangent poles have zero residue because the completed scalar vanishes there. The two finite-height horizontal connecting pieces are retained in this closed rectangle identity. At an upper face move the right edge from Re h=d+1/2 to Re h=d+M+1/2, retaining the same connecting pieces and all cotangent factors. No physical integer state is crossed or deleted. The tangent variables are fixed, not replaced by independent off-grid outputs. Their actual unwrapped arc forms shift with h according to (6). The bounds below hold uniformly while every other head and every transfer stays in its stated bulk chamber. ## 4. Uniform normal estimate, including all original phases Fix an imaginary-height bound T and a compact marked BULK chamber for the remaining factorial arguments. For a literal fixed-height source contour one may require their scaled real parts in [eta,1-eta], with bounded scaled imaginary parts and consistent factorial branches. Let B_N be the unwindowed original scalar at the endpoint h=0 or d, with that head factorial replaced by its actual finite value. All other factorials, pivots and kappa remain in B_N; the same original external chi_N/N multiplies both sides of every estimate. There are constants C,B,delta>0 depending only on the diagram and this chamber such that, for 1<=M<=delta*N, the WHOLE windowed scalar on the outward normal edge satisfies |Atilde_N| <= N^B exp(C(M+1)) [C(M+1)/N]^(2M) |B_N|. (7) The same estimate with the appropriate integer floor of the normal distance holds on the horizontal connecting pieces. The powers of N absorb the finite number of fixed cardinal windows and the bounded normal factorial base. On a macroscopic nonreal tangent chamber one may expand the BULK windows by their exact finite-mode packet and apply (7) to each specified bulk mode with its original integer-marked N-order phase retained: its right-hand B_N is then the MODE-WEIGHTED bulk amplitude, including that exponential, rather than the literal unwindowed B_N used on the fixed-height contour. The HEAD windows stay whole: their separated modes have poles at outside-band integers and their matched currents are essential to the same contour identity. No wrong-side bulk-window exponential or normal cancellation current is erased. Here is a direct uniform proof. At a lower face write h=nu-M with nu in the fixed strip -1<=Re nu<=0, |Im nu|<=T. The exact factorial step gives 1/Fhat_+(h)=product_(r=0)^(M-1)(1-Q^(nu-r)) / Fhat_+(nu). (8) The reciprocal base on that compact strip is O_T(N^C): shift once to 0<=Re(nu+1)<=1, where the bounded-order Gamma expansion gives the usual polynomial base, and retain 1-Q^(nu+1). Moreover |1-Q^(nu-r)| <= C_T(r+1)/N for M<=delta*N. The gathered head factor is its SQUARE by (5). At the upper face write h=d+nu+M with 0<=Re nu<=1. Exactly, Fhat_+(h)=Fhat_+(d+nu) product_(r=1)^M(1-Q^(nu+r-1)), Fhat_+(d+nu)=N exp[i*pi*nu*(nu+d)/N]/Fhat_+(-nu). (9) The second identity is the actual factorial reflection, including its chirp. It proves a polynomial upper base through both endpoints; the first proves the same small-factor product as (8). For every OTHER bulk factorial, a normal displacement of size M+1 has relative modulus at most exp(C(M+1)). This follows either from the uniform complex factorial symbol with bounded logarithmic derivative on the marked compact chamber, or by the exact unit step followed by the bounded fractional Gamma base. The logarithmic derivative of E_N in (4) is O_word(1) on the fixed O(N) box, so ALL Cartan, conversion, pivot and Gaussian phases cost exp(C(M+1)) too. Finally the exact cardinal bound is sqrt(N)*exp(2pi*|Im ell|). On a fixed-height joint contour every Im ell is bounded by a diagram constant, independent of N and M. This proves (7), also at coincident negative integer poles, since all completed factors are holomorphic. For M=N^alpha, 0<alpha<1, the entire collar has exp(o(N)) cost, and its far edge relative to B_N is at most exp[-2(1-alpha)N^alpha log N+O(N^alpha+log N)]. (10) One may also take M=floor(delta*N) with a sufficiently small fixed delta. Then its far edge has a strict exponential drop exp[-c*delta*N*log(1/delta)] relative to the endpoint bulk amplitude. The whole intervening collar has only polynomial normal overhead: choose delta so C+2log(C*delta)<0 in (7), and treat bounded M with the polynomial base. This is a NORMAL estimate; it does not bound the unrestricted tangent exterior amplitude B_N by volume. ## 5. What has and has not been removed The zero-side direction comes from composing the two original neighboring scalar factors FIRST. It is absent from an isolated low-head kernel K_R, whose Hardy residues cancel at its apparent matching pole. No such pole residue was asserted here. The whole head bands remain together in the original finite source, and the outer cotangent edge is filled with its exact scalar continuation. This removes a regular head endpoint as a compulsory scalar POLE exit. It supplies a quantitative outward contour with the original normalization and unwrapped routing. It does not prove that the remaining whole cycle reaches the geometric thimble, or that every simultaneous endpoint cluster has this direction. In particular a head endpoint next to a zero transfer, a repeated head face, and escaping tangent bulk coordinates require their own compensated whole-source treatment. The full global growth estimate remains open. [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_regular_head_face_cot_filling.py): literal signed head incidence, original statewise composition, exact negative-root conversion and both normal small-factor identities.

title: Actual quantum-A energy propagation with regulator weights
text: # Actual quantum-A energy propagation with regulator weights 28 October 2026. A geometric regulator weight cancels the diagonal growth of a smooth spectral branch, but does not by itself control the actual source or channel mixing at each time step. This can be checked EXPLICITLY for the actual affine figure-eight operator, on a regular arc with distinct eigenvalues and no turning-point or resonance issue. The calculation identifies a concrete missing estimate in the proposed rigid-dynamics argument. It does not rule out a better exact Green representation: the [pointed Newton--Green theorem](pointed_newton_green_barrier.md) already provides one for this prototype. Nor does it replace the whole source by a largest-eigenvalue prescription. ## 1. Keep the actual affine operator and source Use C F_N=D(3-U-U^-1), U=Y^N, with the exact coefficients and normalizations of the pointed Green note. On a regular part of the root orbit U=1, its forward inhomogeneous recurrence is w_(j+1)=T_Q(Y_j) w_j+f_Q(Y_j), w_j=(F_N(Y_j),F_N(Q^-1Y_j))^t, T_Q=[-c0/c+, -c-/c+; 1,0], f_Q=(D/c+,0)^t, Y_(j+1)=Q Y_j. (1) This is the original affine source, not an arbitrary homogeneous initial vector. The equation is used away from zeros of c+ only. Its global root singularities and complete-point normal pointing remain exactly those in the actual operator/source theorem. Put Q=exp(h), h=2pi i/N. The limiting homogeneous transfer is T0(Y)=[P(Y),-1;1,0], P(Y)=Y^2+Y^-2-Y-Y^-1-2. (2) Its roots satisfy lambda+lambda^-1=P. On a regular spectral chart with lambda!=+/-1 choose V(Y)=[lambda,lambda^-1;1,1], a(Y)=Y/(Y^2-1), dot P=Y dP/dY. Differentiating the ACTUAL quantum coefficients, not just the classical symbol, gives T_Q=T0+h T1+O(h^2), T1=[-aP,2a;0,0]. (3) The source tends to f0=((Y+1)^2/Y,0)^t. (4) All these expansions are uniform on compact regular arcs. The roots and V can be continued there with their original marks. ## 2. The exact first-order channel connection is nonzero Write Lambda=diag(lambda,lambda^-1). Since dot lambda=dot P lambda^2/(lambda^2-1), the transfer between successive CLASSICAL eigenframes is V(QY)^-1 T_Q(Y) V(Y)=Lambda+h B(Y)+O(h^2), B=V^-1 T1 V-V^-1 dot V Lambda. (5) Direct rational multiplication gives B12=a/lambda+dot P/(lambda^2-1)^2, B21=a lambda+dot P lambda^4/(lambda^2-1)^2. (6) These include BOTH the subprincipal quantum coefficient and the moving-frame derivative. Ignoring the latter is not a time-step energy calculation. At the regular point Y=i, P=-4, lambda=-2-sqrt(3), one obtains EXACTLY B12=i(sqrt(3)-1)/6, B21=-i(sqrt(3)+1)/6. (7) Both are nonzero. The same point is an actual root-orbit sample for every N divisible by four. This mixing is therefore actual quantum transport, not a synthetic matrix counterexample. ## 3. What happens to the proposed step energy Suppose a genuinely identified peripheral branch has its ABSOLUTELY marked regulator R_i(theta), Y=exp(i theta). The [general peripheral bound](general_peripheral_representation_volume_bound.md) and the actual boundary differential give |R_i|<=Vol(X), dR_i/dtheta=log|lambda_i|. (8) This identity uses the squared meridian Y and the actual longitude eigenvalue. It is not asserted for an unidentified factor of an arbitrary annihilator. Let G_N(theta)=diag(exp[-N R_i(theta)/(2pi)]), u_j=G_N(theta_j) V(Y_j)^-1 w_j. Then the EXACT step and source are u_(j+1)=A_(N,j) u_j+g_(N,j), A_(N,j)=G_N(theta_(j+1)) V(Y_(j+1))^-1 T_Q(Y_j)V(Y_j) G_N(theta_j)^-1, g_(N,j)=G_N(theta_(j+1)) V(Y_(j+1))^-1 f_Q(Y_j). (9) The ordinary energy identity is therefore ||u_(j+1)||^2=||A_(N,j)u_j||^2 +2 Re <A_(N,j)u_j,g_(N,j)>+||g_(N,j)||^2. (10) The source and its cross term have NOT been dropped. Equation (8) makes the diagonal factors of A have modulus 1+O(1/N). But for i!=k, (5) gives (A_(N,j))_(ik) =[h B_ik+O(h^2)] exp{N[R_k(theta_j)-R_i(theta_(j+1))]/(2pi)}. (11) A nonzero O(1/N) connection can thus have EXPONENTIALLY large weighted norm when the branch regulators differ. It is not absorbed by |R_i|<=Vol or by a polynomial number of time steps.
