Indeed [local charge selection](actual_pretzel_long_filling_charge_selection.md), sections 2--3, gives a strict source action drop for every sufficiently long finite tuple: \[ V_{\mathrm{src,s}}(\boldsymbol p)<V_s,\qquad V_{\mathrm{src,s}}(\boldsymbol p)\longrightarrow V_s \quad\text{as }\max_i|p_i|^{-1}\longrightarrow0 . \tag{1} \] The derivative estimate there, equation (8), proves the strict inequality; it is stronger than an expansion with an unquantified remainder. For orientation, its quadratic formula (11) reads \[ V_{\mathrm{src,s}}(\boldsymbol p)=V_s- 2\pi^2\operatorname{Im}\tau_s \sum_i|1+2p_i\tau_s|^{-2} +O_s(\|\boldsymbol p^{-1}\|^4). \tag{2} \] This is only a local expansion. Equality with the ACTUAL filled hyperbolic volume requires the further geometric argument below. ## 2. What proves the source has a positive interior angle point The dependencies in [the Casson--Rivin note](actual_long_pretzel_casson_rivin_equality.md) are: 1. **Original source selection, not formal gluing.** Its section 1 invokes [whole-source survival](actual_long_pretzel_full_source_survival.md), sections 1--2. This establishes the exact original invariant's nonzero full-sequence asymptotic and hence its rate \(V_{\mathrm{src}}\). The color complement, all aliases, original normal terms, endpoint currents and noncancellation are analytic premises. Concavity does not prove them. 2. **An actual marked representation near a known geometric point.** [The literal port theorem](actual_pretzel_port_lift_and_geometric_anchor.md), sections 1--6, supplies the source-selected \(\rho_z\), its cap order, preferred peripheral words, and the COMPLETE geometric anchor \(\rho_0\). This uses the explicit augmented geometry. It does not assume that a filled \(\rho_{\boldsymbol p}\) is geometric. 3. **A positive chart at the COMPLETE base.** Casson--Rivin section 2 chooses a fixed positive geometric ideal triangulation of that complete manifold. The CURRENT class-specific input is [the direct positive ideal-angle certificate](actual_pretzel_positive_ideal_angle_certificate.md), sections 1--3: exact homogeneous lifts of the actual polyhedra, all original white/shaded half-twist face maps, and finite compatible affine subdivision give this triangulation directly. Its section 4 also checks the full edge/peripheral tangent rank. The former [Ge audit](ge_geometric_triangulation_audit.md), sections 1--3, conditional on Epstein--Penner, remains an alternative route; it is no longer a dependency for this actual class. The direct proof asserts no universal all-ideal existence theorem for an arbitrary augmented base, and is not itself a quantum source-selection theorem. 4. **Continuity, not an assumed maximizer.** Equivariantly move those finitely many ideal vertices using the selected peripheral flags. They vary continuously from the complete noncentral parabolic flags. Cross-ratios stay in the upper half-plane in one fixed neighborhood. Exact representation relations give the complex edge equations; their angular lifts remain \(2\pi\). The source's inverse-slope implicit-function argument puts every sufficiently long independently signed tuple in that neighborhood. It follows that the actual source point is in the RELATIVE INTERIOR of the prescribed affine angle slice. Thus the interior critical point is not obtained from the statement “a concave functional has a maximum.” It is supplied by an actual source-selected representation which is a small deformation of an independently identified positive complete geometry. None of these steps assumes the desired filled-volume equality. The alternative [finite-center core construction](actual_long_pretzel_geometric_filling_completion.md), sections 2--5, and the [general equivariant averaging construction](general_source_regulator_hyperbolic_equality.md), sections 2--5, prove the geometric completion without requiring the all-ideal triangulation input. They are sufficient for final equality even when one does not use the Casson--Rivin angle presentation. ## 3. The constrained functional is concave and uses FILLED slopes The actual domain in Casson--Rivin section 3 is the positive angle polytope with tetrahedral sums \(\pi\), edge sums \(2\pi\), and \[ \operatorname{Im}(U_i+p_iV_i)=-2\pi,\qquad U_i=-z_i,\quad V_i=-2\ell_i , \tag{3} \] on each filled auxiliary cusp. The logarithms are the SMALL centered PROJECTIVE logs. An old SL longitude sign is not added as a further geometric rotation. A remaining main cusp has its chosen meridian angle zero; the source representation in fact has both its peripheral logs zero. With two main components, the corresponding conditions are imposed on BOTH unfilled cusps. Equation (3) is the all-positive unit charge convention. The other minimal charge signs use their corresponding eigenflag marks. The existence/noncancellation of the selected contribution was already proved in the quantum source theorem. For tetrahedral angles \(\alpha+\beta+\gamma=\pi\), let \[ \mathcal V(\theta)=\sum_t [\Lambda(\alpha_t)+\Lambda(\beta_t)+\Lambda(\gamma_t)]. \] In the two free angles its negative Hessian is \[ \begin{pmatrix} \cot\alpha+\cot\beta&\cot\beta\\ \cot\beta&\cot\gamma+\cot\beta \end{pmatrix}. \tag{4} \] Its determinant is \(1\), and its first diagonal entry is \(\sin\gamma/(\sin\alpha\sin\beta)>0\). Therefore the functional is STRICTLY CONCAVE, not convex, on every affine positive-angle slice. Maximizing on the old UNFILLED completeness slice would concern \(V_s\) and would not prove the filled claim. The large signed integers \(p_i\) belong in the actual affine constraints (3). ## 4. Why stationarity holds for all angle tangents Casson--Rivin section 4 correctly uses the coisotropic edge reduction, not a derivative only along the much smaller representation variety. For \(x=\operatorname{Log} z,\ y=\operatorname{Log} z''\), direct sine-rule differentiation gives \[ d\mathcal V(\delta\theta) =\sum_t(\operatorname{Re}x_t\,\delta\gamma_t -\operatorname{Re}y_t\,\delta\alpha_t). \] The REAL log vector of a complex gluing solution and EVERY tangent obeying the homogeneous edge-angle constraints lie in the edge coisotropic space. The audited boundary pairing, independently on each boundary torus, consequently gives \[ d\mathcal V(\delta\theta)=\frac12\sum_i [\operatorname{Re}V_i\,\delta\operatorname{Im}U_i -\operatorname{Re}U_i\,\delta\operatorname{Im}V_i]. \tag{5} \] There are no cross-torus intersection terms. At the source point the REAL part of its actual filling equation is \(\operatorname{Re}U_i+p_i\operatorname{Re}V_i=0\). Each term of (5) is therefore \[ \tfrac12\operatorname{Re}V_i\, \delta\operatorname{Im}(U_i+p_iV_i)=0 . \] Unfilled cusp terms vanish because both actual logs are zero. This proves the full KKT criticality on the affine slice, including variations not arising from nearby complete gluing solutions. Strict concavity then makes the source point the unique global maximizer, including comparison with the boundary by continuity. ## 5. Absolute calibration, boundary correction, and smooth completion The source-to-volume equality is not fixed by a cusp Hessian alone. [The marked regulator proof](actual_pretzel_marked_regulator_and_filling_action.md), sections 1--4, uses the SAME group representation, eigenflags, preferred longitude and COMPLETE anchor to prove \[ D_{\mathrm{src}} =\operatorname{Im}G-\sum_i\operatorname{Re}z_i \operatorname{Im}\ell_i =D(\beta(\rho_z)). \tag{6} \] Its section 3 defines \(\beta\) by an actual decorated fundamental chain, not an unproved extension of a unipotent coefficient identity. The literal spin \(\lambda=-L_H^{-1}\) is retained before the paired norm. Its exact filling term is \[ W=G+\sum_i(z_i-2\pi i m_i)^2/(4p_i). \] At stationarity \(\operatorname{Re}z_i=-2p_i\operatorname{Re}\ell_i\), so \(\operatorname{Im}W=D_{\mathrm{src}}\). Thus no unestimated complex endpoint term is suppressed when passing from the source action to the volume functional. Finally Casson--Rivin section 6 invokes independently proved smooth completion. The [primitive log theorem](actual_long_pretzel_primitive_filling_angle.md), sections 2--5, identifies the actual log-link periods BEFORE multiplying by a large slope. The selected slope period is exactly \(2\pi\) in absolute angular value, not merely scalar PSL holonomy and not a \(4\pi\) branched fill. The [compact log-link and tube proof](long_pretzel_equality_critical_audit.md), sections 2--5, gives the full tube and degree-one complete filling; the unfilled cusp or cusps remain complete. Therefore the regulator value is the volume of a genuine positive complete hyperbolic metric on the ACTUAL filled topology. Comparing it to a specified hyperbolic metric via the independently proved representation-volume inequality in both directions identifies their volumes without assuming a separate equality-rigidity theorem. The dependency chain is \[ \text{whole source rate}\ \longrightarrow\ \text{actual marked }\rho_{\boldsymbol p}\ \longrightarrow\ \text{positive interior angle point and filled-slope KKT} \ \longrightarrow\ \max\mathcal V=V_{\mathrm{src}} \ \longrightarrow\ \text{smooth complete filled volume}. \tag{7} \] No arrow is justified solely by the previous maximum's numerical value. In particular neither a KKT equation without the positive chart/primitive logs nor strict concavity without a verified source point proves the assertion. ## 6. Current exact quantum scope The old Casson--Rivin and survival bodies state odd \(s\geq25\). The subsequent [width extension](actual_pretzel_all_width_extension.md), sections 5--6, supplies the missing whole-color gap for every fixed odd \(s\geq9\). Section 8 of that note separately verifies the parity-independent source and normalization and gives the original single-cut reduced two-component link theorem at every fixed even \(s\geq10\). For even width both unfilled main cusps remain parabolic and complete; the boundary-pairing and completion arguments are their direct sum. The even-link statement is not obtained by calling a link a knot or modifying each component separately. In both cases all \(|p_i|\) are independently sufficiently large FIXED integers. Their signs and ratios are unrestricted. The common threshold may depend on the fixed width, and can be enlarged once to enter the fixed positive geometric neighborhood. Neither width nor slopes grow with the quantum level \(N\); both level parities and composite levels remain included. Widths \(3,5,7\) and even \(4,6,8\) are not supplied by this current global source estimate. The general geometric certificate applies far beyond pretzels, but the actual quantum source survival is not thereby established for arbitrary graphs or all hyperbolic knots. **Verdict:** the proved-family equality is noncircular with these dependencies. Casson--Rivin is a valid concave variational characterization of the already source-selected point; it is not a substitute for the source-selection and geometric-existence inputs. No new computation was used in this audit.

title: A source-fixed quantitative norm for the actual divided fusion current
text: # A source-fixed quantitative norm for the actual divided fusion current 29 October 2026. The TWO-PHYSICAL-HEAD factorial-fusion defect has a polylogarithmic norm and inverse norm in a specified source-fixing factorial metric. This controls the complete unipotent current, not just its homogeneous bulk, and is an operator estimate before any exterior is paired or phases discarded. The metric is the physical gauge L^(1/2), distinct from the LENGTH frame L^(1/4) in the normalized binary blocks. Merging larger physical blocks is a separate issue: its degree-N current has a genuine positive angle norm. No polynomial bound for arbitrary block fusion or a sharp whole-knot energy estimate is inferred. ## 1. The unchanged original current and factorial identity Use N>=2, q=exp(pi*i/N), Q=q^2, d=N-1 and the original complete balanced head. Put Ecal|a>=(Q^-a-1)|a-1>, K|a>=x Q^-a|a>, x=-q^-1, F_a=(Q;Q)_a, s_a=|F_a|, p_N(X)=sum_(a=0)^d X^a/F_a. Let A=Ecal_1 K_2, B=Ecal_2 and C=A+B. The genuine generic Weyl lift, divided BEFORE root specialization, gives the actual operator J=[C^N/(1-Q^N)]_root =sum_(a=1)^d N B^(N-a) A^a/[F_a F_(N-a)]. (1) This is the already proved [divided-Ward fusion](divided_ward_factorial_fusion.md), including its normal direction and even-level signs. One has J^2=0 and [J,C]=0. Its full finite factorial identity is EXACTLY p_N(-tB)p_N(-tA)=Theta(t) p_N(-tC), Theta(t)=I+(-t)^N J/N, Theta(t)^-1=I-(-t)^N J/N. (2) The sign (-t)^N, all degrees of the finite product, and its actual inhomogeneous/normal current are retained. No equality of the bare homogeneous factors without Theta is asserted. ## 2. An explicit source-fixed physical metric Let L_a=s_a^2/N, G_a=L_a^(1/2)=s_a/sqrt(N), G=diag(G_a). Exact root complementation gives G_a G_(d-a)=1. Thus G on both legs fixes every original cup and ordinary cap, and the full marked co-source after its permitted whole-network degree restriction, as in [the weighted physical Fourier theorem](actual_weighted_fourier_plat_energy.md). The original pivots commute with G. No exponential condition number is charged at that paired source, although G itself is exponentially conditioned in the flat physical basis. The marked-row assertion is used on the fully assembled original degree-preserving operator, or with its actually transported row. It is not a replacement of the unrestricted marked row after splitting off a degree-changing current sector. Directly, G Ecal G^-1 |a> =(Q^-a-1)/|1-Q^a| |a-1>, 1<=a<N. (3) It is a unit-phase unilateral lowering shift, of operator norm1; K remains unitary. Hence every power of the transformed A or B is a contraction. Write ||T||_G=||G^(tensor2) T G^(-tensor2)||. The precise two-head estimate is ||J/N||_G <= R_N, R_N=sum_(a=1)^d 1/[s_a s_(N-a)] =(1/N)sum_(a=1)^d 1/|1-Q^a| <=(1/2)H_(floor(N/2)), (4) where H_r=sum_(j=1)^r1/j. Indeed (1),(3) give the first inequality. Reflection yields s_a s_(N-a)=N|1-Q^a|, and |1-Q^a|>=4 min(a,N-a)/N proves the last bound. In particular ||Theta(t)||_G, ||Theta(t)^-1||_G <=1+|t|^N R_N. (5) For fixed-log tags |t|<=exp(c/N), both norms are O_c(log N). They are polynomial for the more general condition |t|^N<=N^c. There is no such claim for fixed |t|>1. This is a concrete positive Hermitian metric and an explicit bound, not a Gram chosen from an unknown terminal knot operator. In ordinary unitary Fourier coordinates its matrix is H_F=F (L tensor L) F^*, (6) with F the two-head unitary Fourier transform. It is generally non-diagonal. Equivalently conjugate the current by (F_1 G) tensor (F_1 G) and use the flat norm, where F_1 is one-head Fourier. The same source and dual factors must be transported. ## 3. All-exterior scope and coherent packet metrics Identity(2) is an identity of the original finite matrices, so it can be inserted into ANY specified original polynomial exterior, including its actual caps and cut. For a boundary column v, and for a whole boundary matrix V in the corresponding Hilbert--Schmidt norm, (5) gives both comparisons (1+|t|^N R_N)^-1 ||p_N(-tC)V||_G <=||p_N(-tB)p_N(-tA)V||_G <=(1+|t|^N R_N)||p_N(-tC)V||_G. (7) All currents are still present in the exact operator. Tensoring spectators does not change this norm. A FIXED number of such two-physical-head adapters costs at most a fixed power of log N, if their tags obey the stated fixed-log bound and their physical metric interfaces are matched. This is before dephasing; phases in (1) have not been estimated separately at the selected scalar. An arbitrary left exterior X does not turn (7) into a relative comparison of |source(X p_N(B)p_N(A)V)| and |source(X p_N(C)V)|. A scalar may cancel or vanish. Moving an adapter across X requires its actual intertwining relation, or the transported boundary Gram X^*H X. The bounded local adapter does not establish either automatically. There is a useful exact compatibility test for a new packet Gram. If P is ANY invertible function of this SAME total current C, then P commutes with J and Theta. In the pulled-back Gram H_P=P^* (G^2 tensor G^2) P the norm of Theta is therefore exactly its norm in G. Consequently (5)--(7) remain valid. This is a genuine way to include the retained current in a non-diagonal coherent packet metric. The actual q-Pascal matrix is a nilpotent Euler function of a physical current, up to recorded chirps, but identifying its relative register with this two-head C requires the typed module map; it is not inferred from equal dimensions. An arbitrary P need not fix the original source: its vector, co-vector and Riesz norm must be transported through that map. ### Overlapping physical pairs really do have a common tame metric On any fixed b-head space use the SAME global gauge G^(tensor b). Every two-head E-coproduct adapter on adjacent heads, tensored with the spectator identity, has the bound(5) in this metric. The pairs may overlap. No commutation between different adapters is required. Consequently, for a fixed finite word U of these adapters or their inverses, ||U||_G, ||U^-1||_G <=product_j (1+|t_j|^N R_N). (7a) Fixed-log tags give a fixed power of log N. The same physical gauge fixes the original paired endpoints as stated above. This is a valid quantitative overlap lemma, not an estimate only for disjoint two-head blocks. There is an exact limitation on what that word can implement. For b=3, N>=3, take a_i>0 with a_1+a_2+a_3=N. On the input |a_1,a_2,a_3>, every single two-head J leaves a third positive head unchanged. Every product of two or more J's lowers total degree by at least2N and therefore annihilates that input. Hence EVERY word of bare pair adapters and inverses has <0,0,0|U|a_1,a_2,a_3>=0. (7b) By contrast, the full three-head current in(8) has the NONZERO coefficient of modulus1/(s_(a_1)s_(a_2)s_(a_3)) there. Thus bare overlapping tame pair adapters cannot generate that full block correction. A further typed packet conjugation or other operator is necessary. Conjugating by a function of the SAME current is covered above; an overlapping packet for a DIFFERENT current need not commute and is not covered. Opposite raising/lowering orientations also require their actual mirror and metric adapters; (7a) asserts the common E-coproduct orientation just specified. ### A neighboring packet Gram carries an explicit angle weight There is also a quantitative test of the remaining interface. On three actual heads put C_23=Ecal_2 K_3+Ecal_3 and P_23=p_N(C_23). In the coherent packet Gram H_23=P_23^* G_global^2 P_23, G_global=G tensor G tensor G, the neighboring J_12 is measured by its conjugate P_23 J_12 P_23^-1 in the base G metric. On head3=0 the actual packet restricts EXACTLY to p_N(x B), B=Ecal_2: Ecal_3 kills that subspace and K_3=x there. J_12 preserves it as well. For A=Ecal_1 K_2 one has BA=Q^-1 AB. The finite Euler shift equation, with the nilpotent argument Z=xB, gives exactly p_N(Z) A^a p_N(Z)^-1 =A^a product_(j=1)^a(1-Q^-j Z)^-1. (7c) All inverses are finite polynomials because Z^N=0. The coefficient of Z^h in the last product is Q^-h [a+h-1 choose h]_(Q^-1), by the finite coefficient form of the elementary q-binomial generating identity. For 0<=h<a<N and a+h-1<N this coefficient uses only nonzero factorials. In the matrix entry from |a,N-a+h,0> to |0,0,0>, the term a of J_12 is the UNIQUE term lowering head1 to zero, and the displayed h is the unique extra lowering on head2. The conjugated G Ecal G^-1 shifts and K factors have unit modulus. Thus the entry of P_23 (J_12/N) P_23^-1 in the base G frame has modulus |[a+h-1 choose h]_Q|/[s_a s_(N-a)]. (7d) This is a full operator entry, including the retained current and the inverse packet, not one term selected before their cancellation. For N=4k, a=2k,h=k, formula(7d) is exactly |[3k-1 choose k]_Q|/(2N) =(1/2)w_N(k,2k-1,k), (7e) where the three nonnegative indices sum to d. It is an explicit positive affine-angle ENERGY weight. Its logarithmic rate is Lambda(pi/4)*2/pi=Catalan/pi, by the uniform factorial estimate. It must receive geometric accounting rather than being declared polynomial. The same entry of the conjugated Theta_12 is multiplied by |t|^N; its identity term is zero on these distinct input/output states. If |t|^N and its reciprocal are polynomially bounded, this entry has the same exponential rate. An upper bound on |t| alone would not justify that lower-rate assertion. Consequently the nice two-head adapter bound does not automatically persist in a neighboring total-current packet Gram. This does not exclude a global coherent Gram, a source-restricted estimate, or an angle-energy comparison that RETAINS(7e). It pinpoints the additional typed recoupling which the global estimate must handle. ## 4. Why arbitrary-width block fusion is not automatically tame For b actual physical heads let C_b be the total Ecal and J_b=[C_b^N/(1-Q^N)]_root. The exact q-multinomial expansion is J_b/N=sum_(a_1+...+a_b=N,0<=a_i<N) phase(a) product_i Ecal_i^(a_i) K_dressings /product_i F_(a_i). (8) Here every phase and K dressing has modulus one after the complete source-fixed gauge G^(tensor b). Thus ||J_b/N||_G <= sum_(a_1+...+a_b=N,0<=a_i<N) product_i s_(a_i)^-1. (9) For any tuple in (8), its matrix coefficient from |a_1,...,a_b> to |0,...,0> is supplied by that UNIQUE term. Its modulus in the G frame is exactly product_i s_(a_i)^-1. No cancellation in the operator sum can remove this lower bound. The uniform root-factorial estimate and the positive simplex maximum proved in [the clock-source note](actual_length_gauge_clock_source.md) therefore yield, for each fixed b>=2, lim_(N->infinity) (1/N)log||J_b/N||_G =b Lambda(pi/b)/pi. (10) For b=2 this is zero, in agreement with the sharper bound(4). For b=3 it is v_3/pi, with a_i/N near1/3. This is a real positive angle weight in the ACTUAL divided operator, not a hypothetical scalar exterior or a numerical bad state. Likewise the mixed adapter merging blocks X,Y contains the tuples straddling both blocks. When their total has at least three physical heads, the uniform tuple still straddles them. On total input degree N its exponential has only its first degree-N term; higher normal powers cannot cancel that matrix coefficient. Thus the two-head bound cannot be silently iterated into a polynomial bound for arbitrary block fusion. The positive angle cost has to be retained and controlled by the global geometric incidence. This does not obstruct a sharp geometric energy theorem. It identifies a tame local current adapter and the explicit angle energy that appears at the first genuinely larger fusion. Global source gluing and geometric edge support remain to be proved. [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_source_fixed_divided_fusion_norm.py): literal actual matrices, complete factorial/Theta identities, source-fixed metric, norm/inverse bounds, and the unique multihead coefficient with all Frobenius phases retained.

title: The original source has an exact Fourier resolution into twisted traces
text: # The original source has an exact Fourier resolution into twisted traces 27 October 2026. The all-strand endpoint source admits a resolution into UNIT-density Frobenius traces on one common matrix algebra of actual word coefficients. Their source-conjugation transport satisfies an explicit nonabelian norm equation. Primitive Fourier sectors have finite cyclic transport (as do gcd-two sectors); the remaining transport is unipotent, with index EXACTLY gcd(k,N). The zero sector has index EXACTLY N when N>2. Thus nilpotence exists but is not uniformly bounded in level. Individual sectors are not knot invariants: an actual braid-conjugacy test changes their values while preserving their marked Fourier sum. No sector is identified here with a geometric A-period, nor is its coefficient bounded subexponentially. This note does not replace the already proved symmetric trace on the full E,F,K centralizer in [the integral cut theorem](integral_projective_cut_duality.md). ## 1. The actual endpoint is a Nakayama-relative line Use the actual root algebra and cap of [the Euler/Cauchy theorem](actual_euler_cap_cauchy_boundary.md): A_0=<H,f | H^N=1, Hf=Q^-1 fH, f^N=0>, e_j=(1/N)sum_k Q^(jk)H^k, tau(f^a e_j)=delta_(a,N-1), nu(H)=QH, nu(f)=f, tau(ab)=tau(b nu(a)). Set z=xf, J=1/[(1-z)(1-Qz)] and E=e_(N-1)J, nu(E)=e_0 J, s=f^(N-1)e_0. The rational expression J is an actual finite polynomial because z is nilpotent. Its degree-(N-1) coefficient is zero at Q^N=1. Also e_(N-1)J e_(N-1)=e_(N-1). Consequently E^2=E, tau(E)=0, tau(s)=1, E a nu(E)=rho_0(Ja) s for EVERY a in A_0, (1) rho_0=[f^(N-1)e_0]. For (1), the two endpoint idempotents in e_(N-1)Ja e_0 select exactly its f^(N-1)e_0 coefficient. Right multiplication by J does nothing to s since s f=0. Thus the actual source is a specified rank-one linear compression between DIFFERENT projectives. Ordinary compression E a E would erase it: E is a primitive idempotent lifting e_(N-1), so E A_0 E=C E, and tau vanishes on that entire corner. More explicitly put n=e_(N-1)(J-1). Then n^2=0, n e_(N-1)=0, and E=(1-n)e_(N-1)(1+n). The corner claim follows from e_(N-1)A_0 e_(N-1)=C e_(N-1). In contrast (1) is nonzero at a=s. This linear compression is not a word quotient. Already at N=2, the actual positive crossing coefficient is a_R=eta I+(eta^-1/2)s, eta=exp(pi*i/4). Here J=1. The map P(a)=E a nu(E) has P(e_0)=0 but P(a_R e_0)=(eta^-1/2)s!=0. Transport on the selected scalar line alone would lose real word data. One must retain the projective memory E A_0, or another independently proved source complex. Nor is the single cap a twisted trace for some automorphism merely because tau is. If tau(Eab)=tau(Eb theta(a)) for every a,b, Frobenius nondegeneracy implies nu(E)nu(a)=theta(a)nu(E). Thus nu(E)A_0=A_0 nu(E). A normal idempotent is central: both off- diagonal corners vanish. But the center of A_0 is C and E is a proper primitive idempotent. This rules out that shortcut. The Fourier resolution below instead uses invertible densities. ## 2. Align all tail heads on ONE actual coefficient algebra The [all-strand source theorem](all_strand_euler_cauchy_cap.md) decomposes the closed tail into r=N^(b-2) normalized Borel heads. For b>=3 label them lambda=(t,j), with y_lambda=YQ^-j; for b=2 use one head and j=0. Let C_lambda be its actual two-leg fusion. The physical GLOBAL H=K_total/(xY) acts in that local regular frame as Q^-j times left multiplication by H. Replace that local frame by Psi_lambda=C_lambda composed with nu^-j. (2) Indeed nu^-j(Ha)=Q^-j H nu^-j(a), so (2) intertwines the same global H and f on every copy. Consequently the full actual braid, INCLUDING all off-diagonal tail transitions, acts on row vectors by right multiplication by a matrix A in B=Mat_r(A_0). Transposing the usual array of block right coefficients gives this row-vector convention. Operator composition is right action in its original order; no diagonal blocks are extracted during multiplication. The physical Euler-dressed coefficient matrix is b=U^-1 A U, U=diag(u(z)), u(z)=sum_(a=0)^(N-1) z^a/(Q;Q)_a. The matrix Frobenius functional and Nakayama map are T(b)=sum_lambda tau(b_(lambda,lambda)), nu acts entrywise, T(ab)=T(b nu(a)). Changing from the local head to (2) sends its word coefficient to nu^j of the local coefficient. Therefore the original source from the all-strand theorem becomes EXACTLY P_W=chi_W gamma_0 T(D b), gamma_0=N x^(b(1-N))Q, D=diag_lambda[Q^-j e_(j-1)J]. (3) All original framing and full peripheral factors remain in chi_W. This is valid for varying actual meridian x=-M/q at the fixed root on its original source lattice. It does not equate central-F and moving-q normals. Formula (3) follows either from the literal pivotal trace or from rho_j(Jb)=tau(e_(j-1)Jb); no invariant is divided out to choose the frame. ## 3. Fourier resolution into genuine unit-density traces The idempotent Fourier formula gives D=(1/N)sum_(k=0)^(N-1) C_k, C_k=diag_lambda[Q^(-j+(j-1)k)] H^k J. (4) Every C_k is a UNIT of B. Define Phi_k(a)=T(C_k a), theta_k=Ad_(C_k) composed with nu. Then Phi_k is a nondegenerate Frobenius functional and Phi_k(ab)=Phi_k(b theta_k(a)), P_W=(chi_W gamma_0/N)sum_k Phi_k(b). (5) For the twisted trace identity, T(C_k ab)=T(b nu(C_k)nu(a)). Since nu(C_k)=Q^k C_k, its scalar multiplier cancels in inner conjugation, giving theta_k as stated. These are actual whole-word source sectors, not characters assigned to semisimple root points. Their Fourier SUM recovers the original nonunit source density D. If desired the space of all invertible Frobenius densities is a torsor under the noncommutative unit group B^times. It is not yet the G_m/norm-one torus of a simple quantum A-eigenline. Passing to that latter object requires its own central spectral compatibility. ## 4. Exact finite-order and unipotent source transport Put g=gcd(k,N), d=N/g, taking g=N,d=1 when k=0. The scalar- diagonal phases in C_k have Nth power one. Using HfH^-1=Q^-1 f, the product formula for its Nth power is C_k^N=G_k(z) I_r, G_k(z)=[(1-z^d)(1-Q^d z^d)]^-g. (6) Indeed multiplication visits every dth-root orbit of z exactly g times. The two factors in J give the two products displayed in (6). All are units on the actual nilpotent source. Also nu(C_k)=Q^k C_k and nu^N=Id. Hence theta_k^N=Ad_(G_k(z) I_r). (7) In particular primitive k has g=1, z^N=0, so G_k=1 and theta_k^N=Id. This conclusion is valid at every composite N too. The same holds for g=2: Q^d=-1 and the two denominator factors multiply to 1-z^N=1. For g>2 the bound (8) is sharp. For the remaining k, G_k=1+O(z^d). On the basis f^a H^j, Ad_(G_k)(f^a H^j) =f^a [G_k(z)/G_k(Q^-j z)] H^j. The factor in brackets minus one belongs to (z^d), and Ad_(G_k) fixes all functions of z. Iterating a difference therefore gains one further factor z^d on each iteration, proving the sharper bound (theta_k^N-Id)^g=0. (8) To see sharpness, the leading term for g>2 is G_k(z)=1+g(1+Q^d)z^d+O(z^(2d)). The ratio at j=1 has nonzero leading coefficient g(1+Q^d)(1-Q^-d)z^d. Its (g-1)st power survives because d(g-1)<N. Thus the index is exactly g. In particular there is no uniform level-independent bound. For k=0 and N>2, G_0(z)=J(z)^N=1+N(1+Q)z+O(z^2). Its ratio at j=1 has nonzero linear coefficient N(1+Q)(1-Q^-1). Thus (Ad_(G_0)-Id)^(N-1)(H)!=0, while its Nth power is zero: the index in (8) is EXACTLY N. The exception N=2 has J=1, so its cyclic transport is already finite order. The growing index and the unestimated word coefficients prevent using nilpotence alone as a subexponential norm estimate. There is an explicit Hilbert-90 gauge in every g<=2 sector. Put C_k^0=diag_lambda[Q^(-j+(j-1)k)]H^k and mu_k=Ad_(C_k^0) composed with nu. It sends z to Q^-k z. Choose the finite nilpotent exponential g_k(z)=exp sum_(a=1)^(N-1) (1+Q^a)z^a/[a(Q^(ka)-1)]. (8a) At g=1 every displayed denominator is a unit. At g=2 the sole resonant degree a=d has numerator zero too; choose that coefficient to be zero rather than interpret a zero-over-zero expression. Coefficient comparison in the finite logarithm proves g_k(Q^k z)/g_k(z)=J(z), theta_k=Ad_(g_k) composed with mu_k composed with Ad_(g_k^-1). (8b) For k=1 this gauge is especially concrete: g_1(z)=v(z)v(Qz)=[u(z)u(Qz)]^-1 =(1-z)^-1 u(z)^-2. (8c) Thus the finite cyclic transport is explicitly solved, but its comparison gauge contains TWO quantum Euler factors. It is not a polynomial-norm estimate and must retain those factors in a regulator comparison. For g>2 the nonzero resonant term at degree d prevents solving the same scalar-polynomial gauge equation: its numerator 1+Q^d is nonzero while Q^(kd)-1=0. This is precisely the remaining unipotent defect rather than an omitted normalization choice. The subsequent [uniform actual-gauge action proof](actual_hilbert90_gauge_dilogarithm_action.md) now makes this metric issue quantitative. For the CANONICAL finite polynomial g_1, uniformly on |z|<=1/4, g_1(z)=exp[(2/h)Li_2(z)+O(1/N)], h=2pi*i/N. Its flat right-regular operator and inverse have positive exponential norm rates, so its condition number grows exponentially. This is the specified actual source gauge, not an arbitrary rescaling. In contrast, [its Euler meridian half-step](actual_euler_meridian_half_step.md) has a polynomial condition bound and a nonzero exact sourced endpoint. Both results retain their degree-N carries and stated metrics. ## 5. The source-conjugation torsor has a concrete norm equation For any actual invertible word coefficient c, or any unit of B, put h_k(c)=c theta_k(c)^-1. Twisted cyclicity gives the exact PERIOD equation Phi_k(c^-1 b c)=Phi_k(b h_k(c)). (9) This states precisely how the sector co-source must be transported under conjugation. Its ordered cyclic norm telescopes: product_(r=0)^(N-1) theta_k^r(h_k(c)) =c theta_k^N(c)^-1 =c G_k c^-1 G_k^-1. (10) Sectors with gcd(k,N)<=2 therefore have a genuine nonabelian norm-one source equation; the other sectors retain an explicit unipotent commutator defect. On an independently identified commutative simple eigenline this would become an ordinary Hilbert-90-type comparison. Neither that eigenline nor its geometric support is assumed here. The nonprimitive defect and the marked Fourier sum cannot simply be deleted. The individual values Phi_k(b) are not knot invariants. There is an exact actual-matrix witness with the SAME braid index and writhe: at N=3 over F_1009, the figure-eight word beta=(1,-2,1,-2) has sector values [224,545,410], average 393, whereas sigma_1 beta sigma_1^-1=(1,1,-2,1,-2,-1) has [619,845,724], average 393. All external normalization factors are identical in this comparison. Thus an adapter depending only on level, color, braid index and writhe cannot turn these fixed sectors into ordinary-color knot evaluations. Equation (9), with its actual transported co-source, is required. The sum in (5) does give the original invariant. There is also a local E-commutation obstruction: at N=2, J=1 and theta_k sends the nonconstant part f e_0 of the actual crossing to Q^-k f e_1. After undoing the Euler/fusion frame its right operator no longer commutes with the actual total E. The audit checks a nonzero literal commutator. Consequently theta_k is an automorphism of the full Borel-relative algebra, not generally of the smaller actual E,F,K centralizer. Its sectors must not be identified with that centralizer's existing symmetric cut trace. ## 6. What this advances and what remains This gives an explicit source-preserving Fourier family with a fully solved finite-level cyclic transport equation, including its nonabelian norm defect. It also identifies the exact linear source line and shows why ordinary corner compression erases it. These are algebraic statements about the actual selected source and the completed original word at arbitrary braid index. They do not supply a nonzero selected geometric A-sector, a bound for the sector sum, or a sharp volume norm. In particular finite cyclic transport, even in primitive sectors, does not bound the value of a word; the norm-one condition alone permits large comparison matrices. The zero sector's nilpotence index grows with N and its contribution has not been proved negligible. The source family is therefore an exact input for the required singular/nonlocal geometric comparison, not that comparison itself. The [audit](../experiments/audit_actual_source_fourier_twisted_traces.py) and [saved results](../experiments/actual_source_fourier_twisted_traces_results.json) check seven levels N=2,...,8, all basis relative-line compressions, twisted cyclicity, sector inverses, exact norm equations, the sharp zero-sector nilpotence index, and the common-frame original source on six signed words of braid indices two, three and four. The noninvariance and E-commutation witnesses use literal original crossing matrices and pivots, not replacement traces.

title: A source-preserving odd framing period
status: Exact original odd-band source and its local logarithmic residue
text: # A source-preserving odd framing period 30 October 2026. A specified difference of the two nearest physical bands, with its exact quantum coefficient, has the SAME normalized value as the original complete invariant. Its normalization is nonzero at every level and costs only O(N) on an interior real coherent cut. In the actual routed physical chart the underlying odd form has an explicit nonzero logarithmic residue; the actual coherent base weight remains part of the source. This closes the old distinction between the unchanged scalar and an inserted odd observable. It does not determine the original relative cycle's winding, justify a quantum boundary-scale limit from separate local packets, or supply the missing mixed-color global estimate. ## 1. The literal source and its normalization Fix N>=2, d=N-1, q0=exp(pi i/N). Use the original regular generic channel, with epsilon the genuine quantum parameter, C_e(X)=P_V[A U^-1(X tensor I)U B], C_e(I)=z(e)I. (1) Here A:W->V and B:V->W may have different actual Morse widths, U is the recorded braid carrying the chosen W head to FIRST position, and P_V closes the other physical heads with g_e=(-1)^d K_e. All original cups, caps, complete-circle scalars and peripheral lines are retained. These are exactly the hypotheses of the [braided source theorem](actual_braided_two_cut_source_adapter.md). The statement applies at arbitrary fixed width and to the specified regular complete-source sector sum. It does not make a bare root mark a generic intertwiner. Let T_n=sum_(r-s=n)E_rs be the UNWRAPPED physical band, and set beta_a(t)=binom(d,a)t^a(1-t)^(d-a), e_t=beta(t)1^T, O_N=T_1-q0 T_-1, kappa_N(t)=1-q0-t^d+q0(1-t)^d. (2) The [actual divided-descendant theorem](actual_explicit_root_channel_normal_adapter.md) proves C_0(T_n)=z_0 T_n, including both n=+1 and n=-1. Moreover Tr(e_t T_1)=1-beta_d and Tr(e_t T_-1)=1-beta_0. Consequently the exact original scalar is Tr[e_t C_0(O_N)]/kappa_N(t)=z_0, (3) wherever kappa_N!=0. No second pivotal closure or new state is inserted in (3). The numerator is the original coherent FIRST-cut row applied to two actual neighboring bands of (1). For real 0<=t<=1 it is nonzero at EVERY N. Indeed put A0=1-t^d, B0=1-(1-t)^d and theta=pi/N. Then A0,B0>=0, A0+B0>=1, and exactly |kappa_N|^2=(A0-B0)^2 cos^2(theta/2) +(A0+B0)^2 sin^2(theta/2) >=sin^2(theta/2)>=N^-2. (4) There is no odd/even exception. On any fixed t in [delta,1-delta], kappa_N=(1-q0)[1+O_delta(N(1-delta)^(N-1))], kappa_N=-pi i/N+O_delta(N^-2). (5) Thus its inverse has size O(N), without an exponential cost. For complex coherent t, keep the explicit kappa_N and its actual zeros; (4) is not a claim on arbitrary complex t. The exact finite period in (3) is kappa_N^-1 [sum_(0<=a,l<d) beta_a C_0(E_(l+1,l))_(a+1,a) -q0 sum_(1<=a,l<=d) beta_a C_0(E_(l-1,l))_(a-1,a)]. (6) These are TWO different physical support sets, with the original internal head sums and their own finite endpoint rows. Neither is wrapped cyclically or identified with the other's support cycle. Their common primitive charged chart and meromorphic local currents are supplied by the [common-band theorem](actual_matching_graph_common_band_ward_current.md). If the cut is already the first physical slot, U=I is permitted. For a different selected edge, its actual U and U^-1 remain in (6). ## 2. Genuine quantum normals and the indispensable q coefficient The ordinary closed source is F_e=D_N(e)z(e), with D_N=(-1)^d[N]_(q0 exp(epsilon)), D_N(0)=0 and D_N'(0)=nu_N. For example retain the literal regular lift O_e=T_1-q0 exp(epsilon)T_-1 and kappa_e=Tr(e_t O_e). Equation (3) implies exactly Z_e=Tr[e_t C_e(O_e)]/kappa_e, D_N(e)[Z_e-z(e)]=O(epsilon^2), [epsilon]D_N Z_e/nu_N=z_0. (7) Every original exterior scalar is the same on both sides. This is a whole-source FIRST-trace-normal identity. It does not assert Z_e=z(e), equality of higher quantum normals, or permission to differentiate (3) as a generic identity. The audit retains nonzero individual normal defects of that false replacement. There is also a specified eigenkernel lift. With h_s(q) the ACTUAL normalized generic descendants in the adapter theorem, put O_e^h=(T_1-q T_-1)diag(h_s(q)), q=q0 exp(epsilon). Both its bands lie in the same generic descendant family, so C_e(O_e^h)=lambda(e)O_e^h exactly and lambda(0)=z_0. Using its own actual coherent normalization in (7) therefore gives the same first trace normal. This option changes the generic boundary germ; no ordinary coupon or bare mark is silently substituted. The finite q0 in (2) is essential, not a disposable phase. Exactly O_N=(1+q0)/2 (T_1-T_-1) +(1-q0)/2 (T_1+T_-1). (8) Without it, the coherent normalization would be (1-t)^d-t^d, which is exponentially small in the interior and zero at t=1/2. The actual O(1/N) normalization comes from the retained quantum coefficient. Endpoint terms in (2) also remain exact. ## 3. The actual routed momentum and its logarithmic form This section concerns the proved regular geometric chart of the certified complete source. Its local nonzero amplitude and framing form are those of the [source Ward density theorem](actual_augmented_plat_framing_density_source_ward.md). No geometric assertion for an arbitrary algebraic channel is inferred. Write A'=A U^-1 and B'=U B. The inserted head is literally the FIRST physical slot at this new level, so its lower-prefix adapter is the identity. Its meridian is the ACTUAL Hurwitz-transformed meridian, not the old unbraided selected-wire matrix. Inserting E_(l+1,l) changes the first exposed output by +1 and the A'-side input by +1. The original boundary generating form gives +Log p_cut-Log p_e. The coherent row used here has p_cut=1. Thus the two actual local principal ratios are T_1 : p_e^-1, T_-1 : p_e. (9) This is the same bounded-band source calculation as [the physical port theorem, Section 6](actual_two_cut_framing_port_reconstruction.md), now with the route and its physical prefix explicitly fixed. For completeness a suitable noncommuting first-slot route exists in the certified complete-circle source. Choose a slice entering an actual circle box. Its two main meridians A,B have Tr A=Tr B=Tr BA=-2. They cannot both fix reference infinity: two upper triangular trace-minus-two parabolics have product trace +2. The positive route R_1...R_j makes its new first meridian V_j^-1 mu_j V_j, V_j=mu_(j-1)...mu_1, by the actual Hurwitz rule. If every routed candidate fixed infinity, induction would make every original mu_j upper triangular, a contradiction. Thus some recorded route has nonzero lower-left entry. This uses the original reference, main component and complete-circle geometry, not a free reframing. In the same trace-two parabolic normalization as the port theorem, write that routed meridian and the cut frame as mu_e=I+c[[b,-b^2],[1,-b]], c!=0, F(r,s)=[[r,1-r],[s,-s]], s!=0, R=r-sb, A_cut=(1+s)^-1. Directly conjugating by F gives p_e=(R-1)/R, k-1=(c/s)R(1-R). (10) On its regular chart R!=0,1 and k-1!=0, the underlying original marked scalar density is Omega_src=(c_D/s) dr wedge dLog A_cut, c_D!=0. (11) The factor c_D is independent of the framing point; the original marked source and transverse Gaussian normalization is in it. The full channel Gaussian, when included under its proved hypotheses, changes it by its retained nonzero factor, not an assigned unit. That original marked row has entries 1/N, whereas (6) uses beta_a(t). Thus the literal new source retains the base weight B_(N,t)(a)=N beta_a(t)/kappa_N(t). (11a) It multiplies the corresponding two band densities. It is not globally absorbed into the framing-constant c_D: beta_a has its own coherent action as the first cut varies. At a legitimate first-cut localization one instead retains its ACTUAL nonzero local Gaussian factor. The following rational-form calculations concern (11) times the odd symbol; the full coherent source additionally keeps (11a), or that localized factor, and its original first-cut cycle. The q-retained combination of the two classical ratios is exactly p_e^-1-q0 p_e=(1-q0)+1/(R-1)+q0/R. (12) At fixed s its product with the residual one-form c_D dr/s has primitive (c_D/s)[(1-q0)r+Log(R-1)+q0 Log R]. (13) Its residues at R=1, R=0 and r=infinity are respectively c_D/s, q0 c_D/s and -(1+q0)c_D/s. On a FIXED first-cut fiber the coherent base weight is independent of r, so it multiplies all three residues unchanged; after a proved first-cut Gaussian the retained factor does the same. These are local meromorphic-form residues. They do not assert that the original period surrounds any of those divisors with a nonzero relative coefficient. There is an exact noncancellation check for a SPECIFIED sample of this underlying residue. Use the canonical half-index clocks A_a=q0 Q0^a, s_a=A_a^-1-1, Q0=q0^2, 0<=a<=d, G_N(t)=sum_a beta_a(t)/s_a. (13a) None of the s_a is zero. Since |A_a|=1 and A_a!=1, Re[A_a/(1-A_a)]=-1/2. Thus for every real 0<=t<=1, Re G_N(t)=-1/2, |G_N(t)|>=1/2. At t=1/2 the exact pairing a with d-a has A_(d-a)=A_a^-1 and equal beta weights, so G_N(1/2)=-1/2 exactly at both parities. Retaining the base co-source and its original 1/N averaging explicitly, the sampled fiber residue is (1/N)sum_a [N beta_a(t)/kappa_N(t)] *[-(1+q0)c_D/s_a] =-(1+q0)c_D G_N(t)/kappa_N(t)!=0. (13b) This is a finite algebraic sample of the UNDERLYING meromorphic form. It is not an identification with the actual quantum period's residue, its first-cut pushforward, or a uniform packet outside a fixed chart. At fixed framing point q0 tends to one. Put s2=k-1. Equations (10)--(11) give the leading odd form exactly as (p_e^-1-p_e)Omega_src =c_D ds wedge ds2/[(1+s)s s2]. (14) The UNDERLYING form (14) has double logarithmic residue c_D!=0 at s=s2=0, in the displayed order. This is not automatically the full coherent-weighted residue there: (11a) varies with the base clock, and an interior coherent localization is a different operation. Equivalently the physical two-position deck exchanges p_e and p_e^-1; its odd density times this odd observable is the nonzero deck-EVEN form (14). This is a statement about the specified leading form. A formal two-sheet trace cancels an odd-density part only when the actual two-sheet pushforward with its orientations is being taken; it is not automatically the original global cycle. ## 4. What this replacement does and does not settle Equation (3) closes the source-preservation gap left in Section 7 of the older port theorem: the q-weighted odd observable is now an EXACT normalized source for the unchanged scalar. It does not replace the relative cycle by a field trace or determine its winding. The original two support cycles, their marked orientations and every endpoint term in (6) are still required in that comparison. There is a separate uniformity issue at the resonant boundary. For r=N rho, with rho bounded away from zero and s,b bounded, the RATIONAL expression (12) has p_e^-1-q0 p_e=(2/rho-pi i)/N+O(N^-2), (p_e^-1-q0 p_e)/kappa_N -> 1+2i/(pi rho) (15) for an interior real coherent t. Here both parts of (8) have the SAME order. Separate O(1/N) errors in the two actual quantum band packets can alter the normalized limit (15). Consequently (15) is classical-symbol data, not a proved uniform quantum boundary-period kernel. A source-level joint expansion with sufficient cancellation control remains necessary there. Finally this complete-source identity supplies neither a nonzero mixed-color packet nor a global contributing-cycle theorem for long fillings. Its exact finite algebra is uniform in fixed width; its geometric residue has the stated certified complete-source scope. ## Validation The [focused original-source audit](../experiments/audit_actual_source_preserving_odd_framing_period.py) and its [results](../experiments/actual_source_preserving_odd_framing_period_results.json) check 22 actual original/routed sources, including rectangular cuts: 200 root odd entries, 188 literal band terms, 22 whole first normals and 400 generic eigenkernel jet entries. Twenty literal boundary normal defects are nonzero, confirming the stated distinction. Independent symbolic calculations check all four physical Gauss entries, the q decomposition and primitive, three one-form residues, the oriented doublelog form and residue, and the two CLASSICAL boundary limits. At 80 digits, 315 all-level/both-parity normalization checks reproduce (4), with maximum identity error 2.11e-81. The expanded audit also checks the exact inverse-clock residue identity, 315 specified coherent residue samples and 63 symmetric t=1/2 samples; the largest real-part error is 2.02e-77. These samples retain the stated underlying-form scope. The statement concerns the genuine first trace normal and the underlying forms in (13a,b), with the coherent base weight retained. The half-index sampling corollary has only the stated limited domain.

title: The actual source cannot descend by a raw finite critical-algebra quotient
text: # The actual source cannot descend by a raw finite critical-algebra quotient 28 October 2026. There is a precise algebraic obstruction to using the new exact sewing as an exact multiplicative quotient onto a fixed geometric critical algebra while retaining every coupon. The original cut pairing is faithful. Moreover an insertion which vanishes on the geometric critical scheme can still have the FULL volume exponent in an actual hyperbolic-knot period. The latter is proved below for the original figure-eight source: its geometric polynomial p(Z)=Z^2-Z+1 has N * mu_N(p(Z)p(Z^-1))/K_N -> 2pi sqrt(3). (1) Thus the critical relation costs a power of N, not a smaller exponential action. This changes the needed construction: a geometric critical algebra must arise through a specified formal or derived reduction with Gaussian counterterms and source degree, rather than by an exact raw source-preserving algebra quotient or by discarding all insertions of smaller exponential order. ## 1. A perfect cut excludes every proper exact algebra quotient Let C be a finite algebra over a field and let tau:C->k have nondegenerate pairing (x,y)->tau(xy). If an algebra quotient pi:C->A carries the same co-source, tau=lambda pi, then pi is injective. Indeed for x in ker pi and every y in C, tau(xy)=lambda(pi(x)pi(y))=0, and nondegeneracy gives x=0. The same proof works over a ring when the displayed pairing is perfect. The [actual projective cut theorem](integral_projective_cut_duality.md) applies this hypothesis to C_(b,R)=End_(E,F,K)(V_M^(tensor b)), R=k[[M-1]], tau=d_N(M) times the original pivotal first cut. Its pairing is perfect over R and on the complete fibre, with rank N^(2b-3) for b>=2. Thus there is no proper exact quotient of this full coupon algebra through which that whole source factors. Exact sewing and basis changes do not alter the conclusion, since they retain the original cut. The statement also survives the normal direction. Modulo u^(J+1), u=M-1, the R-linear trace pairing remains perfect. Even the scalar top-normal co-source lambda_J(c)=[u^J]tau(c) has nondegenerate k-pairing lambda_J(cd): choose the lowest nonzero u coefficient of c, pair it nontrivially by tau's special-fibre perfect form, and multiply the other input by the complementary power of u. Hence an exact algebra quotient preserving this co-source and all normal coupon products is again injective. Retaining divided sources does not justify semisimplifying their algebra. This excludes a SPECIFIC strong construction. It does not exclude a derived pushforward, a source-compatible corner or restricted insertion algebra, or an action-normalized associated graded. Such constructions must state which operations and currents they retain. Boundary Ward homotopies need not be algebra quotients. ## 2. An actual complete-colour nilpotent source survives There is a small exact model inside the original crossing. At N=2 take q=i, Q=-1, x=i in the original balanced frame: K=diag(i,-i), F=[[0,0],[2,0]], E=[[0,1/2],[0,0]]. Use the original coproduct and normalized Casimir Omega. On two heads it is exactly Omega=[[0,0,0,0], [0,4i,-4,0], [0,-4,-4i,0], [0,0,0,0]], Omega^2=0, Omega!=0. The full two-head centralizer is k[Omega], of dimension two. With the original averaged first-cut Phi and closed pivot (-i,i), direct contraction gives Phi(1)=0, Phi(Omega)=-4, Gram_(1,Omega)(Phi(xy))=[[0,-4],[-4,0]]. (2) Multiplying by the original modified dimension d_2(1)=i/2 retains perfection and makes the offdiagonal entries -2i. The reduced classical Casimir point Omega=0 forgets exactly the nonzero source in (2). For the normalized actual crossing R_0=1+(i/4)Omega one has Phi(R_0)=-i. Its nilpotent term is essential, even though all characters of k[Omega] send it to zero. This persists in a full original hyperbolic-knot check. On three heads form the original figure-eight word W=R_(1)^+ R_(2)^- R_(1)^+ R_(2)^- in its operator-action order. Its writhe is zero, so the crossings' common Cartan factors cancel. With both original closed pivots and the original first-cut average, exactly Phi_3(W)=5, Phi_3(1)=0. (3) Replacing each local crossing by its value at Omega_i=0 would give zero instead of five. This replacement is not a proved algebra map of the global word; (3) shows precisely why that local-character substitution cannot represent the original source. No arbitrary source or renormalized model was introduced. There is a second exact local-to-global warning. At every N, Tr(g)=0 for the complete-colour pivot. Therefore, for an actual local coupon X, Phi_(b+1)(X tensor I)=Phi_b(X) Tr(g)=0. (4) A nonzero local sourced class can be killed by the original global pivotal closure. Nonzero local sine jumps, nonzero Fourier coefficients or nonzero local radial symbols do not by themselves imply a nonzero global geometric image. ## 3. The exact original figure-eight insertion algebra has rank N Use its proved [whole-source identity](figure_eight_whole_source_identity.md): K_N=sum_(n=0)^(N-1)w_(N,n), w_(N,n)=|(Q_N;Q_N)_n|^2>0. On this EXACT reduced whole-source expression retain the literal insertion Z=Q_N^n. Define mu_N(f)=sum_n w_(N,n) f(Q_N^n), A_N=C[Z,Z^-1]/(Z^N-1). (5) No change of the unweighted period is made: mu_N(1)=K_N. Every weight in (5) is nonzero. Root evaluation identifies A_N with C^N and its pairing mu_N(fg) with a diagonal pairing whose entries are those weights. It is nondegenerate. Consequently Section 1 applies: no proper multiplicative quotient of A_N retains all these literal inserted moments. In particular no quotient of uniformly bounded rank can do so. This remains true if the proposed relation has N-dependent coefficients. If mu_N(p q)=0 for every Laurent polynomial q, then p(Q_N^n)=0 for every n. Its representative in A_N is zero, or equivalently p is divisible by Z^N-1. For degrees less than N a nonzero relation is impossible. This is an exact whole hyperbolic-knot source calculation, stronger than checking an unrelated identity insertion or changing a normalized source functional. It does not assert that (5) is already the geometric critical observable of a different polarization. ## 4. The geometric relation retains the full exponent Let p(Z)=Z^2-Z+1. Its two roots are the complete regular ideal shapes. The actual positive source has its unique bulk maximum at x_*=5/6, Z_*=exp(5pi*i/3), also a root of p. Nevertheless mu_N(p(Z)p(Z^-1))>0 (6) at every N, and its exponential rate is the SAME as K_N. Since p has real coefficients and |Z|=1, the insertion in (6) is |p(Z)|^2=(2cos(2pi*n/N)-1)^2. Here is a quantitative proof. Put Phi(x)=integral_0^x Log(4sin^2(pi*t))dt, lambda=-Phi''(5/6)=2pi sqrt(3). The endpoint-aware factorial estimate gives the uniform central expansion w_(N,n)=2N sin(pi*x) exp(N Phi(x))(1+O(1/N)), x=n/N, on every compact subinterval of (0,1). Away from x_* the already proved strict maximum gives an exponential gap. Under xi=sqrt(N)(x-x_*), the normalized sums therefore converge, including their second moments, to the real Gaussian of variance 1/lambda. This follows directly by Taylor expansion, a Gaussian bound on a fixed central neighborhood, and the outside exponential estimate. For g(x)=|p(exp(2pi*i*x))|^2, g(x_*)=g'(x_*)=0, g''(x_*)/2=12pi^2. Thus discrete Laplace evaluation gives the exact limit N mu_N(g)/K_N ->12pi^2/lambda=2pi sqrt(3). (7) In particular lim N^-1 Log mu_N(g)=Vol(4_1)/(2pi), although g belongs to the ideal of the geometric critical polynomial. A vanishing of finite order at the saddle loses only powers of N. The same argument gives the full exponent for every fixed nonzero polynomial insertion |f(Z)|^2, even when it vanishes at Z_*. Therefore an associated graded which discards ONLY smaller exponential rates cannot impose p(Z)=0 while retaining this source. The ordinary semiclassical H-adic leading symbol does impose that relation, but its next Gaussian contractions and normal/divided co-source remain necessary: (7) records one of the terms it would otherwise erase. Here H=Log Q is the quantum semiclassical direction; it is not the distinct meridian normal U-1. A source comparison must retain both rather than identify their filtrations. ## 5. A constructive exact current module in the SAME original source The correct relation can be exhibited without guessing a critical quotient or dividing by the unknown scalar. Put A(Z)=2-Z-Z^-1=(1-Z)(1-Z^-1), S_Q f(Z)=f(QZ), B_Q=A(QZ) S_Q. The actual weights in (5) satisfy w_(n+1)=A(Q^(n+1))w_n, w_0=1, w_N=0. Consequently telescoping the original finite sum gives, for every Laurent polynomial insertion f, EXACTLY mu_N((I-B_Q)f)=f(1). (8) The endpoint value on the right is compulsory. For example the left side for f=1 is one, rather than zero. This is an affine q-difference/Green identity with the original endpoint source, not an ideal relation for the multiplication algebra. There is also a unique completely algebraic realization. On the finite clock A_N one has S_Q^N=I and B_Q^N=product_(l=1)^N A(Q^l Z) =(1-Z^N)(1-Z^-N)=0. It follows that mu_N=ev_(Z=1)(I-B_Q)^-1 =ev_(Z=1)sum_(k=0)^(N-1)B_Q^k. (9) Evaluation of the k-th term is exactly w_k f(Q^k), proving that (9) uses the original period, not an adapter normalized by K_N. Equation (8) uniquely determines this functional. At the classical limit Q=1 its operator has multiplication symbol 1-A(Z)=Z+Z^-1-1=p(Z)/Z. (10) Thus the finite geometric algebra really does appear, but as the principal symbol of a sourced DIFFERENCE OPERATOR. Away from the root set Q=exp(H). Its next formal term contains the Euler derivative, so integration by parts produces higher Gaussian contractions. It is precisely those terms that make (7) compatible with the classical critical relation (10). Equations (8)--(10) supply an actual nonzero affine source object with fixed operator data and exact endpoint pointing. They do not prove a general geometric trace descent. They show concretely which category permits the desired reduction: relative twisted difference/de Rham cohomology, with its boundary current, rather than the raw multiplicative algebra. ## 6. The resulting next construction target The irreducible trace nonvanishing theorem requires an ACTUAL descended critical algebra and source. The exact sewing and its regularized periods do not yield it by taking a raw multiplicative quotient: Sections 1--3 forbid that operation on the full faithful source objects. Taking the final matrix Ward cohomology first instead leaves only its scalar pointed line, rather than a new nontrivial geometric field action. The appropriate test is therefore on the partly integrated weighted/current module, BEFORE final scalar Ward closure: construct its action-normalized formal or derived critical observable, with the required Gaussian counterterms, and map the original relative sewing and meridian-normal co-source through that reduction. A literal flow observable need not satisfy its critical polynomial there; (7) shows the required counterterms are already visible at order 1/N. The existing [formal insertion construction](actual_pointed_commutant_and_critical_observable.md) provides such a renormalized critical observable on the transverse FORMAL block. The still-missing step is its source-compatible whole/derived realization from the exact sewn period. This is a sharper requirement than finding another local nonzero unit. The lemma and original-source calculations above do not prove that realization, but rule out two tempting constructions and specify which source information it must retain. [Exact source and scaling audit](../experiments/audit_actual_source_quotient_critical_relation.py) and [saved results](../experiments/actual_source_quotient_critical_relation_results.json).

title: The actual multi-leg source has no nonzero two-sided null ideal
text: # The actual multi-leg source has no nonzero two-sided null ideal Research proof, 27 October 2026. For three or more strands, the original pivotal highest-input source on the FULL Borel-relative word algebra does not factor through any proper algebra quotient. Every path coefficient can be detected after actual relative matrix coupons. For two strands its maximal null ideal is instead explicit, and the minimal algebra quotient is the triangular path algebra of a line. This is a boundary on algebraic reductions of the entire relative algebra, not an obstruction to a linear relative-period transform, a current-complex quotient, a singular geometric comparison, or a quotient of a smaller actual-word/observable algebra. In particular it does not disprove the volume conjecture. It specifies what a source-preserving attempt to discard the nilpotent shell would need to avoid. ## 1. The actual algebra and the relevant notion of source quotient Fix an original root Q of order N>=2. Let A_0=<H,f | H^N=1, Hf=Q^-1 fH, f^N=0>, z_(a,j)=f^a e_j, 0<=a,j<N. The exact multiplication is the one in [the actual Borel fusion theorem](actual_borel_regular_fusion_and_divided_cap_period.md). Think of z_(a,j) as an oriented path of length a starting at j and ending at j+a modulo N. A product whose total length is at least N is zero. On b strands that theorem identifies the actual tensor module with a free LEFT A_0 module of rank r=N^(b-2). Consequently the full Borel-relative endomorphism algebra is B_b=Mat_r(A_0^op). The original source is the actual pivotal partial trace on all but the first strand, followed by first input e_0 and output ell=ones^t. In coefficient form write Psi(T)=sum_(t,s) Lambda_(t,s)(a_(t,s)). (1) Here T_(t,s)=R_(a_(t,s)) acts by right multiplication in the regular algebra. All original external factors may be included or retained externally. At a regular complete fiber they are nonzero, so they do not change any null ideal below. Define the maximal two-sided source-null ideal by I_Psi={T : Psi(U T V)=0 for every U,V in B_b}. (2) It is the largest two-sided ideal contained in ker(Psi). If an algebra homomorphism pi:B_b->C preserves the source, meaning Psi=lambda composed with pi, then ker(pi) is contained in (2). This formulation does not assume that an arbitrary geometric relative-period map is an algebra homomorphism. ## 2. Literal physical top rows detect all residue classes Use the original full fusion basis, not the later tail-head decomposition. Its tail labels are s=(s_3,...,s_b), 0<=s_i<N. The seed associated with f^a e_k in copy s is f_total^a(e_0 tensor e_(k-sum(s) mod N) tensor e_s). Let X=product_i x_i be the product of the actual highest K roots. The source of the diagonal relative top path is exactly Lambda_(s,s)(f^(N-1)e_k) =gamma_s delta_(k,sum(s) mod N), gamma_s=N X^(1-N) Q^(1-sum(s)), gamma_s!=0. (3) This is a direct physical cap calculation. Returning every tail output to its input s forces zero lowering steps on those legs. For the remaining N-1 steps to return the second output to the required pivotal index, all of them must go to the second leg, whose initial index must be zero. Thus k=sum(s) modulo N; any other k would require N first-leg lowering steps, impossible in total degree N-1. The coefficient of the second-leg steps is F_(N-1)=N, and their K_1 inverses supply x_1^(1-N). The second pivotal entry contributes x_2^(1-N)Q, while the tail pivots contribute product_(i>=3) x_i^(1-N)Q^-sum(s). This is (3). The all-ones first output row remains the actual one; only its zero-index entry occurs in this particular top-row calculation. No normalized trace or geometric co-source is substituted. ## 3. For b>=3, no relative algebra ideal can be discarded **Theorem.** For b>=3, I_Psi=0. Take a nonzero element T of a two-sided ideal I in B_b. Some coefficient a_(t,s) has a nonzero coefficient c of f^a e_j. Relative matrix units first move that entry to any chosen diagonal copy; left/right coefficient idempotents isolate it, because e_(j+a) a_(t,s) e_j=c f^a e_j. (4) Only one degree between zero and N-1 has that start and endpoint. Multiplication by f^(N-1-a) then gives f^(N-1-a) [c f^a e_j]=c f^(N-1)e_j. (5) All these operations are allowed relative matrix coupons, so the result stays in I. For b>=3 choose a diagonal tail copy u with sum(u)=j modulo N, for instance u_3=j and all later u_i=0. Equation (3) evaluates the resulting element to c gamma_u!=0. Thus no nonzero ideal is contained in ker(Psi), proving the theorem. The coefficient algebra is opposite to physical operator composition; this only exchanges which of the two matrix-coupon sides realizes the left or right coefficient factor in (4)-(5). Both sides are available in (2), so no commutativity assumption enters the proof. In particular ANY source-preserving algebra quotient of B_b is injective. This includes nilpotent ideals: the entire radical cannot be removed, nor can a nonzero subideal of it. The result is stronger than an example of one nonzero radical contribution. It does not say Psi(UT) alone is a nondegenerate bilinear pairing; the proof uses both coupon sides. Nor does it say that every relative coupon is an actual braid word or commutes with the full quantum-group E action. The algebra in the theorem is the full actual Borel commutant furnished by fusion. A reduction on a strictly smaller operator algebra needs its own analysis. ## 4. The two-leg contrast: the exact quotient is triangular For b=2, the actual cap is Lambda(f^a e_k)=x_2^(1-N) x_1^-a Q^-(k+a) F_(k+a)/F_k, if k+a<N, 0, if k+a>=N. (6) Define the wrapped-path span I_cut=span{f^a e_k : k+a>=N}. (7) It is a two-sided ideal: further path concatenation cannot undo crossing the cut from N-1 to zero, and paths of total length at least N vanish. The source (6) kills it. Conversely every nonwrapped path has a nonzero source value, and the two endpoint idempotents isolate its coefficient as in (4). Thus no larger two-sided ideal lies in the source kernel, so I_Lambda=I_cut, dim I_cut=N(N-1)/2. (8) The quotient is the lower triangular N-by-N matrix algebra under f^a e_k -> E_(k+a,k) if k+a<N, and zero otherwise. This respects the path multiplication and gives all triangular matrix units. Its dimension is N(N+1)/2. In these coordinates the original cap is the matrix coefficient Lambda(T)=x_2^(1-N) r^t T c, r_i=x_1^-i Q^-i F_i, c_k=x_1^k/F_k. (9) Every r_i and c_k is nonzero. The effective triangular nilpotence length still grows with N. Its existence does not provide a bounded-rank critical algebra or a subexponential coefficient bound. The b>=3 theorem explains why one cannot apply this two-leg quotient independently to intermediate diagonal blocks of a multi-strand word. Off-diagonal tail transitions expose all cyclic residue classes before the final selected contraction. Only the completed word may be passed to the diagonal-source formula of [the all-strand Euler/Cauchy theorem](all_strand_euler_cauchy_cap.md). ## 5. Consequence for the geometric comparison The exact endpoint functional is a tractable finite linear source, but its full algebra source does not descend to a smaller algebra by deleting a null ideal once b>=3. A fixed geometric critical algebra cannot be obtained as such a quotient of B_b while retaining all sourced relative matrix coupons. Morita equivalence may remove the matrix factor, but A_0 still has N simple modules and Loewy length N, so it is not Morita equivalent to one fixed finite etale critical algebra as N grows. This specifies the kind of comparison still available: a linear relative-period or current-complex map, a separately constructed singular/nonlocal transform, or a restriction to an actual smaller meridian/word algebra with a proved invariant source quotient. Zero-source linear current spaces need not be ideals, so they are not excluded by the theorem. The result does not establish a nonzero selected geometric class or a volume norm. ## 6. Exact checks [The audit](../experiments/audit_actual_source_two_sided_quotient.py) and its [saved results](../experiments/actual_source_two_sided_quotient_results.json) check (3) against the literal original physical source after the actual coproduct fusion for braid indices three and four. They also check all relative matrix-basis coefficient recovery certificates in (4)-(5), and the two-leg wrapped ideal at levels two through eight. The proof above is all-level and does not depend on a finite rank fit or on an assertion about untested knots. The full Borel commutant and the algebra generated by the actual quantum words are different objects. The conclusion uses the latter as specified.

title: An exact spectral total derivative for the original root source
status: Exact full-Hermite spectral derivative; global estimate open
text: # An exact spectral total derivative for the original root source , 31 October 2026. This is an exact fixed-root identity for the original pair Casimir, retaining its simple and repeated spectral nodes. No contour deformation or uniform exponential estimate is asserted. Put N>=3,d=N-1,q=exp(pi i/N). Let chi(z)=2T_N(z/2)+2, and let Omega be the ACTUAL pair Casimir from the [original source theorem](actual_homogeneous_casimir_face_source.md). Define its polynomial resolvent numerator V(z)=chi(z)(z-Omega)^(-1). This is the unique degree-(N-1) matrix polynomial supplied by polynomial division and chi(Omega)=0. It is not the determinant adjugate of the full N^2-dimensional matrix. At a paired c=2cos(phi), its resolvent is (z-Omega)^(-1)=P/(z-c)+Q/(z-c)^2+regular. Write h(z)=chi(z)/(z-c)^2 locally. The Chebyshev ODE gives h(c)=N^2/(4-c^2), h'(c)/h(c)=c/(4-c^2). Consequently Q=V(c)/h(c) and P=V'(c)/h(c)-h'(c)V(c)/h(c)^2. With Qhat(z)=(4-z^2)V(z)/N^2 this is Q=Qhat(c), P=Qhat'(c)+c Qhat(c)/(4-c^2). For any function f holomorphic at the spectral nodes, therefore, f(c)P+f'(c)Q =[(4-c^2)(fV)'(c)-c f(c)V(c)]/N^2 =-d_phi[2sin(phi) f(2cos(phi))V(2cos(phi))/N^2]. (1) When N is odd, the simple node is c=-2, chi'(-2)=N^2, and the right side of (1) at phi=pi is 2f(-2)P_*. Thus the original simple term has exactly one half of that derivative. Each paired node occurs twice in the full odd-angle grid and the derivatives are equal there. The exact original operator is accordingly f(Omega)=-1/2 sum_(k=0)^(N-1) B_f'(phi_k), B_f(phi)=2sin(phi) f(2cos(phi))V(2cos(phi))/N^2, phi_k=(2k+1)pi/N. (2) No cyclic physical head is introduced: the cyclic variable in (2) is the spectral parameter, with the original projector multiplicities. For R^n use its [exact full-Hermite Gaussian](actual_direct_long_power_source.md) f(2cos(phi))=q^(n d^2/4) exp[-n(phi-pi)^2/(2hbar)], hbar=2pi i/N, 0<=phi<=2pi. On this interval B_f has equal zero endpoint values and equal first derivatives. Its second derivatives can differ at the endpoints, reflecting the K-cut at z=2. Thus its periodic extension is C^1, but endpoint currents must be retained in further integration by parts. In particular the zero Fourier integral of -B_f' is exactly zero. With Fourier convention hat B(j)=(2pi)^(-1)int_0^(2pi) B(phi)e^(-ijphi)dphi, the finite midpoint formula gives the convergent fixed-N identity f(Omega)=-(iN^2/2)sum_(ell in Z) ell (-1)^ell hat B(Nell). (3) The ell=0 term is zero. For each fixed N,n the sum is absolutely convergent: periodic B is C^1 with piecewise smooth higher derivatives, so hat B(j)=O(j^-3). Constants here may depend exponentially on N; this observation gives no uniform global bound. Formula (3) is an alternative exact source period, closely related to the existing [Fourier-Hermite Gaussian formulas](actual_coherent_filling_gaussian_chirp.md). It does not erase their endpoint currents or determine which nonzero charge contributes after sewing. ## Why complete-channel samples do not control the derivative At a paired node, L_N(c)=0 and L_N'(c)=(-1)^(N-1)N/(2sin^2(phi)). Hence its complete sector equals L_N'(c)Q=(-1)^(N-1)2V(c)/N. The complete positive packet therefore controls V(c), whereas V'(c) also carries the independent semisimple projector P. The simplest illustration is a diagonal coefficient on the face boundary x=y=0: Omega is diagonal there, so at a paired eigenvalue c its entry V(z)=chi(z)/(z-c) vanishes at z=c, but V'(c)=chi''(c)/2 is nonzero. At even N every spectral node is paired, so all corresponding complete diagonal samples vanish while the semisimple derivatives reconstruct the identity. This example concerns the ACTUAL local polynomial specialization, not a freely chosen off-grid interpolation. Thus the proved exponential interpolation of complete packet values cannot simply be differentiated to estimate (2) or (3). A bound on the original polynomial resolvent numerator between nodes, including its semisimple derivative and the retained endpoint charges, is an additional input. No claim that such a bound is impossible is made. ## Exact link to the retained physical colors Polynomial division of the Chebyshev identity gives, in the SAME original Casimir quotient, V(z)=U_(N-1)(Omega/2) +2sum_(h=1)^(N-1)T_(N-h)(z/2)U_(h-1)(Omega/2) =(-1)^d L_N +2sum_(h=1)^(N-1)(-1)^(h-1)T_(N-h)(z/2)L_h. (4) One proof starts from [T_N(x)-T_N(y)]/(x-y)=U_(N-1)(y) +2sum_(h=1)^(N-1)T_(N-h)(x)U_(h-1)(y), then substitutes x=z/2,y=Omega/2 and T_N(Omega/2)=-1. The scalar polynomial identity also follows immediately by induction in N using the two Chebyshev recurrences. It was checked exactly for N=2,...,14 before recording it here. The homogeneous source and every actual exterior functional preserve (4) by linearity. Thus controlling the original off-node numerator means controlling a SPECIFIED coherent combination of all physical colors, with their signs. It is not determined by the complete packet alone. On the other hand a bound on this coherent combination could be sharper than bounds on its separate colors, so (4) is not a no-go statement for a phase-preserving resolvent method. ## Validation and scope The [focused audit](../experiments/audit_actual_spectral_total_derivative_source.py) uses the original coproduct Casimir and independently built signed R matrices. It checks all monomials through degree N-1 and powers n=+/-1,...,+/-5 at N=3,...,8, including both parity conventions. The divided-Chebyshev identity is also checked symbolically at N=2,...,14. [Results](../experiments/actual_spectral_total_derivative_source_results.json) record finite identities; they assert no uniform Fourier constants. The theorem is at a fixed root of unity. It does not establish a uniform Fourier estimate or select a contributing cycle.

title: The geometric longitude for strict Conway trees
status: Preferred geometric longitude and selected classical factor for strict long fillings
text: # The geometric longitude for strict Conway trees A product junction without a crossing circle can be treated geometrically by inserting a circle around a zero-crossing two-strand box. Filling that new circle along its meridian removes it and restores the same ordered tangle. The new circle supplies an angular variable whose stationary elimination recovers the original product action exactly. This note uses that construction to identify the full preferred longitude selected by the strict-tree action, including junctions of arbitrary valence and adjacency. The proof keeps the original peripheral paths and also covers the possible physical edge label \(x=1/2\), where an individual edge quadratic has a double root. ## The theorem and its geometric conventions Use a fixed strict ordered Conway construction from the [strict-tree theorem](actual_conway_all_strict_tree_long_twist_volume.md). The elementary twist pieces are joined by their prescribed ordered products and physical quarter-turns, then closed by the original cylindrical matching. After the forced final product is removed, strictness means that the real angle domain contains a point with \[ 0<a_i<\tfrac12,\qquad \max(u,v)<w<u+v<1 \tag{T1} \] at each original leaf and each retained binary product. A *bare junction* is a maximal group of consecutive products that contains no crossing-circle operator. Any binary association used to calculate it is retained only as an internal resolution; it does not create additional physical turns. Require the original strand pairing to give one knot, counting any circles already closed inside intermediate tangles. Keep all original parity qualifications. In the two-leaf case retain the original pure-leaf qualification; the two-odd pairing is a link and is excluded by the knot test. The construction and the independently signed twist powers \(n_i\) are fixed before the quantum level varies. Assume those powers are sufficiently long for the existing marked strict-tree filling theorem. A *meridian* goes once around a strand. The *preferred longitude* follows the knot once and has zero linking number with it. Holonomy assigns a Möbius transformation to each based closed path in the complement. We use determinant-one matrix lifts; \(M\) is the eigenvalue of the positively oriented main meridian, and \(L\) is the eigenvalue of the preferred longitude on the same line. The source cut selects the other, \(M^{-1}\), eigenline, so \(L\) is the inverse longitude eigenvalue on that selected line. Let \(\mathcal E_T\) be the original physical quarter-turn edges of the reduced junction tree. On edge \(e\), \(x_e\) is the normalized polynomial index shared by its two ends after the trace pairing. When that incidence is exposed as the ordinary output of the rooted branch, the output angle is \(1-x_e\). The original ordered construction fixes this convention. Put \(X_e=e^{2\pi ix_e}\). **Theorem.** For every such fixed construction, sufficiently long independent signed twists give the original complete hyperbolic knot complement and its regular geometric meridian germ. On that germ, \[ \boxed{\displaystyle L_{\mathrm{geom}}(M) =-M^{a(D)} \prod_{e\in\mathcal E_T} \frac{M^2-X_e(M)}{1-M^2X_e(M)},\qquad a(D)=-w(D)-\sum_i n_i.} \tag{T2} \] Here \(w(D)\) is the oriented writhe of the original filled diagram. The variables \(x_e(M)\) are those of the original strict-tree stationary action, not those of a different knot presentation. More precisely, write \(M=e^{\pi it}\) and let \(\Phi\) be the original joint first-charge phase at \(M=1\). This is the limiting logarithmic action of the finite tangle evaluation, with all primitive filling logarithms retained. Its continued critical point is defined by \[ \Phi_t=\Phi+ \sum_{e\in\mathcal E_T} \{2J(x_e)-J(x_e+t)-J(x_e-t)\} +\frac{\pi i\,a(D)}2t^2, \qquad J'(x)=\log(2\sin\pi x),\quad J(0)=0. \tag{T3} \] The theorem identifies this critical branch with the geometric representation germ of the original filled knot. It identifies more than its cusp tangent. At an auxiliary circle the primitive filling slope is \(\mu_v+p_v\lambda_v\), with original signed crossing power \(n_v=\epsilon_v-2p_v\). The disk longitude has selected eigenvalue \(-Q_v\), hence eigenvalue ratio \(Q_v^2\). A retained half twist means \(\epsilon_v\in\{-1,0,1\}\). These words and flags are kept in the proof.
