This proves (3) without an infinite differential expansion or an analytic translation of Gamma by the small complex number Delta. For the literal translated cycle Gamma+Nb, a change of variables also gives I_(Gamma+Nb)[S]=I_Gamma[S(epsilon,x+Nb)], (4) because the original W is N-periodic. This is an identity of the specified continued source at that translated cycle. It does not say the shifted head values are admissible original states or vanish outside the physical basis. In particular the meromorphic continuation need not vanish at out-of-basis shifted indices. If a geometric deformation from one cycle to the other crosses source divisors, their tubes and residues remain in that deformation. Equations (3),(4) compute the translated period; they do not identify the two cycles in the complement of those divisors. ## 3. The first normal and the original exposed trace normalization Write S=S0+epsilon S1+O(epsilon^2). Formula (3) yields I_(Gamma+Nb)[S0]=chi(b) I_Gamma[S0], I_(Gamma+Nb)[S1]-chi(b) I_Gamma[S1] =chi(b) P' (2pi i)^(-k) integral_Gamma G^-1 D_b(W G) S0 dx. (5) The sign is positive: Delta'=-P' and the adjoint exponential is exp(-Delta D_b). The correction includes derivatives of BOTH W and G. Writing it as W D_b Log(WG) is permissible only as a meromorphic identity; the un-divided density in (5) specifies its actual periods. For the original ordinary exposed-head closure, retain nu_N=2N(-1)^N/(q0-q0^-1), P'/nu_N=(-1)^(N+1) N sin(pi/N)/pi. (6) When the original root closure I_Gamma[S0] is zero, its translated root closure is also zero by (5), so division of the first-normal identity by nu_N gives the exact corresponding marked-period difference. Its correction density has the nonzero order-one scalar in (6), rather than an arbitrarily assigned boundary coefficient. It is not yet a nonzero global geometric contribution. For a primitive direction with several nonzero b_j, D_b differentiates the corresponding original cotangent factors. A chosen degree h need not be a primitive free variable. For h=A0 x_j+B0 at fixed other coordinates, the weight is (pi/A0)cot(pi(h-B0)/A0) dh. The finite-part rules of the boundary theorem apply with that weight. Neither (3) nor (5) replaces it by pi cot(pi h) dh. ## 4. A literal cup exhibits a nonzero double-pole correction For one varying cup argument, its source gauge is g(x)=Y/(1-Y), Y=exp(2pi i x), pi cot(pi x)=-pi i(1+2g(x)). Let w=pi cot(pi x). The correction density in (5) is g^-1 (w g)'=w'+w * 2pi i/(1-Y). (7) At an integer n, with y=x-n, this equals -2/y^2+pi i/y+O(1). Consequently its residue against a root source regular there is pi i S0(n)-2 S0'(n). (8) Both copies of the derivative matter: one comes from the original cotangent and one from the actual cup gauge. For the ordered fixed-L cup with L=d=N-1, the exact fixed-root reflection gives p_d(0,x)=exp(pi i d x/N). On a physical n in [0,d], the difference of its translated and parity-weighted original first-normal cotangent periods is therefore exactly (-1)^d N(N-2) exp(pi i d n/N). (9) This is the ordered channel-cup normalization of the source theorem. For the physical cup, multiply by its original root scalar N q0^(-d^2); its generic scalar derivative cancels from the difference because the corresponding root difference is zero. The translated cup can have a generic pole at n+N. Its cotangent period is the actual Laurent finite part, not its value at that pole. Thus (9) is a concrete counterexample to silently declaring these continued periods periodic. ## 5. Scope of the cycle identity The source connection, the original primitive lattice and the original weight together determine every finite-order correction in (3). The isolated wall residues and source-null ordered periods are already given by the boundary theorem. Their combination supplies exact finite-head transport with its boundary terms retained. What remains separate is a deformation of the FULL original period through all its source divisors to a contributing geometric cycle, including its noncompact ends and the coherent outside contraction. No equality of the positive envelope with volume, no periodic extension of the physical basis, and no nonzero saddle coefficient follows from this adjoint identity. Focused verification: [adjoint and original cup audit](../experiments/audit_actual_tensor_source_translated_cycle_normals.py) and [saved results](../experiments/actual_tensor_source_translated_cycle_normals_results.json). The audit checks 60 exact meromorphic adjoint residues through derivative order three, the actual cotangent double-pole coefficient, and 12 genuine translated first-normal cup finite parts obtained independently from the original moving-Gamma Laurent coefficients. The latter agree with (9) to relative error below 5.3e-38 at 100 digits. These are checks of the retained local periods, not evidence for a global saddle coefficient. The result retains all source and gauge divisors and makes no contributing-cycle assertion. No wrapped physical state or geometric contribution is inferred from the translated normal identities.

title: An open six-head bridge reduces exactly to a typed current and angle packet
text: # An open six-head bridge reduces exactly to a typed current and angle packet 29 October 2026. The first bridge crossing that couples the two ordinary cap pairs of a six-head source can be eliminated as an EXACT map between complete multiplicity modules. The cap forces one physical transfer. All spectator inputs and operator coefficients remain open. The resulting six-head terminal packet is the four-head packet composed with the map below, not a scalar knot-by-knot replacement. The through-head feedback factors into a contractive strict shift and a unitary clock in a source-fixing factorial metric. Its remaining angle coefficient is explicit. It has EXTRA factorial powers, so this does not yet prove the requested reduction to one half-density angle cell or a sharp arbitrary-prefix energy estimate. The actual remaining charge and operator, rather than an unspecified boundary current, are identified in (9)--(12). ## 1. Complete source modules and the physical terminal Use the original principal root N>=2,d=N-1,q=exp(pi*i/N),Q=q^2, x=q^d=-q^-1,F_a=(Q;Q)_a,s_a=|F_a|,kappa=q^(d^2/2). All crossings and turns are literal original physical ones from [the complete source module](actual_complete_source_multiplicity_module.md). In particular ell|a,b>=x^(-a)Q^(-a)/N delta_(a+b,d), p_(a,b)=N x^(-b)delta_(a+b,d). Let W_2=(V^tensor4)_(degree2d), W_1=(V^tensor2)_(degree d), L_0=ell_12 tensor I_34:W_2->W_1. Let I_w:V->V^tensor5 be the COMPLETE intertwiner of w in W_2, and D_2 w=I_w|d>. Define the six-head-source terminal rows by T_n^(6)=(ell_12 ell_34 tensor <d|_5) (I_123 tensor R_45^2) Pi_(4,n) D_2. The last marked cap has already been justified through the whole invariant-tensor source; it is not individually replaced by ell. Let T_n^(4) be the corresponding original three-physical-head terminal on W_1 from [the positive terminal packet](actual_terminal_packet_positive_gram.md). Since the cap ell_12 is a Hopf map, deleting it commutes with every prefix coproduct in the highest/lowest intertwiner. In particular (ell_12 tensor I_345)I_w=I_(L_0 w). It also commutes with the specific terminal R_45^2 and Pi_(4,n). Consequently, for EVERY input column and every adjoining exterior, T_n^(6)=T_n^(4)L_0. (1) Now place ONE actual adjacent signed bridge crossing R_23^epsilon immediately before that terminal. It acts on the middle two physical heads of W_2, so define L_epsilon=L_0 R_23^epsilon:W_2->W_1. The complete source identity becomes T_n^(6) R_23^epsilon=T_n^(4)L_epsilon. (2) This keeps the crossing that couples the eliminated cap to the remaining port. It is not commuted past the cap as an unknown scalar. ## 2. Every entry of the positive open bridge, with the original phases Take an input |a,b,c,e> of integer degree2d. For epsilon=+1 the cap forces the actual transfer and surviving output to be k=d-a-c, u=b-k, output |u,e>, u+e=d, 0<=k<=min(b,d-c). (3) There is exactly ONE original positive crossing coefficient, so (L_+)_(u;(a,b,c,e)) =kappa/N x^(-a-b-c+k)Q^(-a+cu) F_(d-a)F_b/(F_k F_c F_u), (4) with zero outside (3). This follows directly by multiplying the cap with the literal R coefficient. In particular the original common Cartan kappa and cap1/N have not been discarded. The true nonnegative angle charges are a+c+k=d. (5) The through-head relation b=u+k is a SECOND actual constraint; the spectator is e=d-u. Thus the external through degree has not been frozen independently of the angle charge k. Root reflection F_aF_(d-a)=N(-1)^aQ^[a(a+1)/2] rewrites (4) as a phase times F_b/(F_a F_c F_k F_u). This is a closed finite kernel, not a sum of absolute paths. Tensoring an arbitrary spectator space leaves (2)--(5) unchanged. If the input entries are matrices on that space, they multiply this kernel in their original order. No commutation of spectator operators is used. ## 3. The negative bridge and its retained complement charges For epsilon=-1 the literal negative crossing instead forces k=a+c-d, u=b+k, output |u,e>, u+e=d, 0<=k<=min(c,d-b). Its exact full coefficient is (L_-)_(u;(a,b,c,e)) =kappa^(-1)/N (-1)^k x^(b+c-k-a) Q^[-bc-ck+k(k-1)/2-a] F_u F_c/(F_k F_b F_(d-a)). (6) If A=d-a and C=d-c, its nonnegative charges are A+C+k=d, b=u-k. (7) Equations (6)--(7), including their phase, are the actual negative source kernel. They are not obtained by deleting an end channel or assuming a scalar beta identity for noncommuting ports. ## 4. The full feedback is a contractive physical current in a typed metric Use the PHYSICAL diagonal coordinate gauge G_a=s_a/sqrt(N)=L_a^(1/2), tau_a=F_a/s_a. It fixes every original paired cup and ordinary cap because G_aG_(d-a)=1. The full marked source is transported literally; on the assembled invariant source its complementary-degree restriction is the one already proved in the complete module. This is not the different quarter physical gauge or length gauge. For the POSITIVE bridge conjugate input and output heads by G. On the total-degree slices the output pair is complementary, so its product gauge is one. Equation (4) factors EXACTLY as Lhat_+ entry=gamma_(a,c,k) U_(c,k)[u,b], gamma_(a,c,k) =kappa N (-1)^a x^(-d+k) Q^[a(a-1)/2] /(s_a s_c F_a F_c F_k), U_(c,k)|b>=1_(b>=k) x^(-u)Q^(cu) tau_b/tau_u |u>, u=b-k. (8) Every nonzero coefficient of U is a UNIT PHASE and different inputs have different outputs. Hence ||U_(c,k)||_op=1 for k<N. More intrinsically it is the literal strict lowering current G(F^T)^kG^-1, followed by the unitary clock x^(-J)Q^(cJ). The condition u+e=d is a final orthogonal degree projector on the retained head and its untouched spectator; its norm is1. For the NEGATIVE bridge use the dual source-fixing gauge G^-1. With A,C as in (7), its exact factorization is Lhat_- entry=gamma^-_(A,C,k) U^-_(c,k)[u,b], gamma^-_(A,C,k)=kappa^(-1)N(-1)^(k+C)x^(A-C-2k) Q^[C(C+1)/2+k(k-1)/2-a] /(s_A s_C F_A F_C F_k), U^-_(c,k)|b>=1_(b+k<N) x^u Q^(-cu) tau_u/tau_b |u>, u=b+k. (9) This is a unitary clock times the contractive strict raising G^-1 F^k G. No cyclic wrap or transfer alias is added. These typed gauges both fix the original paired turns, but they are different: changing between them across a later overlap retains the actual G^2 interface. It is not declared polynomial. ## 5. What remains after one exact bridge elimination Both scalar factors have the same known magnitude on their actual angle triple, denoted (A,C,k) in the signed typed coordinates: |gamma|=N/(s_A^2 s_C^2 s_k). (10) Thus feedback has been isolated as a contractive operator rather than estimated by an arbitrary exterior norm. But the scalar energy is NOT the single half-density-cell weight w_d(A,C,k): |gamma|^2=N^2/(s_A^4 s_C^4 s_k^2). The extra factorial powers are genuine in the exact kernel. They must be grouped coherently with the subsequent T packet or another physical boundary contraction. Deleting them would change (4),(6). This identifies the specific missing angle-energy comparison; it does not rule out such a further coherent contraction. For completeness the entire open bridge has an exact row Gram in these typed source metrics. Rows have disjoint spectator color e. Therefore Lhat_+ Lhat_+^*=diag(E_+(u)), E_+(u)=N^2 sum_(k=0)^(d-u) s_k^(-2) sum_(A+C=d-k) s_A^(-4)s_C^(-4), E_-(u)=E_+(d-u). (11) Equation (11) retains the actual restriction k<=d-u, or k<=u in the negative orientation. It is not replaced by independent unconstrained tetrahedra or by an ideal-edge angle equation. Most importantly (2) remains the COHERENT composition, so its pointed doubled energy for any vector- or operator-valued input is sum_n ||T_n^(4)L_epsilon w||^2. (12) No diagonal sum of |gamma|^2 paths has been inserted into (12). The [closed all-input terminal kernel](actual_terminal_packet_closed_kernel.md) now makes this remaining operator explicit: each six-head entry is T_(n,u) times (4) or (6), with u=b-k or b+k and u=d-e. Its Newton register t has the ACTUAL bounds t<=min(n,u), and its scalar multiplier is the retained partial factorial Green P_t=F_t^2 sum_(v<=t)Q^v/F_v^2. The associated terminal angle triple is (t,n-t,d-n). These are coupled integer port constraints, not independently adjustable spectator variables or a full ideal-edge sum. The partial Green and its coherent clock/shift ordering are not replaced by a scalar norm when composing (12). By the terminal packet theorem, the row sum factors the original co-source. Consequently H_epsilon=(T^(4)L_epsilon)^*(T^(4)L_epsilon) +exp(-N^2)I is a positive Gram on the complete W_2, and its exact boundary dual norm squared is at most N. The regularizer is negligible for fixed original prefixes by the original physical bound. This polynomial dual cost is independent of the spectator ports. Its sharp energy still requires controlling the full composition (12), including every noncommuting clock/shift interface (8),(9). ### The exact row Gram has a uniform pointed octahedral profile Let Lambda(theta)=-integral_0^theta log(2sin t)dt, and v_8=8Lambda(pi/4). Equation (11) has a quantitative asymptotic UNIFORM in EVERY output color, including u=0 and u=d: log E_+(u)=(N/pi)H(u/N)+O(log N), H(t)=v_8, 0<=t<=1/2, H(t)=8Lambda(pi*t/2)-2Lambda(pi*t), 1/2<=t<=1, log E_-(u)=(N/pi)H(1-u/N)+O(log N). (13) The implicit constant is independent of u. In particular the COMPLETE open bridge, in its indicated signed source metric, obeys log ||Lhat_+||_op^2=log ||Lhat_-||_op^2 =N v_8/pi+O(log N). (14) This is an actual pointed row-capacity formula; it is not obtained by maximizing unconstrained independent tetrahedron weights. Here is a proof including its boundary uniformity. The uniform sine-factorial estimate gives the exponent of a term in (11) as (N/pi)[4Lambda(alpha)+4Lambda(chi)+2Lambda(kappa)] +O(log N), where alpha=pi*A/N, chi=pi*C/N, kappa=pi*k/N. The exact sum is pi*d/N and the actual upper bound is k<=d-u. Replacing d/N by1 changes the maximized exponent by O(log N): Lambda has uniform modulus O(delta*(1+|log delta|)) even at0 and pi. For a fixed limiting kappa, alpha+chi=pi-kappa. The unique maximum is alpha=chi=(pi-kappa)/2. Indeed the second derivative on this interval is proportional to -cot(alpha)-cot(chi)=-sin(alpha+chi)/(sin alpha sin chi)<0. The limiting endpoints follow by continuity. The resulting action is F(kappa)=8Lambda((pi-kappa)/2)+2Lambda(kappa), F'(kappa)=2log cot(kappa/2), F''(kappa)=-(tan(kappa/2)+cot(kappa/2))<0. It peaks at kappa=pi/2, with value v_8. The REAL allowed interval is0<=kappa<=pi*(1-u/N), up to its exact1/N endpoint shift. If u/N<=1/2 it contains the maximum; otherwise its maximum is the upper endpoint. Using Lambda(pi-theta)=-Lambda(theta) gives exactly H in (13). For the discrete lower bound choose k nearest N/2, clipped to 0,...,d-u, and choose A,C differing by at most one with sum d-k. Every coordinate differs from a limiting optimizer by O(1/N), uniformly also when the allowed interval collapses. The modulus of Lambda therefore costs only O(log N) after multiplication by N. There are at most N^2 positive terms, and every factorial estimate has the same O(log N) error. Taking the largest term and then summing proves both bounds in (13) uniformly. The negative formula uses the exact mirror E_-(u)=E_+(d-u); replacing (d-u)/N by 1-u/N has the same uniform logarithmic error. Finally E_+ is exactly nonincreasing in u, so its maximum row is u=0; its signed mirror has the same maximum. This proves (14). Thus the remaining weighted angle packet has a precise octahedral capacity depending on the retained output color. Replacing every bridge by its free maximum v_8 would discard the correlations and can overcount the knot volume. Whether its coherent gluing to T enforces the needed GLOBAL geometric angle constraints is not proved by (13)--(14). ### Exact source-fixing pair-degree biases There is additional nontrivial metric freedom with NO original paired-boundary cost. On input heads1,2 multiply the physical coordinate gauges by exp(lambda_1*(j-d/2)) on each head, and on heads3,4 by exp(lambda_2*(j-d/2)). On the output pair use any common exp(lambda_out*(j-d/2)). Every original cup and ordinary cap is fixed pointwise, because its pair degree is d. The assembled marked source retains its original complementary degree restriction and is therefore fixed as well. For an entry (3), the input pair degree is a+b-d=u-c, c+e-d=c-u. The output pair has degree d. Thus the EXACT change of coefficient is exp(delta*(c-u)), where delta=lambda_1-lambda_2. This uses the original physical charge; it is not an adjustable geometric edge label. The full positive row Gram becomes E_(+,delta)(u)=N^2 sum_(k<=d-u) sum_(a+c=d-k) exp(2delta*(c-u))/(s_a^4 s_c^4 s_k^2). (15) For delta in any fixed compact real set, the same uniform factorial and rounding proof gives log E_(+,delta)(u)=(N/pi) max [4Lambda(pi*a)+4Lambda(pi*c)+2Lambda(pi*k) +2pi*delta*(c-t)] +O(log N), t=u/N, (16) where a,c,k>=0, a+c+k=1 and k<=1-t. Its error is uniform in u and in that delta set. For fixed k at an interior maximizer the tilted A,C equation is sin(pi*c)/sin(pi*a)=exp(delta/2). No optimization over delta or global gluing theorem is claimed. These gauges can therefore encode pair-degree constraints without an exponential source norm. Interfaces with preceding/following crossings must still be transported. In particular the factor exp(-delta*u) is an actual through-head degree clock; it is not a unitary factor that can be discarded from (8) or (12). ## 6. Verification and scope [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_terminal_bridge_operator_reduction.py) uses original signed R matrices and the full original E/F intertwiner construction. the finite checks cover seven all-input signed bridge maps N=2,...,8; three COMPLETE six-head-to-four-head terminal identities N=2,3,4; and seven physical source/current metric families. It verifies the complete phases in (4),(6),(8),(9), both gauges, every spectator color, and the exact row Grams (11). Six further growing-level row-profile families through N=256 check the uniform endpoint/interior profile (13) and its mirror. The proof is all-level and all-exterior. Its new operation is an actual open bridge contraction with explicit angle/current feedback. It does not assert that arbitrarily many such contractions close in a one-cell positive algebra, nor a broad sharp knot-volume estimate.

title: The effective terminal Cartan coupon: an exact kernel and its two critical channels
text: # The effective terminal Cartan coupon: an exact kernel and its two critical channels 29 October 2026. This continues the [literal terminal Ward calculation](actual_terminal_phase_coupon_and_ward.md). The complete Steinberg projection can be expanded before taking a classical symbol. Its kernel has an exact root-orbit completion. There are consequently two coherent channels, rather than just the phase-one Hurwitz graph. The regular graph of the first channel is explicit below. The second has an explicit coefficient integral and saddle equations. Neither channel is independently substituted for the original source. This note does **not** prove a full selected-cycle energy bound, or a closed-knot stationary counterexample. In particular its last section keeps the normal equation of the outgoing cap: the finite character cap is at an escaping physical Fourier coordinate. A character intersection alone does not settle that normal equation. ## 1. Exact completion on every original input Use (N\geq2,d=N-1,q=e^{\pi i/N},Q=q^2,x=q^d), and \[ F_a=(Q;Q)_a,\qquad L=\kappa^{-1}R_{12}|_W, \qquad W=(V\otimes V)_{\deg d}. \] The lowest lift and effective coupon, with all normal coefficients, are \[ D w=\sum_{k=0}^d\frac{F_{12}^{\,k}}{F_k}Lw\otimes|d-k\rangle, \qquad M_t=\xi_d^{-1}R_{\mathrm{high}}E_{123}^{,d}t^{J_2}D, \quad \xi_d=(-1)^dN. \tag{1} \] They are the original maps, including the full common Cartan factor in \(R\); in particular (M_1=I). A useful ALL-INPUT identity is \[ \boxed{\quad M_t=\mathcal N_t L,\qquad \mathcal N_t=\left. \sum_{k=0}^d \frac{x^kQ^{k(k+1)/2}}{F_k^2} E_{12}^{,k}t^{J_2}F_{12}^{,k}\right|_W .\quad} \tag{2} \] Here (t^{J_2}|a,b\rangle=t^b|a,b\rangle). No inverse of the terminal packet is used. To prove (2), put \[ A=E_{12}K_3,\quad B=E_3,\quad AB=QBA. \] In ((A+B)^d=\sum_k{d\brack k}_Q B^{d-k}A^k), only the term with (k) pair arrows sends the last color (d-k) to zero. Its coefficient, after (1), is \[ \frac{{d\brack k}_Q x^kQ^{-k(d-k)} Q^{-(d-k)(d-k+1)/2}F_{d-k}}{F_k\xi_d} =\frac{x^kQ^{k(k+1)/2}}{F_k^2}. \] Notice the sign: \(\prod_{a=1}^r(Q^{-a}-1) =Q^{-r(r+1)/2}F_r\). Thus (2) also proves the exact inverse identity \[ \mathcal N_1=L^{-1}. \tag{3} \] It retains the complete total-character projection, not only its Casimir value or a formal fixed-moment constraint. ## 2. A factorized open kernel, including its orbital alias Let (i,j=0,\ldots,d) be the output and input indices of \(\mathcal N_t\), and define \[ \mathcal R_{ij}=\sum_{a=\max(i,j)}^d \frac{F_a^2}{F_{a-i}F_{a-j}}, \] \[ \mathcal S_{ij}(t)= \sum_{s=\max(0,j-i)}^j (tQ^{i+j-d})^s \frac{F_{d-j+s}^2}{F_sF_{s+i-j}}. \] Then the exact finite kernel is \[ \boxed{\quad (\mathcal N_t)_{ij}= \frac{x^{j-i}Q^{i(i-j)}t^{d-j}} {F_jF_{d-j}F_iF_{d-i}} \mathcal R_{ij}\mathcal S_{ij}(t).\quad} \tag{4} \] For an elementary derivation, let (r,s) be the first- and second-head raising counts in (F_{12}^{r+s}). The lowering counts in (E_{12}^{r+s}) are (u=j+r-i) and (v=s+i-j). Their factorial denominators are (F_rF_sF_uF_v). Multiplication in (2) leaves \[ x^{j+2r-i}Q^{-dr-ds+i^2-ij+is+js}t^{d-j+s} \frac{F_{j+r}^2F_{d-j+s}^2} {F_jF_{d-j}F_iF_{d-i}F_rF_sF_uF_v}. \] Since (x^2=Q^d), its (r) phase cancels exactly. The allowed \(r\) and (s) ranges are independent rectangles. This proves (4). The first factor has the exact orbit evaluation \[ \boxed{\quad \mathcal R_{ij}=N\left(1+ [z^N](Q^{1-i}z;Q)_i(Q^{1-j}z;Q)_j\right).\quad} \tag{5} \] Indeed the summand is \((Q^{a-i+1};Q)_i(Q^{a-j+1};Q)_j\). Extend its (a)-sum to a full (N)-orbit: the additional terms vanish. The polynomial has constant coefficient one and degree (i+j<2N), so only its constant and (N)-th coefficients survive that orbit. In particular \[ i+j<N\quad\Longrightarrow\quad\mathcal R_{ij}=N. \tag{6} \] The second coefficient in (5) is not deleted outside this triangle. Nor may one find saddles of the unsummed \\(a\)-sum and regard all of them as separate contributions: (5) already cancels all its nonconstant modes in (6). ## 3. The regular constant-channel canonical graph Here is a precise principal-phase calculation for the constant channel of (5). It applies where all indicated shapes are regular and the \(s\)-sum has an interior saddle. It describes that critical correspondence; it does not assert that this saddle meets the selected source cycle. Write (h=\log Q), (I=e^{hi},J=e^{hj},S=e^{hs}), and set \[ B=S/J,\qquad V=SI/J. \] The exact adjacent summand ratio in \(s\) tends to one precisely when \[ tIJ(1-S/J)^2=(1-S)(1-SI/J). \tag{7} \] Input and output canonical momenta of (4), after taking the constant \(N\) channel, are \[ z_{\mathrm{in}}=(1-S)/S,\qquad z_{\mathrm{out}}=\frac{SI/J}{1-SI/J}. \tag{8} \] These follow by the exact \(j\) and \(i\) ratios, respectively; input momentum is the inverse input ratio. Solving (7)--(8) gives \[ z_{\mathrm{out}}=\frac{z_{\mathrm{in}}} {t[J(1+z_{\mathrm{in}})-1]^2},\qquad I=\frac{J(1+z_{\mathrm{in}})z_{\mathrm{out}}}{1+z_{\mathrm{out}}}. \] At (t=1) this is the original graph of (L^{-1}), consistently with (3). Composing it with (L), the regular constant-channel graph of the effective coupon itself is therefore \[ \boxed{\quad (J,z)\longmapsto \left(\frac{J(1+z)}{t+z},\frac zt\right). \quad} \tag{9} \] It preserves (d\log J\wedge d\log z). The recorded physical clock is (B=z/[J(1+z)]), invariant under (9). To express (9) on the ACTUAL character cubic, the symbols of the literal complete Casimir matrices give \[ X=A-2=-\frac{(1-J)^2(1+z)^2}{z},\quad Y=B_{\mathrm{Cas}}-2=\frac{(J-1)^2(1+z)}J,\quad Z=C-2=\frac{(J-1)^2(1+z)}{Jz}. \] They satisfy ((X+Y+Z)^2+XYZ=0). In these coordinates (9) is \[ \boxed{\quad (X,Y,Z)\longmapsto\lambda(X,Y,tZ),\qquad \lambda=\frac{(X+Y+tZ)^2}{t(X+Y+Z)^2},\qquad B_{\mathrm{clock}}=-Y/X.\quad} \tag{10} \] This is a nontrivial algebraic canonical action. Parseval matching of the recorded clocks in its two copies does not algebraically set \\(t=1\). On the true irreducible terminal \(R_{23}^2\)-cap component one must impose \[ (X',Y',Z')=(c^2,c,-c), \] not just its unsaturated equation (Y'+Z'=0). In particular the condition (Y+tZ=0) alone cannot replace the full cap source. ## 4. The second, coherently retained critical correspondence Put \[ A_{ij}=[z^N](Q^{1-i}z;Q)_i(Q^{1-j}z;Q)_j. \] Its exact Cauchy coefficient integral supplies a second phase. At a regular nonzero coefficient saddle (w), its leading action is \[ \Phi=\operatorname{Li}_2(w/I)+\operatorname{Li}_2(w/J) -2\operatorname{Li}_2(w)-2\pi i\log w, \] with the inherited logarithmic sheets retained. Its stationary equation is \[ (1-w)^2=(1-w/I)(1-w/J),\qquad w=\frac{2IJ-I-J}{IJ-1}. \tag{11} \] Consequently, with (R=w/J,U=w/I,V=SI/J), the second correspondence is specified by (7), (11), and \[ z_{\mathrm{in}}=\frac{1-S}{S(1-R)},\qquad z_{\mathrm{out}}=\frac{V(1-U)}{1-V},\qquad B_{\mathrm{clock}}=S/J. \tag{12} \] One then composes with the SAME original (L). At (t=1), away from excluded denominators, (7) implies (S=R^{-1}); (12) gives both momenta \(-1\). Thus this channel degenerates into the reducible character fiber at phase one. This is consistent with the exact identity \(M_1=I\); it is not permission to omit the channel at other phases. Equations (11)--(12) retain precisely the orbital completion missing from (9). Endpoint saddles of the finite sums and logarithmic/coordinate boundary strata still require their own source analysis. This note does not identify their union with a selected global canonical cycle. ## 5. An exact source/cap intersection and its remaining normal test The endpoint issue is visible without arbitrary exterior data. Take the literal one-component four-plat word \([-2,1,2,2]\), so its prefix is \(B=R_{12}R_{23}^{-1}\). The actual source gives \[ R_{23}^{-1}p=N\kappa^{-1}e_d, \qquad L Bp=N L^2e_d. \] The latter vector has the all-level finite formula \[ (L^2e_d)_j=N^2x^{j-d}\frac{F_j}{F_{d-j}} \sum_{v=0}^j \frac{(-1)^vQ^{v(v+1)/2-jv}}{F_{j-v}F_v^3}. \tag{13} \] Its interior saddle, writing (V_0=e^{hv}), satisfies \[ JV_0^2-3JV_0+3J-1=0,\qquad z_{\mathrm{source}}=\frac{(1-J)^2}{J(V_0-J)}. \tag{14} \] The source curve before the final \(L\) is exactly \((X,Y,Z)=(s,s^2,-s)\), by the literal Hurwitz maps. Formula (14) gives its image under that final \(L\), not an independently chosen boundary phase. On the alias correspondence, take the irreducible terminal cap chart \(I\to\infty\), \(z_{\mathrm{out}}=-1+c/I+O(I^{-2})\). Put \(m=S/J\). Equations (7), (11)--(12) then give \[ J=\frac m{m^2-t(1-m)^2},\quad S=mJ,\quad c=(t-1)(m+m^{-1}-2). \tag{15} \] The incoming effective-coupon character is \[ X=\frac{(m-1)^2(t-1)^2}{t},\quad Y=\frac{(m-1)^2(t-1)(mt-m-t)^2}{mt}, \] \[ Z=-\frac{(m-1)^2(t-1) (m^2t^2-2m^2t+m^2-2mt^2+3mt-m+t^2)^2}{mt^2}. \tag{16} \] There are exact nontrivial unit/unit parameters satisfying the actual prefix curve \(Y=X^2,Z=-X\). For example let \(a\) be the unique real root in \((131/100,33/25)\) of \[ a^6-3a^5-a^4+6a^3-2a^2+14a-19=0, \] put \(m=(a+i\sqrt{4-a^2})/2\), and set \[ t=\frac1{107}\big(50m^{11}-126m^{10}+181m^9-343m^8 +267m^7+295m^6-332m^5-88m^4+397m^3-214m^2+69m-24\big). \tag{17} \] Polynomial reduction proves \(t\bar t=1\), \(t\ne1\), and the two source equations exactly. Numerically \[ m=.658593303580947+.752499076729224i, \quad t=.776413057400676-.630224376153235i, \] \[ s=.201092454204344+.229765297192068i, \quad c=.152668158870543+.430325644530469i. \] Both characters are finite and irreducible, by the [explicit cap atlas](actual_parabolic_cap_trace_certificate.md). The two conjugate copies have matching unit recorded clock \(m\). The actual source saddle (14) is regular at these values. This is an explicit intersection of the completed critical correspondence, the actual prefix source curve and the genuine terminal cap component. **Its normal qualification is essential.** The exact outgoing row is \[ (\ell R_{23}^2)_i=(xQ)^{i-d}/N. \tag{18} \] This follows by the original anti-Pascal matrix and the elementary identity \(\sum_{v=0}^aQ^v/F_v=1/F_a\). Hence full adjacent output stationarity requires \[ z_{\mathrm{out}}=(xQ)^{-1}=-q^{-1} =-1+h/2+O(h^2). \] Together with the cap chart this permits, and requires at leading order, \(I\sim2c/h\). It does not give \(c=0\). Proving a source-preserving full normal critical lift in this N-dependent chart requires controlling the same retained norm/logarithmic sectors; it is not a consequence of the reduced character equations (15)--(17). No such lifting or selected intersection number is asserted here. Accordingly this example is not advertised as a full stationary counterexample or as a nonzero contribution to the quantum period. The actionable calculation is (2)--(5), followed by the two different critical relations (9) and (11)--(12). A proposed geometric estimate of the terminal Parseval energy must handle their coherent completion and the cap normal equation (18). Clock matching alone is insufficient to replace that calculation by a transparent original-knot seam. ## 6. What conjugate Parseval matching says on the first channel The doubled stationary equation must keep the opposite-root convention. If \(m_+\) is the recorded clock in the first copy and \(\bar m_-\) the clock in the conjugate-root copy, differentiation in the retained phase gives \[ \log m_++\log\bar m_-=0 \] on the inherited sheets (equivalently equality of the two integer recorded colors before taking a symbol). On a conjugation-fixed real critical stratum this implies \(|m|=1\). A real retained phase also has \(|t|=1\). It does not say that every complex stationary point of a deformed doubled period lies in that stratum. For the first correspondence, the irreducible terminal cap condition in (10) is \(t=-Y/Z\), with its full component retained. Therefore its conjugation-fixed stationary characters satisfy \[ |X|=|Y|=|Z|,\qquad m=-Y/X,\qquad t=-Y/Z. \tag{19} \] This is a concrete condition on the incoming prefix character curve. It is weaker than \(t=1\). Conversely, if \(m,t\) are unit numbers and the denominators are nonzero, the cubic and terminal cap determine \[ X=\frac{t(1-m+m/t)^2}{m^2},\qquad Y=-mX,\qquad Z=mX/t. \] The outgoing cap parameter is \(c=-1/m\). Thus this first channel has a particularly explicit angular locus; the alias channel (15) has a different relation between recorded clock and cap parameter. They cannot be conflated in a doubled-energy estimate. As a check with the literal figure-eight prefix \(R_{12}^{-1}R_{23}\), its transported source curve is \[ (X,Y,Z)=(s,s^2,-s(1+s)^2). \] Substituting in (19) gives \(|s|=|1+s|=1\), hence \(s=e^{\pm2\pi i/3}\) and \(t=s/(1+s)^2=1\). This is an algebraic transparency check for that channel and that actual prefix. It does not control the alias, escaping cap normal, or non-real doubled critical strata. It is therefore not a substitute for the exact figure-eight packet proof or a broad knot-energy theorem. ## 7. Shrinking the phase does not bound all character ratios The condition |m|=1 above comes from stationary matching in the phase variable. An endpoint of a restricted real phase arc does not supply that equation. Bounded actual character coordinates do not replace it, since m is a ratio. There is an exact escape in (15)--(16), using the SAME original prefix and cap as Section 5. Put tau=t-1 and write m=1+w/tau. The actual source equations Y=X^2 and Z=-X are satisfied exactly whenever w^3-w^2+2tw-t=0. (20) This follows by direct substitution in their common factor, not by choosing independent exterior data. At t=1 the polynomial has discriminant -23, so all three roots are simple and nonzero. Each has a local analytic continuation w(t), including along t=exp(i theta) as theta tends to zero. The real root at one lies in (0.56,0.58). Along each branch the incoming character and outgoing cap parameter are (X,Y,Z)=(w^2/t,w^4/t^2,-w^2/t), c=w^2/(w+tau). (21) They remain bounded and tend to finite irreducible characters. In particular the incoming limit has X=w(1)^2 != 0. Nevertheless |m| is comparable to |t-1|^(-1). The fixed-t cap normal calculation suggests I comparable to 2w(1)/h, a polynomial-radius physical chart. Its uniform validity when |t-1| is smaller than |h| is a separate joint-limit question; the fixed-t expansion does not prove it. Thus t near one and bounded character coordinates alone do not exclude the reduced channel, but do not prove its full normal lift. With v=w(1), the limiting incoming coordinates may equivalently be written (v^2,v(v-1)^2,-v(v^2-v+1)^2). Equation (20) makes this exactly (v^2,v^4,-v^2). This also checks the unscaled limit of (16), including its genuine cap component. This is an algebraic escape certificate, not a proof that an extra contribution survives in the original quantum arc integral. The normal sectors may still cancel this channel, as the exact identity M_1=I requires at phase one. Its calibrated action and coefficient must be retained to decide suppression for |t-1|=N^(-A). Polynomiality alone does not assign that action or its selected intersection number. No shrinking-arc sharp-energy theorem is claimed here. There is a useful action test before asserting suppression. On any genuinely stationary branch with the original t-dependence retained, the envelope identity gives d S / d log(t) = log(m), with the inherited integer color lift. All original scalar factors are t-independent; the identity follows directly from t^n in (1). For m=1+w/tau with w tending to a nonzero limit, it gives on a fixed logarithmic sector S(t)=S_* - tau log(tau) + O(tau). (22) An additional bounded 2pi*i color lift changes only the O(tau) term. Hence this phase differential does not itself yield a positive N*log|tau| vanishing factor. It also does not calculate S_*, prove that the branch is stationary in every retained normal variable, or determine its selected coefficient. Those are essential to any actual suppression or survival claim. The exact cancellation at t=1 must not be replaced by assigning an unproved value to S_*. ## 8. Finite diagnostics of the actual first phase jet The [saved diagnostic](../experiments/diagnose_terminal_cartan_jet_and_arc.py) uses the exact closed T kernel and (13), with the original prefix B=R12 R23^-1. It forms the literal coefficient vector f_n=T_n(Bp), the value sum f_n, and the first phase jet sum n*f_n. It also evaluates the normalized shrinking-arc energy EXACTLY as the finite moment sum E_a=sum_(n,m) f_n conjugate(f_m) sinc(a(n-m)), a=N^-3. All quantities use two working precisions; the saved values agree to at least 24 relative decimal places. Some measured rates are | N | log of first-jet modulus / N | log(E_a)/(2N) | |---|---:|---:| | 16 | 0.651957431682358 | 0.259217703955373 | | 32 | 0.582429288600779 | 0.240456892692090 | | 64 | 0.532365673879463 | 0.328835120972563 | These are finite diagnostics. They do not prove a positive limiting jet rate, identify the jet with another knot invariant, or prove that the escaping critical branch supplies its asymptotics. They show why the proved shrinking-arc Cauchy inequality must be accompanied by a quantitative estimate of the actual normal jets; continuity at phase one alone is inadequate for that estimate. [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_terminal_effective_cartan_kernel.py) compares (2), (4), (5), (13), and (18) with the original full physical maps. It also checks the rational symplectic/cubic calculations and the exact unit/unit algebra in (17). No selected-cycle test is hidden in those algebraic checks.

title: Exponential metric motion is necessary for the current terminal Gram
text: # Exponential metric motion is necessary for the current terminal Gram 29 October 2026. This is an exact obstruction to a UNIFORM, all-port Lyapunov propagation of the presently constructed terminal Gram at subexponential extra cost. Its test vector is now proved to occur on a FIXED original source trajectory, by the cup slide below. It is not an obstruction to Cauchy, a substantially changing positive metric, or a source estimate which first retains the relevant coherent cancellations. Use the original principal root and complete source module W from [the closed kernel](actual_terminal_packet_closed_kernel.md): q=exp(pi*i/N), Q=q^2, d=N-1, x=q^d, F_a=(Q;Q)_a, s_a=|F_a|, kappa=q^(d^2/2), e_j=|j,d-j>. Let R be the FULL original positive checked crossing on W, and let T be the actual terminal projector map. The verified identities are \[ T=N^{-1}X R P_{\mathrm{rev}}R,\qquad H:=TR^{-1}=N^{-1}X R P_{\mathrm{rev}},\qquad X=\operatorname{diag}(x^j),\quad P_{\mathrm{rev}}=\operatorname{diag}(P_{d-j}), \tag{1} \] where P0=1 and the ACTUAL endpoint satisfies \[ P_d=\sum_{j=0}^dF_j=-q\Phi_N(r_N^3),\qquad |P_d|\leq3N^2. \tag{2} \] The full original pivotal functional, odd simple node, even levels, Cartan and framing phases behind (2) are retained in [the quantitative Green proof](actual_terminal_green_capacity_bound.md#2-the-actual-endpoint-closes-polynomially-at-every-parity). No estimate of a sum of absolute Green currents is used here. ## 1. A complete exact energy comparison Put \[ Z_N=\sum_{j=0}^d s_j^2,\qquad v_N=R^{-1}e_0. \] Three literal finite crossing identities give everything needed: \[ R e_0=\kappa x^{-d}e_d,\qquad (R^{-1}e_0)_j=\kappa^{-1}x^jF_{d-j},\qquad |(R e_d)_j|=s_j. \tag{3} \] The second uses the original NEGATIVE crossing formula, rather than assuming a unitary inverse. The third uses root factorial reflection. In particular ||v_N||^2=Z_N, while ||R v_N||=1. Applying (1), \[ \boxed{\displaystyle \|T v_N\|^2=|P_d|^2/N^2,\qquad \|T Rv_N\|^2=\|T e_0\|^2=Z_N/N^2.} \tag{4} \] Both equalities are of COMPLETE coherent packet energies, not of one expanded shear path. The denominator is an original polynomial source endpoint, and the numerator is the entire positive factorial sum. Let epsilon_N=exp(-N^2), and let the current positive terminal Gram be \[ G_N=T^\dagger T+\epsilon_N I. \] Every uniform Lyapunov inequality \[ R^\dagger G_N R\preceq C_N G_N \] must therefore satisfy the exact finite lower bound \[ \boxed{\displaystyle C_N\geq\frac{Z_N+N^2\epsilon_N} {|P_d|^2+N^2\epsilon_N Z_N}.} \tag{5} \] This includes levels at which T is singular; nothing is inverted except the genuine original crossing. It also holds after tensoring the physical ports with any spectator coefficient Hilbert space. The sine-factorial estimate, including its endpoint uniformity, gives \[ \log Z_N=\frac{v_3}{\pi}N+O(\log N), \tag{6} \] where v3 is the regular ideal tetrahedron volume. Indeed log s_j=N J(j/N)+O(log N), and J has its unique maximum v3/(2pi) at 5/6. Polynomially many terms and a nearest lattice point give (6). No volume-conjecture asymptotic is a premise. Combining (2), (5), (6), and epsilon_N=e^(-N^2) proves \[ \boxed{\displaystyle \log C_N\geq\frac{v_3}{\pi}N-O(\log N).} \tag{7} \] One may use the finite bound C_N>=Z_N/(9N^4+1) for every N>=2: Z_N<=N4^(N-1) implies N^2 exp(-N^2)Z_N<1 in this range. Thus this FIXED original terminal Gram does not have a subexponential-cost all-port Lyapunov inequality even for R12. The exponent is forced by a retained source endpoint, not by a generic nonnormal-matrix norm estimate. For the related source-slot Gram \(\widehat G_N=H^\dagger H+\epsilon_N I\), the flat unit vector e0 gives the even simpler exact quotient \[ \frac{\|HR e_0\|^2+\epsilon_N\|Re_0\|^2} {\|H e_0\|^2+\epsilon_N} =\frac{Z_N+N^2\epsilon_N}{|P_d|^2+N^2\epsilon_N}. \tag{8} \] So the conclusion is not caused only by the Euclidean size of v_N. ## 2. Any uniformly comparable moving metric must pay the same cost The statement also quantifies what an adaptive metric has to change. Suppose positive metrics G_before,G_after obey \[ G_{\mathrm{before}}\preceq A_N G_N,\qquad G_{\mathrm{after}}\succeq B_N^{-1}G_N, \] and a propagation inequality is asserted: \[ R^\dagger G_{\mathrm{after}}R\preceq C_N G_{\mathrm{before}}. \] Testing v_N proves, without additional assumptions, \[ C_N A_N B_N\geq \frac{Z_N+N^2\epsilon_N}{|P_d|^2+N^2\epsilon_N Z_N}. \tag{9} \] If A_N and B_N are exp(o(N)), C_N must carry the exponent in (7). Conversely a subexponential step cost requires exponential metric motion relative to this terminal metric, of at least the displayed amount. Exact pullback of a metric can of course make an individual step an isometry; (9) says that its change of scale cannot be ignored when comparing it with this fixed boundary-conditioned metric. This does not forbid an angle/gluing dependent metric with a genuine global certificate for its exponential variation. It specifies one necessary quantitative condition such a construction must meet. ## 3. Original-source scope The [literal all-input cup slide](actual_terminal_source_normalization_packet.md) now strengthens the test to an ACTUAL fixed source trajectory: R23 p=N R12^(-1)e0, R12 R23 p=N e0. Thus the two prefixes [2] and [2,1] realize the exact quotient (5), with both test vectors multiplied by N. Their complete terminal packet energies are respectively |P_d|^2 and Z_N. Restricting the unchanged metric to vectors reached by original braid prefixes does not remove the obstruction. Their scalar closures retain cancellation: the second complete packet is x^(-d)(Q^(-j) conjugate(F_j))_j and sums to the unit phase x^(-d)Q. It is an explicit factorial divergence, with its endpoint and arbitrary spectator finite differences retained in the linked proof. The [shrinking-clock disk bound](actual_normalization_clock_disk_bound.md) now proves a sharp zero-exponent energy estimate for this particular normalization packet in a different coherent metric. No general interior-source energy estimate follows from that repair. The identity Rp=kappa p still holds on the bare cup, but does not apply after the genuine adjacent prefix R23. Any successful source argument must retain this distinction and its coherent closure. At this chosen paired source cut, any diagonal product-head gauge A_a B_b that fixes the cup term by term has A_j B_(d-j)=1. It is therefore the IDENTITY on all of W. Such a paired-source factorial gauge cannot alter this test. Interior gauges not satisfying that condition, or coherent non-product metrics, have to retain their actual interfaces and are outside this restricted observation. All original co-source factors remain unchanged: K=chi 1^T T A p and its polynomial Cauchy boundary cost are the ones already proved. No arbitrary positive trace replaces the pivotal source. Equations (4)--(9) diagnose the cost of propagating its CURRENT complete Gram; they do not give an excess-volume lower bound for a knot scalar. [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_terminal_gram_lyapunov_obstruction.py) uses the literal positive and negative crossing formulas and complete open terminal kernel. It checks the original cup, all coherent energies in (4),(8), and the regularized finite quotient rather than diagonalizing an unresolved near-singular Gram. The finite audit checks seven original complete terminal modules; nineteen literal signed-crossing/source/Gram families at N=2,...,20; five large-level exact energy quotients through N=384.

title: Boundary control of the original terminal Green packet
text:
# Boundary control of the original terminal Green packet 29 October 2026. The original terminal packet admits a quantitative all-input estimate after one literal adjacent inverse is retained. The argument uses its ACTUAL complete endpoint value before taking absolute values. It does not bound independent Green summands or discard the current. An arbitrary preceding three-head braid and an arbitrary external coefficient space remain open. Use the conventions of [the closed terminal kernel](actual_terminal_packet_closed_kernel.md): N>=2, d=N-1, q=exp(pi*i/N), Q=q^2, x=q^d, F_a=(Q;Q)_a, s_a=|F_a|, kappa=q^(d^2/2). R below is the FULL original positive checked crossing restricted to pair integer degree d. T is the original N-row physical terminal map (1) of that note, on the complete module W. ## 1. The whole Green--Pascal packet is a crossed diagonal current Let X=diag(x^n), and let P be the actual coherent finite solution \[ P_0=1,\qquad P_t=(1-Q^t)^2P_{t-1}+Q^t, \qquad P_t=F_t^2\sum_{v=0}^t Q^v/F_v^2. \] Put P_rev=diag(P_(d-j)). Then the ENTIRE terminal matrix is \[  oxed{\displaystyle T= rac1N X R P_{\mathrm{rev}}R.} 	ag{1} \] This is an identity on every input column, independently of a prefix. Both full Cartan scalars remain in R. To check (1) directly from the closed kernel, put L=kappa^(-1)R, and use its exact strict entries \[ L_{i,j}=x^{-d+h}Q^{(d-j)(d-i)}  rac{F_iF_j}{F_hF_{d-j}F_{d-i}},\qquad h=i+j-d\geq0. \] For the squared Pascal matrix U^(2) in that note, root reflection gives \[ L\,\mathrm{Rev}=x^{-d}D_\alpha U^{(2)}D_ eta, \quad \alpha_n=(-1)^nx^nQ^{-n(n+1)/2},\quad  eta_t=(-1)^tx^{-t}Q^{t(t-1)/2}. \] The two diagonal interfaces in its formula (13) simplify exactly: D_out D_alpha^(-1)=X and D_beta^(-1)D_in=I. Finally kappa^2=x^d, giving (1). No sum or absolute value is used in this step. In particular this is not a claim that arbitrary Pascal factors are unitary or that an unmatched source frame can be removed. The all-input packet immediately following a literal R12^(-1) is \[ H_N:=TR^{-1}= rac1N X R P_{\mathrm{rev}}. 	ag{2} \] Its original boundary row is 1^T H_N. Thus the positive completion H_N^dagger H_N+exp(-N^2)I has the SAME polynomial boundary dual cost at most N as the original terminal construction. No inverse of P or T is involved. ## 2. The actual endpoint closes polynomially at every parity The endpoint of this Green solution is exactly \[  oxed{\displaystyle P_d=\sum_{j=0}^d F_j.} 	ag{3} \] Indeed the shifted Durfee identity proved with the closed kernel gives \[ P_d=N\sum_{r=0}^d rac{(-1)^rQ^{r(r+1)/2}}{F_r}. \] Reflecting F_(d-r) and using Q^[d(d+1)/2]=(-1)^d turns the last sum into sum_j F_j. This uses no endpoint asymptotics or nonvanishing assumption. There is now a shorter independent endpoint estimate, with no spectral trace input. Put H_N(t)=sum_j F_j t^j and k=floor(N/6). Its exact Ward identity is (1-t)H_N(t)+tQH_N(Qt)=1. Backward propagation for k steps at t=1 has forcing at most k and remainder at most s_k sum_j s_j. Since s_k=min_j s_j and max_j s_j=N/s_k, |P_d|=|H_N(1)|<=k+N^2. The complete argument, including complex disks and all normal derivatives, is in the [clock-disk theorem](actual_normalization_clock_disk_bound.md). It independently implies the 3N^2 bound used below. The original trace derivation is retained as a second source check. Here is the source-specific bound on (3), including the nonsemisimple trace. The previously derived original trefoil source is K_N=Q sum_j F_j=(-q)^3 Phi_N(r_N^3), so P_d=-q Phi_N(r_N^3). The actual pivotal functional is \[ \Phi_N(f)=-\sum_{a	ext{ odd},\,0<a<N} [c_a f(c_a)+(c_a^2-4)f'(c_a)] + egin{cases}f(-2),&N	ext{ odd},\0,&N	ext{ even},\end{cases} \] where c_a=q^a+q^(-a), and \[ |
u_a|=1,\qquad r_N(c_a)=
u_a,\qquad r_N'(c_a)/
u_a=- rac{N-a}{2(q^a-q^{-a})}. \] These are the finite generic-q specialization and full pivotal partial trace, independently proved in [the spectral-source theorem](casimir_braiding_and_recoupling_lattice.md#8-the-actual-closing-trace-is-a-spectral-jet-functional), with the literal original source identification in [the complete clock calculation](actual_overclock_sector_obstruction.md#3-two-successive-macroscopic-cancellations). No positive trace is substituted. A double-node contribution for f=r^3 has modulus at most 2+3N: c is bounded by 2, and its derivative term has modulus at most 3(N-a)|q^a-q^(-a)|/2<=3N. The possible odd simple term has modulus one. Consequently, at EVERY N>=2, \[ |P_d|\leq3N^2. 	ag{4} \] The common Cartan and framing factors in this source calculation combine to the explicit unit phase above. There is no unknown knot period in (4), and the formula includes every Jordan derivative. ## 3. Boundary-to-interior Green bound For all 0<=t<=d one has the uniform finite estimate \[  oxed{\displaystyle |P_t|\leq N+4s_t^2.} 	ag{5} \] For t<=floor(N/6), forward recurrence has |1-Q^j|^2<=1, hence |P_t|<=t+1<=N. For larger t use the EXACT backward expression \[ P_t=F_t^2\left( rac{P_d}{N^2} -\sum_{v=t+1}^d rac{Q^v}{F_v^2}ight). 	ag{6} \] The sequence s_v first increases after its low minimum, and then decreases to s_d=N. Therefore, for v>=t in the indicated range, s_v>=min(s_t,N). Substitution of (4) in (6) gives \[ |P_t|\leq3s_t^2+N\max(1,s_t^2/N^2)\leq N+4s_t^2. \] Thus the coherent endpoint cancels the potentially large forward Green current before any norm estimate. Merely applying absolute values to the defining partial sum does not give (5). There is a useful nonzero local density. Uniformly for t/N in any compact subinterval of (1/6,1/2), \[ P_t= rac1{2-Q^t}+O(1/N). 	ag{7} \] To prove it, put m=floor(N/2) in (6). The endpoint and terms with v>=m are exponentially small after multiplication by F_t^2: J(t/N)<0 whereas J(v/N)>=-O(log(N)/N), where J(u)=integral_0^u log(2sin(pi*s))ds. On t<v<m all inverse factors |1-Q^v|^(-2) are bounded by a fixed number r<1. For v=t+k, \[ Q^{t+k}F_t^2/F_{t+k}^2 =Q^t(1-Q^t)^{-2k}+O(k^2 r^k/N), \] after possibly increasing r while keeping r<1. This follows by telescoping the k product factors; the factors and their derivatives are uniformly bounded on this compact interval. Sum the error and the geometric series. Its negative sum is -z/[(1-z)^2-1]=1/(2-z), z=Q^t. This proves (7), with no formal adiabatic assumption and no division by P_t. ## 4. A sharp one-octahedron norm for the complete terminal-with-inverse Define the explicit finite factorial maximum \[ M_N=\max_{0\leq k\leq i\leq d}s_i^2/s_k. \] Then (2) and (5) imply the finite operator bound \[  oxed{\displaystyle \|H_N\|_{\mathrm{op}}\leq\|R|_W\|_{\mathrm{HS}}+4M_N.} 	ag{8} \] Here is the full metric calculation. On the actual support h=i+j-d, root reflection gives \[ |R_{i,j}|= rac{s_i^2s_j^2}{N^2s_h}. \] The matrix in (2) consequently obeys the entry bound \[ |(H_N)_{i,j}|\leq|R_{i,j}|+4N|R_{i,j}|/s_j^2. \] The second matrix has Hilbert--Schmidt norm at most 4M_N, since there are at most N^2 entries and |R_ij|/s_j^2=s_i^2/(N^2s_h). This proves (8). It estimates the coherent source-selected Green current together with its ACTUAL crossing and physical complementary charge. It does not independently maximize unrelated P and Pascal factors. Let v3 be the regular tetrahedron volume and v8 the regular octahedron volume. The uniform sine-factorial estimate gives \[ \log M_N= rac{3v_3}{2\pi}N+O(\log N),\qquad \log\|R|_W\|_{\mathrm{HS}}= rac{v_8}{2\pi}N+O(\log N). 	ag{9} \] For the first formula maximize 2J(i/N)-J(k/N): J has maximum v3/(2pi) at 5/6 and minimum -v3/(2pi) at 1/6, simultaneously admissible. For the second, the actual support has i+j>=d and the limiting profile is 2J(u)+2J(v)-J(u+v-1). Put alpha=pi(1-u), beta=pi(1-v), gamma=pi(u+v-1). At fixed gamma, Lambda(alpha)+Lambda(beta) has unique maximum at alpha=beta. The remaining derivative of 4Lambda((pi-gamma)/2)+Lambda(gamma) is log cot(gamma/2). The maximum is at (alpha,beta,gamma)=(pi/4,pi/4,pi/2), with value v8/2. This proves the second formula directly for this pair degree. The rounding of d=N-1 and all boundary points costs O(log N). Since 3v3<v8, (8) yields an upper exponent v8. This is SHARP for the full open operator, not just an upper diagnostic: \[  oxed{\displaystyle \log\|T R^{-1}\|_{\mathrm{op}} = rac{v_8}{2\pi}N+O(\log N).} 	ag{10} \] Indeed take i=j nearest 3N/4. Its actual crossing entry has the maximal exponent in (9), while t=d-j has t/N->1/4. Formula (7) gives \(P_{d-j}	o1/(2-\mathrm i)\), a fixed nonzero number. The single entry of (2), with its factor 1/N retained, supplies the lower bound. Even and composite levels require no separate argument. ## 5. Arbitrary-prefix source consequence and its limit For ANY original prefix A on the complete W, consider the literal terminal word R23^2 R12^(-1) A, with its genuine whole marked source. Its original scalar and positive coherent energy are \[ K_N=\chi_N\,1^{\mathsf T}H_NAp,\qquad E_N(A)=\|H_NAp\|^2. \] Equations (8)--(10) give the SOURCE-EXACT all-prefix inequality \[ |K_N|^2\leq |\chi_N|^2 N E_N(A) \leq |\chi_N|^2 N(\|R|_W\|_{\mathrm{HS}}+4M_N)^2\|Ap\|^2. 	ag{11} \] Every displayed map can be tensored with an arbitrary exterior coefficient Hilbert space. The same norm bound holds, with that space and its ordering untouched. This does not assert a factorization of an unrelated larger physical multiplicity space into W factors. The block costs ONE crossing exponent v8 rather than separately charging three crossings. For example, if A is a fixed m-crossing three-head prefix, its original highest physical source is p tensor |0>. Each original physical signed crossing has operator norm bounded by its Hilbert--Schmidt norm with exponent v8/(2pi); extraction of the last color0 is the complete multiplicity inverse of norm one. Thus (11), with all source factors polynomial, yields \[ \limsup_N rac{2\pi}{N}\log|K_N|\leq(m+1)v_8, 	ag{12} \] for every one-component original four-plat word of that literal form. The generic crossing bound for the same displayed word is (m+3)v8. No favorable packet is substituted for Ap. If an inverse was not actually present, inserting one and its inverse charges the added factor in A and does not give this improvement for free. This is a reusable open-source energy estimate, not the sharp knot volume theorem. The surviving one-octahedron operator capacity can still exceed the geometric contribution of a closed knot. Sharper bounds must use coherent information in Ap and its exterior gluing. [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_terminal_green_capacity_bound.py) checks the exact full-Cartan matrix identity, both actual endpoint formulas and all small parities, the finite bound (8), and the nonzero quarter-window density. Its numerical norm rates are diagnostics for the proved asymptotic, not a replacement for (6)--(10). The finite audit checks eight original full-Cartan packet matrices; 79 levels of the actual source endpoint and every Green color; ten coupled finite operator inequalities; five quarter-window nonzero densities through N=384.

title: Closed open-port kernel of the original terminal positive packet
text: # Closed open-port kernel of the original terminal positive packet 29 October 2026. This is an all-input formula for the terminal map in [the complete-module positive Gram](actual_terminal_packet_positive_gram.md). It does not substitute the figure-eight prefix. Both the recorded physical color and the complete multiplicity input remain open. The answer consists of finite factorial/Newton transforms and an explicit first-order factorial Green register. Its kernel is retained. ## 1. Conventions and the open matrix Put \[ q=e^{\pi i/N},\quad Q=q^2,\quad d=N-1,\quad x=q^d,\quad F_a=(Q;Q)_a,\quad s_a=|F_a|,\quad \kappa=q^{d^2/2}. \] All factorial indices below lie between 0 and d. In particular none of the displayed denominators vanishes. We use the original balanced heads, coproducts, full checked crossing R, ordinary cap ell, and complete map I_w of [the multiplicity theorem](actual_complete_source_multiplicity_module.md). The basis of W is e_j=|j,d-j>. Thus \[ D(w)=I_w|d\rangle,\qquad T_n(w)=(\ell_{12}\otimes\langle d|)(I\otimes R^2) \Pi_{\mathrm{middle}=n}D(w). \tag{1} \] The cap is \(\ell_{a,d-a}=x^{-a}Q^{-a}/N\), and R includes kappa. This definition uses the genuine whole Hopf closure. It does not replace an arbitrary marked coupon by an ordinary cap. Define the finite scalar register \[ P_0=1,\qquad P_t=(1-Q^t)^2P_{t-1}+Q^t, \qquad P_t=F_t^2\sum_{v=0}^t\frac{Q^v}{F_v^2}. \tag{2} \] The following is the closed answer for EVERY input column j: \[ \boxed{\displaystyle T_{n,j}=(-1)^n x^{j-d}Q^{-n(n+3)/2} \frac{F_n}{F_{d-j}}\, \sum_{t=0}^{\min(n,j)} \frac{Q^t(Q^{-n};Q)_t(Q^{-j};Q)_t}{F_t^4}\,P_t .} \tag{3} \] There is no unknown source value in this formula. In particular it specifies the map before a preceding braid is supplied. It holds at even, odd, prime, and composite levels. Let V be the lower triangular finite Newton matrix \(V_{n,t}=(Q^{-n};Q)_t\), set \[ D^{\mathrm{row}}_{n,n}=(-1)^nQ^{-n(n+3)/2}F_n,\qquad D^{\mathrm{col}}_{j,j}=x^{j-d}/F_{d-j}. \] Then (3) is the exact coherent congruence factorization \[ T=D^{\mathrm{row}}\,V\, \operatorname{diag}\!\left(\frac{Q^tP_t}{F_t^4}\right) V^{\mathsf T}D^{\mathrm{col}}. \tag{4} \] The transpose is a bilinear transpose, not an adjoint. Consequently the diagonally rescaled kernel is symmetric. Positivity is supplied by \(T^\dagger T\), not by declaring (4) positive. ## 2. A lowest-column crossing identity Let A be the physical pair Casimir on W, and put \(L=\kappa^{-1}R_{12}|_W\). Its exact entries are \[ L_{i,j}=\begin{cases} x^{-d+h}Q^{(d-j)(d-i)} \dfrac{F_iF_j}{F_hF_{d-j}F_{d-i}},&h=i+j-d\geq0,\\ 0,&i+j<d. \end{cases} \tag{5} \] The full lowest intertwiner column is \[ \boxed{\displaystyle D(w)=\sum_{k=0}^d\frac{F_{12}^{\,k}}{F_k}\,Lw \otimes|d-k\rangle .} \tag{6} \] Here the operator F12 is distinguished from the scalar factorial F_k. For a proof, first extract the last-color-d component of D and call the resulting map L0. Since D is lowest for F123, its other components are fixed by L0: on pair degree d+k+1, \[ K_{12}^{-1}(1-Q^{d-k})=-(1-Q^{k+1}). \] Thus the successive coefficients in (6) are exactly 1. There is no omitted endpoint term: \(F_{12}^N=0\). We next identify L0 without assuming a spectral basis. It commutes with A because A commutes with E12, F12, and K12 in the defining highest and lowest constructions. Let J be the actual highest-chart anti-Pascal matrix. The already proved original source identity is \[ J(x^j)_{j=0}^d=e_d,\qquad J^{\mathsf T}=J. \tag{7} \] On first physical color 0 the highest column is Jw. The divided \(F_{23}^d\) coefficient from |b,d-b> to |d,d> is x^b: expand the two q-commuting terms and use \(F_bF_{d-b}=N(-1)^bQ^{b(b+1)/2}\). The additional first-head factor in F123^d is x^(-d). Hence \[ e_0^{\mathsf T}L_0=x^{-d}(x^b)_b^{\mathsf T}J =x^{-d}e_d^{\mathsf T}. \tag{8} \] The original R commutes with A and its strict transfer formula gives the identical first row for kappa^(-1) R. Every off-diagonal Jacobi coefficient of A is nonzero: it is \(-(1-Q^j)^2\), 1<=j<=d. Therefore the rows \(e_0^{\mathsf T}A^r\), 0<=r<=d, span all rows. Two commuting maps with the same first row are equal. This proves L0=L and (6), including all Jordan channels. For reference, direct divided-power extraction also gives the finite Newton/Euler expression \[ L=\sum_{c=0}^d \frac{(-1)^c q^{c(c+2)}}{F_c^2}\,F_{12}^{\,c}E_{12}^{\,c}. \tag{9} \] It agrees with (5); it is not a completion of the nilpotent currents. ## 3. Forced terminal transfers and squared Pascal factorization The total physical degree of D(w) is 2d. At recorded middle color n, write its physical states as \[ (d-r,n,d-n+r),\qquad 0\leq r\leq n. \] The two terminal crossings and final cap force the first crossing's transfer to n-r and the second crossing's transfer to 0. Substituting the original signed-color formula, with both common Cartan factors, gives the terminal coefficient \[ c_{n,r}=\frac{x^{-n}}N(-1)^{n-r} Q^{-n(n+1)/2-n+r(r+1)/2}\frac{F_n}{F_r}. \tag{10} \] In simplifying it we used exactly \(\kappa^2=x^d\), not a deleted Cartan scalar. This is the only path admitted by the original finite support for these fixed physical colors. For a low-pair input i=d-t, the coefficient of \(|d-r,n\rangle\) in \(F_{12}^{n-r}/F_{n-r}\) is \[ x^{-(n-t)}Q^{(n-t)(d-t)} \frac{F_{d-r}F_n} {F_{t-r}F_{n-t}F_{d-t}F_t}, \qquad 0\leq r\leq t\leq n. \tag{11} \] Multiplying (10) and (11), reflecting F_(d-r), and summing r leaves the finite convolution \[ \sum_{r=0}^t\frac{Q^{r(r+1)}}{F_r^2F_{t-r}} =\sum_{v=0}^t\frac{Q^v}{F_v^2} =\frac{P_t}{F_t^2}. \tag{12} \] A self-contained proof of the first equality is as follows. Let E(z)=sum_r Q^{r(r+1)}z^r/F_r^2 and U(z)=sum_k z^k/F_k, as formal series modulo z^N. Their coefficient recurrences imply \[ E(z)-2E(Qz)+(1-Q^2z)E(Q^2z)=0,\qquad U(Qz)=(1-z)U(z). \] For J(z)=E(z)U(z), compare coefficients through degree d to obtain \[ P_t=(1+Q-2Q^t+Q^{2t})P_{t-1} -Q(1-Q^{t-1})^2P_{t-2}. \] Here P_t=F_t^2[z^t]J, P0=1, P1=1-Q+Q^2. The recurrence factors exactly: \(Z_t=P_t-(1-Q^t)^2P_{t-1}\) satisfies Z_t=Q Z_(t-1) and Z0=1. This proves (2) and (12) at every required index. Let Rev e_i=e_(d-i), and define \[ U^{(2)}_{n,t}=Q^{-nt}F_{n-t}{n\brack t}_Q^2\quad(t\leq n), \] \[ D^{\mathrm{out}}_{n,n}=(-1)^nQ^{-n(n+3)/2},\qquad D^{\mathrm{in}}_{t,t}=(-1)^t x^tQ^{t(t+1)/2}. \] Both D's are unitary diagonal matrices. Equations (6), (10)--(12) give the second useful all-exterior factorization \[ \boxed{\displaystyle T=\frac1N D^{\mathrm{out}}U^{(2)}D^{\mathrm{in}} \operatorname{diag}(P_t)\,\mathrm{Rev}\,L.} \tag{13} \] To recover (3), use the support t<=j in (5), reflect F_(d-t), and use \[ (Q^{-n};Q)_t(Q^{-j};Q)_t =Q^{-(n+j)t+t(t-1)}\frac{F_nF_j}{F_{n-t}F_{j-t}}. \] This also proves every entry of (4), rather than only its row sum. ## 4. Kernel, open Gram, and exact angle incidence All matrices flanking diag(P) in either (4) or (13) are invertible. Consequently \[ \operatorname{rank}T=\#\{t:P_t\ne0\},\qquad \ker T=L^{-1}\mathrm{Rev}\, \operatorname{span}\{e_t:P_t=0\}. \tag{14} \] For N=6, Q^2-Q+1=0, the successive values P0,...,P5 are 1, 0, Q-1, 4Q-5, -4Q-12, 17-13Q. Thus the actual complex packet has rank 5. The positive completion in the terminal Gram note is essential; an inverse of T would be invalid. No lower bound on nonzero P_t is assumed here. The elementary uniform upper bound |P_t|<=(4^(t+1)-1)/3 follows from (2), but is not sharp. For every input w, not only a specified knot prefix, (13) gives the SOURCE-EXACT positive energy \[ \sum_n|T_nw|^2=\frac1{N^2}\sum_n \left|\sum_{t\leq n}U^{(2)}_{n,t} D^{\mathrm{in}}_{t,t}P_t(Lw)_{d-t}\right|^2. \tag{15} \] All interference between distinct t is retained. Equivalently the open Gram is \[ T^\dagger T=\frac1{N^2}L^\dagger\mathrm{Rev}\, \operatorname{diag}(\bar P) (D^{\mathrm{in}})^\dagger (U^{(2)})^\dagger U^{(2)}D^{\mathrm{in}} \operatorname{diag}(P)\mathrm{Rev}\,L. \tag{16} \] This is an explicit finite matrix on the original complete module. Neither dephasing the t register nor dropping its P_t multiplier preserves (15) in general. There is also a genuine local angle weight, with its metric fully specified. For k=n-t and \(w_d(a,b,c)=1/(s_as_bs_c)\), define the THREE-PORT tensor \[ \widetilde U_{n;t,k}=\delta_{n,t+k}\, s_n^{-3/2}s_t^{3/2}s_k^{1/2}U^{(2)}_{n,t}. \] The exact reflection identity gives \[ \boxed{\displaystyle \frac1N|\widetilde U_{n;t,k}|^2 =w_d(t,k,d-n),\qquad t+k+(d-n)=d.} \tag{17} \] Its phase is the ACTUAL phase of \(Q^{-nt}F_{n-t}{n\brack t}_Q^2\). The factors \(s_n^{-3/2}s_t^{3/2}s_k^{1/2}\) are recorded length metrics; they cannot be applied to the two matrix ports while silently deleting the k port or the adjacent source metric. In terms of the existing length gauge A_a=(s_a^2/N)^(1/8), this factor is \(N^{1/4}A_n^{-6}A_t^6A_k^2\). Length zero has s0=1 and is retained. Thus the open packet contains a precise angle-simplex tensor and a coherent original factorial Green register. This is not a proof that every full packet energy is a geometric angle partition function: the complete prefix Lw, the P register, and the exterior length metrics still have to be controlled together. ## 5. Scope and audit The construction applies to arbitrary original prefixes and to arbitrary vectors in the complete W at the selected cut. It is not restricted to the one Casimir source plane. It proves a closed formula and a coherent energy identity; it does not prove a sharp broad-knot upper estimate. The known identity T_n(R12^(-1)R23 p)=|F_n|^2 is an additional prefix-specific cancellation, not a definition of this T. [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_terminal_packet_closed_kernel.py) constructs H, D, the two terminal original crossings, and their full physical projectors directly from the original generators. It compares every input column with (3), (6), (9), and (13); checks the exact rank and shifted-Durfee/Green identities; and verifies the literal angle metrics separately over the complex principal roots. The finite audit checks ten complete original open matrices at N=2,...,10,12, including every input column, original row-sum source and benchmark packet; eleven complex-root three-port angle-metric families. The [quantitative Green companion](actual_terminal_green_capacity_bound.md) combines the Pascal phases into the simpler exact form T=N^(-1)diag(x^n)R diag(P_(d-j))R. It uses the actual polynomial endpoint P_d to control all Green colors, and proves a one-crossing capacity bound for T R^(-1) with an arbitrary preceding input. It does not establish a broad sharp knot-volume bound.

title: A terminal coherent packet gives a positive Gram on the complete original module
text: # A terminal coherent packet gives a positive Gram on the complete original module 29 October 2026. A sharp packet norm need not be diagonal in complete Casimir channels, and its defining packet map need not be invertible. This note constructs a positive Gram on the SAME complete source module used by the original braid representation. It comes from a specified two-crossing terminal tangle, independently of the preceding word. For the original figure-eight prefix its energy has the sharp volume exponent. The construction extends as a source-exact Cauchy construction to arbitrary plat width; a sharp bound on its energy for general prefixes is NOT proved. ## 1. A positive completion of a coherent packet seminorm Let H be a finite-dimensional state space with fixed Euclidean norm. Suppose a prescribed boundary row factors as a=1^T T, where T:H->C^s is an EXPLICIT linear packet map. For any epsilon>0 set G_epsilon=T^*T+epsilon I. (1) This is positive definite even if T has a kernel. Its boundary cost is a G_epsilon^(-1) a^*<=s. (2) Indeed T(T^*T+epsilon I)^(-1)T^* has eigenvalues sigma^2/(sigma^2+epsilon)<=1, by singular-value decomposition. Apply it to the vector of s ones. Thus for every input w, |a w|^2<=s [sum_n |T_n w|^2+epsilon ||w||^2]. (3) The seminorm inequality without epsilon is also exact, by ordinary Cauchy in C^s. Equation (1) makes it a genuine positive inner product on the full original state space; it neither discards a channel nor asserts that the kernel of T is invariant under preceding braids. Use epsilon_N=exp(-N^2). If ||w_N||^2<=exp(C N log N) for a fixed word, its added energy is superexponentially small. No unknown knot value is used to choose epsilon. This completion is useful only when T is specified from a limited terminal packet and its coherent energy is independently estimable. Taking T to be the unknown entire closed period would give no new bound. ## 2. The complete original module and a specified terminal packet Use N>=2, d=N-1, q=exp(pi i/N), Q=q^2, x=q^d, F_a=(Q;Q)_a. All original Ecal,F,K, coproducts, full Cartan factors and sources are those in the [complete multiplicity theorem](actual_complete_source_multiplicity_module.md). Let W=(V tensor V)_(degree d), and write I_w:V->V^tensor3 for its complete intertwiner. Its lowest input column is the explicit map D w=I_w|d>=F_123^d H_L(w)/F_d, H_L(w)=sum_c (-xQ)^c E_12^c w/F_c tensor |c>. (4) This retains all N multiplicities and their full intermediate Jordan channels. The ordinary cap is the original row ell and the cup is p. Define the physical final row and terminal operator by c_top=ell_12 tensor <d|, U_phys=I tensor R_+^2, U=R_23^2 on W. (5) R_+ is the literal original checked crossing INCLUDING its common Cartan factor. Let Pi_n project the middle physical head to color n, with the other two heads untouched. Define the N-row packet T_n(w)=c_top U_phys Pi_n D w, 0<=n<N. (6) Every object in (4)--(6) is fixed before a preceding braid is supplied. In particular this does not use a closed knot value to choose a basis. Summing the physical resolution of identity gives exactly sum_n T_n=ell U. (7) To verify the last equality, the complete intertwiner theorem gives U_phys I_w=I_(Uw); closing its first two heads gives (ell tensor I)I_(Uw)=ell(Uw) I_V. Its input/output d entry is (7). This uses the actual whole source and its Hopf closure, not a replacement of an arbitrary marked row by an ordinary cap. For ANY original prefix B the unchanged closed scalar is therefore K_N=chi_N ell U Bp=chi_N sum_n T_n(Bp). (8) All original external factors remain in chi_N. The specified full marked closure is justified by the complete invariant-tensor theorem; arbitrary nonintertwining inserted exteriors retain their own source. Equations (1)--(3), with s=N, give a positive metric on the prefix cut. One can put it on the final complete module as well: G_final=U^(-*) (T^*T+epsilon_N I) U^(-1). (9) It obeys ell G_final^(-1)ell^*<=N. For the actual final state v=chi_N U Bp its energy is exactly v^*G_final v=|chi_N|^2 [sum_n |T_n(Bp)|^2+epsilon_N||Bp||^2]. (10) Thus this is a full-rank positive Gram on the SAME complete module as the Casimir metric. It does not identify two differently contracted scalar formulas without an actual linear map. No claim of invertibility of T is needed, at prime, even, or composite levels. ## 3. The actual figure-eight prefix has the sharp packet energy Take the literal prefix B=R_12^(-1)R_23. With the terminal U of (5), the full action order is [2,-1,2,2], the original zero-framed four-plat in the [whole-source proof](figure_eight_whole_source_identity.md). Its finite forced-transfer calculation can be kept open at the middle physical color n AFTER the second crossing. The initial lowest column I_p|d> is p tensor |d>. After the first two crossings the physical state is (d-k,a+k,d-a), so that n=a+k is precisely the projector index in (6), not a new auxiliary label. The final two crossings and the actual caps force their transfers to a and 0, respectively. Consequently the proof there, retaining its full Cartan and boundary factors, gives the ROW-BY-ROW identity T_n(Bp)=sum_(k=0)^n [n choose k]_Q (Q;Q)_k (Q^(-n);Q)_(n-k) =(-1)^n Q^[-n(n+1)/2] F_n^2 =|F_n|^2. (11) For the middle equality, reverse the last Pochhammer product and use the finite q-binomial identity; all factorial indices are below N. This is an exact statement about the uncontracted terminal packet on the complete module, not just equality after summing n. The original zero-framing normalization has chi_N=1 for this benchmark. Therefore (10) is E_final=sum_(n<N)|F_n|^4+exp(-N^2)||R_12^(-1)R_23p||^2. The uniform sine-factorial estimate proved in the packet note gives log(sum_(n<N)|F_n|^4)=N Vol(4_1)/pi+O(log N). (12) The last term is superexponentially small by Section 4 below. Thus this ACTUAL complete-module positive metric has the sharp energy rate. It mixes distinct Casimir channels; it is not a positive diagonal reweighting of their separate squared amplitudes. The estimate is reusable for every prefix with this fixed terminal tangle, but equation (11) is special to the displayed prefix. For another knot the full coherent quantities T_n(Bp) must be bounded; replacing them by sums of absolute values is not authorized. ## 4. The regularizer is negligible for fixed original braid words At the principal root, for 1<=j<N, 4/N<=|1-Q^j|<=2. Every original balanced signed crossing coefficient is a monomial of modulus one times a bounded number of factorial/Pochhammer ratios, each of length at most N-1. The explicit signed formulas therefore bound its logarithmic magnitude above by C N log N. A physical crossing has at most polynomially many entries at fixed braid width, so the same order bound holds for its operator norm. For a fixed prefix acting on the odd heads, the highest vector of the initial source is p tensor |0> (and p^tensor r tensor |0> at larger width), of polynomial norm. Apply its fixed number of physical signed crossings and extract the last color0 coefficient. This extraction IS the complete multiplicity inverse and has norm one. For an arbitrary EVEN-plat prefix, including crossings of the last marked partner, use the original invariant bottom p^tensor(r+1) instead. Its complete multiplicity inverse is (x^d/N) times extraction of the last TWO colors (0,d), as proved in the invariant-tensor source theorem. Both the initial norm and extraction cost are polynomial. These arguments prove ||B p||^2<=exp(C_B N log N), (13) and the same statement for the full all-width initial source. No ill-conditioned eigenframe or unestimated reduced inverse enters this proof. Equation (13) is a coarse original-source bound used only to control the regularizer; it is not offered as a volume estimate. ## 5. All-width extension and the remaining sharp theorem For 2k heads, r=k-1, let W_r and I_w:V->V^tensor(2r+1) be the complete original multiplicities. Put D_r w=I_w|d>, c_top=ell^tensor r tensor <d| and lambda=ell^tensor r. For a specified terminal braid U_phys on these odd heads and ANY specified mutually orthogonal physical-color projectors Pi_a summing to identity, set T_a=c_top U_phys Pi_a D_r. Exactly the same complete intertwiner calculation proves sum_a T_a=lambda U_red. Choosing a fixed number s of physical heads to record gives N^s packets and a dual norm at most N^s in (1). The literal last marked cap and all original normalizations are retained by the all-width invariant-tensor source theorem. This construction is valid for every preceding signed braid and at all N. The unresolved geometric problem is now the coherent estimate |chi_N|^2 sum_a |T_a(B w_0)|^2 <=exp(o(N)) Z_N(geometric angles). (14) This note proves the sharp energy rate (12) for the original figure-eight benchmark and provides a genuine complete-module realization of its sharp Gram. Comparison (14) then follows for any of the already proved positive geometric partitions with that same volume rate. It does not prove (14) for a broad knot class, or prove broad geometric survival. The new structural point is that a controlled physical terminal contraction can define the metric; an invertible global spectral frame is not required to do so. [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_terminal_packet_positive_gram.py) constructs the entire highest/lowest intertwiner, original signed crossings and the terminal physical projector rows independently of (11). It checks all rows, every input column of (7), and the positive-completion inequality on unrelated state vectors. The finite tests compare complete terminal modules, figure-eight packet families and positive full-module Grams. The proof keeps the full common Cartan scalar and uses the full even-plat inverse in its regularizer.

title: The retained terminal phase is an extra Cartan coupon, with exact Ward sources
text: # The retained terminal phase is an extra Cartan coupon, with exact Ward sources 29 October 2026. The positive terminal packet has an exact phase integral, but its phase is NOT the knot's existing meridian-color parameter. It inserts a specified Cartan coupon on one physical wire. Original interval Ward equations acquire explicit sources. A terminal ordinary cap projects back to the complete Hopf multiplicity module, leaving a nontrivial, explicit operator-valued coupon there. Neither that projection nor Parseval makes the coupon an original Hurwitz crossing or a transparent frame change. Thus the sharp terminal-energy theorem remains a coherent estimate of this extra coupling. The original scalar at phase one and its Cauchy bound are unchanged. No topological identification with a drilled link or with an existing peripheral variable is made by analogy. ## 1. The exact phase family of the original terminal packet Use the original notation of [the terminal positive Gram](actual_terminal_packet_positive_gram.md): N>=2, d=N-1, Q=exp(2pi i/N), x=-exp(-pi i/N), and D w=I_w|d>, c=ell_12 tensor <d|, U_phys=I tensor R_+^2, U_red=R_23^2, T_n=c U_phys Pi_(2,n) D. All common Cartan, ordinary-cap, framing and peripheral factors are literal original ones. Put C_t=t^(J_2), J_2|a,b,c>=b|a,b,c>, t!=0. Then, as a ROW IDENTITY on every complete multiplicity input, F_t=c U_phys C_t D=sum_(n=0)^d t^n T_n, F_1=ell U_red. (1) For every original prefix B, sum_n |T_n(Bp)|^2 =(1/(2pi)) integral_0^(2pi)|F_(exp(i theta))(Bp)|^2 dtheta. (2) The unchanged original scalar is chi_N F_1(Bp). Its given factor chi_N remains outside (2). The family off t=1 uses the fixed input and output d cut in the definition above. Scalarity of the original uninserted knot does not identify other cut prescriptions off t=1. In particular (1) is the specified packet deformation of a valid original-scalar presentation. It is NOT asserted equal to inserting C_t into an unreduced even plat and then replacing its unrestricted marked row by the same lowest cut. That different off-phase observable must retain its literal marked matrix functional. The exact terminal Cauchy estimate needs only the prescribed (1) and the original t=1 sum, so it makes no such replacement. ## 2. Literal quantum Ward identities with t retained On the physical middle head, including both nilpotent endpoints, C_t F_2 C_t^(-1)=t F_2, C_t Ecal_2 C_t^(-1)=t^(-1)Ecal_2, [C_t,K_i]=[C_t,H_i]=0, all i. (3) In particular every single-head Casimir and its central K^N stay fixed. The actual meridian family x=-M/q instead changes K by M and its Casimir to -(M+M^(-1)). Thus (3) is an independent relative Cartan conjugation on a FIXED-color module, not that meridian family. Write the literal three-head coproducts as Ftot=F_1+K_1^(-1)F_2+K_1^(-1)K_2^(-1)F_3, Etot=Ecal_1 K_2K_3+Ecal_2 K_3+Ecal_3, At=K_1^(-1)F_2, Bt=Ecal_2 K_3. They obey the ALL-EXTERIOR matrix identities [Ftot,C_t]=(1-t)At C_t, [Etot,C_t]=(1-t^(-1))Bt C_t, [Ktot,C_t]=0, [Omega_tot,C_t] =(1-t^(-1))Ftot Bt C_t+(1-t)At C_t Etot. (4) There is no omitted boundary arrow or small-error term. At larger width the same formulas replace At by K_1^(-1)...K_(r-1)^(-1)F_r and Bt by Ecal_r K_(r+1)...K_b. The defect is macroscopic on an ACTUAL original source. For w=p, D p=p_12 tensor |d>, Ftot Dp=0. For |t|=1 equation (4) gives ||Ftot C_t Dp||/||Dp||=sqrt(2)|1-t|, EVERY N>=2. (5) Indeed F_2 sends the u-th cup term to a distinct state with coefficient 1-Q^(-u). Original cup terms have modulus N, the K-prefix and C_t are unitary, and sum_(u=0)^d |1-Q^u|^2=2N.
