Both squared source norms in (5) retain their exact N^3 factor. Thus an order-one unit phase does not preserve the old lowest-source Ward by an O(1/N) error. The exact interval-cap identities DO persist after conjugating ALL their operators and their cap/cup by C_t. If iota_p is an original cup insertion, then iota_(p,t)=C_t iota_p satisfies the conjugated interval identities with Omega^(t)=C_t Omega C_t^(-1). Without that simultaneous change the source terms (4) remain. Keeping the rest of the original word unchanged is precisely the relative seam. ## 3. Projection back to the complete module does not delete the coupon One must not conclude from (4) that the final amplitude has left the total character forever. The terminal ordinary cap is a Hopf map; the following exact projection accounts for this. Set F_d=(Q;Q)_d=N, xi_d=product_(a=1)^d(Q^(-a)-1)=(-1)^d N. Let R_high extract the components |u,d-u,0> of a highest degree-d vector. On physical degree 2d define P_low=Ftot^d Etot^d/(F_d xi_d), M_t=xi_d^(-1) R_high Etot^d C_t D. (6) Then P_low is an idempotent onto the LOWEST degree-2d slice of the COMPLETE total-Casimir-minus-two isotypic component. It has not been declared orthogonal in the physical norm. To prove the statement, Etot^d of any degree-2d vector is highest of degree d because Etot^N=0. The complete highest-vector theorem identifies it with H_L(w). Also Etot^d D w=xi_d H_L(w) and Ftot^d H_L(w)=F_d D w. Therefore P_low D=D and P_low C_t D=D M_t, M_1=I. (7) The original terminal row has c U_phys P_low=c U_phys on that degree slice. This can be checked without a spectral assumption: ordinary-cap naturality replaces Ftot and Etot by the remaining single-head F and E, while <d|F^d=F_d<0| and <0|E^d=xi_d<d|. Consequently the precise ALL-INPUT identity is F_t=ell U_red M_t. (8) Expanding M_t=sum_n t^n M_n gives sum_n M_n=I and T_n=ell U_red M_n. All N original multiplicities remain; no period or unknown amplitude was used in this completion. The resulting M_t is generally neither scalar nor unitary and its coefficients M_n need not be positive or projectors. Already at N=2, in the original degree-one physical multiplicity basis, M_t=[[t,0],[i(t-1),2-t]]. (9) This follows from the original E/F/H_L/D matrices in (6), not a chosen interpolation. M_0^2!=M_0, and at t=-1 the operator has eigenvalue three. Thus physical unitarity of C_t does not give a contractive effective coupon after the nonorthogonal Hopf projection. The complete total character has been restored in (8), but the original operator factorization has acquired the additional M_t. No specific semiclassical canonical graph for M_t is inferred from the finite-level example (9) alone. ## 4. What the doubled phase average matches On the recorded head, Parseval inserts the exact doubled projector D_clock=sum_n Pi_n tensor bar(Pi_n) =(1/(2pi)) integral C_(exp(i theta)) tensor bar(C_(exp(i theta))) dtheta. (10) It matches the integer recorded colors in the two copies. It commutes with their Cartan clocks. It does NOT commute with the independent raising/lowering Ward operators. For example, (F_2 tensor I)D_clock|0,0>=(1-Q)|1,0>, whereas D_clock(F_2 tensor I)|0,0>=0. The same nonzero example works at every N>=2, with physical endpoints retained. Thus (10) is a Cartan matching condition, not a full inverse-meridian matrix equation. It does not by itself reestablish the faithful cap interval certificate for a transparent middle wire. Effective projection (8) instead retains its entire nontrivial operator M_t on both copies. Classically, in an unbased Gauss frame the seam sends (k,e,f)->(k,t^(-1)e,t f), G->h_t G h_t^(-1), h_t=diag(t^(-1/2),t^(1/2)). (11) The square-root sign has no effect on this conjugation. Based meridians to its right also change through their actual L_- prefixes; they may not be held fixed while ignoring that change. This is a relative Cartan-frame transition. It is not generally a peripheral longitude, either: h_t need not commute with the physical meridian G. ## 5. Precise geometric implication The original scalar at t=1 and the positive terminal Cauchy Gram are fully source-exact. At a retained nontrivial phase the equations are the TWISTED equations (4), or equivalently the completed coupon (8). The phase has unchanged color/central powers and so cannot simply be renamed the existing meridian parameter. No theorem here identifies it with a drilled-component holonomy; that would need its own explicit topological/source construction. To apply the original-knot representation-volume bound to all critical contributions of (2), one still needs to prove that this additional seam's complete stationary equations make it transparent, or bound the full M_t coupling with the correct calibrated action. Color equality in (10), or total-Casimir recovery in (8), does not prove that statement. The exact figure-eight energy identity in the terminal-Gram note is unchanged; it is a coherent special calculation of this same family. [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_terminal_phase_coupon_ward.py): literal coproduct Ward operators, full lowest/Hermite multiplicity maps, every input column of (8), all packet coefficients, the exact N=2 coupon, and the macroscopic original-source norm in (5). The terminal Ward checks do not establish closed-knot geometry.

title: An exact original-source jet test for the shrinking-arc metric
text: # An exact original-source jet test for the shrinking-arc metric 29 October 2026. This records an exact original prefix, its complete terminal polynomial, and high-precision evaluations of its first jet and FULL finite Cayley-arc energy. The closed scalar is proved polynomially bounded. The data show amplified jets at the tested levels. An all-N positive exponential jet rate has NOT been proved here, so this is not an asymptotic counterexample to the shrinking-arc proposal. No conclusion about the coefficient of an escaping classical branch is inferred from its character equations. The actual quantum quantities below are evaluated directly from the original finite matrices. ## 1. The literal source prefix and its exact coefficients Keep N>=2,d=N-1,q=exp(pi*i/N),Q=q^2,x=q^d=-q^-1, F_j=(Q;Q)_j,kappa=q^(d^2/2). Use the COMPLETE original Hom module W=(V tensor V)_(integer degree d), the original cup p_j=Nx^(j-d), and the original adjacent signed generators R_12,R_23. Let R be the literal positive pair crossing on W, INCLUDING kappa, and T the [complete original terminal packet](actual_terminal_packet_closed_kernel.md). The prefix in this test is B=R_12 R_23^(-1), so the true full chronological word is [-2,1,2,2], with the same ordinary/marked whole source as in the terminal theorem. It is not a newly chosen vector at the terminal cut. The prefix state has an elementary EXACT formula: R_23^(-1)p=N kappa^(-1)e_d, v_j=(Bp)_j=N^2 x^(j-d)/F_(d-j). (1) For a proof of the first identity, apply the original negative crossing to the highest source p_12 tensor |0>. Its negative transfer must be zero because the second input is0. The outgoing third color is then the old second color. Extracting third color0 leaves only the old cup component |d,0>, of coefficient N, with crossing scalar kappa^-1. This extraction is the inverse of the COMPLETE highest Hom chart, so no arbitrary physical projection is imposed. The strict original positive coefficient R_(j,d)=kappa N x^(j-d)/F_(d-j) gives (1). Define the actual recorded-color polynomial and its coefficients by f_N(t)=sum_(n=0)^d a_(N,n)t^n, a_N=Tv. (2) The complete terminal factorization gives an efficient expression with NO dense inverse: T=N^-1 X R P_rev R, X=diag(x^n), P_0=1, P_j=(1-Q^j)^2P_(j-1)+Q^j, P_rev=diag(P_(d-j)). (3) Thus, explicitly, a_(N,n)=x^n/N sum_(i,j) R_(n,i) P_(d-i) R_(i,j) N^2x^(j-d)/F_(d-j). (4) Equations (1)--(4) retain every original Cartan factor, finite endpoint, cup/cap normalization and coherent Green summation. They are complete source identities, not isolated paths or critical-point ansatzes. The external original scalar chi_N multiplies all of (2), its jets and the corresponding squared energy by its stated exact factors. It is not absorbed into T or fitted from a knot value. ## 2. The raw closed value is polynomial: a direct source proof The exact original terminal ROW, from the cap/Hopf calculation, is sum_n T_(n,j)=(xQ)^(j-d)/N. (5) This is equation (18) of [the effective-Cartan source calculation](actual_terminal_effective_cartan_kernel_and_graph.md), and is independently checked here on every input column using the original physical projectors. Combining (1),(5) and x^2Q=1 gives f_N(1)=N sum_(j=0)^d 1/F_(d-j) =sum_(j=0)^d conjugate(F_j) =conjugate(P_d). (6) The second identity uses F_(d-j) conjugate(F_j)=N. The whole endpoint source estimate in [the terminal Green theorem](actual_terminal_green_capacity_bound.md) proves |P_d|<=3N^2 at ALL parities and composite levels. Hence |f_N(1)|<=3N^2. (7) This proof uses coherent source identities; replacing the sum by sum |F_j| would lose the polynomial bound. For topological context, the original marked four-plat has rational slope3/2: T^2 U^-1 T^-1(0,1)^T=(3,2)^T in the established cap marking. The proof of (6)--(7) does not require a knot census or a framing guess. ## 3. Exact finite first-jet and arc-energy formulas The centered physical first jet is D_N=2f_N'(1)-d f_N(1) =sum_(n=0)^d(2n-d)a_(N,n). (8) It is a recorded PHYSICAL clock moment. It is not identified with an original meridian derivative or an ordinary-color q-jet. Such an identification would require another source/normal Ward theorem. There is a stable complete-polynomial calculation of the proposed arc energy. Define integers K_r(n) by K_0(n)=1, K_1(n)=2n-d, (r+1)K_(r+1)(n)=(2n-d)K_r(n)-(d-r+1)K_(r-1)(n). These are exactly the coefficients of (1+z)^n(1-z)^(d-n). Consequently the ENTIRE Cayley polynomial is Q(y)=(1-iy)^d f_N((1+iy)/(1-iy))=sum_(r=0)^d c_r y^r, c_r=i^r sum_n K_r(n)a_(N,n), c_1=iD_N. (9) For a prescribed arc width h>0 its normalized weighted energy is therefore the exact FINITE sum E_h=1/2 integral_(-1)^1 |Q(hs)|^2 ds =sum_(r+s even) h^(r+s)c_r conjugate(c_s)/(r+s+1). (10) All degrees0,...,d and mixed terms are retained. This is not a Taylor truncation, quadrature approximation, or a sum of independently estimated jets. The original unweighted arc energy E_h^0 obeys E_h/(1+h^2)^d <= E_h^0 <= E_h. (11) The independently proved [sharp derivative-evaluation norm](actual_shrinking_arc_cauchy_metric.md) also gives the exact necessary lower test E_h>=h^2 |D_N|^2/D_d, D_d=[(2r+1)(2r+3)binom(2r,r)/4^r]^2/3, r=floor((d-1)/2). (12) Thus a PROVED positive exponential rate for this actual D_N would prove excessive energy for EVERY polynomial width h=N^-A, A>0. The present data do not prove that rate. They do show which exact source insertion must be controlled before using a shrinking arc. ### The missing normal current is an explicit all-input row Let r=(x^j)_(j=0)^d be a ROW and J=diag(0,...,d). The original cup eigenrelation and the symmetric physical pair crossing give rR=kappa r. Set F_row(t)=sum_n t^n T_n, so f_N(t)=F_row(t)v. Using (3) and differentiating only this recorded phase gives the following identity on EVERY complete input: F_row'(1)=N^-1 r J R P_rev R =(kappa/N) r J P_rev R +N^-1 r[J,R]P_rev R, (13) [J,R]_(c,a)=(c-a)R_(c,a). The same full R and Green register occur on both sides; in particular P_rev is not commuted through a crossing. Applied to v in (1), (13) is the literal first derivative in (8). This specifies an original matrix-valued normal current before the final source pairing. It is not a new meridian Ward identity. A proposed coherent cancellation must transport the second row in (13), with its neighboring factors, or supply its compensated source; the unweighted row identity (5) does not set this current to zero. No exponential estimate for either separate term is asserted. ## 4. High-precision data, explicitly diagnostic The table uses the raw original source above, natural logarithms, and the FULL weighted energy (10) with h=N^-2. | N | log abs f_N(1)/N | log abs D_N/N | log E_h/N | |---:|---:|---:|---:| | 16 | .259042 | .694506 | .637717 | | 32 | .162528 | .604089 | .740650 | | 64 | .097444 | .543196 | .809301 | | 128 | .056861 | .504738 | .849268 | | 256 | .032490 | .481476 | .872016 | At N=32,64,128,256 the ratios of E_h to the first-linear-jet energy h^2|D_N|^2/3 are respectively1.000644,1.000278,1.000105,1.000037. This is a diagnostic comparison of the ENTIRE polynomial with its first-jet contribution, not an all-N error estimate. The raw value trend is explained by the proved bound (7). The jet and energy trends suggest amplification but are not a rigorous asymptotic lower bound. In particular no limiting rate is fitted or asserted, and no comparison with a different knot's geometric action is used as proof. The missing statement is a source-derived bound, cancellation, or exact asymptotic for the normal insertion (8). ## 5. Audit and current limitation [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_terminal_shrinking_arc_jet_diagnostic.py) uses original E/F/R matrices and physical terminal projectors for nine exact finite-root source checks. It verifies (1),(3),(5),(6), all normalizers, the full first-jet coefficients, and the all-input normal-current row (13). Ten high-precision profiles through N=256 then use only the finite R matrices and the coherent first-order Green recurrence; there is no numerical inversion. The Krawtchouk recurrence computes ALL coefficients in (9), followed by the complete monomial Gram (10). At N=128, increasing working precision from228 to360 decimal digits changes the centered first jet by less than2.2e-198 relatively and the complete energies at h=N^-1,N^-2 by less than1.7e-198. These checks make the finite diagnostic reproducible; they do not replace an analytic exponent theorem. The closed source bound is proved, while positive exponential growth of D_N and failure of all polynomial shrinking arcs for this source remain explicitly UNPROVED.

title: An original cup slide exposes an amplified normalization packet
text: # An original cup slide exposes an amplified normalization packet 29 October 2026. The problematic vector in the terminal-Gram transport test is reached by a FIXED original braid prefix applied to the original cup. The complete recorded packet after one further crossing has positive exponential energy, although its original closed scalar is a unit phase. There is also an explicit coherent factorial divergence which removes this amplification at the normalization closure. This is a finite Ward packet with its endpoint retained, rather than a deletion of individual channels or a new positive trace. The result concerns the present full-circle/recorded-color metric. It does not rule out a nondiagonal coherent metric, a shrinking arc, or a sharp estimate on a source after coherent normalization pruning. The [backward Ward disk estimate](actual_normalization_clock_disk_bound.md) now proves subexponential shrinking-arc energy for this SAME original normalization packet, including its whole germ and specified sublinear clock-frequency exteriors. ## 1. A literal source identity on every input color Use the original complete multiplicity conventions: N>=2, d=N-1, q=exp(pi i/N), Q=q^2, x=q^d=-q^-1, F_j=(Q;Q)_j, kappa=q^(d^2/2), kappa^2=x^d, W=(V tensor V)_(integer degree d), e_j=|j,d-j>, p_j=N x^(j-d), ell_j=x^j/N. Let R=R_12 be the FULL original positive pair crossing on W and R_23 its adjacent complete multiplicity operator. The original highest chart, applied to the literal physical crossing, gives (R_23 p)_j=kappa N x^(j-d) F_(d-j), (R^(-1)e_0)_j=kappa^(-1)x^j F_(d-j). Consequently the exact source-orbit identities are R_23 p=N R^(-1)e_0, R R_23 p=N e_0. (1) There is no arbitrary inserted state in (1). The Cartan identity kappa^2=x^d fixes the coefficient N at every even or composite level. The negative coefficient is the literal original inverse crossing, not a unitary adjoint. For completeness the second identity has a direct finite-binomial proof. Multiplying the original positive coefficients yields (R R_23 p)_i =N x^(-i) Q^[i(d-i)] F_i sum_(k=0)^i (Q^(-i);Q)_k Q^(ik)/F_k =N x^(-i) Q^[i(d-i)] F_i (1;Q)_i =N delta_(i,0). (2) Every factorial denominator in this calculation has index below N. The equality is the highest column of the all-input physical cup slide (R_12 R_23)(p_12 tensor I_V)=I_V tensor p_23. (3) Indeed both sides intertwine the ACTUAL coproduct. Applying its F^a/F_a to the verified highest column proves (3) on every original |a>, 0<=a<N. Thus (3) is an operator identity and can be tensored with arbitrary spectator ports. No scalar-knot Schur argument or replacement of the marked row is used. ## 2. Complete terminal packets and their original closed scalars Keep the [full terminal operator](actual_terminal_packet_closed_kernel.md) T=N^(-1) X R P_rev R, X=diag(x^j), P_0=1, P_j=(1-Q^j)^2 P_(j-1)+Q^j, P_rev=diag(P_(d-j)), P_d=sum_(j=0)^d F_j. (4) Its physical-projector rows sum to the original ordinary/marked whole co-source after the two terminal crossings. This is the SAME complete source as in the [positive terminal Gram](actual_terminal_packet_positive_gram.md). Retain the original external factor chi_N on every side below. The two actual prefixes [2] and [2,1] give the exact vector formulas T R_23 p=kappa P_d e_d, b:=T R R_23 p =x^(-d) (Q^(-j) conjugate(F_j))_(j=0)^d. (5) To check the first formula, write T R^(-1)=N^(-1)X R P_rev, use (1) and R e_0=kappa x^(-d)e_d. For the second use (R e_d)_j=kappa N x^(j-d)/F_(d-j), F_(d-j) conjugate(F_j)=N, x^2=Q^(-1), kappa^2=x^d. These retain all coherent Green summation; P_j is never replaced by its absolute envelope. In particular ||T R_23p||^2=|P_d|^2<=9N^4, ||T R R_23p||^2=Z_N:=sum_(j=0)^d |F_j|^2. (6) The first bound is the original endpoint theorem in the [Green-capacity proof](actual_terminal_green_capacity_bound.md). It is not a bound on the sum of absolute factorials. Both original closed scalars remain explicit: 1^T T R_23p=kappa P_d, 1^T b=x^(-d) Q. (7) For the last equality, Q^(j+1)F_j=F_j-F_(j+1), with F_N=0, implies sum_j Q^(-j)conjugate(F_j)=Q. Thus the second full word [2,1,2,2] is a normalization source with raw scalar of modulus one. No phase is fitted from its scalar value. The original chi_N multiplies both this scalar and the corresponding packet; any specified framing normalization remains literal. The usual uniform factorial estimate, with J(t)=integral_0^t log(2sin(pi s))ds, gives log Z_N=N v_3/pi+O(log N), (8) where v_3 is the volume of the regular ideal tetrahedron. Its proof is elementary: log|F_j|=N J(j/N)+O(log N) uniformly to both endpoints, and J has maximum v_3/(2pi) at5/6. A nearest lattice point supplies the lower bound; N terms supply the upper bound. Thus a fixed original source trajectory, rather than only an arbitrary all-port vector, realizes the exponential metric-motion obstruction in [the terminal-Gram test](actual_terminal_gram_lyapunov_obstruction.md). With epsilon=exp(-N^2), the same exact regularized quotient there is obtained after multiplying both test vectors by N. A source-dependent changing metric or a further coherent packet is not excluded. ## 3. Exact coherent pruning and the retained exterior current The amplified vector (5) is a particularly simple finite divergence. Put G_j=conjugate(F_j) for0<=j<N and G_N=0. Then b_j=x^(-d) Q(G_j-G_(j+1)). (9) For ANY row f_j of scalar, vector or operator-valued spectator coefficients, distributivity alone proves sum_j f_j b_j =x^(-d)Q [f_0+sum_(j=1)^d(f_j-f_(j-1))G_j]. (10) No commutativity of the f_j is needed. The factorial factors G_j are fixed scalars. The original constant closing row kills the interior differences and retains the unit endpoint f_0. A general exterior instead keeps the explicit finite-difference current in (10). The difference matrix in (9) has operator norm at most2, and its finite cumulative inverse has norm at most N. These are coefficient bounds; G itself has exponential norm. Accordingly (10) supplies a source-preserving coherent normalization pruning operation. It does NOT give a bound for a general exterior by dropping its difference. This is the exact point at which an iterated bridge estimate needs the neighboring original Ward equations or another coherent identity. ## 4. Arbitrary diagonal recorded-color metrics cannot repair this source For any positive diagonal packet metric D=diag(w_j), including weights with arbitrary N dependence, the complete Cauchy budget is (1^T D^(-1)1)(b^*Db) =(sum_j w_j^(-1))(sum_j w_j |F_j|^2) >=(sum_j |F_j|)^2. (11) The minimum is exactly the right side: choose w_j=1/|F_j|, since every F_j with j<N is nonzero. Uniform factorial asymptotics show its logarithmic rate is again N v_3/pi+O(log N), while the squared raw scalar in (7) is one. This is a complete coherent packet counterexample to a diagonal recorded-color metric, not a sum of isolated shear paths. A genuinely nondiagonal metric can retain the telescoping in (9). Neither (11) nor the full-circle energy proves failure of the [shrinking-arc metric](actual_shrinking_arc_cauchy_metric.md). Indeed the first jet of this particular packet is still polynomial: summation by parts gives sum_j j b_j=x^(-d)Q conjugate(P_d-1). In fact the [whole normalization germ](actual_normalization_clock_disk_bound.md) is polynomial on disks of radius C/N, and subexponential on EVERY shrinking disk. Its shrinking-arc energy therefore has rate zero. This uses the complete backward Ward recurrence, beyond the first-jet identity above. The distinct source in [the jet diagnostic](actual_terminal_shrinking_arc_jet_diagnostic.md) still has no proved positive all-N jet exponent. ## 5. Audit and scope [The audit](../experiments/audit_actual_terminal_source_normalization_packet.py) checks (3) on EVERY physical input color directly from the original signed matrices, not from a chosen reduced R_23. It also extracts the complete highest chart, verifies (1),(5)--(7) on every retained packet, and checks (10) with noncommuting spectator matrices. Complex tests verify the complete energies and the optimized diagonal budget. The algebraic and asymptotic proofs above are all-level. The resulting normalization move is source-exact and usable with arbitrary spectators; the remaining finite-difference exterior in (10) is retained. No broad knot-volume upper bound or selected geometric noncancellation follows. The finite terminal checks concern the displayed normalization identities only.

title: Three complete belts: the saturated source and the marked-pair obstruction
text: # Three complete belts: the saturated source and the marked-pair obstruction 29 October 2026. On the genuine six-head saturated source, three disjoint positive complete-circle forms define an explicit positive Gram. They do NOT have a finite dual norm for the original marked co-source. There is an all-level source vector whose three-belt energy is zero and whose original marked evaluation is exactly ONE. The correctly typed original cap inequality uses C tensor C tensor H, not C tensor C tensor C. It detects the same vector with a polynomial lower bound. Thus a simple tensor-cube DCT or a scalar Frobenius branch cannot be used to claim a marked trivalent source theorem. This result retains the full divided-current kernel and root normals. ## 1. The actual six-port space and the three circle operators Use d=N-1, q=exp(pi i/N), Q=q^2, x=q^d, N>=2. The balanced physical generators are Ecal=-F^dagger, K^dagger=K^-1. Let L=(-1)^d U_d(Omega/2), C=P L>=0, H=L P=P C P>=0, where P exchanges the two physical legs, not a braid crossing. All the literal ordinary-circle pivots and Cartan phases are retained. Their positivity and kernels are the [complete-circle theorem](actual_complete_circle_reflection_positive.md). Let S be the SATURATED generic-q specialization inside the full six-head H=0 invariants. The [divided-power source theorem](actual_six_port_divided_power_source_kernel.md) identifies it, with every original cup/braid word included, as S = Inv_root,H=0 intersect ker J_E,6, ext(S)=ker(J_E,4:W->Llow), W=(V_N^tensor4)_(degree2d), dim S=(N^3+N)/2. (1) The maps Phi:W->Inv and ext are the specified actual source maps, with ext extracting final physical colors(0,d) times x^d/N. No semisimple projection is substituted for (1). On W the three disjoint physical pair Casimirs become A1=Omega12, A2=Omega34, A3=F4 Ecal4+(q+q^-1)I. (2) For completeness A3 is EXACTLY ext Omega56 Phi. Split the six heads into A=1234 and B=56. On an invariant vector, E_B=-K_B E_A, F_B=-K_A F_A, K_B=K_A^-1. Using F_B K_B=Q K_B F_B and E_A K_A=Q^-1 K_A E_A gives F_B E_B=E_A F_A on that vector. The actual commutator [Ecal_A,F_A]=(q-q^-1)(K_A-K_A^-1) therefore turns Omega_B into Omega_A. On W, K_A=1, proving (2). In particular the reduced operators in (2) are not guessed trace variables. They commute on the actual invariant space and preserve S. The positive unmarked-belt form is G_C(v,v)=v^dagger(C12 tensor C34 tensor C56)v. (3) Its kernel equals that of L12 L34 L56, since the product of the three physical P maps is invertible. This kernel assertion does not identify (3) with an original marked link closure. ## 2. Full cluster projectors, including their first normals Let c0=q+q^-1. Its actual root cluster is {0,d}: c0=cd, and it is DOUBLE for every N>=2. The distinct other nodes are c_j=q^(2j+1)+q^(-2j-1), 1<=j<=floor(d/2). Let e0(z) be the FULL Hermite cluster polynomial: value one and derivative zero at c0, and value/derivative zero at the other double nodes (value zero at the possible odd simple node). It may be given by l0(z)=product_(c!=c0)(z-c)/(c0-c), e0(z)=l0(z)^2[1-2l0'(c0)(z-c0)] mod P_N(z). (4) All denominators are nonzero at the fixed level. Thus e0(Ai) is an actual root cluster projector, not an eigenvalue-only substitution. Write E000=e0(A1)e0(A2)e0(A3). It preserves S and every root normal within the chosen joint cluster. Its rank on S is five, as also follows from the five admissible generic branches of {0,d}^3. The regular generic pair projectors give an elementary annihilation identity. The branch (d,0,0) has no generic invariant: a positive spin d cannot couple two spin-zero channels to an invariant. Its joint projector is therefore zero on the saturated generic source lattice. Multiply this projector by the THREE within-cluster gap denominators before specializing q. This gives on E000 S (A1-c0)(A2-c0)(A3-c0)=0. (5) There is no division by a root-zero gap in (5); it is the root value of an exact cleared generic identity on the actual lattice. The complete circle on this cluster is L_N(Ai)E000=L_N'(c0)(Ai-c0)E000, (4-c0^2)L_N'(c0)=(-1)^d 2N !=0. Consequently, with ALL first normal data retained, L_N(A1)L_N(A2)L_N(A3)E000 S=0. (6) This argument does not assume that a rank-eight generic cube would specialize to a regular three-variable dual-number module. ## 3. An original planar source whose marked value survives Take the actual nested planar cups joining physical ends (1,6),(2,3),(4,5). The original cup is p_(a,b)=N x^(-b) delta_(a+b,d). Let v_triangle be their tensor insertion in the physical order. It has the regular generic cup lift, so belongs to S. Its exact W coordinate w_triangle=ext(v_triangle) is w_triangle_(0,b,d-b,d)=N^2 x^(-(d-b)), 0<=b<=d, all other coefficients zero. (7) The original whole marked co-source on W is lambda=ell12 tensor ell34, ell_(a,b)=x^a/N delta_(a+b,d). (8) This is the result of the full six-head invariant identity, not a local replacement of an unrestricted marked row. The only surviving term in lambda w_triangle is b=d, and hence lambda w_triangle=1. (9) On the whole invariant source lambda is a left c0 eigenvector of ALL three Ai. For A1,A2 this is the original ordinary-cap intertwining equation. After those two caps the remaining pair is an actual invariant cup, with Casimir c0; applying the full marked row afterward proves the A3 assertion too. Thus lambda E000=lambda on S. Set u=Phi E000 w_triangle. It is an explicit nonzero original saturated-source vector, with regular cluster coupons and no unknown knot invariant in its definition. Equations (6),(9) prove G_C(u,u)=0, original_marked_row(u)=1. (10) Therefore there is NO finite constant B_N, even one allowed to grow exponentially, such that the original marked functional satisfies |original_marked_row(v)|^2 <= B_N G_C(v,v) for all v in S. This is an actual source Riesz obstruction, not a generic indefinite-metric example or an absolute-value estimate. It does not assert a counterexample to a closed link's volume limit: u uses known Casimir cluster coupons, and the failed statement is the proposed all-exterior marked positive sewing theorem. ## 4. The genuine marked metric evades the obstruction The correctly typed original three-pair form is G_m(v,v)=v^dagger(C12 tensor C34 tensor H56)v. (11) The [original cap/source inequality](actual_complete_circle_positive_quotient.md#5-the-complete-original-boundary-has-a-positive-cauchy-form) gives, after the WHOLE degree restriction of the marked pair, |original_marked_row(v)|^2 <= G_m(v,v)/(8N^11) for every six-head invariant v. (12) In particular the same explicit source vector (10) satisfies G_m(u,u)>=8N^11, while G_C(u,u)=0. (13) The distinction is the physical last-pair reversal, not a harmless choice of positive inner-product coordinates. Writing H=P C P moves that P onto the source vector; a single-pair flip does NOT preserve the original ordered six-head Hopf invariant space. Thus the joint simplex support of the three unreflected pair-Casimir product cannot simply be transferred to (11) by keeping S unchanged. Exact full-source diagnostics give ranks of the two forms on S: | N | dim S | rank G_C | rank G_m | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 2 | 5 | 0 | 1 | | 3 | 15 | 4 | 6 | | 4 | 34 | 1 | 6 | | 5 | 65 | 10 | 19 | These finite ranks illustrate the already proved all-N distinction (10)--(13); no rank trend is used as proof of a limiting theorem. ## 5. What remains possible at a genuine trivalent junction For the three-C observation, joint positivity gives a sum of positive channel weights, but its original source dual already fails (10). The joint branch geometry also removes a full tensor-cube DCT: missing admissible joint nodes cannot reconstruct arbitrary products of three independent half-bandwidth polynomials. A correct simplex interpolation/angle weight would describe that observed quotient, not restore the missing marked functional. One may instead keep (11), change the entire reflected source by the actual duality/permutation braid, or point an auxiliary belt using its FULL open-loop normal source. Each is a concrete different physical problem. The present result neither deletes that current nor identifies a physical leg flip with an added crossing. A geometric trivalent-source survival theorem would need such a source-compatible kernel before its angle or DCT estimate. There is an explicit correctly marked all-input kernel, useful for stating that next problem without an unknown recoupling frame. Use the orthonormal single-pair quotient rows of the [positive circle quotient](actual_complete_circle_positive_quotient.md), pi_(j,r) = w_(j,r)^dagger C / sqrt(g_j beta(2j,r)), w_(j,r)=F_pair^r E_j(Omega)|0,d-j>/F_r, 0<=j<=floor(d/2), 0<=r<=2j. Here E_j is the stated value Lagrange polynomial; use of values is valid only AFTER its actual complete-circle map, and its g_j, factorials and angle normalizations are exactly those proved there. Define on every W input by the FULL original Phi K_(j1,r1;j2,r2;j3,r3)(w) =(pi_(j1,r1) tensor pi_(j2,r2) tensor pi_(j3,r3) P56)Phi_w. (14) Then G_m(Phi_w,Phi_w) is EXACTLY the sum of |K|^2 over all these indices. Integer degree imposes r1+r2+r3=j1+j2+j3, including every endpoint. The original scalar, not an auxiliary unknown invariant, is precisely lambda w = K_(0,0;0,0;0,0)(w)/(sqrt(8) N^(11/2)). (15) This explains the polynomial dual constant in (12). It also locates the missing moment-map constraint. With Pi=pi tensor pi tensor pi, the vector K=Pi P56 v for v in S satisfies E_Q,total K=Pi [Ecal_6,P56]v, F_Q,total K=Pi [F_6,P56]v, (16) not the zero-current trivalent invariant equations. The actual ordered coproducts give the LOCAL currents [Ecal_6,P56] =[E5(K6-1)-E6(K5-1)]P56, [F_6,P56] =K1234^-1 [F5(1-K6^-1)-F6(1-K5^-1)]P56. (17) These follow by exchanging physical legs5,6 in the displayed coproduct, and are exact finite operators. Thus the marked kernel already has genuine normal/momentum data beyond three independent node values. Setting (17) to zero would change the original source. Bounding the coherent kernel (14), or constructing a differently pointed reflected closure with its full source, remains the next analytic step; the tensor-cube sampling proof does not supply it. Audit: [literal six-head source, full Hermite projector and marked/unmarked forms](../experiments/audit_actual_three_belt_saturated_source_and_marked_metric.py). The source-compatible multivariate positive correction is now [the marked middle-degree Chebyshev packet](actual_marked_multiport_chebyshev_source_packet.md), with an explicit original corner and tensor Parseval. Its geometric energy estimate remains separate.

title: Exact three-port Cauchy transport and a nontrivial projected cube kernel
text: # Exact three-port Cauchy transport and a nontrivial projected cube kernel 29 October 2026. The whole-support correlated Gram bound removes a local marked normalization cost. It does not by itself prove sharp transport through a graph. Complete-circle three-port sewing observes only the socle of each regular cube and hence reduces to a scalar weighted Cauchy pairing. This note makes that limitation precise, then gives an ACTUAL nontrivial positive cross-color transfer for the cube packet already proved, with its sharp norm and iterated source rate. The eight cycle projections remain in one cube; there is no full-color cube or arbitrary-graph volume-conjecture assertion. ## 1. What the correlated Gram does under complete-circle observation On a supported source cell use the exact boundary frame R_r=C[eta_1,...,eta_r]/eta_i^2, lambda(fv)=tau[eta_all](q f), q(0)=1, w_I=q^(-1/2)eta_Iv, <w_I,w_J>=delta_IJ. The [whole-support theorem](actual_whole_support_boundary_gram_envelope.md) proves polynomial source cost K and exact dual cost tau^2 K in this frame. But the complete paired-circle product itself is simply eta_all w_empty=w_all, eta_all w_I=0 for I!=empty. (1) Thus it has operator norm EXACTLY ONE and rank one. The simple axes contribute their actual scalar N, so the full three-circle product has norm N^(3-r). On its image the original row is lambda(w_all)=tau, lambda(eta_all f v)=tau f(0). (2) Equations (1),(2) keep the original marked row; they do not replace it by an ordinary cap. They also show that the complete observation does not measure the lower nilpotent coordinates of f. After this observation, a Cauchy estimate on one cell is an estimate of its one surviving scalar. Polynomial K supplies no independent geometric upper bound for that scalar's exterior-dependent energy. ## 2. The exact weighted packet and its available transport Let D_N be the supported folded triples and put theta_l=Z_theta(l)>0, a_G(l)=Z_G(l)/theta_l, F_G(l)=sqrt(theta_l)a_G(l)=Z_G(l)/sqrt(theta_l). Here Z_G(l) is the COMPLETE coherent interior source with the three boundary labels fixed, not an individual black vertex. For the exact typed vertex substitution, including the exposed mark and one circle per merged edge, the [source sewing theorem](actual_nc_three_port_source_sewing.md) gives Z_new=sum_(l in D_N) theta_l a_A(l)a_B(l) =sum_l F_A(l)F_B(l), |Z_new|^2<=E_A E_B, E_G=sum_l |Z_G(l)|^2/theta_l. (3) The bilinear sewing map has norm one in this explicitly prescribed Hilbert space. Its Cauchy proof conjugates the first numerical vector; it does NOT assume that one physical graph is the mirror of the other. No extra K or generic inverse-frame factor occurs in (3). The theta weight can be exponential and must not be called a polynomial cost. Grafting a fixed piece B onto an unsummed boundary is multiplication by a_B. Its norm is EXACTLY max_l |a_B(l)|. Thus sharp control of (3) requires the actual boundary packet or this multiplier, not just an estimate of the closed scalar sum_l Z_B(l). For example, for two supported labels l_1,l_2 the numerical packet a(l_1)=T/theta_(l_1), a(l_2)=-T/theta_(l_2) has closure zero and unbounded energy as T grows. This is a finite-space obstruction to deducing energy from one closure; it is not asserted to be a realizable knot counterexample. The proved signed-theta boundary has a_theta,e(l)=product_i omega_(l_i)^e_i. It is consequently an exact unitary multiplier in (3). These are actual source-preserving twist operations; theta substitution itself leaves the graph skeleton unchanged. The one-variable complete-pretzel circle metric is a different actual cut and polarization. A bound on its one closed functional does not identify a three-variable F_G or bound E_G without an explicit port-opening identity. No such general identity is inferred here. ## 3. An actual two-boundary cube transfer beyond a scalar closure Now take N=2m+1 and the original ordered cube of the [four-rung packet](actual_cube_four_rung_positive_source.md). Fix its eight cycle edges to m. Keep the outer-white rung (edge 10) at j, the interval-black rung (edge 1) at l, and sum the other two rung labels (edges 4,7). Use zero rung twists. Set p_j=P_(N,j)>0, k_j=2 except k_m=1, h_j=Rturn L_j/(N k_j), f=sum_(l=0)^m k_l p_l^2 h_l, theta_j=Z_theta(m,j,m)=N^3 k_j p_j^2. (4) The last normalization is exact: in the actual theta formula s_j s_(d-j)=N and the one-leg source has R_N(m,j,m)=p_j. All paired rung nilpotents and the original unrestricted mark remain. By the proved four-rung SOURCE formula and linearity, the actual two-boundary cube contribution is B_(j,l)=N^12 k_j k_l p_j^2 p_l^2 phi(h_j h_l f^2). (5) This is a full coherent magnetic contraction, not a product of unsewn black coefficients. The exposed white boundary is (m,j,m) and the interval black boundary is (m,l,m), with their original orders. Both are supported at every j,l. For a typed graft, the three shared contacts are summed once using the exact denominator theta_l, so its relative-packet transport is a_new(j)=sum_l B_(j,l)/theta_j *a_old(l). Equivalently in F=sqrt(theta)a coordinates its matrix is A_(j,l)=B_(j,l)/sqrt(theta_j theta_l) =N^9 sqrt(k_j k_l)p_j p_l phi(h_j h_l f^2). (6) This is an actual cross-color kernel, not the product of two known closed scalar values. It is real symmetric and ENTRYWISE strictly positive. Indeed all h_j have positive Newton coefficients through their degree j, while f^2 has strictly positive coefficients at every degree 0,...,d. The constant coefficient of h_jh_l is positive, so the actual phi in (6) is strictly positive. The Newton theorem retains the full root algebra and its first normals in this argument. Entry positivity does not make A a positive semidefinite Gram. At N=3, h_0=1,h_1=1+Bhat_1, p_0=1,p_1=2 and f=6+4Bhat_1. The exact matrix of the phi factors in (6) is [phi(h_j h_l f^2)]_(j,l=0,1) = [[16,80],[80,244]], determinant=-2496. (7) Thus A itself has determinant -19968*3^18. This is a genuine correlated transfer with both eigenvalue signs; no Hilbert norm square or physical reflection identity is being smuggled into it. ## 4. Its operator norm has the sharp primitive-core increment Put h=h_m, S=p_m, W=phi(h^4)>0. Coefficientwise Newton monotonicity and the positive multiplication law give h_j<=h, p_j<=S, S^2 h<=f<=2(m+1)S^2 h. Consequently, with R_N=N^9 S^6 W, R_N<=A_(m,m)<=[2(m+1)]^2 R_N, 0<A_(j,l)<=2A_(m,m), A_(m,m)<=||A||_2<=2(m+1)A_(m,m). (8) The last lower bound is a diagonal Rayleigh quotient. The upper bound is the maximum row sum for the absolute-entry matrix, or sqrt(||A||_1||A||_infty); symmetry makes those norms equal. It does not require A to be positive semidefinite. Thus (8) is a direct source-preserving weighted Cauchy transport estimate whose exponent is computed independently from positive factorial periods. The proved actual central scalar and [cuboctahedral period theorem](actual_positive_newton_cuboctahedral_period.md) give, on all odd levels, lim (1/N)log||A||_2=6v8/pi+Vol(Q_cube)/pi. In hyperbolic-volume units this is lim (2pi/N)log||A||_2 =12v8+2Vol(Q_cube) =Vol(augmented cube)-Vol(augmented theta). (9) The equality with these ACTUAL complements is the independently proved labeled rectified-core geometry, not a volume-constant fit. It is the precise primitive-core increment in this projected packet. ## 5. Iteration is a genuine but still projected graph-source family Start with theta, keeping its two cycle contacts at m and its third label j summed. Repeatedly insert the ordered cube at the interval black vertex (0,1,2), with outer white boundary (0,10,11). Preserve the original exposed mark. At each stage the two cycle contacts remain m and the middle contact is summed as an actual full circle. The exact NC substitution supplies the new Morse word and one circle per merged edge. Equations (3),(5),(6) give, for fixed k>=0, Z_k^proj=u^T A^k u, u_j=sqrt(theta_j). (10) This is the raw original partial source of the resulting graph. It retains ALL 1+3k rung labels and fixes the 2+6k cycle labels to m. The graph has b=1+3k vertices of each color. The one exposed physical mark is never replicated; the formula comes from the already normalized fixed-first-normal quotient at each graft. Every matrix entry in (10) is positive. Choosing only the central index at each step supplies the lower bound, while (8) and u_j<=sqrt(2)u_m supply the upper bound N^(3+9k) S^(2+6k) W^k <= Z_k^proj <=[2(m+1)]^(3k+1) N^(3+9k) S^(2+6k) W^k. (11) For k=1 this is the exact four-rung packet bound; k=0 is the one-rung theta face. Therefore for every fixed k, lim_(N odd) (2pi/N)log Z_k^proj =(4+12k)v8+2k Vol(Q_cube). (12) The actual graph geometry is the same sequence of triangular core grafts: its core is k cuboctahedra glued along triangles, with additive volume k Vol(Q_cube). The [rectified-core theorem](actual_nc_graph_rectified_core_geometry.md) therefore identifies (12) with its ACTUAL augmented complement volume. All cycle twists can be kept as one common unit character; different rung-twist phases do not preserve this positivity argument. The proved one-leg boundary gap also transfers, without a new stationary-phase assertion. For fixed delta>0, p_j/S<=poly(N)exp(-gamma_delta N) whenever m-j>=delta N. Resolve each f in (5) into its actual complete-circle color sum and iterate the source quotient. Every one of the 1+3k rung labels occurs with its factor k_jp_j^2 ONCE, while every surviving phi factor is bounded above by W using h_j<=h. Therefore sum_(some rung m-j>=delta N) Z_(k,labels)^proj <=poly_(k,delta)(N)exp(-2gamma_delta N) N^(3+9k)S^(2+6k)W^k. (13) These are the whole-label one-leg estimates of the actual theta source transported through a specified branching kernel. They now control EVERY unfrozen rung channel in the projected chain, rather than just its scalar endpoints. The labels remain INTERNAL pair- Casimir channels. No auxiliary meridian interpretation, complex peripheral-color packet or Dehn-filling estimate follows from (13). This is an unbounded sequence of actual graph diagrams and correlated source transports. It remains a PARTIAL original source with many cycle projections and odd levels. Removing those projections and controlling even levels remain necessary before asserting a full graph invariant equality. The result does not rename the general scalar Cauchy inequality as a sharp energy theorem: its new energy bound is the independently positive two-boundary kernel (5)--(8). Audit: [literal boundary kernels and projected graph sources](../experiments/audit_actual_three_port_cauchy_transport_and_cube_kernel.py), with [recorded results](../experiments/actual_three_port_cauchy_transport_and_cube_kernel_results.json). The focused replay passes the exact N=3 non-PSD certificate, all three full boundary matrices at N=3,5,7 using 353 original marked rung contractions, and seven complete projected-chain sources, including the fourteen-vertex two-cube source with all seven rung labels summed. The source checks use the actual unrestricted mark and local regular generic first-normal identities. They supplement the all-N source/graft and positive-cone proofs, not an inference from measured matrix spectra or a whole-graph invariant claim. The exact scalar quotient pairing and the bounded projected cross-color kernel are different objects. The latter estimate does not establish equality with a full graph invariant.

title: Coherent original-transfer endpoint packets and exact Markov corners
text: # Coherent original-transfer endpoint packets and exact Markov corners 28 October 2026. Collapsing the two Euler factors BEFORE separating transfer endpoints gives a quantitative, source-preserving boundary filtration of every original signed braid word. Both sublinear total-transfer endpoint collars have subexponential operator norm. Consequently the entire all-endpoint corner of the full original source is subexponential, without an assumption about its stationary positions. This does not bound a mixed corner containing macroscopic transfers by the knot volume. It also does not identify a bridge overclock endpoint with a total physical transfer endpoint. An exact Markov calculation below shows why an isolated endpoint attached to a nontrivial exterior can still carry that exterior's full rate and must be grouped as a normalization cell. ## 1. Use the original coherently summed crossing Put d=N-1, Q=exp(2pi*i/N), x=-exp(-pi*i/N), F_r=(Q;Q)_r. The original positive crossing, with its common unit scalar kappa retained, sends input (a,b) to (b+k,a-k), where 0<=k<=min(a,d-b), with exact coefficient kappa x^(-a-b+k)Q^(b(a-k)) F_(b+k)F_a/[F_k F_b F_(a-k)]. (1) This is the independently checked physical coefficient of [the weighted-crossing theorem](weighted_crossing_source_gap.md), with j=a-k. Both Euler factors have already been summed coherently; one of their separate orders is not called k here. The negative crossing is the exact balanced antiunitary mirror P conjugate(R_plus)P. It has the same k-indexed magnitude and bounds. For an integer 0<=R<=d/2 let E_low be the sum of the original matrix entries with k<=R, and E_top those with d-k<=R. These are specified entry submatrices, with every original phase and zero retained. They are not substituted invariants or new quantum atoms. ## 2. Uniform quantitative normal-scale bounds In the variables j=a-k,b, the magnitude of (1) is A(k,b,j)=|F_(k+b)F_(k+j)|/[|F_k F_b F_j|]. (2) For k<=R each numerator ratio adds k factors of magnitude at most two, while |F_k|>=(4/N)^k k! for k<=N/2. Hence A(k,b,j)<=N^k/k!. (3) For k=d-r, support forces 0<=b,j<=r. Exact reflection |F_(d-s)|=N/|F_s| gives instead A(d-r,b,j)=N/|F_r| *|[r choose b]_Q|*|[r choose j]_Q| <=N^(r+1)/r!. (4) Indeed the sine formula and decrease of sin(t)/t on (0,pi) give |[r choose s]_Q|<=binom(r,s); their product is at most 4^r, which cancels the factor 4^r in the lower bound for |F_r|. The polynomial matrix dimension and disjoint k-support now imply the conservative explicit bounds, for BOTH signs, ||E_low||,||E_top|| <=H_N(R), H_N(R)=N^3 (e N/max(1,R))^R. (5) The exponent at R=0 is interpreted as zero. For every R_N=o(N), log H_N(R_N)=o(N). This includes all bounded normal quantum jets, but also collars growing arbitrarily sublinearly. For R=floor(epsilon N), the rate is at most epsilon log(e/epsilon)+o(1), tending to zero with epsilon. The physical endpoint normal scale has therefore been bounded, rather than evaluated using an invalid bulk Stirling expansion. The top collar forces both physical inputs and outputs into endpoint collars: a=d-r+j, b<=r, output(d-r+b,j). This is stronger support than a single separate Euler endpoint. The low collar includes its noncentral zero-transfer Cartan branch, so centrality must not be inferred for that branch. ## 3. A full-source all-corner estimate at arbitrary braid width Use the original scalar source, already justified before decomposition, K_N=chi_N/N Tr[(I tensor g tensor ... tensor g) W_N], g_a=x^(1-N)Q^(-a). Fix the original word and replace EACH of its m crossings by either E_low or E_top, keeping all signs, order, pivots and chi_N. The entire sum of these 2^m corner words has magnitude at most |chi_N| N^(b-1) 2^m H_N(R)^m. (6) This follows from the operator trace inequality on the actual N^b-head space; each pivot is unitary. In particular the WHOLE all-endpoint corner is exp(o(N)) times its retained external source for R_N=o(N). No position compactness, separate-sector positivity or removal of clock feedback is a hypothesis of (6). For a mixed corner one must retain and estimate every remaining bulk operator. Its endpoint factors still cost (5), but this alone gives only the norm bound for the remaining coherent blocks. Neither (6) nor the zero local endpoint rate assigns a volume bound to that mixed source. In particular one may not fix bridge clocks and ignore W_h. ### Exact thin-source reduction and the regular top-collar criterion The top packet has an additional original-source description: E_top,+(R)=sum_(a-j>=d-R) (I tensor E_j)R_plus(E_a tensor I). (6a) There are (R+1)(R+2)/2 terms: a=d-s, s,j>=0, s+j<=R. Each term keeps the COMPLETE original R between two PHYSICAL head projectors. Put k=a-j=d-(s+j). Its sole remaining input index b lies in [0,s+j]. The term is exactly J_out diag_b(r_plus(a,b,k)) J_in^dagger, J_in|b>=|a,b>, J_out|b>=|b+k,j>. (6b) Both J maps are isometries from a space of dimension at most R+1; the diagonal has the subexponential bound (4). Thus this is a literal lower-dimensional boundary source, with the exterior word and its actual coupons unchanged. The negative version is the exact mirror. It is not a replacement by an ordinary low-color representation. This grouping also supplies a quantitative version of the REGULAR physical-projector value theorem in [the actual cap note, Section 9](actual_coupled_caps_interval_source.md#9-finite-physical-projector-stationary-strata-have-action-zero). Suppose the remaining full phase is stationary in every direction except the fixed projector-clock normals; every crossing belongs to its genuine regular actual canonical graph, or a controlled joint limit of that graph. Bound all physical positions, their inverses and the finitely many based conjugating frames by H>=1. Then for a fixed diagram there is a fixed exponent C such that the top-collar clocks give, throughout their stationary support, delta_N=H^C(R+1)/N, |Im W|<=C delta_N(1+|log delta_N|) if delta_N is small. (6c) Here W is the complete calibrated leading phase with its original unit-clock and integer marks, not a phase obtained by dropping a factorial face. To verify the estimate, the projector clocks satisfy |B-1|<=2pi(R+1)/N. In the actual finite position chart, e and f vanish to first order at B=1, K=-B^(-1), so ||G+I||<=C H^C(R+1)/N. The actual Hurwitz and inverse-turn relations propagate this estimate through the one-component knot. This does not assume that a projector preserves the meridian. Cut the oriented knot at EVERY projector. Each resulting interval has projector endpoints, and each side of each such endpoint is independently near -I: its clock is near one while either position is bounded by H. Follow an interval from its endpoint. Each actual crossing retains its physical strand meridian or conjugates it by a matrix whose norm and inverse are bounded by a fixed power of H. Each turn inverts the same nearcentral matrix. There are only a fixed number of these operations, so its distance from -I grows by at most a fixed power of H along the entire interval. At the next projector restart with its independently small endpoint value; no equality across its allowed position jump is assumed. All physical arcs, and hence their clocks, are within C delta_N of the central value. This also covers multiple retained top packets, since their number is bounded by the fixed original word. The projector constraints are pure-imaginary logarithmic constraints. At restricted stationarity their missing normal gradients consequently have zero contraction with Re Z, exactly as in that cap theorem. The phase-defect identity leaves the original direct five-symbol sum. Its arguments are products and ratios of these near-unit physical clocks, and D(z)=O(|z-1|(1+|log|z-1||)) near z=1. This proves (6c). In particular H<=N^epsilon and R<=N^alpha give a vanishing regular action whenever alpha+C epsilon<1. The estimate does not concern arbitrary auxiliary cleared branches, uncontrolled chart denominators, or a restriction to a REAL cutoff face without stationarity in its normal. At |z|=N^epsilon the missing conormal can contract nontrivially with Re Log z. Thus (6c) alone does not bound gradient-flow exit currents, their mass, or escaping mixed endpoint periods. The low-transfer Cartan branch is not covered by its central-meridian argument. Formula (8) below demonstrates that a top endpoint can still carry an exterior's full rate through exact normalization; it is not legitimate to discard it from (6c). ## 4. The maximal-transfer Markov corner is exactly normalization Let theta=x^(1-N), the original complete twist line. At k=d, (1) has only a=d,b=0, and its coefficient is kappa N. Therefore E_top,+ at R=0 =kappa N |d,0><d,0|, E_top,- at R=0 =kappa^(-1) N |0,d><0,d|. (7) Open an arbitrary original knot at the strand where a Markov cell is to be attached, BEFORE decomposing that cell. Its complete cut is C=K I. Keep the SAME original averaged cut on that strand and close the new head with its original g. Direct evaluation gives (1/N)Tr[(C tensor I)(I tensor g)E_top,+] =kappa theta K, (1/N)Tr[(C tensor I)(I tensor g)E_top,-] =kappa^(-1)theta^(-1)K. (8) Here g_0=theta and g_d=theta^(-1). These are exactly the full original positive/negative Markov-cell values, before the known framing line cancels their twist. Thus ALL other transfer slices of that attached cell sum to zero with this prescribed exterior and source. This is a source-level normalization reduction, not an operator equality or a permission to relocate a cut after insertion. For comparison, its k=0 corner alone has value kappa theta K/N *sum_(a=0)^d Q^(a^2) (9) in the positive case. This can have the full exterior rate, despite its own unit operator norm. Such endpoint pieces are paired in the exact normalization (8), rather than assigned a strict gap one by one. This is consistent with regular finite-position endpoint action zero: that action statement does not control an escaping source or its complete exterior normalization. The SAME phenomenon holds for an actually summed low endpoint packet, not only a single k=0 term. For every fixed R and odd N>2R+1 its normalized multiplier relative to kappa theta K is exactly L_(N,R)=1/N sum_(k=0)^R F_k^(-1) sum_(b=0)^d Q^(b^2)(Q^(b+1);Q)_k^2. (9a) Indeed tracing (1) forces a=b+k. The factors x^(-2b), Q^(b^2) and g_b leave theta Q^(b^2). Terms b>d-k can be included because their displayed Pochhammer is exactly zero. No endpoint source has been changed in (9a). Let G_N=sum_b Q^(b^2). At every odd N, |G_N|=sqrt(N): in its squared modulus the invertible change (a,b)->(a-b,a+b) gives sum_(u,v)Q^(uv)=N. For P_k(t)=(Qt;Q)_k^2=sum_s c_s(Q)t^s, completion of the same finite square gives exactly sum_b Q^(b^2)P_k(Q^b)/G_N =sum_(s=0)^(2k)c_s(Q)Q^(-s^2/4), (9b) where division by four is modulo N. Along N=1 mod4, Q^(-1/4) tends to i; along N=3 mod4 it tends to -i. Since c_s(Q) tends to (-1)^s binom(2k,s), the right side for k>=1 tends respectively to 2^(2k-1)(1-i) or 2^(2k-1)(1+i). It is a fixed finite expression, so its error is O_R(1/N). Finally F_k=(-2pi*i/N)^k k!(1+O_R(1/N)). Thus the largest k=R term dominates the ACTUAL sum in (9a), and for every fixed R>=1, |L_(N,R)|= [2^(2R-1)sqrt(2)/((2pi)^R R!)] N^(R-1/2)(1+O_R(1/N)). (9c) For R=0 its magnitude is exactly N^(-1/2). These are polynomial, nonzero multipliers of the unchanged exterior knot period. A single Markov cell has no adjacent inverse pair to contract first. Hence a mixed low endpoint packet does NOT in general restore the missing normal gluing equation by itself. Exact complete-cell normalization is necessary even for this simplest source test. This does not assign the same behavior to an endpoint after that whole cell has been pruned. ## 5. A closed half-integer contour retaining physical support zeros There is an actual finite-height quadrature starting from (1), without moving upper transfer limits or a free separate Euler endpoint. Use the normalized factorial Fhat of [the exact interpolation](exact_factorial_interpolation_and_complex_contours.md) and replace the factorial ratio in (1) by Fhat(b+z)F_a/[Fhat(z)F_b Fhat(a-z)]. (10) It is holomorphic on a neighborhood of -1/2<=Re z<=d+1/2. To check this, Fhat is nonzero on -1<Re z<N. Its shift equation extends Fhat holomorphically to Re z>-1, with zeros at all integers N,N+1,...; the reciprocal extends holomorphically to Re z<N, with zeros at -1,-2,.... These continuations follow by shifting to the original nonzero strip and multiplying finite factors. At every integer z in [0,d], (10) is the actual coefficient and is zero if z>a or b+z>=N. Thus the forbidden physical tails vanish EXACTLY; they are not restored by declaring a new state support. After multiplying by the specified port monomials and choosing their logarithms, the finite sum is its integral against pi cot(pi z)/(2pi*i) around a positively oriented rectangle with vertical edges -1/2,d+1/2 and finite nonzero heights. This contour contains precisely the original integer transfer poles 0,...,d. It preserves their endpoints and all corners, for any fixed bridge width and every fixed choice of the other original source variables. Fubini on these compact contours gives the simultaneous word identity. No infinite-height type estimate or sharp full-source bound is inferred from this representation. Rounding an artificial meeting of contour pieces does not remove their enclosed integer poles. The quantitative normal packets which can presently be grouped without such a claim are (3)--(8); mixed intermediate/endpoint strata remain additional work. The [projected cotangent completion](actual_projected_transfer_cot_completion.md) now provides a further OPERATOR-level normal extension: retaining the original physical output Fourier projections makes every added negative integer pole removable, even at simultaneous scalar factorial collisions. Its normal collar cost is exp[O(s log N)], uniformly over all physical inputs, hence subexponential for s<=N^alpha, alpha<1. It keeps the original nonnegative residues and supplies no sharp estimate for a bulk exterior. ### The low normal packet has an explicit nonzero source current The normal-scale equation can be calculated before a contour or saddle argument. Fix the literal a,b and write r_k for (1), with zero forbidden coefficients. Its exact successive ratio gives, at every index, (1-Q^(k+1))r_(k+1) =c(1-Q^(b+k+1))(1-Q^(a-k))r_k, c=xQ^(-b). (11) For F_R(t)=sum_(k=0)^R r_k t^k and sigma F(t)=F(Qt), define L=(1-sigma)-ct(1-Q^(b+1)sigma)(1-Q^a sigma^(-1)). Then the ENTIRE finite low packet has the exact sourced equation L F_R=-c t^(R+1)(1-Q^(b+R+1))(1-Q^(a-R))r_R. (12) The full physical sum F_d has zero right side: either its last coefficient is already zero, or the actual support endpoint kills one displayed factor. Thus adjacent complementary transfer packets cancel exactly the SAME boundary current, with no arbitrary source normalization. Formula (12) holds inside the original full word with all other head variables and source coupons retained. This current cannot be dropped on the bounded or sublinear normal scale. Suppose a/N,b/N stay in compact subsets of (0,1), R=o(N), and t stays in a compact nonzero annulus. For every k<=R, (11) gives |r_(k-1)/(t r_k)|<=C R/N. The two shifted denominator factors stay bounded away from zero; the numerator is at most 2pi k/N. Summing the resulting geometric tail proves uniformly for R>=1, F_R(t)=r_R t^R(1+O(R/N)). (13) For R=0 this equality is exact. Dividing the SOURCE in (12) by (13) therefore has nonzero limiting symbol -ct(1-B)(1-A), A=lim Q^a, B=lim Q^b. (14) In particular it does not tend to zero. Omitting this source would incorrectly force the extra normal equation (1-A)(1-B)=0 and a central meridian. Closed half-integer contours do retain its original integer residues; rounding a contour corner alone does not authorize that omission. The operator size of the source in (12) is subexponential by (3), multiplied by a polynomial dimensional factor and the bounded displayed unit-clock factors. Its contraction with a bulk exterior can nevertheless have that exterior's full rate, as the exact packet calculation (9a)--(9c) demonstrates. [Audit](../experiments/audit_actual_total_transfer_endpoint_packets.py): independent original coefficients at both endpoint collars and signs, their normal-scale inequalities, whole-source Markov normalization corners, summed low packets, their sourced normal equation, and exact holomorphic support zeros in (10).

title: Simultaneous lower-transfer faces with interior physical heads go downhill
text: # Simultaneous lower-transfer faces with interior physical heads go downhill 28 October 2026. This gives a source-preserving boundary operation for an arbitrary fixed one-component braid word. Several actual total transfers may approach zero simultaneously. If every physical head factorial stays in a regular interior strip, all those transfer normals have compatible zero sides. The original scalar cardinal source can be continued from its existing lower cotangent sides through their joint NEGATIVE collar, with its exact currents retained. Every outgoing selected-strip norm/cardinal phase is downhill at the stated nested scale. Head endpoints are excluded. This is a genuine class of removable exits, not a sharp bound for the remaining whole knot period, nor a claim about the number of repeated boundary visits during a global descent. ## 1. The original source has independent integer transfer coordinates Use the original complete balanced crossing, with d=N-1. Its two signed routings are (a,b) -> (b+sigma*k, a-sigma*k), sigma=+1 or -1. (1) All original kappa, Cartan, pivotal, framing and external factors are retained. Before splitting states, use the justified whole original averaged trace K_N=chi_N/N Tr[(I tensor g tensor ... tensor g) W_N]. (2) For a one-component closure its integer closed paths have coordinates (t,k_1,...,k_m) in Z^(m+1), (3) with counting Jacobian ONE. Here t is one arc's color. Follow the oriented physical knot: each crossing's two visits change that color by opposite multiples of k_j. Every intermediate arc label is therefore an integer linear form ell_r=t+sum_j e_(rj) k_j, e_(rj) in {0,1,-1}. (4) Each k_j cancels after its second visit, so the path closes for EVERY integer transfer vector, and conversely every closed path recovers its unique t and transfers. An equivalent direct proof propagates symbolic initial heads through (1). At the end their owners are permuted by a single cycle P and acquire integral offsets d_r(k). Closure asks A_r-A_(Pr)=d_r(k). Degree conservation gives sum_r d_r=0 identically, so these equations solve integrally around that cycle, with one free common color and no divisibility constraint. The physical state polytope is exactly 0<=k_j<=d, 0<=ell_r(t,k)<=d. (5) For the average (2) it has strict real interior: take t=d/2 and every k_j=eta d with eta<1/(4(m+1)). This is a domain assertion, not a positivity or noncancellation assertion. A highest-cut t=0 presentation can have forced faces. Its forced equalities must be removed before using a free-coordinate interior statement; (2) is justified for the whole original word, not separately after inserting a current. This is the explicit knot lattice of [the scalar cardinal completion](actual_scalar_cardinal_source_completion.md#explicit-knot-coordinates-dimension-and-forced-cut-faces). It explains why the lower-transfer normals in the following theorem are independent even after the original closure is imposed. ## 2. Exact singular factor and the regular-head hypotheses For a positive crossing the original coefficient is r_+(a,b;k)=kappa x^(-a-b+k) Q^(b(a-k)) Fhat(b+k)Fhat(a)/[Fhat(k)Fhat(b)Fhat(a-k)], Q=exp(2pi*i/N), x=-exp(-pi*i/N). (6) The negative one is precisely its balanced conjugate mirror, not a replacement positive coefficient. Its denominator also contains the negative-root Fhat_-(k). The exact full-function identity is 1/Fhat_epsilon(k)=Psi_epsilon(epsilon*h*(k+1))/phi_epsilon, h=2pi*i/N, phi_-=conjugate(phi_+). (7) Thus the classical lower-transfer normal has the EXACT tag xi_j=(k_j+1)/N, u_j=epsilon_j*2pi*i*xi_j. (8) It is not legitimate to omit the +1 when locating finite zeros. Fix a subset J of crossings. Put delta=N^(-alpha), 0<alpha<1, and assume |xi_j|<=delta for j in J. Every physical head label appearing in any crossing is assumed to stay in the interior strip eta <= Re(ell_r/N) <= 1-eta, eta=N^(-epsilon), |Im(ell_r/N)| <= C epsilon log N+C/N. (9) Other transfer factorial arguments are regular in their own marked strips. In particular none of their full-function arguments approaches one during this operation. More generally it is enough to assume the regular part G of the original logarithmic action satisfies |partial_(xi_j) G| <= C_0+C_word epsilon log N (10) on the entire normal tube. Condition (9), the actual five-function formula (6), and the fixed integer coefficients (4) imply (10). Indeed every relevant derivative is a fixed combination of Log(1-Q^ell) and Log(Q^ell), plus fixed lift constants. Interior angular margin eta bounds the first by O(1+epsilon log N); (9) bounds the second. The original Cartan Gaussian has the same bound. Constants depend only on the fixed word and the prescribed tube constants. If alpha>C_word' epsilon for a sufficiently large fixed word constant, all heads stay in (9), with slightly weaker constants, when ANY subset of the k_j is displaced by real distance at most 2N delta. This uses the finite integer routing coefficients in (4). Thus this hypothesis can be checked before the move; it is not an assumed unknown period comparison. In what follows choose alpha so that alpha > (C_word+2) epsilon, (11) enlarging C_word to cover those margin changes. Such alpha exists for all sufficiently small fixed epsilon. ## 3. All retained marks have zero real variation in these normals The [scalar cardinal source](actual_scalar_cardinal_source_completion.md) uses fixed powers of w^+(s)=A_N(s)+B_N(s) exp(2pi*i*s), w^-(s)=B_N(s)+A_N(s) exp(-2pi*i*s). (12) Every mode of every window is an INTEGER character of the actual linear labels (4). Along a real transfer displacement its modulus is EXACTLY constant, even when the other variables are complex. Hence these leading integer marks cannot change the downhill sign below. Their coefficients have only polynomial normal bounds on the fractional fixed-height edges used here: heads stay in (9), and a transfer window's digamma poles are a fixed distance from those edges. No assertion that the modes are harmless on arbitrary macroscopic complex deformations is made. Likewise the original full-Psi reset Psi_epsilon(u)=(1-exp(Nu)) Psi_epsilon(u+epsilon*2pi*i) (13) retains TWO outgoing sectors. Their relative character exp(Nu), with u from (8), also has exactly constant modulus along a real k_j shift. All original norm factors 1-exp(Nu) remain; none is replaced by one. Integer step shifts leave these characters themselves unchanged. At outside physical integers the A_N,B_N packets have compensating poles. Consequently (12) must remain a JOINT packet during the filling. It is split only on regular outgoing edges. The ensuing statement about each outgoing sector does not authorize independent pole crossings for its separated terms. ## 4. Uniform simultaneous downhill at the nested scale Write the original density's leading exponential as exp(N S), so its height is Re S. On a continuous marked branch its singular transfer part has the exact leading form S_sing=sum_(j in J) Li_2(exp(epsilon_j*2pi*i*xi_j)) /(epsilon_j*2pi*i). (14) All other leading terms are G in (10). Along xi_j -> xi_j-s_j with s_j real and 0<=s_j<=2delta, partial_(s_j) Re S =log|1-exp(epsilon_j*2pi*i*(xi_j-s_j))| -Re partial_(xi_j)G <= -(alpha-C_word epsilon) log N+C. (15) This follows directly by differentiating Li_2. Its real logarithm is single valued on the punctured normal disk. The exact holomorphic completion below retains the zero if the path meets it. Under (11), (15) is <=-c_word log N for all sufficiently large N. The normals are independent coordinates, so they can be shifted in any order; no positive circuit arises among them. After shifting each one by 2delta, its signed full-Psi imaginary coordinate satisfies epsilon_j Im u_j' in [-6pi delta,-2pi delta]. (16) Apply (13) at every outgoing factor and retain the complete 2^|J| norm packet, together with every cardinal mode. The two-sector selected-strip calculation in [the shape-one patch](actual_isolated_shape_one_downhill_patch.md) shows that the maximum outgoing sector height is at most the continuously marked height followed in (15). Equivalently, the branch on either side of the normal cut is the larger of the two reset sectors; the other one has smaller height. Integer cardinal characters do not change (15). Therefore EVERY outgoing sector obeys Re S_out <= Re S_in -2 c_word |J| delta log N. (17) The assertion is local in the stated regular-head tube. It makes no claim about every sector of the entire original period away from it. The full quantum factor, including its zeros, has the uniform normal bound exp[O(N delta(1+|log delta|))+O(log N)]. The regular background varies by O(N delta(1+epsilon log N)). Cardinal coefficients contribute only a fixed polynomial factor on the stated edges. Thus the complete fixed finite patch has additional mass exp(o(N)). These estimates use alpha<1 and (11); they do not divide by the value of the knot period. ## 5. Exact cotangent filling and source sides The finite-level reason this is an original-source operation is also explicit. At a newly crossed integer k_j=-s, 1<=s<N, ord[1/Fhat_epsilon(k_j)]=1. Every head factorial in (6) is nonzero and holomorphic on the interior strip (9). The remaining transfer factors are regular, so the complete summand has a zero at k_j=-s. Its full cardinal completion is holomorphic there too, and has at least that zero. The cotangent pole is therefore removable. At joint negative integers these statements hold separately in every free k_j variable; the completed scalar summand is holomorphic before taking any multivariate residue. Consequently the old lower side Re k_j=-1/2 can be moved to Re k_j=-R-1/2, with R=O(N delta)<N, at fixed positive upper/lower heights, retaining both horizontal connecting pieces. No original physical integer residue is removed and no new one is added. This can be performed simultaneously in all j in J, because (3) is an integer coordinate system. The iterated product-prism Stokes identity retains every side and corner current with its induced orientation. The statement is applied to a joint-chain piece on whose ENTIRE sweep the head margin (9) holds. If the full source is first split into this regular-head piece and head-endpoint pieces, the new transverse cutting curtains are part of those side currents. They are not dropped or declared lower-rate by the present theorem. For a single translated patch, with sweep S and partial S=Gamma_out-Gamma_in-S_side, the exact identity is integral_(Gamma_in) omega =sum_outgoing_sectors integral_(Gamma_out) omega_sector -integral_(S_side) omega. (18) At outside integer poles the packet is kept combined, as required in Section 3. Formula (18) does not drop the horizontal connectors or the side currents of the other original logarithmic/radial factors. Its residue-free form assumes the sweep stays in Re k_j<0, starting at the original lower sides as just specified. A patch starting at POSITIVE transfer coordinates can cross the original poles k_j=0,1,...,O(N delta). Their original residue currents must then be added with their orientations. They are not canceled by the windows, which equal one on physical integers. The existing low-transfer packet bound controls their operator cost but does not bound an unrestricted exterior by the knot volume. No generic positive-side residue deletion is part of this theorem. A direct finite-step estimate provides an independent check on the zero side. For k=nu-s on a fractional fixed-height edge, 1/Fhat(k)=product_(r=0)^(s-1)(1-Q^(nu-r))/Fhat(nu). For s=O(N delta), its modulus is at most N^C [C(s+1)/N]^s. (19) The regular head and Cartan ratios cost at most N^(C_word epsilon*s+C). All integer characters are invariant under those step shifts. Thus the far negative edge has the suppressing factor exp[-(alpha-C_word epsilon)s log N+O(s+log N)], in agreement with (15). Near the start and on the retained horizontal connectors one uses the complete bounded normal patch rather than asserts a uniform strict gap from a face of zero displacement. ## 6. Boundary of the theorem This supplies a simultaneous downward filling for lower-TRANSFER-only outer cotangent faces with regular interior heads, in the original complete closed source at arbitrary braid width. A failure of its regular-head hypotheses routes the analysis to a physical head endpoint, another transfer endpoint, or an escaping/nonregular head chart. It cannot be blamed on an arbitrary circuit of nine auxiliary atomic variables in this chart. An interior normal cut may instead retain the original low-transfer residue packet described above; that current is also not removed. It does NOT assert that all physical face directions are downhill. For example at the all-zero head AND transfer vertex, reverse any strict interior flow. Since the factorial-degree imbalance at either signed crossing is +k, its logarithmic modulus along that outward ray has the leading positive increment -k t log t+O(t). Fixed cardinal characters have unit modulus there. Thus Slater feasibility alone does not give a downhill direction when head endpoints collide. That increment is still o(1) at t=N^(-alpha); it is not an excess-volume counterexample and does not affect (15), where heads are regular. Global sharp upper bounds still require handling those other faces, controlling repeated patch/flow visits and their aggregate source, and retaining the original phase through any chart change. Neither geometric survival nor the original volume limit is inferred here. Reproducible free-coordinate, signed phase and exact-window checks: [audit](../experiments/audit_actual_transfer_only_face_downhill.py).

title: Source-normalized triangle entropy and an algebraic complete-radius balance test
status: Algebraic sufficient test on the actual complete packing
text: # Source-normalized triangle entropy and an algebraic complete-radius balance test exact lemma, 31 October 2026. This uses the original complete triangle potential and its proved closed coefficient entropy. It supplies a sufficient local test for the [complete-radius balance theorem](general_complete_radius_balance_filling_volume.md). Realization at arbitrary width remains separate. The full Fejér entropy $h$ is [not everywhere nonnegative](actual_fejer_entropy_signs_and_tail_insertion.md); no such assertion is used here. ## 1. The exact source normalization For nonnegative weights $w=(x,b,y)$, not all zero, let $Q(w)=Q_b(0)$ be the original determinant-plus-beta-plus-half-forced-product triangle action. The [marked cofactor action theorem](actual_cross_cofactor_marked_action.md), equations (5)–(6), gives $Q_b(0)=F(x,b,y)$ with its absolute source normalization. No additive constant or magnetic monomial is changed here. The [closed endpoint coefficient theorem](actual_fejer_half_block_entropy.md), Section 5, equations (15)–(16), gives on the triangle simplex $$ \begin{aligned} C_{\mathrm{tri}}(\boldsymbol\alpha)&=\sum_j f(\alpha_j), &f(t)&=\frac{\Lambda(\pi t)+\Lambda(\pi/2-\pi t)}{\pi},\\ \alpha_j&\geq0,\qquad\sum_j\alpha_j=\frac12, &\Lambda(s)&=-\int_0^s\log|2\sin v|\,dv. \end{aligned} $$ Its original positive triangle polynomial has degree $N/2+O(1)$, full triangle support, and uniform closed coefficient entropy $C_{\mathrm{tri}}$. Its weighted exponential rate is the same $F$. Finite positive Laplace summation therefore gives the exact identity $$ Q(w)=\max_{\substack{\alpha_j\geq0\\\sum_j\alpha_j=1/2}} \left[C_{\mathrm{tri}}(\boldsymbol\alpha)+\sum_j\alpha_j\log w_j\right].\tag{1} $$ For a zero weight, the maximum is restricted to $\alpha_j=0$ at that coordinate; use $0\log0=0$ on the restricted face. This is literal coefficient specialization. It neither regularizes a protected target nor permits positive allocation to a zero weight. More explicitly, the number of triangle coefficients is polynomial in $N$, uniform closed entropy gives the upper bound in (1), and lattice approximations to a maximizing point on the supported simplex face give the lower bound. The finite degree offset $O(1)$ vanishes after division by $N$. The polynomial comparison scalar between the original determinant and endpoint coefficient kernel has zero rate, as recorded in the closed theorem. Equation (1) is the source's own Legendre identity, not a free normalization choice. ## 2. A sharp elementary entropy lower bound Define $g(t)=f(t)+t\log(2t)$, continuously at zero. Direct differentiation on $0<t<1/2$ gives $$ f'(t)=\log\cot(\pi t),\qquad g''(t)=\frac1t-\frac{2\pi}{\sin(2\pi t)}<0.\tag{2} $$ The strict inequality follows from $0<\sin(2\pi t)<2\pi t$. Also $g(0)=g(1/2)=0$. Strict concavity gives $g(t)>0$ in the open interval. Summing at a triangle load yields $$ C_{\mathrm{tri}}(\boldsymbol\alpha) \geq-\sum_j\alpha_j\log(2\alpha_j),\tag{3} $$ with equality exactly at the three vertices of its simplex. Indeed, equality requires every $\alpha_j$ to be either $0$ or $1/2$, and their sum is $1/2$. The inequality applies to boundary edges as well as the strict interior. Let $S=x+b+y>0$ and choose $\alpha_j=w_j/(2S)$ in (1), retaining zero coordinates exactly. The Shannon expression in (3) then satisfies $$ -\sum_j\alpha_j\log(2\alpha_j)+\sum_j\alpha_j\log w_j =\sum_j\alpha_j\log S=\frac12\log S. $$ Consequently $$ Q(x,b,y)\geq\frac12\log(x+b+y).\tag{4} $$ This is strict whenever at least two weights are positive, because the chosen load is not a simplex vertex. If exactly one weight is positive, the supported simplex consists of one vertex and (1) gives equality. This checks the absolute constant: $Q(x,0,0)=\tfrac12\log x$. If all weights vanish, the original positive-degree triangle polynomial vanishes and its logarithmic rate is minus infinity; that case is not used at an actual matching port. ## 3. Algebraic sufficient balance, including protected zeros Let a port have nonnegative ordered weights $(x,b,c,y)$, and assume $A=x+y>0$. Write $X=Q(x,b,y)+Q(x,c,y)$. Then $$ X\geq\frac12\log[(A+b)(A+c)].\tag{5} $$ If $M=\max(b,c)>0$, at least the triangle with middle $M$ has two positive weights, so (5) is strict. Therefore the nonstrict algebraic condition $$ (A+b)(A+c)\geq\max(b^2,c^2)\tag{6} $$ implies $$ X>\log b\quad\text{whenever }b>0,\qquad X>\log c\quad\text{whenever }c>0.\tag{7} $$ This includes equality in (6); strictness still comes from the actual triangle entropy.
