Its DIFFERENT polynomial power from the odd coefficient N^3/4 is the retained paired-normal CD normalization, not a new exponential. Equations(8),(23) together with the odd theorem give a nonzero central scalar at BOTH level parities. They do not produce a uniform analytic packet for shifted joint colors, a full projective frame, a tame marked-vertex norm, or a global Casson--Rivin maximum. Those remain additional tasks. Audit: [literal even Clebsch/normal, contiguous finite transform, marked kernel and scalar density](../experiments/audit_actual_trivalent_even_central_normal_packet.py). The full marked packet, noncentral joint-color continuation and global graph estimates remain outside this central theorem.

title: Full trivalent CD normalization and an actual magnetic-growth obstruction
text: # Full trivalent CD normalization and an actual magnetic-growth obstruction 29 October 2026. The complete-circle image on EVERY physical pair has an exact ordinary-channel normalization. This lifts a black scalar to its entire magnetic tensor, but does not preserve the scalar's growth rate. An explicit coefficient of the already proved odd central tensor has rate 5j0/4, where its scalar has rate j0=v8/pi. Thus even the central scalar cannot be used as an upper bound for the full CD vertex norm. This is a source-exact obstruction, not a conjecture about a candidate Racah formula or a counterexample to a volume conjecture. ## 1. Original modules and the general positive single-object metric Use the full physical conventions of [the positive-circle quotient](actual_complete_circle_positive_quotient.md): N>=2, d=N-1, q=exp(pi i/N), Q=q^2, x=q^d, F_a=(Q;Q)_a, s_a=|F_a|, and the complete physical module V_N. On V_N tensor V_N write E_t,F_t,K_t for the original ordered coproduct, Omega for the actual Casimir, P for physical leg exchange, and L=L_N. In particular E_t^dagger P=-P F_t, F_t^dagger P=-P E_t, H=L P>=0, C=P L>=0. (1) Put M=floor(d/2). At folded node c_j=q^(2j+1)+q^(-2j-1), 0<=j<=M, set t_j=d-j and define the first-entry-one highest vector h^(j)=sum_(a=0)^t_j q^(a^2)[t_j choose a]_Q |a,t_j-a>, W_(j,r)=F_t^r h^(j)/F_r, 0<=r<=2j. (2) Its literal highest ratio is -x^(-1)Q^a(1-Q^(t_j-a))/(1-Q^(a+1)). Its highest K is q^(2j), and its Casimir is c_j. The established full paired-image theorem gives one image vector in each degree t_j,...,t_j+2j; their nonzero ladder coefficients show that (2) is an injective ACTUAL Hopf map W_j:Q_j->V_N tensor V_N, where Q_j is the ordinary (2j+1)-dimensional module. No root semisimplification is used. At odd j=M it is the simple Steinberg module V_N. In this divided-F basis its matrices are K_j|r>=q^(2j)Q^(-r)|r>, F_j|r>=(1-Q^(r+1))|r+1>, E_j|r>=q^(-2j-1)(1-Q^(2j+1-r))|r-1>. Every interior coefficient is a unit at the root. Define G_(j,r)=beta(2j,r)=s_(2j)/[s_r s_(2j-r)], G_j=diag(G_(j,r)). (3) This is positive. Its ratio is sin((2j+1-r)pi/N)/sin(r pi/N), so DIRECTLY E_j^dagger G_j=-G_j F_j, K_j^dagger G_j K_j=G_j. (4) It is a metric of one ordinary object. A tensor coproduct is not therefore unitary in its product metric: its adjoint reverses order. ## 2. Exact full-degree CD normalization Let H_j be the ACTUAL c_j summand of L P, after L has acted with its first normal on a paired block. Its full column factor is H_j=h0_j W_j G_j^(-1) W_j^dagger, F_j[:,r]=sqrt(h0_j/G_(j,r)) W_(j,r), (5) where h0_j=2 s_(d-j)^2/s_(d-2j)=2N beta(2j,j), 2j<d, h0_(d/2)=N, 2j=d. (6) The first equality in(6) is the exact canonical CD coefficient in the first degree t_j, whose eigenvector has first entry one. Root reflection s_a s_(d-a)=N gives its second form. The simple odd node has HALF the paired prefactor. It is not continued as two simple copies of a double node. Here is a proof that the same constant fixes EVERY magnetic row. The original covariance and centrality of L imply F_t H_j=-H_j E_t^dagger. The range of H_j is W_j(Q_j). Since H_j preserves physical integer degree and W_(j,r) have distinct degrees, write H_j=sum_r a_r W_(j,r)W_(j,r)^dagger. The covariance gives a_(r+1)/a_r=G_(j,r)/G_(j,r+1). Its first coefficient is h0_j, so (5) follows. This uses actual physical arrows and the original positive circle, not a presumed unitary Clebsch frame. The correctly typed channel map is pi_j=G_j^(-1) W_j^dagger P. (7) It is a Hopf map by(1),(4). On paired nodes pi_j W_j=0; on the odd simple node it is I. Indeed L W_j is zero or N W_j respectively, and (5) gives exactly these compositions. In particular the paired map is not a retraction. Equations(5)--(7) retain the normal source before passing to the ordinary image. These factors need not be polynomial away from the center. Uniformly on physical indices, with Lcal(u)=integral_0^u log(2sin pi v)dv, log beta(2j,r) =N[Lcal(2j/N)-Lcal(r/N)-Lcal((2j-r)/N)]+O(log N). (8) For example j/N near1/4,r near j has strictly positive exponential rate j0/4. Separate bounds on the factors in(5) can lose the cancellations of a specific magnetic coefficient. ## 3. The whole black source, its true support and its 3j tensor Let J_source=p_16 p_23 p_45 be the literal nested six-head cup, with p_(a,b)=N x^(-b)delta_(a+b,d). For any fixed triple j_1,j_2,j_3 put U_bal=(pi_j1 tensor pi_j2 tensor pi_j3) J_source, J=j_1+j_2+j_3. It is an ACTUAL invariant of Q_j1 tensor Q_j2 tensor Q_j3. Its physical support gives the TRUE integer condition r_1+r_2+r_3=J, 0<=r_i<=2j_i. (9) It vanishes unless the ordinary triangle inequalities hold. The invariant space in this H=0 sector is at most one-dimensional. To see this, let v_r be its third magnetic slice. The first slice satisfies F_12 v_0=0 at degree J. The rectangular bidiagonal F_12 has a one-dimensional kernel exactly in the triangle range and is injective, or has empty domain, outside it. Every later slice is forced by v_r=-K_j3(r-1)/E_j3(r-1,r) E_12 v_(r-1). (10) Its denominators are units. An explicit ordinary trivalent tensor Theta_j is obtained from that lowest-vector kernel and (10), with Theta_j(2j_1,j_2+j_3-j_1,0)=1. (11) For completeness its initial F-kernel ratios are v_0(a+1,J-a-1)/v_0(a,J-a) =-K_j1(a+1)(1-Q^(a+1))/(1-Q^(J-a)). (12) All required indices lie in the physical ranges below N. These are also the regular finite ordinary Clebsch recursions before root specialization; their initial nonzero column and nonzero interior arrows give the stated canonical tensor. The top E endpoint is the same finite intertwiner identity, with no division by F_N. There is a stronger original-source restriction: U_bal=0 whenever J<d. (13) This is the cleared missing-corner identity of the [actual saturated three-circle source](actual_six_port_three_circle_support.md), applied to the genuine six-head cup. Its complete-circle observation is exactly ||(F_j1^dagger tensor F_j2^dagger tensor F_j3^dagger) P_ports J_source||^2. The source Ward identity annihilates it outside J>=d. Positivity then annihilates the black tensor itself. Odd simple axes are included by that proof. This is not inferred from an ordinary semisimple fusion rule. For J>=d the triangle inequalities already follow from j_i<=M, but(13) is not by itself a nonvanishing assertion. Let the unweighted source coefficient at the magnetic point(11) be N^3 A_j, namely take rows W_j^dagger P before dividing by G_j. Then the ENTIRE tensor is exactly U_bal=[N^3 A_j/G_(j2,j2+j3-j1)] Theta_j, U_CD(r)=sqrt(h0_j1 h0_j2 h0_j3) product_i sqrt(G_(ji,ri)) U_bal(r). (14) This supplies the precise interface for any independently proved scalar formula. It does not assign that scalar's rate to the whole tensor, nor bound the marked white packet by an ordinary covector. ## 4. An unconditional central magnetic-growth counterexample Now take odd N=2m+1 and all three j_i=m. Then G_j=I,h0_j=N exactly. The already proved [central actual source](actual_trivalent_steinberg_central_anchor.md) gives U_CD=N^(7/2)q^(-m^2) A_N Theta, Theta_(a,b,c)=N x^(-c) W_(d-c)(a,b), A_N=q^[m(2-m)] sum_k beta(m,k)^4. (15) Here Theta uses its physical normalization, not the normalized (11). Its exact lowest-column formula is W_d(m+k,d-k)=h_k, with |h_k|=beta(m,k). Therefore an ACTUAL magnetic coefficient is U_CD(m+k,d-k,0)=N^(9/2)q^(-m^2) A_N h_k. (16) At k nearest m/2, the same affine-shift Laplace expansion already proved for the scalar gives beta(m,k)=2^(-1/4)N^(-1/2)exp(Nj0/4)[1+O(1/N)], |A_N|=(1/4)N^(-3/2)exp(Nj0)[1+O(1/N)]. Consequently, at odd levels with that chosen nearest magnetic index, |U_CD(m+k,d-k,0)| =2^(-9/4)N^(5/2)exp[(5/4)Nj0][1+O(1/N)], (17) liminf_(N odd) N^(-1)log ||U_CD||_2^2 >=(5/2)j0. (18) This is the original positive three-circle black energy J_source^dagger C_St^tensor3 J_source, in a valid CD factor of the actual circles. Changing that factor by a unitary frame leaves the energy unchanged. It is not a freely selected abstract inner product. Thus an upper bound exp[Nj0+o(N)] for the FULL vertex amplitude, or exp[2Nj0+o(N)] for its Euclidean CD energy, is FALSE. A metric subexponentially equivalent to that CD metric cannot repair it. A rescaling must retain its corresponding co-source dual cost. ## 5. Consequences for coherent graph sewing The scalar C R partition, when identified with A_j by its exact source proof, can control a specific normalized magnetic coefficient. Equations(14)--(18) show why it does not by itself control the remaining magnetic sums. Ordinary white Hopf covectors, the sole marked row, genuine bends and their pivotal factors may contract that growth coherently. They must be sewn BEFORE a sharp energy estimate is asserted. Nothing here contradicts a knot-volume bound or rules out a different coherent positive metric on the complete pointed source. It rules out precisely the scalar-to-full-CD-norm shortcut, already at the actual odd central anchor. The [focused exact source audit](../experiments/audit_actual_trivalent_full_cd_normalization_and_magnetic_growth.py) passes eight all-parity physical levels N=2,...,9: every CD magnetic degree, both typed channel compositions, whole balanced black tensors against independently constructed ordinary 3j recursions, exact forbidden source blocks, and the central magnetic identity(16). Four separately labeled 85-digit growing-level checks calibrate(17). The covariance, support and growth proofs above establish the general claims; these checks are supplementary. No source-to-graph scalar bound is inferred from the finite range.

title: Historical transform port and actual mixed highest chart
text: # Historical transform port and actual mixed highest chart 29 October 2026. This records the algebra and mixed highest-chart route available BEFORE the general coefficient bridge was completed. The general original-source formula is now proved in the [all-channel positive scalar and regular-cube theorem](actual_trivalent_all_channel_positive_scalar_and_regular_cubes.md), using the [complete finite Euler--Racah transform](finite_trivalent_euler_racah_transform.md). An independent, shorter coefficient bridge is the [finite square-linearization proof](actual_trivalent_square_linearization_bridge.md). The former missing identity(4) below is therefore established by those proofs. This historical derivation and its audit do not themselves replace either proof, and the separate mixed chart in section3 still requires its recorded bending normalizations before source use. ## 1. Exact long and short series for the candidate factorial object Put N>=2,d=N-1,q=exp(pi i/N),Q=q^2,F_n=(Q;Q)_n,s_n=|F_n|. Take a=max(a,b,c), 0<=a,b,c<=floor(d/2), J=a+b+c>=d. Write r=b+c-a, delta=J-d. Then 0<=delta<=r<=min(b,c), and every factorial below has index<N. Define the positive OBJECT, without identifying it with the source, R=N sum_(t=a)^(b+c) s_t/[prod_(j=a,b,c) s_(t-j) s_(d+t-J) s_(a+b-t)s_(a+c-t)s_(b+c-t)]. Its first summand is R0=N s_a/[s_(a-b)s_(a-c)s_(a-delta)s_b s_c s_r]. Direct factorial ratios prove R=R0 H_long, H_long=4phi3(Q^-r,Q^(a+1),Q^-b,Q^-c; Q^(a-b+1),Q^(a-c+1),Q^-b-c;Q,Q). (1) Here series have their usual FINITE meaning sum_k product(numerator;Q)_k Q^k/[F_k product(denominator;Q)_k]. For a direct check, put t=a+k, convert each sine factorial using s_n=i^n q^[-n(n+1)/2]F_n, and reverse the three descending factorials. The variable powers combine to (-q^(d+3))^k=Q^k. The term k=0 is exactly R0. Thus (1) is an own ratio calculation, not a 6j formula. The root relation gives Q^(a-delta+1)=Q^-b-c. Accordingly the series is balanced. Apply the independently PROVED finite Sears identity in [the elementary symmetric-operator proof](finite_balanced_sears_operator_proof.md), with kept parameter alpha=Q^-b, transformed parameters beta=Q^(a+1),gamma=Q^-c and denominator choices D=Q^-b-c,E=Q^(a-b+1). It gives EXACTLY H_long=S_pref H_short, S_pref=(Q^(a+1);Q)_r(Q^-2b;Q)_r /[(Q^(a-b+1);Q)_r(Q^-b;Q)_r], H_short=4phi3(Q^-delta,Q^-r,Q^-b,Q^-b; Q^-b-c,Q^-b-c,Q^-2b;Q,Q). (2) The Sears proof is a finite polynomial operator calculation; no published summation or quantum 6j identity is a premise. At the root the new parameter Q^(-J-1) is Q^-delta, so the second sum stops at delta. Every denominator in the old and new TRUE summation ranges is a unit. In particular Q^-b and Q^-2b never reach a zero before their allowed lengths r<=b and delta<=b. No zero prefactor is canceled by an unspecified continuation. This short series is the paired-parameter Askey--Wilson polynomial of degree delta at z=1 with elementary operator parameters A=D=Q^-b,B=C=Q^-c, divided by its explicit leading normalization. Indeed ABCD Q^(delta-1)=Q^-r. This is an identification of the PROVED finite series(2), not a source identification by that name. ## 2. The former source gate, with its exact normalization The actual scalar A_source already has an independent [root-Fourier coefficient theorem](actual_trivalent_root_fourier_source_certificate.md). Let C_delta be its REVERSED coefficient in that note's(7), WITHOUT the outer phase Q^[b(b+1)-c(c-1)]. Explicitly c_e=[U^e](U;Q)_c^2, C_delta=[U^delta](UQ^-b;Q)_b^2 sum_e c_e F_(2c-e)/F_(2c-e-r) U^e. (3) Only 0<=e<=delta matter, and all its factorials are physical units. Set E=3a^2+b^2+c^2-2ab-2ac+2bc-2c-2, K_source=N q^[E+2b(b+1)-2c(c-1)]/(F_a F_b F_c F_r). Then the already proved source formula is A_source=K_source C_delta. Combining(1),(2) with exact sine-factorial reflection proves that the proposed equality A_source=(-1)^(N+J)q^[2a^2-ab-ac+bc-J-3] *s_a s_b s_c/(N s_delta)*R is EQUIVALENT to the following coefficient identity, now proved by the complete transform and independent square-linearization bridge above: C_delta=Q^[b(a+c-b)+c(2c+1)] *F_(2b)/F_(a+b-c) *F_a^2/[F_delta F_(a-delta)^2] *H_short. (4) The equivalence here was proved separately from(4). To check the phase, first multiply R0 by s_a s_b s_c/(N s_delta), then the Sears prefactor in(2). In F-factorials this leaves F_a F_(b+c)F_(2b)/[F_delta F_(a-delta)F_r F_c F_(a+b-c)F_b] times its stated root phase. Divide by K_source and use F_(b+c)F_(a-delta)=N(-1)^(b+c)Q^[(b+c)(b+c+1)/2]. All signs combine to the Q power in(4); the extra factor Q^(d^2+d) is one. Also F_a/F_(a-delta)=(Q^-b-c;Q)_delta EXACTLY at this root. Thus (4) is a short, normalized Rodrigues-type target for the paired operator polynomial in(2). The coefficient theorem proves A_source=0 when J<d. Its leading coefficient also proves nonzero entire saturation layers delta0 and1. Those facts and the finite comparisons alone did not prove(4) at arbitrary delta. The completed finite proofs now supply that step and establish the all-order positive scalar. No broad graph asymptotic or geometric conclusion follows merely from(1)--(4). ## 3. An actual mixed highest chart with a simple right channel There is a separate direct source-operator route to the same type of recoupling problem. Write Q_j for the genuine ordinary highest-weight 2j module in its divided-F balanced basis, with F|u>=(1-Q^(u+1))|u+1>, Ecal|u>=q^(-2j-1)(1-Q^(2j+1-u))|u-1>, K|u>=q^(2j)Q^-u|u>. Study highest vectors of weight2b in V_N tensor V_N tensor Q_a. Their left physical pair degree at third color0 is D0=d+a-b. For a physical pair vector w of that degree, the exact highest lift is H_L(w)=sum_(u=0)^(2a) alpha_u Ecal_12^u w tensor |u>, alpha_u=(-1)^u q^[u(4a+1)] Q^[-u(u-1)/2] F_(2a-u)/F_(2a). (5) The last highest-vector equation is Ecal_12^(2a+1)w=0. Every earlier equation follows directly from the ratio of the actual Ecal_3 and K_3 coefficients. The right highest chart is similarly H_R(w')=sum_(v=0)^d (-x q^(-2b))^v/F_v |v> tensor Ecal_23^v w'. (6) Extracting first color0 from(5) gives the rectangular anti-Pascal map J_mix[B,A]=alpha_(D0-B) x^A Q^[(B(B+1)-D0(D0+1))/2] F_(D0-B)F_(D0-A)/[F_(D0-B-A)F_B], (7) where A is a first-pair physical color, B a right-pair physical color, and entries outside the true physical ranges or A+B>D0 are zero. This follows by the same finite coproduct binomial as the original complete anti-Pascal chart. It is not a square inverse frame on an unrestricted pair space; no polynomial conditioning is asserted. More simply, extracting third color0 after the ACTUAL Omega_23 gives on the valid highest source the upper-bidiagonal operator B_mix e_A=-(Q^(A+b+1)+Q^(-A-b-1))e_A +q^(2b+1)(1-Q^A)(1-Q^(D0-A+1)) e_(A-1). (8) For a>=1 this equality holds even on the entire displayed w space: only third colors0,1 can reach that extraction, and their F_2 E_2 terms cancel. If a=0, the same expression agrees on the genuine highest-source kernel Ecal_12 w=0; the absent third color1 must not be invented for arbitrary w. The right intermediate V_N has eigenvalue-2. It is SIMPLE in(8), at A*=d-b: its diagonal equals-2 only when Q^(A+b+1)=1. A normalized left eigenrow has support A=A*+k and closed entries ell_k=(-q^-1)^k Q^[k(k+1)] [a choose k]_Q[b choose k]_Q, 0<=k<=min(a,b). (9) Its first entry is one. The direct ratio of the bidiagonal equation is -q^-1 Q^(2k)(1-Q^(a+1-k))(1-Q^(b+1-k))/(1-Q^k)^2, which proves(9). Its modulus is beta(a,k)beta(b,k), with unit phase (-1)^k q^[k(a+b+1)]. No collision or even-level derivative is being silently treated as simple: this is a DIFFERENT, genuinely mixed V_N tensor Q_a channel, whose -2 node is simple at both parities. The left ordinary channel c is the actual vector W^(c)_(a+c-b) in degree D0, and has a regular generic Clebsch lift. Equations(5)--(9) provide an explicit finite overlap to its simple right channel. Relating that overlap to the original triangular corner requires all the bending and 3j normalization factors. Those factors are not proved merely from the existence of this chart. The separate completed coefficient proof of(4) does not supply an unstated normalization for this alternative mixed-chart route. Audit: [root long/short Racah algebra and literal mixed highest-chart extraction](../experiments/audit_actual_trivalent_general_finite_transform_port.py).

title: Original three-channel corner and the positive factorial identity
text: # Original three-channel corner and the positive factorial identity 29 October 2026. The original coproduct fixes a general trivalent corner, including its endpoint phases, at both level parities. The positive factorial evaluation is now proved by the [short finite transformation](actual_trivalent_square_linearization_bridge.md) and the independent [Fourier/Newton transformation](finite_trivalent_euler_racah_transform.md). This historical filename retains the original formulation and exact source normalization. The [general theorem and regular-cube corollary](actual_trivalent_all_channel_positive_scalar_and_regular_cubes.md) record the completed scope. No graph-volume equality or full vertex norm is inferred from this scalar theorem. ## 1. General physical columns and endpoint phases Put d=N-1, q=exp(pi i/N), Q=q^2, x=q^d=-q^-1, F_r=(Q;Q)_r and s_r=|F_r|. For 0<=j<=floor(d/2), let h=d-j and H^(j)_a=q^(a^2)[h choose a]_Q at |a,h-a>, W^(j)_r=F_pair^r H^(j)/F_r, 0<=r<=2j. (1) These are the original balanced physical pair and its original ordered coproduct. The highest equation follows directly from H_(a+1)/H_a=-x^-1 Q^a(1-Q^(h-a))/(1-Q^(a+1)). For a+b=h+r, their finite binomial expansion is W_r(a,b)=F_a F_b F_h *sum_s q^(s^2)x^(-r+a-s)Q^[s(r-a+s)] /[F_s^2 F_(h-s)^2 F_(a-s) F_(r-a+s)], (2) where max(0,a-r)<=s<=min(h,a). All denominators have index<N. This follows by expanding F_pair=A+B with AB=Q^-1 BA, just as in the [central proof](actual_trivalent_steinberg_central_anchor.md). The exact endpoints at EVERY retained j are W_(2j)(j+t,d-t)=ell_j H_t, 0<=t<=h, ell_j=q^[j(d-2j)], W_j(0,d)=q^(-j^2). (3) For the first, its lowest-vector recurrence fixes the successive ratios; the first coefficient in (2) is q^(-j^2) sum_s Q^(s^2)[h choose s]_Q[j choose s]_Q =q^(-j^2) F_d/(F_h F_j)=q^[j(d-2j)]. The equality in the middle is finite Vandermonde, proved by coefficient extraction in the finite binomial product. Root reflection gives F_h F_j=N(-1)^j q^[j(j+1)] and F_d=N. The last expression in (3) comes from the sole s=0 term of (2). The displayed lowest column also has zero next F arrow by its literal ratio; no generic semisimple decomposition is assumed. ## 2. The corner of the actual black tensor Choose j_1=a, j_2=b, j_3=c with the triangle inequalities and let r=b+c-a. The magnetic indices (2a,r,0) have physical pair degrees (d+a, d-a+c, d-c), whose sum is exactly 3d. Apply the three rows W^dagger P to the original nested cup source p_16 p_23 p_45. Its corner is N^3 A_N, where the exact original-source kernel gives A_N=conjugate(ell_a) sum_(k=0)^min(d-a,d-c) x^(k+a+c-2d) conjugate[H^(a)_k H^(c)_k W^(b)_r(c+k,d-a-k)]. (4) Indeed set the first physical cup color to d-k in the literal [black vertex kernel](actual_trivalent_complete_circle_vertex_kernel.md). Its other two colors are a+k and c+k. Formula (3) then gives (4), including the conjugate lowest-column scalar. The positive evaluation below is proved by the separate finite transformations linked above. ## 3. Precisely normalized positive evaluation Set J=a+b+c and delta=J-d. For delta>=0 define R_N=N sum_(max(a,b,c)<=t<=min(a+b,a+c,b+c)) s_t/[s_(t-a)s_(t-b)s_(t-c)s_(d+t-J) s_(a+b-t)s_(a+c-t)s_(b+c-t)], C_N=s_a s_b s_c/(N s_delta), e=2a^2-ab-ac+bc-J-3. (5) The proved original-source identity is A_N=(-1)^(N+J) q^e C_N R_N, J>=d; A_N=0, J<d. (6) The zero branch is now proved independently by the [root-Fourier coefficient theorem](actual_trivalent_root_fourier_source_certificate.md): the actual scalar is a specified coefficient of degree d in a polynomial of degree J. That proof keeps the complete Fourier mode and its exact low-mode cancellation. The two finite transformations linked above prove the positive branch, its exact phase, and every root denominator. The asymmetry of e belongs to the specified ordered corner (2a,r,0). The positive modulus C_N R_N is symmetric. Neither C_N nor the support cutoff may be suppressed. For example the unnormalized candidate has R_N(0,0,0)=1 whereas the original source is zero, and at even N=4, a=b=c=1 one has R_N=2sqrt(2), C_N=1/sqrt(2), |A_N|=2. At odd N=2m+1, (a,b,c)=(m,j,m), C_N=1 and (6) reduces to the [proved one-channel formula](actual_trivalent_one_channel_source_packet.md). At the even nearest center a=b=c=N/2-1, C_N=cos(pi/N), consistent with the separately proved [weighted quartic and retained normal](actual_trivalent_even_central_normal_packet.md). The [joint scalar saddle theorem](actual_trivalent_candidate_racah_partition_geometry.md) proves a unique joint saddle, a strict global color gap, and a complex packet for the positive expression in (5). Through the proved (6), these are now original-source SCALAR estimates. The complete CD normalization, the magnetic tensor, ordinary/marked white rows and their ordered sewing are additional data. ## 4. Exact checks and their logical limit The [independent finite-source audit](../experiments/audit_actual_trivalent_general_scalar_candidate.py) builds W from the original coproduct, instead of (2) or (5), and evaluates the literal source corner. It checks every retained triangle triple at N=2,...,16: 539 supported triples and 1,212 vanishing triples, including all root phases and both parities. It also checks (3) at every retained j in those levels. A separate high-precision calculation checked the full complex phase and modulus on all 636 triangle triples at N=2,...,13; an additional 305 supported triples at N=11,13,17 were used to determine and check the candidate phase modulo N. These computations supply reproducible counterexample searches and normalization evidence. They do not by themselves prove the positive branch of (6) for arbitrary N. The finite algebra linked above proves the identity directly.

title: Every original crossing has a two-Newton, one-Rogers source layer
text: # Every original crossing has a two-Newton, one-Rogers source layer 28 October 2026. The nine original scalar atoms admit a complete partition into three disjoint trivalent sinks. Two sinks are the PROVED Newton/Barnes template; the third is its actual all-U Rogers polynomial. A positive Gaussian must first be combined with its adjacent reciprocal factorial. A negative Gaussian stays ONCE and is shared by its indicated Newton and Rogers variables. This yields an exact one-internal-variable crossing kernel WITH its original final nonnegative Hardy barrier, then a simultaneous layer on any signed word and any bridge count. Each Newton kernel can be replaced by its explicit two-full-Psi source plus its retained central current. No positive-factorial edge, Gaussian or original cap is used twice. The resulting current branches are not classified as geometric degeneracies. ## 1. Fixed kernels and original normalization Put Q=exp(2pi*i/N), d=N-1, F_a=(Q;Q)_a and p_a=(-1)^a Q^(a(a-1)/2)/F_a, U(t)=sum_(a=0)^d t^a/F_a, V(t)=sum_(a=0)^d p_a t^a, F(t)=sum_(a=0)^d F_a t^a. These finite expressions are used to prove the source identity. Their original full-Psi coefficient/relative-cycle realizations may be reinserted exactly; they are not replaced by a new positive invariant. Keep the original color x, not only its complete value. Define B_N(u,v)=sum_(i+j<N) F_(i+j)/F_i *p_j u^i v^j, R_N(u,v)=sum_(i+j<N) F_(i+j)/(F_iF_j) u^i v^j. (1) B_N is the proved Newton polynomial. R_N is the actual truncated Rogers--Szego generating kernel; it is not assumed to satisfy the same beta theorem. All factorial normalization is already contained in the coefficients in (1). No residual N^3 is to be inserted after the three original factorials have been contracted this way. Let the two input variables of one crossing be z_0,z_1 and its outputs z_6,z_7. The four original internal head vertices after Hardy-forest contraction are z_2,z_3,z_4,z_5. Write t=z_4. The original external Cartan scalar kappa remains external. Write Pi_+^(6) for the original nonnegative Hardy projection on the first OUTPUT variable z_6. It is independent of N. This barrier is retained in the physical crossing and in every separated branch below. ## 2. Literal nine-atom table, including the Gaussian placement The original atom slots, in traversal order, are as follows. The table displays the finite coefficient kernels; every F carries its actual factorial support. | Slot | Positive crossing | Negative crossing | | --- | --- | --- | | 0 | U(z_2/z_1) | same | | 1 | V(x^(-1)z_2/z_0) | same | | 2 | U(z_3/z_0) | same | | 3 | F(t/z_2) | same | | 4 | U(x^(-1)z_3/t) | V(g_- x^(-1)z_3/t) | | 5 | U(g_+ z_5/t) | U(g_- z_5/t) | | 6 | F(z_6/z_3) | same | | 7 | U(x^(-1)z_5/z_6) | same | | 8 | F(z_7/z_5) | same | Here a Gaussian is still represented by its original moment g_s=-x^(-2s)exp(-s h/2)exp(sqrt(pi)(1+i s)xi), sqrt(N/(2pi))exp(-Nxi^2/2)d xi, h=2pi*i/N, s=+1 or -1. (2) The original diagonal entries are d_a=(-1)^a x^(-2a)Q^(a(a-1)/2). For R_+ the active Gaussian index is the slot-5 reciprocal index h_5, hence its full exponent is g_+^(h_5). For R_- the Gaussian precedes the central transfer; the index is h_5+h_4, hence the two displayed g_- factors are the SAME Gaussian variable. This is a literal gate-order calculation, not two independently integrated Gaussians. The four internal affine vertex equations are h_0+h_1+h_3=d, h_2+h_4+h_6=d, h_3+h_4+h_5=d, h_5+h_7+h_8=d. (3) The first, second and fourth are sinks. Their atomic stars {0,1,3}, {2,4,6}, {5,7,8} are PAIRWISE DISJOINT and partition ALL nine atoms. The third equation is at the remaining source vertex t; its integration is retained. The table follows either by coefficient conservation in the strict original word or by weighted Hardy-forest residues. At the Gaussian edge z_out=z_in/g_s, logarithmic residue measure has no extra g_s Jacobian. This gives precisely the two placements in the table. Its original caps are unchanged. ## 3. Positive crossing: absorb one COMPLETE Gaussian cell In the positive word C D U_+ C^(-1), the Gaussian D is adjacent to the reciprocal second-head factorial in C. Their exact combined diagonal coefficient is d_a/F_a=p_a x^(-2a). (4) Thus the COMPLETE Gaussian-plus-slot-5 cell is exactly V(x^(-2)z_5/t). It has no remaining Gaussian variable or extra scalar. One first contracts that whole Gaussian cell, then uses the Newton identity. It is not a pointwise deletion of g_+ in an arbitrarily separated full-Psi sector. Contract the three disjoint sinks in (3). The guaranteed first star {0,1,3} gives B_N(t/z_1,x^(-1)t/z_0). The last star {5,7,8}, after (4), gives B_N(x^(-1)z_7/z_6,x^(-2)z_7/t). The middle star is R_N(z_6/z_0,x^(-1)z_6/t). Consequently the ENTIRE raw positive crossing kernel is Ktilde_+=kappa CT_t [ B_N(t/z_1,x^(-1)t/z_0) R_N(z_6/z_0,x^(-1)z_6/t) B_N(x^(-1)z_7/z_6,x^(-2)z_7/t)]. (5) On the original finite input heads, the PHYSICAL finite-head crossing is K_+=Pi_+^(6) Ktilde_+. All upper support and second-output lower support are already enforced by the three factors; only negative first-output tails remain in the raw expression. In particular the all-U middle star was not renamed Newton. The original Gaussian is accounted for by the exact identity (4), including its color x^(-2a) and linear root phase. ## 4. Negative crossing: one shared Gaussian, not two For the negative crossing, stars {0,1,3} and {2,4,6} have the original U,V,F types and give Newton kernels directly. The last star is all-U and gives the Rogers polynomial. The exact raw negative kernel is Ktilde_-=kappa^(-1)sqrt(N/(2pi))integral_R exp(-Nxi^2/2) CT_t [ B_N(t/z_1,x^(-1)t/z_0) B_N(z_6/z_0,g_-x^(-1)z_6/t) R_N(g_-z_7/t,x^(-1)z_7/z_6)] dxi. (6) On those same finite input heads, K_-=Pi_+^(6) Ktilde_-. For example the raw kernels, on input (0,0), have a nonzero output (-1,1) from h_7=1, with coefficient kappa^(+/-1)x^(-1). The final original Hardy barrier removes it. Thus (5)--(6) are not asserted entrywise finite-head operators without that barrier. The two appearances of g_- are linked by the SINGLE Gaussian measure (2). Keeping only one or integrating each independently changes the original phase. No remaining Rogers sink is declared a Newton move without a further proved transformation. One finite coefficient proof checks (5)--(6) directly. On an input (a,b), put h_1=j, h_2=a-j, h_5=b+j-h_4 and output (c,e)=(h_2+h_4-h_7,h_5+h_7). The first Newton coefficient is F_(b+j)/F_b *p_j x^(-j). The second chosen Newton and the Rogers factor supply exactly the remaining original F and reciprocal F coefficients. Their Gaussian powers are h_5 for the positive crossing before (4), and h_5+h_4 for the negative crossing. Illegal original indices have zero coefficient. This proves the entire matrix equality, not merely a scalar cap evaluation. ## 5. Simultaneous exact layer on an arbitrary original word For m signed crossings, select the TWO Newton stars specified in (5) or (6) at each crossing. They are disjoint inside each crossing and occur at distinct internal sink vertices in the original ordered word. Spectator/Hardy contractions cannot merge one of these sinks with a later crossing: it has only its three atomic incidences and its affine charge -d. Thus there are exactly 2m independent Newton contractions, one remaining Rogers polynomial and one remaining internal t variable per crossing. Every F edge is used exactly once. Perform the positive Gaussian contraction (4) before expanding any new beta sectors. Retain one Gaussian per negative crossing. Glue the output and input head variables with the SAME original Hardy/source identifications and pair with the SAME original cups, ordinary caps, full marked cap, and external peripheral/framing line. Equations (5)--(6) then give the original whole period. This is valid for any bridge count and the whole original nonzero color x family at the fixed physical root. At each chosen Newton sink use its exact original-source identity B_N(u,v)=S_N(u,v)+D_N(u,v)I_N(u,v), D_N=1-u^N+v^N, S_N=(N/phi_N)u^N Psi_+(h-Logu)Psi_+(Log(v/u)) exp[-Log(v/u)Logu/h]. (7) This is the [proved beta source](actual_trivalent_quantum_beta_source.md) with the [exact Fermat normalizer](exact_balanced_source_normalizer_fermat.md), not bare replacement of a factorial coefficient by its symbol. Multilinearity gives at most 2^(2m)=4^m source branches, with all Rogers kernels, remaining Gaussians and original caps retained. Expanding each D into its three monomials would give at most 4^(2m) terms; keeping it grouped is preferable. The number depends on the word, not N. The branches live on specified logarithmic/relative source charts. They need not be separately single-valued scalar periods or independently absolutely integrable on an uncontinued original torus. Start on a common regular marked chart, use (7), and continue with its exact beta currents. Equivalently use common finite Gaussian cutoffs and matched pole indentations BEFORE summing the branches. Their sum is the original finite polynomial integrand, so its limiting period is fixed by the original absolute convergence theorem. No independent finite part is chosen for one branch alone. The joint deck/source gluing is part of the retained source extension; deleting current sectors would destroy it. Thus this is an exact finite-branch whole-source NORMAL FORM. It is not a proof of termwise global growth estimates or of dominance of the all-S branch. There is an optional whole-source reduction of the last Hardy barrier, but it has a different scope. The COMPLETE raw B/R kernel has only nonnegative incoming index demands, so it annihilates any negative input head. Its only unphysical output is a negative first head. The next crossing touching that head annihilates it; if no crossing touches it again, the original finite final source annihilates it. Therefore the raw complete crossings give the same whole-word source after summing their complete finite kernels. This no-healing argument must NOT be applied separately to the meromorphic S/I branches. The displayed branch normal form retains Pi_+^(6), unless that full-word source reduction has first been performed before splitting. ## 6. What the actual central monomials do For the guaranteed first star the literal central function is A=u^N-v^N=t^N[z_1^(-N)-x^(-N)z_0^(-N)]. (8) It is a free scalar boundary function, not identically zero or one. At the other positive star it is A_F=x^(-N)z_7^N/z_6^N-x^(-2N)z_7^N/t^N, and at the negative central star it is A_C=z_6^N/z_0^N-g_-^N x^(-N)z_6^N/t^N. (9) The original peripheral x^N and the Gaussian norm g_-^N remain. They cannot be evaluated at an ideal point before normal source operations. A separately chosen cyclic boundary-character extension with z_1^N=x^N z_0^N would make (8) zero, but that is not a specialization theorem for the original finite-head scalar source. There IS an exact finite-input support statement. The original inverse fusion kernel after the first contraction is U(z_3/z_0)B_N(t/z_1,x^(-1)t/z_0). (10) Its monomial indexed by i,j,r has incoming exponents (r+j,i) and outgoing (r,i+j), with i+j<N. Multiplication by u^N demands incoming second index i+N; multiplication by v^N demands incoming first index r+j+N. Both are outside the original head. Therefore each inserted WHOLE-kernel tail in (10) is zero on every original finite-head input. This holds before closing a knot, for every original color. It is a degree-tail annihilation, not a scalar value A=0 assigned inside (7). The separated full-Psi and Barnes kernels are not finite nonnegative head polynomials. They do not inherit this support assertion termwise. The exact constraint after splitting is instead the equal-sum statement exterior[A S_N]+exterior[A D_N I_N]=0, (11) whenever the indicated original finite-head exterior is used. It is invalid to set A=0 in a generic inverse norm or to conclude from (11) that each current vanishes. Inputs outside the original head already detect the nonzero degree shifts. Likewise the current monomials do not force a degenerate Hurwitz representation. On any regular logarithmic current branch they add to its action respectively 0, 2pi*i(Logt-Logz_1), 2pi*i(Logt-Logz_0-Logx). (12) Their logarithmic momenta change by integer 2pi*i shifts, while their EXPONENTIATED canonical relation is unchanged. Thus they are lifted charge/degree corrections to whatever regular current graph is present, not automatic identity or rank-deficient classical maps. The known full-Psi deck mixing can put the same growing S class into I, so a current-only quotient cannot be imposed without transporting this source extension. ## 7. Audit and remaining obligation Run python3 experiments/audit_actual_trivalent_layer_crossing_source.py The [audit](../experiments/audit_actual_trivalent_layer_crossing_source.py) checks the exact inverse-fusion kernel, both original signed/color crossings, two arbitrary Gaussian dilation values before moment contraction, the positive complete-cell identity, whole original pivotal word sources, the disjoint graph partition and the full-B degree-tail assertion. All original normalization factors are read from the independent original crossing evaluator. To reach a global volume theorem one still needs to control the remaining Rogers fibers and the combined marked source branches, and show a nonzero geometric exterior coefficient or a suitable global norm gap. Positivity of a single local bipyramid does not give that gap, as the explicit original-source nongrowth chamber already demonstrates. The normal form above states exactly the actual network and currents to which such a proof must apply.

title: Whole-label asymptotic of the original signed marked theta source
text: # Whole-label asymptotic of the original signed marked theta source 29 October 2026. The exact coherent magnetic contraction in the [all-channel marked theorem](actual_trivalent_all_channel_marked_contraction.md) gives a sharp positive partition before any estimate. This note proves its entire-label gap and the nonzero Gaussian asymptotic after ANY fixed signed twists on its three original pair edges. Both parities, the odd simple endpoint weight, paired-circle first normals and the sole physical marked normal are retained. No complement geometry or arbitrary graph sewing theorem is inferred. ## 1. Actual raw source and the theorem Set N>=2, d=N-1, q=exp(pi i/N), Q=q^2, kappa=q^(d^2/2), m=d/2, M=floor(m), and s_u=product_(r=1)^u 2sin(pi r/N). For physical folded labels 0<=j_i<=M put J=sum j_i, delta=J-d, and r_i=J-2j_i. Let k_j=2 except at the odd simple node j=m, where k_j=1. The EXACT marked raw channel contribution is Z_N(j)=N^2 product_i k_(j_i) *[product_i s_(r_i)/s_delta] R_N(j)^2, J>=d, Z_N(j)=0, J<d. (1) Here R_N is the proved finite factorial partition. Formula (1) has already summed EVERY magnetic index with the genuine ordinary white dual and original unrestricted physical marked row. It is not the black tensor's Euclidean norm. There is no outside component normalization in this raw source. Insert the original R^(e_i)L_N on edge i, for arbitrary FIXED signed integers e_1,e_2,e_3. The raw whole source is exactly Theta_N(e)=sum_j Z_N(j) product_i omega_(j_i)^(e_i), omega_j=kappa(-1)^j q^[j(j+1)]. (2) This includes the full original Cartan scalar. A separately recorded external line factor chi_N remains outside Theta_N. Put j0=v8/pi=8 Lambda(pi/4)/pi and define the literal unit phase Omega_N=kappa exp(i pi d/2) q^[m(m+1)] (-1)^d, q^r means exp(i pi r/N), including fractional r. Then Theta_N(e)=N^(3/2) exp(2N j0) Omega_N^(e_1+e_2+e_3) /[16 product_i sqrt(2-i e_i)] *[1+O_e(1/N)]. (3) EACH square root has positive real part. Equivalently choose the determinant square root by continuation from e=0. The principal square root of the product can have the WRONG SIGN for large same-sign twists, for example e=(5,7,9). The leading constant in (3) is nonzero. Thus for both parities and composite levels lim_(N->infinity) (2pi/N)log|Theta_N(e)|=4v8. (4) This is an actual source limit. It is not a claim that its complement has volume 4v8 absent a separate literal topological certificate. ## 2. A whole-label strictly concave action Let L(x)=integral_0^x log(2sin pi u)du and set sigma_i=(m-j_i)/N, x_i=1/4+sigma_i-(sum sigma)/2, i=1,2,3, x_4=1/4+(sum sigma)/2. The physical supported set has sigma_i>=0, sum sigma_i<=m/N; all four x_i lie in (0,1/2) and sum x_i=1. On the compact limiting support the endpoints are included by continuity. The established scalar partition has rate Phi=-(2)sum_(i=1)^4 L(x_i). Its extra weight in (1) has rate sum_(i<=3)L(2x_i)-L(1-2x_4)=sum_(i<=4)L(2x_i). Consequently the complete channel contribution has action E(sigma)=sum_(i=1)^4[L(2x_i)-4L(x_i)] =sum_(i=1)^4 h(x_i), h(x)=-2[L(x)+L(1/2-x)]. (5) The last equality follows from the elementary duplication and reflection identities for L. DIRECTLY h(1/2-x)=h(x), h''(x)=-4pi/sin(2pi x)<0, 0<x<1/2. (6) Hence h is strictly concave, with unique maximum at x=1/4. Equation (5) has its UNIQUE maximum at sigma=0, with E(0)=2j0, Hess_sigma E(0)=-4pi I_3. (7) The four tetrahedral sign rows mapping sigma/2 to x-1/4 have orthonormal columns. Flipping ANY one sigma_i takes that row set to the negatives of a permutation of itself. Together with (6) this proves E is SEPARATELY EVEN in every sigma_i, not merely stationary at zero. In particular E(sigma)=2j0-2pi sum sigma_i^2+O(||sigma||^4). (8) The uniform all-index O(log N) sine-factorial estimate, including zero indices, and the at-most-N inner R sum give log[Z_N(j)/product_i k_(j_i)]=N E(sigma)+O(log N) (9) uniformly on the ENTIRE supported physical set. The actual half-step in m only changes this global estimate by O(log N). All forbidden labels contribute zero exactly. By compactness and strictness of (7), for every fixed rho>0 there is gamma_rho>0 such that sum_(max sigma_i>=rho) Z_N(j) <=poly(N)exp[N(2j0-gamma_rho)]. (10) Thus a complete physical-label complement is exponentially small. Since every physical twist in (2) has modulus one, the SAME bound controls the signed source complement before any cancellation. ## 3. Uniform local prefactor, including the three half-steps The exact complex scalar partition theorem gives, uniformly on a fixed small sigma polydisk, Rwin_N=N^(-3/2)exp(NPhi) /[4sqrt(product_i cos(pi sigma_i))]*(1+O(1/N)). Its actual physical omitted terms have a strict gap. The remaining sine factors in (1) have indices r_i=2N x_i-1/2, delta=N(1-2x_4)-1/2. The canonical half-shifted factorial formula S_hat_N(Na-1/2)=sqrt(N)exp[NL(a)](1+O(1/N)) therefore gives product_i s_(r_i)/s_delta =N exp{N sum_(i=1)^4 L(2x_i)}*(1+O(1/N)). The N^2 in (1), this N, and Rwin_N^2's N^-3 cancel EXACTLY. Thus locally on the physical lattice Z_N(j)=product_i k_(j_i) *exp[N E(sigma)]/[16 product_i cos(pi sigma_i)] *(1+O(1/N)). (11) The error is uniform on a fixed corridor. On a smaller corridor, real coercivity E<=2j0-c||sigma||^2 holds. The known exact complex factorial window also gives bounded fixed derivatives, but no off-grid identification with auxiliary meridians is needed here. ## 4. Exact signed twist chirp and parity unfolding At EVERY physical folded label, omega_j=Omega_N exp(i pi N sigma^2). (12) Indeed j=m-Nsigma and 2m+1=N. Writing (-1)^j=exp(pi i j), the q exponent difference between the two sides of (12) is -2N(d-j), an integer multiple of 2N. This proves (12) with its literal fractional root, not an arbitrary choice of sqrt(kappa). If N is odd, Nsigma is an integer >=0 and the zero point has weight one while every positive point has weight two. If N is even, Nsigma lies in Z+1/2, is positive, and every point has weight two. Thus the k_j weights unfold any EVEN leading integrand EXACTLY to the full integer respectively half-integer lattice. Their product unfolds all three directions. The supported simplex boundary is a fixed distance from zero, so extending the local Gaussian lattice to infinity has an exponential error. Insert (8),(11),(12) into (2). Quartic action errors contribute relative O(1/N) after absolute Gaussian integration, because N||sigma||^4 has Gaussian mean O(1/N). The even amplitude's error is O(||sigma||^2), with the same O(1/N) expectation. Uniform factorial errors in (11) are O(1/N) already. The fixed signed chirp has modulus one on the real grid, so these absolute error estimates remain valid. Equation (10) controls the rest of the original sum. For A_i=2-i e_i, Re A_i=2. The one-dimensional exact Gaussian Poisson identity gives, with epsilon=0 or 1/2, sum_(h in Z+epsilon) exp[-pi A_i h^2/N] =sqrt(N)/sqrt(A_i) *sum_(ell in Z)exp[-pi N ell^2/A_i]exp(2pi i ell epsilon). Its nonzero Fourier modes are exponentially small because Re(1/A_i)=2/(4+e_i^2)>0. Multiply the three identities and the factor 1/16 from (11). This proves (3), including its nonzero phase, N^(3/2), both parity cosets and every fixed signed triple. No uniform assertion for twists growing with N is made. ## 5. Source and geometry scope The magnetic growth of an individual black vertex has been contracted COHERENTLY with the actual white/marked source before (1). This positive partition is specific to that two-vertex wiring. Formula (3) does not make arbitrary white vertices adjoints, does not bound an arbitrary branched graph in a tensor-product norm, and does not identify a spectral channel parameter with a peripheral color. Any hyperbolic-volume conclusion still needs the complement's separate literal geometric certificate and original external line. That separate certificate is now given in [the actual theta-link and angle geometry](actual_marked_theta_link_and_angle_geometry.md): the literal source is the three-box augmented pretzel matching, its complete complement has four regular ideal octahedra for every fixed signed e, and the original reduced one-cut external line has modulus one. Together with (3), it identifies (4) with the ACTUAL complement volume for that complete link family. It does not prove a filled-knot statement or general open-graph source factorization. Audit: [exact phases/folding and all-parity whole-label sums](../experiments/audit_actual_trivalent_marked_theta_label_asymptotic.py). The full-normal marked source identity is an input. Finite source and Gaussian-profile checks supplement the uniform analytical proof.

title: An actual noncentral trivalent source packet with two Steinberg legs
text: # An actual noncentral trivalent source packet with two Steinberg legs 29 October 2026. The odd central quartic transform extends to EVERY retained node on one leg of the original black trivalent source, with the other two legs central. It gives an exact common-phase positive factorial sum, a fixed complex color packet, and a strict physical complement gap. This is one actual magnetic coefficient, not a replacement for the full three-channel vertex or its white/marked rows. Set N=2m+1>=3, d=2m, q=exp(pi i/N), Q=q^2, x=q^d, F_a=(Q;Q)_a and s_a=|F_a|. All indices are unwrapped. Original normalizations are those of the [full vertex kernel](actual_trivalent_complete_circle_vertex_kernel.md). ## 1. Actual source coefficient and exact positive evaluation For 0<=j<=m put t=d-j. In the original physical pair define h^(j)_a=q^(a^2)[t choose a]_Q at |a,t-a>, W^(j)_r=F_pair^r h^(j)/F_r, 0<=r<=2j. (1) The highest equation follows from the ratio -x^-1 Q^a(1-Q^(t-a))/(1-Q^(a+1)). Its Casimir is c_j=q^(2j+1)+q^(-2j-1). At physical degree d, W^(j)_j(a,d-a)=q^(-j^2) f_a(c_j). (2) Indeed both sides solve the same actual tridiagonal eigenvector recurrence, and the first entry of the coproduct binomial is N x^-j/(F_t F_j)=q^(-j^2). No inverse frame is used. Extract the black source rows (W^(m)_d,W^(j)_j,W^(m)_0), after the literal port exchanges of the full kernel. Their pair degrees are (3m,2m,m), summing to 3d. The actual coefficient is N^3 B_(N,j), where B_(N,j)=sum_(k=0)^m x^(k-d) conjugate[(h^(m)_k)^2 W^(j)_j(m+k,m-k)]. (3) Here the exact lowest-column identity W^(m)_d(m+k,d-k)=h^(m)_k was proved with all phases in the [central anchor](actual_trivalent_steinberg_central_anchor.md#2-exact-source-normalizations-including-both-ends). Thus (3) is an original source coefficient, not a chosen abstract 6j. Define z_j(k)=s_(j+k)/[s_(j-k)s_k^2], 0<=k<=j, z_m(k)=beta(m,k)^2=N/[s_k^2 s_(m-k)^2]. The exact all-node formula is B_(N,j)=q^[m(2-3m+2j)] P_(N,j), P_(N,j)=sum_(k=0)^j z_j(k)z_m(k)>0. (4) It includes j=0,m, every odd composite N, and recovers the central quartic at j=m. In the specified CD basis sqrt(N)W on the two central legs and sqrt(2N)f(c_j) on the middle leg, j<m, the coefficient is sqrt(2)N^(9/2)q^(-j^2)B_(N,j). At j=m it is N^(9/2)B_(N,m). The sqrt(2) is the actual double-node FIRST-normal multiplicity; one must not continue it through the odd simple node. ## 2. Own finite proof at every node Let J_0 denote the actual complete anti-Pascal recoupling, not the six-head cup. The [central proof](actual_trivalent_steinberg_central_anchor.md#4-a-finite-coherent-quartic-transform) established by finite binomial inversion (J_0)_(a,b)=x D_aD_b[a+b choose a]_(Q^-1), D_a=(-q^-1)^a, a+b<=d; zero otherwise, conjugate(J_0) P J_0=P. (5) The actual other Casimir is lower bidiagonal, with diagonal c_a and lower entry Q^a+Q^-a-2. Hence y_j=J_0 f(c_j) is REAL, supported at d-j,...,d, with (y_j)_(d-j+k) =s_(d-j)s_j/[s_(d-2j+k)s_k s_(j-k)^2]. (6) Its last entry is (J_0)_(d,0)=1. Solve the first-order recurrence backwards from there using (c_a-c_j)/[-(Q^a+Q^-a-2)] =-q^-1(1-Q^(a-j))(1-Q^(a+j+1))/(1-Q^a)^2. The second occurrence of c_j forces all earlier entries to zero. Root reflection F_aF_(d-a)=N(-1)^a Q^[a(a+1)/2] cancels every phase in (6). Reversal P y_j is exactly the vector z_j above. At this root z_j(i)=(-q)^i(Q^-j;Q)_i(Q^(j+1);Q)_i/F_i^2. For k<=j form C_(j,k)=sum_(i=k)^j z_j(i)D_i[i choose k]_(Q^-1). With n=j-k, its k-th term times the remaining series is (Q^-j;Q)_k(Q^(j+1);Q)_k/F_k^2 *sum_(r=0)^n (Q^-n;Q)_r(Q^(j+k+1);Q)_r Q^(-kr) /[F_r(Q^(k+1);Q)_r]. The SECOND finite q-Chu applies: b=Q^(j+k+1), c=Q^(k+1), and cQ^n/b=Q^-k. It is the own finite identity obtained from the first q-Chu at base Q^-1 by inverting parameters, as in the central proof. All denominator indices are <=j<N. Its product side simplifies to C_(j,k)=(-1)^j q^[k^2-j(j+1)]z_j(k). (7) Vandermonde in (5) now gives, for ANY j,l<=m, z_j^T J_0 z_l=x(-1)^(j+l)q^[-j(j+1)-l(l+1)] *sum_(k=0)^min(j,l)z_j(k)z_l(k). (8) To recover the actual source, (2),(3) and the phases of h^(m) give B_(N,j)=q^[j^2-4m^2] f(c_j)^dagger J_0 f(c_m). Since y_j,y_m are real, (5) rewrites this matrix element as z_j^T J_0 z_m. Equation (8) and q^N=-1 give precisely (4). This evaluates the coherent source BEFORE any absolute values. ## 3. Entire physical color bound and strict complement gap For k<=j<m, z_(j+1)(k)/z_j(k) =sin[pi(j+k+1)/N]/sin[pi(j-k+1)/N]>=1. (9) For k>0 the difference of these sines is 2cos[pi(j+1)/N]sin(pi k/N)>0. Therefore 1=P_(N,0)<=P_(N,j)<=P_(N,m), log P_(N,j)<=N j0+O(log N), j0=v8/pi. (10) For EVERY fixed delta>0 there is gamma_delta>0 such that max_(m-j>=delta N) P_(N,j) <=poly(N)exp[N(j0-gamma_delta)]. (11) Outside a fixed neighborhood of k/N=1/4 the central quartic terms already have a strict gap. Inside it, sum log(9) over a fixed subinterval between j/N and 1/2. Its continuous positive integral is uniformly bounded below when (m-j)/N>=delta. The uniform O(log N) sine-factorial estimate covers endpoints. This proves (11), with an empty physical range simply ignored. ## 4. Exact complex-color factorial packet Let S_hat_N be the [canonical sine factorial](exact_factorial_interpolation_and_complex_contours.md), with S_hat_N(a)=s_a and S_hat_N(z)S_hat_N(d-z)=N EXACTLY. Fix a small epsilon>0, I_N={k:|k/N-1/4|<=epsilon}, and set Pwin_N(sigma)=N sum_(k in I_N) S_hat_N(m-Nsigma+k) /[S_hat_N(m-Nsigma-k)s_k^4s_(m-k)^2]. (12) This is an EXACT holomorphic function on a fixed small complex sigma disk, with all scaled factorial arguments in a compact bulk strip. It is EXACTLY EVEN by reflection. At physical sigma=(m-j)/N it is exactly the retained terms of (4). Their omitted positive terms have a uniform exponential gap, also relative to the retained packet after shrinking the disk. The original source completion is q^[m(2-m)-2mN sigma]Pwin_N(sigma); at integral deficit s its extra character is (-1)^s q^s, which has NOT been deleted. Put J(t)=integral_0^t Log(2sin pi a)da on the marked bulk strip and F(t,sigma)=J(1/2-sigma+t)-J(1/2-sigma-t) -4J(t)-2J(1/2-t). (13) The canonical complex factorial expansion, including the actual half-step m/N=1/2-1/(2N), gives the summand in (12) as exp[NF(t,sigma)]/[4N^2 sin^2(pi t)] *[1+O(1/N)], (14) uniformly on a slightly larger complex t,sigma tube. The square root of the numerator/denominator sine ratio cancels the phase shift exp[-(G(1/2-sigma+t)-G(1/2-sigma-t))/2], G=J'. The remaining exp[G(1/2-t)]=2cos(pi t) cancels its denominator. Thus (14) has neither an unknown periodic multiplier nor a missing half-step constant. The unique real saddle continues holomorphically as t_*(sigma)=atan(cos pi sigma)/pi, A(sigma)=-F_tt(t_*,sigma) =2pi[1+cos^2(pi sigma)]^2/cos^3(pi sigma). For real small sigma, strict concavity follows directly from the cotangent derivatives in (13). Let Phi(sigma)=F(t_*,sigma). Then Phi(0)=j0, Phi'(sigma)=-2 artanh(sin pi sigma), Phi''(sigma)=-2pi/cos pi sigma, Phi(sigma)=j0-pi sigma^2+O(sigma^4). (15) The EXACT packet has the uniform COMPLEX asymptotic Pwin_N(sigma)=N^(-3/2) exp[NPhi(sigma)] /[4sqrt(cos pi sigma)] *[1+O(1/N)]. (16) Here sqrt is +1 at zero. For completeness, enclose I_N by half-grid vertical sides and horizontal sides of fixed small height b, using the exact kernel pi N cot(pi N t). The vertical sides have |cot|<=1 and retain the source endpoint currents; their phase has a strict window boundary gap. On horizontal sides the cotangent error is O(exp(-2pi N b)), whereas phase growth is <=Cb^2+C|sigma|^2b. Choose b first with Cb^2<pi b and then shrink the complex sigma disk. All these errors and the endpoint connectors are exponentially gapped. The main contours deform through t_* within the same zero-free factorial strip. Analytic Gaussian integration of (14) gives (16), since sqrt(2pi/A)/(4sin^2(pi t_*))=1/[4sqrt(cos pi sigma)]. This proves uniformity for the exact packet, not just its real-grid leading terms. Cauchy estimates keep every FIXED color derivative. In particular on smaller real/imaginary corridors, |Pwin_N(x+iy)|<=poly(N)exp[N(j0-cx^2+Cy^2)], c>0. (17) ## 5. Remaining branching interfaces The theorem concerns a genuine original black coefficient with two central legs. The double-node CD factor above has retained the first normal of the complete circle BEFORE its fixed-root image is taken. Equation (12) continues color in this coefficient; it does NOT take derivatives of a moving-q physical source germ. Here sigma is an INTERNAL pair-Casimir channel deficit. It has not been identified with an auxiliary meridian or an ordinary-circle color parameter; such an identification needs its own actual source and peripheral transport certificate. For three independently noncentral legs the actual kernel still has three distinct highest/descendant polynomials. The reduction to (8) used the two central legs essentially. One magnetic coefficient also does not bound all other T_i, or identify the distinct U,V,V_m. Paired socle columns have W^dagger P W=0, whereas the central column has W^dagger P W=I; its retraction cannot simply be continued. Those remain explicit interfaces before an arbitrary noncrossing triple-partition graph can be estimated by this positive packet. Audit: [literal source and all-node finite transform](../experiments/audit_actual_trivalent_one_channel_source_packet.py). Tests supplement the finite proof and contour estimate; no sewn-graph survival or new hyperbolic-volume claim is inferred from them.

title: An exact original trivalent beta cycle and its norm remainder
text: # An exact original trivalent beta cycle and its norm remainder 28 October 2026. The original balanced head equation at a trivalent vertex now has a specified one-dimensional relative source. Its finite convolution is an explicit Newton polynomial. A norm-corrected Barnes contour splits this polynomial into a NONZERO balanced residue block and an explicitly retained normalization term. The Barnes factor of that latter term is uniformly bounded on compact positive boundary families. No unknown knot coefficient or replaced invariant occurs. This is a local source theorem. The norm factor can have exponential size; the rate of the nonzero residue block and its comparison with that normalization term are separate. Nonvanishing of this block does not yet prove the global knot period selects it after all other boundary integrations. ## 1. The source and its exact finite polynomial Use the original full functions Psi_+, Psi_- from [the circle-and-boundary source theorem](actual_modular_dilog_circle_and_boundary_source.md). Put N>=2, d=N-1, h=2*pi*i/N and Q=exp h. Their coefficients through degree d are p_a=(-1)^a Q^(a(a-1)/2)/(Q;Q)_a, m_a=Q^a/(Q;Q)_a. After the exact reflection of the positive factorial order, the trivalent fiber field is precisely F_N(L;U,V)=r^d Psi_-(Log U-L) Psi_+(Log V-L)Psi_+(-L), r=exp L. (1) The graph incidence argument in [the bipyramid source note](positive_bipyramid_source_transport.md#4-the-original-source-law-checked-on-the-actual-reduced-graph) shows that its constant Laurent coefficient is the original complete source convolution, with all original boundary tags retained. The finite q-binomial calculation gives [r^0] F_N=(Q^(-d)/N) B_N(Q^2 U,Q V), B_N(u,v)=sum_(a=0)^d product_(j=0)^(a-1)(u-Q^j v). (2) The empty product is one. Thus u=Q^2 U, v=Q V and N Q^d are exact tags and normalization, not only their classical limits. The basic original-source recurrences are B_N(u,v)=(u-v)B_N(u,Qv)+D_N(u,v), v B_N(Qu,Qv)=(u-1)B_N(u,v)+D_N(u,v), D_N(u,v)=1-u^N+v^N. (3) The second follows by summing Q^a p_a=(u p_a-p_(a+1))/v for the Newton products p_a. Both endpoint terms are part of the source. ## 2. A single exact outer-Hankel current At large r, each full Psi in (1) has its first N ordinary coefficients plus O_N((1+|Log r|)|r|^(-N)). Therefore F_N is its ordinary Laurent polynomial down through the constant term plus O_N(log|r|/|r|), uniformly over a bounded logarithmic turn. Its generalized constant coefficient is consequently an actual limit of full lifted circles. Write M_N(r)=(r^N-V^N)(r^N-1)/[r^N(r^N-U^N)], C_N(R)=(1/(2*pi*i)) integral_(log R-i*pi)^(log R+i*pi) F_N(L)dL. For R initially larger than max(1,|U|,|V|), with the fixed logarithmic marks in (1), the EXACT source identity is [r^0]F_N=C_N(R)+(1/(2*pi*i)) integral_R^infinity [M_N(-s)-1]F_N(log s-i*pi) ds/s. (4) Indeed F_N(L+2*pi*i)=M_N(exp L)F_N(L). Apply Cauchy's theorem to the logarithmic rectangle log R<=Re L<=log S and let S increase to infinity. The circle's positive Laurent powers integrate to zero, and its remainder tends to zero. The outer integral converges because M_N(-s)-1=O_N(s^(-N)) and d=N-1. This identity is the simultaneous pushforward of the coefficient source. It carries all mixed original radial pieces; it is not a replacement by three bare circles. Subsequent contour continuation retains the poles and end faces it crosses. No unproved positive separating contour is assigned to (4). ## 3. A convergent Barnes contour with a variable central norm Consider the positive boundary chamber Im u<0, Im(v/u)>0. (5) Fix Log u with -pi<Arg u<0 and c=Log(v/u) with 0<Im c<pi. Their sum is the continuous logarithm of v, whose imaginary part lies strictly between -pi and pi. Choose 0<epsilon<1 with 2*pi*epsilon/N<Im c. Define g(a)=exp(a Log u) Psi_+(c)/Psi_+(c+h a), t=exp(2*pi*i*a), lambda(t)=u^N-v^N t, I_N(u,v)=integral_(-epsilon-i*infinity)^(-epsilon+i*infinity) g(a)/(exp(-2*pi*i*a)-1) da. (6) The line is oriented UPWARD. The exact full-Psi steps give g(n)=product_(j<n)(u-Q^j v), g(a+N)=[u^N-v^N exp(2*pi*i*a)]g(a). (7) The variable exponential in (7) is essential. A constant Floquet multiplier is true at integer samples only, and cannot be used in a complex contour argument. On the entire strip -epsilon<=Re a<=N-epsilon, the denominator Psi_+(c+h a) has no zeros: its argument has positive imaginary part, whereas the zeros of Psi_+ occur at nonpositive imaginary integer combinations of h and 2*pi*i. Thus g is holomorphic there. ## 4. Exact norm-pole residue transport Assume temporarily u^N!=1 and D_N!=0, and choose alpha with exp(2*pi*i*alpha)=(u^N-1)/v^N, -epsilon<Re alpha<1-epsilon, v_*=v exp(h alpha), so u^N-v_*^N=1. (8) Avoid parameters with a pole on the two chosen vertical sides; the result extends by continuation. Use the original sample-preserving norm-corrected differential omega=2*pi*i D_N t g(a) da/[(t-1)(1-lambda(t))]. (9) Its residues are g(n) at n=0,...,N-1 and -g(alpha+k) at alpha+k, k=0,...,N-1. At the latter points g(alpha+k)=g(alpha) product_(j<k)(u-Q^j v_*). The factor t in (9) is important BOTH for these residues and for the ends. For Im a tending to positive infinity it supplies the decay exp(-2*pi Im a). For Im a tending to negative infinity, the two denominator factors and this numerator leave the decay exp(-2*pi |Im a|), overcoming the full right-edge growth of g. The full-Phi horizontal asymptotics prove that the horizontal sides of the width-N rectangle tend to zero, uniformly in its real coordinate. On its two vertical sides, (7) gives omega(a+N)-omega(a) =2*pi*i D_N g(a)/(exp(-2*pi*i*a)-1) da. The residue theorem therefore proves the exact source-cycle identity B_N(u,v)=S_N(u,v)+D_N(u,v) I_N(u,v), S_N(u,v)=g(alpha) B_N(u,v_*). (10) All central norm factors are retained. The extra norm poles are not discarded: their complete balanced Fourier block is the first term. Changing alpha by an integer does not change S_N, by the balanced version of (3). Thus (10) is independent of the root/deck choice. The balanced block B_N(u,v_*) is nonzero if uv_*!=0. One elementary proof takes the discrete Fourier transform of the cyclic sequence p_k=product_(j<k)(u-Q^jv_*), for which p_N=p_0=1. Its Fourier components obey a first-order cyclic recurrence with all coefficients nonzero. No component, including their zero-frequency sum B_N, can vanish. This is a finite source statement, not an asymptotic argument. The other factors in S_N are nonzero in the stated chamber. At D_N=0, equation (10) extends directly and S_N=B_N is nonzero. At u^N=1 the norm pole escapes and must be checked separately. If u_0=Q^(-j) with its lower principal argument, the first nonzero coefficient of B_N(u_0,w) is b_j w^j, b_j!=0. This follows from (u_0 Q^k-1)b_k=Q^(k-1)b_(k-1) and its nonzero top coefficient. As u tends to u_0, v_*^j contributes [(u^N-1)/v^N]^(j/N), exactly cancelling the opposite power in exp(alpha Log u). Since Psi_+(c+h alpha) tends to one, the finite limit is Psi_+(c)b_j v^j!=0. This is a fixed-N collision calculation; no uniform collision asymptotic is assumed. Consequently S_N is nonzero throughout (5), after these specified removable continuations. ## 5. The Barnes normalization term is uniformly tame For every compact K inside (5), there are C_K and N_K such that |I_N(u,v)|<=C_K, (u,v) in K, N>=N_K. (11) This bound includes the norm collisions just described. To prove it, write a=-epsilon+i N y and x=v/u. The uniform actual full-Psi symbol on the entire selected strip gives the leading real exponent R_N(y)=-y Arg u+ Im[Li_2(x)-Li_2(x exp(-2*pi*i*epsilon/N-2*pi*y))]/(2*pi). Here N R_N(0)=O_K(1). Its EXACT leading derivative is R_N'(y)=-Arg u- Arg(1-x exp(-2*pi*i*epsilon/N-2*pi*y)). (12) It lies between -Arg u>0 and pi-Arg v+O_K(1/N)<2*pi. Thus R_N(y)<=O_K(1/N)+eta y for y<=0, while R_N(y)-2*pi*y<=O_K(1/N)-eta y for y>=0, with a fixed eta>0. The denominator in (6) supplies precisely exp(-2*pi*N*y) on the positive half-line and is bounded on the negative half-line. The full-Psi amplitude ratio is bounded uniformly for all real y, because its selected argument stays a fixed distance from the positive real ray. Its relative error is O_K(1/N). The resulting integrand is bounded by C_K exp(-eta |Im a|). This proves (11); the apparent N in da=N i dy cancels its decay scale N^(-1). A fixed finite set of smaller N is treated by the original horizontal full-Phi bounds. The leading normalization symbol can also be determined rather than left unspecified. Uniformly on the same compact families, I_N=1/(1-u+v)-h*v*(u-v)/(1-u+v)^3+O_K(h^2). (11a) For a on the fixed vertical line with |Im a|<=C log N, the actual full-Psi symbol and its holomorphic derivative bound give g(a)=(u-v)^a [1-h*a*(a-1)*(v/u)/(2*(1-v/u)) +O_K(h^2*(1+|a|^6))]. Here Log(u-v)=Log u+Log(1-v/u) has imaginary part in (-2*pi,0). The exponentially decaying tails proved above permit a cutoff C log N with error smaller than any fixed inverse power, while the displayed error integrates to O(h^2). The elementary convergent Barnes identity integral_(Re a=-epsilon,up) w^a/(exp(-2*pi*i*a)-1) da =1/(1-w) holds on that cut plane, first by closing to the right for |w|<1 and then by analytic continuation. Applying w^2*d_w^2 proves (11a). The same coefficient also follows from the exact current recurrence I_N(u,v)=(u-v)I_N(u,Qv)+1 on their common logarithmic chamber. Thus the retained term is three explicit norm phases 1,u^N,v^N times an analytic normalization symbol. This asymptotic description does not discard possible subdominant exponentially small pieces. The normalization group's rate therefore obeys limsup (1/N) log |D_N I_N| <=max(0,log|u|,log|v|), (13) uniformly on compact families. It is NOT always exponentially small. For instance it can have the original boundary norm rate. Any proof of a geometric lower bound must compare S_N with this retained term and with the subsequent exterior source; it cannot discard (13). ## 6. The actual homogeneous source line, with its normalizer explicit The zero-charge part now really is an explicit torsor section. Put c_*=c+h alpha, so exp(N c_*)=1-u^(-N). Equation (10) becomes S_N(u,v)=A_N(u) exp[-c Log u/h] Psi_+(c), A_N(u)=exp[c_* Log u/h] B_N(u,u exp c_*)/Psi_+(c_*). (14) Changing c_* by h leaves A_N unchanged by (3) and the full-Psi shift. Thus A_N depends only on u and is NONZERO; there is no unidentified knot scalar in this local source formula. On a common lower logarithmic chamber (and subsequently by the specified analytic continuation), the exact source equations imply A_N(Qu)=(1-u^(-1))A_N(u). (15) The selected function Psi_+(h-Log u) has the same step. Their quotient is h-periodic in Log u. This observation alone does NOT make that quotient constant or tame. The subsequent [exact normalizer proof](actual_trivalent_beta_normalizer.md) uses the actual source's divisor and both end bounds to determine it: A_N(u)=(N/phi_N) u^N Psi_+(h-Log u). (15a) The central u^N is compulsory and may have an exponential rate. Periodicity by itself would not have justified its omission. The classical growing saddle of the original fiber is r=V/(1+V-U), and its signed positive bipyramid has V/r and 1/r upper and U/r lower. The exact nonzero section (14) is the candidate that can carry this growing block. Its comparison with the full geometric normal contour and the bound (13) remains the next step. The earlier charged REAL kernel with negative volume rate is not used as a substitute for this original source. ## 7. Positive geometry alone does not dominate this local source There is a useful exact obstruction to dropping the norm-gap or the exterior boundary functional. Whenever |u|+|v|<=c<1, |B_N(u,v)|<=1/(1-c), B_N(u,v) -> 1/(1-u+v) as N -> infinity. (16) Every Newton product is bounded by c^a. For each fixed a it tends to (u-v)^a as Q tends to one, so dominated convergence proves both claims. This is an open chamber of the original polynomial source. It contains genuine strictly positive signed bipyramids. For example take u=-4*i/5 and v=1/100. The three-side shapes and two outputs are p=1+v-u=101/100+4*i/5, q=p/v=101+80*i, H=u*q=64-404*i/5, p/H=v/u=i/80, q/H=1/u=5*i/4. Both p,q are upper, H is lower, and both outputs are upper; their oriented volume D(p)+D(q)-D(H)=D(i/80)+D(5*i/4) is strictly positive. Nevertheless the actual local source (16) has rate ZERO. The exact original tags in (2) converge to these same shapes, so this is not a replacement by a different quantum atom. Thus a positive classical bipyramid cannot by itself force the scalar trivalent source to grow at its volume. Its boundary Legendre terms, branch marks and the complete exterior pairing matter. In a family where the explicit residue rate DOES strictly exceed max(0,log|u|,log|v|), (10)--(13) instead give B_N=S_N(1+o(1)) with an exponentially small relative remainder, once the residue's uniform logarithmic error is controlled. The present note proves the exact source decomposition and remainder bound; it does not assume that inequality for every positive bipyramid or every knot network.

title: An independent root-Fourier certificate for the trivalent black scalar
text: # An independent root-Fourier certificate for the trivalent black scalar 29 October 2026. This derives an EXACT Euler-polynomial coefficient formula from the actual highest/descendant source. It proves its integer saturation support J>=d by cancellation of a complete Fourier mode. The positive C R identity is not assumed in this derivation; its remaining finite transformation is now separately [proved](finite_trivalent_euler_racah_transform.md). This coefficient certificate retains all original phases and root endpoint currents. Let N>=2, d=N-1, q=exp(pi i/N), Q=q^2, x=q^d, F_a=(Q;Q)_a. Assume integer 0<=j_i<=floor(d/2) satisfying the triangle inequalities, and put r=j_2+j_3-j_1 and J=j_1+j_2+j_3. Thus 0<=r<=2min(j_2,j_3). Use the original balanced coproduct and highest vectors h^(j)_k=q^(k^2)[d-j choose k]_Q. The selected actual black coefficient is N^3 A, with A=q^[-j_1(d-2j_1)] sum_k x^[k+j_1+j_3-2d] conjugate[h^(j_1)_k h^(j_3)_k W^(j_2)_r(j_3+k,d-j_1-k)]. (1) Here k=0,...,min(d-j_1,d-j_3), W^(j)_r=F_pair^r h^(j)/F_r. This is the literal endpoint extraction of the all-port vertex, including its lowest-column phase; no generic 6j formula is used. ## 1. Exact coefficient theorem Define the unnormalized Jackson difference D_Q g(T)=[g(T)-g(QT)]/T, D_Q T^h=(1-Q^h)T^(h-1), f(T)=(TQ^(1-j_3);Q)_(j_3), g(T)=(TQ;Q)_(j_2). The source-exact identity is A= N q^E/[F_(j_1)F_(j_2)F_(j_3)F_r] *[T^d] g(T)^2 D_Q^r f(T)^2, E=3j_1^2+j_2^2+j_3^2-2j_1j_2-2j_1j_3 +2j_2j_3-2j_3-2. (2) Every polynomial and denominator is finite; all denominator indices are below N. In particular deg(g^2 D_Q^r f^2)=J, so J<d implies A=0 EXACTLY. (3) This is an original-source cancellation before taking absolute values, not an admissibility rule imposed on a guessed 6j symbol. ## 2. Own finite Fourier proof The original coproduct binomial gives, with b=d-j_1-k, W^(j_2)_r(j_3+k,b)=F_(j_3+k)F_bF_(d-j_2) *sum_z q^(z^2)x^[-r+j_3+k-z] Q^[z(r-j_3-k+z)] /[F_z^2 F_(d-j_2-z)^2 F_(j_3+k-z) F_(j_2-j_1-k+z)]. The range is exactly where every displayed denominator index is nonnegative and <N. Substitute this and the two highest vectors in (1). Use only conjugate(F_a)=(-1)^a Q^[-a(a+1)/2]F_a, F_(d-a)=N(-1)^a Q^[a(a+1)/2]/F_a, q^N=-1. After the factors N cancel, the result is A=(-1)^(j_3)q^B/[F_(j_1)F_(j_2)F_(j_3)] *sum_(k,z) (-1)^(k+z) q^[(k-z)^2+(1+2j_1-2j_2)k+(1-2j_3)z] [(Q^(k+1);Q)_(j_3)(Q^(z+1);Q)_(j_2)]^2 /[F_(j_3+k-z)F_(j_2-j_1-k+z)], B=3j_1^2-2j_1j_2+j_2^2-j_3-2. (4) Equation (4) displays all phase bookkeeping; no root sign is left in an unspecified scalar. Put l=k-z and p=j_3+l. The two last factorials force p=0,...,r. For fixed p the z-dependent factor is Q^[(1-r)z] (Q^(z+p-j_3+1);Q)_(j_3)^2(Q^(z+1);Q)_(j_2)^2. Its sum extends EXACTLY to z=0,...,N-1. For z>d-j_2 the second Euler factor contains 1-Q^N. If k=z+p-j_3<0 then k>=-j_3 and the first factor contains 1-Q^0; if k>d-j_3 it contains 1-Q^N. There is no k>=N wrap because z<=d-j_2 and p-j_3<=j_2-j_1 imply k<=d-j_1. Thus all added states are killed by their literal factorial zeros. For a polynomial P(T) of degree <=2(j_2+j_3)<2N, complete root Fourier summation consequently selects precisely sum_(z=0)^(N-1) Q^[(1-r)z]P(Q^z) =N([T^(r-1)]P+[T^(N+r-1)]P). (5) Absent or negative coefficient indices mean zero. The p sum in (4) is, after its explicit constant phase is extracted, H(T)=sum_(p=0)^r (-1)^p Q^[p(p-1)/2+(1-r)p] [r choose p]_Q f(Q^pT)^2. If f(T)^2=sum_h c_h T^h, the finite binomial theorem gives H(T)=sum_h c_h T^h(Q^(1-r+h);Q)_r =T^r D_Q^r f(T)^2. (6) In fact for h<r the product contains 1-Q^0, while for h>=r it equals F_h/F_(h-r). Therefore the LOW Fourier coefficient r-1 in (5) vanishes EXACTLY. The surviving high coefficient is [T^(N+r-1)]g^2H=[T^d]g^2D_Q^r f^2. The p-independent phase in (4) is q^E, with E as in (2), and its factorial denominator is F_r. This proves (2) and (3), including r=0 and all level parities. ## 3. A finite low-degree version at saturation depth delta For delta=J-d>=0, put c_e=[U^e](U;Q)_(j_3)^2. Reversal of the two finite Euler products in (2) gives [T^d]g^2D_Q^r f^2 =Q^[j_2(j_2+1)-j_3(j_3-1)] [U^delta] (UQ^(-j_2);Q)_(j_2)^2 *sum_(e=0)^(2j_3-r) c_e F_(2j_3-e)/F_(2j_3-e-r) U^e. (7) Thus only coefficients <=delta need be computed. All denominator indices in (7) are physical: delta<=j_i and delta<=2j_3-r follow from the bounds on the other two j's. For any fixed saturation depth this is a fixed-length source formula, with no unspecified boundary data or q-normal derivative. It is not claimed that its summands have a common phase. ## 4. Two entire saturation layers are manifestly nonzero Let Lead=Q^[j_2(j_2+1)-j_3(j_3-1)] F_(2j_3)/F_(2j_3-r). This is the NONZERO leading coefficient of g^2D_Q^r f^2. Therefore on the entire layer delta=0, equation (2) gives A=Nq^E Lead/[F_(j_1)F_(j_2)F_(j_3)F_r]!=0. (8) For delta=1, so J=N, the next-to-leading coefficient divided by Lead is -2/(1-Q) [Q^(-j_2)(1-Q^(j_2)) +(1-Q^(j_3))(1-Q^(2j_3-r))/(1-Q^(2j_3))] =2Q^(-2j_2)(1-Q^(j_2))(1-Q^(j_2+j_3)) /[(1-Q)(1+Q^(j_3))]. (9) The first equality follows by taking the next coefficient in the two Euler squares before the Jackson derivative: their ratios are -2sum_(a=1)^(j_2)Q^-a and -2sum_(a=0)^(j_3-1)Q^a; the derivative multiplies the latter ratio by (1-Q^(2j_3-r))/(1-Q^(2j_3)). For the second equality use 2j_3-r=J-2j_2=N-2j_2 and cancel the factor 1-Q^(j_3) in 1-Q^(2j_3). Every factor on the last line of (9) is nonzero. Indeed J=N and 2j_i<=d force j_i>=1; also j_2+j_3=N-j_1 lies strictly between 0 and N, and j_3<N/2 excludes 1+Q^(j_3)=0. Multiplying (9) by the nonzero prefactor in (2) proves A!=0 on the ENTIRE delta=1 layer, at both level parities. Empty small-N layers are simply absent. These are genuine all-triple source nonvanishing statements, not deductions from a presumed positive formula. ## 5. The subsequent exact transformation The complete positive formula from this independent route equates the finite coefficient in (2) or (7), including its displayed phase, to (-1)^(N+J)q^[2j_1^2-j_1j_2-j_1j_3+j_2j_3-J-3] *[prod_i s_(j_i)/(N s_delta)] R_N(j). Equation (3) already proves its saturation-zero branch. The [one-central-channel result](actual_trivalent_one_channel_source_packet.md) supplies a proved nonzero boundary line. The finite coefficient-to- short-series and Sears bridge is now proved in the linked finite Euler-to-Racah transform, with an independent square-linearization derivation. Finite experiments alone do not prove it. No sewn-graph energy, magnetic norm or hyperbolic-volume claim is made from this coefficient formula. Audit: [literal source, Fourier selection and coefficient theorem](../experiments/audit_actual_trivalent_root_fourier_source_certificate.py).

title: A short finite square-linearization proof of the positive source scalar
text: # A short finite square-linearization proof of the positive source scalar 29 October 2026. This proves the remaining source-coefficient-to-short-series identity by finite product linearization and root cancellation. It is independent of the Jackson-Leibniz/Newton derivation. The input is the already proved original-source coefficient theorem, not a proposed 6j formula. All root denominators and zero coefficients are retained. Put N>=2, d=N-1, Q^N=1 with Q primitive, F_k=(Q;Q)_k. Take retained triangle labels a,b,c<=floor(d/2), let J=a+b+c, delta=J-d>=0, r=b+c-a, and H=2c-r=a+c-b=d-2b+delta. In particular 0<=delta<=min(a,b,c,H), 0<=r<=2min(b,c), 2b,2c<N. The reversed coefficient in the [actual root-Fourier theorem](actual_trivalent_root_fourier_source_certificate.md) is C_delta=[U^delta](UQ^-b;Q)_b^2 *sum_(e=0)^H [V^e](V;Q)_c^2 F_(2c-e)/F_(H-e) U^e. (1) The first three sections prove exactly C_delta=T_0 H_c, T_0=Q^[delta(delta-1-2b)] F_b^2 F_(2c) /[F_H F_delta F_(b-delta)^2], H_c=sum_(k=0)^delta (Q^-delta,Q^-c,Q^-c,Q^-H;Q)_k Q^k /(Q,Q^-2c,Q^(b-delta+1),Q^(b-delta+1);Q)_k. (2) Every denominator here is nonzero. No ordering such as a=max(a,b,c) is required. Section 4 completes the finite Sears transformation and explicit phase conversion to the positive factorial partition. ## 1. An elementary finite product linearization For generic v and nonnegative m,n, (U;v)_m(U;v)_n =sum_(k=0)^min(m,n) A_(m,n,k) U^k(U;v)_(m+n-k), A_(m,n,k)=(-1)^k v^[k(k-1)/2] (v;v)_m(v;v)_n /[(v;v)_k(v;v)_(m-k)(v;v)_(n-k)]. (3) Here is a finite induction. The m=0 case is immediate. With S=m+n, (1-v^m U)U^k(U;v)_(S-k) =U^k(U;v)_(S+1-k) +(v^(S-k)-v^m)U^(k+1)(U;v)_(S-k). Consequently the next coefficient is A_(m,n,k)+(v^(m+n-k+1)-v^m)A_(m,n,k-1) =A_(m+1,n,k). Substitution of the displayed factorials proves this equality; the interior ratio is (1-v^(m+1))/(1-v^(m+1-k)). Endpoints follow by clearing denominators and setting out-of-range coefficients to zero. Thus (3) is a polynomial identity, and specializes at Q with m=n=c because c<N. The largest product length 2c is also below N here. Apply the coefficient multiplier V^e -> F_(2c-e)U^e/F_(H-e), 0<=e<=H, to (3) with m=n=c, discarding coefficients above H. In its k-th term the finite binomial coefficient [2c-k choose e-k]_Q cancels the factor F_(2c-e). The remaining finite binomial theorem gives sum_(e=0)^H [V^e](V;Q)_c^2 F_(2c-e)U^e/F_(H-e) =sum_(k=0)^min(c,H) (-1)^k Q^[k(k-1)/2] F_c^2 F_(2c-k) /[F_k F_(c-k)^2 F_(H-k)] U^k(U;Q)_(H-k). (4) No coefficient beyond the genuine derivative range H is introduced. ## 2. The exact root coefficient cancellation For 0<=n<=b put I_n=[U^n](UQ^-b;Q)_b^2(U;Q)_(d-2b+n). Since (U;Q)_N=1-U^N and n<N, coefficient extraction gives exactly I_n=[U^n] (UQ^-b;Q)_b /(UQ^(n-1-2b);Q)_(b+1-n). (5) Indeed the missing factor in the length-N product runs from exponent n-1-2b through -1. Its last b factors cancel one of the two numerator products. Formal division is valid because every Euler factor has constant coefficient one. The discarded numerator term U^N cannot affect the coefficient n. Set h=b+1-n>=1 and z=Q^(n-1-2b). The reciprocal finite-product coefficient is z^l(Q^h;Q)_l/F_l: it follows either by multiplying the factors, or from the recurrence obtained by shifting U to QU.
