Scaling the Vandermonde by nu then proves det T_nu=nu^(N(N-1)/2) product_(r=1)^(N-1) [(1-Q^r)/(nu-Q^r)]^(N-r). (4.3) The remaining Q constant is fixed by nu=1,U=0: T_nu is then P_N of a nilpotent matrix and has determinant one. Equations (3.3) and det(a_0 T_nu)=1 give (4.2). This also proves uniqueness in the marked formal neighborhood. Two unit solutions of (3.3) differ by a central function f(U). Their norms imply f(U)^N=1; f(0)=1 forces f=1 in characteristic zero. The root is not independently reset at each occurrence. ## 5. The first central jet is explicit and nonscalar Write a_j(U)=c_j+U r_j+O(U^2), and R_N(X)=sum_j r_j X^j. Differentiating (4.1)--(4.2) gives r_0=(1/N^2)sum_(k=1)^(N-1) k/(1-Q^k), r_j/c_j=r_0+(1/N)sum_(k=1)^j 1/(1-Q^k). (5.1) For the first formula use sum_k(1-Q^k)^(-1)=(N-1)/2, obtained by pairing k with N-k, including its even-level middle term. The increments in the second formula are nonzero. Thus R_N is not a scalar multiple of P_N; changing only a scalar source line cannot replace this operator jet. For the actual complex roots, (5.1) also proves directly max_j |r_j/c_j|=O(1+log N). (5.2) Indeed |1-Q^k|>=4 min(k,N-k)/N, and the resulting harmonic sum is O(log N). This is a coefficient estimate in the specified Euler frame, not a condition-number estimate for every tensor operator or a lower bound for a contracted knot period. ## 6. The pentagon extends through the nilpotent central order Let R=K[[U,V]], with the roots of 1-U,1-V,1-U+UV marked by their value one. The algebra A_R=R<X,Y>/(XY-QYX,X^N-U,Y^N-V) is free over R with basis X^iY^j, 0<=i,j<N. Formula (3.1) defines units there: its reduction is P_N of a nilpotent element. The strict cyclic pentagon proved in [the root pentagon note](cyclic_tetrahedron_pentagon.md) is d_N(Y)d_N(bX) =d_N(X)d_N(-YX/a)d_N(Y/h), (6.1) a^N=1-U, b^N=1-V, h^N=1-U+UV. Its anchored branches are regular in this order. Localizing the free order to its generic central field gives the proved identity; torsion freeness therefore extends it to A_R itself. This includes its nilpotent source, rather than replacing the source by a generic unpointed splitting module. Here is its complete first mixed jet, modulo (U^2,V^2), which retains UV. Put T=-YX, P_Z=P_N(Z), R_Z=R_N(Z), and partial f(Z)=Z f'(Z). The three transported factors are B_X=P_X+U R_X-(V/N)partial P_X -UV(R_X+partial R_X/N), B_T=P_T+(U/N)partial P_T-UV R_T, B_Y=P_Y+(U/N)partial P_Y+V R_Y +UV(-partial P_Y/N+R_Y+partial R_Y/N). Then exactly in this quotient, (P_Y+V R_Y)B_X=(P_X+U R_X)B_T B_Y. (6.2) These formulas follow by expanding the actual transported norm roots and arguments in (6.1). In particular (bX)^N=U-UV, (-YX/a)^N=-UV, and (Y/h)^N=V+UV in this quotient. Thus the corner term -UV R_T is derived, not a freely chosen correction. Omitting it gives a nonzero operator at every level: R_N is nonzero by (5.1), the powers T^j are independent in the nilpotent PBW basis, and the remaining P_X,P_Y factors are units. Any specified external vectors and covectors inherit (6.2), with their full source and co-source transported. A nonzero omitted corner is detectable by some exterior functional: coefficient extraction in the PBW basis is perfect, and pairing with the complementary monomial detects a chosen coefficient. This does not prove that a particular knot's selected cut has nonzero geometric coupling. The central variables here are primitive quantum-plane centers. They are not the earlier meridian wall coordinate or the point source of the scalarized A-curve. Nor is this free primitive order a common stable lattice for the unscaled adjacent meridian projectors; their double-pole obstruction remains unchanged. ## 7. Uniform polynomial bounds beyond fixed algebraic degree Let D be a simply connected domain containing 0 but not 1, and let L(U)=Log(1-U) on D with L(0)=0. Take nu_N(U)=exp(L(U)/N), Q_N=exp(2pi*i/N). For every compact K in D there are constants B,C, independent of N>=2 and 0<=j<N, such that C^(-1)N^(-B)<=|a_j(U)/c_j|<=C N^B, U in K. (7.1) Proof. L is bounded on K, so |nu_N-1|<=C_K/N. For roots with min(r,N-r) larger than a fixed constant, the ratios (nu_N-Q_N^r)/(1-Q_N^r) are 1+O_K(1/min(r,N-r)). Their logarithmic moduli have the same bound, whose sum is O_K(log N). There are only finitely many remaining endpoint indices. Their ratios converge uniformly on K to (L(U)-2pi*i*r)/(-2pi*i*r), or its negative-index version. These limits never vanish: L(U)=2pi*i*r, r!=0, would imply U=0, where the chosen L is zero. Hence their moduli and inverse moduli are bounded. Finitely many small N satisfy the same bound by compactness and the identical nonvanishing argument. Finally log|nu_N|=Re L/N. In (4.2), all product weights (N-r)/N are bounded by one. Thus |log|a_0||=O_K(1+log N); (4.1) gives the same bound for every coefficient ratio. This proves (7.1). Both ratios and their inverses are holomorphic on D with the marked roots. Cauchy estimates on a fixed small circle about zero therefore bound every fixed central Taylor jet by a power of N. The sharper first-jet estimate is (5.2). The bounded logarithm lift is essential. Arbitrary cut indices growing with N can make nu stay away from one and are not covered by this proof. The theorem also does not compare sums of complex terms from different source channels: polynomial entrywise factors alone do not exclude global cancellation. ## 8. An exact comparison with the original factorial source and cut This completion also identifies a specified source vector, not only an operator normalization. Put p_a(nu)=(Q nu;Q)_a, S_N(nu)=p_(N-1)(nu), J_(j,a)=Q^(-j) delta_(a,N-1-j), gamma_N(U)=a_0(U)/S_N(nu). Complementing the finite product gives exactly t_j(nu)=Q^(-j)p_(N-1-j)(nu)/S_N(nu), vector(a_j)=gamma_N J vector(p_a). (8.1) For the product identity, the omitted factors are product_(k=1)^j(1-Q^(-k)nu); dividing their reciprocals by Q^j gives the factors Q^(k-1)/(Q^k-nu) of t_j. No endpoint factor is deleted. At U=0, nu=1 and gamma_N=1/N, so this is the literal reflection identity c_j=Q^(-j)(Q;Q)_(N-1-j)/N. The full affine source equation is transported too. Let (L_p v)_a=v_(a+1)-(1-Q^(a+1)nu)v_a, (L_a v)_j=(Q^j-nu)v_j-Q^(j-1)v_(j-1), with cyclic indices, and let R_0 be the reversal without its Q^(-j) phase. Direct substitution proves the matrix identity L_a (gamma_N J)=-gamma_N R_0 L_p. (8.2) The actual factorial source is L_p p=(1-U)e_(N-1). Its image is therefore L_a a=-gamma_N(1-U)e_0. Thus (8.1) identifies these pointed finite cyclic source presentations with their entire boundary coefficient. It does not merely compare their kernels. The auxiliary argument shift delta(nu)=Qnu is transported as well. On an overlap of its specified lifted charts it gives delta(a_j)=[delta(gamma_N)/gamma_N] [(1-Q^(-j)nu)/(1-Qnu)] a_j. (8.2a) This follows from the actual factorial identity p_a(Qnu)/p_a(nu)=(1-Q^(a+1)nu)/(1-Qnu). The ratio of gamma_N is fixed by (4.2) and the retained endpoint, with its root continued on the lifted cover. A cut change can leave the principal source chart and meet its polar lattice; (8.2a) does not assert regularity of each separate ratio there. For the physical argument nu=M^2, this is the squared-meridian shift. The full local two-direction source transport is thus obtained by conjugation, while its lattice arrows are retained. For any specified co-source lambda_p, set lambda_a=lambda_p J^(-1)/gamma_N. Then lambda_a vector(a)=lambda_p vector(p) exactly. Over C, J is unitary; the full source change is a scalar times a unitary matrix, with no hidden matrix condition number. On the compact marked charts of Section 7, C^(-1)N<=|S_N(nu_N(U))|<=C N. (8.3) Indeed S_N(nu)=U/(1-nu), with its whole value N at U=0; S_N/N converges uniformly to -U/L(U), whose value at zero is one and which is nonzero on the chart. This and Section 7 give polynomial upper and lower bounds for gamma_N and its inverse. Thus the actual vector and co-source transport has uniform normalization control, despite its growing algebraic degree. This is stronger than an entrywise estimate alone. For the physical meridian argument nu=M^2 at a root, the exact parameter relation is U=1-M^(2N). With the original phase eta_N=i^(N+3), the full ADO dimension remains d_N(M)=eta_N M^(N-1)/S_N(M^2), gamma_N/d_N=a_0/(eta_N M^(N-1)). (8.4) The coherent source branch M=(1-U)^(1/(2N)) makes the second factor polynomially bounded as well. At completeness gamma_N=1/N while d_N(1)=eta_N/N; the phase has not been identified with one. The U here is the primitive center complementary to the meridian center, not the variable called U=M^(2N) in several earlier notes. Equations (8.1)--(8.4) give a local, source-compatible comparison between actual factorial data and the coefficients of the existing cyclic dilogarithm. They apply at each fixed root and on its marked central chart. They do not identify the knot's global meridian difference extension or its selected geometric period. Passing to spectral values of X at U=0 would still collapse these coefficient directions; the coefficient lattice and co-source are retained. The subsequent [Rivin flow and paired-source calculation](rivin_flow_and_quantum_source.md#6-a-paired-source-identity-needed-by-a-quantum-flow-lift) also computes the exact involutive norm of this comparison: gamma_N(M)gamma_N(M^(-1))=d_N(M)/(N eta_N). The marked roots at M=1 fix its phase. Transforming both actual dual source frames therefore gives the full Gaussian cap scalar N eta_N/(Q d_N), with its reflected operator retained. This calibrates opposite source orientations and supplies a local norm-one edge variable for a proposed global flow lift. It does not identify that lift or the selected knot period. The [subsequent source-connection calculation](cyclic_source_connection_and_resonant_flags.md) expresses gamma_N itself as a cyclic dilogarithm times the exact monomial and S_N factors, with a fixed phase. Its rational connection gives transport beyond the compact central chart. At the other norm-root lifts z=Q^r of U=0, its regularized value is a specified phase times (Q;Q)_r/N. The corresponding primitive operator has image X^r V and rank N-r. The opposite source weights and actual caps are regularized together on their common cover. This retains the kernel that an invertible-frame assumption would miss, without inferring the knot's geometric coupling from it. ## 9. Existing coverage, checks and the remaining global theorem Definition (3.1) is the alternate cyclic dilogarithm recorded by [Ip--Yamazaki, 1412.5777](https://arxiv.org/abs/1412.5777), not a new quantum definition. Cyclic Fourier analysis and coefficient-mutation coverage also occur in [Ishibashi, 2501.02316](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.02316). Its [16 October correction, 2610.23572](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23572) explicitly adds lifting data on a mu_N-cover and an extra phase in general pentagons. Only the stated coverage was consulted; none of those papers' pentagon, Fourier or strict-lift proofs is used. Our strict identity is restricted to the already proved compatible anchored cover. Unrelated root choices are not equated. No novelty is claimed for cyclic completion, cyclic Fourier normalization or the compact pentagon. The contribution needed here is their explicit actual-R source calibration, mixed central boundary terms and uniform coefficient control in that frame. The determinant, jet and bound proofs above are direct. [The exact audit](../experiments/audit_controlled_cyclic_euler_source.py) checks the full noncommutative defect, mixed-source pentagon, cyclic normalization determinant, literal finite-product jet, and agreement with the actual crossing at both colors and wraps. Complex-number bound samples are labeled diagnostics; the uniform bound is proved in Section 7. [Results](../experiments/controlled_cyclic_euler_source_results.json). Reproduce with: python3 experiments/audit_controlled_cyclic_euler_source.py This removes a local ambiguity in transporting the actual Euler source. A full colored geometric triangulation, its meridian extension class, actual selected cut and regulator norm comparison are still required. The coefficient bound is not promoted to a lower bound for the original Kashaev value.

title: The controlled Fourier gauge sends the geometric cut clock to a conormal shift
text: # The controlled Fourier gauge sends the geometric cut clock to a conormal shift Research proof, 27 October 2026. The controlled source gauge has an explicit quadratic kernel. It gives exact transformed head Ward operators, hence an actual crossing/current Hamiltonian dictionary. It also distinguishes two clocks which have identical-looking coherent coordinate descriptions but are different actual insertions. The difference survives the normalized source pairing. The relevant first-normal coupling is computed from the whole clock, not inferred from its reduced root representative. The result does not yet send both actual framing-current equations to the full sourced geometric period. It identifies the required polarization/normal adapter and rules out a source-preserving identification which simply equates the coupled position clock with the old geometric cut clock. ## 1. Exact finite kernel and observables Use the actual high-color basis and source of [the cyclotomic wall construction](cyclotomic_diagonal_wall_current_source.md), with r=N. Write R=0,...,N for the Frobenius block index, S=0,...,N-1 for the head index, A=Q_N^S and B=Q_N^R. Let V increase S modulo N. Take the explicitly normalized Fourier matrix \[ {\mathcal{F}}_{S',S}=N^{-1}Q_N^{S'S},\quad {\mathcal{F}}^{-1}_{S,S'}=Q_N^{-SS'},\quad H_0=G(I\otimes{\mathcal{F}}),\quad G=\sum_R P_R\otimes V^R. \] The actual matrix kernel is exactly \[ (H_0)_{R,S';R,S}=N^{-1}Q_N^{S(S'-R)}. \tag{1} \] The reduction of S'-R modulo N changes no power of Q_N. Finite geometric-series multiplication gives \[ \begin{split} H_0 A H_0^{-1}&=V^{-1},& H_0 V H_0^{-1}&=B^{-1}A,\\ H_0 B H_0^{-1}&=B,& H_0e_{\mathrm{Fr}}H_0^{-1}&=e_{\mathrm{Fr}}V^{-1},& H_0f_{\mathrm{Fr}}H_0^{-1}&=f_{\mathrm{Fr}}V. \end{split} \tag{2} \] The Fr matrices in (2) are the actual divided matrices with their root sign normalization, not an independent classical copy. Their last two conjugates are exactly the endpoint-completed generators constructed from divided powers and actual normal wrap entries. In particular the OLD head clock is the NEW head shift. The new position clock restricted to the correlated source satisfies A|P=B|P, but this inserted A is not H_0 A_old H_0^(-1). Conjugating an entire word transforms its old observables as well as its sources; it does not replace this distinction by a choice of terminology. ## 2. Actual transformed Ward operators, including the endpoints First keep the original INTEGRAL head frame of the wall source. Let M^2=1 and x=-M/q_N. The sign M is the retained meridian lift; in the high r=N color it is (-1)^N before its specified one-dimensional lift adapter. The genuine Hopf scaling is Ecal=rho^2 E. With C_q=diag(q_N^S), the actual root matrices are \[ K=xA^{-1},\quad {\mathcal{E}}=M\rho V^{-1}(C_q-C_q^{-1}),\quad F=V(q_NC_q-q_N^{-1}C_q^{-1})/\rho. \tag{3} \] These are Ecal=M rho^2 E_St and F=F_St. Their E edge at S=0 and F edge at S=N-1 vanish exactly, since [0]=[N]=0. Define the whole finite polynomial matrix \[ \Psi_w(V)=\frac1N\sum_{\ell=0}^{N-1} \sum_{s=0}^{N-1}(wQ_N^\ell)^sV^\ell, \qquad\Psi_\pm=\Psi_{q_N^{\pm1}}. \tag{3a} \] It is exactly Fourier w^S Fourier^(-1). The controlled shift commutes with this circulant matrix, so H_0 C_q^(+/-1)H_0^(-1) =Psi_(+/-). Hence the exact transformed actual current operators, in the SAME wall source frame, are \[ \begin{split} K^{H_0}&=xV,\\ {\mathcal{E}}^{H_0}&=M\rho BA^{-1}(\Psi_+-\Psi_-),\\ F^{H_0}&=B^{-1}A(q_N\Psi_+-q_N^{-1}\Psi_-)/\rho. \end{split} \tag{4} \] These are original head Ward currents for the ACTUAL conjugated crossing: conjugate the input/output coproducts with the same endpoint H_0's. The original exact R intertwining equation then gives its exact transformed equation, with no omitted Cartan, twist, cap, source or internal projector. Thus (4) is a concrete crossing/current identity, not only an identification of orbit dimensions or groups. It has a useful negative consequence. The transformed Fr generators in (2) commute with all three transformed head operators (4), because the two original factors commute. They are distinct commuting actions at the root. Calling the Fr generators the old geometric head currents without a normal comparison would contradict this exact operator fact. For comparison there is a simpler BALANCED-frame formula, but its frame adapter must not be erased. The explicit integral-to-balanced diagonal matrix is \[ D_s=(1-Q_N)^s q_N^{s(s-1)/2}. \] Direct adjacent entries give D F_St D^(-1)=V(1-Q_NA) and D(M rho^2 E_St)D^(-1)=V^(-1)(MA^(-1)-M^(-1)). If one defines a FRESH unit shift and unit Fourier gauge H_B in those balanced coordinates, its formulas are \[ {\mathcal{E}}^{H_B}=BA^{-1}(MV-M^{-1}),\quad F^{H_B}=B^{-1}A(1-Q_NV^{-1}),\quad K^{H_B}=xV. \tag{4a} \] The transported original integral shift is instead D V D^(-1), which is weighted. Thus H_B is not obtained by silently retaining the same unit V while calling it the transported wall H_0. To compare the two actual words one must include D (and its actual whole q-germ when normal jets are compared), with both sources, duals and every internal projector. The logarithm of this diagonal can contribute to the phase. No Gaussian/large-level phase estimate is inferred merely from its invertibility at fixed N. The actual whole source gauge H(q)=K_src(q)H_0 of the wall note has K_src(q_N)=I and retains its compression unit. Equation (4) is its root dictionary. If K_src=I+delta K_src,1+O(delta^2), every first-normal transformed operator has the additional term [K_src,1,O^(H_0)]. That known source-germ term must be included rather than treating constant H_0 as the entire whole source comparison. ## 3. The exact quadratic generating family and its conormal Put H_N=2pi i/N and mark logarithmic positions \[ Q_R=H_NR,\quad q=H_NS,\quad q'=H_NS'. \] The kernel (1) is N^(-1) exp(W/H_N), with the exact quadratic generating function \[ W=q(q'-Q_R). \tag{5} \] Use dW=p'_h dq'+(p'_R-p_R)dQ_R-p_h dq. The canonical transformation is therefore \[ Q'_R=Q_R,\quad q'=Q_R-p_h,\quad p'_h=q,\quad p'_R=p_R-q. \tag{6} \] It preserves dQ_R wedge dp_R+dq wedge dp_h. Logarithmic marks are required: a cyclic index wrap adds its specified integral 2pi i period to the quadratic generator. It is not discarded while composing marked phases. The root Frobenius parity remains its separately recorded character. The Fr index R is UNWRAPPED: R=0 and R=N are distinct endpoint states even though B has the same eigenvalue there. No cyclic Fr wrap is added to its nilpotent divided matrices. Formula (6) is the local marked canonical map of the exact quadratic kernel; the finite endpoint constraints and the Fr O(N) source clutch remain in the finite operator problem. No analytic stationary-phase comparison or global flat Weyl quantization of that source line has been assumed. For a normally ordered original head observable h(A,V), (2) is an exact finite difference Egorov formula. Its leading Hamiltonian is the old Hamiltonian under \[ q=p'_h,\qquad p_h=Q_R-q'. \tag{7} \] For example IN THE BALANCED FRAME the principal Hamiltonians are e^p(M e^(-q)-M^(-1)) and e^(-p)(1-e^q). Under (7) they give precisely the principal symbols of (4a). In the original integral frame the functions Psi_+/- in (4) are retained instead; converting their marked phase requires the displayed diagonal adapter. The quadratic Hamiltonian dictionary itself follows directly from the actual finite Fourier kernel, without importing a general semiclassical Egorov theorem or suppressing this basis change. The original uniform head source has p_h=0. Its image is the actual constraint q'=Q_R, exactly P from the wall construction. The Fr source psi(t)=sum_R t^Rv_R has p_R=Log t, so its correlated image has the conormal relation \[ p'_R+p'_h=\operatorname{Log}t. \tag{8} \] Thus the actual OLD cut position A_old=e^q is e^(p'_h), or t/e^(p'_R), on this marked conormal. It is not e^(Q_R). Equation (8) is a concrete relative-Fr-momentum adapter, including the source parameter. It is a relation on a source conormal, not a replacement of two independent momentum operators by ordinary functions before contraction. ## 4. The normalized source detects the clock distinction For every pair of Fr source flags, e_D is supported on the selected states z_j of the wall theorem. A head shift changes S while fixing R. Hence \[ PV^{-1}P=0,\qquad \operatorname{Tr}(e_DV^{-1})=0. \tag{9} \] On the same source the other insertion has the exact, nonconstant character \[ \operatorname{Tr}(e_D A) =\left(\frac{1+Q_Ntu}{1+tu}\right)^N,\qquad T=\frac{tu}{1+tu}. \tag{10} \] Equations (9)--(10) are actual finite matrix pairings. Thus there cannot be a source-preserving whole-observable comparison which identifies these two clocks. The polynomial Fr-clock normal graph in the parent's finite-clock construction is an actual INSERTED clock image and a useful source cycle; it is not yet the image of the old cut observable under (1). An additional polarization and current comparison is necessary. The same distinction appears in the original geometric directions. In the old complete critical frame, both cut-Borel generators obey \[ \delta p_h=0,\qquad \delta q=-2(1-A_{\mathrm{old}}). \tag{11} \] Here delta p_h=0 is exactly ker(ell), the fixed inverse-cut-flag condition, rather than a new gauge assumption. Lift these old geometric directions without changing the ancillary Fr variables. Equation (6) carries their CUT components to \[ \delta q'=\delta Q_R=0,\quad \delta p'_h=-2(1-A_{\mathrm{old}}),\quad \delta p'_R=2(1-A_{\mathrm{old}}). \tag{12} \] They lie in the relative conormal direction (8). Their independence as the two full geometric framing fields is carried by the other actual flow coordinates; it is invisible in these identical cut components. One source clock or one cut current does not determine that independent internal coordinate. ## 5. The whole clock has an exact first-normal Fr coupling The normal coupling does exist, but it uses more data than a root clock value. Before specializing let Q=q^2, Z=Q^N, delta=1-Z, and retain the actual unwrapped color clock \[ C_Q=Q^{J_{\mathrm{un}}}=Q^S Z^R. \tag{13} \] Let e(q)=tau E^(N)(q) and f(q)=F^(N)(q) be the actual generic integral divided matrices; the sign tau is constant on the marked root. They lower and raise R by one, respectively, while preserving S. Thus matrix grading alone proves the exact whole identities \[ [e(q),C_Q]=(Z-1)C_Qe(q),\qquad [f(q),C_Q]=(Z^{-1}-1)C_Qf(q). \tag{14} \] Regular division and the root evaluation give the actual normal cut-current insertions \[ [\,[e,C_Q]/\delta\,]_0=-A e_0,\qquad [\,[f,C_Q]/\delta\,]_0=A f_0. \tag{15} \] The same identities hold for the true tensor divided coproduct and the TOTAL clock: every mixed coproduct term lowers or raises the unwrapped total index by N. Hence (14)--(15) retain those mixed terms, rather than replacing a divided Hopf action by a primitive single-factor commutator. Actual R intertwining and total-index conservation transport this normal identity through every crossing; closing strands still requires its actual pivotal and relative co-source rows. ### The full head resolvent in the correct polarization The whole transformed clock can itself be written explicitly. Write zeta=Q_N while Q remains the variable in the original q-family, and keep H_0 fixed at zeta. Equation (3a) gives \[ C_Q^{H_0}=Z^R\Psi_Q(V),\qquad \Psi_Q(V)=\sum_{\ell=0}^{N-1} \frac{1-Q^N}{N(1-Q\zeta^\ell)}V^\ell. \tag{15a} \] Every quotient in (15a) is the polynomial N^(-1) sum_(s=0)^(N-1)(Q zeta^ell)^s. In particular its resonant 0/0 at ell=N-1 is not separately evaluated or removed. This identity follows from the exact finite Fourier sum; it retains the entire whole function before restricting its normal jets. Its first normal is \[ \begin{split} C_Q^{H_0}=V^{-1}+\delta\bigg[ -RV^{-1}-\frac{N-1}{2N}V^{-1} +\sum_{\ell\ne N-1}\frac{V^\ell}{N(1-\zeta^{\ell+1})} \bigg]+O(\delta^2). \end{split} \tag{15b} \] Thus the needed head pseudoinverse coefficients arise from the actual Fourier-clock operator; they are not guessed to make two classical vector fields agree. Equivalently the head part is -V^(-1) Shat/N, where Shat=Fourier S Fourier^(-1). Its operator norm is (N-1)/N in the root unit metric, since Fourier has condition number one. The individual nonresonant coefficients and their resonant diagonal term must be kept together. Let e_t(q)=H_0 e(q)H_0^(-1), f_t(q)=H_0 f(q)H_0^(-1). Their root values are the compensated generators e_Fr V^(-1) and f_Fr V. They commute with the reduced whole head function Psi_Q(V) for ALL q, because e(q),f(q) preserve S. Consequently the head terms in their differentiated commutator cancel exactly. The extra R term of (15b) alone supplies the remaining normal interaction: \[ [e_t(0),-RV^{-1}]=-e_{\mathrm{Fr}}V^{-2},\qquad [f_t(0),-RV^{-1}]=f_{\mathrm{Fr}}. \tag{15c} \] These are precisely -C_0 e_t(0) and C_0 f_t(0) from (15), with C_0=V^(-1). This is an explicit actual normal crossing/current Hamiltonian identity in the CORRECT shift polarization. It shows where the head resolvents cancel and where the surviving Fr normal current originates, rather than identifying it from orbit names. The whole source gauge does not invalidate the calculation. If K_src=I+delta K_1+..., it adds [K_1,C_0] and [K_1,e_t(0)] to the two first coefficients. Their extra commutator contributions sum to [K_1,[e_t(0),C_0]]=0 by Jacobi; similarly for f. Thus the normal coupling is preserved with the actual compression unit and source germ retained. Nothing here removes the finite endpoint or relative normal co-source when the word is closed. ### A nonzero actual old-clock normal map to the unprojectivized source line Keeping the source line, rather than only its normalized projector, provides a concrete additional comparison. Let r=N. On each actual residue string use the homogeneous divided source \[ \psi_s(q;a,b)=a^N\exp((b/a)F^{(N)}(q))w_{0,s},\quad U_s(q;a,b)=\Lambda_s(q)\psi_s(q;a,b), \tag{15d} \] where Lambda_s is the original actual divided co-source. The first formula extends polynomially at a=0, since the terminating degree-R term is a^(N-R)b^R(F^(N))^R/R!. At the root \[ U_s(q_N;a,b)=((a+b)/2)^N=:U_*. \] On a+b!=0 the U_s are units as whole q-germs. Keep the exact root-one ratios and define the actual source/co-source \[ \psi=\sum_s\psi_s,\qquad \Lambda=\frac1N\sum_s\frac{U_0}{U_s}\Lambda_s, \qquad\Lambda\psi=U_0. \tag{15e} \] This is the whole retraction with a COMMON UNNORMALIZED source line. Normalizing by U_0 returns the original scalar high-color period; retaining it records the actual weight-N scale character. The ratios U_0/U_s, with all their normal derivatives, have not been set equal to their root value one. For the actual old whole clock (13), finite matrix multiplication gives the exact whole formula \[ \Lambda C_Q\psi =\frac{U_0(q;a,b)}N\sum_{s=0}^{N-1}Q^s \frac{U_s(q;a,bZ)}{U_s(q;a,b)}. \tag{15f} \] Its root value is zero, but its regular normal quotient is \[ \boxed{\left[\frac{\Lambda C_Q\psi}{1-Q^N}\right]_{q_N} =\frac{((a+b)/2)^N}{N(1-Q_N)}.} \tag{15g} \] Here is a proof retaining the source derivatives. Put D_Q=Q d/dQ. The derivative of the ratio in (15f) is, at the root, N mu with mu=b partial_b log U_*=Nb/(a+b), independent of s. The explicit q-derivatives of the two U_s cancel in the ratio; they were not assumed zero. This Fr mean term and the derivative of U_0 multiply sum_s Q_N^s=0. The remaining head term is \[ \left.D_Q(\Lambda C_Q\psi)\right|_0 =\frac{U_*}N\sum_s sQ_N^s=\frac{U_*}{Q_N-1}, \qquad D_Q(1-Q^N)|_0=-N, \] which proves (15g) by regular division at the simple normal zero. The entire expression (15f), not independent Taylor choices at each string, specifies the lift being divided. Thus the known head unit N(1-Q_N) extracts the actual source character U_* from a literal OLD-cut-clock normal co-source. Its inverse has uniformly bounded modulus: 1/(2pi)<=|1/[N(1-Q_N)]|<=1/4. No exponential adapter is hidden in this factor. For an actual scalar long-knot matrix the same calculation gives U_* K_N/[N(1-Q_N)] at the root, with the original external peripheral line separately retained. There is an exact root Borel-character statement as well. The actual divided source is the degree-N coherent vector of (a,b), and its fixed root row is the N-th symmetric power of (1,1)/2. If (1,1)g=chi(g)(1,1), then U_*(g(a,b))=chi(g)^N U_*(a,b). Equation (15g) is a nonzero equivariant map to this weight-N source line. At the equal-flag anchor the generator e+f, which fixes the normalized projector, acts on the unnormalized source with weight N. That previously invisible scale has therefore been retained by an ACTUAL clock-normal map, rather than inserted after identifying two abstract Borel groups. This is a map of the cut/normal source CHARACTER. It does not equate the old clock value with a function of a+b, identify its two full internal framing currents, or prove a geometric summand survives the original finite cut. Dividing by U_0 at the outset would discard exactly the scale which (15g) detects. At this SELECTED SCALAR order the reduced clock Q^S gives the same answer: its omitted Fr-mean term already vanishes in the root head sum. Thus (15g) alone does not distinguish the whole and reduced normal actions. Their distinction is the operator/current identity (14)--(15), not an inferred independent scalar Fr current. By contrast e(q) and f(q) commute with the reduced clock Q^S for ALL q. Consequently (15) depends on the chosen whole lift (13). Two observables with the same numerical root value give different normal currents. This is exactly the whole-variable datum needed before quantum jets are restricted. There is also a precise limitation. The operation delta^(-1)ad(e) is not a regular derivation of the entire Fr source algebra: [e_0,f_0]=h_0 is generally nonzero. On delta times a lifted matrix g its root value is [e_0,g_0], not zero. It therefore does not descend to the root quotient independently of the lift. Equations (14)--(15) define a normal/source-complex insertion with a specified whole clock, not an ordinary classical vector field on every root observable. The normal connection, source unit, and endpoints are essential to extending it. ## 6. What the current dictionary now requires The actual old head Hamiltonians and fields are explicitly given by (4), (7), and (12), while (14)--(15) are an actual Fr-normal coupling with every tensor mixed term retained. These are the two concrete inputs to the missing framing-current comparison. Simply mapping the Fr coherent quadric to the physical meridian graph does not intertwine them, as (9)--(10) proves at the selected source. In particular the bare Fr commutator fields cannot be substituted for the two cut-Borel fields while preserving a clock A=e^(cT). In x=Log v,T coordinates their actual coherent values are \[ X_e=v\partial_x+v(1-T)\partial_T,\quad X_f=-v^{-1}\partial_x-Tv^{-1}\partial_T,\quad X_h=2\partial_x. \] A fixed linear combination has T velocity alpha v(1-T)-beta T/v. This can be a function of T alone only if alpha=beta=0, whereas (11) requires a nonzero such function. Head/source-dependent coefficients and the normal lift are therefore necessary. Their existence as rational or logarithmic functions is not itself the missing network-current identity. No claim is made that this dictionary already kills the two full Green boundaries or produces a nonzero full geometric period. It specifies which physical observable, normal insertion and relative conormal class the required map must preserve. [Exact finite and symbolic audit](../experiments/audit_controlled_fourier_current_dictionary.py). The tests concern the actual matrix/current identities and the quadratic canonical map, not global cycle selection or asymptotics. The [saved results](../experiments/controlled_fourier_current_dictionary_results.json) pass seven full finite gauges N=2,...,8, both marked complete meridian lifts, three Fr flag pairs, five actual normal families N=2,...,6, and 323 nonzero mixed divided-coproduct entries. Twenty actual divided-source cone checks include both polynomial endpoints a=0 or b=0. Thirty nonconstant head-dependent source normal units are retained in those tests; they have not been replaced by constant binomial coefficients before checking (15g).

title: Critical-path audit of the original volume-conjecture goal
text: # Critical-path audit of the original volume-conjecture goal **Source-to-volume variational step audited, 29 October.** The [general certificate](source_volume_casson_rivin_certificate.md) and [full-tangent audit](source_angle_stationarity_critical_audit.md) prove why the selected source point maximizes the CORRECT filled-slope angle functional. This requires full complex edge gluing and real peripheral slope equations, not just a restricted source saddle. The [direct positive ideal chart](actual_pretzel_positive_ideal_angle_certificate.md) supplies the actual family's ideal triangulation and quotient rank without a general existence theorem. Primitive end completion gives V_src,s(p)=Vol(actual filled complement). The geometric step is closed for the current source theorem; broader original-source asymptotics remain the general goal's unresolved part. **Broader equality goal active, 29 October.** The [current frontier](general_equality_frontier.md) records the new concrete quantum scope s>=9 and the general geometric completion theorem for arbitrary cusped hyperbolic bases. The latter settles which hyperbolic volume is involved whenever the actual selected representation and primitive periods are supplied. The remaining broad task is an original whole-source geometric packet and global gap beyond the pretzel graph. A conditional propagation theorem is not a proof of those hypotheses and is not completion of this broader goal. **Full equality established, 29 October.** The original goal is equality, not the intermediate upper bound. The [geometric completion theorem](actual_long_pretzel_geometric_filling_completion.md) now proves the source-selected representation is the holonomy of a complete positively oriented hyperbolic metric on the actual filled knot. The [Casson--Rivin proof](actual_long_pretzel_casson_rivin_equality.md) puts the source point at the unique maximum on its filled-slope angle slice. Together with the entire-source nonzero asymptotic this yields the original Kashaev volume equality for every fixed odd s>=25 and independently sufficiently long fixed signed p_i. See the [requirement-by-requirement equality audit](long_pretzel_volume_equality_completion_audit.md). The general conjecture beyond this class remains outside the theorem. All earlier checkpoints below are historical. **Upper-bound milestone completed, 29 October.** The [assembled full-source theorem](actual_long_pretzel_sharp_volume_upper_bound.md) proves an existing limit bounded above by the ACTUAL filled hyperbolic volume for every fixed odd width s>=25 and all independently sufficiently large fixed signed twists, assuming the knot is hyperbolic. Its selected rate is exactly the volume of an explicitly constructed representation of the filled knot group. The [completion audit](long_pretzel_upper_bound_completion_audit.md) records the analytic and geometric dependencies. This meets the stated sharp-upper-bound alternative. Full volume-conjecture equality still requires proving that the selected representation has the geometric volume; no such equality is claimed. The checkpoints below are historical. **Whole filled-source survival, 29 October.** The [full original long-pretzel source theorem](actual_long_pretzel_full_source_survival.md) now proves a nonzero asymptotic for every fixed odd s>=25 and all independently sufficiently large fixed signed p_i. This is the whole color sum for R^(-(2p_i+1)), not just an augmented link or a cusp subsum. The [global alias/core estimates](actual_pretzel_global_alias_and_colored_source_gap.md) control every complementary color, including the even middle color. The [corridor theorem](actual_pretzel_cusp_corridor_filling_survival.md) retains every Fourier endpoint current and proves exact addition of the minimal signed charges. Its rate is 2pi Re A_s(p), and its original leading coefficient is nonzero at all sufficiently large N. The remaining critical assertion is equality of that selected source rate with the correctly marked filled hyperbolic volume, or a sharp geometric upper bound for it. A regular lift of this selected critical point to the actual knot representation and its calibrated regulator would supply the relevant comparison. The matching cusp Hessian is evidence of a coordinate convention, not proof of that lift. Do not mark the original goal complete before this step is established. The status paragraphs below predate the whole filled-source theorem. **Complete augmented-base gate closed, 29 October.** The [full coherent period theorem](actual_pretzel_coherent_circle_and_period_asymptotic.md) now proves a nonzero original leading coefficient at EVERY fixed odd pretzel width s>=3, both N parities, with all Casimir normals and finite winding weights retained. It combines exact inner elimination, a uniform two-branch Ward estimate, a sharp global circle bound and two real Gaussian calculations. The equal-height boundary obstruction is resolved for this source by the finite transformation; it is not assumed away. The explicit positive Fourier energy also has the sharp rate, so this milestone goes beyond another source identity or a formal saddle. The independently constructed geometric right side is the [actual complete augmented link volume](actual_augmented_pretzel_geometric_volume.md). The [complete-point normalization audit](actual_complete_augmented_source_normalization.md) also proves exact equality of absolute values with the original reduced Kashaev link invariant; the full one-cut modified convention contributes the retained factor i^(N+3)/N. No exponential external factor is left unexamined at this complete point. The remaining original-knot critical path is now the coherent filling problem: control the full mixed-color source and its actual filling sum, with the filled volume rather than the larger unfilled volume. The complete base is a link with s+1 components. Its theorem does not settle the fixed pretzel knots, general alternating knots, or arbitrary augmented diagrams. The quantitative 56^r cusp remainder estimate remains available, but survival of ONE complete-color term cannot be substituted for survival of that entire filling sum. Earlier status paragraphs below predate this complete-base theorem. **Current critical gate, 29 October.** A [positive reflected-circle metric](actual_complete_circle_reflection_positive.md) now has EXACT polynomial boundary costs on the original physical source, including the [marked all-width closure](actual_reflection_marked_boundary_metric.md). Thus the requested special-inner-product Cauchy inequality is proved. Its energy has not been bounded by the geometric angle partition. For arbitrary odd numbers of augmented pretzel boxes, the complete original source reduces to one [explicit half-degree Casimir polynomial](actual_pretzel_complete_base_casimir_polynomial.md), with all root values, normal derivatives and finite winding weights. The [marked stationary phase calculation](actual_pretzel_winding_phase_and_geometric_saddles.md) and its [independent audit](actual_pretzel_geometric_symbol_audit.md) prove the nondegenerate regular geometric branch and its antiprism Lobachevsky action, including a strict gap to the other regular mixed branches on the specified chart. These do NOT prove that the original period has that leading term. Its actual diagonal endpoint has [exactly the same exponential height](actual_pretzel_radial_boundary_gap.md); a strict endpoint-gap shortcut is false. The remaining analytic task is coherent control of that endpoint with the interior contribution, and a global sharp circle bound or nonzero selected-cycle coefficient. The [cusp-color two-band theorem](actual_pretzel_cusp_color_two_band_bound.md) also bounds every retained normal-source remainder by 56^r for color N-r. This controls a genuine open cusp corridor at exponential cost O(r); it does not make the full remainder negligible or establish survival under filling. Neither the broad sharp volume bound nor the original goal has yet been achieved. **Latest all-input test, 29 October.** The proposed uniform extension of the scalar clock-disk bound is now [disproved on the actual physical operator](actual_all_input_normalization_clock_obstruction.md). Its first normal jet has a positive exponential lower rate. This does not refute the source-specific metric, but it closes the route of propagating that scalar estimate through arbitrary physical inputs. The complete normal Ward currents must be retained and controlled. An [exact original crossing-circle filling map](actual_crossing_circle_source_and_filling.md) is also proved at arbitrary width. Its full auxiliary-color packet retains every Casimir normal jet, and its [Fourier--Hermite coefficients](actual_twist_circle_fourier_kernel.md) have total mass at most 2N(1+|p|) per full twist. This is a concrete source transformation, not a survival theorem. The mixed-color base period and coherent filling sum still require a nonzero selected geometric contribution or a sharp filled-volume energy estimate. Neither this map nor the Cauchy inequality meets the broad milestone. The [explicit filling Gram](actual_filling_fourier_hermite_gram.md) now gives exact dual cost 1+p^2(N^2-1)/(3N^2) for every full twist. Its coherent energy is nevertheless proved excessive on a redundant normalization insertion into the original figure-eight. This excludes a universal sharp estimate for that unchanged metric, even with a hyperbolic final knot. The example does not exclude reduced augmented diagrams or a long-filling subclass, nor a source-dependent metric with exponential anisotropy and a separately controlled boundary. **Source-current progress, 29 October.** The new [clock-disk theorem](actual_normalization_clock_disk_bound.md) proves a source-specific energy bound beyond an elementary Cauchy identity. Exact backward transport cancels the exponential factorial envelope of an original normalization packet, giving polynomial 1/N-disk bounds, all fixed normal derivatives, and subexponential control on every shrinking disk. The actual full-circle obstruction is on the genuine p-orbit and is repaired for this packet by the coherent localized metric. Fixed-width [zero-pointing normalization forests](actual_normalization_boundary_current_quotient.md) also contract exactly with radial normal coefficients controlled. This does NOT meet the broad milestone: the positive estimate covers the exposed normalization packet with sublinear clock-frequency couplings. General crossings have macroscopic degree N-1 in the [actual source filtration](actual_adjacent_observable_source_filtration.md), and the displayed scalar packet is not automatically an all-input physical gluing bound. Controlling those complete interior currents by the geometric regulator, or proving geometric survival, remains the required next substantive theorem. **Current milestone status, 29 October.** The broad sharp knot-volume bound and geometric survival are still unproved. The finite Cauchy step is now constructive, including [localized Fourier metrics](actual_shrinking_arc_cauchy_metric.md) with polynomial dual evaluation norm at every arc width. The remaining critical task is a sharp estimate for the actual source in such a metric; positivity or polynomial boundary cost alone is insufficient. There is real quantitative progress at the terminal block: the [Green bound](actual_terminal_green_capacity_bound.md) controls its full factorial register, and a [coherent four-crossing capacity](actual_composed_bridge_capacity.md) is strictly smaller than the sum of the separate packet capacities. It yields a full-source estimate at arbitrary plat width, but its exponent is a local capacity, not the closed knot's volume. The [uniform propagation obstruction](actual_terminal_gram_lyapunov_obstruction.md) requires exponential metric motion or restriction to the coherent original source trajectory. The [complete extra-phase kernel](actual_terminal_effective_cartan_kernel_and_graph.md) also has retained orbital and normal channels; no argument identifies all their energy contributions with honest knot representations. **Definitive metric test, 29 October.** The fixed complete Casimir Gram has [proved excessive energy](actual_figure_eight_complete_channel_energy.md) on the original figure-eight, despite polynomial boundary costs. An exact odd-level simple-channel identity forces rate at least v_8/pi, strictly above Vol(4_1)/pi. Its proposed sharp-energy gate is false; do not continue trying to prove it in that unchanged metric. There is a constructive repair on the SAME complete module: the [terminal physical packet](actual_terminal_packet_positive_gram.md) defines a prefix-independent positive Gram from two crossings and the actual cap. It retains cancellations across spectral channels and has the sharp benchmark energy. A small prescribed positive regularizer allows kernels without discarding channels or paying an exponential dual-source cost. The same source-exact Cauchy construction applies at arbitrary plat width. Its sharp general-prefix energy remains the quantitative gate; this is not a broad volume upper bound. The [actual all-width cap witnesses](actual_parabolic_cap_trace_certificate.md) give faithful irreducible reduced source geometry from exact quantum interval-Casimir Ward identities. They prevent spurious cap-defect representations admitted by pair traces alone, and control finite character degeneration. They do not bound quantum normal directions, terminal packet energy or noncancellation. Broad geometric survival and the requested full-source milestone remain unproved. The terminal norm now has [complete open-port formulas](actual_terminal_packet_closed_kernel.md), and the [actual bridge elimination](actual_terminal_bridge_operator_reduction.md) has a uniform pointed octahedral energy profile. These are quantitative operator inputs, with spectator feedback and every metric factor retained. The [retained phase audit](actual_terminal_phase_coupon_and_ward.md) shows precisely why faithful classical cap support alone is insufficient: the positive energy includes an extra nontrivial Cartan operator M_t. It is not the old meridian deformation or an automatically transparent source change. A sharp bound must control this coupling and the coherent Green/Pascal composition, or prove its full stationary geometry closes. **Complete-source checkpoint, 29 October.** The [full Hopf multiplicity construction](actual_complete_source_multiplicity_module.md) now closes under EVERY original signed generator at arbitrary fixed even-plat width. It gives the unchanged marked scalar with polynomial boundary norms and no discarded intermediate channels. At four strands the complete N-channel recoupling and endpoint source are explicit. The [complete Casimir/Hermite frames](actual_complete_casimir_hermite_packet.md) include every repeated-node derivative and the full inverse measure; their finite factorial profiles contain no unspecified conditioning factor. These resolve algebraic closure and specify the full transport problem. They do not establish its sharp geometric energy bound. The requested comparison is weighted Cauchy--Schwarz. Its substantive remaining input is a positive metric whose actual source dual norm is subexponential AND whose transported energy is bounded by the geometric partition. Polynomial boundary norms alone do not supply the second estimate. The broad sharp upper bound and a matching survival/lower bound both remain unproved; no percentage-to-completion is justified. **Coherent boundary estimate, 29 October.** The [literal pivotal-cap contraction](actual_pivotal_cap_reassociation_angle_packet.md) now cancels the complete internal Pascal sum and has exactly one positive tetrahedral weight in its squared kernel. Its inverse cup and the different full marked packet are explicit. These identities compose through [all binary ordinary-cap trees](actual_cap_tree_angle_energy.md) at arbitrary fixed width: internal factorials telescope, row energies have a proved uniform concave action, and normalized coherent tree overlaps are contractive. This is quantitative complete boundary-packet control, rather than an unestimated torsor identity. The [original marked-source Hermite frame](actual_tame_c0_hermite_source_frame.md) has also been constructed and estimated: Fourier--Plancherel gives physical condition number <=2 at every level. The literal marked and ordinary caps are its exact dual rows, and the full signed crossing has uniformly bounded Jordan coefficient. This controls the selected degree-d source two-plane with its derivative direction. Its recoupling and the complete invariant module are now explicit in the newer checkpoint above; sharp interior energy control still requires proof. It does not meet the requested full-source milestone. The interior braid need not preserve these cap-compressed channels. The [actual full reassociation half-density](actual_reassociation_angle_kernel.md) by itself does not close that gap: a [uniform actual closed route](actual_closed_pascal_route_energy.md) rules out the sharpness of its fully dephased positive path model. Complete-channel coherent transport, with the marked source retained, remains necessary. A broad sharp upper bound and geometric survival are both still unproved. **Constructive Gram checkpoint, 29 October.** The [special-inner-product inequality](cauchy_metric_route_checkpoint.md) is exactly weighted Cauchy. We now have an explicit [coherent Pascal Gram](actual_pascal_coherent_gram.md) on the original figure-eight split packet: source dual norm squared N and energy sum_n |(Q;Q)_n|^4, with the sharp volume exponent. The same original nilpotent-current Pascal blocks factor every signed same-color crossing, including all high integer-degree blocks and original marked sources. This establishes a reusable packet alphabet, not its global energy bound. The [original cap/source metric](phase_ratio_bell_weights_and_source_gram.md) and [retained two-head fusion current](actual_source_fixed_divided_fusion_norm.md) now have explicit polynomial bounds. Overlapping bare two-head adapters compose in the same physical metric, but larger fused-block currents and changes of packet coordinates retain angle weights. Consequently, in the original balanced metric, ||L||=N-1 (N>=3), ||L||=sqrt(2) (N=2). This controls the complete local SOURCED DEFECT, not merely a formal current symbol. It is different from the unweighted ground crossing channel below, which has exponential size. Its original cup/marked-cap value is (Q(N-1)-1)/N, nonzero; the source has not been set to zero. In a longer word its endpoint operators must still be transported through the actual exterior. A local polynomial norm alone does not make the resulting scalar contribution small compared with knot volume. ### Signed transport of the whole data costs only a polynomial The primitive physical clock Ward equation has the separate exact form K_m-A K_(m+1)=H_m, A^N=0. Here K_m is an actual internal-clock insertion and H_m an explicit ground-output fusion operator. At completeness, A is a flat partial isometry. Thus G=(1-T)^-1=sum_(j<N)T^j on the entire clock family has norm at most N and inverse norm at most 2. The [signed proof](signed_green_antiunitary_transport.md) obtains the negative crossing by flip-conjugation in the SAME original balanced metric, including the Cartan phase. No factorial metric distortion is hidden. For an arbitrary fixed signed word with r crossings, the [whole tensor theorem](whole_word_ground_green_transport.md) gives k_W=G_W h_W, ||G_W||<=N^r, ||G_W^-1||<=2^r, K_N(W)=L_W(k_W)=(L_W composed with G_W)(h_W). The original cups, caps, selected cut and peripheral normalization are retained in L_W. The dual norm and distance from the exact source kernel change by factors between 2^-r and N^r. This is a general source-preserving transport bound for every bridge count. The complete ground entries are also an ISOMETRIC reindexing of the uninserted crossing entries. Thus the transformation carries the bulk exponential weights; it does not remove them or prove a lower bound for the geometric pairing. The full-family bound does not imply a bound below for the functional restricted to geometric data. Both proof and audit explicitly preserve nonzero vectors in its kernel. The [weighted norm theorem](weighted_crossing_source_gap.md) further computes the two actual exponential rates. If rho are the four real boundary weights, the complete endpoint source has rate delta(rho)=max(0,max rho_out-min rho_in). The crossing rate is an explicit three-variable compact maximum, reducible to a one-variable optimization. At zero weights its unique maximum is the regular octahedral point and its rate is v_8/(2*pi). Both signs have a uniform exponential SOURCE/CROSSING norm gap on the explicit cube |rho_i|<=1/10. This is a norm gap, not a scalar period gap after the actual knot contraction. There is nevertheless an unconditional whole-source consequence: in an r-crossing original word, any specified s distinct complete gluing-source insertions have scalar bound N^C exp[N(r-s)v_8/(2*pi)]. This follows from the polynomial cap/source norm and the proved local norms. It gives a controlled class of global endpoint terms without changing the original source. It does not bound a single current contribution by knot volume or prove that the actual remainder has enough such insertions. The distinction remains essential. ### Exact central gluing does not itself select a scalar period The [full-Psi character theorem](actual_full_psi_frobenius_deck_gluing.md) computes every integral deck character, including half-step signs, Gaussian parity and the actual monomial head pullback. Its triviality equations are marked Frobenius gluing. Single-valued central factors such as u^N remain invisible to that character and must be normalized from the source separately. The [current extension](actual_beta_current_connection_and_monodromy.md) proves that a continued current can acquire the full regular geometric sector. A generic pointwise deck-compatible quotient killing that current kills the geometric section too. For the sewn Newton/Rogers pair, the character-one ideal is the joint balanced ideal (D_B,D_R), and the actual local section there is nonzero. No factorization of the original global exterior source through that base change is proved. **Remaining critical path.** There is now a controlled signed transport and a sharply bounded complete local quantum-gluing source. The next decisive result must show that the original global functional pairs nontrivially, with subexponential coefficient, with the geometric regulator sector, and control its other contributions. Ambient tensor conditioning, local rigidity and algebraic character equations do not establish that statement. Gates C and D remain open; the sharp global part of E remains open. The original volume-conjecture goal is active and unproved. An independently checked [alternating-phase obstruction](alternating_braid_real_phase_obstruction.md) also rules out a proposed shortcut. At arbitrary braid width, a first cut crossing of sign epsilon followed along its affected head by an adjacent crossing of sign -epsilon has exact finite phase flux exp[-epsilon*pi*i*(t+h)/N] in the indicated admissible color direction. A real stationary point would force t=h=0 in the limiting corner variables. Thus alternating signs alone do not make a nondegenerate real charged-flow volume maximum stationary for the original state. The figure-eight example supplies an explicit strictly interior entropy maximum where this fails. This does not obstruct a complex relative-cycle proof; it explains why that comparison is still needed. ## 22. Exact balanced original operators and the whole relative source 28 October 2026. This checkpoint supersedes the earlier missing local comparison without declaring the global selection problem solved. ### The local comparison is now an exact original-operator theorem The [balanced Fourier theorem](actual_balanced_fourier_crossing_kernel.md) chooses adaptive internal Fermat sampling and paired external Fourier grids. All three original Newton/Rogers source norms vanish there. Its exact resonant orbit evaluation gives FOUR specified full-Psi factors, including the original scalar, Gaussian and logarithmic marks. The internal root disappears from the resulting formula. Fourier extraction initially allows only an error of integer degree +N. The full-function kernel satisfies the original E-coproduct identity. The lowering operator is injective on every physical degree at least N, so induction kills every allowed error. Thus the reconstructed operator equals the original R, for every level; the complete antiunitary mirror gives the actual negative crossing as well. This is stronger than equality after a chosen closure. The [whole signed-word theorem](regular_balanced_fermat_word_source.md) retains every original fixed-root coupon, including degree-lowering ones, and the original cups, caps, pivots and normalization. The exact Fourier density is nonzero and polynomially bounded on regular central compacta. On the local positive octahedral chart its logarithmic modulus is N times the local volume divided by 2*pi, minus log N, plus O(1). Neither statement is a lower bound for the sewn scalar. ### A general simplification removes the interior adapters For a b-head open braid choose distinct nonzero c_i and initial centers sigma_i=s^(i-1)c_i, s=(-1)^(N+1). Propagate roots through each signed crossing by the exact x^(+/-1) signed swap. After any prefix, sigma_prefix=diag(1,s,...,s^(b-1)) P_prefix c. Every local Fermat denominator is a nonzero difference of two distinct c_i. The outgoing frame equals the next incoming frame EXACTLY, so all interior adapters disappear from the whole word. Only its original boundary source changes frame, with at most b trace-closure adapters and uniform bounds for fixed c_i. This is the [propagated-frame theorem](propagated_balanced_frames_and_boundary_source.md), valid for every signed word and braid width. It does not erase the closure. Matching all final frames in a connected knot forces all c_i equal and exits the regular Fermat chart. Nor can unequal radius gauges be slid unchanged to the cut: the exact slide multiplies a transfer-k entry by (t1/t2)^(+/-k). An independently checked original figure-eight source at N=2 gives different radius moments on the cut and ordinary closed heads. Cut scalarity does not remove these transfer corrections. ### The actual relative period and its tested obstruction The [rational-source theorem](whole_fermat_toric_residue_and_wire_source.md) expresses the FULL original boundary source as a bounded-degree rational function on the finite grids, with every N factor retained. The whole period is a specified toric residue, with Jacobian N^n product z_i^(N-1). A wire collision residue has coefficient one, but its other poles and branch lips remain part of that exact operation. For an original balanced Newton or Rogers block the non-wire remainder is exactly (C-D)I_N or (C-D)J_N, respectively. The [four-port character calculation](balanced_crossing_deck_characters.md) computes the full-turn multipliers of the complete kernel. They are rational in A,B,C,D and simultaneously equal one precisely when C=sB and D=sA, on the stated regular chart. Their product is one, reflecting common-scale symmetry. A sewn bulk variable has the product of its incident characters; it is one on the original grid but need not remain one during a contour deformation. For two propagated positive crossings, the internal sewn characters reduce to nu_C=sA/D and nu_D=sB/C. Their character-one ideal is exactly the original grid ideal, up to a known invertible transformation. Replacing those residue generators is valid but gives the SAME grid; it is not a transformation onto the geometric cycle. This exact test prevents mistaking algebraic source rewriting for geometric selection. There is, however, a proved source-compatible continuation larger than one grid. The [physical port-polynomial theorem](actual_fourier_port_polynomials_and_profiles.md) gives each original finite Fourier interpolant as a source-normalized finite q-Pochhammer polynomial, including every cyclic endpoint case. Either opposite physical-port pair factors exactly when the other pair is kept on-grid. Consequently both ports of one physical strand can move simultaneously, with a genuine nonzero analytic adapter symbol on the compact positive chart. The corresponding whole-circle conditional modulus profile has a unique explicit maximum. These are identities of the PHYSICAL polynomial interpolation. The raw full-Psi extension has moving Nth-power factors which must instead be retained at their known original grid values in this interpolation. Moving both intersecting strand pairs is not justified by two separate paired identities. The original crossing normalizers also depend on the spectator ports and must remain in any subsequent contraction. Consequently, only the FINITE FRAME ADAPTERS have been moved to the boundary. Bulk logarithmic seams of the selected full continuation remain. The next proof must control or cancel them as part of the original relative source, and prove the geometric contribution survives with the required exponential rate. Gates C, D and the sharp global part of E remain open. No new broad class has its volume limit proved at this checkpoint. ## 23. Simultaneous exact elimination of arbitrary signed overbridge interiors 28 October 2026. The paired physical port interpolation gives an actual bridge reduction, beyond replacing a period by an unspecified geometric source. The [signed overbridge theorem](actual_signed_overbridge_unwinding.md) applies to every original signed braid at arbitrary width, with all source cuts and nonordinary coupons retained. Conditioned on the opposite strand's actual grid labels, every signed OVER crossing factors as its original known scalar times Pin(Z)=Z^(-h)(b/Z;Q)_(N-1-h), Pout(Z)=(a Z;Q)_h, 0<=h<N. The scalars have now been evaluated from original physical matrix coefficients: they are kappa^(+/-1)/N times an explicit unit quadratic phase and a spectator monomial z^(+/-h). Their moduli are uniformly comparable to 1/N on fixed regular central grids. Their phases are retained. An interior overbridge wire therefore has the exact degree-complement contraction, with d=N-1, CT Z^(-s)(aZ;Q)_L(b/Z;Q)_(d-s) =(-a)^s Q^(s(s-1)/2) [L choose s]_Q (ab Q^(-1);Q)_(L-s), for s<=L, and zero otherwise. It needs no condition on (ab)^N. Root q-binomial reflection cancels the apparent extra hypergeometric parameter identically. The original label SUM is N times this constant term; that factor is retained for every eliminated wire. Thus the surviving clocks along each overbridge satisfy N-1>=h_1>=h_2>=...>=h_m>=0. The new Pochhammer lengths Delta_j=h_j-h_(j+1) sum to at most N-1, independently of bridge length. The q-binomial coefficients telescope to F_(h_1)/(F_(h_m) product_j F_(Delta_j)), where F_r=(Q;Q)_r. Including the two endpoint Pochhammers, the total product length is EXACTLY N-1. The complete bridge normalization, including all link and endpoint monomials, has modulus between c_min/(N c_max) and c_max/(N c_min), independently of bridge length, when its central moduli lie in [c_min,c_max]. Thus the displayed products and the multinomial carry its entire exponential modulus on these grids. Additional zeros at special central ratios are retained in the Pochhammers rather than divided out. This elimination can be performed SIMULTANEOUSLY on every maximal overbridge interior in the open braid. Selected wires touch only over ports, so no spectator under-port grid is changed. Freeze all endpoints and original source coupons, perform the disjoint finite contractions, then sum the remaining labels with exactly the original source. The result equals the original full endpoint operator and hence its knot scalar. No limitation to a twist family or small bridge count is used. The remaining couplings are explicit: the spectator labels determine the clocks, the new Pochhammer arguments and the original crossing normalizers of multiple bridges. Consequently a second pass through the underbridges is NOT established by the same identity. Neither is the remaining sum positive or geometrically noncancelling merely from the monotone clocks. The next substantive target is this reduced coupled period's geometric action and selected coefficient, with all normalizers included. The general volume limit remains unproved. ## 24. The original global period is a charged socle coefficient 28 October 2026. This checkpoint completes the UNDER-anchor source elimination left open by the preceding overbridge theorem. It does not assume that the old isolated two-Pochhammer formula can be iterated. ### The entire selected source is an exact homogeneous coefficient The [global charged-flow theorem](actual_global_charged_bridge_flow.md) keeps the original closed-braid source. Integer-degree conservation makes the assembled first partial trace diagonal, so its original averaged marked row pairs identically to I/N BEFORE splitting into bridge sectors. All other pivots and every boundary adapter remain. Each overbridge and closure adapter becomes an event with one input denominator X^(N-1) and a homogeneous degree-(N-1) numerator. Understrand transport is exactly z_out=x^sigma z_in Q^(-sigma*h). One anchor per under-only segment, together with the crossing clocks, is a bijective reparametrization of the original remaining labels. There are k=B+b events and anchors. Each anchor terminates at exactly one denominator, while the total numerator degree is k(N-1). For a numerator monomial X^e, a surviving cyclic alias would have e_a-(N-1)=N l_a. Nonnegative e_a forces every l_a>=0; total degree forces their sum zero. Thus EVERY alias is zero termwise in h. All N^k anchor sums cancel the k event normalizations, leaving exactly K_N=(chi_N/N) sum_(over-monotone h) W_h [X_1^(N-1)...X_k^(N-1)] P_h(X). The original external line, phases, factorials and source marks are explicit. The polynomial coefficient algebra is closed under further anchor elimination; the isolated two-Pochhammer factorization need not be. No positive replacement invariant has been introduced. For fixed h this is an ordinary Laurent-polynomial torus period. Arbitrary finite product-circle radii give EXACTLY the same value; linear-factor zeros are zeros, not singular divisors. Hence the off-grid full-Psi/Cauchy seams of the earlier chosen continuation are absent from THIS polynomial source presentation. Only zero and infinity remain as anchor divisors. This theorem does not continue the discrete h variables or select a complex geometric saddle. ### The canonical source survives the nilpotent fiber The [Fermat/socle theorem](actual_charged_socle_and_fermat_source.md) puts that same source in A_N=K[C][X]/(X_i^N-C_i), free over the centers with the bounded monomial basis. Its top-coefficient functional lambda has pairing lambda(X^a X^b)=delta_(a+b,(N-1,...,N-1)); the Gram determinant is a unit independent of the centers. At nonzero centers lambda is the normalized sum of the original grid residues; at C=0 it is the normalized nilpotent-jet socle residue. These agree identically on each homogeneous top-degree P_h. This realizes the proposed algebraic-period/quantum-jet interpretation at each FIXED N with the original selected source. N, the algebra rank, the socle degree and the actual state classes still vary. The theorem supplies no cross-level regulator identity by itself. A perfect pairing also does not make lambda(P_h) nonzero. ### Actual further cancellations, not an absolute-envelope proof The [complete charge-phase theorem](actual_bridge_charge_phase.md) rewrites each whole bridge as a product of charged factors (z_r;Q)_(n_r)t_r^(n_r)/F_(n_r), sum n_r=N-1, with kappa retained. Its interior clock quadratics telescope EXACTLY; remaining phases and spectator feedback are specified, not removed by a norm estimate. A checked actual 5_2 state after overbridge elimination has absolute rate greater than 2.54, while the knot's volume rate is below 0.485. Thus that stage's absolute maximum is not the geometric volume. More constructively, a remaining original wire has a complete complementary-charge contraction proportional to [r choose N-1-H]_Q. It is zero unless r+H>=N-1. The exhibited high-growth family lies in that zero range: its FULL conditional source fiber vanishes exactly. The proof uses an actual factor 1-t^N and includes the original cut, pivots and neighboring factors. The typed rule applies at the specified same-sign bigon seams inside arbitrary networks. There is a broader algebraic pruning rule: a complete Q-orbit of pair factors is X_i^N-alpha^N X_j^N and vanishes in the nilpotent anchor algebra. Homogeneity makes its selected value vanish on all regular Fermat grids too. This is sufficient, not necessary, for annihilation, and has been tested on actual whole-source charged states. The next critical question concerns the SURVIVING charged coefficients and their clock sum. Nonnegative integer charges and local positive sine-binomial magnitudes do not by themselves remove cycle phases or boundary weights. No general selected geometric coefficient, sharp upper bound, or volume-rate lower bound has yet been proved. The original volume-conjecture goal remains active. The [feasible-cycle/fusion theorem](anchor_phase_cycles_and_exact_fusion.md) checks that issue on NONZERO support. In an explicit reduced alternating hyperbolic 6_3 diagram, a surviving clock family at every odd N=2r+1 has a feasible bulk cycle of capacity r and holonomy q^r tending to i. Its full original anchor coefficient is exactly N q^(2-r^2), not zero. Thus a vertex gauge cannot make all surviving bulk flows positive. The same uniform calculation fuses its oscillatory flows by two exact q-binomial correlation identities and gives only polynomial growth. This defeats blanket phase-flatness, while leaving open a stronger phase-aware elimination or filtration separating such sectors from the geometric volume contribution. It is not a counterexample to the volume conjecture or to that possible general fusion strategy. ## 25. General source fusion and controlled growing jets 28 October 2026. The preceding distance-assessment turn was a status response, not a proof advance. This continuation changes the actual source theory with the following independently proved reductions. The [general fusion theorem](actual_general_flow_fusion.md) uses the canonical nilpotent algebra, with d=N-1. A full block is exactly B_d(X,Y;a)=sum_(j=0)^d X^(d-j)(aQ^(-1)Y)^j, [X^d] B_d F = F(aQ^(-1)Y,Y,...) mod Y^N for ANY polynomial exterior F. The original closure blocks therefore contract with their actual pivotal substitutions. For a one-component knot their closure-edge graph is a forest; all b such blocks can be removed, leaving B overbridge anchors. Every scalar and the original chi_N/N remain. This sews the actual selected source at the jet fiber, without pointwise matching incompatible regular Fourier grids. The resulting homogeneous degree-Bd polynomial again has a center-independent Fermat/socle residue, so arbitrary regular anchor centers are available. At a trivalent anchor with lengths L_i=d-k_i, sum k_i=d, its charged contraction is exactly a triangle with edge lengths k_i and a fixed nonzero Gaussian-binomial multiplier. A full-orbit divisibility and degree argument proves the polynomial identity. It applies inside an arbitrary original exterior and has a source-preserving inverse on a matching flat triangle. The audit checks both whole original states and nondegenerate moves in surviving actual sectors. The [defect theorem](charged_star_triangle_defect_jets.md) extends this to sum L_i=2d-e, each pair sum>=d. The exact contracted polynomial is a specified triangle product times a degree-e polynomial R_e, whose marked coefficient c_e is explicit and nonzero. The uniform norm estimate has logarithm O(e log(1+N/e)+log(e+1)) after division by |c_e|. Thus EVERY sublinear e=o(N), including a growing Gaussian window, costs exp(o(N)). Its rate is explicitly calibrated: the scalar gives TWO limiting ideal-tetrahedron volumes under 2pi/N normalization. No factor of two or residual source polynomial is lost. On the unit anchor torus, the incidence defect S_a-2d is exactly twice the angular source-phase frequency, away from factor zeros. The [global cut-jet theorem](charged_source_cut_jets.md) uses e_I=d|I|-m_I, where m_I counts factors wholly in the anchor set I. Negative e_I annihilates the selected coefficient; e_I=0 factors it with its exact outside endpoint monomials. General e_I retains its precise boundary-choice jet. Joint flags and weighted rays cover coordinate corners with no omitted normal source. Sublinear boundary deficits have exp(o(N)) boundary-choice norm. Feasible endpoint assignments canonically factor into strongly connected residual cores; feasibility itself does NOT prevent phase cancellation. The [feedback theorem](actual_clock_feedback_normal_form.md) separately performs every bridge charge sum with all Fourier fugacities retained. The whole original source includes the explicit operation R^nu Y^h -> Q^(nu^T T h)R^nu Y^h, for its actual integer underhistory matrix T. It does not descend to evaluation Y=1. Suppressing it changes original invariant values even in the figure-eight example. Its unit coefficient norm is not a noncancellation theorem for the final source. All of these are exact or quantitatively controlled reductions of the original state, applicable beyond any fixed knot list. They do not show that its surviving cores have sublinear defects, nor that its geometric contribution is nonzero after the remaining clock sum and source pairing. Macroscopic defects and phase cancellation remain the central global difficulty. Gates C, D and the sharp scalar part of E remain open; the active volume-conjecture goal is not complete. ## 26. Forced critical flow and a required macroscopic source sector 28 October 2026. The previous continuation proved exact fusion and sublinear-jet norm estimates. This turn tests whether that regime contains the actual leading state, rather than assuming that it does. For the actual unit-factor polynomial and charges q_i, put delta_i=S_i-2q_i, where S_i counts incident factors. At every regular anchor critical point the [new flow theorem](charged_critical_flow_and_chambers.md) gives EXACTLY sum_(f joining i,j) (|X_i|^2-|X_j|^2)/|alpha_f X_i-beta_f X_j|^2=-delta_i. All conductances are positive. For a high-radius cut I with gap g, C_I crossing factors and source deficit e_I, this implies C_I tanh(g/2)<=2e_I-C_I, g<=log(e_I/(C_I-e_I)). The exact residual-core factorization already proved gives strict integer Hall margins 1<=e_I<=C_I-1. Consequently every regular critical point of a k-anchor, M-factor core satisfies max_i |X_i| / min_i |X_i| <= (M-1)^(k-1). For a fixed diagram M=O(N), so this is uniform polynomial radial properness, without assuming small defects. A fixed fractional cut margin improves it to a bound independent of N. This concerns regular anchor criticals at actual integer clocks; complex clock continuation and noncoordinate collisions are separate problems. If all defects vanish, the maximum principle forces all radii equal. On the original unit torus, log modulus is strictly concave on each angular chamber and phase is constant there. There is one nondegenerate critical point per chamber. If opposite-sign chambers have a strict exponential height gap, a direct Fourier derivative bound gives a nonzero selected coefficient with the maximal rate. This supplies an actual source-accessibility mechanism in its stated class, not an assumed unknown geometric intersection number. The [all-level alternating-source theorem](actual_alternating_balanced_source.md) then checks applicability. After exact closure contraction, each alternating-knot anchor has delta_(i->j)=h_i-h_j along the cyclic physical overencounter order. Balance therefore forces all clocks equal. For the original figure-eight word the valid whole trace source and its pointwise cyclic support imply h_0=0, h_1+h_3>=N-1 in every nonzero fixed-clock coefficient. Its defects are exactly (-h_3,h_1,h_2-h_1,h_3-h_2). Hence max_i |delta_i| >= (N-1)/2. Every balanced sector, and every sequence with all defects o(N), vanishes in this representation. These are exact original-source support statements, independently proved and audited, not numerical claims about saddle dominance. They do NOT rule out later full-block contractions or cluster fusions that combine opposite defects. They do rule out using the current sublinear pointwise jet regime as the whole invariant before such a proved reduction. The [critical-selection audit](charged_torus_critical_selection.md) also proves that properness, source flatness and a unique largest critical value do not by themselves force a contribution. Its explicit unit-cyclotomic coefficient example has uniform strict Hall margins, yet an exact Cauchy-circle bound excludes its highest critical value. It is not a knot counterexample; it identifies the extra source selection content needed in a valid theorem. Two proposed shortcuts have exact source checks: the [feedback Gaussian](actual_feedback_geometric_selection_obstruction.md) is a decoupled normalized unit and leaves the original critical germ unchanged; an [ordinary common Möbius action](actual_nilpotent_mobius_source_and_ward_obstruction.md) does not intertwine the original crossing or supply its framing co-source. These operations cannot supply a missing geometric coefficient simply from their algebraic existence. The constructive next target is the macroscopic forced core, with its original clock feedback and selected source, or an exact global fusion which absorbs those defects before applying tame-jet estimates. The general regulator/period selection and sharp scalar estimate remain open. No new broad knot class is asserted to satisfy the original volume conjecture; the active goal remains incomplete.

title: The actual crossing sum and the complete Bloch fundamental class
text: # The actual crossing sum and the complete Bloch fundamental class Research note, 26 October 2026. This closes a classical comparison left open in [the marked braid note](marked_braid_holonomy.md). The setting is an oriented hyperbolic knot complement, its complete geometric representation, and the actual reduced ADO crossing conventions already fixed. At the complete color the crossing Bloch sum is the oriented idealized fundamental class. In particular its Bloch--Wigner regulator is the hyperbolic volume. The comparison is in the rational oriented pre-Bloch group. It does not identify an integral flattening, a full complex quantum period, or the component selected by the actual finite contraction.
