text: # Volume equality through Conway tangle composition 31 October 2026. Current research formulation, following the user's explicit choice of Conway algebraic/arborescent knots. Bridge number is no longer the organizing parameter. The active objective remains a general equality for the original invariant with the ACTUAL hyperbolic volume; the full arborescent target below is open. ## Every strict Conway composition tree The [strict-tree theorem](actual_conway_all_strict_tree_long_twist_volume.md) now covers every fixed literal \(C(FG)\) that passes the finite strict type test: leaves have type L, turns exchange L/H and preserve A; the nonempty products are LL/LA/AA→A and HL/HA→H, and the root pair is AA, AL, AH or LH. Equivalently, each reduced product hub has at most one flagged original leaf. Mixtures of flagged and unflagged hubs are included. For each such presentation there is a finite \(B(\tau)\). Every fixed tuple of independently signed integer weights with \(|n_i|>B(\tau)\) at every leaf, and loop-free one-component pairing, gives the original invariant's hyperbolic knot complement volume limit through all levels. The presentation and twists are fixed before the quantum limit. The auxiliary crossing circles are filled; the main knot cusp stays unfilled. The new [positive probe bound](actual_conway_unflagged_core_probe_bound.md) controls each maximal unflagged component at its actual intrinsic boundary action. The [spectral propagation theorem](actual_conway_mixed_core_spectral_propagation.md) transports every physical-color loss through that component and restores angular localization. The [geometric adapter](actual_conway_unflagged_probe_geometry.md) proves that these boundary actions sum to the original complete action. The exact complementary-color identity restores the original packet; its primitive marked filling action is the actual knot complement volume. The [pointed quantum A-period corollary](actual_conway_pointed_quantum_a_volume.md) also writes this limit through a genuine all-level ADO operator, its finite initial data and bounded quantum-parameter jets. Existence of the operator was already proved from the finite cut-state source. The remaining general tasks are presentation coverage beyond this strict literal class and identification of the selected classical main-meridian geometric factor with the marked regulator module. No threshold uniform over growing trees or conclusion for arbitrary short weights is asserted. The earlier completed-root TeX manuscript retains its stated theorem. Older scope discussions below record the steps that preceded this extension; their mixed-source obstruction is now resolved for the strict class. ## 1. The target is a composition theorem An algebraic tangle is obtained from rational tangles by the literal Conway sum/product operations and rotations. Close the resulting four-port tangle by a specified numerator or denominator closure, retaining its endpoint order. When the closure has one component it is a Conway algebraic, or arborescent, knot. This is the sense used here, consistent with [Wu's definition](https://homepage.divms.uiowa.edu/~wu/papers/p17.pdf). It is not the plane-curve-singularity meaning of algebraic knot. Fix a reduced, marked tangle expression tree tau, with a specified continued-fraction presentation of each rational leaf, explicit twist boxes, and a closure. Every twist box retains its disk framing and a half-twist parity epsilon_e; its final exponent is epsilon_e-2p_e. Require the resulting diagram to be a knot and its marked augmentation to satisfy the actual hyperbolic/source hypotheses being used. Those requirements must be verified, not inferred from the word arborescent. The desired theorem is: for each such fixed admissible template tau, there is T(tau)<infinity such that every independently chosen fixed signed filling vector with |p_e|>T(tau) has \[ \lim_{N\to\infty}\frac{2\pi}{N} \log|K_N(K_\tau(p))| =\operatorname{Vol}(S^3\setminus K_\tau(p)). \tag{1} \] The template, parity pattern and twists are fixed BEFORE the quantum level tends to infinity. Both level parities and composite levels belong to (1). The right side is the knot complement volume after the auxiliary fillings; the knot cusp itself remains unfilled. No threshold depending only on tree depth, valence or bridge number is asserted. The useful structural task is to prove that the required source, boundary-period and signed-estimate properties survive the actual tangle operations. Arbitrarily large coefficients in a fixed rational tangle do not by themselves prove such closure. ## 2. The baseline grammar and its subsequent enlargements The existing Conway results already give a constructive subclass with unbounded branching and turn depth. After ALL auxiliary circles are filled, write \[ h(n)=\mathcal R(R^n),\qquad n=\epsilon-2p,\qquad A_s=h(n_1)\cdots h(n_s),\quad s\ge3. \tag{2} \] Here R^n means the literal integral two-strand twist tangle, and mathcal R is the actual quarter-turn with the recorded oriented cups and caps. Each h(n) is rational. Generate expressions by \[ E ::= A_s\ (s\ge3)\quad|\quad\mathcal R(E) \quad|\quad E_1E_2. \tag{3} \] The retained closure class is C(FG), with both F and G in (3), plus the isolated C(A_s) for s>=4. The isolated C(A_3) is outside the mixed-color long-filling theorem. Each expression and every s are fixed but otherwise unbounded. The [signed long-filling theorem](actual_odd_conway_long_filling_volume.md) and its [arbitrary-width extension](actual_conway_arbitrary_width_seeds.md) state (1) for this literal class, at independently sufficiently long signed fillings, whenever its parity pattern gives a knot. Their connectivity construction supplies such a pattern for EVERY allowed expression. It is a choice of endpoint pairings, not an assertion that every sign/parity pattern has one component. Here is the exact membership argument. Filling an original auxiliary circle replaces its box by R^(epsilon-2p), with its original disk framing. All auxiliary components disappear when all are filled. Its turned leaf is the rational tangle h(n). Actual stacking and quarter-turns are Conway operations, so structural induction on (3) gives an algebraic tangle. Its literal cylindrical closure is a Conway closure; a loop-free one-component endpoint pattern makes it an arborescent knot. No addition of numerical fractions is used to claim that a sum of rational tangles is rational. With partial fillings, auxiliary components remain and this all-filled membership statement is not the asserted description of the whole link. This membership audit does not reprove every analytic dependency of the existing long-filling theorem. It locates its exact topological scope. In particular there is NO coverage theorem identifying every algebraic tangle with grammar (3). The seed grouping, closure choices, parity test and long-filling conditions remain substantive. A continued- fraction chain cannot be replaced by a three-leaf seed merely because some numerical tangle fractions coincide. The [new two-leaf theorem](actual_arborescent_algebraic_leaf_long_twist_volume.md) extends the retained C(FG) class to seeds of every width s>=2, provided the actual selected complete port solution satisfies \[ X_\ell=\cot(\pi a_\ell)>0, \qquad 9X_\ell^2\ge4 \tag{3a} \] at every leaf. This is a finite algebraic sign test on an isolated selected geometric solution. All old proper seeds with s>=3 satisfy it automatically; only the new two-leaf seeds need checking. The actual even-level missing top coefficient of h^2 is handled by strict interior rounding on the original primitive lattice. The full complex packet, whole-color bound and marked geometric completion then give (1) with the original source normalization. C(A_2) itself remains excluded. \(C(A_2\mathcal R(A_2))\) is an exact passing instance with X=1/sqrt(2); no claim of topological novelty is attached to it. This is a general finite-tree theorem with a geometric certificate, not an all-arborescent theorem. The exact failing tangent example \(C(A_2\mathcal R(A_4))\) has some leaves X=1/sqrt(3). It shows that one cannot simply omit (3a); it does not refute the desired invariant limit. A sharper version uses the exact positive tangent-deficit condition, whose threshold is proved in the same new argument. **The subsequent block theorem removes both restrictions.** The [uniform two-leaf grammar theorem](actual_arborescent_two_leaf_long_twist_volume.md) covers EVERY fixed tree of seeds s>=2 with retained closure C(FG), without (3a). It contracts the two leaves with their original gate and proves an alias margin1/100 on the entire proper geometric range. The finite rational certificate covers all slopes and every point of the actual convex domain; closed-source stationarity gives the global gap. Thus \(C(A_2\mathcal R(A_4))\) is now included. Exact regrouping also supplies the isolated C(A_3) gap, so all isolated C(A_s),s>=3, are included. C(A_2) alone remains excluded. The earlier algebraic leaf test remains sufficient but is no longer required for this grammar. **The single-leaf extension now allows repeated rational-leaf additions.** The [current composition theorem](actual_arborescent_single_leaf_long_twist_volume.md) uses completed expressions \[ E::=hh\mid T(E)\mid E_1E_2\mid hE\mid Eh, \tag{3b} \] with both root children completed in the closure \(C(FG)\). Every physical leaf automatically has \(1/2<X_\ell<1\). An exact alias comparison with the completed child's output tangent propagates through each single attachment, retaining the actual gate and all original physical colors. The whole-source gaps, original nonzero packet and primitive marked filling action give (1) for this enlarged grammar. Any finite number and depth of these operations is allowed, with the same independently long fixed signed-twist quantifiers. The isolated \(C(h^s)\), \(s\ge3\), cases remain available separately. The [general quarter and core theorem](actual_conway_general_core_packet_and_gap.md) places every complete leaf of a strict closed tree at index at least \(1/4\). For strict knot patterns, gate curvature controls every primitive direction when there are at least three leaves; a pure leaf supplies the needed curvature in the two-leaf case. The original all-core sum then has a nonzero complex packet and a strict physical-color complement gap. The [marked-mask theorem](actual_conway_general_mask_marked_filling.md) extends the actual primitive peripheral deformation and absolute filling calibration to all those trees. For strict knot patterns, the remaining global source input is a bound on the total nonempty alias contribution at the geometric rate, or an equally sufficient bound after exact filling. The [root-star assembly](actual_conway_root_star_long_filling_volume.md) supplies the whole invariant limit for \(C(h_0T(h_1\cdots h_s))\), \(s\ge2\), with arbitrary fixed pure/odd patterns that give a knot and independently sufficiently long fixed signed twists. Its child proof retains the full Hermite jets and spectral localization; the root proof uses the exact missing Fourier mode. The [prior-source comparison](actual_conway_root_star_prior_source_coverage.md) records that this Fourier cancellation was already in the outer-kernel note and that all-odd star scalars overlap the older belt-stack source. Inner pure leaves extend the recorded two-type source alphabet, but no new knot isotopy classification follows. Arbitrary internally turned children still need a global alias estimate, and general presentation coverage remains open. The completed-root manuscript is unchanged. ### Weighted trees with independently long integer entries The [weighted-tree theorem](actual_conway_weighted_tree_long_twist_volume.md) now covers every fixed finite rooted ordered tree with \(H\ge2\) vertices, one actual integer twist weight at each vertex, arbitrary branching and unary chains. Nonroot tangles satisfy \[ Q_v=T\!\left(R^{n_v}\prod_w Q_w\right), \] and the retained closure is \(C(T(R^{n_0})T(\prod_wQ_w))\). For each fixed tree there is a finite \(B(\mathcal T)\). Every fixed, independently signed tuple with \(|n_v|>B(\mathcal T)\) at every vertex and a loop-free one-component terminal pairing has the original invariant's actual knot complement volume limit through all levels. The tree and weights are fixed before \(N\) grows. Only the auxiliary crossing circles are filled. The [decorated-character estimate](actual_conway_decorated_character_spectral_closure.md) is closed under arbitrary products and \(T(R^\epsilon L_jE)\). It retains the full Hermite jets, restores angular localization, and propagates every physical-color deficit with a strict loss. The exact complementary-color identity then bounds the total nonempty alias contribution. The pure complete rate is \(2G_0(H-1)\), independently calibrated by the [positive kernel](actual_conway_reduced_hub_source_normal_form.md) and [rigid-spine geometry](actual_conway_rigid_spine_and_flagged_tree_geometry.md). The complete augmented volume is \(2v_{\mathrm{oct}}(H-1)\); the filled knot limit is the distinct marked critical value. The exact reduced-source criterion permits at most one flagged original leaf per product hub. The no-flag case reduces to the earlier completed grammar; the new estimate covers the case with one flag at every hub. Mixed trees still require a sharp bound for turns without an adjacent original character. Their full-Hermite norm costs \(2G_0\) exponentially, and that cost cannot simply be added to the geometric action. General presentation coverage and a generic main-meridian quantum A-operator remain open. Neither the source normal form nor this theorem asserts a new knot isotopy classification. ## 3. What the algebraic boundary object must retain For composition, a polynomial relation alone is incomplete boundary data. Retain the original boundary quantum state, an algebraic boundary correspondence, the selected logarithmic lifts, and an absolutely normalized pressure/action primitive. For a geometric CROSS disk module with boundary weights L_b, the currently proved version is \[ q_b=\frac{\partial F}{\partial\log L_b},\qquad B_b=e^{2\pi i q_b},\qquad dF=\sum_b q_b\,d\log L_b. \tag{4} \] The selected phases B_b are algebraic in the boundary weights. The integer lifts q_b and the additive constant of F are extra data. The [algebraic boundary-curve theorem](research_cap_algebraic_boundary_curve_and_volume_period.md) constructs these explicitly for the original one-cap exterior and reconstructs its quantum root density from the same branch. Restoring the original complete cap gives a unique algebraic point and an absolutely normalized period equal to the original drilled hyperbolic volume divided by 2pi. This is an actual geometric calibration, not a claim that an arbitrary eliminated curve carries that volume. For admissible gluing of whole original port disks, internal shared faces s impose the lifted condition \[ q_{1,s}+q_{2,s}=1,\qquad B_{1,s}B_{2,s}=1, \tag{5} \] and the positive primitive composes by \[ F_{12}=\inf_{\log L_S} \left(F_1+F_2-\sum_{s\in S}\log L_s\right). \tag{6} \] At finite level the same operation is coefficient extraction at the original face demands: \[ P_{12,N}=\left[\prod_{s\in S}L_s^{N-1}\right]P_{1,N}P_{2,N}. \tag{7} \] Shared external variables are identified, and every old internal extraction and original coupon factor is retained. The [boundary composition theorem](research_tangle_source_boundary_composition.md) proves these laws and their associativity under its explicit whole-port, anchoring and simplicity conditions. It does not identify arbitrary Conway operations with those cuts automatically. The actual signed four-port tangle tensor carries additional information beyond this positive CROSS coefficient module. A four-punctured Conway seam has boundary shape data. Its geometric volume is obtained after matching that data and solving the shared critical equations. One cannot replace (6) by a sum of independently maximized piece volumes. Neither this source-boundary correspondence nor its one-variable eliminant is called the ordinary knot A-polynomial without the missing meridian/longitude dictionary. ## 4. The remaining closure theorem The general extension beyond these certified grammars must establish, for each allowed rational-tangle building block and composition: * The literal original quantum boundary contraction, including turns, full repeated-root information, framing and the final knot closure. * The selected algebraic boundary branch and primitive with correct integer lifts and all shared shape variables. * A signed estimate that survives that contraction, at both level parities, followed by the original full filling-period argument. The current two-cap calculation demonstrates why the last requirement is substantive: pair-total extraction can destroy joint stability, and completing two cap sums creates mixed tails as well as a double tail. The [joint response theorem](research_two_cap_joint_extraction_response_bound.md) retains those terms and gives a finite sufficient comparison. The [even-level obstruction](research_even_cross_stability_obstruction.md) shows that the actual local CROSS polynomial already fails real stability at N=6; a positive comparison does not transfer its signed negative-axis rate automatically. These findings concern the general source extension and do not revoke the existing robust Conway proof, which uses a different exact full-Newton estimate. Thus the immediate target is a tangle-gluing theorem on the original boundary data, capable of enlarging the admissible seed and rational- edge class. The older general prescribed-plat question remains an open presentation of the broader problem; bridge number is not used to organize the present argument. The research goal remains ACTIVE.

title: Exact full-circle sewing beyond the cyclic pretzel source
text: # Exact full-circle sewing beyond the cyclic pretzel source 29 October 2026. There is an all-level, source-preserving circle resolution for every original two-port Hopf box. Its dual is a difference of TWO ordinary circle colors, with polynomial norm. This gives an exact alphabet for arbitrary finite arborescent circuits of such boxes, and a quantitative whole-source upper bound. It does **not** yet give a sharp geometric bound or nonzero geometric period for a general augmented graph. All identities below retain the first derivatives at repeated Casimir nodes. In particular none takes a semisimple quotient at a root of unity. ## 1. The original algebra and the actual turn Put \(d=N-1, q=e^{\pi i/N}, Q=q^2, x=q^d\), and \[ \mathcal H_N=\mathbb C[z]/P_N(z),\qquad P_N(z)=2T_N(z/2)+2, \qquad L_a(z)=(-1)^{a-1}U_{a-1}(z/2),\quad1\leq a\leq N. \tag{1} \] The [full physical commutant theorem](actual_pair_casimir_commutant_and_rotated_trace.md) identifies this algebra faithfully with every \(E,F,K\)-intertwiner on the original \(V_N\otimes V_N\), by \(z\mapsto\Omega\). It includes all degrees, even and composite levels, and the odd simple node. The operators \(L_a\) are the [literal auxiliary ordinary-circle traces](actual_crossing_circle_source_and_filling.md), with their original pivotal trace and no division by \(a\). Use the unscaled genuine turn \(\mathscr R\), with the original cup and cap \[ p_{ab}=Nx^{-b}\delta_{a+b,d},\qquad \ell_{ab}=x^a\delta_{a+b,d}/N. \] For a Hopf box \(B\), its symmetry and degree support give \[ (\mathscr R B)_{(a,b);(c,e)} =x^{a-e}B_{(d-a,c);(b,d-e)},\qquad \mathscr R^2=I,\quad \mathscr R(I)=p\ell, \quad \mathscr R(R^{-1})=R. \tag{2} \] The scaled \(Z_B=x^{-d}\mathscr R B\) used in the older charge-block conjugation is different notation. Here every turn is (2), so no \(x^d\) is lost. Rotation is a linear automorphism, **not** a product map. The original marked functional is \[ \phi(f)=\frac1N\operatorname{Tr}[(I\otimes K^{1-N})f(\Omega)] =(-1)^dN^2[z^d](f\bmod P_N). \tag{3} \] The last equality, proved in the commutant note, is a full Hermite identity. In particular \(\phi(L_a)=N^2\delta_{aN}\). ## 2. A sparse all-normal Frobenius inverse The ordinary polynomial product identity and its exact root reduction are \[ L_aL_b=\sum_{r=0}^{\min(a,b)-1}L_{a+b-1-2r},\qquad L_{N+h}=L_{N-h}-2(-1)^N L_h\pmod {P_N}, \quad1\leq h<N. \tag{4} \] The first follows by multiplying the two finite geometric expressions for \(U_{a-1}( (w+w^{-1})/2)\). For the second use \[ 2T_N(z/2)U_{h-1}(z/2)=U_{N+h-1}(z/2)-U_{N-h-1}(z/2) \] and \(2T_N=-2\) in the QUOTIENT POLYNOMIAL RING. Thus (4) retains normal derivatives, rather than merely agreeing on distinct nodes. The coefficient mass in any product of two basis elements is at most \(3N\). At even \(N\), the cancellations include the exact identity \(L_N^2=0\); omitting the high aliases would destroy it. Only a term \(L_N\) contributes to (3). The high terms in (4) cannot reduce to \(L_N\). Consequently \[ M_{ab}:=N^{-2}\phi(L_aL_b) =\mathbf1_{a+b\geq N+1}\mathbf1_{a+b\equiv N+1\ (2)}. \tag{5} \] Let \(J_{ab}=\delta_{a+b,N+1}\) and let \(S\) be the upper shift. Then \[ M=J(I-S^2)^{-1},\qquad M^{-1}=(I-S^2)J, \qquad(M^{-1})_{ab}=\delta_{a+b,N+1}-\delta_{a+b,N-1}. \tag{6} \] Here \((I-S^2)^{-1}\) is the finite geometric sum. In particular \[ L_a^\vee=\frac{L_{N+1-a}-L_{N-1-a}}{N^2},\qquad \phi(L_a^\vee L_b)=\delta_{ab}, \tag{7} \] with \(L_j=0\) for \(j\leq0\). This proves nondegeneracy at EVERY level. It also gives \(\|M\|_2\leq\lceil N/2\rceil\) and \(\|M^{-1}\|_2\leq2\), hence condition number at most \(N+1\). The Frobenius pairing is bilinear and generally indefinite; (6) is not a claim of a positive pivotal trace. In a positive coefficient norm its Riesz vector must be conjugated in the usual way. ## 3. A literal all-exterior turn kernel Write \[ z_{N,a}=\mathscr R(R^{-1}L_a),\quad1\leq a\leq N. \] These are the full mixed-circle packets, including both the low core and the nonzero \(RP\) band. Since \(R\) is invertible in the FULL algebra, the bases \(R^{-1}L_a\) and \(R L_a^\vee\) are dual. For EVERY \(f\in\mathcal H_N\), \[ \boxed{\quad \mathscr R f=\sum_{a=1}^{N}z_{N,a}\, \phi(R L_a^\vee f). \quad} \tag{8} \] This is a full physical operator identity before any exterior is attached. It therefore allows arbitrary adjacent physical tensors and spectator couplings; it is not an identity only after evaluating a knot scalar. All original Cartan factors and \(\kappa\) remain in the literal \(R\). Products are given by (4), twists by their exact signed powers, and turns by (8). These operations provide a finite source-independent sewing algorithm on any fixed two-port circuit generated by them. Every internal resolution uses only the sparse dual (7). Both closures also keep their original source. The denominator closure is (3). The original marked row is \(m_{ab}=x^b/N^2\), with NO delta. Directly contracting its entries with (2) gives \[ \boxed{\qquad \phi(\mathscr R f)=m f(\Omega)p=f(c_0),\qquad c_0=q+q^{-1}. \qquad} \tag{9} \] For clarity, in the diagonal trace the coefficient of \(f_{(d-a,a);(b,d-b)}\) is \(g_bx^{a-b}/N=x^{a+b-d}/N\). This equals \(m_{(d-a,a)}p_{(b,d-b)}\); hence the first equality is the genuine unrestricted marked contraction. Finally \(f(\Omega)p=f(c_0)p\), and \(mp=1\). No local replacement of the marked row by an ordinary cap was used. ## 4. A quantitative faithful norm on all normal channels For the distinct roots of \(P_N\), put \[ \|f\|_{\mathrm{H}}=\max_c|f(c)|+ N^{-2}\max_{c\ {\mathrm{double}}}|f'(c)|. \tag{10} \] At an odd simple node only its value occurs. This is a faithful submultiplicative norm. Let \(f=\sum_{a=1}^{N}\beta_aL_a\). Then \[ \|f\|_{\mathrm{H}}\leq\tfrac32N^{3/2}\|\beta\|_2, \qquad \|\beta\|_2\leq6N^{3/2}\|f\|_{\mathrm{H}}. \tag{11} \] For the first estimate use \(\max_{[-2,2]}|L_a|\leq a\), and the elementary polynomial derivative bound \(\max|L_a'|\leq(a-1)^2a/2\). For completeness the reverse estimate does not invert a confluent Vandermonde: set \(w_k=q^{2k+1}\), \(h_k=f(w_k+w_k^{-1})\), and \(d_k=(w_k-w_k^{-1})f'(w_k+w_k^{-1})\), with \(d_k=0\) at the simple node. Write \(f=a_0+\sum_{n=1}^d a_n2T_n(z/2)\). The finite Fourier transforms \(H_n,D_n\) obey \[ a_0=H_0,\quad a_n=\{D_n+(N-n)H_n\}/N, \quad\beta_{j+1}=(-1)^j(a_j-a_{j+2}). \tag{12} \] Indeed the two aliases are \(H_n=a_n-a_{N-n}\) and \(D_n=na_n+(N-n)a_{N-n}\). Since \(|h_k|\leq\|f\|_{\mathrm{H}}\) and \(|d_k|\leq2N^2\|f\|_{\mathrm{H}}\), (12) proves (11), including the even middle Fourier index and the odd simple node. The original full crossing satisfies, for EVERY signed integer \(e\), \[ \|R^e\|_{\mathrm{H}}\leq1+|e|/8. \tag{13} \] Its nodal values have modulus one. The exact full-Cartan derivative is \( (R^e)'/R^e=-e(d-2k)/[2(w_k-w_k^{-1})]\). At a double node \(|\sin((2k+1)\pi/N)|\geq\sin(\pi/N)\geq2/N\); division by \(N^2\) gives (13). Negative powers are literal inverses, and their derivatives are included. Also \(\|L_a\|_{\mathrm{H}}\leq3N/2\). The [global full-colored packet bound](actual_pretzel_global_alias_and_colored_source_gap.md), sections 3--4, gives a sequence \(\epsilon_N\to0\), independent of \(a\), such that \[ \max_{1\leq a\leq N}\|z_{N,a}\|_{\mathrm{H}} \leq\exp[N(j_0+\epsilon_N)],\qquad j_0=v_8/\pi. \tag{14} \] This LOCAL statement needs no box-count threshold. Its proof keeps the full high band; that band's upper rate \(\tfrac12\log(4+\sqrt{15})<j_0\) is uniform over all colors. Apply (11) to \(Rf\), expand in \(L_a\), and apply (8). It follows that \[ \|\mathscr R\|_{{\mathrm{H}}\to{\mathrm{H}}} \leq7N^2\exp[N(j_0+\epsilon_N)]. \tag{15} \] The exponential rate in (15) is exact, not an artifact of a physical basis condition number: \[ \boxed{\quad\lim_{N\to\infty}N^{-1} \log\|\mathscr R\|_{{\mathrm{H}}\to{\mathrm{H}}}=j_0.\quad} \tag{16} \] To prove the lower bound, use \(z_N=z_{N,N}\). Its input \(R^{-1}L_N\) has polynomial norm. For every fixed odd \(s\geq3\), the [proved original complete period](actual_pretzel_coherent_circle_and_period_asymptotic.md) has \(N^{-1}\log|\phi(z_N^s)|\to A_s=V_s/(2\pi)\), whereas \(|\phi(f)|\leq3N^3\|f\|_{\mathrm{H}}\) and the norm is submultiplicative. Hence the lower rate is at least \(A_s/s\). Its explicit volume formula gives \(A_s/s\to8\Lambda(\pi/4)/\pi=v_8/\pi\). First take the limit in \(N\) for EACH fixed \(s\), then the supremum in \(s\); no exchange of two growing parameters is needed. ## 5. A reusable original-source upper bound, and its limitation Consider any fixed finite typed two-port syntax circuit with leaves \(R^{e_i}\) and ordinary circle operators \(L_{a_i}\), product vertices, and \(t\) genuine turns (2). Close by either original closure (3) or (9). All colors \(1\leq a_i\leq N\) are allowed. For fixed signed powers, \[ \limsup_{N\to\infty}\frac{2\pi}{N}\log|A_N| \leq 2t\,v_8. \tag{17} \] This follows inductively from submultiplicativity, (13)--(15), \(|\phi|\leq3N^3\|\cdot\|_{\mathrm{H}}\), and \(|f(c_0)|\leq\|f\|_{\mathrm{H}}\). The only exponential cost is an ACTUAL turn. No additional turn is charged for the numerator closure. The same proof allows growing exponents if \(\sum_i\log(1+|e_i|)=o(N)\). The object in (17) is the literal original marked scalar. For a diagram using the original reduced zero-framed convention, the explicit turn and [whole normalization comparison](actual_complete_augmented_source_normalization.md) give only the recorded unit framing character. The one-cut modified convention adds \(i^{N+3}/N\). These preserve (17); no unspecified meridian normalization is absorbed in the estimate. Thus (17) applies to any arborescent/conway presentation ACTUALLY built from this typed alphabet, not just a cyclic power of an identical box. It is a broad source upper, but generally not the sharp filled volume: already \(V_s<2s v_8\) for the known complete cyclic pretzel examples. An exact regular-octahedron decomposition whose incidence and turn count match (17) would make a stronger base comparison possible. Such an identification has not been proved here for all octahedral FALs. ## 6. What a prime six-port graph still requires The circle resolution is valid on a TWO-port Hopf separator. A prime six-port cell is not supplied by assigning an independent commuting circle variable to each incident pair. The actual complete multiplicity space has adjacent operators \(A=\Omega_{12}\), \(B=\Omega_{23}\); they generate the full matrix algebra, as proved in [the original observable filtration](actual_adjacent_observable_source_filtration.md). This rules out an EXACT quotient preserving both operators by commuting circle coordinates. It does not rule out a geometric microlocal metric. The concrete missing kernel is the full source-selected recoupling \(C=V_d^{-1}JV_d\), with every Hermite channel retained, or equivalently the [complete-circle split-pair map](actual_complete_circle_positive_quotient.md) \((I\otimes\pi)(\iota\otimes I)\). A source-exact six-port octahedral identity, its mixed-color analytic bound, and its original marked dual cost would extend the present sewing beyond two-port trees. None follows from a positive Turaev--Viro partition function alone. For coverage only, the [abstract of Ibarra--McQuire--Purcell](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.09296) identifies octahedral FAL complements with fundamental-shadow-link complements and reports a colored skein formula and a Turaev--Viro result. That abstract supplies no identity with this original marked Kashaev source. No proof or technique from it is used above. ## 7. Complete-circle connectors: a coherent channel sum, not independent blocks There is a useful exact positive statement about a complete connector. Since \(P_N'=NU_{N-1}\), one has \(L_N=(-1)^dP_N'/N\) in the FULL algebra. At a double node, \(L_N(c)=0\) and \((4-c^2)L_N'(c)=(-1)^d2N\). At the odd simple node \(L_N(-2)=N\). Substitution in the original trace formula gives \[ \boxed{\quad \phi(L_Nfg)=N\sum_{c\ {\mathrm{distinct}}}m_c f(c)g(c), \qquad m_c=2\ {\mathrm{(double)}},\quad m_{-2}=1\ {\mathrm{(simple)}} . \quad} \tag{18} \] Thus for coefficient reflection \(f^\sharp(z)=\overline{f(\bar z)}\), \(\phi(L_N f^\sharp f)=N\sum m_c|f(c)|^2\geq0\). All nodes are real. The positive form has rank \(\lfloor(N+1)/2\rfloor\), and its kernel is EXACTLY the ideal of polynomials whose values vanish at all distinct nodes. The derivatives of \(L_N\), rather than a discarded projective sector, supply the positive weights. Reflection of an actual tensor diagram must still use its genuine dual turns; (18) does not license bending an already formed positive matrix in a different bipartition. In particular the normalized connector is the JOINT channel average \(N^{-1}\sum m_c f(c)g(c)\), not the product of the separate averages. Its rank is greater than one for every \(N\geq3\). Independent block factorization for arbitrary exterior boxes is therefore false even though the connector is positive on reflected pairs. Here is an exact test of the proposed purely Frobenius tree sewing. Let a fixed finite tree have vertex tensor \(\phi(f_v\prod L_{a_{ve}})\). At each edge use the COMPLETE connector \[ C_{ab}=\phi(L_a^\vee L_N L_b^\vee). \tag{19} \] These are specified actual algebra/trace tensors with the original source normalizations, not a metric chosen from the final scalar. Repeatedly applying the all-exterior resolution (7) at a leaf proves \[ \boxed{\qquad Z_{\mathrm{tree}}=\phi\!\left(L_N^{|E|}\prod_v f_v\right). \qquad} \tag{20} \] This identity includes vertices of arbitrary valency and arbitrary external \(f_v\). Every leaf elimination inserts one literal \(L_N\); there is no inverse of a nilpotent circle operator. For \(|E|\geq2\), it specializes further to \[ Z_{\mathrm{tree}}= \begin{cases} 0,&N\ {\mathrm{even}},\\ N^{|E|}\prod_v f_v(-2),&N\ {\mathrm{odd}}. \end{cases} \tag{21} \] Indeed at a double node the value and first derivative of \(L_N^e\) vanish for \(e\geq2\); only the odd simple node survives. This is an ACTUAL full-normal obstruction to replacing every internal Conway connector by an independent Frobenius complete-circle propagator and then multiplying known local geometric periods. Such a sewing is computable and may describe a particular diagram, but it cannot be identified with a new nonzero all-level augmented tree source without an additional physical port theorem. The true branched graph can have six open physical legs at a vertex; its intertwiner need not be this commutative multiplication tensor. Turns at intermediate vertices also change (20) into the nonmultiplicative kernel (8). Equations (18)--(21) locate the next constructive task: retain the shared channel and its actual six-port vertex tensor before estimating or factorizing it. They do not rule out a coherent geometric positive metric, or an exact larger class after that tensor has been supplied. There is a source-exact nonbranched extension that avoids (20): [the balanced octahedral belt stack](actual_balanced_octahedral_belt_stack_volume.md) cuts every piece at the SAME outer belt and retains ONE complete circle after cyclic stacking, so its source is \(\phi(L_N(z_N^\sharp z_N)^k)\), not a power of \(L_N\). The [actual bandlimited sampling theorem](actual_complete_circle_nodal_energy_and_belt_sewing.md) gives its sharp energy and the literal pants/collar certificate gives volume \(4k v_8\). This does not replace a genuinely branched physical vertex by the Frobenius tensors in (19). Audit: [original matrices, all normal aliases, sparse duals and open-port sewing](../experiments/audit_general_augmented_graph_source_extension.py).

title: Fixed-skeleton long fillings: the proved geometric quantifiers
status: Geometric long fillings; quantum threshold conditional
text: # Fixed-skeleton long fillings: the proved geometric quantifiers 30 October 2026. The new multi-cusp rigidity result and the existing geometric completion theorem have a useful joint corollary: an actual positive marked augmented-link certificate supplies ALL independently sufficiently long signed integral fillings, without requiring a quantum source branch to construct those geometric fillings. This is an assembly of the repo's established geometric arguments, not a claim of a new general hyperbolic Dehn filling theorem or of a volume-conjecture proof. ## 1. Fix the topology before either parameter limit Fix k>=2 and one ordered 2k-strand plat skeleton D. Its r designated crossing-circle disks, outside wires, upper/lower pairings, marked cut, and retained half twists epsilon_i in {0,+1,-1} are part of D. The corresponding filled word has exponents epsilon_i-2p_i. Combine adjacent powers of the same generator before calling the disks independent. Let Y_D be the actual drilled augmented exterior, with its primitive crossing-disk pairs (mu_i,lambda_i). Supply a positive complete ideal gluing certificate for this ACTUAL marked Y_D, as in [the general positive certificate](general_marked_positive_gluing_certificate.md). A certified right-angled matching-graph realization is one existing way to supply it. The conclusion below applies at every fixed k and fixed r; neither k nor r is sent to infinity, and constants may depend on the entire fixed diagram D. A parity test decides whether filling all auxiliary circles gives knots: the fixed plat pairings composed with the permutation of the retained half-twist word must have one component. Full twists have trivial strand permutation. Consequently the number of surviving main components is independent of every p_i. Long twisting cannot repair a failed knot connectivity test. A 2k-plat gives a k-bridge presentation; minimal bridge number is not being asserted. ## 2. Geometric corollary with independent signed slopes There exists T_geom(D)<infinity with the following property. Choose ANY subset I of the r auxiliary cusps and ANY fixed signed integer slopes p_i, i in I, satisfying |p_i|>T_geom(D) for every i in I. Fill precisely those cusps along the original primitive curves mu_i+p_i lambda_i. Then the actual filled exterior has a positively oriented complete finite-volume hyperbolic metric. All main cusps and all auxiliary cusps outside I remain complete. There is no common-sign or slope-comparability condition. One threshold works for every subset. The empty subset recovers the supplied complete augmented geometry. Here is the direct proof, including the existence step that the older completion theorem did not assert on its own. By [multi-cusp marked rigidity](general_marked_multicusp_gluing_rigidity.md), with main meridian logs fixed to zero, the auxiliary PROJECTIVE meridian logs U=(U_1,...,U_r) are holomorphic coordinates on the decorated geometric germ. The actual preferred longitude logs obey V_i(U)=U_i t_i(U), t_i(0)=tau_i, Im tau_i>0. (1) This divisibility follows from the exact commuting-similarity identity, not a guessed source potential. Choose a sufficiently small geometric neighborhood where all t_i are nonzero and where the framed representations lie in the fixed neighborhood required by the existing [geometric completion theorem](general_source_regulator_hyperbolic_equality.md). Normalize a developed triple to obtain a bounded holomorphic representative of the framed family there. Introduce complex parameters e_i and solve V_i(U)+e_i U_i=-2pi i e_i, i=1,...,r. (2) At (U,e)=(0,0) the U-Jacobian is diag(tau_i), hence invertible. The holomorphic implicit-function theorem gives one solution U(e) in a fixed polydisk around zero. Shrink that polydisk so the framed family stays in the above completion neighborhood and |t_i(U(e))+e_i|>=c_D>0. Using (1), equation (2) becomes the exact coordinatewise identity U_i(e)=-2pi i e_i/[t_i(U(e))+e_i]. (3) In particular |U_i(e)|<=2pi|e_i|/c_D, even when the e_i have arbitrarily unequal magnitudes. If e_i=0, then U_i=V_i=0 EXACTLY. That cusp is unfilled and parabolic; it has not been assigned a filling coefficient p_i=0. Now put e_i=1/p_i for i in I and e_i=0 otherwise. For sufficiently large independently signed |p_i| this is in the same polydisk and (2) gives the ACTUAL small-log equations U_i+p_i V_i=-2pi i, i in I. (4) The curve mu_i+p_i lambda_i is primitive because its meridian coefficient is one. Equation (4) has unit charge, with its original orientation. All unfilled groups are parabolic and nontrivial nearby. These are precisely the inherited hypotheses of the geometric completion theorem: actual nearby framed representation, correct primitive marking, parabolic unfilled ends, and unit-charge filling logarithms. That theorem constructs the complete smooth metric on the correctly marked filled topology. This proves the corollary. The argument makes no rational-surgery quantum claim. Retained half twists belong to Y_D and its own primitive collar. A hidden half-integer slope on a different pure link is not substituted for (4). ## 3. The strongest honest general volume statement is still conditional For this SAME D, suppose the original mixed-color marked source satisfies all hypotheses of [the general original-source long-filling transfer](general_original_source_long_filling_transfer.md): an exact analytic color packet, uniform complex asymptotic with nonzero leading density, the full complementary-color/alias/normal-current gap, and selection of the actual marked geometric action and its complete regulator anchor. Then that transfer theorem gives a threshold T_vol(D)>=T_geom(D) such that, for every FIXED signed vector p with all |p_i|>T_vol(D), lim_(N -> infinity) (2pi/N) log |K_N(K_D(p))| =Vol(S^3 minus K_D(p)). (5) Here the parity test in section 1 is assumed, and all auxiliary circles are filled. Every quantum level is included, both parities and composite levels. The order of quantifiers is for each fixed k and admissible fixed D, there exists T_vol(D), for every fixed signed long vector p, take the full sequence N -> infinity. The general quantum hypotheses have NOT yet been proved for every D. Thus T_geom(D) is established under the positive marked certificate, whereas existence of T_vol(D) for arbitrary certified D remains the active volume-conjecture target. The exact compiler, classical geometric critical scheme and local column amplitudes do not by themselves supply that missing full-source estimate or period coefficient. If only a nonzero analytic density germ is proved, rather than a unit or a controlled peripheral monomial times a unit, the [source-divisor extension](general_long_filling_source_divisor.md) allows an exceptional analytic divisor of slopes. Its density-one conclusion must not be restated as the all-long-slopes assertion (5). There is no assertion of uniformity when p depends on N. The transfer errors and their constants are proved with p fixed. Likewise no threshold depending ONLY on k follows from these arguments: bridge width bounds the number of simultaneous heads, while the number/order of boxes and all geometric and source constants remain part of D. This is a limitation of the proved quantifiers, not a proof that a universal k-only threshold cannot exist within a more restrictive certified class. ## 4. What long twisting does and does not provide Given the positive marked base certificate, long integral twists provide the hyperbolic filled geometry by section 2. They preserve the already fixed knot/link connectivity. They do not imply the base certificate: Y_D is independent of p, as are its cusp labels, essential crossing disks and actual cut topology. Nor does hyperbolicity of a filled knot imply that every chosen augmented presentation has a hyperbolic base. There is an elementary obstruction to using raw crossing counts in place of essential marked disks. Two adjacent same-pair blocks can satisfy R^(2p) R^(-2p+2c)=R^(2c) with fixed c while both apparent twist counts grow. This identity holds in the original source, with its Cartan factor and marked closure. It motivates merging redundant regions and certifying the drilled topology; it does not disprove a uniform threshold inside the certified essential class. The present target is therefore broad but precise: every fixed certified essential augmented 2k-plat skeleton, for every k>=2, with the required parity and independently long signed full twists. It is not a claim that every k-bridge knot already lies in that long-twist class, nor that the full volume conjecture for that class has now been proved. The geometric threshold assumes the marked positive certificate. The quantum threshold also requires the stated source estimates.

title: The general long-twist target at arbitrary fixed plat width
text: # The general long-twist target at arbitrary fixed plat width 31 October 2026 update. The target remains arbitrary fixed k>=2 and independently sufficiently long FIXED signed twists, with the knots and slopes fixed before the quantum level tends to infinity. It remains a CONJECTURE for a general essential hyperbolic augmented skeleton. The latest [endpoint theorem](general_fejer_endpoint_source_volume.md) proves the actual augmented volume for the full positive numerator, with [odd regularization](actual_fejer_odd_regularized_full_numerator.md) and a [unique geometric maximum](actual_fejer_unique_geometric_maximizer.md). This settles the positive endpoint optimization at every certified fixed width. The whole-period and conditional full-invariant results below now extend this endpoint calculation. The [full spectral numerator theorem](general_full_spectral_numerator_geometric_packet.md) now proves a nonzero relative asymptotic on a fixed complex neighborhood of the geometric endpoint, including every spectral Hermite datum. Its ordinary-face cycle is the original Cauchy torus. The [absolute marked action](actual_cross_cofactor_marked_action.md) identifies the unit-charge filling critical value with the actual filled volume. The [local charge comparison](general_local_charge_critical_monotonicity.md) proves strict dominance of the all-unit charge among nearby positive integer charges, uniformly for independent signed twists with no ratio condition. These results hold under the supplied simple-white geometric certificate at arbitrary fixed plat width. The [localized original-period theorem](general_localized_unit_charge_filling_period.md) now deforms the actual restricted spectral contour to that saddle, retains its boundary currents, and proves its coefficient is nonzero. The finite local charge sector therefore has the actual filled volume as its normalized logarithmic growth rate, at both level parities. The [entire CROSS period theorem](general_all_cross_long_filling_volume.md) now controls every original Fourier charge and the whole spectral contour for the CROSS sector, with its actual filled-volume rate. The [complete-radius balance theorem](general_complete_radius_balance_filling_volume.md) also proves the FULL original invariant limit whenever the actual marked complete packing satisfies its finite test at every port. A sufficient [algebraic criterion](actual_triangle_entropy_algebraic_balance.md) is $$ (x+y+b)(x+y+c)\geq\max\{b^2,c^2\}. $$ The theorem permits every independently long fixed signed twist vector, with no slope-ratio condition. What remains is broad geometric coverage of this condition, or a bound for the macroscopic one-sided sectors when it fails. In particular, arbitrary supplied plat width or a numerical packing experiment does not by itself prove the desired family coverage. A separate generic-q normal estimate is unnecessary for this exact fixed-root route; see the [scope audit](fixed_root_direct_power_scope.md). The older mixed-color route and its conditions are preserved below as alternative approaches. The [one-end layer theorem](general_one_end_layer_long_filling_volume.md) now proves actual balance for a family at EVERY fixed k>=2, with 3k-3 independently long signed twist regions. An exact packing recurrence and convex comparison prove its curvature bound uniformly. The [Fox certificate](actual_fox_coloring_exact_plat_bridge.md) gives subfamilies of minimal bridge number exactly k. This establishes genuinely unbounded bridge complexity at every k>=2, but not every k-bridge diagram. The earlier reduced-layer family remains separately recorded with its original k>=4 scope. There is now a whole-source intermediate theorem: the [original signed augmented source](general_signed_augmented_source_volume.md) has limit equal to the actual complete volume for every fixed connected plat with the stated labeled right-angled certificate and any retained half-twist pattern. Both parities and composite levels are included. This is an augmented-LINK theorem, including patterns whose main strands form one component; it is not yet the general long-filled knot theorem. The proof uses the [exact positive face coefficient](actual_original_marked_face_coefficient.md), its [global torus saddle](actual_positive_face_coefficient_saddle.md), the [uniform all-channel bound](actual_positive_face_channel_rate.md), and the [absolute facet-coning volume](actual_original_boundary_stationary_character.md). The signed extension derives a uniform relative folded Gaussian from the original continuants and sums the actual phases to a nonzero leading coefficient. All original factors and the primitive grid measure remain. The [fixed complex complete-core theorem](actual_complete_core_complex_packet.md) now supplies a nonzero asymptotic on a fixed neighborhood in EXTERNAL crossing-circle colors, for the exact complete-image term of reflection. The [marked geometric assembly](actual_complete_core_geometric_deformation.md) now identifies its limiting action, including at the zero faces, with the actual geometric regulator and its complex boundary correction. The [whole-source untwisted corridor](general_untwisted_mixed_source_volume_corridor.md) now transfers this volume identity to the original mixed source when any chosen set of untwisted ports varies near completeness. The [homogeneous source theorem](actual_homogeneous_casimir_face_source.md) now gives the exact original coefficient for all Casimir coupons and a JOINT signed/unsigned corridor under finite shared-radius certificates, including disconnected subsets. Existence of such signed certificates for a general class and the combined far-color bound remain open. The current dependency map is in the [frontier chapter](../book/chapters/frontier.md). The older source, operator, Fourier and torsor tools are preserved below with their own scopes. They are not an assertion that the general filling inputs have now been proved. ## 1. Quantifiers and the actual diagram Fix k>=2 and an ordered 2k-strand plat diagram with r designated two-strand twist boxes. Every crossing belongs to one of the boxes; all other wires, cups and caps are those of this fixed diagram. For example its braid word can be written beta(p)=sigma_(i_1)^(epsilon_1-2p_1) ... sigma_(i_r)^(epsilon_r-2p_r), epsilon_s in {0,+1,-1}, p_s in Z. The index word, box ordering, endpoint marking and epsilon are fixed. Adjacent powers of the same generator are combined before treating their twist parameters as independent. The fixed upper and lower pairings together with the permutation of the epsilon word must give one component. This is a finite permutation/matching test: adding a full twist does not change it. Thus every p gives a knot with a k-bridge presentation, so b(K_D(p))<=k; equality is not asserted. Drill one actual crossing circle around each box, remove the full twists, and retain its specified half twist. Denote the resulting marked augmented exterior by Y_D. Require Y_D to be hyperbolic, with the actual primitive crossing-disk markings retained. This is a geometric hypothesis on the supplied diagram, not an assertion that every presentation of a hyperbolic knot has hyperbolic augmentation. **General long-twist conjecture.** For every such fixed diagram D there is T(D)<infinity such that, for every fixed integer vector p with all |p_s|>T(D), lim_(N->infinity) (2pi/N) log|K_N(K_D(p))| =Vol(S^3 minus K_D(p)). (1) Here N is the quantum level. Twist numbers are fixed BEFORE this limit. The conjecture includes both level parities and composite levels, arbitrary signed twist vectors, and no comparability condition on their magnitudes. It asks for the volume of the FILLED knot, not the complete drilled volume or a limit in which p grows with N. For a partial filling the analogous statement is about the remaining link exterior with its original single marked normalization. The quantifier is every fixed k and every admissible fixed skeleton; there is no proposed universal threshold depending on k alone. We use T(D) for the required twist length so that it cannot be confused with the quantum level N. A twist region here is a designated two-strand box with its essential crossing disk, not an arbitrary tangle with a large crossing count. Under an actual positive marked gluing certificate, the [geometric long-filling corollary](general_augmented_plat_long_filling_quantifiers.md) now proves a threshold T_geom(D) for complete hyperbolic geometry of every independently long signed filling. Existence of the quantum threshold T(D) in (1) is the remaining conjectural assertion for a general skeleton. These two thresholds must not be conflated. A [finite sufficient geometric criterion](general_simple_white_plat_class.md) is now available: the ACTUAL white cellulation of the flat plat is a simple triangulated sphere. The existing angle optimization and labeled cut construction then supply its complete right-angled geometry, with all prescribed half-twist patterns and primitive markings. This class has explicit examples at every fixed supplied width. It is a sufficient class for the geometric and endpoint results. Assertion (1) is now proved in its complete-radius balanced subclass; without that additional test it remains open. ## 2. Why twist length needs a diagram hypothesis Raw box counts do not measure geometric twisting. For the actual crossing operator, including its Cartan factor, R^(2p) R^(-2p+2c)=R^(2c). (2) Both displayed blocks can have arbitrarily many crossings while the diagram remains the fixed bounded-twist diagram on the right. The identity holds inside ANY 2k-strand source and before its marked cap. It is an exact algebraic cancellation, not an asymptotic example. Likewise a nugatory twist can change a presentation without adding an essential drilled cusp. Thus independent long parameters must refer to actual essential crossing disks. Certifying Y_D directly is a uniform way to impose this requirement without restricting k or assuming that a visually complicated plat is geometrically essential. ## 3. The exact reduction already works for every fixed k The all-input circle identity gives the original full-twist expansion on each pair of strands. Let A_(D,N)(h_1,...,h_r) be the actual augmented source with circle color j_s=N-h_s, including all its specified half twists, cups, caps, pivots and the exposed first cut. Then the [general source transfer](general_original_source_long_filling_transfer.md) has the exact identity K_N(K_D(p))=chi_N kappa^(-2 sum_s p_s) sum_(j_1,...,j_r=1)^N product_s beta_(j_s-1)^(-p_s) A_(D,N)(N-j). (3) The source A is defined before the displayed recorded outer factor chi_N; it is not normalized using the unknown answer. All repeated Casimir-root normals are part of beta. Multilinearity applies each substitution in its original operator order. Physical crossings at different boxes need not commute. Only the independent color-register functionals commute. Consequently the long-twist problem does not require a new surgery formula for each bridge number. The same exact filling map is already available. What is missing generally is control of its input A_D. There is also a direct polynomial form, supplied by the homogeneous source theorem. For N>=3 put d=N-1 and let f_(e,N,p)(Omega) be the ACTUAL root Casimir polynomial for the whole operator R^(epsilon_e-2p_e) in the original box, including its repeated-node Hermite data. If Z_(D,p,N) denotes the original marked contraction before its recorded exterior framing factor, then exactly Z_(D,p,N)=[prod_(ordinary faces f) L_f^d] prod_e H_(f_(e,N,p)) |_(L_u=L_v=0). (3a) Every local polynomial has degree d; the number of shared face variables depends only on the fixed skeleton. Thus (3a) is an exact polynomial form of the full source at arbitrary fixed k, including negative twists. The known exterior normalization is retained when passing from Z to K_N. This gives a second route for studying long twists directly at each box. No sharp long-power estimate for these kernels is being assumed: their coefficients are complex, and larger p does not by itself make their shared-face contraction positive. Nor is (3a) being called the eliminated knot A-polynomial. These whole-box kernels also compose without introducing an external circle color. For two Casimir polynomials f,g, exactly H_(fg)(x,b,c,y)=[z^d] H_f(x,b,z,y) H_g(x,z,c,y). (3b) Indeed the input index j of the left kernel contributes z^(d-j), while the output index j' of the right kernel contributes z^j'. Extraction forces j'=j and gives the original matrix composition. Thus arbitrary positive or negative twist powers admit a layered coefficient formula using only the literal R or R^-1 kernels, with all their scalar phases retained. This is an alternative finite presentation of the same source, not a new asymptotic estimate. The [direct-power theorem](actual_direct_long_power_source.md) retains the original phases and proves a limitation of the absolute-value spectral bound. The [crossing Casimir theorem](actual_crossing_casimir_torus.md) now solves the local classical transport uniformly in the twist power: on the generic spectral cover it is multiplication by lambda^n on a punctured norm torus, with a separate additive parabolic fiber. Its canonical Hamiltonian agrees with the exact full-Hermite quantum Gaussian. These facts hold independently of bridge width; they do not supply the remaining global coefficient estimate or an eliminated knot A-polynomial. The [physical meridian transport](actual_crossing_torus_meridian_transport.md) now gives a further width-independent algebraic result. Differentiating the original physical kernel, including its half powers and the outer head derivative, fixes the physical momentum as the reciprocal of the coefficient momentum. The resulting matrices obey the full signed Hurwitz relations, not merely conservation of their Casimir trace. After the literal cup/cap/marked constraints are imposed, every FULL regular critical point of the layered source defines a representation of the actual filled diagram group. This is a forward morphism on its specified regular open scheme; it is not a classification of critical points after setting protected faces to zero, nor a proof that the original coefficient cycle selects the geometric representation. The [full spectral total derivative](actual_spectral_total_derivative_source.md) and [Gaussian resolvent numerator](actual_gaussian_resolvent_numerator_and_cap.md) retain both semisimple and nilpotent data of every original pair Casimir. The numerator is an exact coherent transform of ALL physical colors; its positive path expansion can be sewn with the same shared face targets. The closing cap near spectral +2 is controlled at fixed twist power. The fixed complex shared numerator and entire CROSS spectral period are now proved. Complete-radius balance also controls the full one-sided remainder. Without that condition, its macroscopic sectors remain to be estimated. Long twisting alone does not damp both sides of a spectral contour. The [full positive endpoint theorem](general_fejer_endpoint_source_volume.md) now proves W_D=Vol(Y_D)/(2pi) for the original even numerator under the labeled right-angled certificate, at every fixed plat width. Its full local support gives one unrestricted incidence-flow polytope; the older single-level support test remains useful only for fixed branch patterns. The [odd regularization](actual_fejer_odd_regularized_full_numerator.md) has the same rate and supplies explicit bounds for fixed spectral jets. The [unique-maximizer theorem](actual_fejer_unique_geometric_maximizer.md) identifies the only endpoint maximum with the original marked complete geometry and gives a strict gap for its complement, including the entire one-sided remainder. These are positive-source and spectral statements. The localized spectral Gaussian unit-charge contribution is now proved. The entire CROSS period and balanced full remainder are now controlled as well; unrestricted geometric coverage remains the gap. ## 4. Remaining inputs and preserved alternative routes For the current direct fixed-root route, the full local numerator packet, its contributing ordinary-face saddle and the marked filled critical value are proved by the results linked at the start. The whole-CROSS period and full balanced-class limit are also proved. The remaining input is broad coverage of balance or a more general full remainder estimate. The mixed-color requirements in this section concern the older alternative route and must not be added as prerequisites to the direct one. **Full mixed-color quantum source.** The complete-image term already has its exact holomorphic packet and a uniform complex asymptotic. The original mixed source agrees with it exponentially accurately on the physical integer corridor for all untwisted varied ports, and for joint signed/unsigned ports satisfying the finite certificates below. What remains generally is to establish those certificates (or stronger phase-preserving estimates), and to bound the combined original source on the ENTIRE physical color complement. This must include opposite-end aliases, their exact cancellations, and the normal currents used by the filling transform. The marked multiport Chebyshev/Parseval packet is exact at every fixed k, but its physical source-to-coefficient energy is still the quantity to estimate. For clarity, the new near-complete sufficient condition is finite and independent of the quantum level. For every nonempty reflected subset S of the varied ports, choose ONE shared positive weight per original face such that C_S(l)=sum_(e notin S) [F(x_e,b_e,y_e)+F(x_e,c_e,y_e)] +sum_(e in S,epsilon_e!=0) G(b_e,x_e,y_e,c_e) +sum_(e in S,epsilon_e=0) log max(b_e,c_e) -sum_(ordinary faces f) log l_f < Vol(Y_D)/(2pi). Here F is the complete triangle potential and G the exact crossing coefficient-magnitude potential defined in the [homogeneous source theorem](actual_homogeneous_casimir_face_source.md). Different subsets may use different weights. The finite strict margins give one fixed color corridor for ALL subsets, including disconnected ones, at arbitrary fixed bridge width. Establishing these inequalities for a structural class of diagrams is a general theorem problem; it does not require a separate quantum asymptotic for each knot. Their validity alone still does not control the far-color complement. **Actual geometry.** Supply the marked complete augmented exterior and its absolute volume anchor. A positive ideal gluing certificate on a triangulation of the actual exterior is one sufficient route. Another starts from its actual disk/projection cut: the cubic graph of shaded triangles and its distinguished crossing-circle matching describe the whole polyhedron, and a positive right-angled realization supplies the complete metric. A triangulation of an unrelated manifold or a numerically matching volume does not identify this labeled topology. The [general marked gluing certificate](general_marked_positive_gluing_certificate.md) proves the geometric implication directly. It also proves the Casson--Rivin equivalence with an interior critical point of the actual angle-volume function, whose unique maximum is Vol(Y_D). Positive phases and positive multiplier variables give a finite algebraic certificate; the selected optimum has algebraic shapes. None of these geometric facts implies the quantum packet estimate. **Same selected action.** Prove that the critical source action is the calibrated primitive on the ACTUAL peripheral branch, retaining the selected square roots and logarithms. The required equations are G=2pi i phi, U_s=-2pi i x_s, V_s=-2 partial_s phi, Im G(0)=Vol(Y_D). (4) The filled source saddle then gives the primitive equation U_s+p_s V_s=-2pi i. The existing geometric completion theorem constructs the actual smooth filled metric and identifies its volume with the boundary-corrected source action. It is this last equality, not an unnamed source volume, that yields the right side of (1). The already proved long-filling transfer is independent of k once these inputs are available. It must not be cited as having supplied them for an arbitrary plat. The new [critical-scheme equivalence](actual_augmented_plat_critical_scheme.md) and [marked multi-cusp rigidity](general_marked_multicusp_gluing_rigidity.md) now supply a nearby geometric stationary branch under an actual positive gluing certificate. The only magnetic Hessian null directions are the two framing directions; a transverse slice removes them. The branch has the actual peripheral differential and absolute volume anchor. The quantum statement still requires that the original finite source select and contribute to this branch. The new [actual local character map](actual_augmented_plat_local_critical_character_map.md) proves the primitive differential on any correctly marked stationary branch. The [absolute endpoint regulator theorem](actual_augmented_plat_endpoint_regulator.md) proves the complete-volume anchor at a regular correctly marked geometric critical point. A [generic framing theorem](actual_augmented_plat_regular_geometric_phase_chart.md) supplies a regular unfolded geometric candidate, but does not select its physical logarithmic sheet or a contributing quantum cycle. Thus the identities in (4) have a general classical proof with these hypotheses. Under the stronger labeled right-angled certificate the complete-image source realization is now proved; its extension to the full mixed source outside the proved corridors remains part of the quantum problem. The [actual channel Hessian](actual_augmented_plat_channel_hessian.md) also has a general primitive normalization: H_(xi_i,xi_j) is -delta_ij 4pi i/tau_i, and the channel/magnetic mixed block vanishes. Its negative real part gives a local channel elimination at the geometric endpoint, while holding the magnetic variables as parameters. It supplies no nonzero cycle coefficient or magnetic asymptotic. ## 5. Preserved operator and Fourier routes The [complete source compiler](actual_augmented_plat_phase_compiler.md) and [all-color compiler](actual_mixed_augmented_plat_compiler.md) give explicit finite factorial sums, phases and generic confluence normals for every fixed plat. Their inverse measures retain their exponential profiles. No unknown local recoupling inverse remains. The [entire core function](actual_augmented_plat_entire_core_color_packet.md) also supplies an exact separately-even finite Fourier interpolation, including the odd endpoint. It does not supply a uniform complex asymptotic. If the required nonzero analytic corridor packet exists, its periodicity mirrors the same rate near the opposite cube face. The actual physical alias split therefore matters for the global gap. For each actual local q-Hahn column, the [negative-root theorem](actual_q_hahn_negative_root_source_polynomial.md) now proves a canonical slit-plane logarithm, and the [complex-action theorem](actual_q_hahn_selected_complex_action.md) proves its actual leading action on the physical Fourier arc. The [uniform amplitude theorem](actual_q_hahn_uniform_complex_amplitude.md) adds a nonzero prefactor with relative error O(1/N). The [magnetic corridor theorem](actual_q_hahn_magnetic_complex_corridor.md) continues the actual finite kernel in one magnetic variable while the pair degree and channel stay real and discrete. The subsequent [joint determinant](actual_q_hahn_joint_accretive_determinant.md) and [joint amplitude theorem](actual_q_hahn_joint_complex_amplitude.md) now continue pair degree and magnetic coordinate together on a fixed central domain, including folded channels, with an explicit selected local sheet. The channel remains an integer. The [common-framing criterion](actual_augmented_plat_physical_framing_criterion.md) states finite strict inequalities for simultaneous use on a plat; the [right-angled obstruction](actual_right_angled_selected_framing_obstruction.md) now proves that an all-central selected frame cannot exist for the actual certified right-angled cut. Generic geometric strip flags localize the weaker strict physical-support failures to exactly TWO factors, for arbitrary bridge width. Those facets can be prescribed, including the pair adjacent to the original marked physical edge. The [full physical packet](actual_q_hahn_full_physical_complex_packet.md) and [selected-factor corollary](actual_augmented_plat_selected_factor_localization.md) now put EVERY other ordinary factor in its actual selected physical packet, with no central-support hypothesis. The two exceptions can instead be placed together at one crossing-circle matching edge. The [selected local certificate](actual_augmented_plat_selected_local_certificate.md) remains a conditional local theorem; it does not establish a whole-source cycle or sum estimate. The [small-channel generic-normal estimate](actual_q_hahn_small_channel_generic_normals.md) and [exact partner collision](actual_q_hahn_partner_normal_collision.md) retain the original derivatives. The latter exposes additional individual normal poles, so a full-domain paired-normal estimate cannot be assumed. The [physical paired-normal theorem](actual_q_hahn_physical_partner_normal_bound.md) does prove polynomial relative cost on the whole complete physical grid, retaining the actual large partner and both parities. The [complex near-fold theorem](actual_q_hahn_near_fold_complex_partner_bound.md) now supplies subexponential relative cost on a fixed complex compact when (l-j) log N=o(N). A fixed nonzero scaled channel shift and a whole-source asymptotic remain open. Every fixed generic q jet of all physical columns and completed divided pairs is also controlled by the [physical generic-jet theorem](actual_q_hahn_physical_generic_jet_bound.md). Its forward/backward proof does not supply a completed boundary tensor norm. The full physical packet extends the complex near-fold bound to all fixed physical compacts, still with a shrinking scaled channel window. These local results are not a whole-source asymptotic. Outside the specified marked domain the endpoint quadratic has monodromy, so an unspecified analytic continuation alone cannot identify the selected geometric root. A controlled simultaneous continuation and a global cycle estimate remain necessary. Choosing the exceptional pair at a crossing-circle matching edge also gives the [exact marked four-port rewrite](actual_matching_edge_marked_four_port_block.md) of the COMPLETE-circle source. Its original row measure cancels the exponential factorial gauge, and the [positive scalar theorem](actual_matching_edge_racah_positive_scalar.md) controls every recoupling target and fixed generic jet. The [completed-projector formula](actual_matching_edge_completed_projector_block.md) also cancels the target scalar gauge and combines the collision pairs before taking the first normal, retaining their nilpotent part. The remaining native projector/complement costs are explicit but not yet sharply bounded by the geometric action. This is not the general mixed-color packet required for fixed long fillings. The [native-projector energy theorem](actual_matching_edge_native_projector_energy.md) now bounds every fixed generic operator derivative by a polynomial times its explicit magnetic energy, uniformly at both parities and all physical degrees. A simple midpoint channel proves that energy can itself be exponential. The remaining joint variational estimate must keep the actual shared wire variables and these energy terms; independent local maxima do not supply it. The [full folded boundary rate](actual_matching_edge_magnetic_energy_profile.md) is now computed by exact Plancherel and the actual selected endpoint polynomial. It remains valid in [all shrinking real fold windows](actual_matching_edge_shrinking_fold_native_energy.md). For arbitrary fixed skeletons, the [shared-cycle compiler](actual_matching_graph_shared_cycle_fourier_compiler.md) gives an exact bounded-flow source with coupled Fourier congruences and the original one-unit mark. Its [positive coefficients](actual_q_hahn_fourier_coefficient_variational.md) have a uniform interior variational rate. These source reductions retain every shared label and phase. They do not supply the general mixed-color packet, sharp joint geometric estimate or lower bound needed for the fixed-long-filling theorem. The [explicit positive partition](actual_matching_graph_positive_fourier_partition.md) now gives a polynomial-loss Cauchy upper bound retaining every shared flow and Fourier charge. Its sharp rate is not yet the hyperbolic volume: the [conditional radial-frame obstruction](actual_positive_fourier_radial_geometric_obstruction.md) prevents one proposed all-ordinary geometric reconstruction, without proving a numerical gap. The exact coherent source and the retained exceptional matching block remain the objects to estimate. The [full graph identity](general_matching_graph_full_normal_source.md) puts all folded labels and normals on the actual matching graph. The [reflection-double identity](actual_planar_three_port_reflection_double.md) removes the final gluing cancellation for specified three-port doubles, retaining the full source. Neither identity already bounds the internally coherent half-packets for arbitrary graphs. The [matching-graph geometry](general_augmented_plat_matching_geometry.md) constructs the actual complete complement and primitive markings from a labeled positive right-angled certificate. It also constructs a positive ideal triangulation. The [geometric endpoint theorem](actual_augmented_plat_geometric_channel_endpoint.md) locates the complete disk character at c=-2, the folded-channel endpoint, and retains its marked peripheral square root. This is necessary geometric information, not a proof of quantum selection. The [endpoint phase calculation](actual_central_endpoint_magnetic_phase_obstruction.md) also shows that a universal separate-leg positive normalization already fails at N=3. It leaves coherent resummation available. The [source-divisor extension](general_long_filling_source_divisor.md) allows a nonzero analytic source-density germ to vanish at the complete point. With the other packet, gap and geometric hypotheses proved, it yields the filling equality away from an analytic exceptional divisor, including density one of long slopes in each signed box. A peripheral monomial times a unit gives EVERY independently long signed slope. The general nonzero-germ version does not by itself prove the all-slopes conjecture (1). These results remove finite-source and geometric ambiguities. The principal remaining theorem is still a coherent asymptotic with the required global gap and the actual selected geometric period. The [arbitrary-width Conway extension](actual_conway_arbitrary_width_seeds.md) is retained as an application and a calibration of these interfaces. It does not settle (1) for all k-bridge diagrams. The full cube source, which lies beyond that grammar, remains one useful branching test, not the definition of the general target. ## 6. Literature coverage only Purcell's [highly twisted volume paper](https://research.monash.edu/en/publications/volumes-of-highly-twisted-knots-and-links/) states hyperbolicity and geometric volume bounds under diagrammatic hypotheses; those are not an original Kashaev volume-limit theorem. Van der Veen's [augmented KTG paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/0805.0094) states a volume conjecture result for its augmented knotted trivalent graphs and a containing-link corollary. Its abstract does not assert (1) for all independently long fillings of arbitrary fixed plats. These are coverage observations, not imported proofs or an exhaustive novelty claim. The definitions and source normalizations must still be compared before identifying any covered family. A further primary-statement coverage check on 31 October 2026 distinguishes three nearby claims. [Giambrone](https://arxiv.org/abs/1310.8414v3) states coarse volume bounds for certain plat closures via stable Jones coefficients. [Lee](https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.09903v2) takes the twist parameters to infinity to obtain a limiting skein element before studying its root-of-unity growth. [Shen](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.11839v3) states long fixed signed filling results for SO(3) Turaev-Viro and WRT invariants of fundamental shadow-link fillings along odd levels. These abstract statements have different invariants or quantifiers from the full Kashaev knot limit here. This checks stated coverage only: no proof correctness, equivalence of invariants, or exhaustive novelty conclusion is inferred, and no proof technique from these papers is used above.

title: The actual augmented plat as a cubic graph with a marked perfect matching
text: # The actual augmented plat as a cubic graph with a marked perfect matching 30 October 2026. This gives a geometry/topology interface for an arbitrary fixed 2k-plat, k>=2, rather than only a two-port Conway tree. Its input is the ACTUAL diagram, its designated crossing boxes and their retained half twists. The reversible cut produces a plane cubic graph Delta with a specified perfect matching D. A positive labeled right-angled ideal rectification certificate for Delta then gives the actual complete augmented complement, with volume 2 Vol(Q_Delta). The certificate is an explicit geometric hypothesis. This note does not prove its existence for every reduced plat, the growing-color source limit for that plat, or a generic auxiliary deformation from an unmarked polyhedron. It does identify the correct graph and exactly why the existing trivalent NC source theorem is only a subclass. Here k is the supplied plat width; no claim that this presentation realizes the knot's minimal bridge number is required. ## 1. Start with a literal diagram and its crossing disks Fix a 2k-plat word together with a disjoint collection of two-strand crossing boxes covering ALL crossings. The outside strands, original caps and cups have no remaining crossing. One may first take maximal twist regions, but the chosen boxes and their order are recorded data. Put a crossing circle around each box and retain its original twice- punctured spanning disk. Remove full twists, retaining epsilon_i in {0,+1,-1} as its half-twist sign. Full twist integers remain recorded in the peripheral collar marking when they are to be restored. For the cut first remove these half twists as well; their effects are restored by the explicit shaded pairings in section 4. The resulting flat diagram has main arcs in the projection sphere and perpendicular crossing circles. Let r be the number of crossing disks. Assume every main component meets at least one of them, so that the pieces outside the punctures are exactly 2r intervals pairing 4r labeled terminals. For a nontrivial knot with all its crossings in the designated boxes this requirement is automatic. An extra circle with no disk incidence must not be silently discarded. At disk i choose the four CYCLIC local labels C_i0,...,C_i3 so that its untwisted strands restore the pairs 0--1 and 2--3. This is a local crossing-disk chart; it is not an unrecorded permutation of the global plat endpoints. Its upper half disk has the two sides S_i0=(O_i,C_i1,C_i2), S_i1=(O_i,C_i3,C_i0). (1) The diagram's actual outside intervals, including all plat cups and caps, give a perfect matching of the C terminals. Two matched ends are the two ends of ONE actual main segment. The embedding and cyclic orders are retained, not just its abstract endpoint permutation. ## 2. Construct Delta and its marked matching without a geometry guess Give Delta one vertex v_i0 and v_i1 for each pair (1). Add the edge d_i=v_i0 v_i1 and mark it as a crossing-disk edge. For each actual outside main segment join the two vertices whose shaded triangles contain its two terminal labels. The incident edge order at each vertex is exactly the cyclic order in its triangle (1). Each vertex has one disk edge and two main-segment edges. Hence Delta is a plane CUBIC ribbon graph, and D={d_i} is a specified perfect matching, |V(Delta)|=2r, |E(Delta)|=3r. (2) The embedding follows by contracting the small shaded sectors to their centers and following the actual planar identity strips. This operation does not move an endpoint through another endpoint. Loops, parallel edges or repeated facial walks are recorded if the supplied diagram produces them. They are not repaired by an arbitrary graph isomorphism or by changing the knot diagram. The original bowtie boundary graph is the MEDIAL graph of Delta: * An ideal vertex x_e corresponds to an edge e of Delta. For e=d_i it is O_i, the crossing-circle semicircle. Otherwise it is the actual main segment represented by e. * The three edges incident to v give the shaded triangle T_v. * The other facial walks are the original white projection regions; their edge labels are the face walks of Delta. This identification follows at a main segment by concatenating its two oriented shaded sectors, and at O_i by its two half-disk sectors. These local rotations determine EVERY medial face cycle.
