The subsequent [four cyclic-atom proof](four_cyclic_atoms.md) now constructs a finite root counterpart for the genuine semicyclic crossing: each atom is the literature alternate cyclic dilogarithm, acting between explicitly transported centers. Two independent Fermat norm roots and their inverses restore the external clocks. Their determinant normalization, an external root and the actual source anchor fix the whole crossing scalar. This is not a termwise evaluation of (3.3); the finite cyclic atoms include the required center transport and boundary frame. Recombination has exactly the original regular crossing and full cut period. The subsequent [root tetrahedral pentagon](cyclic_tetrahedron_pentagon.md) constructs the corresponding finite cyclic move with monomial shears and changing centers. Compatible roots give the same final clock/shift frame on both paths; a determinant and formal zero-tag anchor fix the scalar to one on the stated lifted component. This supplies an exact root move for specified exterior contractions, rather than a separate specialization of the compact infinite factors. The global geometric tensor presentation and selected regulator norm are still missing. ## 7. Role in the regulator comparison There are now actual four-factor crossing data, an algebraic tetrahedral pentagon and a pointed root-period transport theorem for finite formal operator rewrites. The cyclic norm character and its relative lattice are explicit. These are local algebraic inputs for a triangulation presentation of the source period. The positive geometric triangulation supplies the marked classical Bloch fundamental class, as already audited. To apply Section 5 to it requires a compatible colored/polarized tensor presentation and a move transport of the cut and its relative gluing data. Existence of positive tetrahedra alone does not supply that presentation or a global branching. Nor does the operator move identity show that a chosen hyperbolic character contribution is the selected quantum period or has its regulator norm. The original distinction between root-central and semiclassical shape coordinates remains in force. In particular (5.1) preserves the actual state and its source; it does not equate its abelian interior root character with the different fixed hyperbolic character separated in the [threading note](ado_threaded_shadow.md). The needed comparison remains a relative marked-period theorem. Its norm statement and the volume conjecture are not proved here. The subsequent [pointed tetrahedron gluing construction](pointed_tetrahedron_gluing.md) does resolve local order coherence and nonvanishing at the root module level. Integral edge primitivity gives a nonzero saturated rank-N boundary block for S^3 knots at all N. It also specifies the projected tetrahedron generator, without proving that vector nonzero or identifying it with the selected relative Verma trace. The full tensor-face presentation and marked regulator norm are still additional comparisons. ## 8. Coverage and exact diagnostics [Kashaev, q-alg/9503005](https://arxiv.org/abs/q-alg/9503005) already covers a canonical Heisenberg-double pentagon and reconstruction of Yang--Baxter solutions. The abstract of [Suzuki, 1612.08262](https://arxiv.org/abs/1612.08262) covers a Heisenberg-double construction on colored ideal triangulations and colored moves. These are coverage of the framework, not proof premises or an unrestricted geometric-triangulation comparison. The earlier consulted [four-dilogarithm holonomy-R coverage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.02354) also prevents a novelty claim for the general factorization idea. The formulas and polynomial-specialization proof above are reconstructed directly in the fixed actual Verma conventions. [The audit](../experiments/audit_verma_tetrahedral_transport.py) checks the compact pentagon symbolically, the tagged tetrahedral operator on Laurent monomials, forbidden-transfer cancellations in the four-factor product, root-specialized compressed entries and their actual ADO restrictions, the full meromorphic frame, and the period through the grading using independent finite ADO and classical Burau data. See [the results](../experiments/verma_tetrahedral_transport_results.json). These diagnostics verify the stated constructions and not the remaining global geometric or regulator-norm theorem. The saved checks include 28 symbolic compact-pentagon coefficients, 81 Laurent inputs and 1,215 coefficients for the tagged tetrahedral operator, 49 symbolic four-factor compressions with 21 forbidden transfers canceled, 3,360 compressed root entries, nine full pole lattice levels through 12, and 210 graded coefficients in 30 transported trace cases. Even and composite levels and the exact Kashaev boundary are included.

title: Exact Ward cancellation of cyclic wall currents, with the marked charge retained
text: # Exact Ward cancellation of cyclic wall currents, with the marked charge retained 28 October 2026. The original all-plat Ward corner has an explicit co-source homotopy. Under cyclic completion it produces a rank-two commutator wall current. That current is canceled exactly by the corresponding sewing defect, before asymptotics or closure. For an assembled word the typed defects telescope. This gives a finite relative-cycle comparison for the Ward reduction; it does not identify nonlinear positive-angle boundary prisms with those currents. The surviving marked wall has charge one. It is not permitted to delete the only source carrier. ## 1. An explicit original co-source homotopy Use the literal arbitrary-plat conventions in [the Rogers transport theorem](actual_rogers_bridge_transport.md). Put d=N-1. After the k-1 ordinary caps the remaining dual pair has total integer degree d. On that fiber let p=|d,0>, ell=<d,0|, mu(a)=x^(d-a)(-1)^a Q^(-a(a+1)/2) F_a^2/N^2. The first color x here is the remaining pair's actual color. In particular mu(d)=1. Let F_rel=S_a be the ACTUAL total lowering operator in fusion coordinates. It sends the degree-d fiber to degree d+1. Define a row on the latter fiber by nu(a+1,d-a)=mu(a), 0<=a<d. Then, on the entire degree-d fiber, exactly mu-ell=nu F_rel. (1) This is an actual co-source homotopy, not just vanishing on a single vector. Since the full original remaining vector v satisfies F_rel v=0, equation (1) proves mu v=ell v. It is the explicit current behind the Ward corner. All meridian powers in mu and nu remain functions. For a general nonintertwining coupon or a separated cyclic sector, F_rel v need not vanish. Its omitted term is precisely nu F_rel v. ## 2. Cyclic completion has a rank-two Ward defect Consider the positive actual Euler transfer T=a J_+ tensor J_-, A=a S tensor S^-1, with the literal truncated shifts J and cyclic S. The two residue fibers relevant to F_rel are k=d and k=0. In either cyclic basis the operator A is aS. Between them F_rel is the strict raising shift J_+. Consequently its typed cyclic defect is Delta=F_rel A_in-A_out F_rel =a (|1><d|-|0><d-1|). (2) For N=2 this is the same two distinct matrix units; no generic rank assertion or separated-wall assumption is required. The ACTUAL transfer has no such defect: F_rel T_in=T_out F_rel, because J_+ on the first head commutes with J_+ tensor J_-. Writing R_A=(t-A)^(-1), R_T=(t-T)^(-1), and E=R_T-R_A, the resolvent identity gives the exact rational equations F_rel R_A,in-R_A,out F_rel=R_A,out Delta R_A,in, F_rel E_in-E_out F_rel=-R_A,out Delta R_A,in. (3) Thus the cyclic Ward defect and its sewing Ward defect cancel POINTWISE. This is more than equality after a particular trace. The full central polynomial t^N-a^N and its poles remain in (3). On a cut meeting such poles one must use the matched residue and finite-part prescription already proved in [the sewing cycle theorem](cyclic_sewing_regularized_cut_cycle.md). Equation (3) does not authorize retaining only the old branch cuts. Every common Cartan line multiplies the same two equations. The negative crossing and other residue fibers have the same typed identity with their literal operators; no replacement inverse or scalar normalization is used. ## 3. The full original marker detects the Ward current For one actual dual cup, input colors are (x,y), y=x^(-1)Q^(-1), and the checked positive core is D u_N(aJ_+ tensor J_-) with a=x^(-1). The output marked row is mu_y. The Gaussian D depends only on the second head, so it commutes with F_rel as a typed map. Since T p=0, the original marked resolvent is exactly mu_y D R_T,in(t) p=1/t. (4) Thus every holomorphic functional-calculus germ f gives the original value f(0). In particular the actual Euler germ has f(0)=1. Together with the original Cartan/framing line this is the original one-bridge normalization, not a newly assigned scalar. Set g_mu=mu_y D R_A,in p and g_ell=ell R_A,in p. Equation (1) and the first equation of (3), with F_rel p=0, give g_mu-g_ell=nu D_out R_A,out Delta R_A,in p. (5) This is the exact missing current when somebody applies the Ward corner separately to a cyclic sector. The right-hand side can be nonzero and has source-visible cyclic poles. The corner cyclic term is especially simple: g_ell=t^(N-1)/(t^N-a^N). Its marked relative wall is 1/t-g_ell=-a^N/[t(t^N-a^N)]. (6) Its residue at zero is one, its residues at the N cyclic poles are -1/N each, and it has zero residue at infinity. Hence even after full zero-current Ward reduction a nonzero augmented wall survives. A source-free cyclic resolvent is holomorphic at zero and has zero original small-circle period. It cannot be the replacement for (4) with the wall removed. ## 4. Exact residue contraction with polynomial cost Let beta_j=aQ^j. In the input fiber write S for its cyclic shift, and put c_r=mu_y D S^r p, 0<=r<N, c_0=1. The original cyclic residues are exactly w_j=Res_(beta_j) g_mu(t)dt =(1/N)sum_(r=0)^(N-1)c_r Q^(-jr), sum_j w_j=1. (7) The corner residues are 1/N. Their difference is an explicit cyclic boundary. With (S_res J)_j=J_(j+1), put J_j=(1/N)sum_(r=1)^(N-1) c_r Q^(-jr)/(Q^(-r)-1). Then (S_res-1)J=w-(1/N)1. (8) The zero-average inverse H of S_res-1 satisfies the genuine chain contraction Delta_res H=H Delta_res=I-Pi_0, ||H||_(ell2)<=1/[2sin(pi/N)]<=N/4, ||H||_(ell-infinity)<=N. (9) These are the flat norms on the ACTUAL scalar cyclic-residue coordinates j=0,...,N-1. They are not norms asserted invariant under an exponentially conditioned fusion frame. The first bound is the unitary Fourier spectral calculation. For the second, a zero-sum input g has a cumulative primitive P_j=sum_(h<j)g_h. Both j and N-j bound its absolute size, so |P_j|<=N||g||_infinity/2. Subtract its mean to impose zero average. This proves the stated N bound. No inverse is applied to the constant character; Pi_0 retains its marked augmentation. Equations (5)--(9) are an actual Ward/cyclic residue comparison. With a nonconstant analytic test function f, summation by parts retains the dual difference of f, and its cut/pole terms. Thus (8) does not permit deleting these currents before their full relative pairing. For f=1 all nonconstant residues cancel exactly. ## 5. Large individual residues occur in this original unit source At the canonical unit root and any unit meridian, for 1<=r<N, |c_r|=|F_(r-1)|^2/N^2. (10) Indeed S^r p has first index r-1 and second index N-r; the Gaussian has modulus one, and the actual marked row is mu_y(n)=y^(d-n)|F_n|^2/N^2. This also proves uniformity over all unit meridians, not only one complete numerical value. Finite Fourier inversion gives the two-sided inequalities (max_r |c_r|)/N <= max_j |w_j| <= max_r |c_r|. The already independently proved figure-eight factorial estimate therefore yields lim_N (1/N)log max_j|w_j|=Vol(4_1)/(2pi)>0, (11) whereas sum_j w_j is EXACTLY one. This is an original-source cancellation example satisfying all the actual zero-current Ward equations. It is neither an arbitrary normalization counterexample nor a claim that this unknot has positive volume. The polynomial homotopy bound (9) is entirely compatible with (11): it controls the cost relative to the original coefficient norm; it does not replace exponential input coefficients by polynomial ones without their exact cancellation. ## 6. Whole-word cancellation and the precise surviving class For arbitrary finite typed factors O_j:V_(j-1)->V_j, retain the actual transported lowering operators F_j and define delta_j=F_j O_j-O_j F_(j-1). Their original ordered product W obeys the exact identity F_L W-W F_0 =sum_j O_L...O_(j+1) delta_j O_(j-1)...O_1. (12) The original cups have F_0 p=0; the original assembled word and ordinary caps intertwine. Therefore the TOTAL co-source change from mu to the Ward corner is zero. In a cyclic/sewn realization (3) supplies the local rational defect cancellation. With its complete matched contours, every cyclic residue and ramified finite-part contribution is carried through (12). This statement is linear in the exact rational forms and does not assume an unmarked deformation of a small circle into branch cuts. It follows that the FULL original fused corner can use the purely cyclic cross-sewing representation with its explicit relative boundary source. This is obtained by applying the Ward co-source homotopy to the assembled original network and then the local exact resolvent expansion, or by retaining all the currents in the opposite order; (3) and (12) equate the procedures. The total sum of marker-reduction Ward currents is removable. The unit augmented class (6) is NOT removable. In particular a sectorwise corner replacement without (5) is not this theorem. All of (1)--(12) are covariant under a literal full tensor/frame change, with F, the source, every sewing map and every current transformed together. An isomorphism of cyclic kernel lines alone does not supply that full change. In particular this note does not identify arbitrary nonlinear positive-quad angular boundary prisms with the currents in (12), nor prove that the retained cusp class couples to a geometric critical point. The complementary [compactified quad transport](cap_wall_fermat_quad_residue_transport.md) constructs an actual divisor-residue image of the cup. That local transition can carry the augmentation; it must still respect the cyclic-pole and source-current data above in a whole positive chart comparison. [Original-matrix and wall-current audit](../experiments/audit_ward_cyclic_wall_contraction.py). The audit passes fourteen original complete/generic dual-cup families, twelve assembled two- and three-slot original Euler words with every cyclic/sewing sector retained, eight chain-contraction norm cases, and six source-scale grids through N=1280. In the assembled words the separate marker changes are nonzero, their commutator-current sum is exactly zero, and the original unit source is retained. The proofs above are uniform; these finite tests independently fix operator order and the two different residue fibers in (3) and (5).

title: Deleting cut roots preserves the pointed relative Ward class
text: # Deleting cut roots preserves the pointed relative Ward class Research proof, 27 October 2026. The original cut covector does not descend after deleting the root `A=1`. A different literal finite cut does descend, and its matrix functional is explicitly cochain homotopic to the original on the actual Ward complex. The equivalence extends to the relative boundary resolution and to a marked whole normal family. It is a boundary/source comparison, not a rule for compressing crossings or a geometric Gaussian source-survival theorem. ## 1. The localized source and its exact normalization Fix `N>=2`, `Q` primitive of order `N`, and the original evaluation color `V=C_N=k[A^+/-1]/(A^N-1)`. In its evaluation basis the source is `psi=(1,...,1)^t`, the co-source is `phi=(1/N)(1,...,1)`, and `e=psi phi`. Let `S` be any nonempty set of retained roots, `m=|S|=N-s>0`, and let `P` be multiplication by its characteristic idempotent. Define psi_S=P psi, phi_S=(N/m)phi P, e_S=psi_S phi_S=(N/m)P e P. (1) One has `phi_S psi_S=1`, `e_S^2=e_S`, and `Tr e_S=1`. The literal new matrix cut is Phi_S(C)=Tr(e_S C)=(1/m)sum_(a,b in S) C_(a,b). (2) The factor `N/(N-s)` is retained exactly, for every `s<N`. The original pivot and marked defect remain available via `Phi(C)=Tr(g D C)`; equation (2) changes the boundary representative, not the original numerical invariant on closed tangles. The entire external full-ADO factor remains unchanged. For deletion only of `A=1`, let `epsilon_1=(1/N)sum_(j<N)A^j` and `P=1-epsilon_1`. The new color co-source is intrinsically phi_S(f)=[N phi(f)-f(1)]/(N-1). (3) It kills the deleted root's entire idempotent summand and factors through `C_N[(A-1)^(-1)]=P C_N`. Thus it removes the previously displayed localization obstruction for this new representative. ## 2. The actual Ward homotopy, on all matrices Use the actual root matrices `K,F` and the split image Ward complex from [the Ward contraction](actual_borel_ward_cut_contraction.md): W_N^0=End(V), W_N^1=im delta_N, delta_N(C)=([K,C],[F,C]), h_N delta_N=I-i_N p_N, delta_N h_N=I, p_N(C)=Tr(C)/N, i_N(c)=c I. Both `Phi` and `Phi_S` take value one on `I`. Consequently Phi_S-Phi=(Phi_S-Phi) h_N delta_N. (4) This is an explicit all-matrices cochain homotopy, with the known finite denominators in `h_N`. Every actual closed cut tangle is Ward closed and equals `F_N(M)I`. Hence Phi_S(C_K)=Phi(C_K)=F_N(M). (5) This holds wherever that original root-color cut operator is defined, as a meromorphic whole germ in `M`; no scalar or peripheral factor is replaced by its value at completeness. The distinction between the two source complexes matters. In the color relative complex `R(C_N)` alone, `phi_S` and `phi` are not homotopic: its top cohomology is `C_N`, and they have different values on `epsilon_1`. Equation (4) uses the **matrix Ward** differential. It must not be presented as a homotopy in the old color relative complex without that additional differential. ## 3. An explicit localized Ward complex and retraction Order the retained labels as `a_1<...<a_m`. Put `V_S=P V` and `K_S=K|_(V_S)`. If several interior roots were deleted, the ordinary compression of `F` can be disconnected. Instead use the specified skip-transport matrix (F_S)_(a_(j+1),a_j)=product_(r=a_j)^(a_(j+1)-1)(1-Q^(r+1)), 1<=j<m. (6) All these coefficients are units. This is the original F transport along the unique retained linear interval between the two labels. For deletion only of label zero it is ordinary compressed `F`. For `m=1` it is zero, as appropriate to a one-dimensional space. The distinct `K_S` eigenvalues and the connected nonzero path (6) give `ker delta_S=k I_S`. The same entrywise and cumulative formulas give its explicit split image Ward complex `W_S` and contraction `h_S`, with normalized row `p_S=Tr/m`. Let `L:V->V_S` be restriction and `J:V_S->V` be inclusion, so `JL=P,LJ=I_S`. Define c_0(C)=L C J, c_1=delta_S c_0 h_N. (7) Then `c_1 delta_N=delta_S c_0`: the only omitted term is `delta_S c_0 i_N p_N=0`. Thus (7) is a genuine chain map, not an assumed rowwise compression of Ward currents. It sends `I_N` to `I_S` and induces the identity on scalar cohomology. A section is equally explicit. Set s_0(T)=J T L+p_S(T)(I_N-P), s_1=delta_N s_0 h_S. (8) It is a chain map, sends `I_S` to `I_N`, and `c s=I` in both degrees. With `H=(I-s_0 c_0)h_N` in degree one, direct multiplication gives H delta_N=I-s_0 c_0, delta_N H=I-s_1 c_1. (9) Therefore deleting any `s<N` roots gives an explicit homotopy retraction of these Ward complexes. The localized cut on `W_S` composed with `c_0` is exactly (2). This construction transports currents as well as the scalar class. It does not turn `V_S` into the original quantum-group module. The skip matrix is a Ward transport operator; no coproduct, crossing intertwining, or Hopf-pivotal property is inferred for it. ## 4. The relative source map is strict after adjoining Ward currents For a coefficient space `E`, the existing relative source resolution is `R(E)=R(k) tensor E`, where R(E)^1=E[t], R(E)^2=E[t] direct_sum E direct_sum E, d_R h=(partial_t h,h(0),h(1)). Its contraction is natural for every linear coefficient map. Apply it degreewise to `W_N` and `W_S` and use the usual total differential `d_R tensor I+(-1)^degR I tensor delta`. Equations (7)--(9) extend to actual relative-Ward chain maps and homotopies. The two cut rows extend to maps into `R(k)`; their homotopy is explicitly r tensor x -> (-1)^deg(r) r tensor [(Phi_S-Phi)h_N](x). Thus the **combined** relative-Ward complex has the same nonzero pointed line after deletion. This is a precise relative source extension of (4), rather than just equality on one knot value. ## 5. The whole normal and its branch mark can be retained Let `R=k[[U-1]]`, and retain the actual finite color normal algebra C_U=R[A]/(A^N-U). Mark the unique root `alpha(U)^N=U`, `alpha(1)=1`. Its evaluation branches are `A=alpha(U)Q^a`. The idempotent epsilon_0(U)=(1/N)sum_(j=0)^(N-1)(A/alpha(U))^j is regular and projects onto the marked branch reducing to `A=1`. Put `P(U)=1-epsilon_0(U)`. The exact whole-normal co-source is phi_S,U(f)=[Tr_(C_U/R)(f)-f(alpha(U))]/(N-1) =Tr_(P(U)C_U/R)(P(U)f)/(N-1). (10) It is regular, normalized on `P(U)`, and retains every normal coefficient. Since `A-1` is a unit on the retained summands, (10) factors through `A-1` localization. The marked deleted branch is removed as a whole; its punctured generic remnant is not used to divide away its normal contribution. For a canonical representative `f_tilde=sum_(j<N)f_j A^j`, equation (10) reads `[N f_0-f_tilde(alpha)]/(N-1)`. Multiplication still has the exact carry A f_tilde-(Af)_tilde=f_(N-1)(A^N-U). The source is linear, and this carry remains necessary. Deletion repairs the excluded-root obstruction; it does not make a trace functional into a ring map or erase the normal `U`. The same marked construction works for any subset of branches. In the split evaluation lattice one can use `K_aa=x alpha^(-1)Q^(-a)` and the interior path entries `F_(a+1,a)=1-alpha Q^(a+1)`. They specialize to the original matrices. Distinct K differences and these interior path entries are units over `R`. A separately specified cyclic wrap can also be retained; it does not enter the interior entries used by the Ward contraction. The retractions above therefore extend over this whole formal boundary normal family, with their normalization `N/(N-s)` unchanged. No Hopf or internal-network extension is inferred from this boundary construction. ## 6. Compression has an exact composition defect For arbitrary matrices `C,D`, one has c_0(CD)-c_0(C)c_0(D)=L C(I-P)D J. (11) The right side records an excursion through the deleted root sector. It is generally nonzero. Thus independently compressing each crossing, turn, or cap does not reproduce compression of the whole actual network. Nor is `c_0` multiplicative or an ordinary quantum-group intertwiner. The current map (7) is the specific repair in the split Ward complex; it supplies no local R-matrix replacement or strict tensor functor. The old statement that the **original** co-source fails to descend is still correct. The new result is that its pointed relative-Ward class has a literal representative supported on the geometric open chart, with an exact normalization and a marked whole-normal extension. A source-compatible internal Gaussian comparison can use this representative and its homotopy. Such a comparison must still transport the excursion currents, carries, and the other retained divisors. Nonzero geometric-source survival and the volume conjecture do not follow just from deleting the root. [Exact audit](../experiments/audit_ward_source_localization.py) and [results](../experiments/ward_source_localization_results.json) check the source homotopy and explicit chain retraction on matrix units, for every nonempty retained subset at seven levels. They also retain a nonzero compression-excursion defect and the marked whole-normal carry. [Independent proof audit](ward_source_localization_independent_audit.md).

title: Independent audit of pointed relative Ward localization
text: # Independent audit of pointed relative Ward localization Audit, 27 October 2026. The proof in [ward_source_localization.md](ward_source_localization.md) is sound as a boundary/source homotopy statement. No crossing, coproduct, Hopf-pivotal, or multiplicative compression is claimed or supplied. No new matrix tests were needed. ## 1. Source normalization and the chain maps For a nonempty retained set of size \(m\), the formulas \(\psi_S=P\psi,\ \phi_S=(N/m)\phi P\) give \(\phi_S\psi_S=1\). Hence \(e_S\) is rank one, idempotent, and has trace one. The new row and the original row both take value one on \(I_N\). Therefore their difference equals that difference composed with \(h_N\delta_N\), exactly as claimed. This requires the matrix Ward differential; it does not descend to a homotopy in the color relative complex alone. The compressed \(K\) eigenvalues are distinct. Every skip coefficient is a product of \(1-Q^r\) with \(1\le r<N\); it is nonzero. Thus the retained path is connected and the split image Ward complex has kernel precisely \(kI_S\). For \[ c_1=\delta_Sc_0h_N,\qquad s_1=\delta_Ns_0h_S, \] the identities \(c_0i_N=i_S,\ s_0i_S=i_N,\ c_0s_0=I\) give the chain-map equations directly. In particular \[ c_1s_1 =\delta_Sc_0(I-i_Np_N)s_0h_S =\delta_Sh_S=I \] on the image complex. With the stated order \(H=(I-s_0c_0)h_N\), one gets \[ H\delta_N=I-s_0c_0,\qquad \delta_NH=I-s_1c_1. \] These calculations remain valid for \(m=1\), where the retained degree-one image is zero. ## 2. The relative sign and the whole normal For total differential \(d_R\otimes I+(-1)^pI\otimes\delta\), \(p=\deg_R\), the induced Ward homotopy is \((-1)^pI\otimes H\). Its two \(d_R\) contributions cancel; its remaining terms are \(I\otimes(\delta H+H\delta)\). The displayed relative sign is therefore correct. The marked root \(\alpha(U)^N=U,\ \alpha(1)=1\) exists uniquely over \(k[[U-1]]\). Root orthogonality gives the specified regular idempotent and \[ \phi_{S,U}(f)= \frac{\operatorname{Tr}(f)-f(\alpha)}{N-1}. \] For a degree-\(<N\) representative the trace is \(Nf_0\); the carry \(f_{N-1}(A^N-U)\) is consequently retained. There is a useful subtlety which the proof handles correctly: localizing \(C_U\) at \(A-1\) does not literally delete the entire marked branch over the punctured normal base. That branch has \(\alpha-1\) invertible after \(U-1\) is inverted. The new functional instead kills the marked summand as a whole and extends by zero there. It is regular on the retained summands, where \(A-1\) is a unit. The extended \(K\)-differences and interior \(F\)-entries are units over the formal base, so the boundary Ward retractions extend regularly. An extra cyclic wrap does not change the interior reconstruction on the split image complex. This is not an internal Hopf extension. ## 3. There is an explicit obstruction to network compression The composition defect is exactly \[ c_0(CD)-c_0(C)c_0(D)=LC(I-P)DJ. \] For retained \(i,j\) and deleted \(d\), choose \(C=E_{i,d}\), \(D=E_{d,j}\). Both separate compressions are zero, whereas \(c_0(CD)=E_{i,j}\). Thus even the most elementary excursion forbids treating the retraction as a local crossing replacement or tensor functor. The proof states this limitation explicitly. The resulting representative is supported on the \(A\ne1\) cut chart. Other geometric chart divisors and the internal Gaussian/source map remain separate. ## 4. Additional check of the off-root product and pivot moment The two-normal distinction in [the complete-color divided Ward note](complete_color_divided_ward_and_fusion.md), section 7, also checks directly. In the generic balanced lift, \[ \epsilon_a=MQ^{-a-1}-M^{-1},\qquad F_{a+1,a}=1-Q^{a+1}. \] Subtracting adjacent diagonal products gives the usual \(\rho(K-K^{-1})\) at every interior vertex. The absent last edge leaves exactly \[ [\mathcal E,F]-\rho(K-K^{-1}) =-(1-Q^N)(MQ^{-N}-M^{-1})E_{N-1,N-1}. \] Hence the root wall and the integral-color wall are different normals, even though the defect vanishes on both. On the integral color \(m=N-1\), each of the \(b-1\) closed pivot ratios contributes \(q^{-Nm+2Na_j}\). The inverse-writhe twist ratio contributes \(q^{Nm\ell}\). Their product is exactly \[ q^{Nm(\ell-b+1)+2N\sum_{\mathrm{closed}}a_j}. \] Knot parity makes its root value one. Its logarithmic derivative still contains the closed-position moment; there is no equality of off-root jets merely from the root scalar equality. The current notes retain that moment and use the genuine generic pivot before divided specialization, so no adapter is omitted.

title: The weaving reflection source has expanding nonordinary channels
text: # The weaving reflection source has expanding nonordinary channels 28 October 2026. A bounded negative correction would be enough to evade the exact indefinite-Gram obstruction at the leading exponential scale. This note tests a specific way to obtain that correction: ordinary-color unitary traces and finitely many of their source jets. The original five-strand weaving source does not admit that particular reflection-positive decomposition. Its retained projective source has nonreal EXPANDING moment channels, not only the constant channel seen at N=2. This is a fixed-root, word-growth theorem. It is NOT a disproof of a polynomial-in-N correction for each fixed knot, an asymptotic positive formula valid only at large N, or a word-dependent scalar norm. Those would require additional arguments. In particular nothing below identifies the negative source terms with the bounded ordinary-color tail of the [regular meridian period](regularized_kashaev_period.md). ## 1. The exact arbitrary-width reflection pairing At complete color the original balanced crossing matrices are symmetric: R_plus^t=R_plus, R_minus^t=R_minus. For example the positive coefficient with input (a,b), output (c,j), c=a+b-j, is kappa x^(-b-j) Q^(jb) F_c F_a/(F_(a-j)F_bF_j). Transposing exchanges (a,b) with (c,j); c-b=a-j makes this coefficient identical. The negative statement follows by inversion. The proved [complete antiunitary identity](signed_green_antiunitary_transport.md) therefore gives R_minus=P R_plus^dagger P, including kappa. Let the width p be odd. Put U=product_(i odd)R_i^+, and let J reverse the p head factors. Since the odd crossings are disjoint, V=product_(i even)R_i^-=J U^dagger J, B=VU=J U^dagger J U, B^dagger J=J B. (1) The actual first-cut source is F=P_0 tensor g^(tensor(p-1)); the equivalent averaged marked row may be used only through its already proved whole-source identity. With the original writhe-zero framing and its external line retained, the reduced weave moments are k_n=Tr(F B^n), h(X,Y)=Tr(F J X^dagger J Y), h(B^i,B^j)=k_(i+j). (2) Thus a definite reflection subspace containing these half-states would give a positive Hankel form on the sequence (k_n). Equations (1)--(2) are an actual source pairing. They do not assert that the involution J, or its original marked co-source, is positive. For p=5 the time-ordered braid block is [1,3,-2,-4]. Its physical over and under encounters alternate, and its strand permutation is a five-cycle. In particular the closures at n=5m+2 are knots. The scalar is the original reduced Kashaev value. Restoring the full ADO dimension line multiplies every moment at this fixed N by the same known nonzero scalar; it changes none of the poles below. ## 2. An exact selected-source computation at N=3 Put omega=Q=exp(2 pi i/3). Then x=omega and g_a=omega^(1-a). The two positive and two negative common Cartan factors cancel in B. Its entries lie in Z[omega]. The audit constructs this literal operator and its original source exactly, rather than sampling its spectrum numerically. The resulting rational generating function is G(z)=sum_(n>=0) k_n z^n=A(z)/D(z), (3) where A and D are COPRIME integer polynomials and deg D=43. The full coefficient lists are saved in the audit certificate. The denominator is D=-(z-1)^3 P4a^2 P4b P8^2 P12, P4a=z^4-17z^3+55z^2-17z+1, P4b=z^4-5z^3+7z^2-5z+1, P8=z^8-19z^7+126z^6-380z^5+557z^4 -380z^3+126z^2-19z+1, P12=z^12-57z^11+1032z^10-8306z^9+34071z^8 -75492z^7+95323z^6-75492z^5+34071z^4 -8306z^3+1032z^2-57z+1. (4) The first moments are 0,1,217,15349,707317,26955828,936961969,... . This is not an inferred finite recurrence. After discovering its coefficients, the audit verifies the reversed denominator polynomial as an EXACT annihilating matrix identity on every source-supported integer-degree block. It then verifies the numerator and coprimeness. Cayley--Hamilton-style multiplication of that displayed identity proves (3) at ALL n, independently of any finite fit. The ordinary source includes only first-head index zero, hence supports total integer degrees 0,...,8. The exact arithmetic represents a+b omega by the integer matrix [[a,-b],[b,a-b]], so the calculation uses neither floating eigenvalues nor approximate cancellation. The local matrices and pivot are also checked directly against the existing independently assembled original balanced crossing. ## 3. The retained source couples to nonreal expanding modes Exact rational root isolation places a root z_0 of P8 in .41<Re z_0<.42, .11<Im z_0<.13. (5) In particular |z_0|<1. Numerically z_0 is approximately .4133686+.1189402i, giving |1/z_0| approximately 2.324825. The numerical values are explanatory only; (5) proves expansion. Since gcd(A,P8)=1, this is a genuine DOUBLE pole of the selected whole source. Its moment contribution has the form (a+b n)lambda^n with b!=0 and lambda=1/z_0. It survives on the all-knot subsequence n=5m+2. Indeed the exact fifth-power resultant is Res_z(P8(z),w-z^5) =w^8-58634w^7+98866981w^6-2511273890w^5 +449769171292w^4-2511273890w^3 +98866981w^2-58634w+1. (6) This polynomial is squarefree and coprime to the corresponding resultant of D/P8^2. Thus no two relevant fifth powers collide and cancel the selected double pole. The box (5) also proves Im(z_0^5)>0: for z_0=x+iy it is y(5x^4-10x^2y^2+y^4), whose lower bound on that box is positive. Consequently the generating series of k_(5m+2) has a NONREAL pole strictly inside the unit disk. This selected-source assertion is stronger than noticing nonreal eigenvalues in the ambient transfer matrix. Such eigenvalues could have been invisible to the marked cap; coprimeness in (3) proves that these are visible. ## 4. What this rules out, and what it leaves open An ordinary-color braid action in the positive path model is unitary. At fixed N, its closing trace is therefore uniformly bounded as the weave repetition varies. Finitely many fixed-order analytic jets of those finite matrices have at most polynomial growth in the repetition: differentiating a product chooses only polynomially many factors, with the remaining zero-order factors unitary. Their generating functions are analytic in |z|<1. Suppose the reflection form (2), restricted even to nonempty half-states B^(1+5i), split into a positive form plus such an ordinary-color/finite-unitary-jet correction. Then the sequence k_(5m+2) would differ by a polynomially bounded sequence from a positive Hankel moment sequence. This is impossible because of the nonreal pole just proved. Here is an elementary justification, avoiding a spectral-positivity assumption about B. A positive Hankel sequence a_m of exponential size defines the inner product <X^i,X^j>=a_(i+j) on polynomials. Multiplication T by X is symmetric. Iterated Cauchy--Schwarz gives ||Tf||<=||f||^(1-2^(-j)) ||T^(2^j)f||^(2^(-j)). The exponential moment bound makes ||T^n f||<=C_f R^n, so letting j tend to infinity proves ||Tf||<=R||f||. Thus T extends to a bounded self-adjoint operator on the Hilbert completion. Its scalar resolvent <1,(I-zT)^(-1)1> is analytic at EVERY nonreal z. One may verify the usual resolvent fact directly from ||(T-w)f||>=|Im w| ||f|| and the same inequality for its adjoint. It agrees near zero with the moment series. Subtracting a polynomially bounded sequence changes that series by a function analytic in the unit disk, which cannot remove the nonreal pole in (5)--(6). This is the contradiction. The conclusion concerns a source-compatible REFLECTION/HANKEL decomposition with a correction uniformly polynomial in repetition. The nonordinary source radical cannot be bounded in that way just by invoking ordinary-color unitarity. It retains expanding channels. It remains possible that, for each fixed knot as N tends to infinity, a different marked extension has a polynomially bounded negative part; this fixed-N computation does not decide that question. Likewise a nonlinear or word-dependent norm formula need not give the Hankel form (2), and is not excluded. The positive cyclic norm already known for all knots is a different construction. No broad volume theorem, asymptotic counterexample, or positivity failure for the scalar values themselves follows here. ## 5. Reproducible certificate python3 experiments/audit_weaving_source_expanding_reflection_channels.py The certificate contains the exact numerator/denominator lists, the matrix-recurrence verification, the rational isolating rectangle, and the disjoint fifth-power resultants. The whole proof uses the original local matrices, source, word and ordinary-color unitarity already independently derived in this repository.

title: Weighted complete-crossing norms and the actual Green-source gap
text: # Weighted complete-crossing norms and the actual Green-source gap 28 October 2026. The original complete crossing has a uniform compact variational formula for its exponential norm in real boundary metrics. At the flat metric its unique maximum is the regular octahedral point and its rate is 2 Catalan/pi. The COMPLETE Green source, including its carry, has a much smaller explicit metric exponent. This proves an open weighted operator-norm gap for both signs. This is a norm comparison. It does not assert noncancellation of the original closed scalar period or replace the actual exterior source by a norm-maximizing vector. The [audit](../experiments/audit_weighted_crossing_source_gap.py) and [results](../experiments/weighted_crossing_source_gap_results.json) check literal weighted R/source norms, endpoint-uniform factorial estimates and signed metric-rate diagnostics. The weighted optimizer in that script is a diagnostic; the rigorous variational formula, flat maximum and explicit gap chamber are proved below. ## 1. The actual coefficient and metric Put q=exp(pi*i/N), Q=q^2, x=-q^(-1), F_k=(Q;Q)_k and d=N-1. The exact positive Green reconstruction, with original unit scalar kappa retained, has input (a,b), output (a+b-j,j), and coefficient kappa*x^(-b-j)Q^(jb) F_(a+b-j)F_a/[F_(a-j)F_bF_j], (1) when 0<=j<=a<N, 0<=b<N and a+b-j<N; otherwise it is zero. Every displayed factor is nonzero on this range. This is the original crossing coefficient, independently checked against its gate word, not a positive surrogate. Give input and output basis vectors real exponential metrics W_in|a,b>=exp(rho_a*a+rho_b*b)|a,b>, W_out|c,e>=exp(rho_c*c+rho_d*e)|c,e>, R_(+,rho)=W_out R_+ W_in^(-1). (2) Set p=rho_c-rho_a, q_w=rho_c-rho_b, r=rho_d-rho_a. The symbol q_w is a REAL weight, distinct from the root q. With alpha=(a-j)/N, beta=b/N, gamma=j/N, the exact boundary-metric exponent in (1) is N(p alpha+q_w beta+r gamma). ## 2. Uniform factorial and Laplace estimates Define the continuous function J(s)=integral_0^s log(2 sin(pi t))dt, 0<=s<=1. Uniformly for 0<=k<N, log|F_k|=N J(k/N)+O(log N). (3) One direct proof writes log(2 sin(pi t))=log t+log(1-t)+b(t), where b extends smoothly to [0,1]. Stirling bounds on the two finite factorial sums give O(log N) uniformly, including k=0 and k=N-1; the smooth remainder has bounded Riemann-sum error. Thus no fixed distance from a factorial endpoint is needed. Let D={alpha,beta,gamma>=0: alpha+beta<=1, alpha+gamma<=1}, f=J(alpha+beta)+J(alpha+gamma)-J(alpha)-J(beta)-J(gamma), M(p,q_w,r)=max_D [f+p alpha+q_w beta+r gamma]. (4) Then for EVERY compact real metric set K, log||R_(+,rho)||_HS=N M(p,q_w,r)+O_K(log N). (5) The same formula holds for operator norm, with another O_K(log N). Indeed the positive sum of squared matrix entries lies between its largest summand and N^3 times that summand. Equation (3) approximates each logarithm by the phase in (4) with O(log N) error. Conversely shrink any point of D by 1-1/N and round its coordinates DOWN to the 1/N grid. The resulting physical indices obey both upper bounds N-1 and lie O(1/N) away. The uniform modulus of continuity of J is O(eta(1+|log eta|)), so the maximal phase changes by O_K(log N/N). This proves the uniform two-sided estimate (5). Finally ||R||_op<=||R||_HS<=N||R||_op, so their rates agree. There is also an exact finite separable formula useful for computation. Set A_N(k;s)=sum_(t=0)^(d-k) |F_(k+t)/F_t|^2 exp(2s t). Then the ACTUAL weighted squared HS norm is exactly ||R_(+,rho)||_HS^2=sum_(k=0)^d |F_k|^(-2) exp(2p k) A_N(k;q_w)A_N(k;r). (5a) This takes O(N^2) positive real operations without evaluating a new invariant or assuming that the original scalar sum is positive. For the negative crossing the exact balanced antiunitary identity is R_-=P overline(R_+)P, including its original Cartan phase. Therefore (5) applies with both input weights and both output weights swapped: p_-=rho_d-rho_b, q_-=rho_d-rho_a, r_-=rho_c-rho_b. (6) No factorial metric conversion is used. All estimates are uniform on compact sets and hold for the literal two signs. ## 3. The unique flat maximum and its value For fixed 0<alpha<1 put g_alpha(t)=J(alpha+t)-J(t). On 0<t<1-alpha, g_alpha'=log[sin(pi(alpha+t))/sin(pi t)], g_alpha''=-pi sin(pi alpha) /[sin(pi(alpha+t))sin(pi t)]<0. Thus the unique maximizers in beta and gamma at zero weights are both (1-alpha)/2. The mean of log(2 sin(pi t)) is zero and J(1-s)=-J(s). The reduced maximum is consequently F(alpha)=-4J((1-alpha)/2)-J(alpha), F'(alpha)=log cot(pi alpha/2). (7) It increases to alpha=1/2 and decreases afterward; its endpoint values are zero. Hence the unique maximum on the ENTIRE domain is (alpha,beta,gamma)=(1/2,1/4,1/4), M(0,0,0)=-4J(1/4)=2G/pi, (8) where G=sum_(n>=0)(-1)^n/(2n+1)^2 is Catalan's constant. To obtain the last equality independently, expand log|1-r exp(2*pi*i*t)| for r<1, integrate its absolutely convergent Fourier series, and let r tend to one in L^1. This gives J(1/4)=-G/(2*pi). Equivalently 2G/pi=v_8/(2*pi), where v_8=4G is the volume of the regular ideal octahedron. Only the explicit Catalan value is needed for the norm theorem. In particular log||R_+||=log||R_-||=N*(2G/pi)+O(log N). (9) The maximizing Hessian is -pi[[2,1,1],[1,2,0],[1,0,2]], negative definite. Thus the maximum and M vary smoothly for sufficiently small weights. No global concavity for arbitrary weights is assumed. ## 4. A one-dimensional computation for arbitrary real weights For every 0<alpha<1, strict concavity gives the exact inner optima beta_*(alpha;q_w) =Arg(exp(-q_w)-exp(-pi*i*alpha))/pi, gamma_*(alpha;r) =Arg(exp(-r)-exp(-pi*i*alpha))/pi. (10) Both lie strictly between zero and 1-alpha. Thus M is the maximum over the SINGLE interval alpha in [0,1] of (4) evaluated at (10). Its endpoint values are max(0,q_w)+max(0,r) at alpha=0 and p at alpha=1. This is an explicit computable variational problem, including weighted maxima that reach the boundary. Uniqueness is not asserted for arbitrary weights. ## 5. Sharp complete Green-source exponent with its carry retained Use the actual COMPLETE Green source L=G_out+G_in+G_top from [the sharp endpoint theorem](actual_crossing_shared_face_fourier_source.md#9-exact-flat-metric-norm-of-the-complete-green-source). This is the weighted crossing source of that theorem, NOT the unweighted exponentially large fusion-ground channel H_m. Its exact complete coefficients are unit phases on the following supports: * G_out maps (a,b) to(a+b,0), a>=1 and a+b<N. * G_in maps (a,0) to(a-e,e), 1<=e<=a<N. * G_top is one rank-one block on pair degree N, with input(a,N-a) and output(N-e,e), 1<=a,e<N, and unit-modulus input/output factors. Put L_rho=W_out L W_in^(-1). For either operator or HS norm, log||L_rho||=N delta(rho)+O_K(log N), delta(rho)=max(0,max(rho_c,rho_d)-min(rho_a,rho_b)). (11) Here is the full endpoint proof. The rank-one carry has norm equal to the product of its weighted vector norms. Its output components have magnitudes exp[rho_c(N-e)+rho_d e], and its input covector components exp[-rho_a a-rho_b(N-a)]. The allowed grids approach both ends within 1/N, so its logarithmic norm is N(max rho_out-min rho_in)+O_K(log N), uniformly even at tied weights. The ground-output triangular support gives rate max(0,p,q_w). The ground-input triangular support gives rate max(0,p,r). The degree-one ground entry supplies the lower rate zero even if every metric difference is negative. Both triangular rates are at most delta. Different total-degree blocks isolate the top carry, and different second-output supports isolate the two lower-degree ground terms, so cancellation cannot remove the maximal component. Projection onto those supports bounds each component by the whole operator; the reverse bound is their triangle sum. This proves (11), including the carry and BOTH ground sources. The same assertion for HS follows also by their disjoint matrix-entry supports. Negative crossing sources are transported by the same flip-conjugation; delta is unchanged by the swaps, proving (11) for both signs. The norms of the COMPLETE Green source are only polynomial at the flat metric. The carry fixes the sharp positive exponent when output radii dominate input radii. It has not been omitted as a negligible degree-N correction. ## 6. An explicit open radius chamber for the relative source norm gap Evaluate (4) at its unweighted maximizing point. This gives M_+(rho)>=2G/pi+L_+(rho), L_+=(3rho_c+rho_d-3rho_a-rho_b)/4, M_-(rho)>=2G/pi+L_-(rho), L_-=(rho_c+3rho_d-rho_a-3rho_b)/4. (12) Consequently the following strict, explicit piecewise-linear chamber contains the flat metric: delta(rho)<2G/pi+min(L_+(rho),L_-(rho)). (13) On every compact subset with a margin eta>0, equations (5), (6), and (11) prove for BOTH crossing signs ||L_(sigma,rho)||/||R_(sigma,rho)|| <=N^C exp(-N eta). (14) One convenient radius cube is |rho_i|<=epsilon, with 0<epsilon<G/(2*pi). Then delta<=2epsilon and L_+,L_->=-2epsilon. Hence (14) holds uniformly with any eta<2G/pi-4epsilon. The fixed explicit choice epsilon=1/10 even permits eta=4/25 without relying on a decimal evaluation: the alternating series gives G>8/9, and pi<22/7 implies 2G/pi-2/5>82/495>4/25. A common additive shift of all four rho_i leaves every comparison unchanged, so this can also be viewed as a chamber of radius RATIOS rather than a fixed overall scale. These are relative operator/HS norm gaps for the actual sourced crossing equation. Contracting through the rest of a knot can select a subspace far below the norm-maximizing octahedral profile. No scalar volume limit or source-angle lower bound follows from (14) alone.

title: Whole clock functions require an endpoint extension
text: # Whole clock functions require an endpoint extension Independent algebraic proof and actual-source audit, 27 October 2026. The exact endpoint-completed Jackson current retains its input function, rather than only that function's finite matrix value. There is a precise obstruction to forgetting the function and an explicit flat tower that retains the additional endpoints. This is the usual infinite-order quantum-shift phenomenon; no novelty claim is made for the algebraic simplicity statement. ## 1. The actual whole current and its retained function On one actual Frobenius residue string, let \[ C_Q=c Z^R,\quad 0\le R\le N,\quad Z=Q^N, \quad eC_Q=ZC_Qe,\quad fC_Q=Z^{-1}C_Qf. \] Here c=Q^s for the original physical clock. The actual divided e(q),f(q) have nonzero interior arrow coefficients at the root. Invert just those finite arrows and set the absent endpoint arrow to zero. This defines regular original whole germs e^dagger,f^dagger with \[ e^\dagger e=I-P_0,\qquad f^\dagger f=I-P_N. \tag{1} \] No inverse of the whole nilpotent matrix is asserted. For a RETAINED function g, the exact whole current is \[ \mathcal J_Z(g)= \frac{-e^\dagger[e,g(ZC_Q)] +P_0 f^\dagger[f,g(C_Q)]}{1-Z} =\frac{g(C_Q)-g(ZC_Q)}{1-Z}. \tag{2} \] The full proof and its actual matrix/source implementation are in [the endpoint-completed normal clock current](endpoint_completed_normal_clock_euler_current.md). For an independent check of the order, put D=g(C_Q)-g(ZC_Q). The first numerator is (I-P_0)D, and the second is P_0(I-P_N)D=P_0D. Their sum is D. This also identifies precisely where the lower endpoint is repaired. Polynomials and Laurent polynomials are always allowed. Rational or marked analytic functions require their denominators or domains at EVERY shifted spectrum used in (2). The root value is C_0 g'(C_0), with any explicit coefficient parameter held fixed. An additional coefficient derivative is a separate operation. The inverse arrows are regular actual q-germs because their root coefficients are r-R+1 and R+1, respectively (with r=N here), times fixed nonzero root units. This is not a generic module inverse or a Hopf-natural contraction on arbitrary tensor summands. ## 2. No finite-dimensional compatible function quotient at generic Z Let K be a characteristic-zero field, let Z in K^times have infinite multiplicative order, and put F=K[x,x^-1]. The shift is sigma(g)(x)=g(Zx), fixing K. Then **Claim.** A nonzero ideal I with sigma(I) contained in I is F. Consequently F has no nonzero finite-dimensional quotient carrying the induced whole shift or Jackson operator D_Z=(1-sigma)/(1-Z). Proof. Write I=(p), multiplying its Laurent generator by a unit to make p an ordinary polynomial with nonzero constant term. The divisibility p(x)|p(Zx), and equality of degrees, give p(Zx)=a p(x) for a nonzero scalar a. If p has positive degree, choose a root r over an algebraic closure. It is nonzero. Then all Z^j r, j>=0, are roots, contradicting their infinitude. Thus p is a nonzero constant and I=F. This also proves sigma(I)=I; one-sided stability was sufficient. Because 1-Z is a field unit, Jackson stability and shift stability are equivalent. The statement concerns a COMPATIBLE FUNCTION-ALGEBRA quotient at generic Z. It does not prohibit finite root modules, finite matrix representations, or the actual cyclic/Steinberg source. Evaluation on a finite spectral string is perfectly valid; it simply forgets the endpoint value needed for the next shift. ## 3. The actual minimal-polynomial certificate and its normal order For the actual spectral string let \[ P_N(x)=\prod_{r=0}^N(x-cZ^r). \] Then P_N(C_Q)=0 exactly, whereas \[ P_N(ZC_Q)=P_N(cZ^{N+1})P_N^{\mathrm{top}},\qquad P_N(cZ^{N+1})= c^{N+1}Z^{N(N+1)/2}\prod_{j=1}^{N+1}(Z^j-1). \tag{3} \] Here P_N^top denotes the last BLOCK PROJECTOR, not the polynomial. Every other entry of P_N(ZC_Q) is zero. Thus the retained function P_N and the zero function have the SAME actual matrix value, but their currents differ. With delta=1-Z, (2)--(3) give \[ \mathcal J_Z(P_N)=(-1)^N c_0^{N+1}(N+1)! \delta^N P_N^{\mathrm{top}}+O(\delta^{N+1}). \tag{4} \] The defect is invisible to every normal truncation below order N. This is an exact reason why a bounded-order jet calculation cannot discard the whole clock function. It does not contradict bounded-jet reconstruction in a separately fixed bounded-complexity pole lattice: the degree of P_N grows with N. ## 4. A flat confluent tower supplies the missing endpoints There is a constructive integral alternative to an impossible fixed finite quotient. Let R=k[[delta]], Z=1-delta, and c in R^times. Put \[ P_L(x)=\prod_{r=0}^L(x-cZ^r),\qquad A_L=R[x,x^{-1}]/(P_L),\quad L\ge0. \tag{5} \] The polynomial is monic with unit constant term, so A_L is R-free of rank L+1. Forgetting the last endpoint gives A_L to A_(L-1). The exact Jackson operator induces \[ D_Z:A_L\longrightarrow A_{L-1}. \tag{6} \] Indeed D_Z P_L is integral: every coefficient of P_L(x)-P_L(Zx) is divisible by 1-Z. Over k((delta)) it vanishes at c,cZ,...,cZ^(L-1), so is divisible by the monic P_(L-1). Monic division shows the quotient is already integral over R. The same argument applies to a multiple of P_L, or directly to the Jackson product formula. Thus (6) is independent of a representative. At the root, \[ A_L/delta A_L=k[x]/(x-c_0)^{L+1},\qquad D_Z\longmapsto x\partial_x:A_{L,0}\to A_{L-1,0}. \tag{7} \] These are CONFLUENT jet lattices. They are not the ordinary root matrix image: the latter sets C_0=c_0 I and kills all positive powers of x-c_0. For example x-c_0 has zero ambient root matrix value, but its Jackson image has root value c_0 I. For the actual original interval L=N, one extra endpoint suffices for one whole Jackson action; j actions use A_(N+j) to A_N. The compatible inverse tower retains all such endpoint values without divided Vandermonde or idempotent denominators. It is an infinite completed FUNCTION object, not an extra finite quantum color or a tensor-intertwining theorem. The functions supplied to it must still be the specified actual whole functions, with their marks; arbitrary formal sections are not substituted for them. ### The exact spectral index and its flat source extension The integral distinction from the ambient finite matrix values can be computed exactly. Use the Newton basis \[ p_j(x)=\prod_{u=0}^{j-1}(x-cZ^u),\quad 0\le j\le L. \] The monomial-to-Newton change of basis is unitriangular. Its evaluation matrix V_(rj)=p_j(cZ^r), r=0,...,L, is lower triangular: \[ V_{rj}=c^jZ^{j(j-1)/2} \prod_{k=r-j+1}^r(Z^k-1) =\delta^j W_{rj}\quad(r\ge j). \tag{8} \] At the root W_(rj)=(-c_0)^j(r)_j, with falling factorial (r)_j. Its diagonal entries (-c_0)^j j! are units. Thus W is invertible over R and the evaluation map A_L to R^(L+1) has EXACT Smith factors \[ 1,\delta,\ldots,\delta^L, \qquad v_\delta(\det V)=L(L+1)/2. \tag{9} \] This identifies the confluent source lattice lost by ordinary ambient root evaluation. The kernel of forgetting the last endpoint is explicitly \[ 0\longrightarrow R\,P_{L-1}\longrightarrow A_L \longrightarrow A_{L-1}\longrightarrow0. \tag{10} \] Multiplication by x acts on this rank-one line by cZ^L. Its sole nonzero generic spectral value is at the new endpoint, namely \[ P_{L-1}(cZ^L)=c^LZ^{L(L-1)/2}\prod_{j=1}^L(Z^j-1), \] of exact order L, with leading coefficient (-c_0)^L L!. There is a second, different exact sequence giving an integral Jackson primitive: \[ 0\longrightarrow R\cdot1\longrightarrow A_L \xrightarrow{D_Z}A_{L-1}\longrightarrow0. \tag{11} \] Indeed D_Z x^j=[j]_Z x^j and [j]_Z is a root unit for 1<=j<=L. The classes x,...,x^L form a basis of A_(L-1), because x is a unit there. This proves surjectivity. If a degree-at-most-L representative g has D_Z g=0 in the target, D_Z g must be a scalar multiple of P_(L-1); its zero constant term and the unit constant term of P_(L-1) force that scalar to vanish. Thus g is constant. The whole primitive requires no division by delta. Both actions are explicit in the same Newton basis: \[ x p_j=p_{j+1}+cZ^j p_j,\qquad D_Zp_j=[j]_Z x p_{j-1}\quad(j\ge1). \tag{11a} \] The first identity makes the retained clock a bidiagonal matrix; at delta=0 it is the single Jordan block c_0 I plus its nilpotent shift. The second follows by factoring p_j(Zx)=Z^j(x-cZ^{-1})p_{j-1}(x). These give constructive finite flow equations on the confluent lattice, without diagonalizing by singular idempotents. The root of every [j]_Z is the nonzero scalar j, so the primitive is regular at the marked root at each fixed L. Its whole rational formulas retain the other zeros of [j]_Z; no common growing-L analytic neighborhood or bound is asserted. These regular FUNCTION lattices are not every actual regular matrix insertion. For example the original block-number matrix R is regular, while the marked function Log(x/c)/Log Z representing it on this spectrum contains a divided normal factor. Saturating the evaluation lattice allows such functions but can introduce poles in their Jackson currents: already g=(x-c)/delta has a regular finite matrix value and D_Z g=x/delta. Therefore fractional normal/current lattices and their endpoint compensations remain part of the data. Equations (9)--(11) do not discard those factors or assert that every matrix coefficient is a regular scalar function of the clock. ## 5. The root primitive has a tame actual coherent norm In the original divided basis, the Fr coherent metric is \(\|v_k\|^2=\binom Nk\). The normalized inverse-arrow lengths are \[ \frac1{\sqrt{(k+1)(N-k)}}\quad(e^\dagger),\qquad \frac1{\sqrt{k(N-k+1)}}\quad(f^\dagger). \] Their largest values occur at the extreme arrows. Consequently \[ \|e^\dagger_0\|=\|f^\dagger_0\|=N^{-1/2}, \quad\|P_0\|=\|P_N\|=1. \tag{12} \] This positive bound is for the ROOT inverse-arrow operators in the specified actual Frobenius metric. It gives neither a uniform whole normal-neighborhood estimate nor a norm bound for arbitrary inserted functions and all full braiding operators. In particular it does not remove the separate exponential endpoint-row norms computed in [the actual relative source period](actual_frobenius_relative_endpoint_period.md). The integrated row can still have cancellations; all endpoint and source normalization factors remain. The conclusions are therefore compatible: a tame finite root primitive exists, while exact whole functional transport requires the additional endpoint extension. A comparison with the actual network's geometric framing currents must preserve that extension, its true co-source and the ordinary/divided Hopf endpoint terms. [The exact audit](../experiments/audit_whole_clock_endpoint_extension.py) checks the integral confluent tower, the actual spectral-polynomial defect and its sign/order, and the root primitive norms. The independent [confluent-lattice audit](../experiments/audit_whole_clock_confluent_lattice.py) checks the Newton evaluation, Smith factors, primitive kernel and new-endpoint line explicitly.

title: The whole original Fermat source as a toric residue, with its wire seams
text: # The whole original Fermat source as a toric residue, with its wire seams 28 October 2026. The exact balanced Fourier crossing theorem gives a single scalar period for the original complete knot source. Its co-source is an explicit rational function of bounded degree on the finite Fermat grids. This note computes its root-grid Jacobian and the different Jacobian of a wire-pole pushforward. The latter has coefficient one, but its other relative currents need not vanish. In fact an exact local calculation shows that sewing a balanced full-Psi block off its original central grid REGENERATES the beta/Rogers current. Thus the residue formula does not by itself identify the original period with a positive geometric cycle. All frame changes below are reversible finite changes of basis. All original cups, ordinary caps, the FULL marked row, pivots and external scalar lines are retained. The proofs use the exact crossing theorem, not a new invariant or a favorable source. ## 1. Exact bounded-degree rational co-source Put N>=2, d=N-1, Q=exp(2*pi*i/N), x=-exp(-pi*i/N), and s=x^N=(-1)^(N+1). On a port with central coordinate C choose a marked root r^N=C and the finite grid z=r Q^k. The normalized frame is F(r)_(k,a)=z^a/sqrt(N), F(r)^(-1)_(a,k)=z^(-a)/sqrt(N), 0<=a,k<N. (1) The [exact balanced crossing](actual_balanced_fourier_crossing_kernel.md) and its complete antiunitary mirror apply independently at every signed crossing. Join their ports with the actual frame adapters. No matching of distinct central grids is implicit. Let K_N(t)=sum_(a=0)^d t^a. For an output port x0^N=C and the next input y^N=D the adapter is exactly E(y,x0)=[1-D/C]/[N(1-y/x0)]. (2) The pivot on the actual oriented head is g_a=x^(1-N)Q^(-a)=(x/s)Q^(-a), so its adapter is E_g(y,x0)=(x/s)[1-D/C]/[N(1-Q^(-1)y/x0)]. (3) At a removable collision the original finite K_N is understood. The unpivoted first trace, where present, has its original external normalization; it is not absorbed into (3). For completeness, use the actual physical pair sources proved in [the coupled-cap theorem](actual_coupled_caps_interval_source.md): p(a,b)=N x^(a-d) delta_(a+b,d), m(a,b)=N^(-1)(x^(-1)Q^(-1))^a delta_(a+b,d), m_mark(a,b)=x^b/N^2, ALL 0<=a,b<N. (4) If z_i^N=C_i, their transformed entries are the following exact rational functions ON THE GRIDS: (F_1 tensor F_2)p =(x/s)(C_2-s C_1)/(z_2-x z_1), m(F_1^(-1) tensor F_2^(-1)) =z_1 z_2(C_1-s C_2) /[N^2 C_1 C_2(z_1-x^(-1)Q^(-1)z_2)], m_mark(F_1^(-1) tensor F_2^(-1)) =z_1 z_2(C_1-1)(C_2-s) /[N^3 C_1 C_2(z_1-1)(z_2-x)]. (5) In particular the marked source in (5) is the FULL row in (4), not its restriction to an invariant fiber after some decomposition. The first two formulas follow from K_N and z_i^d=C_i/z_i. The marked row gives N^(-3)K_N(z_1^(-1))K_N(x/z_2), which gives the last formula. These computations fix every N and Q factor. For a fixed diagram the product of (2), (3), (5) is therefore a rational function of degree bounded independently of N, after its explicit powers of N and the actual unit phases are separated. The central parameters are fixed nonzero constants. On the generic source chart require the corresponding numerator differences in (2), (5) to be nonzero. This is a finite list of proper algebraic conditions and can be arranged by the independent local frames. One may insert another reversible frame on a wire if needed; the added grid variable and BOTH adapters are then retained. On compact subsets of this generic central chart, each entry of this rational source and its reciprocal has at most polynomial size in N. Indeed the moduli of all marked Nth roots are uniformly bounded above and below, each numerator difference stays nonzero, and |1-y/x0| >= c/N if C!=D, and likewise for the shifted denominators in (5). To see the last bound, use (1-t^N)/(1-t)=sum_(a=0)^d t^a and the fixed nonzero central numerator. The elementary upper bound on this sum is O(N) because |t|^N is fixed. Thus no exponential source gauge is hidden in this initial regular chart. An ambient rational unit is not a geometric thimble coefficient. ## 2. The exact single toric residue of the whole source Expand the complete transformed word, including (5), as its finite sum over all port labels. Write it as P_N=chi_N sum_(z_i^N=C_i, all i) H_N(z) A_N(z). (6) Here H_N is the product of the exact signed four-full-Psi crossing entries (including their Gaussian and actual local constants); A_N is the rational co-source from Section 1. The external original line chi_N is unchanged. No new normalization of the sum is used. Let f_i=z_i^N-C_i. The coordinate algebra T_N=C[z_1^(+/-1),...,z_n^(+/-1)]/(f_1,...,f_n) is finite etale. Its source is the actual finite trace in (6), not a postulated trace on a geometric critical algebra. At a grid point det(d f_i/d z_j)=N^n product_i z_i^(N-1). (7) Choose the continued local full-Psi germs which give the specified grid entries. With coordinate order fixed as dz_1 wedge ... wedge dz_n, the exact period is P_N=chi_N Res_(all f_i=0) H_N(z) A_N(z) product_i [N z_i^(N-1) dz_i/(z_i^N-C_i)]. (8) The normalized residue is the sum of the local product-circle integrals divided by (2*pi*i)^n. Every grid point has coefficient ONE, by (7). The same statement holds with N C_i/z_i in place of N z_i^(N-1); these numerators agree on the grid. Such a change of off-grid extension need not preserve individual zero/infinity boundary terms during a later contour deformation. Equation (8) is a specified original cycle and a single period. It does not turn the grid algebra into the classical gluing algebra. Different off-grid holomorphic extensions with the same grid values have the same small residues and can have different critical schemes. Any proposed deformation to a geometric shape cycle must therefore transport the whole form, source and relative boundaries, not just its sampled values. ## 3. Wire-pole pushforward and its exact Jacobian Keep one wire with x0^N=C, y^N=D, C!=D. Let f(x0) denote the complete remaining local field, with its actual logarithmic marks. Its Fourier interpolation is I_(C->D) f(y) =sum_(x0^N=C) [1-D/C]/[N(1-y/x0)] f(x0) =sum_(x0^N=C) Res_x0 omega, omega=(C-D)f(x0) dx0/[(x0^N-C)(x0-y)]. (9) The grid residue in (9) is (2) times f. The DISTINCT wire collision pole x0=y has Res_(x0=y) omega=-f(y). (10) Thus pushing the grid contours across the collision gives a coefficient-one substitution x0=y. No color, Gaussian or root Jacobian is missing. It is a different residue calculation from (7). More precisely, on any marked branch domain U containing the grid points and y, with all additional poles and branch lips retained, the residue theorem gives I_(C->D) f(y) =f(y)+(1/(2*pi*i)) integral_(boundary U) omega -sum_(other poles in U) Res omega. (11) The boundary includes the logarithmic cut lips and any zero/infinity or endpoint circles needed to specify that branch domain. There is no assumption that they vanish. If f is a polynomial of degree<N, one can take U approaching the sphere, the integral at infinity vanishes, and (11) is ordinary polynomial interpolation. For a full function these hypotheses generally fail. For a collection of wire edges whose undirected graph is a forest, successive collision residues eliminate one variable at a time with the same coefficient one. Retain one variable in each component; with leaf-first orientation their coordinate incidence matrix is triangular with diagonal one. All non-wire branches in (11) are still present. For an edge closing a cycle there is no additional independent leaf variable; a closure condition or a remaining residue has to be retained. In particular the forest calculation does not dispose of the closed knot source. ## 4. Sewing recreates the exact original beta current Fix v and choose the old central grid C=1+v^N, C!=0. On that grid the EXACT original Newton source identity is B_N(x0,v)=S_N(x0,v), B_N(u,v)=S_N(u,v)+(1-u^N+v^N)I_N(u,v). (12) The functions and marks in (12) are those of [the normalized beta source](actual_trivalent_quantum_beta_source.md). Choose the grid germs by that identity, away from its exceptional divisors. The polynomial B_N has degree<N in its first argument. For y^N=D, its interpolation theorem and (12) therefore imply the EXACT identity I_(C->D)[ S_N(.,v)|_(x0^N=C) ](y) =B_N(y,v) =S_N(y,v)+(C-D)I_N(y,v). (13) Consequently the aggregate non-wire term in (11), for this source, is exactly boundary integral - other-pole residues =(C-D)I_N(y,v). (14) This is an identified beta source, rather than an unspecified remainder defined by a putative global asymptotic. Its coefficient is the difference between the two central wire parameters. The current is generally nonzero; it is not killed by the old balance C=1+v^N after y has moved off that grid. The Rogers sink is identical in structure. On its old grid C=1-v^N, use the independently proved R_N(u,v)=T_N(u,v)+(1-u^N-v^N)J_N(u,v). Since R_N also has degree<N in u, the corresponding exact formula is I_(C->D)[ T_N(.,v)|_(x0^N=C) ](y) =R_N(y,v)=T_N(y,v)+(C-D)J_N(y,v). (15) It retains the opposite-root contour and the full norm of [the Rogers source](actual_rogers_sink_opposite_beta_source.md). Apparent C=D collisions are interpreted by the finite interpolation and the continued complete source, not by dividing (14) by C-D. Thus balancing the local blocks and then gluing by only the collision residues is not in general an exact source operation. The omitted seam is the original current in a different polarization. Its exact logarithmic continuation can itself carry a regular geometric sector, as proved in [the current connection](actual_beta_current_connection_and_monodromy.md). Neither its vanishing nor an exponential gap follows from local balancing or from the unit residue (10). ## 5. Interior adapters and bulk logarithmic seams are different The [propagated-frame theorem](propagated_balanced_frames_and_boundary_source.md) makes every INTERIOR finite Fourier adapter the identity on an open braid. Thus at most the braid width many nontrivial frame adapters remain at its boundary. This exact statement does not imply that the off-grid bulk full-Psi continuation has no logarithmic seams. Here is an explicit sewn test, using the independently verified [four-port characters](balanced_crossing_deck_characters.md). Sew two positive crossings with central port data M_1=M(A,B,C,D), M_2=M(C,D,E,F). The internal C and D variables have whole-product characters nu_C=-s E(A-C)/[D(C-E)], nu_D=-s B(F-D)/[C(D-B)]. (16) For example nu_C is mu_c of the first crossing times mu_a of the second; C-sD=-s(D-sC) cancels the common local factor. No wire adapter was introduced. After the propagated pair of crossings the external centers return to their original values, so set E=A,F=B. Then, as identities of the WHOLE bulk product away from divisors, nu_C=sA/D, nu_D=sB/C. (17) These characters equal one on the original internal grids C=sB, D=sA, but do not equal one during arbitrary off-grid motion. The whole product has a bulk seam even though it has no interior Fourier adapter. This example also permits an exact, but limited, dual-character residue transformation. Write c,d for the actual internal variables and put f_c=c^N-sB, f_d=d^N-sA, G_c=nu_C-1=-f_d/d^N, G_d=nu_D-1=-f_c/c^N. (18) The change from (f_c,f_d) to (G_c,G_d) is invertible near every nonzero grid point. Its coefficient matrix and determinant are L=[[0,-d^(-N)],[-c^(-N),0]], det L=-(cd)^(-N). Consequently the exact local Grothendieck transformation rule is Res_f H dc wedge dd/(f_c f_d) =Res_G H det(L) dc wedge dd/(G_c G_d). (19) At a grid point the two coordinate Jacobians are respectively N^2 c^(N-1)d^(N-1) and -N^2/(cd). Their ratio is exactly det L, including its sign; the residue contours use their respective ordered defining functions. Thus (19) has no missing Jacobian. But the zero sets in (18) are EXACTLY the same finite grid. This calculation replaces its defining equations; it does not transform the source to a different classical geometric cycle. In particular nu_C=nu_D=1 pins the two internal centers at their original values when A,B are fixed. Also, the first defect in (18) cancels the OPPOSITE grid denominator f_d in a seam form. The resulting regular current is not zero merely because its numerator vanished on the grid. Formula (13) gives a fully normalized source example of that same cancellation mechanism. The source-deformation problem therefore includes both the remaining boundary Fourier co-source and the bulk logarithmic seams of the chosen off-grid continuation. Neither is removed by the telescoping of interior finite changes of basis. ## 6. What is fixed and what is still required Equations (5)--(8) give the entire original co-source and a single finite etale residue period, without an exponentially unspecified matrix source. Equations (9)--(15) compute what an actual wire-pole pushforward adds. Iterated forest collision residues have exact degree one, but the independent non-wire currents remain and can be identified explicitly on the elementary trivalent blocks. The remaining theorem is an actual deformation or exact regrouping of this complete relative source onto the geometric shape cycle, with its geometric coefficient proved nonzero and the other total sectors controlled. A nonzero rational density on the grid, or a unit collision Jacobian, does not prove that theorem. No volume limit for a broad knot class is claimed here. ## 7. Reproducible audit python3 experiments/audit_whole_fermat_toric_residue_and_wire_source.py The audit checks the normalized source table via its unnormalized finite Fourier form (so every square-root normalization is explicit), the original whole signed plat contraction, the toric Jacobians, the wire/extra-pole residue identity, both exact current regeneration identities using independent full-Psi evaluations, the sewn characters (16)--(17), and the exact dual-character Jacobian in (19).

title: An actual whole Frobenius source is a Fermat-cover trace
text: # An actual whole Frobenius source is a Fermat-cover trace Research proof, 27 October 2026. Integral divided powers give a whole algebraic source polynomial whose root value is the actual binomial coherent source. Its Kummer-cover trace, norm and first quantum-normal flag transport are explicit. This supplies a source object before taking jets, with every power and phase retained. This is a choice of whole coupons in the original integral color. An explicit root-identity pair gauge compares it with the previously specified divided-exponential coupons. Operators and all partial sources must be transported by that gauge. No equality with a new state model, controlled growing-level norm, or selected geometric period is inferred. ## 1. Actual divided powers and the whole polynomial Fix N>=2, m=N(N+1)-1 and a residue string 0<=s<N in D_m(q). Use the constant actual sign frame \[ w_{k,s}=\beta_{k,s}u_{kN+s},\qquad \beta_{k,s}=(-1)^{Nk(k-1)/2+ks},\quad 0\le k\le N. \] Symmetric Gaussian coefficients below are integral Laurent polynomials, with the original divided-power formulas \[ F^{(r)}u_j={j+r\brack r}_q u_{j+r},\qquad E^{(r)}u_j={m-j+r\brack r}_q u_{j-r}. \] Put L_s=m-s and epsilon_s=(-1)^(N-1+s). Define \[ A_{k,s}(q)=\epsilon_s^k{L_s\brack kN}_q,\qquad P_s(q,t)=\sum_{k=0}^N A_{k,s}(q)t^k. \tag{1} \] Here t is a SOURCE-FLAG coupling. It is not the knot meridian, the classical longitude, or a quantum-A spectral coordinate. The literal constant-frame ket psi_s=sum_k w_(k,s) is made from actual divided powers as \[ \psi_s=\sum_k\frac{\beta_{k,s}}{{s+kN\brack kN}_q} F^{(kN)}u_s. \tag{2} \] Every denominator is a unit at q_N: its root value is (-1)^(ks). The homogeneous dual is also an actual divided-power row: \[ \widetilde\lambda_s(q;c,d)= \sum_k\epsilon_s^k\beta_{k,s}c^{N-k}d^k u_s^*E^{(kN)}. \] Its value on w_(k,s) is A_(k,s)c^(N-k)d^k. Thus its pairing with the ket is the homogeneous polynomial \[ B_s(q;c,d)=\sum_k A_{k,s}(q)c^{N-k}d^k, \quad B_s(q;1,t)=P_s(q,t). \tag{3} \] Normalize by this original pairing unit on its marked chart. At c=d=1 the normalized dual has coefficients A_k/P_s(q,1). The root value P_s(q_N,1)=2^N is retained, not set to one before normalization. Scaling the ket by alpha^N and the dual inversely retains the unprojectivized source line. ## 2. Exact trace and norm on the root cover Let zeta_N be the marked N-th root of unity, independent of the variable q. Work on the Kummer cover x^N=epsilon_s t and set \[ \Pi_s(q,x)=\prod_{r=0}^{L_s-1} (1+q^{L_s-1-2r}x). \] Multiplication of the factors gives the symmetric Gaussian identity Pi_s=sum_j {L_s choose j}_q x^j. Averaging the deck transformations x->zeta_N x kills exactly the degrees not divisible by N. Hence \[ \boxed{\ P_s(q,t)=\frac1N\operatorname{Tr}_{x^N=\epsilon_st} \Pi_s(q,x).\ } \tag{4} \] This is an exact polynomial identity before normal specialization. It is valid even at t=0 as an identity of coefficients; the cover is etale on t!=0. The 1/N is part of the source construction. The full norm is equally explicit. Put Z=Q^N=q^(2N) and theta_s=(-1)^s q^[N(L_s-1)]. The elementary deck product gives \[ \boxed{\ \mathcal N_s(q,t):=\operatorname{Norm}\Pi_s =\prod_{r=0}^{L_s-1}(1+\theta_s Z^{-r}t).\ } \tag{5} \] Indeed Norm(1+a x)=1-(-a)^N epsilon_s t, and (-1)^N epsilon_s=-(-1)^s. No peripheral sign or central power has been removed in (5). This is a finite factorial in the WHOLE power coordinate Z, distinct from its value Z=1. On a marked cover let nu_s^N=mathcal N_s, with nu_s=1 at t=0. Then c_s=Pi_s/nu_s has norm one and \[ P_s=\nu_s\,\frac{\operatorname{Tr}c_s}{N}. \tag{6} \] Thus the source polynomial is a selected trace in a concrete norm torsor. A norm-one statement about c_s does not by itself give the trace in (6); both are specified here. Zeros of the norm or trace remain part of the lattice/domain data. There is an exact power-parameter law for the SAME source product. Put q_hat=-q^N, so q_hat^2=Z and q_hat=1 at the marked root. Since L_s-1 has parity s, (5) becomes \[ \operatorname{Norm}\Pi_s(q,x) =\prod_{r=0}^{L_s-1}(1+\widehat q^{L_s-1-2r}t) =\sum_{j=0}^{L_s}{L_s\brack j}_{\widehat q}t^j. \tag{6a} \] Thus the Kummer norm is the identical finite Gaussian product at the power parameter -q^N. Its chosen root restriction is a classical binomial product. This is an algebraic identity; it does not assert a modular-group action or equate different knot states. The norm and selected trace also retain different normal data. Write v=Log Z with v=0 at the marked root. Pairing the symmetric exponents in (6a) gives \[ [\partial_v\log\mathcal N_s]_0=0,\qquad [v^2]\log\mathcal N_s =\frac{t L_s(L_s^2-1)}{24(1+t)^2}. \tag{6b} \] Indeed their sum is zero and their squared sum is L_s(L_s^2-1)/12. The source trace in (9) generally has a nonzero FIRST normal on middle residue strings. That information is in its specified cyclic trace, even though the norm's first derivative vanishes. ## 3. Its actual root restriction and normalization Write L_s=N^2+b_s, b_s=N-1-s. At q_N every block of N factors in Pi_s contributes EXACTLY 1+t: the sign from q_N^N=-1 cancels epsilon_s as in (1). There are N full blocks. The remaining polynomial has degree b_s<N, so its deck average is one. Therefore \[ P_s(q_N,t)=(1+t)^N,\qquad A_{k,s}(q_N)={N\choose k}. \tag{7} \] One can also verify (7) by cancelling the root zero factors in the Gaussian product. Its symmetric phase is (-1)^[k(N-1-s)], which epsilon_s^k cancels for every s and every parity of N. Equations (5)--(6) keep a useful fractional head correction: \[ \mathcal N_s(q_N,t)=(1+t)^{L_s},\quad \nu_s(q_N,t)=(1+t)^{N+b_s/N},\quad \frac{\operatorname{Tr}c_s(q_N)}N=(1+t)^{-b_s/N}. \tag{8} \] All branches have the same mark at t=0. The product is (7). Dropping either factor would change the source character. In particular the original selected dual gives the endpoint E_(N,0) the value 2^(-N), with the full N-th power still visible. ## 4. First normal equals an explicit flag connection Use delta=1-Q^N and q=q_N(1-delta)^(1/(2N)). Set \[ \ell_s=-\frac12\sum_{a=1}^{s} \frac{q_N^a+q_N^{-a}}{q_N^a-q_N^{-a}}. \] Then the actual Gaussian polynomial has the exact first derivative \[ [\partial_\delta A_{k,s}]_0=k\ell_s{N\choose k},\qquad [\partial_\delta P_s]_0=\ell_s N t(1+t)^{N-1}. \tag{9} \] Here is a direct cancellation proof. Split the symmetric Gaussian product into arguments divisible by N and the remaining residues. Ratios of the vanishing q-integers have zero first relative logarithmic derivative: after their simple zeros cancel they are ratios of odd sinh functions. For each of the k nonzero residue blocks, cyclic reindexing leaves N sum_(a<=b_s) cot_q(a) in the q-log derivative. Pairing residues a and N-a makes that sum equal N sum_(a<=s) cot_q(a). Finally q partial_q=-2N partial_delta at the root. This gives (9), including its sign. At the normalized selected point t=1, the dual's first derivative is \[ [\partial_\delta\lambda_s(w_k)]_0 =2^{-N}{N\choose k}\ell_s(k-N/2). \tag{10} \] More generally it is ell_s t partial_t of the normalized root dual. Thus the first normal is a concrete source-flag transport. The same ell_s is the original head connection in [the whole Jackson current](endpoint_completed_normal_clock_euler_current.md). It vanishes for s=0,N-1; middle strings retain it. Higher normals remain those of the WHOLE polynomial (4), with no assertion that they are all a single flag reparameterization. ## 5. Exact pivotal/moment character and the original coupon gauge On this residue string J=kN+s.
